% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_11, "findMajorityElement": scanning an integer list for the
% first value occurring strictly more than half the list length, or returning
% -1 when no such value is found. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_11: THEORY
BEGIN

  findMajorityElement_precond(lst: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_list_length(lst: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES lst OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail): int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE lst BY <<

  countOccurrences(n: int, lst: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES lst OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = n THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + countOccurrences(n, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE lst BY <<

  findMajorityElement_scan(
      original, remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES remaining OF
      null: -1,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF countOccurrences(head, original)
             > ndiv(int_list_length(original), 2)
        THEN
          head
        ELSE
          findMajorityElement_scan(original, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  findMajorityElement(lst: list[int]): int =
    findMajorityElement_scan(lst, lst)

  all_at_most_half(
      original, remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        countOccurrences(head, original)
            <= ndiv(int_list_length(original), 2)
          AND all_at_most_half(original, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  all_at_most_half_or_result(
      result: int,
      original, remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (countOccurrences(head, original)
             <= ndiv(int_list_length(original), 2)
           OR head = result)
          AND all_at_most_half_or_result(
            result,
            original,
            tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  majority(
      lst: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    countOccurrences(result, lst)
        > ndiv(int_list_length(lst), 2)
      AND all_at_most_half_or_result(result, lst, lst)

  findMajorityElement_postcond(
      lst: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    (result = -1 IMPLIES
      all_at_most_half(lst, lst) OR majority(lst, result))
      AND (result /= -1 IMPLIES majority(lst, result))

  findMajorityElement_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (lst: list[int]):
      findMajorityElement_precond(lst) IMPLIES
        findMajorityElement_postcond(
          lst,
          findMajorityElement(lst))

END verina_advanced_11

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_12,
   catalog title "firstDuplicate": an executable left-to-right list scan that
   returns the first integer encountered for a second time, together with its
   earliest-second-occurrence correctness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition firstDuplicate_precond (lst : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint firstDuplicate_helper
    (seen remaining : list Z) : option Z :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => None
  | x :: xs =>
      if existsb (fun y => Z.eqb y x) seen
      then Some x
      else firstDuplicate_helper (x :: seen) xs
  end.

Definition firstDuplicate
    (lst : list Z)
    (_h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst) : option Z :=
  firstDuplicate_helper [] lst.

Fixpoint firstDuplicate_idxOf
    (lst : list Z) (v : Z) : nat :=
  match lst with
  | [] => 0%nat
  | x :: xs =>
      if Z.eqb x v
      then 0%nat
      else S (firstDuplicate_idxOf xs v)
  end.

Definition secondOccIdx (lst : list Z) (v : Z) : nat :=
  let first := firstDuplicate_idxOf lst v in
  first + 1 + firstDuplicate_idxOf (skipn (first + 1) lst) v.

Definition firstDuplicate_postcond
    (lst : list Z)
    (result : option Z)
    (_h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst) : Prop :=
  match result with
  | None => NoDup lst
  | Some x =>
      (1 < count_occ Z.eq_dec lst x)%nat /\
      forallb
        (fun y =>
          orb
            (Nat.eqb (count_occ Z.eq_dec lst y) 1)
            (Nat.leb (secondOccIdx lst x) (secondOccIdx lst y)))
        lst = true
  end.

Theorem firstDuplicate_spec_satisfied
    (lst : list Z)
    (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst) :
  firstDuplicate_postcond
    lst (firstDuplicate lst h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_12,
  catalog title "firstDuplicate": an executable list program returns the first
  integer whose repeated occurrence is encountered when scanning left to
  right, or None for a duplicate-free list, together with its correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_12
  imports Main
begin

definition firstDuplicate_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "firstDuplicate_precond lst \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun firstDuplicate_helper ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int option" where
  "firstDuplicate_helper seen [] = None"
| "firstDuplicate_helper seen (x # xs) =
    (if x \<in> set seen
     then Some x
     else firstDuplicate_helper (x # seen) xs)"

definition firstDuplicate :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int option" where
  "firstDuplicate lst = firstDuplicate_helper [] lst"

fun firstDuplicate_idxOf :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "firstDuplicate_idxOf [] v = 0"
| "firstDuplicate_idxOf (x # xs) v =
    (if x = v then 0 else Suc (firstDuplicate_idxOf xs v))"

definition secondOccIdx :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "secondOccIdx lst v =
    (let first = firstDuplicate_idxOf lst v
     in first + 1 + firstDuplicate_idxOf (drop (first + 1) lst) v)"

definition firstDuplicate_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int option \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "firstDuplicate_postcond lst result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (case result of
       None \<Rightarrow> distinct lst
     | Some x \<Rightarrow>
         count_list lst x > 1 \<and>
         list_all
           (\<lambda>y. count_list lst y = 1 \<or>
             secondOccIdx lst x \<le> secondOccIdx lst y)
           lst)"

theorem firstDuplicate_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "firstDuplicate_precond lst"
  shows "firstDuplicate_postcond lst (firstDuplicate lst)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_12,
  catalog title "firstDuplicate": an executable left-to-right list scan returns
  the first integer encountered for a second time, with its total precondition
  and occurrence-index postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let firstDuplicate_precond = new_definition
  `firstDuplicate_precond (lst:int list) <=> T`;;

let firstDuplicate_helper =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(firstDuplicate_helper (seen:int list) [] = (NONE:int option)) /\
     (!h:int. !t:int list. !seen:int list.
        firstDuplicate_helper seen (CONS h t) =
        if MEM h seen
        then SOME h
        else firstDuplicate_helper (CONS h seen) t)`;;

let firstDuplicate = new_definition
  `firstDuplicate (lst:int list) = firstDuplicate_helper [] lst`;;

let firstDuplicate_idxOf =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(firstDuplicate_idxOf (v:int) [] = 0) /\
     (!h:int. !t:int list. !v:int.
        firstDuplicate_idxOf v (CONS h t) =
        if h = v then 0 else SUC (firstDuplicate_idxOf v t))`;;

let firstDuplicate_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!lst:int list. firstDuplicate_drop 0 lst = lst) /\
     (!n:num. !lst:int list.
        firstDuplicate_drop (SUC n) lst =
        if lst = [] then [] else firstDuplicate_drop n (TL lst))`;;

let secondOccIdx = new_definition
  `secondOccIdx (lst:int list) (v:int) =
     let first = firstDuplicate_idxOf v lst in
     first + 1 +
     firstDuplicate_idxOf v (firstDuplicate_drop (first + 1) lst)`;;

let firstDuplicate_count = new_definition
  `firstDuplicate_count (lst:int list) (v:int) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = v) lst)`;;

let firstDuplicate_nodup =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(firstDuplicate_nodup ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!h:int. !t:int list.
        firstDuplicate_nodup (CONS h t) <=>
        ~MEM h t /\ firstDuplicate_nodup t)`;;

let firstDuplicate_postcond = new_definition
  `firstDuplicate_postcond
      (lst:int list) (result:int option) <=>
     (result = NONE /\ firstDuplicate_nodup lst) \/
     (?x:int.
        result = SOME x /\
        firstDuplicate_count lst x > 1 /\
        ALL
          (\y:int.
             firstDuplicate_count lst y = 1 \/
             secondOccIdx lst x <= secondOccIdx lst y)
          lst)`;;

let firstDuplicate_spec_satisfied =
  `!lst:int list.
     firstDuplicate_precond lst
     ==> firstDuplicate_postcond lst (firstDuplicate lst)`;;

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_12,
;; "firstDuplicate": a deterministic left-to-right scan returns the first
;; integer encountered for a second time, or none when the input has no
;; duplicates, together with its correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-12-integer-listp (lst)
  (if (consp lst)
      (and
       (integerp (car lst))
       (verina-advanced-12-integer-listp (cdr lst)))
    (equal lst nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the List Int type is made explicit in the
;; final statement predicate.

(defun verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-precond (lst)
  (declare (ignore lst))
  t)

;; Option Int is represented by :none or by the tagged pair (:some . value).

(defun verina-advanced-12-option-int-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result :none)
   (and
    (consp result)
    (equal (car result) :some)
    (integerp (cdr result)))))

(defun verina-advanced-12-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-helper (seen remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (member-equal (car remaining) seen)
          (verina-advanced-12-some (car remaining))
        (verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-helper
         (cons (car remaining) seen)
         (cdr remaining)))
    :none))

(defun verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate (lst)
  (verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-helper nil lst))

(defun verina-advanced-12-list-count (value lst)
  (if (consp lst)
      (+
       (if (equal (car lst) value) 1 0)
       (verina-advanced-12-list-count value (cdr lst)))
    0))

;; This is List.idxOf: failure at the empty suffix returns zero, so failure in
;; a nonempty list returns that list's length through the recursive increments.

(defun verina-advanced-12-index-of (value lst)
  (if (consp lst)
      (if (equal (car lst) value)
          0
        (+ 1
           (verina-advanced-12-index-of value (cdr lst))))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-12-drop (count lst)
  (if (and (posp count) (consp lst))
      (verina-advanced-12-drop (- count 1) (cdr lst))
    lst))

(defun verina-advanced-12-second-occ-index (lst value)
  (let ((first
         (verina-advanced-12-index-of value lst)))
    (+
     first
     1
     (verina-advanced-12-index-of
      value
      (verina-advanced-12-drop (+ first 1) lst)))))

(defun verina-advanced-12-no-duplicates-p (lst)
  (if (consp lst)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car lst) (cdr lst)))
       (verina-advanced-12-no-duplicates-p (cdr lst)))
    (equal lst nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-12-all-second-indices-at-least-p
    (remaining whole first-duplicate)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or
        (equal
         (verina-advanced-12-list-count
          (car remaining) whole)
         1)
        (<=
         (verina-advanced-12-second-occ-index
          whole first-duplicate)
         (verina-advanced-12-second-occ-index
          whole (car remaining))))
       (verina-advanced-12-all-second-indices-at-least-p
        (cdr remaining) whole first-duplicate))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-postcond
    (lst result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-12-integer-listp lst)
   (verina-advanced-12-option-int-p result)
   (if (equal result :none)
       (verina-advanced-12-no-duplicates-p lst)
     (let ((value (cdr result)))
       (and
        (< 1
           (verina-advanced-12-list-count value lst))
        (verina-advanced-12-all-second-indices-at-least-p
         lst lst value))))))

(defun verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-spec-satisfied-statement
    (lst)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-12-integer-listp lst)
    (verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-precond lst))
   (verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate-postcond
    lst
    (verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate lst))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_12,
-- catalog title "firstDuplicate": a deterministic list program returns the
-- first integer whose second occurrence is encountered from left to right,
-- or no value when the input has no duplicates. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced12 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ _∈_
infixr 5 _||_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

one : Nat
one = suc zero

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

FirstDuplicate-precond : List Int → Set
FirstDuplicate-precond lst = Top

firstDuplicateHelper : List Int → List Int → Maybe Int
firstDuplicateHelper seen [] = nothing
firstDuplicateHelper seen (x ∷ xs) =
  if containsInt x seen
  then just x
  else firstDuplicateHelper (x ∷ seen) xs

firstDuplicate :
  (lst : List Int) →
  FirstDuplicate-precond lst →
  Maybe Int
firstDuplicate lst h-precond = firstDuplicateHelper [] lst

countInt : Int → List Int → Nat
countInt sought [] = zero
countInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then suc (countInt sought xs)
  else countInt sought xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

indexOf : Int → List Int → Nat
indexOf sought [] = zero
indexOf sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then zero
  else suc (indexOf sought xs)

secondOccurrenceIndex : List Int → Int → Nat
secondOccurrenceIndex lst value =
  let firstIndex = indexOf value lst
  in firstIndex + one +
     indexOf value (dropList (firstIndex + one) lst)

allSecondOccurrencesAfter :
  Int → List Int → List Int → Bool
allSecondOccurrencesAfter duplicate original [] = true
allSecondOccurrencesAfter duplicate original (y ∷ ys) =
  if
    natEqual (countInt y original) one ||
    natLessOrEqual
      (secondOccurrenceIndex original duplicate)
      (secondOccurrenceIndex original y)
  then allSecondOccurrencesAfter duplicate original ys
  else false

data _∈_ (x : Int) : List Int → Set where
  here : {xs : List Int} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : Int} {xs : List Int} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

NoDuplicates : List Int → Set
NoDuplicates [] = Top
NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs) = Not (x ∈ xs) ∧ NoDuplicates xs

FirstDuplicate-postcond :
  (lst : List Int) →
  (result : Maybe Int) →
  FirstDuplicate-precond lst →
  Set
FirstDuplicate-postcond lst nothing h-precond = NoDuplicates lst
FirstDuplicate-postcond lst (just x) h-precond =
  (one < countInt x lst) ∧
  IsTrue (allSecondOccurrencesAfter x lst lst)

FirstDuplicate-spec-satisfied : Set
FirstDuplicate-spec-satisfied =
  (lst : List Int) →
  (h-precond : FirstDuplicate-precond lst) →
  FirstDuplicate-postcond
    lst
    (firstDuplicate lst h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_12,
  cataloged as "firstDuplicate": the recursive program returns the first
  integer whose second occurrence is encountered while scanning left to
  right, or NONE when the input list has no duplicates.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val firstDuplicate_precond_def = new_definition (
  "firstDuplicate_precond_def",
  ``firstDuplicate_precond (lst : int list) <=> T``
);

val firstDuplicate_helper_def = Define `
  (firstDuplicate_helper (seen : int list) ([] : int list) =
     (NONE : int option)) /\
  (firstDuplicate_helper seen (h::t) =
     if MEM h seen then
       SOME h
     else
       firstDuplicate_helper (h::seen) t)
`;

val firstDuplicate_def = new_definition (
  "firstDuplicate_def",
  ``firstDuplicate (lst : int list) =
      firstDuplicate_helper ([] : int list) lst``
);

val firstDuplicate_idxOf_def = Define `
  (firstDuplicate_idxOf (v : int) ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (firstDuplicate_idxOf v (h::t) =
     if h = v then 0 else SUC (firstDuplicate_idxOf v t))
`;

val secondOccIdx_def = new_definition (
  "secondOccIdx_def",
  ``secondOccIdx (lst : int list) (v : int) =
      let first = firstDuplicate_idxOf v lst
      in
        first + 1 +
        firstDuplicate_idxOf v (DROP (first + 1) lst)``
);

val firstDuplicate_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "firstDuplicate_postcond_def",
  ``firstDuplicate_postcond
      (lst : int list) (result : int option) <=>
      case result of
        NONE => ALL_DISTINCT lst
      | SOME x =>
          LENGTH (FILTER (\y : int. y = x) lst) > 1 /\
          EVERY
            (\y : int.
              LENGTH (FILTER (\z : int. z = y) lst) = 1 \/
              secondOccIdx lst x <= secondOccIdx lst y)
            lst``
);

val firstDuplicate_spec_satisfied =
  ``!lst : int list.
      firstDuplicate_precond lst ==>
      firstDuplicate_postcond lst (firstDuplicate lst)``;

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_12, catalog title firstDuplicate: an executable
  left-to-right scan of a finite integer list returns the first value whose
  occurrence repeats, or none when the list has no duplicate, together with
  its count and second-occurrence correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k
  is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA12None, VERINA12Some, and VERINA12OptionInt give a disjoint tagged
  encoding of Option Int. VERINA12Count is List.count. The predicate
  VERINA12DuplicateAt seen rem k says that rem[k] is already in seen or
  occurs earlier in rem. Consequently VERINA12HelperGraph selects the least
  such k and returns some rem[k], or returns none exactly when no such k
  exists. VERINA12Helper is the unique output of that graph, and
  VERINA12FirstDuplicate applies it to the empty seen word and the input
  word. This is the exact graph of the source recursion on every pair of
  typed seen and remaining lists, not merely an output satisfying the
  postcondition.

  VERINA12SecondOccGraph is exactly secondOccIdx. With at least two
  occurrences it returns the least index that has an earlier equal entry;
  with exactly one occurrence it returns the list length; and with no
  occurrence it returns length plus one, matching idxOf and drop/idxOf in
  every case. VERINA12Nodup and VERINA12Post reproduce List.Nodup and the
  Option match, duplicate-count clause, and list-wide comparison of second
  occurrence indices. The proof-valued True precondition argument is
  computationally unused and is omitted from the target function. The final
  $a declaration applies that executable result to the complete
  postcondition under the source precondition. Every earlier $a is syntax or
  a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA12None VERINA12Some VERINA12OptionInt
  VERINA12Count VERINA12DuplicateAt
  VERINA12HelperGraph VERINA12Helper VERINA12FirstDuplicate
  VERINA12Pre VERINA12Nodup
  VERINA12SecondOccGraph VERINA12SecondOccIdx VERINA12Post
$.

verina12-none-syntax $a class VERINA12None $.
verina12-some-syntax $a class ( VERINA12Some A ) $.
verina12-option-int-syntax $a class VERINA12OptionInt $.
verina12-count-syntax $a class ( VERINA12Count A B ) $.
verina12-duplicate-at-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA12DuplicateAt A B C ) $.
verina12-helper-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA12HelperGraph A B C ) $.
verina12-helper-syntax $a class ( VERINA12Helper A B ) $.
verina12-first-duplicate-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA12FirstDuplicate A ) $.
verina12-precondition-syntax $a wff ( VERINA12Pre A ) $.
verina12-nodup-syntax $a wff ( VERINA12Nodup A ) $.
verina12-second-occ-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA12SecondOccGraph A B C ) $.
verina12-second-occ-idx-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA12SecondOccIdx A B ) $.
verina12-postcondition-syntax $a wff ( VERINA12Post A B ) $.

verina12-none-definition $a |- VERINA12None = (/) $.

verina12-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA12Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina12-option-int-definition $a |- VERINA12OptionInt =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA12None
        \/
        E. y e. ZZ x = ( VERINA12Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina12-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
      |
      ( B ` k ) = A
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina12-duplicate-at-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12DuplicateAt A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( B ` C ) e. ran A
      \/
      E. j e. ( 0 ..^ C )
        ( B ` j ) = ( B ` C )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k m A B C $.

  verina12-helper-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12HelperGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINA12OptionInt
    )
    /\
    (
      E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          ( VERINA12DuplicateAt A B k )
          /\
          (
            C = ( VERINA12Some ( B ` k ) )
            /\
            A. m e. ( 0 ..^ k )
              -. ( VERINA12DuplicateAt A B m )
          )
        )
      \/
      (
        -.
        E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( VERINA12DuplicateAt A B k )
        /\
        C = VERINA12None
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d o A B $.

  verina12-helper-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12Helper A B
  ) = (
    iota_ o e. VERINA12OptionInt
      ( VERINA12HelperGraph A B o )
  ) $.
$}

verina12-first-duplicate-definition $a |- (
  VERINA12FirstDuplicate A
) = (
  VERINA12Helper (/) A
) $.

verina12-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA12Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina12-nodup-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12Nodup A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i =/= j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) =/= ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k A B C $.

  verina12-second-occ-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12SecondOccGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        (
          C e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          /\
          (
            ( A ` C ) = B
            /\
            E. j e. ( 0 ..^ C )
              ( A ` j ) = B
          )
        )
        /\
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          -.
          (
            ( A ` k ) = B
            /\
            E. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
              ( A ` i ) = B
          )
      )
      \/
      (
        ( VERINA12Count B A ) = 1
        /\
        C = ( # ` A )
      )
      \/
      (
        ( VERINA12Count B A ) = 0
        /\
        C = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d n A B $.

  verina12-second-occ-idx-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12SecondOccIdx A B
  ) = (
    iota_ n e. NN0
      ( VERINA12SecondOccGraph A B n )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k x A B $.

  verina12-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA12Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. VERINA12OptionInt
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          B = VERINA12None
          /\
          ( VERINA12Nodup A )
        )
        \/
        E. x e. ZZ
          (
            B = ( VERINA12Some x )
            /\
            (
              1 < ( VERINA12Count x A )
              /\
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  ( VERINA12Count ( A ` k ) A ) = 1
                  \/
                  (
                    VERINA12SecondOccIdx A x
                  ) <_ (
                    VERINA12SecondOccIdx A ( A ` k )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-12-first-duplicate $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINA12Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA12Post
        w
        ( VERINA12FirstDuplicate w )
    )
  )
$.
