content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_12, catalog title "firstDuplicate": an exact finite-
:: sequence graph of the unconditional precondition, left-to-right
:: first-duplicate implementation, second-occurrence index helper,
:: postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, NUMBERS,
    NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, XXREAL_0;
  constructors RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, REAL_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    INT_1, FINSEQ_1, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1,
    INT_1, FINSEQ_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for lst,result being FinSequence of INT st
    0 = 0 &
    ((len result = 0 &
      for i,j being Nat st
        i in dom lst & j in dom lst & lst.i = lst.j
      holds i = j) or
     (len result = 1 &
      ex q,p being Nat st
        q in dom lst & p in dom lst & p < q &
        result.1 = lst.q & lst.p = lst.q &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom lst & h in dom lst & h < k & k < q
        holds lst.h <> lst.k))
  holds
    (len result = 0 implies
      for i,j being Nat st
        i in dom lst & j in dom lst & lst.i = lst.j
      holds i = j) &
    (len result = 1 implies
      len Seq (lst | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom lst & lst.i = result.1}) > 1 &
      ex sx,fx being Nat st
        sx in dom lst & fx in dom lst & fx < sx &
        lst.sx = result.1 & lst.fx = result.1 &
        (for k being Nat st
          k in dom lst & k < sx & lst.k = result.1
        holds k = fx) &
        for i being Nat st i in dom lst holds
          len Seq (lst | {j where j is Nat :
            j in dom lst & lst.j = lst.i}) = 1 or
          ex sy,fy being Nat st
            sy in dom lst & fy in dom lst & fy < sy &
            lst.sy = lst.i & lst.fy = lst.i &
            (for k being Nat st
              k in dom lst & k < sy & lst.k = lst.i
            holds k = fy) &
            sx <= sy)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_12
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_12, "firstDuplicate": scanning an integer list from left to
% right to return the value whose duplicate occurrence is encountered first,
% or no value when the list has no duplicates. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_12: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoneInt: NoneInt?
    SomeInt(option_value: int): SomeInt?
  END int_option

  firstDuplicate_precond(lst: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_member(value: int, values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = value OR int_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  firstDuplicate_helper(
      seen, remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE int_option =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        NoneInt,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF int_member(head, seen) THEN
          SomeInt(head)
        ELSE
          firstDuplicate_helper(cons(head, seen), tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  firstDuplicate(lst: list[int]): int_option =
    firstDuplicate_helper(null, lst)

  occurrence_count(value: int, values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  index_of(value: int, values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head = value THEN
          0
        ELSE
          1 + index_of(value, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  list_drop(count: nat, values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  secondOccIdx(lst: list[int], value: int): nat =
    LET first: nat = index_of(value, lst)
    IN
      first + 1 + index_of(value, list_drop(first + 1, lst))

  no_duplicates(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT int_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicates(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_second_occurrences_not_earlier(
      original, remaining: list[int],
      result_value: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (occurrence_count(head, original) = 1
          OR secondOccIdx(original, result_value)
               <= secondOccIdx(original, head))
          AND all_second_occurrences_not_earlier(
            original,
            tail,
            result_value)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  firstDuplicate_postcond(
      lst: list[int],
      result: int_option): bool =
    CASES result OF
      NoneInt:
        no_duplicates(lst),
      SomeInt(value):
        occurrence_count(value, lst) > 1
          AND all_second_occurrences_not_earlier(
            lst,
            lst,
            value)
    ENDCASES

  firstDuplicate_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (lst: list[int]):
      firstDuplicate_precond(lst) IMPLIES
        firstDuplicate_postcond(
          lst,
          firstDuplicate(lst))

END verina_advanced_12

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "hasChordIntersection" from VERINA item verina_advanced_13.
-- This file contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux

-- !benchmark @end solution_aux

-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible]
def hasChordIntersection_precond (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  N ≥ 2 ∧
  chords.length = N ∧
  chords.all (fun chord => chord.length = 2 ∧ chord[0]! ≥ 1 ∧ chord[0]! ≤ 2 * N ∧ chord[1]! ≥ 1 ∧ chord[1]! ≤ 2 * N) ∧
  List.Nodup (chords.flatMap id)
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def hasChordIntersection (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond (N) (chords)) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord =>
    let a := chord[0]!
    let b := chord[1]!
    if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b]
  )

  let rec checkIntersection (stack : List (List Nat)) (remaining : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
    match remaining with
    | [] => false
    | chord :: rest =>
      let a := chord[0]!
      let b := chord[1]!
      let newStack := stack.dropWhile (fun c => (c)[1]! < a)
      match newStack with
      | [] => checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest
      | top :: _ =>
        if top[1]! > a && top[1]! < b then
          true
        else
          checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest

  let rec insert (x : List Nat) (xs : List (List Nat)) : List (List Nat) :=
    match xs with
    | [] => [x]
    | y :: ys => if x[0]! < y[0]! then x :: xs else y :: insert x ys

  let rec sort (xs : List (List Nat)) : List (List Nat) :=
    match xs with
    | [] => []
    | x :: xs => insert x (sort xs)

  let sortedChords := sort sortedChords
  checkIntersection [] sortedChords
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def hasChordIntersection_postcond (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (result: Bool) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond (N) (chords)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord =>
    let a := chord[0]!
    let b := chord[1]!
    if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b]
  )

  let rec hasIntersection (chord1 : List Nat) (chord2 : List Nat) : Bool :=
    let a1 := chord1[0]!
    let b1 := chord1[1]!
    let a2 := chord2[0]!
    let b2 := chord2[1]!
    (a1 < a2 && a2 < b1 && b1 < b2) || (a2 < a1 && a1 < b2 && b2 < b1)

  let rec checkAllPairs (chords : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
    match chords with
    | [] => false
    | x :: xs =>
      if xs.any (fun y => hasIntersection x y) then true
      else checkAllPairs xs

  ((List.Pairwise (fun x y => !hasIntersection x y) sortedChords) → ¬ result) ∧
  ((sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasIntersection x y))) → result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied (N: Nat) (chords: List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond (N) (chords)) :
    hasChordIntersection_postcond (N) (chords) (hasChordIntersection (N) (chords) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_13,
   catalog title "hasChordIntersection": an executable normalization,
   insertion sort, and stack scan for intersecting circle chords, together
   with its correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition hasChordIntersection_endpoint
    (index : nat) (chord : list nat) : nat :=
  nth index chord 0%nat.

Definition hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord
    (chord : list nat) : list nat :=
  let a := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat chord in
  let b := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord in
  if Nat.ltb b a then [b; a] else [a; b].

Definition hasChordIntersection_precond
    (N : nat) (chords : list (list nat)) : Prop :=
  (2 <= N)%nat /\
  length chords = N /\
  forallb
    (fun chord =>
      let a := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat chord in
      let b := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord in
      andb
        (Nat.eqb (length chord) 2%nat)
        (andb
          (Nat.leb 1%nat a)
          (andb
            (Nat.leb a (2 * N)%nat)
            (andb
              (Nat.leb 1%nat b)
              (Nat.leb b (2 * N)%nat)))))
    chords = true /\
  NoDup (concat chords).

Fixpoint hasChordIntersection_dropWhile
    (a : nat) (stack : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  match stack with
  | [] => []
  | chord :: rest =>
      if Nat.ltb
           (hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord)
           a
      then hasChordIntersection_dropWhile a rest
      else stack
  end.

Fixpoint hasChordIntersection_checkIntersection
    (stack remaining : list (list nat)) : bool :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => false
  | chord :: rest =>
      let a := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat chord in
      let b := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord in
      let newStack := hasChordIntersection_dropWhile a stack in
      match newStack with
      | [] =>
          hasChordIntersection_checkIntersection
            (chord :: newStack) rest
      | top :: _ =>
          let top_b :=
            hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat top in
          if andb (Nat.ltb a top_b) (Nat.ltb top_b b)
          then true
          else
            hasChordIntersection_checkIntersection
              (chord :: newStack) rest
      end
  end.

Fixpoint hasChordIntersection_insert
    (x : list nat) (xs : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if Nat.ltb
           (hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat x)
           (hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat y)
      then x :: xs
      else y :: hasChordIntersection_insert x ys
  end.

Fixpoint hasChordIntersection_sort
    (xs : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      hasChordIntersection_insert
        x (hasChordIntersection_sort rest)
  end.

Definition hasChordIntersection
    (N : nat)
    (chords : list (list nat))
    (_h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords) : bool :=
  let normalized :=
    map hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord chords in
  let sorted := hasChordIntersection_sort normalized in
  hasChordIntersection_checkIntersection [] sorted.

Definition hasChordIntersection_pair
    (chord1 chord2 : list nat) : bool :=
  let a1 := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat chord1 in
  let b1 := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord1 in
  let a2 := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 0%nat chord2 in
  let b2 := hasChordIntersection_endpoint 1%nat chord2 in
  orb
    (andb (Nat.ltb a1 a2)
      (andb (Nat.ltb a2 b1) (Nat.ltb b1 b2)))
    (andb (Nat.ltb a2 a1)
      (andb (Nat.ltb a1 b2) (Nat.ltb b2 b1))).

Fixpoint hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs
    (chords : list (list nat)) : bool :=
  match chords with
  | [] => false
  | x :: xs =>
      if existsb (hasChordIntersection_pair x) xs
      then true
      else hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs xs
  end.

Definition hasChordIntersection_postcond
    (N : nat)
    (chords : list (list nat))
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords) : Prop :=
  let normalized :=
    map hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord chords in
  (ForallOrdPairs
     (fun x y =>
       negb (hasChordIntersection_pair x y) = true)
     normalized ->
   ~ result = true) /\
  (existsb
     (fun x =>
       existsb
         (fun y => hasChordIntersection_pair x y)
         normalized)
     normalized = true ->
   result = true).

Theorem hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied
    (N : nat)
    (chords : list (list nat))
    (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords) :
  hasChordIntersection_postcond
    N chords
    (hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_13,
  catalog title "hasChordIntersection": an executable program normalizes and
  sorts chords, then scans them for an endpoint interleaving that represents
  an intersection, together with its precondition and correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_13
  imports Main
begin

fun chordEndpoint :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "chordEndpoint [] i = 0"
| "chordEndpoint (x # xs) 0 = x"
| "chordEndpoint (x # xs) (Suc i) = chordEndpoint xs i"

definition hasChordIntersection_precond ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "hasChordIntersection_precond N chords \<longleftrightarrow>
    N \<ge> 2 \<and>
    length chords = N \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>chord.
        length chord = 2 \<and>
        chordEndpoint chord 0 \<ge> 1 \<and>
        chordEndpoint chord 0 \<le> 2 * N \<and>
        chordEndpoint chord 1 \<ge> 1 \<and>
        chordEndpoint chord 1 \<le> 2 * N)
      chords \<and>
    distinct (concat chords)"

definition normalizeChord :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "normalizeChord chord =
    (let a = chordEndpoint chord 0;
         b = chordEndpoint chord 1
     in if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b])"

fun checkIntersection ::
    "nat list list \<Rightarrow> nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "checkIntersection stack [] = False"
| "checkIntersection stack (chord # rest) =
    (let a = chordEndpoint chord 0;
         b = chordEndpoint chord 1;
         newStack =
           dropWhile (\<lambda>c. chordEndpoint c 1 < a) stack
     in case newStack of
          [] \<Rightarrow> checkIntersection (chord # newStack) rest
        | headChord # tail \<Rightarrow>
            (if chordEndpoint headChord 1 > a \<and>
                chordEndpoint headChord 1 < b
             then True
             else checkIntersection (chord # newStack) rest))"

fun insertChord ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list list \<Rightarrow> nat list list" where
  "insertChord x [] = [x]"
| "insertChord x (y # ys) =
    (if chordEndpoint x 0 < chordEndpoint y 0
     then x # y # ys
     else y # insertChord x ys)"

fun sortChords :: "nat list list \<Rightarrow> nat list list" where
  "sortChords [] = []"
| "sortChords (x # xs) = insertChord x (sortChords xs)"

definition hasChordIntersection ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "hasChordIntersection N chords =
    checkIntersection [] (sortChords (map normalizeChord chords))"

definition hasIntersection ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "hasIntersection chord1 chord2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let a1 = chordEndpoint chord1 0;
         b1 = chordEndpoint chord1 1;
         a2 = chordEndpoint chord2 0;
         b2 = chordEndpoint chord2 1
     in (a1 < a2 \<and> a2 < b1 \<and> b1 < b2) \<or>
        (a2 < a1 \<and> a1 < b2 \<and> b2 < b1))"

fun checkAllPairs :: "nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "checkAllPairs [] = False"
| "checkAllPairs (x # xs) =
    (if list_ex (hasIntersection x) xs
     then True
     else checkAllPairs xs)"

fun pairwiseNoIntersection :: "nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "pairwiseNoIntersection [] = True"
| "pairwiseNoIntersection (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. \<not> hasIntersection x y) xs \<and>
     pairwiseNoIntersection xs)"

definition hasChordIntersection_postcond ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list list \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "hasChordIntersection_postcond N chords result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let sortedChords = map normalizeChord chords
     in (pairwiseNoIntersection sortedChords \<longrightarrow> \<not> result) \<and>
        (list_ex
           (\<lambda>x. list_ex (\<lambda>y. hasIntersection x y) sortedChords)
           sortedChords
         \<longrightarrow> result))"

theorem hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "hasChordIntersection_precond N chords"
  shows
    "hasChordIntersection_postcond
      N chords (hasChordIntersection N chords)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_13,
  catalog title "hasChordIntersection": an executable normalization, insertion
  sort, and stack scan detects crossings among chords with distinct numbered
  endpoints, together with its correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let hasChordIntersection_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:num list.
        hasChordIntersection_get 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then 0 else HD xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:num list.
        hasChordIntersection_get (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then 0
        else hasChordIntersection_get n (TL xs))`;;

let hasChordIntersection_first = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_first (chord:num list) =
     hasChordIntersection_get 0 chord`;;

let hasChordIntersection_second = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_second (chord:num list) =
     hasChordIntersection_get 1 chord`;;

let hasChordIntersection_flatten =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_flatten ([]:(num list)list) = []) /\
     (!chord:num list. !chords:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_flatten (CONS chord chords) =
        APPEND chord (hasChordIntersection_flatten chords))`;;

let hasChordIntersection_nodup =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_nodup ([]:num list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list.
        hasChordIntersection_nodup (CONS x xs) <=>
        ~MEM x xs /\ hasChordIntersection_nodup xs)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_precond = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_precond
      (N:num) (chords:(num list)list) <=>
     2 <= N /\
     LENGTH chords = N /\
     ALL
       (\chord:num list.
          LENGTH chord = 2 /\
          1 <= hasChordIntersection_first chord /\
          hasChordIntersection_first chord <= 2 * N /\
          1 <= hasChordIntersection_second chord /\
          hasChordIntersection_second chord <= 2 * N)
       chords /\
     hasChordIntersection_nodup
       (hasChordIntersection_flatten chords)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord (chord:num list) =
     let a = hasChordIntersection_first chord in
     let b = hasChordIntersection_second chord in
     if a > b then CONS b (CONS a [])
     else CONS a (CONS b [])`;;

let hasChordIntersection_normalize = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_normalize (chords:(num list)list) =
     MAP hasChordIntersection_normalizeChord chords`;;

let hasChordIntersection_dropWhile =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_dropWhile (a:num) [] = []) /\
     (!chord:num list. !chords:(num list)list. !a:num.
        hasChordIntersection_dropWhile a (CONS chord chords) =
        if hasChordIntersection_second chord < a
        then hasChordIntersection_dropWhile a chords
        else CONS chord chords)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_insert =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_insert
        (x:num list) ([]:(num list)list) = CONS x []) /\
     (!y:num list. !ys:(num list)list. !x:num list.
        hasChordIntersection_insert x (CONS y ys) =
        if hasChordIntersection_first x < hasChordIntersection_first y
        then CONS x (CONS y ys)
        else CONS y (hasChordIntersection_insert x ys))`;;

let hasChordIntersection_sort =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_sort ([]:(num list)list) = []) /\
     (!x:num list. !xs:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_sort (CONS x xs) =
        hasChordIntersection_insert x
          (hasChordIntersection_sort xs))`;;

let hasChordIntersection_check =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_check
        (stack:(num list)list) [] = F) /\
     (!chord:num list. !rest:(num list)list.
      !stack:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_check stack (CONS chord rest) =
        let a = hasChordIntersection_first chord in
        let b = hasChordIntersection_second chord in
        let newStack = hasChordIntersection_dropWhile a stack in
        if newStack = []
        then hasChordIntersection_check (CONS chord newStack) rest
        else
          let top = HD newStack in
          if hasChordIntersection_second top > a /\
             hasChordIntersection_second top < b
          then T
          else
            hasChordIntersection_check
              (CONS chord newStack) rest)`;;

let hasChordIntersection = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection (N:num) (chords:(num list)list) =
     let sortedChords =
       hasChordIntersection_normalize chords in
     let sortedChords =
       hasChordIntersection_sort sortedChords in
     hasChordIntersection_check [] sortedChords`;;

let hasChordIntersection_pair = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_pair
      (chord1:num list) (chord2:num list) =
     let a1 = hasChordIntersection_first chord1 in
     let b1 = hasChordIntersection_second chord1 in
     let a2 = hasChordIntersection_first chord2 in
     let b2 = hasChordIntersection_second chord2 in
     (a1 < a2 /\ a2 < b1 /\ b1 < b2) \/
     (a2 < a1 /\ a1 < b2 /\ b2 < b1)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_anyWith =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_anyWith
        (x:num list) ([]:(num list)list) = F) /\
     (!y:num list. !ys:(num list)list. !x:num list.
        hasChordIntersection_anyWith x (CONS y ys) =
        if hasChordIntersection_pair x y
        then T
        else hasChordIntersection_anyWith x ys)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs
        ([]:(num list)list) = F) /\
     (!x:num list. !xs:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs (CONS x xs) =
        if hasChordIntersection_anyWith x xs
        then T
        else hasChordIntersection_checkAllPairs xs)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_pairwiseNone =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_pairwiseNone
        ([]:(num list)list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:num list. !xs:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_pairwiseNone (CONS x xs) <=>
        ALL
          (\y:num list. ~hasChordIntersection_pair x y)
          xs /\
        hasChordIntersection_pairwiseNone xs)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_anyScan =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(hasChordIntersection_anyScan
        (whole:(num list)list) [] = F) /\
     (!x:num list. !xs:(num list)list.
      !whole:(num list)list.
        hasChordIntersection_anyScan whole (CONS x xs) =
        if hasChordIntersection_anyWith x whole
        then T
        else hasChordIntersection_anyScan whole xs)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_any = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_any (chords:(num list)list) =
     hasChordIntersection_anyScan chords chords`;;

let hasChordIntersection_postcond = new_definition
  `hasChordIntersection_postcond
      (N:num) (chords:(num list)list) (result:bool) <=>
     let sortedChords =
       hasChordIntersection_normalize chords in
     (hasChordIntersection_pairwiseNone sortedChords
      ==> ~result) /\
     (hasChordIntersection_any sortedChords
      ==> result)`;;

let hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied =
  `!N:num. !chords:(num list)list.
     hasChordIntersection_precond N chords
     ==> hasChordIntersection_postcond
           N chords (hasChordIntersection N chords)`;;

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_13,
;; "hasChordIntersection": a deterministic normalization, insertion sort, and
;; stack scan detects whether any two circle chords have alternating endpoints,
;; together with its correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-13-nat-list-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (natp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-13-nat-list-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-nat-list-list-p (xss)
  (if (consp xss)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-13-nat-list-p (car xss))
       (verina-advanced-13-nat-list-list-p (cdr xss)))
    (equal xss nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-list-length (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (+ 1 (verina-advanced-13-list-length (cdr xs)))
    0))

;; These are the source List.get! operations at indices zero and one, whose
;; default value for Nat is zero.

(defun verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero (chord)
  (if (consp chord)
      (car chord)
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one (chord)
  (if (and (consp chord)
           (consp (cdr chord)))
      (car (cdr chord))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-13-flatten (xss)
  (if (consp xss)
      (append
       (car xss)
       (verina-advanced-13-flatten (cdr xss)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-valid-chord-p (chord n)
  (let ((a (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero chord))
        (b (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one chord)))
    (and
     (equal (verina-advanced-13-list-length chord) 2)
     (<= 1 a)
     (<= a (* 2 n))
     (<= 1 b)
     (<= b (* 2 n)))))

(defun verina-advanced-13-all-valid-chords-p (chords n)
  (if (consp chords)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-13-valid-chord-p (car chords) n)
       (verina-advanced-13-all-valid-chords-p (cdr chords) n))
    (equal chords nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection-precond
    (n chords)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (verina-advanced-13-nat-list-list-p chords)
   (<= 2 n)
   (equal (verina-advanced-13-list-length chords) n)
   (verina-advanced-13-all-valid-chords-p chords n)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal
    (verina-advanced-13-flatten chords))))

(defun verina-advanced-13-normalize-chord (chord)
  (let ((a (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero chord))
        (b (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one chord)))
    (if (< b a)
        (list b a)
      (list a b))))

(defun verina-advanced-13-normalize-chords (chords)
  (if (consp chords)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-13-normalize-chord (car chords))
       (verina-advanced-13-normalize-chords (cdr chords)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-drop-stack-before (a stack)
  (if (consp stack)
      (if (< (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one (car stack)) a)
          (verina-advanced-13-drop-stack-before a (cdr stack))
        stack)
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-check-intersection
    (stack remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((chord (car remaining))
             (rest (cdr remaining))
             (a (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero chord))
             (b (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one chord))
             (new-stack
              (verina-advanced-13-drop-stack-before a stack)))
        (if (consp new-stack)
            (let ((top-end
                   (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one
                    (car new-stack))))
              (if (and (< a top-end)
                       (< top-end b))
                  t
                (verina-advanced-13-check-intersection
                 (cons chord new-stack)
                 rest)))
          (verina-advanced-13-check-intersection
           (cons chord new-stack)
           rest)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-insert-chord (x xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (let ((y (car xs)))
        (if (< (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero x)
               (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero y))
            (cons x xs)
          (cons
           y
           (verina-advanced-13-insert-chord x (cdr xs)))))
    (list x)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-sort-chords (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-advanced-13-insert-chord
       (car xs)
       (verina-advanced-13-sort-chords (cdr xs)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection
    (n chords)
  (declare (ignore n))
  (verina-advanced-13-check-intersection
   nil
   (verina-advanced-13-sort-chords
    (verina-advanced-13-normalize-chords chords))))

(defun verina-advanced-13-chords-intersect-p
    (chord1 chord2)
  (let ((a1 (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero chord1))
        (b1 (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one chord1))
        (a2 (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-zero chord2))
        (b2 (verina-advanced-13-endpoint-one chord2)))
    (or
     (and (< a1 a2)
          (< a2 b1)
          (< b1 b2))
     (and (< a2 a1)
          (< a1 b2)
          (< b2 b1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-with-p
    (chord chords)
  (if (consp chords)
      (or
       (verina-advanced-13-chords-intersect-p
        chord (car chords))
       (verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-with-p
        chord (cdr chords)))
    nil))

;; This is the source checkAllPairs helper, retained even though the source
;; postcondition states its two directions through Pairwise and nested any.

(defun verina-advanced-13-check-all-pairs (chords)
  (if (consp chords)
      (if (verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-with-p
           (car chords) (cdr chords))
          t
        (verina-advanced-13-check-all-pairs (cdr chords)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-with-p
    (chord chords)
  (if (consp chords)
      (and
       (not
        (verina-advanced-13-chords-intersect-p
         chord (car chords)))
       (verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-with-p
        chord (cdr chords)))
    (equal chords nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-p (chords)
  (if (consp chords)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-with-p
        (car chords) (cdr chords))
       (verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-p
        (cdr chords)))
    (equal chords nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-p
    (remaining whole)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-with-p
        (car remaining) whole)
       (verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-p
        (cdr remaining) whole))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-13-bool-p (result)
  (or (equal result t)
      (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection-postcond
    (n chords result)
  (declare (ignore n))
  (let ((normalized
         (verina-advanced-13-normalize-chords chords)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-13-bool-p result)
     (implies
      (verina-advanced-13-pairwise-nonintersection-p
       normalized)
      (not result))
     (implies
      (verina-advanced-13-any-intersection-p
       normalized normalized)
      result))))

(defun
    verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection-spec-satisfied-statement
    (n chords)
  (implies
   (verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection-precond
    n chords)
   (verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection-postcond
    n
    chords
    (verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection
     n chords))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_13,
-- catalog title "hasChordIntersection": a deterministic program decides
-- whether normalized chords have alternating endpoints on the circle.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced13 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_
infixr 5 _&&_ _||_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

flatMapList :
  {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) = appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = nthDefault default n xs

firstEndpoint : List Nat → Nat
firstEndpoint chord = nthDefault zero zero chord

secondEndpoint : List Nat → Nat
secondEndpoint chord = nthDefault zero one chord

normalizeChord : List Nat → List Nat
normalizeChord chord =
  let a = firstEndpoint chord
      b = secondEndpoint chord
  in if natLess b a
     then (b ∷ a ∷ [])
     else (a ∷ b ∷ [])

allChordsValid : Nat → List (List Nat) → Bool
allChordsValid N [] = true
allChordsValid N (chord ∷ chords) =
  natEqual (listLength chord) two &&
  natLessOrEqual one (firstEndpoint chord) &&
  natLessOrEqual (firstEndpoint chord) (two * N) &&
  natLessOrEqual one (secondEndpoint chord) &&
  natLessOrEqual (secondEndpoint chord) (two * N) &&
  allChordsValid N chords

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

data _∈_ {A : Set} (x : A) : List A → Set where
  here : {xs : List A} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : A} {xs : List A} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

NoDuplicates : List Nat → Set
NoDuplicates [] = Top
NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs) = Not (x ∈ xs) ∧ NoDuplicates xs

HasChordIntersection-precond :
  Nat → List (List Nat) → Set
HasChordIntersection-precond N chords =
  (two ≤ N) ∧
  ((listLength chords ≡ N) ∧
  ((IsTrue (allChordsValid N chords)) ∧
  (NoDuplicates (flatMapList (λ chord → chord) chords))))

dropWhileList :
  {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
dropWhileList predicate [] = []
dropWhileList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then dropWhileList predicate xs
  else (x ∷ xs)

insertChord :
  List Nat → List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
insertChord x [] = x ∷ []
insertChord x (y ∷ ys) =
  if natLess (firstEndpoint x) (firstEndpoint y)
  then (x ∷ y ∷ ys)
  else (y ∷ insertChord x ys)

sortChords : List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
sortChords [] = []
sortChords (x ∷ xs) = insertChord x (sortChords xs)

checkIntersection :
  List (List Nat) → List (List Nat) → Bool
checkIntersection stack [] = false
checkIntersection stack (chord ∷ rest) =
  let a = firstEndpoint chord
      b = secondEndpoint chord
      newStack =
        dropWhileList
          (λ c → natLess (secondEndpoint c) a)
          stack
  in checkNewStack a b chord rest newStack
  where
  checkNewStack :
    Nat →
    Nat →
    List Nat →
    List (List Nat) →
    List (List Nat) →
    Bool
  checkNewStack a b chord rest [] =
    checkIntersection (chord ∷ []) rest
  checkNewStack a b chord rest (topChord ∷ stackTail) =
    if
      natLess a (secondEndpoint topChord) &&
      natLess (secondEndpoint topChord) b
    then true
    else checkIntersection (chord ∷ topChord ∷ stackTail) rest

hasChordIntersection :
  (N : Nat) →
  (chords : List (List Nat)) →
  HasChordIntersection-precond N chords →
  Bool
hasChordIntersection N chords h-precond =
  checkIntersection
    []
    (sortChords (mapList normalizeChord chords))

hasIntersection : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
hasIntersection chord1 chord2 =
  let a1 = firstEndpoint chord1
      b1 = secondEndpoint chord1
      a2 = firstEndpoint chord2
      b2 = secondEndpoint chord2
  in
    (natLess a1 a2 && natLess a2 b1 && natLess b1 b2) ||
    (natLess a2 a1 && natLess a1 b2 && natLess b2 b1)

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x then true else anyList predicate xs

checkAllPairs : List (List Nat) → Bool
checkAllPairs [] = false
checkAllPairs (x ∷ xs) =
  if anyList (hasIntersection x) xs
  then true
  else checkAllPairs xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

noIntersectionRelation :
  List Nat → List Nat → Set
noIntersectionRelation x y =
  IsTrue (notBool (hasIntersection x y))

anyIntersection : List (List Nat) → Bool
anyIntersection chords =
  anyList
    (λ x → anyList (λ y → hasIntersection x y) chords)
    chords

HasChordIntersection-postcond :
  (N : Nat) →
  (chords : List (List Nat)) →
  (result : Bool) →
  HasChordIntersection-precond N chords →
  Set
HasChordIntersection-postcond N chords result h-precond =
  let normalizedChords = mapList normalizeChord chords
  in
    (Pairwise noIntersectionRelation normalizedChords →
      Not (IsTrue result)) ∧
    (IsTrue (anyIntersection normalizedChords) →
      IsTrue result)

HasChordIntersection-spec-satisfied : Set
HasChordIntersection-spec-satisfied =
  (N : Nat) →
  (chords : List (List Nat)) →
  (h-precond : HasChordIntersection-precond N chords) →
  HasChordIntersection-postcond
    N
    chords
    (hasChordIntersection N chords h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_13,
  cataloged as "hasChordIntersection": the executable program detects whether
  normalized chords have endpoints that alternate around the circle.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val hasChordIntersection_precond_def = new_definition (
  "hasChordIntersection_precond_def",
  ``hasChordIntersection_precond
      (N : num) (chords : num list list) <=>
      2 <= N /\
      LENGTH chords = N /\
      EVERY
        (\chord : num list.
          LENGTH chord = 2 /\
          1 <= EL 0 chord /\
          EL 0 chord <= 2 * N /\
          1 <= EL 1 chord /\
          EL 1 chord <= 2 * N)
        chords /\
      ALL_DISTINCT (FLAT chords)``
);

val normalizeChord_def = new_definition (
  "normalizeChord_def",
  ``normalizeChord (chord : num list) =
      let a = EL 0 chord in
      let b = EL 1 chord in
        if a > b then [b; a] else [a; b]``
);

val normalizeChords_def = new_definition (
  "normalizeChords_def",
  ``normalizeChords (chords : num list list) =
      MAP normalizeChord chords``
);

val chordInsert_def = Define `
  (chordInsert (x : num list) ([] : num list list) = [x]) /\
  (chordInsert x (y::ys) =
     if EL 0 x < EL 0 y then
       x::y::ys
     else
       y::chordInsert x ys)
`;

val chordSort_def = Define `
  (chordSort ([] : num list list) = ([] : num list list)) /\
  (chordSort (x::xs) =
     chordInsert x (chordSort xs))
`;

val checkChordIntersection_def = Define `
  (checkChordIntersection
      (stack : num list list) ([] : num list list) = F) /\
  (checkChordIntersection stack (chord::rest) =
     let a = EL 0 chord in
     let b = EL 1 chord in
     let newStack =
       dropWhile (\c : num list. EL 1 c < a) stack
     in
       case newStack of
         [] => checkChordIntersection (chord::newStack) rest
       | top::tail =>
           if EL 1 top > a /\ EL 1 top < b then
             T
           else
             checkChordIntersection (chord::newStack) rest)
`;

val hasChordIntersection_def = new_definition (
  "hasChordIntersection_def",
  ``hasChordIntersection (N : num) (chords : num list list) =
      checkChordIntersection
        ([] : num list list)
        (chordSort (normalizeChords chords))``
);

val chordsIntersect_def = new_definition (
  "chordsIntersect_def",
  ``chordsIntersect (chord1 : num list) (chord2 : num list) =
      let a1 = EL 0 chord1 in
      let b1 = EL 1 chord1 in
      let a2 = EL 0 chord2 in
      let b2 = EL 1 chord2 in
        (a1 < a2 /\ a2 < b1 /\ b1 < b2) \/
        (a2 < a1 /\ a1 < b2 /\ b2 < b1)``
);

val checkAllChordPairs_def = Define `
  (checkAllChordPairs ([] : num list list) = F) /\
  (checkAllChordPairs (x::xs) =
     if EXISTS (\y : num list. chordsIntersect x y) xs then
       T
     else
       checkAllChordPairs xs)
`;

val chordsPairwiseNonintersecting_def = Define `
  (chordsPairwiseNonintersecting ([] : num list list) = T) /\
  (chordsPairwiseNonintersecting (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : num list. ~chordsIntersect x y) xs /\
      chordsPairwiseNonintersecting xs))
`;

val hasChordIntersection_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "hasChordIntersection_postcond_def",
  ``hasChordIntersection_postcond
      (N : num)
      (chords : num list list)
      (result : bool) <=>
      let sortedChords = normalizeChords chords
      in
        (chordsPairwiseNonintersecting sortedChords ==> ~result) /\
        (EXISTS
           (\x : num list.
             EXISTS
               (\y : num list. chordsIntersect x y)
               sortedChords)
           sortedChords ==>
         result)``
);

val hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(N : num) (chords : num list list).
      hasChordIntersection_precond N chords ==>
      hasChordIntersection_postcond
        N chords (hasChordIntersection N chords)``;

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_13, catalog title hasChordIntersection: an executable
  normalization, insertion sort, and stack scan decides whether a finite
  family of chords has an alternating-endpoint intersection, together with
  its precondition and Boolean correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain. Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists, and Word ( Word NN0 ) is
  the type of arbitrary finite lists of such lists. Function application to
  an index outside a word's domain is the empty set, which is ordinal zero,
  matching Lean's Nat-valued List.get! default.

  VERINA13Normalize is the source map that orders the two endpoints of every
  chord. VERINA13InsertGraph and VERINA13SortGraph give the exact recursive
  insertion and insertion-sort computations; the sort trace inserts the
  input chords from right to left, exactly as the source recursion does.

  VERINA13DropGraph is List.dropWhile for the stack predicate c[1] < a.
  VERINA13Hit is precisely the successful top-of-stack test, and
  VERINA13NoHitStep is precisely one recursive stack update. The two branches
  of VERINA13CheckGraph describe, respectively, the first successful scan
  step and a complete unsuccessful scan. Hence VERINA13Program is the exact
  executable hasChordIntersection computation, not an unconstrained output
  relation and not an existential choice satisfying the postcondition.

  VERINA13IntersectionBool is the local hasIntersection Boolean helper, and
  VERINA13CheckAllPairs is the exact local recursive pair scan (although that
  local helper is unused by the source postcondition body). VERINA13Pre
  reproduces the lower bound, chord count, endpoint bounds, and global
  duplicate-freedom precondition. VERINA13Post reproduces both implications
  of the source postcondition, including List.Pairwise and the nested any
  searches. The proof-valued precondition arguments are computationally
  unused and are omitted from the target functions. The final $a declaration
  is the source correctness proposition; every earlier $a is syntax or a
  faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA13NormalizeGraph VERINA13Normalize
  VERINA13InsertGraph VERINA13Insert
  VERINA13SortGraph VERINA13Sort
  VERINA13DropGraph VERINA13Drop
  VERINA13Hit VERINA13NoHitStep
  VERINA13CheckGraph VERINA13Check
  VERINA13Program
  VERINA13IntersectionBool
  VERINA13CheckAllPairsGraph VERINA13CheckAllPairs
  VERINA13PairwiseClear VERINA13AnyIntersection
  VERINA13Pre VERINA13Post
$.

verina13-normalize-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13NormalizeGraph A B ) $.
verina13-normalize-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Normalize A ) $.
verina13-insert-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13InsertGraph A B C ) $.
verina13-insert-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Insert A B ) $.
verina13-sort-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13SortGraph A B ) $.
verina13-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Sort A ) $.
verina13-drop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13DropGraph A B C ) $.
verina13-drop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Drop A B ) $.
verina13-hit-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13Hit A B ) $.
verina13-no-hit-step-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13NoHitStep A B C ) $.
verina13-check-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13CheckGraph A B ) $.
verina13-check-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Check A ) $.
verina13-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13Program A B ) $.
verina13-intersection-bool-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13IntersectionBool A B ) $.
verina13-check-all-pairs-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13CheckAllPairsGraph A B ) $.
verina13-check-all-pairs-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA13CheckAllPairs A ) $.
verina13-pairwise-clear-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13PairwiseClear A ) $.
verina13-any-intersection-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13AnyIntersection A ) $.
verina13-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13Pre A B ) $.
verina13-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA13Post A B C ) $.

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina13-normalize-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13NormalizeGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          ( # ` ( B ` k ) ) = 2
          /\
          (
            (
              ( B ` k ) ` 0
            ) = if (
              ( ( A ` k ) ` 1 ) < ( ( A ` k ) ` 0 ) ,
              ( A ` k ) ` 1 ,
              ( A ` k ) ` 0
            )
            /\
            (
              ( B ` k ) ` 1
            ) = if (
              ( ( A ` k ) ` 1 ) < ( ( A ` k ) ` 0 ) ,
              ( A ` k ) ` 0 ,
              ( A ` k ) ` 1
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina13-normalize-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Normalize A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA13NormalizeGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j p A B C $.

  verina13-insert-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13InsertGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              -. ( ( A ` 0 ) < ( ( B ` j ) ` 0 ) )
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` B )
              ->
              ( A ` 0 ) < ( ( B ` p ) ` 0 )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
            /\
            (
              ( C ` p ) = A
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
                  ( C ` j ) = ( B ` j )
                /\
                A. j e. ( p ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( C ` ( j + 1 ) ) = ( B ` j )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina13-insert-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Insert A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA13InsertGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verina13-sort-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13SortGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ( Word NN0 ) )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA13InsertGraph
                ( A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k ) )
                ( t ` k )
                ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina13-sort-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Sort A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA13SortGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j p A B C $.

  verina13-drop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13DropGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` A )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              ( ( A ` j ) ` 1 ) < B
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` A )
              ->
              -. ( ( ( A ` p ) ` 1 ) < B )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) - p )
            /\
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
              ( C ` j ) = ( A ` ( j + p ) )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina13-drop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Drop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA13DropGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina13-hit-definition $a |- (
  VERINA13Hit A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    /\
    B e. Word NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    0 < ( # ` ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) )
    /\
    (
      ( B ` 0 )
        < ( ( ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) ` 0 ) ` 1 )
      /\
      ( ( ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) ` 0 ) ` 1 )
        < ( B ` 1 )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina13-no-hit-step-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13NoHitStep A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
        /\
        B e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    (
      -. ( VERINA13Hit A B )
      /\
      (
        ( # ` C ) =
          ( ( # ` ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) ) + 1 )
        /\
        (
          ( C ` 0 ) = B
          /\
          A. j e.
            ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) ) )
            (
              C ` ( j + 1 )
            ) = (
              ( VERINA13Drop A ( B ` 0 ) ) ` j
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k t A B $.

  verina13-check-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13CheckGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = 1
        /\
        E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          E. t e. Word ( Word ( Word NN0 ) )
            (
              (
                ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
                /\
                ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
              )
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                  (
                    VERINA13NoHitStep
                      ( t ` j )
                      ( A ` j )
                      ( t ` ( j + 1 ) )
                  )
                /\
                ( VERINA13Hit ( t ` k ) ( A ` k ) )
              )
            )
      )
      \/
      (
        B = 0
        /\
        E. t e. Word ( Word ( Word NN0 ) )
          (
            (
              ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
            )
            /\
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                VERINA13NoHitStep
                  ( t ` k )
                  ( A ` k )
                  ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
              )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina13-check-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Check A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. { 0 , 1 }
      ( VERINA13CheckGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina13-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA13Program A B
) = (
  VERINA13Check
    ( VERINA13Sort ( VERINA13Normalize B ) )
) $.

verina13-intersection-bool-definition $a |- (
  VERINA13IntersectionBool A B
) = if (
  (
    (
      (
        ( A ` 0 ) < ( B ` 0 )
        /\
        ( B ` 0 ) < ( A ` 1 )
      )
      /\
      ( A ` 1 ) < ( B ` 1 )
    )
    \/
    (
      (
        ( B ` 0 ) < ( A ` 0 )
        /\
        ( A ` 0 ) < ( B ` 1 )
      )
      /\
      ( B ` 1 ) < ( A ` 1 )
    )
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verina13-check-all-pairs-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13CheckAllPairsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = 1
        /\
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              i < j
              /\
              ( VERINA13IntersectionBool
                  ( A ` i ) ( A ` j ) ) = 1
            )
      )
      \/
      (
        B = 0
        /\
        -.
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              i < j
              /\
              ( VERINA13IntersectionBool
                  ( A ` i ) ( A ` j ) ) = 1
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina13-check-all-pairs-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13CheckAllPairs A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. { 0 , 1 }
      ( VERINA13CheckAllPairsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina13-pairwise-clear-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13PairwiseClear A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( VERINA13IntersectionBool
                ( A ` i ) ( A ` j ) ) = 0
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina13-any-intersection-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13AnyIntersection A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      /\
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( VERINA13IntersectionBool
              ( A ` i ) ( A ` j ) ) = 1
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p q A B $.

  verina13-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA13Pre A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    (
      2 <_ A
      /\
      (
        ( # ` B ) = A
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              ( # ` ( B ` i ) ) = 2
              /\
              (
                (
                  1 <_ ( ( B ` i ) ` 0 )
                  /\
                  ( ( B ` i ) ` 0 ) <_ ( 2 x. A )
                )
                /\
                (
                  1 <_ ( ( B ` i ) ` 1 )
                  /\
                  ( ( B ` i ) ` 1 ) <_ ( 2 x. A )
                )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            A. p e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( B ` i ) ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( B ` j ) ) )
                  (
                    (
                      i =/= j
                      \/
                      p =/= q
                    )
                    ->
                    ( ( B ` i ) ` p ) =/= ( ( B ` j ) ` q )
                  )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina13-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA13Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    C e. { 0 , 1 }
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      ( VERINA13PairwiseClear ( VERINA13Normalize B ) )
      ->
      C = 0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( VERINA13AnyIntersection ( VERINA13Normalize B ) )
      ->
      C = 1
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-13-has-chord-intersection $a |- A. n e. NN0
  A. w e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    (
      ( VERINA13Pre n w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA13Post
          n
          w
          ( VERINA13Program n w )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_13, catalog title "hasChordIntersection": an exact finite-
:: sequence graph of chord normalization, insertion sorting, stack-based
:: intersection detection, the input precondition, output postcondition, and
:: final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1,
    ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1,
    XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0,
    XXREAL_0, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for N being Nat, chords being FinSequence of NAT* st
    2 <= N &
    len chords = N &
    (for i being Nat st i in dom chords holds
      ex a,b being Nat st
        chords/.i = <*a,b*> &
        1 <= a & a <= 2 * N &
        1 <= b & b <= 2 * N) &
    (for i,j,a,b,c,d being Nat st
      i in dom chords & j in dom chords &
      chords/.i = <*a,b*> & chords/.j = <*c,d*>
    holds
      (a = c implies i = j) & a <> d & b <> c &
      (b = d implies i = j))
  for result being Element of BOOLEAN st
    ex low,high,sortedLow,sortedHigh,permutation
      being FinSequence of NAT st
      len low = len chords & len high = len chords &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom chords holds
        ex a,b being Nat st
          chords/.i = <*a,b*> &
          ((a > b & low/.i = b & high/.i = a) or
           (a <= b & low/.i = a & high/.i = b))) &
      len sortedLow = N & len sortedHigh = N &
      len permutation = N &
      rng permutation = Seg N & permutation is one-to-one &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom sortedLow holds
        permutation/.i in dom low &
        sortedLow/.i = low/.(permutation/.i) &
        sortedHigh/.i = high/.(permutation/.i)) &
      (for i,j being Nat st
        i in dom sortedLow & j in dom sortedLow & i < j
      holds sortedLow/.i < sortedLow/.j) &
      ((result = FALSE &
        ex stackLength,stackData being FinSequence of NAT st
          len stackLength = N + 1 &
          len stackData = (N + 2) * N &
          stackLength/.1 = 0 &
          for i being Nat st i in dom sortedLow holds
            ex k being Nat st
              k <= stackLength/.i &
              (for j being Nat st j in Seg k holds
                stackData/.(i * N + j) < sortedLow/.i) &
              (k = stackLength/.i or
                not stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) < sortedLow/.i) &
              (k = stackLength/.i or
                not (stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) > sortedLow/.i &
                  stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) < sortedHigh/.i)) &
              stackLength/.(i + 1) + k = stackLength/.i + 1 &
              stackData/.((i + 1) * N + 1) = sortedHigh/.i &
              (for j being Nat st
                1 <= j & k + j <= stackLength/.i
              holds
                stackData/.((i + 1) * N + j + 1) =
                  stackData/.(i * N + k + j))) or
       (result = TRUE &
        ex stop being Nat,
           stackLength,stackData being FinSequence of NAT st
          stop in dom sortedLow &
          len stackLength = stop &
          len stackData = (N + 2) * N &
          stackLength/.1 = 0 &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom sortedLow & i < stop holds
            ex k being Nat st
              k <= stackLength/.i &
              (for j being Nat st j in Seg k holds
                stackData/.(i * N + j) < sortedLow/.i) &
              (k = stackLength/.i or
                not stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) < sortedLow/.i) &
              (k = stackLength/.i or
                not (stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) > sortedLow/.i &
                  stackData/.(i * N + k + 1) < sortedHigh/.i)) &
              stackLength/.(i + 1) + k = stackLength/.i + 1 &
              stackData/.((i + 1) * N + 1) = sortedHigh/.i &
              (for j being Nat st
                1 <= j & k + j <= stackLength/.i
              holds
                stackData/.((i + 1) * N + j + 1) =
                  stackData/.(i * N + k + j))) &
          ex k being Nat st
            k < stackLength/.stop &
            (for j being Nat st j in Seg k holds
              stackData/.(stop * N + j) < sortedLow/.stop) &
            not stackData/.(stop * N + k + 1) < sortedLow/.stop &
            stackData/.(stop * N + k + 1) > sortedLow/.stop &
            stackData/.(stop * N + k + 1) < sortedHigh/.stop))
  holds
    ex low,high being FinSequence of NAT st
      len low = len chords & len high = len chords &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom chords holds
        ex a,b being Nat st
          chords/.i = <*a,b*> &
          ((a > b & low/.i = b & high/.i = a) or
           (a <= b & low/.i = a & high/.i = b))) &
      (((for i,j being Nat st
          i in dom low & j in dom low & i < j
        holds
          not ((low/.i < low/.j & low/.j < high/.i &
            high/.i < high/.j) or
          (low/.j < low/.i & low/.i < high/.j &
            high/.j < high/.i)))
        implies result = FALSE) &
       ((ex i,j being Nat st
          i in dom low & j in dom low &
          ((low/.i < low/.j & low/.j < high/.i &
            high/.i < high/.j) or
           (low/.j < low/.i & low/.i < high/.j &
            high/.j < high/.i)))
        implies result = TRUE))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_13
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_13, "hasChordIntersection": detecting whether two chords
% have alternating endpoints and therefore cross inside a circle.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_13: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  chord_list_length(
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(chord, rest):
        chord_list_length(rest) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  nat_list_nth_default(
      index: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          nat_list_nth_default(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_member(value: nat, values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR nat_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicate_nats(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT nat_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_nats(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_nat_lists(
      first, second: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, append_nat_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  flatten_chords(chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(chord, rest):
        append_nat_lists(chord, flatten_chords(rest))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  valid_chord(N: nat, chord: list[nat]): bool =
    nat_list_length(chord) = 2
      AND nat_list_nth_default(0, chord) >= 1
      AND nat_list_nth_default(0, chord) <= 2 * N
      AND nat_list_nth_default(1, chord) >= 1
      AND nat_list_nth_default(1, chord) <= 2 * N

  all_valid_chords(
      N: nat,
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(chord, rest):
        valid_chord(N, chord)
          AND all_valid_chords(N, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  hasChordIntersection_precond(
      N: nat,
      chords: list[list[nat]]): bool =
    N >= 2
      AND chord_list_length(chords) = N
      AND all_valid_chords(N, chords)
      AND no_duplicate_nats(flatten_chords(chords))

  normalize_chord(chord: list[nat]): list[nat] =
    LET a: nat = nat_list_nth_default(0, chord),
        b: nat = nat_list_nth_default(1, chord)
    IN
      IF a > b THEN
        cons(b, cons(a, null))
      ELSE
        cons(a, cons(b, null))
      ENDIF

  normalize_chords(
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE list[list[nat]] =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(chord, rest):
        cons(normalize_chord(chord), normalize_chords(rest))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  drop_while_ending_before(
      a: nat,
      stack: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE list[list[nat]] =
    CASES stack OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(chord, rest):
        IF nat_list_nth_default(1, chord) < a THEN
          drop_while_ending_before(a, rest)
        ELSE
          cons(chord, rest)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE stack BY <<

  insert_chord(
      chord: list[nat],
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE list[list[nat]] =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        cons(chord, null),
      cons(head, tail):
        IF nat_list_nth_default(0, chord)
             < nat_list_nth_default(0, head)
        THEN
          cons(chord, chords)
        ELSE
          cons(head, insert_chord(chord, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  sort_chords(
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE list[list[nat]] =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        insert_chord(head, sort_chords(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  check_intersection(
      stack: list[list[nat]],
      remaining: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(chord, rest):
        LET a: nat = nat_list_nth_default(0, chord),
            b: nat = nat_list_nth_default(1, chord),
            new_stack: list[list[nat]] =
              drop_while_ending_before(a, stack)
        IN
          CASES new_stack OF
            null:
              check_intersection(cons(chord, null), rest),
            cons(top, stack_tail):
              IF nat_list_nth_default(1, top) > a
                   AND nat_list_nth_default(1, top) < b
              THEN
                TRUE
              ELSE
                check_intersection(
                  cons(chord, new_stack),
                  rest)
              ENDIF
          ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  hasChordIntersection(
      N: nat,
      chords: list[list[nat]]): bool =
    check_intersection(
      null,
      sort_chords(normalize_chords(chords)))

  has_intersection(
      chord1, chord2: list[nat]): bool =
    LET a1: nat = nat_list_nth_default(0, chord1),
        b1: nat = nat_list_nth_default(1, chord1),
        a2: nat = nat_list_nth_default(0, chord2),
        b2: nat = nat_list_nth_default(1, chord2)
    IN
      (a1 < a2 AND a2 < b1 AND b1 < b2)
        OR (a2 < a1 AND a1 < b2 AND b2 < b1)

  chord_intersects_any(
      chord: list[nat],
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        has_intersection(chord, head)
          OR chord_intersects_any(chord, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  checkAllPairs(chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF chord_intersects_any(head, tail) THEN
          TRUE
        ELSE
          checkAllPairs(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  chord_avoids_all(
      chord: list[nat],
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT has_intersection(chord, head)
          AND chord_avoids_all(chord, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  pairwise_no_intersection(
      chords: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chords OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        chord_avoids_all(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_no_intersection(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chords BY <<

  any_chord_has_intersection(
      original: list[list[nat]],
      remaining: list[list[nat]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        chord_intersects_any(head, original)
          OR any_chord_has_intersection(original, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  hasChordIntersection_postcond(
      N: nat,
      chords: list[list[nat]],
      result: bool): bool =
    LET sorted_chords: list[list[nat]] =
      normalize_chords(chords)
    IN
      (pairwise_no_intersection(sorted_chords)
        IMPLIES NOT result)
      AND (any_chord_has_intersection(
             sorted_chords,
             sorted_chords)
        IMPLIES result)

  hasChordIntersection_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (N: nat), (chords: list[list[nat]]):
      hasChordIntersection_precond(N, chords) IMPLIES
        hasChordIntersection_postcond(
          N,
          chords,
          hasChordIntersection(N, chords))

END verina_advanced_13

title: verina_advanced_14
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_14,
   catalog title "ifPowerOfFour": an executable recursive test for whether a
   natural number is a power of four, together with its correctness contract.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool.

Definition ifPowerOfFour_precond (_n : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | O => false
  | S fuel' =>
      match n with
      | O => false
      | S m =>
          match m with
          | O => true
          | S l =>
              if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo (l + 2) 4) 0
              then
                ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel
                  fuel' (Nat.div (l + 2) 4)
              else false
          end
      end
  end.

Definition ifPowerOfFour_helper (n : nat) : bool :=
  ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel n n.

Definition ifPowerOfFour
    (n : nat)
    (_h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n) : bool :=
  ifPowerOfFour_helper n.

Definition ifPowerOfFour_postcond
    (n : nat)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n) : Prop :=
  result = true <->
  exists m : nat, n = Nat.pow 4 m.

Theorem ifPowerOfFour_spec_satisfied
    (n : nat)
    (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n) :
  ifPowerOfFour_postcond
    n (ifPowerOfFour n h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_14
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_14,
  catalog title "ifPowerOfFour": an executable natural-number program decides
  whether its input is a power of four, together with its precondition and
  Boolean correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_14
  imports Main
begin

definition ifPowerOfFour_precond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "ifPowerOfFour_precond n \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun ifPowerOfFour_helper :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "ifPowerOfFour_helper 0 n = False"
| "ifPowerOfFour_helper (Suc fuel) 0 = False"
| "ifPowerOfFour_helper (Suc fuel) (Suc 0) = True"
| "ifPowerOfFour_helper (Suc fuel) (Suc (Suc l)) =
    (if (l + 2) mod 4 = 0
     then ifPowerOfFour_helper fuel ((l + 2) div 4)
     else False)"

definition ifPowerOfFour :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "ifPowerOfFour n = ifPowerOfFour_helper (Suc n) n"

definition ifPowerOfFour_postcond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "ifPowerOfFour_postcond n result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (result \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>m. n = 4 ^ m))"

theorem ifPowerOfFour_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "ifPowerOfFour_precond n"
  shows "ifPowerOfFour_postcond n (ifPowerOfFour n)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_14
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_14,
  catalog title "ifPowerOfFour": an executable natural-number recursion tests
  powers of four by repeated exact division, together with its total
  precondition and power-of-four postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let ifPowerOfFour_precond = new_definition
  `ifPowerOfFour_precond (n:num) <=> T`;;

let ifPowerOfFour_helper = define
  `ifPowerOfFour_helper (n:num) =
     if n = 0 then F
     else if n = 1 then T
     else if n MOD 4 = 0
     then ifPowerOfFour_helper (n DIV 4)
     else F`;;

let ifPowerOfFour = new_definition
  `ifPowerOfFour (n:num) = ifPowerOfFour_helper n`;;

let ifPowerOfFour_postcond = new_definition
  `ifPowerOfFour_postcond (n:num) (result:bool) <=>
     (result <=> ?m:num. n = 4 EXP m)`;;

let ifPowerOfFour_spec_satisfied =
  `!n:num.
     ifPowerOfFour_precond n
     ==> ifPowerOfFour_postcond n (ifPowerOfFour n)`;;

;; its input is an exact power of four, together with its Boolean correctness
;; contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True; the Nat input domain is explicit in the
;; final statement predicate.

(defun verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; Each recursive source call replaces n by floor(n / 4), so for natural n at
;; least two the residual strictly decreases. Initial fuel n therefore cannot
;; expire before the source recursion terminates and does not add a cutoff.

(defun verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-helper-aux
    (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (not (natp n))
      nil
    (if (equal n 0)
        nil
      (if (equal n 1)
          t
        (if (equal (mod n 4) 0)
            (if (zp fuel)
                nil
              (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-helper-aux
               (floor n 4)
               (- fuel 1)))
          nil)))))

(defun verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-helper (n)
  (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-helper-aux
   n
   (nfix n)))

(defun verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four (n)
  (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-helper n))

(defun-sk verina-advanced-14-power-of-four-p (n)
  (exists (m)
    (and
     (natp m)
     (equal n (expt 4 m)))))

(defun verina-advanced-14-bool-p (result)
  (or (equal result t)
      (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-postcond
    (n result)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (verina-advanced-14-bool-p result)
   (iff
    result
    (verina-advanced-14-power-of-four-p n))))

(defun
    verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-spec-satisfied-statement
    (n)

    (natp n)
    (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-precond n))
   (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four-postcond
    n
    (verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four n))))
