-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_14,
-- catalog title "ifPowerOfFour": a deterministic natural-number program
-- decides whether its input is an exact power of four. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced14 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 2 _↔_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalDiv : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero = zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

one : Nat
one = suc zero

four : Nat
four = suc (suc (suc one))

power : Nat → Nat → Nat
power base zero = one
power base (suc exponent) = base * power base exponent

ifPowerOfFour-precond : Nat → Set
ifPowerOfFour-precond n = Top

ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel : Nat → Nat → Bool
ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel fuel zero = false
ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel fuel (suc zero) = true
ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel zero (suc (suc n)) = false
ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel
  (suc fuel)
  (suc (suc n)) =
  let current = suc (suc n)
  in
    if natEqual (naturalMod current four) zero
    then
      ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel
        fuel
        (naturalDiv current four)
    else false

ifPowerOfFour :
  (n : Nat) →
  ifPowerOfFour-precond n →
  Bool
ifPowerOfFour n h-precond =
  ifPowerOfFour-helper-with-fuel n n

data PowerOfFour (n : Nat) : Set where
  power-of-four :
    (exponent : Nat) →
    n ≡ power four exponent →
    PowerOfFour n

ifPowerOfFour-postcond :
  (n : Nat) →
  (result : Bool) →
  ifPowerOfFour-precond n →
  Set
ifPowerOfFour-postcond n result h-precond =
  IsTrue result ↔ PowerOfFour n

ifPowerOfFour-spec-satisfied : Set
ifPowerOfFour-spec-satisfied =
  (n : Nat) →
  (h-precond : ifPowerOfFour-precond n) →
  ifPowerOfFour-postcond
    n
    (ifPowerOfFour n h-precond)
    h-precond

  (ifPowerOfFour_helper (SUC 0) = T) /\
  (ifPowerOfFour_helper (SUC (SUC l)) =
     if (l + 2) MOD 4 = 0 then
       ifPowerOfFour_helper ((l + 2) DIV 4)
     else
       F)
`;

      ifPowerOfFour_postcond n (ifPowerOfFour n)``;

title: verina_advanced_14
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_14, catalog title ifPowerOfFour: an executable natural-
  number recursion decides whether its input is a power of four, with the
  corresponding Boolean correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, Word NN0 is exactly the type
  of arbitrary finite natural-number lists, and { 0 , 1 } represents Bool
  with false = 0 and true = 1.

  VERINA14HelperGraph is the exact finite execution graph of the source local
  helper. A trace starts at the input. Every nonterminal entry is at least two
  and divisible by four, and the next entry is its natural-number quotient by
  four. The trace stops at zero, at one, or at a value at least two that is
  not divisible by four. Its output is true exactly when the terminal entry
  is one and false in the other terminal cases. Since every recursive step
  strictly decreases the current natural number, this graph has exactly the
  source helper's unique output on every input.

  VERINA14Helper selects that unique Boolean output, and
  VERINA14IfPowerOfFour is the source executable implementation. The
  proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally unused and is
  omitted from the target function. VERINA14Post states that the returned
  Boolean is true exactly when the input is four to a natural-number power.
  The final $a declaration applies the executable implementation to this
  postcondition under the source precondition. Every earlier $a is syntax or
  a faithful definition, and this artifact adds no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA14HelperGraph VERINA14Helper
  VERINA14IfPowerOfFour VERINA14Pre VERINA14Post
$.

verina14-helper-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA14HelperGraph A B ) $.
verina14-helper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA14Helper A ) $.
verina14-if-power-of-four-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA14IfPowerOfFour A ) $.
verina14-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA14Pre A ) $.
verina14-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA14Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i k s A B $.

  verina14-helper-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA14HelperGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( k + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = A
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              (
                1 < ( s ` i )
                /\
                ( ( s ` i ) mod 4 ) = 0
              )
              /\
              (
                s ` ( i + 1 )
              ) = (
                |_ ` ( ( s ` i ) / 4 )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( s ` k ) = 1
              /\
              B = 1
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                ( s ` k ) = 0
                \/
                (
                  1 < ( s ` k )
                  /\
                  ( ( s ` k ) mod 4 ) =/= 0
                )
              )
              /\
              B = 0
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina14-helper-definition $a |- (
    VERINA14Helper A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. { 0 , 1 }
      ( VERINA14HelperGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina14-if-power-of-four-definition $a |- (
  VERINA14IfPowerOfFour A
) = (
  VERINA14Helper A
) $.

verina14-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA14Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
) $.

${
  $d m A B $.

  verina14-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA14Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    (
      B = 1
      <->
      E. m e. NN0 A = ( 4 ^ m )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-14-if-power-of-four $a |- A. n e. NN0
  (
    ( VERINA14Pre n )
    ->
    (
      VERINA14Post
        n
        ( VERINA14IfPowerOfFour n )
    )
  )
$.

:: Boolean implementation, power-of-four postcondition, and final correctness

environ

    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,

    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,

  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat, result being Element of BOOLEAN st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex trace being FinSequence of NAT st
      0 < len trace &
      trace/.1 = n &
      (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len trace holds
        2 <= trace/.j &
        trace/.j mod (4 qua Nat) = 0 &
        trace/.(j + 1) = trace/.j div (4 qua Nat)) &
      ((result = TRUE & trace/.(len trace) = 1) or
       (result = FALSE &
        (trace/.(len trace) = 0 or
         (2 <= trace/.(len trace) &
          trace/.(len trace) mod (4 qua Nat) <> 0)))))
  holds
    (result = TRUE iff ex m being Nat st n = (4 qua Nat) |^ m)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_14
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_14, "ifPowerOfFour": deciding by repeated exact division by
% four whether a natural number is a power of four. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_14: THEORY
BEGIN

  ifPowerOfFour_precond(n: nat): bool =
    TRUE

  ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel(
      n, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF n = 1 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF mod(n, 4) = 0 THEN
      ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel(
        ndiv(n, 4),
        fuel - 1)
    ELSE
      FALSE
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  ifPowerOfFour_helper(n: nat): bool =
    ifPowerOfFour_helper_fuel(n, n)

  ifPowerOfFour(n: nat): bool =
    ifPowerOfFour_helper(n)

  ifPowerOfFour_postcond(
      n: nat,
      result: bool): bool =
    result IFF (EXISTS (m: nat): n = 4 ^ m)

  ifPowerOfFour_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      ifPowerOfFour_precond(n) IMPLIES
        ifPowerOfFour_postcond(
          n,
          ifPowerOfFour(n))

END verina_advanced_14

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_15,
   catalog title "increasingTriplet": an executable two-candidate scan for a
   strictly increasing subsequence of length three, together with its
   correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition increasingTriplet_precond (_nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint increasingTriplet_loop
    (xs : list Z)
    (first second : option Z) : bool :=
  match xs with
  | [] => false
  | x :: rest =>
      match first with
      | None =>
          increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some x) None
      | Some f =>
          if Z.leb x f
          then increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some x) second
          else
            match second with
            | None =>
                increasingTriplet_loop rest first (Some x)
            | Some s =>
                if Z.leb x s
                then increasingTriplet_loop rest first (Some x)
                else true
            end
      end
  end.

Definition increasingTriplet
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : increasingTriplet_precond nums) : bool :=
  if Nat.ltb (length nums) 3%nat
  then false
  else increasingTriplet_loop nums None None.

Fixpoint increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom
    (nums : list Z)
    (index : nat) : list (Z * nat) :=
  match nums with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      (x, index) ::
      increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom rest (S index)
  end.

Definition increasingTriplet_zipIdx
    (nums : list Z) : list (Z * nat) :=
  increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom nums 0%nat.

Definition increasingTriplet_hasTriplet
    (nums' : list (Z * nat)) : bool :=
  existsb
    (fun xi =>
      existsb
        (fun yj =>
          existsb
            (fun zk =>
              andb
                (Nat.ltb (snd xi) (snd yj))
                (andb
                  (Nat.ltb (snd yj) (snd zk))
                  (andb
                    (Z.ltb (fst xi) (fst yj))
                    (Z.ltb (fst yj) (fst zk)))))
            nums')
        nums')
    nums'.

Definition increasingTriplet_allNonIncreasing
    (nums' : list (Z * nat)) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun xi =>
      forallb
        (fun yj =>
          forallb
            (fun zk =>
              orb
                (Nat.leb (snd yj) (snd xi))
                (orb
                  (Nat.leb (snd zk) (snd yj))
                  (orb
                    (Z.leb (fst yj) (fst xi))
                    (Z.leb (fst zk) (fst yj)))))
            nums')
        nums')
    nums'.

Definition increasingTriplet_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : increasingTriplet_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let nums' := increasingTriplet_zipIdx nums in
  (result = true ->
    increasingTriplet_hasTriplet nums' = true) /\
  (result <> true ->
    increasingTriplet_allNonIncreasing nums' = true).

Theorem increasingTriplet_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : increasingTriplet_precond nums) :
  increasingTriplet_postcond
    nums (increasingTriplet nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_15,
  catalog title "increasingTriplet": an executable two-threshold list scan
  decides whether three integer entries at increasing indices have strictly
  increasing values, together with its correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_15
  imports Main
begin

definition increasingTriplet_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "increasingTriplet_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun increasingTriplet_loop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int option \<Rightarrow> int option \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "increasingTriplet_loop [] first second = False"
| "increasingTriplet_loop (x # rest) None second =
    increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some x) None"
| "increasingTriplet_loop (x # rest) (Some first) second =
    (if x \<le> first
     then increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some x) second
     else
       (case second of
          None \<Rightarrow> increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some first) (Some x)
        | Some second' \<Rightarrow>
            (if x \<le> second'
             then increasingTriplet_loop rest (Some first) (Some x)
             else True)))"

definition increasingTriplet :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "increasingTriplet nums =
    (if length nums < 3
     then False
     else increasingTriplet_loop nums None None)"

definition increasingTriplet_zipIdx ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "increasingTriplet_zipIdx nums = zip nums [0..<length nums]"

definition increasingTriplet_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "increasingTriplet_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let nums' = increasingTriplet_zipIdx nums
     in
       (result \<longrightarrow>
         list_ex
           (\<lambda>(x, i).
             list_ex
               (\<lambda>(y, j).
                 list_ex
                   (\<lambda>(z, k).
                     i < j \<and> j < k \<and> x < y \<and> y < z)
                   nums')
               nums')
           nums') \<and>
       (\<not> result \<longrightarrow>
         list_all
           (\<lambda>(x, i).
             list_all
               (\<lambda>(y, j).
                 list_all
                   (\<lambda>(z, k).
                     i \<ge> j \<or> j \<ge> k \<or> x \<ge> y \<or> y \<ge> z)
                   nums')
               nums')
           nums'))"

theorem increasingTriplet_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "increasingTriplet_precond nums"
  shows "increasingTriplet_postcond nums (increasingTriplet nums)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_15
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_15,
  catalog title "increasingTriplet": an executable two-threshold list scan
  detects three increasing integers at increasing indices, together with its
  total precondition and indexed postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let increasingTriplet_precond = new_definition
  `increasingTriplet_precond (nums:int list) <=> T`;;

let increasingTriplet_optionValue = new_definition
  `increasingTriplet_optionValue (value:int option) =
     @x:int. value = SOME x`;;

let increasingTriplet_loop =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(increasingTriplet_loop
        ([]:int list) (first:int option) (second:int option) = F) /\
     (!x:int. !rest:int list.
      !first:int option. !second:int option.
        increasingTriplet_loop (CONS x rest) first second =
        if first = NONE then
          increasingTriplet_loop rest (SOME x) NONE
        else
          let f = increasingTriplet_optionValue first in
          if x <= f then
            increasingTriplet_loop rest (SOME x) second
          else if second = NONE then
            increasingTriplet_loop rest first (SOME x)
          else
            let s = increasingTriplet_optionValue second in
            if x <= s then
              increasingTriplet_loop rest first (SOME x)
            else T)`;;

let increasingTriplet = new_definition
  `increasingTriplet (nums:int list) =
     if LENGTH nums < 3 then F
     else increasingTriplet_loop nums NONE NONE`;;

let increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom
        (start:num) ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !rest:int list. !start:num.
        increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom start (CONS x rest) =
        CONS (x,start)
          (increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom (SUC start) rest))`;;

let increasingTriplet_zipIdx = new_definition
  `increasingTriplet_zipIdx (nums:int list) =
     increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom 0 nums`;;

let increasingTriplet_postcond = new_definition
  `increasingTriplet_postcond
      (nums:int list) (result:bool) <=>
     let indexed = increasingTriplet_zipIdx nums in
     (result
      ==> EX
            (\xi:int#num.
               EX
                 (\yj:int#num.
                    EX
                      (\zk:int#num.
                         SND xi < SND yj /\
                         SND yj < SND zk /\
                         FST xi < FST yj /\
                         FST yj < FST zk)
                      indexed)
                 indexed)
            indexed) /\
     (~result
      ==> ALL
            (\xi:int#num.
               ALL
                 (\yj:int#num.
                    ALL
                      (\zk:int#num.
                         SND yj <= SND xi \/
                         SND zk <= SND yj \/
                         FST yj <= FST xi \/
                         FST zk <= FST yj)
                      indexed)
                 indexed)
            indexed)`;;

let increasingTriplet_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     increasingTriplet_precond nums
     ==> increasingTriplet_postcond nums (increasingTriplet nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_15
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_15,
;; "increasingTriplet": a deterministic two-threshold scan decides whether an
;; integer list contains indices i < j < k with increasing values.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-15-integer-listp (nums)
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (integerp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-15-integer-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the List Int domain is explicit in the
;; final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet-precond (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-15-list-length (nums)
  (if (consp nums)
      (+ 1 (verina-advanced-15-list-length (cdr nums)))
    0))

;; Option Int is represented by :none or by the tagged pair (:some . value).

(defun verina-advanced-15-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun verina-advanced-15-loop
    (xs first-option second-option)
  (if (consp xs)
      (let ((x (car xs))
            (rest (cdr xs)))
        (if (equal first-option :none)
            (verina-advanced-15-loop
             rest
             (verina-advanced-15-some x)
             :none)
          (let ((first-value (cdr first-option)))
            (if (<= x first-value)
                (verina-advanced-15-loop
                 rest
                 (verina-advanced-15-some x)
                 second-option)
              (if (equal second-option :none)
                  (verina-advanced-15-loop
                   rest
                   first-option
                   (verina-advanced-15-some x))
                (let ((second-value (cdr second-option)))
                  (if (<= x second-value)
                      (verina-advanced-15-loop
                       rest
                       first-option
                       (verina-advanced-15-some x))
                    t)))))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet (nums)
  (if (< (verina-advanced-15-list-length nums) 3)
      nil
    (verina-advanced-15-loop nums :none :none)))

;; Each zip-index entry is the pair (value . zero-based-index), matching
;; List.zipIdx on the source list.

(defun verina-advanced-15-zip-index-from (nums index)
  (if (consp nums)
      (cons
       (cons (car nums) index)
       (verina-advanced-15-zip-index-from
        (cdr nums) (+ index 1)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-15-zip-index (nums)
  (verina-advanced-15-zip-index-from nums 0))

(defun verina-advanced-15-any-third-p
    (first-entry second-entry entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let ((third-entry (car entries)))
        (or
         (and
          (< (cdr first-entry) (cdr second-entry))
          (< (cdr second-entry) (cdr third-entry))
          (< (car first-entry) (car second-entry))
          (< (car second-entry) (car third-entry)))
         (verina-advanced-15-any-third-p
          first-entry second-entry (cdr entries))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-15-any-second-p
    (first-entry entries all-entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (or
       (verina-advanced-15-any-third-p
        first-entry (car entries) all-entries)
       (verina-advanced-15-any-second-p
        first-entry (cdr entries) all-entries))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-15-any-increasing-triplet-p
    (entries all-entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (or
       (verina-advanced-15-any-second-p
        (car entries) all-entries all-entries)
       (verina-advanced-15-any-increasing-triplet-p
        (cdr entries) all-entries))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-15-all-thirds-fail-p
    (first-entry second-entry entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let ((third-entry (car entries)))
        (and
         (or
          (<= (cdr second-entry) (cdr first-entry))
          (<= (cdr third-entry) (cdr second-entry))
          (<= (car second-entry) (car first-entry))
          (<= (car third-entry) (car second-entry)))
         (verina-advanced-15-all-thirds-fail-p
          first-entry second-entry (cdr entries))))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-15-all-seconds-fail-p
    (first-entry entries all-entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-15-all-thirds-fail-p
        first-entry (car entries) all-entries)
       (verina-advanced-15-all-seconds-fail-p
        first-entry (cdr entries) all-entries))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-15-all-triplets-fail-p
    (entries all-entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-15-all-seconds-fail-p
        (car entries) all-entries all-entries)
       (verina-advanced-15-all-triplets-fail-p
        (cdr entries) all-entries))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-15-bool-p (result)
  (or (equal result t)
      (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet-postcond
    (nums result)
  (let ((indexed-nums
         (verina-advanced-15-zip-index nums)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-15-integer-listp nums)
     (verina-advanced-15-bool-p result)
     (implies
      result
      (verina-advanced-15-any-increasing-triplet-p
       indexed-nums indexed-nums))
     (implies
      (not result)
      (verina-advanced-15-all-triplets-fail-p
       indexed-nums indexed-nums)))))

(defun
    verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-15-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-15-increasing-triplet nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_15
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_15,
-- catalog title "increasingTriplet": a deterministic list program decides
-- whether three entries at increasing indices have strictly increasing values.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced15 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_ _||_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

natGreaterOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natGreaterOrEqual m n = natLessOrEqual n m

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual x y = intLessOrEqual y x

three : Nat
three = suc (suc (suc zero))

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

IncreasingTriplet-precond : List Int → Set
IncreasingTriplet-precond nums = Top

increasingTripletLoop :
  List Int → Maybe Int → Maybe Int → Bool
increasingTripletLoop [] firstThreshold secondThreshold = false
increasingTripletLoop
  (x ∷ rest)
  nothing
  secondThreshold =
  increasingTripletLoop rest (just x) nothing
increasingTripletLoop (x ∷ rest) (just firstThreshold) nothing =
  if intLessOrEqual x firstThreshold
  then increasingTripletLoop rest (just x) nothing
  else increasingTripletLoop rest (just firstThreshold) (just x)
increasingTripletLoop
  (x ∷ rest)
  (just firstThreshold)
  (just secondThreshold) =
  if intLessOrEqual x firstThreshold
  then increasingTripletLoop rest (just x) (just secondThreshold)
  else
    if intLessOrEqual x secondThreshold
    then increasingTripletLoop rest (just firstThreshold) (just x)
    else true

increasingTriplet :
  (nums : List Int) →
  IncreasingTriplet-precond nums →
  Bool
increasingTriplet nums h-precond =
  if natLess (listLength nums) three
  then false
  else increasingTripletLoop nums nothing nothing

record IndexedInt : Set where
  constructor indexed
  field
    indexedValue : Int
    indexedPosition : Nat

open IndexedInt public

zipIdxFrom : Nat → List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdxFrom position [] = []
zipIdxFrom position (x ∷ xs) =
  indexed x position ∷ zipIdxFrom (suc position) xs

zipIdx : List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdx nums = zipIdxFrom zero nums

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

isIncreasingIndexedTriple :
  IndexedInt → IndexedInt → IndexedInt → Bool
isIncreasingIndexedTriple x y z =
  natLess (indexedPosition x) (indexedPosition y) &&
  natLess (indexedPosition y) (indexedPosition z) &&
  intLess (indexedValue x) (indexedValue y) &&
  intLess (indexedValue y) (indexedValue z)

isNotIncreasingIndexedTriple :
  IndexedInt → IndexedInt → IndexedInt → Bool
isNotIncreasingIndexedTriple x y z =
  natGreaterOrEqual (indexedPosition x) (indexedPosition y) ||
  natGreaterOrEqual (indexedPosition y) (indexedPosition z) ||
  intGreaterOrEqual (indexedValue x) (indexedValue y) ||
  intGreaterOrEqual (indexedValue y) (indexedValue z)

hasIncreasingIndexedTriple : List IndexedInt → Bool
hasIncreasingIndexedTriple entries =
  anyList
    (λ x →
      anyList
        (λ y →
          anyList
            (λ z → isIncreasingIndexedTriple x y z)
            entries)
        entries)
    entries

allIndexedTriplesFail : List IndexedInt → Bool
allIndexedTriplesFail entries =
  allList
    (λ x →
      allList
        (λ y →
          allList
            (λ z → isNotIncreasingIndexedTriple x y z)
            entries)
        entries)
    entries

IncreasingTriplet-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Bool) →
  IncreasingTriplet-precond nums →
  Set
IncreasingTriplet-postcond nums result h-precond =
  let entries = zipIdx nums
  in
    (IsTrue result → IsTrue (hasIncreasingIndexedTriple entries)) ∧
    (Not (IsTrue result) → IsTrue (allIndexedTriplesFail entries))

IncreasingTriplet-spec-satisfied : Set
IncreasingTriplet-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : IncreasingTriplet-precond nums) →
  IncreasingTriplet-postcond
    nums
    (increasingTriplet nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_15
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_15,
  cataloged as "increasingTriplet": the executable Boolean program detects
  whether an integer list contains a strictly increasing subsequence of
  length three. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val increasingTriplet_precond_def = new_definition (
  "increasingTriplet_precond_def",
  ``increasingTriplet_precond (nums : int list) <=> T``
);

val increasingTriplet_loop_def = Define `
  (increasingTriplet_loop
      ([] : int list) (first : int option) (second : int option) = F) /\
  (increasingTriplet_loop (x::xs) NONE second =
     increasingTriplet_loop xs (SOME x) NONE) /\
  (increasingTriplet_loop (x::xs) (SOME f) NONE =
     if x <= f then
       increasingTriplet_loop xs (SOME x) NONE
     else
       increasingTriplet_loop xs (SOME f) (SOME x)) /\
  (increasingTriplet_loop (x::xs) (SOME f) (SOME s) =
     if x <= f then
       increasingTriplet_loop xs (SOME x) (SOME s)
     else if x <= s then
       increasingTriplet_loop xs (SOME f) (SOME x)
     else
       T)
`;

val increasingTriplet_def = new_definition (
  "increasingTriplet_def",
  ``increasingTriplet (nums : int list) =
      if LENGTH nums < 3 then
        F
      else
        increasingTriplet_loop nums NONE NONE``
);

val increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom_def = Define `
  (increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = ([] : (int # num) list)) /\
  (increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom index (x::xs) =
     (x,index)::increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom (SUC index) xs)
`;

val increasingTriplet_zipIdx_def = new_definition (
  "increasingTriplet_zipIdx_def",
  ``increasingTriplet_zipIdx (nums : int list) =
      increasingTriplet_zipIdxFrom 0 nums``
);

val increasingTriplet_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "increasingTriplet_postcond_def",
  ``increasingTriplet_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : bool) <=>
      let nums' = increasingTriplet_zipIdx nums
      in
        (result ==>
          EXISTS
            (\xi : int # num.
              EXISTS
                (\yj : int # num.
                  EXISTS
                    (\zk : int # num.
                      SND xi < SND yj /\
                      SND yj < SND zk /\
                      FST xi < FST yj /\
                      FST yj < FST zk)
                    nums')
                nums')
            nums') /\
        (~result ==>
          EVERY
            (\xi : int # num.
              EVERY
                (\yj : int # num.
                  EVERY
                    (\zk : int # num.
                      SND xi >= SND yj \/
                      SND yj >= SND zk \/
                      FST xi >= FST yj \/
                      FST yj >= FST zk)
                    nums')
                nums')
            nums')``
);

val increasingTriplet_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      increasingTriplet_precond nums ==>
      increasingTriplet_postcond nums (increasingTriplet nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_15
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_15, catalog title increasingTriplet: an executable greedy
  scan of a finite integer list decides whether three entries at increasing
  indices have strictly increasing values, together with its Boolean
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists, and { 0 , 1 } represents Bool with false
  = 0 and true = 1. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k is zero-based
  lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA15None, VERINA15Some, and VERINA15OptionInt give a disjoint tagged
  encoding of Option Int. VERINA15State is the pair of optional first and
  second candidates maintained by the source loop. VERINA15NoHitStep is
  exactly one recursive branch that continues scanning, while VERINA15Hit
  is exactly the final branch that returns true.

  VERINA15LoopGraph records the exact finite execution of the local loop.
  Its true branch contains all preceding non-hit transitions followed by
  the first successful input position; its false branch contains one
  non-hit transition for every input entry. VERINA15Loop selects the unique
  Boolean output of this graph. VERINA15IncreasingTriplet also retains the
  source's explicit length-below-three guard, so this is the executable
  program semantics on every typed input, not an unconstrained output
  relation and not a choice made from the postcondition.

  VERINA15Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int
  input type. VERINA15Post reproduces both nested zipIdx any/all clauses:
  true implies an increasing indexed triplet, and false implies that every
  indexed triple violates at least one required inequality. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally unused and is omitted from the
  target function. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and
  this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA15None VERINA15Some VERINA15OptionInt
  VERINA15State VERINA15Initial
  VERINA15Hit VERINA15NoHitStep
  VERINA15LoopGraph VERINA15Loop VERINA15IncreasingTriplet
  VERINA15Pre VERINA15Post
$.

verina15-none-syntax $a class VERINA15None $.
verina15-some-syntax $a class ( VERINA15Some A ) $.
verina15-option-int-syntax $a class VERINA15OptionInt $.
verina15-state-syntax $a class VERINA15State $.
verina15-initial-syntax $a class VERINA15Initial $.
verina15-hit-syntax $a wff ( VERINA15Hit A B ) $.
verina15-no-hit-step-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA15NoHitStep A B C ) $.
verina15-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA15LoopGraph A B ) $.
verina15-loop-syntax $a class ( VERINA15Loop A ) $.
verina15-increasing-triplet-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA15IncreasingTriplet A ) $.
verina15-precondition-syntax $a wff ( VERINA15Pre A ) $.
verina15-postcondition-syntax $a wff ( VERINA15Post A B ) $.

verina15-none-definition $a |- VERINA15None = (/) $.

verina15-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA15Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina15-option-int-definition $a |- VERINA15OptionInt =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA15None
        \/
        E. y e. ZZ x = ( VERINA15Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

verina15-state-definition $a |- VERINA15State = (
  VERINA15OptionInt X. VERINA15OptionInt
) $.

verina15-initial-definition $a |- VERINA15Initial = <.
  VERINA15None , VERINA15None
>. $.

${
  $d f s A B $.

  verina15-hit-definition $a |- (
    VERINA15Hit A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. VERINA15State
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. f e. ZZ E. s e. ZZ
      (
        (
          ( 1st ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some f )
          /\
          ( 2nd ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some s )
        )
        /\
        (
          f < B
          /\
          s < B
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f s A B C $.

  verina15-no-hit-step-definition $a |- (
    VERINA15NoHitStep A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINA15State
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINA15State
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( 1st ` A ) = VERINA15None
        /\
        C = <. ( VERINA15Some B ) , VERINA15None >.
      )
      \/
      E. f e. ZZ
        (
          (
            ( 1st ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some f )
            /\
            B <_ f
          )
          /\
          C = <. ( VERINA15Some B ) , ( 2nd ` A ) >.
        )
      \/
      E. f e. ZZ
        (
          (
            (
              ( 1st ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some f )
              /\
              f < B
            )
            /\
            ( 2nd ` A ) = VERINA15None
          )
          /\
          C = <. ( 1st ` A ) , ( VERINA15Some B ) >.
        )
      \/
      E. f e. ZZ E. s e. ZZ
        (
          (
            (
              ( 1st ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some f )
              /\
              f < B
            )
            /\
            (
              ( 2nd ` A ) = ( VERINA15Some s )
              /\
              B <_ s
            )
          )
          /\
          C = <. ( 1st ` A ) , ( VERINA15Some B ) >.
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i k t A B $.

  verina15-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA15LoopGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = 1
        /\
        E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          E. t e. Word VERINA15State
            (
              (
                ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
                /\
                ( t ` 0 ) = VERINA15Initial
              )
              /\
              (
                A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                  (
                    VERINA15NoHitStep
                      ( t ` i )
                      ( A ` i )
                      ( t ` ( i + 1 ) )
                  )
                /\
                ( VERINA15Hit ( t ` k ) ( A ` k ) )
              )
            )
      )
      \/
      (
        B = 0
        /\
        E. t e. Word VERINA15State
          (
            (
              ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( t ` 0 ) = VERINA15Initial
            )
            /\
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                VERINA15NoHitStep
                  ( t ` k )
                  ( A ` k )
                  ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
              )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina15-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA15Loop A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. { 0 , 1 }
      ( VERINA15LoopGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina15-increasing-triplet-definition $a |- (
  VERINA15IncreasingTriplet A
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) < 3 ,
  0 ,
  ( VERINA15Loop A )
) $.

verina15-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA15Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d i j k A B $.

  verina15-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA15Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. { 0 , 1 }
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = 1
        ->
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                (
                  i < j
                  /\
                  j < k
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( A ` i ) < ( A ` j )
                  /\
                  ( A ` j ) < ( A ` k )
                )
              )
      )
      /\
      (
        B = 0
        ->
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                j <_ i
                \/
                k <_ j
                \/

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_15, "increasingTriplet": a deterministic two-threshold scan
% decides whether an integer list has three strictly increasing values at
% strictly increasing indices. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_15: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoneInt: NoneInt?
    SomeInt(option_value: int): SomeInt?
  END int_option

  increasingTriplet_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_list_length(nums: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES nums OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE nums BY <<

  increasingTriplet_loop(
      xs: list[int],
      first, second: int_option): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(x, rest):
        CASES first OF
          NoneInt:
            increasingTriplet_loop(
              rest,
              SomeInt(x),
              NoneInt),
          SomeInt(f):
            IF x <= f THEN
              increasingTriplet_loop(
                rest,
                SomeInt(x),
                second)
            ELSE
              CASES second OF
                NoneInt:
                  increasingTriplet_loop(
                    rest,
                    first,
                    SomeInt(x)),
                SomeInt(s):
                  IF x <= s THEN
                    increasingTriplet_loop(
                      rest,
                      first,
                      SomeInt(x))
                  ELSE
                    TRUE
                  ENDIF
              ENDCASES
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  increasingTriplet(nums: list[int]): bool =
    IF int_list_length(nums) < 3 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      increasingTriplet_loop(
        nums,
        NoneInt,
        NoneInt)
    ENDIF

  int_list_nth_default(
      index: nat,
      nums: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES nums OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_nth_default(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE nums BY <<

  has_increasing_indexed_triplet(nums: list[int]): bool =
    EXISTS (i, j, k: nat):
      i < int_list_length(nums)
        AND j < int_list_length(nums)
        AND k < int_list_length(nums)
        AND i < j
        AND j < k
        AND int_list_nth_default(i, nums)
              < int_list_nth_default(j, nums)
        AND int_list_nth_default(j, nums)
              < int_list_nth_default(k, nums)

  all_indexed_triplets_fail(nums: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (i, j, k: nat):
      (i < int_list_length(nums)
        AND j < int_list_length(nums)
        AND k < int_list_length(nums))
      IMPLIES
        (i >= j
          OR j >= k
          OR int_list_nth_default(i, nums)
               >= int_list_nth_default(j, nums)
          OR int_list_nth_default(j, nums)
               >= int_list_nth_default(k, nums))

  increasingTriplet_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: bool): bool =
    (result IMPLIES
      has_increasing_indexed_triplet(nums))
      AND (NOT result IMPLIES
        all_indexed_triplets_fail(nums))

  increasingTriplet_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      increasingTriplet_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        increasingTriplet_postcond(
          nums,
          increasingTriplet(nums))

END verina_advanced_15

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_16,
   catalog title "insertionSort": executable insertion sort on integer lists,
   with sortedness and permutation correctness. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Sorting.Permutation Sorting.Sorted ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition insertionSort_precond (_xs : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint insertionSort_insert
    (x : Z) (ys : list Z) : list Z :=
  match ys with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys' =>
      if Z.leb x y
      then x :: y :: ys'
      else y :: insertionSort_insert x ys'
  end.

Fixpoint insertionSort_sort (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs' =>
      insertionSort_insert x (insertionSort_sort xs')
  end.

Definition insertionSort
    (xs : list Z)
    (_h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs) : list Z :=
  insertionSort_sort xs.

Definition insertionSort_postcond
    (xs result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le result /\
  Permutation xs result.

Theorem insertionSort_spec_satisfied
    (xs : list Z)
    (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs) :
  insertionSort_postcond
    xs (insertionSort xs h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

  "insertionSort_insert x [] = [x]"
| "insertionSort_insert x (y # ys) =

     else y # insertionSort_insert x ys)"

fun insertionSort :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "insertionSort [] = []"
| "insertionSort (x # xs) =

  "insertionSort_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "insertionSort_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     insertionSort_pairwise_le xs)"

definition insertionSort_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insertionSort_postcond xs result \<longleftrightarrow>
    insertionSort_pairwise_le result \<and>
    (\<forall>z. count_list xs z = count_list result z)"

theorem insertionSort_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "insertionSort_precond xs"
  shows "insertionSort_postcond xs (insertionSort xs)"
  sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_16,
;; "insertionSort": recursive insertion sort returns a nondecreasing integer
;; list that is a permutation of its input. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-16-integer-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-16-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the List Int input domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort-precond (xs)
  (declare (ignore xs))
  t)

;; These two recursive functions are the source's local insert and sort
;; definitions, with the proof-valued precondition argument erased.

(defun verina-advanced-16-insert (x ys)
  (if (consp ys)
      (let ((y (car ys)))
        (if (<= x y)
            (cons x ys)
          (cons
           y
           (verina-advanced-16-insert x (cdr ys)))))
    (list x)))

(defun verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-advanced-16-insert
       (car xs)
       (verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort (cdr xs)))
    nil))

;; List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y) requires each head to be at most every
;; later element and recursively imposes the same condition on the tail.

(defun verina-advanced-16-head-at-most-all-p (x ys)
  (if (consp ys)
      (and
       (<= x (car ys))
       (verina-advanced-16-head-at-most-all-p x (cdr ys)))
    (equal ys nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-16-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-16-head-at-most-all-p
        (car xs) (cdr xs))
       (verina-advanced-16-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; Removing one matching occurrence at each step gives exact finite-list
;; multiset equality, including multiplicities, and hence List.isPerm.

(defun verina-advanced-16-remove-first (value xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal value (car xs))
          (cdr xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-16-remove-first value (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-16-permutation-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-advanced-16-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-advanced-16-remove-first (car left) right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort-postcond
    (xs result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-16-integer-listp xs)
   (verina-advanced-16-integer-listp result)
   (verina-advanced-16-pairwise-nondecreasing-p result)
   (verina-advanced-16-permutation-p xs result)))

(defun
    verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort-spec-satisfied-statement
    (xs)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-16-integer-listp xs)
    (verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort-precond xs))
   (verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort-postcond
    xs
    (verina-advanced-16-insertion-sort xs))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_16,
-- catalog title "insertionSort": a deterministic insertion-sort program returns
-- the input integers in ascending order as a permutation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced16 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A → List A → Set where
  permutationNil :
    Permutation [] []

  permutationSkip :
    {x : A} {xs ys : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

  permutationSwap :
    {x y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Permutation (y ∷ x ∷ xs) (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

  permutationTrans :
    {xs ys zs : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation ys zs →
    Permutation xs zs

insertionSort-precond : List Int → Set
insertionSort-precond xs = Top

insert : Int → List Int → List Int
insert x [] = x ∷ []
insert x (y ∷ ys) =
  if intLessOrEqual x y
  then (x ∷ y ∷ ys)
  else (y ∷ insert x ys)

sort : List Int → List Int
sort [] = []
sort (x ∷ xs) = insert x (sort xs)

insertionSort :
  (xs : List Int) →
  insertionSort-precond xs →
  List Int
insertionSort xs h-precond = sort xs

insertionSort-postcond :
  (xs : List Int) →
  (result : List Int) →
  insertionSort-precond xs →
  Set
insertionSort-postcond xs result h-precond =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual result ∧ Permutation xs result

insertionSort-spec-satisfied : Set
insertionSort-spec-satisfied =
  (xs : List Int) →
  (h-precond : insertionSort-precond xs) →
  insertionSort-postcond
    xs
    (insertionSort xs h-precond)
    h-precond

  verina_advanced_16, catalog title insertionSort: exact recursive insertion
  sort on an arbitrary finite integer list returns a nondecreasing
  permutation of that list. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k
  is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA16InsertGraph gives the exact computation of the source local insert
  recursion. Its position p is the first input position whose value is at
  least the inserted integer, or the word length if there is no such
  position. The output copies the prefix, places the new integer at p, and
  shifts the remaining suffix by one. VERINA16Insert selects the unique word
  described by this graph.

  VERINA16SortGraph gives the exact computation of the source local sort

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_16, "insertionSort": recursively insertion-sorting an
% integer list into nondecreasing order while preserving its elements.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_16: THEORY
BEGIN

  insertionSort_precond(xs: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  insert_int(
      x: int,
      ys: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES ys OF
      null:
        cons(x, null),
      cons(y, rest):
        IF x <= y THEN
          cons(x, cons(y, rest))
        ELSE
          cons(y, insert_int(x, rest))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE ys BY <<

  insertionSort(xs: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(x, rest):
        insert_int(x, insertionSort(rest))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  occurrence_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_is_permutation(
      first, second: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      occurrence_count(value, first)
        = occurrence_count(value, second)

  insertionSort_postcond(
      xs: list[int],
      result: list[int]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing(result)
      AND int_list_is_permutation(xs, result)

  insertionSort_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (xs: list[int]):
      insertionSort_precond(xs) IMPLIES
        insertionSort_postcond(
          xs,
          insertionSort(xs))

END verina_advanced_16

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_17,
   catalog title "insertionSort": executable insertion sort on integer lists,
   with nondecreasing sortedness and permutation correctness. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Sorting.Permutation Sorting.Sorted ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition insertionSort_precond (_l : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint insertElement (x : Z) (l : list Z) : list Z :=
  match l with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if Z.leb x y
      then x :: y :: ys
      else y :: insertElement x ys
  end.

Fixpoint sortList (l : list Z) : list Z :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertElement x (sortList xs)
  end.

Definition insertionSort
    (l : list Z)
    (_h_precond : insertionSort_precond l) : list Z :=
  let result := sortList l in
  result.

Definition insertionSort_postcond
    (l result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : insertionSort_precond l) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le result /\
  Permutation l result.

Theorem insertionSort_spec_satisfied
    (l : list Z)
    (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l) :
  insertionSort_postcond
    l (insertionSort l h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_17,
  catalog title "insertionSort": an executable insertion-sort program inserts
  each integer into the recursively sorted tail and returns a pairwise
  nondecreasing permutation of the input. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_17
  imports Main
begin

definition insertionSort_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insertionSort_precond l \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun insertElement :: "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "insertElement x [] = [x]"
| "insertElement x (y # ys) =
    (if x \<le> y
     then x # y # ys
     else y # insertElement x ys)"

fun sortList :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "sortList [] = []"
| "sortList (x # xs) = insertElement x (sortList xs)"

definition insertionSort :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "insertionSort l = (let result = sortList l in result)"

fun insertionSort_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insertionSort_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "insertionSort_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     insertionSort_pairwise_le xs)"

definition insertionSort_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insertionSort_postcond l result \<longleftrightarrow>
    insertionSort_pairwise_le result \<and>
    (\<forall>z. count_list l z = count_list result z)"

theorem insertionSort_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "insertionSort_precond l"
  shows "insertionSort_postcond l (insertionSort l)"
  sorry

end

  with its total precondition and nondecreasing permutation postcondition.

     (!y:int. !ys:int list. !x:int.
        insertElement x (CONS y ys) =

        then CONS x (CONS y ys)
        else CONS y (insertElement x ys))`;;

    `(sortList ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        sortList (CONS x xs) = insertElement x (sortList xs))`;;

let insertionSort = new_definition
  `insertionSort (l:int list) = sortList l`;;

let insertionSort_count = new_definition
  `insertionSort_count (z:int) (xs:int list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = z) xs)`;;

let insertionSort_isPerm = new_definition
  `insertionSort_isPerm (xs:int list) (ys:int list) <=>
     !z:int. insertionSort_count z xs = insertionSort_count z ys`;;

let insertionSort_postcond = new_definition
  `insertionSort_postcond (l:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) result /\
     insertionSort_isPerm l result`;;

let insertionSort_spec_satisfied =
  `!l:int list.
     insertionSort_precond l
     ==> insertionSort_postcond l (insertionSort l)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_17,
;; "insertionSort": recursive insertion sort returns a nondecreasing integer
;; list that is a permutation of its input. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-17-integer-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-17-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the List Int input domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort-precond (xs)
  (declare (ignore xs))
  t)

;; These recursive functions are exactly the source insertElement and sortList
;; helpers. The proof-valued precondition argument to insertionSort is erased.

(defun verina-advanced-17-insert-element (x ys)
  (if (consp ys)
      (let ((y (car ys)))
        (if (<= x y)
            (cons x ys)
          (cons
           y
           (verina-advanced-17-insert-element x (cdr ys)))))
    (list x)))

(defun verina-advanced-17-sort-list (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-advanced-17-insert-element
       (car xs)
       (verina-advanced-17-sort-list (cdr xs)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort (xs)
  (verina-advanced-17-sort-list xs))

;; List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y) requires each head to be at most every
;; later element and recursively imposes the same condition on the tail.

(defun verina-advanced-17-head-at-most-all-p (x ys)
  (if (consp ys)
      (and
       (<= x (car ys))
       (verina-advanced-17-head-at-most-all-p x (cdr ys)))
    (equal ys nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-17-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-17-head-at-most-all-p
        (car xs) (cdr xs))
       (verina-advanced-17-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; Removing one matching occurrence at each step gives exact finite-list
;; multiset equality, including multiplicities, and hence List.isPerm.

(defun verina-advanced-17-remove-first (value xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal value (car xs))
          (cdr xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-17-remove-first value (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-17-permutation-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-advanced-17-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-advanced-17-remove-first (car left) right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort-postcond
    (xs result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-17-integer-listp xs)
   (verina-advanced-17-integer-listp result)
   (verina-advanced-17-pairwise-nondecreasing-p result)
   (verina-advanced-17-permutation-p xs result)))

(defun
    verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort-spec-satisfied-statement
    (xs)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-17-integer-listp xs)
    (verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort-precond xs))
   (verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort-postcond
    xs
    (verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort xs))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_17,
-- catalog title "insertionSort": a deterministic insertion-sort program returns
-- the input integers in nondecreasing order as a permutation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced17 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A → List A → Set where
  permutationNil :
    Permutation [] []

  permutationSkip :
    {x : A} {xs ys : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

  permutationSwap :
    {x y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Permutation (y ∷ x ∷ xs) (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

  permutationTrans :
    {xs ys zs : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation ys zs →
    Permutation xs zs

insertionSort-precond : List Int → Set
insertionSort-precond l = Top

insertElement : Int → List Int → List Int
insertElement x [] = x ∷ []
insertElement x (y ∷ ys) =
  if intLessOrEqual x y
  then (x ∷ y ∷ ys)
  else (y ∷ insertElement x ys)

sortList : List Int → List Int
sortList [] = []
sortList (x ∷ xs) = insertElement x (sortList xs)

insertionSort :
  (l : List Int) →
  insertionSort-precond l →
  List Int
insertionSort l h-precond = sortList l

insertionSort-postcond :
  (l : List Int) →
  (result : List Int) →
  insertionSort-precond l →
  Set
insertionSort-postcond l result h-precond =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual result ∧ Permutation l result

insertionSort-spec-satisfied : Set
insertionSort-spec-satisfied =
  (l : List Int) →
  (h-precond : insertionSort-precond l) →
  insertionSort-postcond
    l
    (insertionSort l h-precond)
    h-precond

`;

val sortList_def = Define `
  (sortList ([] : int list) = ([] : int list)) /\
  (sortList (x::xs) =
     insertElement x (sortList xs))
`;

val insertionSort_def = new_definition (
  "insertionSort_def",
  ``insertionSort (l : int list) = sortList l``
);

val insertionSort_pairwise_def = Define `
  (insertionSort_pairwise ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (insertionSort_pairwise (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
      insertionSort_pairwise xs))
`;

val insertionSort_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "insertionSort_postcond_def",
  ``insertionSort_postcond
      (l : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      insertionSort_pairwise result /\
      PERM l result``
);

val insertionSort_spec_satisfied =
  ``!l : int list.
      insertionSort_precond l ==>
      insertionSort_postcond l (insertionSort l)``;

title: verina_advanced_17
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_17, catalog title insertionSort: exact recursive insertion
  sort on an arbitrary finite integer list returns a nondecreasing
  permutation of that list. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k
  is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA17InsertGraph gives the exact computation of the source insertElement
  recursion. Its position p is the first input position whose value is at
  least the inserted integer, or the word length if there is no such
  position. The output copies the prefix, places the new integer at p, and
  shifts the remaining suffix by one. VERINA17Insert selects the unique word
  described by this graph.

  VERINA17SortGraph gives the exact computation of the source sortList
  recursion. Its trace begins with the empty word and inserts the input
  entries from right to left, matching
  sortList (x :: xs) = insertElement x (sortList xs).
  VERINA17Sort selects the unique final trace value, and
  VERINA17InsertionSort is the source executable implementation. Thus the
  implementation is not an unconstrained function and is not selected from
  the postcondition.

  VERINA17Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int
  input type. VERINA17Pairwise is List.Pairwise with integer <=, and
  VERINA17Perm is List.isPerm, represented by equality of the multiplicity
  of every integer. VERINA17Post is their conjunction. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally unused and is omitted from the
  target function. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA17InsertGraph VERINA17Insert
  VERINA17SortGraph VERINA17Sort VERINA17InsertionSort
  VERINA17Pre VERINA17Pairwise VERINA17Perm VERINA17Post
$.

verina17-insert-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17InsertGraph A B C ) $.
verina17-insert-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA17Insert A B ) $.
verina17-sort-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17SortGraph A B ) $.
verina17-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA17Sort A ) $.
verina17-insertion-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA17InsertionSort A ) $.
verina17-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17Pre A ) $.
verina17-pairwise-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17Pairwise A ) $.
verina17-permutation-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17Perm A B ) $.
verina17-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA17Post A B ) $.

${
  $d j p A B C $.

  verina17-insert-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17InsertGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              -. A <_ ( B ` j )
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` B )
              ->
              A <_ ( B ` p )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
            /\
            (
              ( C ` p ) = A
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
                  ( C ` j ) = ( B ` j )
                /\
                A. j e. ( p ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( C ` ( j + 1 ) ) = ( B ` j )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina17-insert-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17Insert A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA17InsertGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verina17-sort-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17SortGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA17InsertGraph
                ( A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k ) )
                ( t ` k )
                ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina17-sort-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17Sort A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA17SortGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina17-insertion-sort-definition $a |- (
  VERINA17InsertionSort A
) = (
  VERINA17Sort A
) $.

verina17-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA17Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina17-pairwise-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17Pairwise A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j x A B $.

  verina17-permutation-definition $a |- (
    VERINA17Perm A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    A. x e. ZZ
      (
        # ` {
          i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          |
          ( A ` i ) = x
        }
      ) = (
        # ` {
          j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          |
          ( B ` j ) = x
        }
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina17-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA17Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA17Pairwise B )
    /\
    ( VERINA17Perm A B )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-17-insertion-sort $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINA17Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA17Post
        w
        ( VERINA17InsertionSort w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_advanced_17
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_17, "insertionSort": recursively insertion-sorting an
% integer list into nondecreasing order while preserving its elements.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_17: THEORY
BEGIN

  insertionSort_precond(l: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  insertElement(
      x: int,
      l: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES l OF
      null:
        cons(x, null),
      cons(y, ys):
        IF x <= y THEN
          cons(x, cons(y, ys))
        ELSE
          cons(y, insertElement(x, ys))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE l BY <<

  sortList(l: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES l OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(x, xs):
        insertElement(x, sortList(xs))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE l BY <<

  insertionSort(l: list[int]): list[int] =
    sortList(l)

  all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  occurrence_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_is_permutation(
      first, second: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      occurrence_count(value, first)
        = occurrence_count(value, second)

  insertionSort_postcond(
      l: list[int],
      result: list[int]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing(result)
      AND int_list_is_permutation(l, result)

  insertionSort_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (l: list[int]):
      insertionSort_precond(l) IMPLIES
        insertionSort_postcond(
          l,
          insertionSort(l))

END verina_advanced_17
