title: verina_advanced_18
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_18,
   catalog title "isArmstrong": an executable Armstrong-number test and its
   decimal-digit power-sum correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint countDigits_go
    (fuel n acc : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => acc
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n 0
      then acc
      else countDigits_go fuel' (Nat.div n 10) (acc + 1)
  end.

Definition countDigits (n : nat) : nat :=
  countDigits_go n n (if Nat.eqb n 0 then 1 else 0).

Definition isArmstrong_precond (_n : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint sumPowers_go
    (fuel n acc k : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => acc
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n 0
      then acc
      else
        let digit := Nat.modulo n 10 in
        sumPowers_go
          fuel' (Nat.div n 10) (acc + Nat.pow digit k) k
  end.

Definition sumPowers (n k : nat) : nat :=
  sumPowers_go n n 0 k.

Definition isArmstrong
    (n : nat)
    (_h_precond : isArmstrong_precond n) : bool :=
  let k := countDigits n in
  Nat.eqb (sumPowers n k) n.

Fixpoint decimalDigits_rev_go
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => []
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n 0
      then []
      else
        Nat.modulo n 10
          :: decimalDigits_rev_go fuel' (Nat.div n 10)
  end.

Definition decimalDigits (n : nat) : list nat :=
  if Nat.eqb n 0
  then [0]
  else rev (decimalDigits_rev_go n n).

Definition isArmstrong_digitPowerSum (n : nat) : nat :=
  fold_left
    (fun acc d => acc + Nat.pow d (countDigits n))
    (decimalDigits n) 0.

Definition isArmstrong_postcond
    (n : nat)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : isArmstrong_precond n) : Prop :=
  let n' := isArmstrong_digitPowerSum n in
  (result = true -> n = n') /\
  (result = false -> n <> n').

Theorem isArmstrong_spec_satisfied
    (n : nat)
    (h_precond : isArmstrong_precond n) :
  isArmstrong_postcond
    n (isArmstrong n h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_18,
  catalog title "isArmstrong": an executable natural-number program counts
  decimal digits, sums each digit raised to that count, and decides the
  Armstrong-number property together with its correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_18
  imports Main
begin

fun countDigits_go :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countDigits_go 0 n acc = acc"
| "countDigits_go (Suc fuel) n acc =
    (if n = 0
     then acc
     else countDigits_go fuel (n div 10) (acc + 1))"

definition countDigits :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countDigits n =
    countDigits_go (Suc n) n (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition isArmstrong_precond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isArmstrong_precond n \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun sumPowers_go ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumPowers_go 0 n k acc = acc"
| "sumPowers_go (Suc fuel) n k acc =
    (if n = 0
     then acc
     else
       (let digit = n mod 10
        in sumPowers_go fuel (n div 10) k (acc + digit ^ k)))"

definition sumPowers :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumPowers n k = sumPowers_go (Suc n) n k 0"

definition isArmstrong :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isArmstrong n = (let k = countDigits n in sumPowers n k = n)"

fun decimalDigitsRev_go :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "decimalDigitsRev_go 0 n = []"
| "decimalDigitsRev_go (Suc fuel) n =
    (if n = 0
     then []
     else (n mod 10) # decimalDigitsRev_go fuel (n div 10))"

definition decimalDigits :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "decimalDigits n =
    (if n = 0
     then [0]
     else rev (decimalDigitsRev_go (Suc n) n))"

definition isArmstrong_postcond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isArmstrong_postcond n result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let n' =
       foldl
         (\<lambda>acc d. acc + d ^ countDigits n)
         0
         (decimalDigits n)
     in (result \<longrightarrow> n = n') \<and>
        (\<not> result \<longrightarrow> n \<noteq> n'))"

theorem isArmstrong_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "isArmstrong_precond n"
  shows "isArmstrong_postcond n (isArmstrong n)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_18,
  catalog title "isArmstrong": an executable decimal-digit computation tests
  whether a natural number equals the sum of its digits raised to the number
  of digits, together with its total correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let countDigits_go = define
  `countDigits_go(n,acc) =
     if n = 0 then acc
     else countDigits_go(n DIV 10,acc + 1)`;;

let countDigits = new_definition
  `countDigits (n:num) =
     countDigits_go(n,if n = 0 then 1 else 0)`;;

let isArmstrong_precond = new_definition
  `isArmstrong_precond (n:num) <=> T`;;

let sumPowers_go = define
  `sumPowers_go(n,k,acc) =
     if n = 0 then acc
     else
       let digit = n MOD 10 in
       sumPowers_go(n DIV 10,k,acc + digit EXP k)`;;

let sumPowers = new_definition
  `sumPowers (n:num) (k:num) = sumPowers_go(n,k,0)`;;

let isArmstrong = new_definition
  `isArmstrong (n:num) =
     (sumPowers n (countDigits n) = n)`;;

let isArmstrong_decimalDigits = define
  `isArmstrong_decimalDigits (n:num) =
     if n < 10 then CONS n []
     else
       APPEND
         (isArmstrong_decimalDigits (n DIV 10))
         (CONS (n MOD 10) [])`;;

let isArmstrong_foldDigitPowers =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!k:num. !acc:num.
        isArmstrong_foldDigitPowers k acc [] = acc) /\
     (!d:num. !ds:num list. !k:num. !acc:num.
        isArmstrong_foldDigitPowers k acc (CONS d ds) =
        isArmstrong_foldDigitPowers
          k (acc + d EXP k) ds)`;;

let isArmstrong_postcond = new_definition
  `isArmstrong_postcond
      (n:num) (result:bool) <=>
     let n' =
       isArmstrong_foldDigitPowers
         (countDigits n) 0 (isArmstrong_decimalDigits n) in
     (result ==> n = n') /\
     (~result ==> ~(n = n'))`;;

let isArmstrong_spec_satisfied =
  `!n:num.
     isArmstrong_precond n
     ==> isArmstrong_postcond n (isArmstrong n)`;;

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_18,
;; "isArmstrong": a deterministic decimal-digit computation decides whether a
;; natural number equals the sum of its digits raised to its digit count,
;; together with its Boolean correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True; the Nat input domain is explicit in the
;; final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; The fuel is initialized to n. Each recursive source call replaces a
;; positive residual by floor(n / 10), so at most n calls occur and the fuel
;; does not add a cutoff to the source computation.

(defun verina-advanced-18-count-digits-go (n acc fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (not (natp acc)))
      0
    (if (equal n 0)
        acc
      (if (zp fuel)
          acc
        (verina-advanced-18-count-digits-go
         (floor n 10)
         (+ acc 1)
         (- fuel 1))))))

(defun verina-advanced-18-count-digits (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (verina-advanced-18-count-digits-go
       n
       (if (equal n 0) 1 0)
       n)
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-18-sum-powers-go (n k acc fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (not (natp k))
          (not (natp acc)))
      0
    (if (equal n 0)
        acc
      (if (zp fuel)
          acc
        (let ((digit (mod n 10)))
          (verina-advanced-18-sum-powers-go
           (floor n 10)
           k
           (+ acc (expt digit k))
           (- fuel 1)))))))

(defun verina-advanced-18-sum-powers (n k)
  (if (and (natp n) (natp k))
      (verina-advanced-18-sum-powers-go n k 0 n)
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong (n)
  (let ((k (verina-advanced-18-count-digits n)))
    (equal (verina-advanced-18-sum-powers n k)
           n)))

;; Nat.toString yields one zero digit for 0 and otherwise the ordinary
;; most-significant-first decimal expansion. This separate digit-list
;; computation preserves the source postcondition's string/list fold rather
;; than identifying it definitionally with the implementation loop above.

(defun verina-advanced-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (zp n)
          (zp fuel))
      nil
    (let ((quotient (floor n 10))
          (digit (mod n 10)))
      (if (equal quotient 0)
          (list digit)
        (append
         (verina-advanced-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux
          quotient
          (- fuel 1))
         (list digit))))))

(defun verina-advanced-18-decimal-digits (n)
  (if (not (natp n))
      nil
    (if (equal n 0)
        (list 0)
      (verina-advanced-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux n n))))

(defun verina-advanced-18-fold-digit-powers (digits k acc)
  (if (consp digits)
      (verina-advanced-18-fold-digit-powers
       (cdr digits)
       k
       (+ acc (expt (car digits) k)))
    acc))

(defun verina-advanced-18-bool-p (result)
  (or (equal result t)
      (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong-postcond (n result)
  (let* ((k (verina-advanced-18-count-digits n))
         (digits (verina-advanced-18-decimal-digits n))
         (decimal-power-sum
          (verina-advanced-18-fold-digit-powers
           digits k 0)))
    (and
     (natp n)
     (verina-advanced-18-bool-p result)
     (implies result
              (equal n decimal-power-sum))
     (implies (not result)
              (not (equal n decimal-power-sum))))))

(defun verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong-spec-satisfied-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong-precond n))
   (verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong-postcond
    n
    (verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_18,
-- catalog title "isArmstrong": a deterministic natural-number program decides
-- whether a number equals the sum of its decimal digits raised to its digit count.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced18 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalDiv : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero = zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

one : Nat
one = suc zero

ten : Nat
ten =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))))))))

power : Nat → Nat → Nat
power base zero = one
power base (suc exponent) = base * power base exponent

countDigitsWithFuel : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
countDigitsWithFuel zero current accumulator = accumulator
countDigitsWithFuel (suc fuel) zero accumulator = accumulator
countDigitsWithFuel (suc fuel) current@(suc _) accumulator =
  countDigitsWithFuel
    fuel
    (naturalDiv current ten)
    (suc accumulator)

countDigits : Nat → Nat
countDigits n =
  if natEqual n zero
  then one
  else countDigitsWithFuel n n zero

isArmstrong-precond : Nat → Set
isArmstrong-precond n = Top

sumPowersWithFuel : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
sumPowersWithFuel zero current exponent accumulator = accumulator
sumPowersWithFuel (suc fuel) zero exponent accumulator = accumulator
sumPowersWithFuel
  (suc fuel)
  current@(suc _)
  exponent
  accumulator =
  let digit = naturalMod current ten
  in
    sumPowersWithFuel
      fuel
      (naturalDiv current ten)
      exponent
      (accumulator + power digit exponent)

sumPowers : Nat → Nat → Nat
sumPowers n exponent =
  sumPowersWithFuel n n exponent zero

isArmstrong :
  (n : Nat) →
  isArmstrong-precond n →
  Bool
isArmstrong n h-precond =
  let digitCount = countDigits n
  in natEqual (sumPowers n digitCount) n

digitsReversedWithFuel : Nat → Nat → List Nat
digitsReversedWithFuel zero current = []
digitsReversedWithFuel (suc fuel) zero = []
digitsReversedWithFuel (suc fuel) current@(suc _) =
  naturalMod current ten ∷
  digitsReversedWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv current ten)

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

decimalDigits : Nat → List Nat
decimalDigits zero = zero ∷ []
decimalDigits n@(suc _) =
  reverseList (digitsReversedWithFuel n n)

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

decimalPowerSum : Nat → Nat
decimalPowerSum n =
  foldLeft
    (λ accumulator digit →
      accumulator + power digit (countDigits n))
    zero
    (decimalDigits n)

isArmstrong-postcond :
  (n : Nat) →
  (result : Bool) →
  isArmstrong-precond n →
  Set
isArmstrong-postcond n result h-precond =
  let n′ = decimalPowerSum n
  in
    (IsTrue result → n ≡ n′) ∧
    (Not (IsTrue result) → Not (n ≡ n′))

isArmstrong-spec-satisfied : Set
isArmstrong-spec-satisfied =
  (n : Nat) →
  (h-precond : isArmstrong-precond n) →
  isArmstrong-postcond
    n
    (isArmstrong n h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_18,
  cataloged as "isArmstrong": the executable Boolean program tests whether a
  natural number equals the sum of its decimal digits raised to the number of
  decimal digits. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val countDigitsFuel_def = Define `
  (countDigitsFuel 0 (n : num) (acc : num) = acc) /\
  (countDigitsFuel (SUC fuel) n acc =
     if n = 0 then
       acc
     else
       countDigitsFuel fuel (n DIV 10) (acc + 1))
`;

val countDigits_def = new_definition (
  "countDigits_def",
  ``countDigits (n : num) =
      countDigitsFuel n n (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)``
);

val isArmstrong_precond_def = new_definition (
  "isArmstrong_precond_def",
  ``isArmstrong_precond (n : num) <=> T``
);

val sumPowersFuel_def = Define `
  (sumPowersFuel 0 (n : num) (k : num) (acc : num) = acc) /\
  (sumPowersFuel (SUC fuel) n k acc =
     if n = 0 then
       acc
     else
       sumPowersFuel fuel
         (n DIV 10)
         k
         (acc + (n MOD 10) EXP k))
`;

val sumPowers_def = new_definition (
  "sumPowers_def",
  ``sumPowers (n : num) (k : num) =
      sumPowersFuel n n k 0``
);

val isArmstrong_def = new_definition (
  "isArmstrong_def",
  ``isArmstrong (n : num) =
      (sumPowers n (countDigits n) = n)``
);

val decimalDigitsFuel_def = Define `
  (decimalDigitsFuel 0 (n : num) = ([] : num list)) /\
  (decimalDigitsFuel (SUC fuel) n =
     if n < 10 then
       [n]
     else
       decimalDigitsFuel fuel (n DIV 10) ++ [n MOD 10])
`;

val decimalDigits_def = new_definition (
  "decimalDigits_def",
  ``decimalDigits (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then [0] else decimalDigitsFuel n n``
);

val isArmstrong_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "isArmstrong_postcond_def",
  ``isArmstrong_postcond (n : num) (result : bool) <=>
      let n' =
        FOLDL
          (\acc d. acc + d EXP countDigits n)
          0
          (decimalDigits n)
      in
        (result ==> n = n') /\
        (~result ==> n <> n')``
);

val isArmstrong_spec_satisfied =
  ``!n : num.
      isArmstrong_precond n ==>
      isArmstrong_postcond n (isArmstrong n)``;

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_18, catalog title isArmstrong: exact decimal digit
  recursion decides whether a natural number equals the sum of its digits
  raised to its digit count, with its Boolean correctness contract. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, Word NN0 is exactly the type
  of arbitrary finite natural-number lists, and { 0 , 1 } represents Bool
  with false = 0 and true = 1.

  VERINA18CountDigitsGraph is the exact finite execution graph of the local
  recursion in countDigits. Its trace repeatedly replaces a positive current
  value by its natural quotient by ten and stops at zero. The output is the
  number of divisions, except that the source's special initial accumulator
  makes the output one when the original input is zero.

  VERINA18SumPowersGraph is the exact finite execution graph of sumPowers.
  Its first trace performs the same repeated quotient-by-ten computation, and
  its second trace starts at zero and adds the current last decimal digit
  raised to the supplied exponent at each step. VERINA18CountDigits and
  VERINA18SumPowers select the unique outputs of these deterministic traces.

  VERINA18DecimalDigits is the unique canonical most-significant-first
  decimal digit word of a natural number, including the one-digit word
  containing zero for input zero. VERINA18DigitPowerSum is therefore exactly
  the source postcondition's fold over the character codes of toString after
  subtracting the code of '0'.

  VERINA18IsArmstrong is the source executable Boolean equality test, not an
  unconstrained function and not a result selected from the postcondition.
  VERINA18Pre is the source True precondition together with the Nat input
  type. VERINA18Post retains both source implications. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally unused and is omitted from the
  target function. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA18CountDigitsGraph VERINA18CountDigits
  VERINA18SumPowersGraph VERINA18SumPowers
  VERINA18DecimalDigitsGraph VERINA18DecimalDigits
  VERINA18DigitPowerSum
  VERINA18Pre VERINA18IsArmstrong VERINA18Post
$.

verina18-count-digits-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA18CountDigitsGraph A B ) $.
verina18-count-digits-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA18CountDigits A ) $.
verina18-sum-powers-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA18SumPowersGraph A B C ) $.
verina18-sum-powers-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA18SumPowers A B ) $.
verina18-decimal-digits-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA18DecimalDigitsGraph A B ) $.
verina18-decimal-digits-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA18DecimalDigits A ) $.
verina18-digit-power-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA18DigitPowerSum A ) $.
verina18-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA18Pre A ) $.
verina18-is-armstrong-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA18IsArmstrong A ) $.
verina18-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA18Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i k s A B $.

  verina18-count-digits-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18CountDigitsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( k + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = A
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              0 < ( s ` i )
              /\
              (
                s ` ( i + 1 )
              ) = (
                |_ ` ( ( s ` i ) / ; 1 0 )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` k ) = 0
            /\
            B = if ( A = 0 , 1 , k )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina18-count-digits-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18CountDigits A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA18CountDigitsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i k s t A B C $.

  verina18-sum-powers-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18SumPowersGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. s e. Word NN0 E. t e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          (
            ( # ` s ) = ( k + 1 )
            /\
            ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` 0 ) = A
            /\
            ( t ` 0 ) = 0
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              0 < ( s ` i )
              /\
              (
                (
                  s ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  |_ ` ( ( s ` i ) / ; 1 0 )
                )
                /\
                (
                  t ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  ( t ` i )
                  +
                  ( ( ( s ` i ) mod ; 1 0 ) ^ B )
                )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` k ) = 0
            /\
            C = ( t ` k )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina18-sum-powers-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18SumPowers A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA18SumPowersGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina18-decimal-digits-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18DecimalDigitsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( VERINA18CountDigits A )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( B ` i ) < ; 1 0
        /\
        (
          (
            0 < A
            ->
            0 < ( B ` 0 )
          )
          /\
          A = sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              ( B ` i )
              x.
              (
                ; 1 0
                ^
                ( ( ( # ` B ) - 1 ) - i )
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina18-decimal-digits-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18DecimalDigits A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA18DecimalDigitsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verina18-digit-power-sum-definition $a |- (
    VERINA18DigitPowerSum A
  ) = (
    sum_ i e. (
      0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA18DecimalDigits A ) )
    )
      (
        (
          ( VERINA18DecimalDigits A ) ` i
        )
        ^
        ( VERINA18CountDigits A )
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina18-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA18Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
) $.

verina18-is-armstrong-definition $a |- (
  VERINA18IsArmstrong A
) = if (
  (
    VERINA18SumPowers
      A
      ( VERINA18CountDigits A )
  ) = A ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina18-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA18Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. { 0 , 1 }
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      B = 1
      ->
      A = ( VERINA18DigitPowerSum A )
    )
    /\
    (
      B = 0
      ->
      A =/= ( VERINA18DigitPowerSum A )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-18-is-armstrong $a |- A. n e. NN0
  (
    ( VERINA18Pre n )
    ->
    (
      VERINA18Post
        n
        ( VERINA18IsArmstrong n )
    )
  )
$.

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_18, catalog title "isArmstrong": exact finite-trace
:: encodings of decimal digit counting, digit-power summation, the
:: unconditional precondition, Boolean implementation, decimal-string
:: postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, NEWTON, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    NEWTON, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, NEWTON,
    WSIERP_1, XXREAL_0, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, WSIERP_1, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat, result being Element of BOOLEAN st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex k,s being Nat,
        countValues,countTallies,sumValues,sumTotals
          being FinSequence of NAT st
      0 < len countValues &
      len countTallies = len countValues &
      countValues/.1 = n &
      ((n = 0 & countTallies/.1 = 1) or
       (n <> 0 & countTallies/.1 = 0)) &
      countValues/.(len countValues) = 0 &
      countTallies/.(len countTallies) = k &
      (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len countValues holds
        countValues/.j <> 0 &
        countValues/.(j + 1) = countValues/.j div (10 qua Nat) &
        countTallies/.(j + 1) = countTallies/.j + 1) &
      0 < len sumValues &
      len sumTotals = len sumValues &
      sumValues/.1 = n &
      sumTotals/.1 = 0 &
      sumValues/.(len sumValues) = 0 &
      sumTotals/.(len sumTotals) = s &
      (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len sumValues holds
        sumValues/.j <> 0 &
        sumValues/.(j + 1) = sumValues/.j div (10 qua Nat) &
        sumTotals/.(j + 1) =
          sumTotals/.j + ((sumValues/.j mod (10 qua Nat)) |^ k)) &
      ((result = TRUE & s = n) or
       (result = FALSE & s <> n)))
  holds
    ex k,n9 being Nat,
       countValues,countTallies,digits,prefixes,totals
         being FinSequence of NAT st
      0 < len countValues &
      len countTallies = len countValues &
      countValues/.1 = n &
      ((n = 0 & countTallies/.1 = 1) or
       (n <> 0 & countTallies/.1 = 0)) &
      countValues/.(len countValues) = 0 &
      countTallies/.(len countTallies) = k &
      (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len countValues holds
        countValues/.j <> 0 &
        countValues/.(j + 1) = countValues/.j div (10 qua Nat) &
        countTallies/.(j + 1) = countTallies/.j + 1) &
      0 < len digits &
      len prefixes = len digits + 1 &
      len totals = len digits + 1 &
      prefixes/.1 = 0 &
      totals/.1 = 0 &
      prefixes/.(len digits + 1) = n &
      totals/.(len digits + 1) = n9 &
      (len digits = 1 or digits/.1 <> 0) &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom digits holds
        digits/.i < 10 &
        prefixes/.(i + 1) = (10 qua Nat) * prefixes/.i + digits/.i &
        totals/.(i + 1) = totals/.i + ((digits/.i) |^ k)) &
      (result = TRUE implies n = n9) &
      (result = FALSE implies n <> n9)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_18
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_18, "isArmstrong": deciding whether a natural number equals
% the sum of its decimal digits raised to the number of its decimal digits.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_18: THEORY
BEGIN

  countDigits_go(
      n, accumulator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSE
      countDigits_go(
        ndiv(n, 10),
        accumulator + 1,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  countDigits(n: nat): nat =
    countDigits_go(
      n,
      IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF,
      n)

  isArmstrong_precond(n: nat): bool =
    TRUE

  sumPowers_go(
      n, k, accumulator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSE
      LET digit: nat = mod(n, 10)
      IN
        sumPowers_go(
          ndiv(n, 10),
          k,
          accumulator + digit ^ k,
          fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  sumPowers(n, k: nat): nat =
    sumPowers_go(n, k, 0, n)

  isArmstrong(n: nat): bool =
    LET k: nat = countDigits(n)
    IN
      sumPowers(n, k) = n

  decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(
      n, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        mod(n, 10),
        decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(
          ndiv(n, 10),
          fuel - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  decimal_digits_reversed(n: nat): list[nat] =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      cons(0, null[nat])
    ELSE
      decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(n, n)
    ENDIF

  reverse_nat_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_nat_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  decimal_digits(n: nat): list[nat] =
    reverse_nat_list_acc(
      decimal_digits_reversed(n),
      null)

  fold_digit_powers(
      values: list[nat],
      k, accumulator: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(digit, rest):
        fold_digit_powers(
          rest,
          k,
          accumulator + digit ^ k)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  decimal_string_power_sum(n: nat): nat =
    fold_digit_powers(
      decimal_digits(n),
      countDigits(n),
      0)

  isArmstrong_postcond(
      n: nat,
      result: bool): bool =
    LET n_prime: nat = decimal_string_power_sum(n)
    IN
      (result IMPLIES n = n_prime)
        AND (NOT result IMPLIES n /= n_prime)

  isArmstrong_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      isArmstrong_precond(n) IMPLIES
        isArmstrong_postcond(
          n,
          isArmstrong(n))

END verina_advanced_18

title: verina_advanced_19
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "isCleanPalindrome" from VERINA item verina_advanced_19. This
-- file contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

title: verina_advanced_19
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_19,
   catalog title "isCleanPalindrome": an executable Unicode-string palindrome
   test that filters non-ASCII letters and lowercases ASCII uppercase letters,
   together with its correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition isUpperAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 65 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 90)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition isLowerAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 97 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 122)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition isAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  orb (isUpperAlpha c) (isLowerAlpha c).

Definition toLower (c : lean_char) : lean_char :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      if isUpperAlpha (LeanAscii a)
      then
        LeanAscii
          (Ascii.ascii_of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a + 32))
      else LeanAscii a
  | LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid =>
      LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid
  end.

Definition normalizeChar (c : lean_char) : option lean_char :=
  if isAlpha c then Some (toLower c) else None.

Definition normalizeString (s : lean_string) : list lean_char :=
  fold_right
    (fun c acc =>
      match normalizeChar c with
      | Some c' => c' :: acc
      | None => acc
      end)
    [] s.

Definition isCleanPalindrome_precond (_s : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition reverseList (xs : list lean_char) : list lean_char :=
  rev xs.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | LeanAscii a, LeanAscii b =>
      Nat.eqb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) (Ascii.nat_of_ascii b)
  | LeanNonAscii xcode _ _, LeanNonAscii ycode _ _ =>
      N.eqb xcode ycode
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint lean_char_list_eqb
    (xs ys : list lean_char) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (lean_char_eqb x y) (lean_char_list_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition isCleanPalindrome
    (s : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s) : bool :=
  let norm := normalizeString s in
  lean_char_list_eqb norm (reverseList norm).

Definition isCleanPalindrome_postcond
    (s : lean_string)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s) : Prop :=
  let norm := normalizeString s in
  (result = true -> norm = rev norm) /\
  (result = false -> norm <> rev norm).

Theorem isCleanPalindrome_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s) :
  isCleanPalindrome_postcond
    s (isCleanPalindrome s h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_19
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_19,
  catalog title "isCleanPalindrome": an executable Unicode-scalar string
  program keeps ASCII letters, lowercases ASCII capitals, and decides whether
  the resulting character list is a palindrome. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_19
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_trit_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_trit" where
  "lean_trit_of_nat n =
    (if n mod 3 = 0 then Trit0
     else if n mod 3 = 1 then Trit1
     else Trit2)"

definition lean_bits3_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits3" where
  "lean_bits3_of_nat n =
    LeanBits3
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_byte_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_byte" where
  "lean_byte_of_nat n =
    LeanByte
      ((n div 128) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 64) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 32) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_low_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_low_char_of_nat n =
    (let q = n div 2048
     in BMP_Low
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q div 9))
          (lean_trit_of_nat ((q div 3) mod 3))
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q mod 3))
          (lean_bits3_of_nat ((n div 256) mod 8))
          (lean_byte_of_nat (n mod 256)))"

definition isUpperAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isUpperAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow>
    65 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 90"

definition isLowerAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isLowerAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow>
    97 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 122"

definition isAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow> isUpperAlpha c \<or> isLowerAlpha c"

definition toLower :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "toLower c =
    (if isUpperAlpha c
     then lean_low_char_of_nat (lean_char_to_nat c + 32)
     else c)"

definition normalizeChar :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char option" where
  "normalizeChar c =
    (if isAlpha c then Some (toLower c) else None)"

fun normalizeString :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "normalizeString [] = []"
| "normalizeString (c # cs) =
    (case normalizeChar c of
       Some c' \<Rightarrow> c' # normalizeString cs
     | None \<Rightarrow> normalizeString cs)"

definition isCleanPalindrome_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isCleanPalindrome_precond s \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition reverseList :: "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "reverseList xs = rev xs"

definition isCleanPalindrome :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isCleanPalindrome s =
    (let norm = normalizeString s
     in norm = reverseList norm)"

definition isCleanPalindrome_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isCleanPalindrome_postcond s result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let norm = normalizeString s
     in (result = True \<longrightarrow> norm = rev norm) \<and>
        (result = False \<longrightarrow> norm \<noteq> rev norm))"

theorem isCleanPalindrome_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "isCleanPalindrome_precond s"
  shows "isCleanPalindrome_postcond s (isCleanPalindrome s)"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_19,
;; "isCleanPalindrome": ASCII letters in a Unicode string are lowercased,
;; nonletters are removed, and the resulting character list is tested for
;; palindromicity with its Boolean correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values. This preserves characters beyond ACL2's host character set.

(defun verina-advanced-19-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-advanced-19-string-p (s)
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-19-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-advanced-19-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-upper-alpha (c)
  (and
   (<= 65 c)
   (<= c 90)))

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-lower-alpha (c)
  (and
   (<= 97 c)
   (<= c 122)))

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-alpha (c)
  (or
   (verina-advanced-19-is-upper-alpha c)
   (verina-advanced-19-is-lower-alpha c)))

(defun verina-advanced-19-to-lower (c)
  (if (verina-advanced-19-is-upper-alpha c)
      (+ c 32)
    c))

;; Option Char is represented by :none or the tagged pair (:some . code).

(defun verina-advanced-19-normalize-char (c)
  (if (verina-advanced-19-is-alpha c)
      (cons :some (verina-advanced-19-to-lower c))
    :none))

;; This right-recursive definition is the source foldr over String.toList.

(defun verina-advanced-19-normalize-string (s)
  (if (consp s)
      (let* ((normalized-char
              (verina-advanced-19-normalize-char (car s)))
             (normalized-rest
              (verina-advanced-19-normalize-string (cdr s))))
        (if (equal normalized-char :none)
            normalized-rest
          (cons (cdr normalized-char) normalized-rest)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome-precond (s)
  (declare (ignore s))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-19-reverse-list (xs)
  (reverse xs))

;; The source proof-valued precondition argument is erased; the final
;; statement supplies the corresponding precondition predicate explicitly.

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome (s)
  (let ((norm
         (verina-advanced-19-normalize-string s)))
    (equal
     norm
     (verina-advanced-19-reverse-list norm))))

(defun verina-advanced-19-bool-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result t)
   (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome-postcond
    (s result)
  (let ((norm
         (verina-advanced-19-normalize-string s)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-19-string-p s)
     (verina-advanced-19-bool-p result)
     (implies
      (equal result t)
      (equal
       norm
       (verina-advanced-19-reverse-list norm)))
     (implies
      (equal result nil)
      (not
       (equal
        norm
        (verina-advanced-19-reverse-list norm)))))))

(defun
    verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome-spec-satisfied-statement
    (s)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-19-string-p s)
    (verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome-precond s))
   (verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome-postcond
    s
    (verina-advanced-19-is-clean-palindrome s))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_19
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_19,
-- catalog title "isCleanPalindrome": a deterministic string program removes
-- non-ASCII letters, lowercases ASCII uppercase letters, and tests for a palindrome.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced19 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primCharToNat; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using (String; primStringToList)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_ _||_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

isUpperAlpha : Char → Bool
isUpperAlpha c =
  natLessOrEqual 65 (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) 90

isLowerAlpha : Char → Bool
isLowerAlpha c =
  natLessOrEqual 97 (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) 122

isAlpha : Char → Bool
isAlpha c = isUpperAlpha c || isLowerAlpha c

toLower : Char → Char
toLower c =
  if isUpperAlpha c
  then primNatToChar (primCharToNat c + 32)
  else c

normalizeChar : Char → Maybe Char
normalizeChar c =
  if isAlpha c
  then just (toLower c)
  else nothing

foldRight :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B → B) →
  B →
  List A →
  B
foldRight step base [] = base
foldRight step base (x ∷ xs) =
  step x (foldRight step base xs)

normalizeStep : Char → List Char → List Char
normalizeStep c accumulator with normalizeChar c
... | just c′ = c′ ∷ accumulator
... | nothing = accumulator

normalizeString : String → List Char
normalizeString s =
  foldRight normalizeStep [] (primStringToList s)

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

listCharEqual : List Char → List Char → Bool
listCharEqual [] [] = true
listCharEqual [] (_ ∷ _) = false
listCharEqual (_ ∷ _) [] = false
listCharEqual (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  primCharEquality x y && listCharEqual xs ys

isCleanPalindrome-precond : String → Set
isCleanPalindrome-precond s = Top

isCleanPalindrome :
  (s : String) →
  isCleanPalindrome-precond s →
  Bool
isCleanPalindrome s h-precond =
  let norm = normalizeString s
  in listCharEqual norm (reverseList norm)

isCleanPalindrome-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (result : Bool) →
  isCleanPalindrome-precond s →
  Set
isCleanPalindrome-postcond s result h-precond =
  let norm = normalizeString s
  in
    ((result ≡ true) → norm ≡ reverseList norm) ∧
    ((result ≡ false) → Not (norm ≡ reverseList norm))

isCleanPalindrome-spec-satisfied : Set
isCleanPalindrome-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (h-precond : isCleanPalindrome-precond s) →
  isCleanPalindrome-postcond
    s
    (isCleanPalindrome s h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_19, catalog title isCleanPalindrome: exact ASCII
  alphabetic filtering and lowercasing of an arbitrary Unicode string,
  followed by a Boolean palindrome test and its correctness contract. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINA19Char is exactly the Unicode scalar-value domain represented by
  Lean's Char: natural numbers below 1114112 excluding the surrogate interval
  55296 through 57343. Word VERINA19Char therefore represents arbitrary Lean
  strings extensionally through String.toList, without restricting inputs to
  ASCII.

  VERINA19IsUpper, VERINA19IsLower, and VERINA19IsAlpha are the source
  Boolean helpers, using precisely the ASCII ranges A--Z and a--z.
  VERINA19ToLower adds 32 exactly in the uppercase case; this agrees with
  Char.ofNat because every resulting code is a valid lowercase ASCII scalar.
  VERINA19None, VERINA19Some, and VERINA19OptionChar faithfully encode
  Option Char, and VERINA19NormalizeChar is the source optional helper.

  VERINA19NormalizeGraph retains exactly, in original order, all input
  positions where normalizeChar is non-none and stores the corresponding
  lowercase characters. Thus VERINA19NormalizeString is exactly the source
  foldr computation, not an output selected from the postcondition.
  VERINA19ReverseGraph reverses every finite character word exactly, and
  VERINA19ReverseList is the source reverseList helper.

  VERINA19IsCleanPalindrome is the executable Boolean equality test on the
  normalized word and its reversal. VERINA19Pre is the source True
  precondition together with the String input type. VERINA19Post reproduces
  both result implications in the source postcondition. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally unused and is omitted from the
  target function. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no proof declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA19Char
  VERINA19IsUpper VERINA19IsLower VERINA19IsAlpha
  VERINA19ToLower
  VERINA19None VERINA19Some VERINA19OptionChar
  VERINA19NormalizeChar
  VERINA19NormalizeGraph VERINA19NormalizeString
  VERINA19ReverseGraph VERINA19ReverseList
  VERINA19Pre VERINA19IsCleanPalindrome VERINA19Post
$.

verina19-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA19Char $.
verina19-is-upper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19IsUpper A ) $.
verina19-is-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19IsLower A ) $.
verina19-is-alpha-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19IsAlpha A ) $.
verina19-to-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19ToLower A ) $.
verina19-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA19None $.
verina19-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19Some A ) $.
verina19-option-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA19OptionChar $.
verina19-normalize-char-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19NormalizeChar A ) $.
verina19-normalize-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA19NormalizeGraph A B ) $.
verina19-normalize-string-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19NormalizeString A ) $.
verina19-reverse-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA19ReverseGraph A B ) $.
verina19-reverse-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19ReverseList A ) $.
verina19-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA19Pre A ) $.
verina19-is-clean-palindrome-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA19IsCleanPalindrome A ) $.
verina19-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA19Post A B ) $.

verina19-char-definition $a |- VERINA19Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verina19-is-upper-definition $a |- (
  VERINA19IsUpper A
) = if (
  (
    ; 6 5 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; 9 0
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina19-is-lower-definition $a |- (
  VERINA19IsLower A
) = if (
  (
    ; 9 7 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; ; 1 2 2
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina19-is-alpha-definition $a |- (
  VERINA19IsAlpha A
) = if (
  (
    ( VERINA19IsUpper A ) = 1
    \/
    ( VERINA19IsLower A ) = 1
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina19-to-lower-definition $a |- (
  VERINA19ToLower A
) = if (
  ( VERINA19IsUpper A ) = 1 ,
  ( A + ; 3 2 ) ,
  A
) $.

verina19-none-definition $a |- VERINA19None = (/) $.

verina19-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA19Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina19-option-char-definition $a |- VERINA19OptionChar =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA19None
        \/

) = if (

    VERINA19NormalizeGraph A B

    (

      B e. Word VERINA19Char

$}

${

  verina19-normalize-string-definition $a |- (
    VERINA19NormalizeString A
  ) = (

$}

${

  verina19-reverse-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA19ReverseGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA19Char
      /\

title: verina_advanced_19
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_19, "isCleanPalindrome": filtering a Unicode-scalar string
% to ASCII letters, lowercasing them, and deciding whether the result is a
% palindrome. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_19: THEORY
BEGIN

  % The program observes a Lean String only through String.toList.  A finite
  % list of Unicode scalar values is therefore its exact extensional input.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]

  lean_char_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoLeanChar: NoLeanChar?
    SomeLeanChar(option_value: lean_char): SomeLeanChar?
  END lean_char_option

  isUpperAlpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 65 AND c <= 90

  isLowerAlpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 97 AND c <= 122

  isAlpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    isUpperAlpha(c) OR isLowerAlpha(c)

  toLower(c: lean_char): lean_char =
    IF isUpperAlpha(c) THEN c + 32 ELSE c ENDIF

  normalizeChar(c: lean_char): lean_char_option =
    IF isAlpha(c) THEN
      SomeLeanChar(toLower(c))
    ELSE
      NoLeanChar
    ENDIF

  normalizeString(s: lean_string): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES s OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(c, rest):
        CASES normalizeChar(c) OF
          NoLeanChar:
            normalizeString(rest),
          SomeLeanChar(c_prime):
            cons(c_prime, normalizeString(rest))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE s BY <<

  isCleanPalindrome_precond(s: lean_string): bool =
    TRUE

  reverseList_acc(
      xs, accumulator: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(x, rest):
        reverseList_acc(rest, cons(x, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  reverseList(xs: list[lean_char]): list[lean_char] =
    reverseList_acc(xs, null)

  isCleanPalindrome(s: lean_string): bool =
    LET norm: list[lean_char] = normalizeString(s)
    IN
      norm = reverseList(norm)

  isCleanPalindrome_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      result: bool): bool =
    LET norm: list[lean_char] = normalizeString(s)
    IN
      (result IMPLIES norm = reverseList(norm))
        AND (NOT result IMPLIES norm /= reverseList(norm))

  isCleanPalindrome_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string):
      isCleanPalindrome_precond(s) IMPLIES
        isCleanPalindrome_postcond(
          s,
          isCleanPalindrome(s))

END verina_advanced_19

title: verina_advanced_2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_2,
   catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": an executable dynamic-programming
   computation of the longest common subsequence length for two integer arrays,
   together with its exhaustive-subsequence correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence_precond
    (_a _b : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition intMax (x y : Z) : Z :=
  if Z.ltb x y then y else x.

Fixpoint lcs_set_nth {A : Type}
    (index : nat) (value : A) (xs : list A) : list A :=
  match index, xs with
  | 0%nat, _ :: rest => value :: rest
  | S index', x :: rest =>
      x :: lcs_set_nth index' value rest
  | _, [] => []
  end.

Definition lcs_get_row
    (dp : list (list Z)) (i : nat) : list Z :=
  nth i dp [].

Definition lcs_get_cell
    (dp : list (list Z)) (i j : nat) : Z :=
  nth j (lcs_get_row dp i) 0.

Definition lcs_update_cell
    (a b : list Z)
    (i j : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  if orb (Nat.eqb i 0%nat) (Nat.eqb j 0%nat)
  then dp
  else
    let ai := nth (Nat.pred i) a 0 in
    let bj := nth (Nat.pred j) b 0 in
    let newVal :=
      if Z.eqb ai bj
      then lcs_get_cell dp (Nat.pred i) (Nat.pred j) + 1
      else
        intMax
          (lcs_get_cell dp (Nat.pred i) j)
          (lcs_get_cell dp i (Nat.pred j)) in
    let row := lcs_get_row dp i in
    lcs_set_nth i (lcs_set_nth j newVal row) dp.

Fixpoint lcs_run_columns
    (a b : list Z)
    (i remaining j : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  match remaining with
  | 0%nat => dp
  | S remaining' =>
      lcs_run_columns
        a b i remaining' (S j)
        (lcs_update_cell a b i j dp)
  end.

Fixpoint lcs_run_rows
    (a b : list Z)
    (column_count remaining i : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  match remaining with
  | 0%nat => dp
  | S remaining' =>
      let dp' := lcs_run_columns a b i column_count 0%nat dp in
      lcs_run_rows
        a b column_count remaining' (S i) dp'
  end.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence
    (a b : list Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) : Z :=
  let m := length a in
  let n := length b in
  let dp0 := repeat (repeat 0 (S n)) (S m) in
  let dp :=
    lcs_run_rows a b (S n) (S m) 0%nat dp0 in
  lcs_get_cell dp m n.

Definition lcs_allSubseq (arr : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  map
    (fun sub : list Z => rev sub)
    (fold_left
      (fun acc x =>
        acc ++ map (fun sub => x :: sub) acc)
      arr [[]]).

Fixpoint lcs_list_Z_eqb
    (xs ys : list Z) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (Z.eqb x y) (lcs_list_Z_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition lcs_contains_subsequence
    (needle : list Z) (haystack : list (list Z)) : bool :=
  existsb (fun candidate => lcs_list_Z_eqb candidate needle) haystack.

Definition lcs_contains_length
    (needle : Z) (haystack : list Z) : bool :=
  existsb (fun candidate => Z.eqb candidate needle) haystack.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
    (a b : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) : Prop :=
  let subseqA := lcs_allSubseq a in
  let subseqB := lcs_allSubseq b in
  let commonSubseqLens :=
    map
      (fun sub : list Z => Z.of_nat (length sub))
      (filter
        (fun sub => lcs_contains_subsequence sub subseqB)
        subseqA) in
  lcs_contains_length result commonSubseqLens = true /\
  forallb (fun candidate => Z.leb candidate result) commonSubseqLens = true.

Theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied
    (a b : list Z)
    (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) :
  LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
    a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_2,
  catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": an executable row-major dynamic
  program computes the longest common subsequence length of two integer
  sequences, with its precondition and subsequence-maximality postcondition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_2
  imports Main
begin

definition LongestCommonSubsequence_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition intMax :: "int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "intMax x y = (if x < y then y else x)"

definition list_getBang :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "list_getBang dflt xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else dflt)"

definition list_setBang :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

definition lcs_get :: "int list list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "lcs_get dp i j =
    list_getBang 0 (list_getBang [] dp i) j"

definition lcs_set ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_set dp i j value =
    list_setBang dp i
      (list_setBang (list_getBang [] dp i) j value)"

definition lcs_cell ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int list list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_cell a b i j dp =
    (if i = 0 \<or> j = 0 then dp
     else if list_getBang 0 a (i - 1) = list_getBang 0 b (j - 1)
     then lcs_set dp i j (lcs_get dp (i - 1) (j - 1) + 1)
     else lcs_set dp i j
       (intMax (lcs_get dp (i - 1) j) (lcs_get dp i (j - 1))))"

definition lcs_row ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int list list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_row a b i dp =
    foldl (\<lambda>table j. lcs_cell a b i j table)
      dp [0..<length b + 1]"

definition LongestCommonSubsequence ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence a b =
    (let initial =
       replicate (length a + 1) (replicate (length b + 1) 0);
         dp =
       foldl (\<lambda>table i. lcs_row a b i table)
         initial [0..<length a + 1]
     in lcs_get dp (length a) (length b))"

definition allSubseq :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "allSubseq arr =
    map rev
      (foldl
        (\<lambda>acc x. acc @ map (\<lambda>sub. x # sub) acc)
        [[]] arr)"

definition LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond a b result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subseqA = allSubseq a;
         subseqB = allSubseq b;
         commonSubseqLens =
           map (\<lambda>l. int (length l))
             (filter (\<lambda>l. l \<in> set subseqB) subseqA)
     in result \<in> set commonSubseqLens \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>k. k \<le> result) commonSubseqLens)"

theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b"
  shows
    "LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
      a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b)"
  sorry

end
