::$P+

title: verina_advanced_23
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_23, "isPowerOfTwo": deciding whether an integer is a
% positive natural power of two by fuel-bounded repeated division by two.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_23: THEORY
BEGIN

  intNatAbs(n: int): nat =
    IF n < 0 THEN -n ELSE n ENDIF

  isPowerOfTwo_precond(n: int): bool =
    TRUE

  isPowerOfTwo_aux(
      m, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF m = 1 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSIF mod(m, 2) /= 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      isPowerOfTwo_aux(
        ndiv(m, 2),
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  isPowerOfTwo(n: int): bool =
    IF n <= 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      isPowerOfTwo_aux(
        intNatAbs(n),
        intNatAbs(n))
    ENDIF

  pow(base: int, exp: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF exp = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      base * pow(base, exp - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exp

  isPowerOfTwo_postcond(
      n: int,
      result: bool): bool =
    IF result THEN
      EXISTS (x: nat):
        pow(2, x) = n AND n > 0
    ELSE
      NOT (EXISTS (x: nat):
        pow(2, x) = n AND n > 0)
    ENDIF

  isPowerOfTwo_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: int):
      isPowerOfTwo_precond(n) IMPLIES
        isPowerOfTwo_postcond(
          n,
          isPowerOfTwo(n))

END verina_advanced_23

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_24,
   catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable patience-sorting computation of
   the longest strictly increasing subsequence length of an integer list,
   together with its exhaustive-subsequence correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition lengthOfLIS_precond (_nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint lengthOfLIS_replace
    (x : Z) (l acc : list Z) : list Z :=
  match l with
  | [] => rev acc ++ [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if Z.leb x y
      then rev acc ++ (x :: ys)
      else lengthOfLIS_replace x ys (y :: acc)
  end.

Definition lengthOfLIS_lisHelper
    (dp : list Z) (x : Z) : list Z :=
  lengthOfLIS_replace x dp [].

Definition lengthOfLIS
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) : Z :=
  Z.of_nat (length (fold_left lengthOfLIS_lisHelper nums [])).

Fixpoint lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing
    (l : list Z) : bool :=
  match l with
  | [] => true
  | _ :: [] => true
  | x :: (y :: rest as tail) =>
      andb
        (Z.ltb x y)
        (lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing tail)
  end.

Fixpoint lengthOfLIS_subsequences
    (xs : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => [[]]
  | x :: xs' =>
      let rest := lengthOfLIS_subsequences xs' in
      rest ++ map (fun r => x :: r) rest
  end.

Definition lengthOfLIS_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let allIncreasing :=
    filter
      lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing
      (lengthOfLIS_subsequences nums) in
  existsb
    (fun l => Z.eqb (Z.of_nat (length l)) result)
    allIncreasing = true /\
  forallb
    (fun l => Z.leb (Z.of_nat (length l)) result)
    allIncreasing = true.

Theorem lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) :
  lengthOfLIS_postcond
    nums (lengthOfLIS nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_24,
  catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable integer-list program computes
  patience-sorting tails for the length of a longest strictly increasing
  subsequence, together with its precondition and maximality contract. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_24
  imports Main
begin

definition lengthOfLIS_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun lengthOfLIS_replace ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_replace x [] acc = rev acc @ [x]"
| "lengthOfLIS_replace x (y # ys) acc =
    (if x \<le> y
     then rev acc @ (x # ys)
     else lengthOfLIS_replace x ys (y # acc))"

definition lengthOfLIS_helper ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_helper dp x = lengthOfLIS_replace x dp []"

definition lengthOfLIS :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "lengthOfLIS nums =
    int (length (foldl lengthOfLIS_helper [] nums))"

fun lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing [] = True"
| "lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing [x] = True"
| "lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing (x # y # rest) =
    (x < y \<and> lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing (y # rest))"

fun lengthOfLIS_subsequences :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_subsequences [] = [[]]"
| "lengthOfLIS_subsequences (x # xs) =
    (let rest = lengthOfLIS_subsequences xs
     in rest @ map (\<lambda>r. x # r) rest)"

definition lengthOfLIS_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let allIncreasing =
       filter lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing
         (lengthOfLIS_subsequences nums)
     in list_ex (\<lambda>l. int (length l) = result) allIncreasing \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>l. int (length l) \<le> result) allIncreasing)"

theorem lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "lengthOfLIS_precond nums"
  shows "lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_24,
  catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable patience-sorting list fold computes
  the length of a longest strictly increasing integer subsequence, with its
  total precondition and exhaustive-subsequence maximality postcondition. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let lengthOfLIS_precond = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_precond (nums:int list) <=> T`;;

let lengthOfLIS_replace =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!x:int. !acc:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_replace x acc [] =
        APPEND (REVERSE acc) (CONS x [])) /\
     (!y:int. !ys:int list. !x:int. !acc:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_replace x acc (CONS y ys) =
        if x <= y then
          APPEND (REVERSE acc) (CONS x ys)
        else
          lengthOfLIS_replace x (CONS y acc) ys)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_lisHelper = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_lisHelper (dp:int list) (x:int) =
     lengthOfLIS_replace x [] dp`;;

let lengthOfLIS_fold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!dp:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_fold [] dp = dp) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !dp:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_fold (CONS x xs) dp =
        lengthOfLIS_fold xs (lengthOfLIS_lisHelper dp x))`;;

let lengthOfLIS = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS (nums:int list) =
     (&(LENGTH (lengthOfLIS_fold nums [])):int)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing (CONS x xs) <=>
        if xs = [] then T
        else x < HD xs /\ lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing xs)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_subsequences =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(lengthOfLIS_subsequences ([]:int list) =
        CONS ([]:int list) []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_subsequences (CONS x xs) =
        let rest = lengthOfLIS_subsequences xs in
        APPEND rest (MAP (\r:int list. CONS x r) rest))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_postcond = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_postcond (nums:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let allIncreasing =
       FILTER lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing
         (lengthOfLIS_subsequences nums) in
     EX (\l:int list. &(LENGTH l) = result) allIncreasing /\
     ALL (\l:int list. &(LENGTH l) <= result) allIncreasing`;;

let lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     lengthOfLIS_precond nums
     ==> lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_24,
;; "lengthOfLIS": a deterministic tail-list fold computes the length of a
;; longest strictly increasing subsequence, together with its exhaustive
;; subsequence correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-24-integer-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-24-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the List Int domain is explicit in the
;; final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis-precond (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

;; This is the source lisHelper.replace recursion. ACC stores the traversed
;; prefix in reverse order. The first tail value at least x is replaced by x;
;; if no such value exists, x is appended.

(defun verina-advanced-24-replace (remaining accumulator x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((y (car remaining))
            (ys (cdr remaining)))
        (if (<= x y)
            (append
             (reverse accumulator)
             (cons x ys))
          (verina-advanced-24-replace
           ys
           (cons y accumulator)
           x)))
    (append
     (reverse accumulator)
     (list x))))

(defun verina-advanced-24-lis-helper (dp x)
  (verina-advanced-24-replace dp nil x))

;; Folding left over NUMS exactly reproduces the source finalDP computation.

(defun verina-advanced-24-foldl-lis-helper (remaining dp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-24-foldl-lis-helper
       (cdr remaining)
       (verina-advanced-24-lis-helper
        dp
        (car remaining)))
    dp))

(defun verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis (nums)
  (len
   (verina-advanced-24-foldl-lis-helper nums nil)))

;; Exact Boolean translation of the postcondition's local
;; isStrictlyIncreasing recursion.

(defun verina-advanced-24-strictly-increasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (and
       (consp xs)
       (consp (cdr xs)))
      (and
       (< (car xs) (car (cdr xs)))
       (verina-advanced-24-strictly-increasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-24-prepend-to-each
    (x subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (cons x (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-24-prepend-to-each
        x
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

;; This direct recursion preserves the source order and multiplicity:
;; subsequences xs' followed by the same list with x prepended to each member.

(defun verina-advanced-24-subsequences (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (let ((rest
             (verina-advanced-24-subsequences
              (cdr xs))))
        (append
         rest
         (verina-advanced-24-prepend-to-each
          (car xs)
          rest)))
    (list nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-24-filter-increasing
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (if (verina-advanced-24-strictly-increasing-p
           (car subsequences))
          (cons
           (car subsequences)
           (verina-advanced-24-filter-increasing
            (cdr subsequences)))
        (verina-advanced-24-filter-increasing
         (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-24-some-length-equal-p
    (subsequences result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (or
       (equal (len (car subsequences)) result)
       (verina-advanced-24-some-length-equal-p
        (cdr subsequences)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-24-all-lengths-at-most-p
    (subsequences result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (and
       (<= (len (car subsequences)) result)
       (verina-advanced-24-all-lengths-at-most-p
        (cdr subsequences)
        result))
    (equal subsequences nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis-postcond
    (nums result)
  (let* ((all-subsequences
          (verina-advanced-24-subsequences nums))
         (all-increasing
          (verina-advanced-24-filter-increasing
           all-subsequences)))
    (and
     (integerp result)
     (verina-advanced-24-some-length-equal-p
      all-increasing
      result)
     (verina-advanced-24-all-lengths-at-most-p
      all-increasing
      result))))

;; The source proof-valued precondition argument is erased from computation;
;; its predicate remains an explicit hypothesis of this correctness statement.

(defun
    verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-24-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_24,
-- catalog title "lengthOfLIS": a deterministic integer-list program maintains
-- minimal subsequence tails and returns the longest strictly increasing
-- subsequence length characterized by exhaustive subsequence enumeration.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced24 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

lengthOfLIS-precond : List Int → Set
lengthOfLIS-precond nums = Top

replaceTail :
  Int → List Int → List Int → List Int
replaceTail x [] accumulator =
  appendList (reverseList accumulator) (x ∷ [])
replaceTail x (y ∷ ys) accumulator =
  if intLessOrEqual x y
  then appendList (reverseList accumulator) (x ∷ ys)
  else replaceTail x ys (y ∷ accumulator)

lisHelper : List Int → Int → List Int
lisHelper dp x = replaceTail x dp []

lengthOfLIS :
  (nums : List Int) →
  lengthOfLIS-precond nums →
  Int
lengthOfLIS nums h-precond =
  pos (listLength (foldLeft lisHelper [] nums))

isStrictlyIncreasing : List Int → Bool
isStrictlyIncreasing [] = true
isStrictlyIncreasing (_ ∷ []) = true
isStrictlyIncreasing (x ∷ y ∷ rest) =
  intLess x y && isStrictlyIncreasing (y ∷ rest)

subsequences : List Int → List (List Int)
subsequences [] = [] ∷ []
subsequences (x ∷ xs) =
  let rest = subsequences xs
  in appendList rest (mapList (λ subsequence → x ∷ subsequence) rest)

increasingSubsequences : List Int → List (List Int)
increasingSubsequences nums =
  filterList isStrictlyIncreasing (subsequences nums)

hasLength : Int → List Int → Bool
hasLength result subsequence =
  intEqual (pos (listLength subsequence)) result

lengthAtMost : Int → List Int → Bool
lengthAtMost result subsequence =
  intLessOrEqual (pos (listLength subsequence)) result

lengthOfLIS-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  lengthOfLIS-precond nums →
  Set
lengthOfLIS-postcond nums result h-precond =
  let allIncreasing = increasingSubsequences nums
  in
    IsTrue (anyList (hasLength result) allIncreasing) ∧
    IsTrue (allList (lengthAtMost result) allIncreasing)

lengthOfLIS-spec-satisfied : Set
lengthOfLIS-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : lengthOfLIS-precond nums) →
  lengthOfLIS-postcond
    nums
    (lengthOfLIS nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_24,
  cataloged as "lengthOfLIS": the executable patience-sorting program returns
  a length that is attained by a strictly increasing subsequence and is
  maximal among all strictly increasing subsequences. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val lengthOfLIS_precond_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_precond_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_precond (nums : int list) <=> T``
);

val lengthOfLIS_replace_def = Define `
  (lengthOfLIS_replace
      (x : int) ([] : int list) (acc : int list) =
     REVERSE acc ++ [x]) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_replace x (y::ys) acc =
     if x <= y then
       REVERSE acc ++ (x::ys)
     else
       lengthOfLIS_replace x ys (y::acc))
`;

val lengthOfLIS_helper_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_helper_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_helper (dp : int list) (x : int) =
      lengthOfLIS_replace x dp []``
);

val lengthOfLIS_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS (nums : int list) =
      int_of_num (LENGTH (FOLDL lengthOfLIS_helper [] nums))``
);

val lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing_def = Define `
  (lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing [x] = T) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing (x::y::rest) =
     (x < y /\ lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing (y::rest)))
`;

val lengthOfLIS_subsequences_def = Define `
  (lengthOfLIS_subsequences ([] : int list) =
     ([[]] : int list list)) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_subsequences (x::xs) =
     let rest = lengthOfLIS_subsequences xs
     in
       rest ++ MAP (\r. x::r) rest)
`;

val lengthOfLIS_allIncreasing_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_allIncreasing_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_allIncreasing (nums : int list) =
      FILTER
        lengthOfLIS_isStrictlyIncreasing
        (lengthOfLIS_subsequences nums)``
);

val lengthOfLIS_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_postcond_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : int) <=>
      let allIncreasing = lengthOfLIS_allIncreasing nums
      in
        EXISTS
          (\l : int list. int_of_num (LENGTH l) = result)
          allIncreasing /\
        EVERY
          (\l : int list. int_of_num (LENGTH l) <= result)
          allIncreasing``
);

val lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      lengthOfLIS_precond nums ==>
      lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_24 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_24), catalog title
  lengthOfLIS: an exact executable tail-replacement fold computes an integer
  length, with the contract that it is the maximum length of a strictly
  increasing subsequence of the input integer list. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number
  length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete
  index set. Natural lengths embed canonically in ZZ, matching Lean's
  coercion from List.length to Int.

  VERINA24ReplaceGraph is the exact source replace recursion, including its
  arbitrary list and accumulator arguments and the integer x captured by the
  enclosing helper. Its position p is the first list entry at least x, or the
  list length if none exists. The output is the reversed initial accumulator,
  the traversed prefix, x, and then the suffix after the replaced entry; at
  the end of the list, x is appended instead. VERINA24Replace selects this
  unique output, and VERINA24LisHelper calls it with the empty accumulator.

  VERINA24FinalDPGraph threads VERINA24LisHelper through nums from left to
  right, exactly reproducing List.foldl. VERINA24LengthOfLIS is the integer
  coercion of the final word length, so the implementation remains connected
  explicitly to the final correctness assertion.

  VERINA24StrictlyIncreasing is the source Boolean adjacency recursion.
  VERINA24BitSet and VERINA24MaskWordGraph enumerate each subsequence by the
  binary mask whose most-significant input-position bit corresponds to the
  list head. Numeric mask order therefore gives exactly
  rest ++ rest.map (fun r => x :: r) at every recursive step, preserving
  order and duplicate occurrences. VERINA24Subsequences selects that exact
  word of words. VERINA24AllIncreasingGraph is the exact stable filter by
  VERINA24StrictlyIncreasing, and VERINA24AllIncreasing selects its unique
  result.

  VERINA24Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int
  input type. VERINA24Post reproduces List.any for a subsequence whose length
  equals the result and List.all asserting that every increasing subsequence
  length is at most the result. The proof-valued precondition argument is
  computationally and propositionally unused and is omitted from the target
  function and predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

  VERINA24FinalDPGraph VERINA24FinalDP
  VERINA24Pre VERINA24LengthOfLIS
  VERINA24StrictlyIncreasing
  VERINA24BitSet VERINA24MaskWordGraph
  VERINA24SubsequencesGraph VERINA24Subsequences
  VERINA24AllIncreasingGraph VERINA24AllIncreasing
  VERINA24Post
$.

        A e. ZZ

        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. Word ZZ
        /\
        D e. Word ZZ
      )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              -. A <_ ( B ` j )
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` B )
              ->
              A <_ ( B ` p )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` D ) = if (
              p < ( # ` B ) ,
              ( ( # ` C ) + ( # ` B ) ) ,
              ( ( ( # ` C ) + ( # ` B ) ) + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
                (
                  D ` j
                ) = (
                  C ` ( ( ( # ` C ) - 1 ) - j )

                  ( # ` C ) ..^ ( ( # ` C ) + p )

$}

verina24-bit-set-definition $a |- (
  VERINA24BitSet A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0

  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2

) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina24-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA24MaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\

          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (

    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )

    E. p e. Word NN0

        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA24AllIncreasing A ) )

verina-advanced-24-length-of-lis $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_24, catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an exact finite-sequence
:: operational graph of the unconditional precondition, first-greater-or-
:: equal replacement helper and left-fold implementation, strictly increasing
:: subsequence postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1,
    XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    XXREAL_0, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex states being FinSequence of INT*,
        finalDP being FinSequence of INT st
      len states = len nums + 1 &
      states/.1 = <*>INT &
      states/.(len nums + 1) = finalDP &
      result = len finalDP &
      for i being Nat st i in dom nums holds
        ex current,next being FinSequence of INT,
           x being Integer st
          current = states/.i &
          next = states/.(i + 1) &
          x = nums/.i &
          ((ex j being Nat st
              j in dom current &
              x <= current/.j &
              (for k being Nat st k in dom current & k < j holds
                current/.k < x) &
              len next = len current &
              next/.j = x &
              (for k being Nat st k in dom current & k <> j holds
                next/.k = current/.k)) or
           ((for k being Nat st k in dom current holds
              current/.k < x) &
            next = current ^ <*x*>)))
  holds
    (ex increasing being FinSequence of INT,
        positions being FinSequence of NAT st
      result = len increasing &
      len positions = len increasing &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
        positions/.k in dom nums &
        increasing/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
      holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len increasing holds
        increasing/.k < increasing/.(k + 1)) &
    (for increasing being FinSequence of INT st
      (ex positions being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positions = len increasing &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
          positions/.k in dom nums &
          increasing/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
        holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      (for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len increasing holds
        increasing/.k < increasing/.(k + 1))
    holds len increasing <= result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_24
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_24, "lengthOfLIS": computing the length of a longest
% strictly increasing subsequence by the specified list-fold implementation,
% with an exhaustive-subsequence correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_24: THEORY
BEGIN

  lengthOfLIS_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_int_lists(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null)

  replace_for_lis(
      values, accumulator: list[int],
      x: int): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        append_int_lists(
          reverse_int_list(accumulator),
          cons(x, null)),
      cons(y, rest):
        IF x <= y THEN
          append_int_lists(
            reverse_int_list(accumulator),
            cons(x, rest))
        ELSE
          replace_for_lis(
            rest,
            cons(y, accumulator),
            x)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  lisHelper(dp: list[int], x: int): list[int] =
    replace_for_lis(dp, null, x)

  lengthOfLIS_fold(
      remaining, dp: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        dp,
      cons(x, rest):
        lengthOfLIS_fold(
          rest,
          lisHelper(dp, x))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  lengthOfLIS(nums: list[int]): int =
    int_list_length(
      lengthOfLIS_fold(nums, null))

  isStrictlyIncreasing(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(x, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null:
            TRUE,
          cons(y, rest):
            x < y
              AND isStrictlyIncreasing(cons(y, rest))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_subsequence_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_subsequence_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_to_each(
      value: int,
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(value, head),
          prepend_to_each(value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  subsequences(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(null[int], null[list[int]]),
      cons(x, rest):
        LET rest_subsequences: list[list[int]] =
          subsequences(rest)
        IN
          append_subsequence_lists(
            rest_subsequences,
            prepend_to_each(x, rest_subsequences))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  filter_strictly_increasing(
      candidates: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES candidates OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF isStrictlyIncreasing(head) THEN
          cons(
            head,
            filter_strictly_increasing(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_strictly_increasing(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE candidates BY <<

  any_has_length(
      candidates: list[list[int]],
      requested_length: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES candidates OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(head) = requested_length
          OR any_has_length(tail, requested_length)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE candidates BY <<

  all_lengths_at_most(
      candidates: list[list[int]],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES candidates OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(head) <= upper_bound
          AND all_lengths_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE candidates BY <<

  lengthOfLIS_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET allIncreasing: list[list[int]] =
      filter_strictly_increasing(subsequences(nums))
    IN
      any_has_length(allIncreasing, result)
        AND all_lengths_at_most(allIncreasing, result)

  lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      lengthOfLIS_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        lengthOfLIS_postcond(
          nums,
          lengthOfLIS(nums))

END verina_advanced_24

-- Statement-only formalization of "lengthOfLIS" from VERINA item verina_advanced_25. This file
-- contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux

-- !benchmark @end solution_aux

-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible]
def lengthOfLIS_precond (nums : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux
def maxInArray (arr : Array Nat) : Nat :=
  arr.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) 0
-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def lengthOfLIS (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums)) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if nums.isEmpty then 0
  else
    let n := nums.length
    Id.run do
      let mut dp : Array Nat := Array.mkArray n 1

      for i in [1:n] do
        for j in [0:i] do
          if nums[j]! < nums[i]! && dp[j]! + 1 > dp[i]! then
            dp := dp.set! i (dp[j]! + 1)

      maxInArray dp
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux
-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def lengthOfLIS_postcond (nums : List Int) (result: Nat) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
  let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
  increasingSubseqLens.contains result ∧ increasingSubseqLens.all (· ≤ result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied (nums: List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums)) :
    lengthOfLIS_postcond (nums) (lengthOfLIS (nums) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_25,
   catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable dynamic-programming computation
   of the longest strictly increasing subsequence length of an integer list,
   together with its exhaustive-subsequence maximality contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition lengthOfLIS_precond (_nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition lengthOfLIS_get_Z
    (xs : list Z) (index : nat) : Z :=
  nth index xs 0%Z.

Definition lengthOfLIS_get_nat
    (xs : list nat) (index : nat) : nat :=
  nth index xs 0%nat.

Fixpoint lengthOfLIS_set_nat
    (index value : nat) (xs : list nat) : list nat :=
  match index, xs with
  | 0%nat, _ :: rest => value :: rest
  | S index', x :: rest =>
      x :: lengthOfLIS_set_nat index' value rest
  | _, [] => []
  end.

Definition maxInArray (arr : list nat) : nat :=
  fold_left
    (fun a b => if Nat.leb b a then a else b)
    arr 0%nat.

Definition lengthOfLIS_cell
    (nums : list Z)
    (i : nat)
    (dp : list nat)
    (j : nat) : list nat :=
  if andb
       (Z.ltb
         (lengthOfLIS_get_Z nums j)
         (lengthOfLIS_get_Z nums i))
       (Nat.ltb
         (lengthOfLIS_get_nat dp i)
         (S (lengthOfLIS_get_nat dp j)))
  then
    lengthOfLIS_set_nat
      i (S (lengthOfLIS_get_nat dp j)) dp
  else dp.

Definition lengthOfLIS_row
    (nums : list Z)
    (dp : list nat)
    (i : nat) : list nat :=
  fold_left
    (lengthOfLIS_cell nums i)
    (seq 0%nat i)
    dp.

Definition lengthOfLIS
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) : nat :=
  match nums with
  | [] => 0%nat
  | _ =>
      let n := length nums in
      let initial := repeat 1%nat n in
      let dp :=
        fold_left
          (lengthOfLIS_row nums)
          (seq 1%nat (Nat.pred n))
          initial in
      maxInArray dp
  end.

Definition lengthOfLIS_allSubseq
    (nums : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  map
    (fun sub : list Z => rev sub)
    (fold_left
      (fun acc x =>
        acc ++ map (fun sub => x :: sub) acc)
      nums [[]]).

Fixpoint lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess
    (xs : list Z) : bool :=
  match xs with
  | [] => true
  | x :: rest =>
      andb
        (forallb (fun y => Z.ltb x y) rest)
        (lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess rest)
  end.

Definition lengthOfLIS_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let allSubseq := lengthOfLIS_allSubseq nums in
  let increasingSubseqLens :=
    map
      (fun xs : list Z => length xs)
      (filter lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess allSubseq) in
  existsb (Nat.eqb result) increasingSubseqLens = true /\
  forallb (fun candidate => Nat.leb candidate result)
    increasingSubseqLens = true.

Theorem lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) :
  lengthOfLIS_postcond
    nums (lengthOfLIS nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_25,
  catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable dynamic-programming program
  computes the length of a longest strictly increasing subsequence of an
  integer list, together with its precondition and maximality contract. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_25
  imports Main
begin

definition lengthOfLIS_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition list_getBang :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "list_getBang dflt xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else dflt)"

definition list_setBang :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

definition maxInArray :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "maxInArray arr =
    foldl (\<lambda>a b. if a \<ge> b then a else b) 0 arr"

definition lengthOfLIS_cell ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_cell nums i dp j =
    (if list_getBang 0 nums j < list_getBang 0 nums i \<and>
        list_getBang 0 dp j + 1 > list_getBang 0 dp i
     then list_setBang dp i (list_getBang 0 dp j + 1)
     else dp)"

definition lengthOfLIS_row ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_row nums dp i =
    foldl (lengthOfLIS_cell nums i) dp [0..<i]"

definition lengthOfLIS :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lengthOfLIS nums =
    (if nums = []
     then 0
     else
       (let n = length nums;
            initial = replicate n 1;
            dp = foldl (lengthOfLIS_row nums) initial [1..<n]
        in maxInArray dp))"

definition lengthOfLIS_allSubseq :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lengthOfLIS_allSubseq nums =
    map rev
      (foldl
        (\<lambda>acc x. acc @ map (\<lambda>sub. x # sub) acc)
        [[]] nums)"

fun lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess [] = True"
| "lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x < y) xs \<and>
     lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess xs)"

definition lengthOfLIS_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lengthOfLIS_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let allSubseq = lengthOfLIS_allSubseq nums;
         increasingSubseqLens =
           map length (filter lengthOfLIS_pairwiseLess allSubseq)
     in result \<in> set increasingSubseqLens \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>k. k \<le> result) increasingSubseqLens)"

theorem lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "lengthOfLIS_precond nums"
  shows "lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_25,
  catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an executable dynamic-programming array
  computation returns the length of a longest strictly increasing integer
  subsequence, with its total precondition and exhaustive-subsequence
  maximality postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let lengthOfLIS_precond = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_precond (nums:int list) <=> T`;;

let lengthOfLIS_getInt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_getInt 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_getInt (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else lengthOfLIS_getInt n (TL xs))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_getNum =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_getNum 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then 0 else HD xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_getNum (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then 0
        else lengthOfLIS_getNum n (TL xs))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_setNum =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!value:num. !xs:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_setNum 0 value xs =
        if xs = [] then [] else CONS value (TL xs)) /\
     (!n:num. !value:num. !xs:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_setNum (SUC n) value xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else CONS (HD xs)
          (lengthOfLIS_setNum n value (TL xs)))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_fillInner =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !nums:int list. !dp:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_fillInner 0 i nums dp = dp) /\
     (!j:num. !i:num. !nums:int list. !dp:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_fillInner (SUC j) i nums dp =
        let previous =
          lengthOfLIS_fillInner j i nums dp in
        if lengthOfLIS_getInt j nums <
             lengthOfLIS_getInt i nums /\
           lengthOfLIS_getNum j previous + 1 >
             lengthOfLIS_getNum i previous
        then
          lengthOfLIS_setNum i
            (lengthOfLIS_getNum j previous + 1)
            previous
        else previous)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_fillOuter =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:int list. !dp:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_fillOuter 0 nums dp = dp) /\
     (!k:num. !nums:int list. !dp:num list.
        lengthOfLIS_fillOuter (SUC k) nums dp =
        let previous =
          lengthOfLIS_fillOuter k nums dp in
        let i = SUC k in
        lengthOfLIS_fillInner i i nums previous)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_maxFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:num.
        lengthOfLIS_maxFold acc [] = acc) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list. !acc:num.
        lengthOfLIS_maxFold acc (CONS x xs) =
        lengthOfLIS_maxFold
          (if acc >= x then acc else x) xs)`;;

let maxInArray = new_definition
  `maxInArray (arr:num list) = lengthOfLIS_maxFold 0 arr`;;

let lengthOfLIS = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS (nums:int list) =
     if nums = [] then 0
     else
       let n = LENGTH nums in
       let initialDp = REPLICATE n 1 in
       let finalDp =
         lengthOfLIS_fillOuter (n - 1) nums initialDp in
       maxInArray finalDp`;;

let lengthOfLIS_subseqFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int list)list.
        lengthOfLIS_subseqFold [] acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:(int list)list.
        lengthOfLIS_subseqFold (CONS x xs) acc =
        lengthOfLIS_subseqFold xs
          (APPEND acc
            (MAP (\sub:int list. CONS x sub) acc)))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_allSubseq = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_allSubseq (nums:int list) =
     MAP REVERSE
       (lengthOfLIS_subseqFold nums
         (CONS ([]:int list) []))`;;

let lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing (CONS x xs) <=>
        ALL (\y:int. x < y) xs /\
        lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing xs)`;;

let lengthOfLIS_postcond = new_definition
  `lengthOfLIS_postcond (nums:int list) (result:num) <=>
     let allSubseq = lengthOfLIS_allSubseq nums in
     let increasingSubseqLens =
       MAP (\l:int list. LENGTH l)
         (FILTER lengthOfLIS_strictlyIncreasing allSubseq) in
     MEM result increasingSubseqLens /\
     ALL (\k:num. k <= result) increasingSubseqLens`;;

let lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     lengthOfLIS_precond nums
     ==> lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_25,
;; "lengthOfLIS": a deterministic dynamic-programming computation returns the
;; length of a longest strictly increasing subsequence, together with its
;; exhaustive subsequence correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-25-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-25-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Int input domain is made explicit
;; in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis-precond (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

;; Array.mkArray n 1 is represented by a proper list of n natural-number ones.

(defun verina-advanced-25-make-ones (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     1
     (verina-advanced-25-make-ones
      (- count 1)))))

;; This is one complete source inner loop. J is its current index and
;; REMAINING is the number of indices still to process. UPDATE-NTH is exact
;; here because every reachable I is within the fixed-length DP list.

(defun verina-advanced-25-dp-inner-loop
    (j remaining i nums dp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      dp
    (let* ((nums-j (nth j nums))
           (nums-i (nth i nums))
           (dp-j (nth j dp))
           (dp-i (nth i dp))
           (next-dp
            (if (and
                 (< nums-j nums-i)
                 (> (+ dp-j 1) dp-i))
                (update-nth i (+ dp-j 1) dp)
              dp)))
      (verina-advanced-25-dp-inner-loop
       (+ j 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       i
       nums
       next-dp))))

;; This is the source outer loop over i = 1,...,n-1. Each inner loop consumes
;; the already computed entries j = 0,...,i-1 in their original order.

(defun verina-advanced-25-dp-outer-loop
    (i remaining nums dp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      dp
    (let ((next-dp
           (verina-advanced-25-dp-inner-loop
            0 i i nums dp)))
      (verina-advanced-25-dp-outer-loop
       (+ i 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       nums
       next-dp))))

;; Exact left fold used by the source maxInArray helper, with initial value 0.

(defun verina-advanced-25-max-in-array-fold
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((entry (car remaining)))
        (verina-advanced-25-max-in-array-fold
         (cdr remaining)
         (if (>= accumulator entry)
             accumulator
           entry)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-25-max-in-array (arr)
  (verina-advanced-25-max-in-array-fold arr 0))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant in the
;; source. On a nonempty input, the following definitions reproduce the
;; Array.mkArray initialization, both sequential for-loops, and final fold.

(defun verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis (nums)
  (if (endp nums)
      0
    (let* ((n (len nums))
           (initial-dp
            (verina-advanced-25-make-ones n))
           (final-dp
            (verina-advanced-25-dp-outer-loop
             1
             (- n 1)
             nums
             initial-dp)))
      (verina-advanced-25-max-in-array final-dp))))

;; The next four definitions reproduce the postcondition's fold from [[]].
;; At each input element x, the accumulator is followed by a map that prepends
;; x to every accumulated list; all lists are reversed after the fold.

(defun verina-advanced-25-prepend-to-each
    (x subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (cons x (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-25-prepend-to-each
        x
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-25-subsequence-fold
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((next-accumulator
             (append
              accumulator
              (verina-advanced-25-prepend-to-each
               (car remaining)
               accumulator))))
        (verina-advanced-25-subsequence-fold
         (cdr remaining)
         next-accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-25-reverse-each
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (reverse (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-25-reverse-each
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-25-all-subsequences (nums)
  (verina-advanced-25-reverse-each
   (verina-advanced-25-subsequence-fold
    nums
    (list nil))))

;; Exact Boolean translation of List.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b).

(defun verina-advanced-25-strictly-increasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (and
       (consp xs)
       (consp (cdr xs)))
      (and
       (< (car xs) (car (cdr xs)))
       (verina-advanced-25-strictly-increasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-25-filter-increasing
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (if (verina-advanced-25-strictly-increasing-p
           (car subsequences))
          (cons
           (car subsequences)
           (verina-advanced-25-filter-increasing
            (cdr subsequences)))
        (verina-advanced-25-filter-increasing
         (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-25-map-lengths
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (len (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-25-map-lengths
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-25-contains-length-p
    (lengths result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lengths)))
  (if (consp lengths)
      (or
       (equal (car lengths) result)
       (verina-advanced-25-contains-length-p
        (cdr lengths)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-25-all-lengths-at-most-p
    (lengths result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lengths)))
  (if (consp lengths)
      (and
       (<= (car lengths) result)
       (verina-advanced-25-all-lengths-at-most-p
        (cdr lengths)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis-postcond
    (nums result)
  (let* ((all-subsequences
          (verina-advanced-25-all-subsequences nums))
         (increasing-subsequences
          (verina-advanced-25-filter-increasing
           all-subsequences))
         (increasing-subsequence-lengths
          (verina-advanced-25-map-lengths
           increasing-subsequences)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-25-integer-listp nums)
     (natp result)
     (verina-advanced-25-contains-length-p
      increasing-subsequence-lengths
      result)
     (verina-advanced-25-all-lengths-at-most-p
      increasing-subsequence-lengths
      result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. The ACL2
;; antecedent expresses the Lean binder type and its True precondition.

(defun
    verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-25-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_25,
-- catalog title "lengthOfLIS": a deterministic dynamic-programming program
-- computes the longest strictly increasing subsequence length, characterized
-- by exhaustive subsequence enumeration. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced25 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

one : Nat
one = suc zero

listIsEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listIsEmpty [] = true
listIsEmpty (_ ∷ _) = false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

repeatList : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A
repeatList zero value = []
repeatList (suc n) value = value ∷ repeatList n value

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

setNth : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A → List A
setNth zero value [] = []
setNth zero value (_ ∷ xs) = value ∷ xs
setNth (suc n) value [] = []
setNth (suc n) value (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ setNth n value xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

containsNat : Nat → List Nat → Bool
containsNat sought [] = false
containsNat sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if natEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsNat sought xs

lengthOfLIS-precond : List Int → Set
lengthOfLIS-precond nums = Top

maxNat : Nat → Nat → Nat
maxNat a b =
  if natLess a b then b else a

maxInArray : List Nat → Nat
maxInArray arr = foldLeft maxNat zero arr

updateDPEntry :
  List Int →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat
updateDPEntry nums i dp j =
  let candidate = suc (nthDefault zero j dp)
      current = nthDefault zero i dp
  in
    if
      intLess
        (nthDefault (pos zero) j nums)
        (nthDefault (pos zero) i nums)
      && natLess current candidate
    then setNth i candidate dp
    else dp

updateDPIndex :
  List Int →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat
updateDPIndex nums dp i =
  foldLeft
    (updateDPEntry nums i)
    dp
    (range i)

buildDP : List Int → List Nat
buildDP nums =
  let n = listLength nums
      initial = repeatList n one
  in
    foldLeft
      (updateDPIndex nums)
      initial
      (rangeFrom one (natSubtract n one))

lengthOfLIS :
  (nums : List Int) →
  lengthOfLIS-precond nums →
  Nat
lengthOfLIS nums h-precond =
  if listIsEmpty nums
  then zero
  else maxInArray (buildDP nums)

allSubseqStep :
  List (List Int) →
  Int →
  List (List Int)
allSubseqStep accumulator x =
  appendList
    accumulator
    (mapList (λ subsequence → x ∷ subsequence) accumulator)

allSubseq : List Int → List (List Int)
allSubseq nums =
  mapList
    reverseList
    (foldLeft allSubseqStep ([] ∷ []) nums)

isStrictlyIncreasing : List Int → Bool
isStrictlyIncreasing [] = true
isStrictlyIncreasing (_ ∷ []) = true
isStrictlyIncreasing (x ∷ y ∷ rest) =
  intLess x y && isStrictlyIncreasing (y ∷ rest)

increasingSubsequenceLengths : List Int → List Nat
increasingSubsequenceLengths nums =
  mapList
    listLength
    (filterList isStrictlyIncreasing (allSubseq nums))

lengthOfLIS-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Nat) →
  lengthOfLIS-precond nums →
  Set
lengthOfLIS-postcond nums result h-precond =
  let lengths = increasingSubsequenceLengths nums
  in
    IsTrue (containsNat result lengths) ∧
    IsTrue (allList (λ length → natLessOrEqual length result) lengths)

lengthOfLIS-spec-satisfied : Set
lengthOfLIS-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : lengthOfLIS-precond nums) →
  lengthOfLIS-postcond
    nums
    (lengthOfLIS nums h-precond)
    h-precond
