content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_25,
  cataloged as "lengthOfLIS": the executable dynamic-programming program
  returns an attained maximal length of a strictly increasing subsequence.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val lengthOfLIS_precond_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_precond_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_precond (nums : int list) <=> T``
);

val maxInArray_def = new_definition (
  "maxInArray_def",
  ``maxInArray (arr : num list) =
      FOLDL
        (\a b. if a >= b then a else b)
        0
        arr``
);

val lengthOfLIS_update_cell_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_update_cell_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_update_cell
      (nums : int list)
      (i : num)
      (dp : num list)
      (j : num) =
      if EL j nums < EL i nums /\ EL j dp + 1 > EL i dp then
        LUPDATE (EL j dp + 1) i dp
      else
        dp``
);

val lengthOfLIS_process_index_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_process_index_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_process_index
      (nums : int list)
      (dp : num list)
      (i : num) =
      FOLDL
        (\table j. lengthOfLIS_update_cell nums i table j)
        dp
        (GENLIST (\j. j) i)``
);

val lengthOfLIS_table_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_table_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_table (nums : int list) =
      let n = LENGTH nums in
      FOLDL
        (lengthOfLIS_process_index nums)
        (GENLIST (\k. 1) n)
        (GENLIST (\k. k + 1) (n - 1))``
);

val lengthOfLIS_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS (nums : int list) =
      if NULL nums then
        0
      else
        maxInArray (lengthOfLIS_table nums)``
);

val lengthOfLIS_allSubseq_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_allSubseq_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_allSubseq (nums : int list) =
      MAP REVERSE
        (FOLDL
          (\acc x. acc ++ MAP (\sub. x::sub) acc)
          ([[]] : int list list)
          nums)``
);

val lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt_def = Define `
  (lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt [x] = T) /\
  (lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt (x::y::rest) =
     (x < y /\ lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt (y::rest)))
`;

val lengthOfLIS_increasingSubseqLens_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_increasingSubseqLens_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_increasingSubseqLens (nums : int list) =
      MAP LENGTH
        (FILTER
          lengthOfLIS_pairwise_lt
          (lengthOfLIS_allSubseq nums))``
);

val lengthOfLIS_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "lengthOfLIS_postcond_def",
  ``lengthOfLIS_postcond
      (nums : int list)
      (result : num) <=>
      MEM result (lengthOfLIS_increasingSubseqLens nums) /\
      EVERY
        (\len : num. len <= result)
        (lengthOfLIS_increasingSubseqLens nums)``
);

val lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      lengthOfLIS_precond nums ==>
      lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_25 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_25), catalog title
  lengthOfLIS: the exact array-based dynamic-programming implementation,
  including its maximum fold, returns the maximum length of a strictly
  increasing subsequence of an arbitrary finite integer list. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains.
  Word ZZ and Word NN0 are exactly the types of arbitrary finite integer
  lists and natural-number arrays. For a word w, # ` w is its length,
  w ` k is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA25DPGraph is an exact operational graph for the mutable source
  program. For each outer-loop index i, the witness s is the trace of the
  current dp[i] through j = 0,...,i-1. It starts at the Array.mkArray value
  one and changes to dp[j] + 1 exactly when nums[j] < nums[i] and that value
  is greater than the current cell. Earlier cells dp[j] already have their
  final values, while later cells remain irrelevant. This recurrence uniquely
  gives the same final array as the nested loops and set! updates.
  VERINA25DP selects that unique final array.

  VERINA25MaxInArrayGraph reproduces the source Array.foldl from initial
  accumulator zero, using the same maximum conditional at every array entry.
  VERINA25MaxInArray selects its unique output. VERINA25LengthOfLIS preserves
  the source isEmpty branch explicitly and otherwise applies this helper to
  VERINA25DP, so it is the executable implementation rather than an output
  selected from the postcondition.

  VERINA25BitSet and VERINA25MaskWordGraph give a closed form for the source
  allSubseq fold followed by List.reverse. Mask r selects exactly input
  position k when bit k of r is one; numeric mask order is precisely the
  fold's append order, and the selected positions are restored to increasing
  input order by the final reverse. Thus VERINA25Subsequences preserves order,
  duplicates, and every one of the 2^(length nums) occurrences.
  VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing is exactly List.Pairwise (<).
  VERINA25IncreasingLensGraph is the stable filter by that predicate followed
  by the length map, and VERINA25IncreasingLens selects its unique result.

  VERINA25Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int input
  type. VERINA25Post reproduces contains for the returned natural length and
  all for the assertion that every increasing-subsequence length is at most
  it. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA25DPGraph VERINA25DP
  VERINA25MaxInArrayGraph VERINA25MaxInArray
  VERINA25LengthOfLIS VERINA25Pre
  VERINA25BitSet VERINA25MaskWordGraph
  VERINA25SubsequencesGraph VERINA25Subsequences
  VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing
  VERINA25IncreasingLensGraph VERINA25IncreasingLens
  VERINA25Post
$.

verina25-dp-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25DPGraph A B ) $.
verina25-dp-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA25DP A ) $.
verina25-max-in-array-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25MaxInArrayGraph A B ) $.
verina25-max-in-array-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA25MaxInArray A ) $.
verina25-length-of-lis-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA25LengthOfLIS A ) $.
verina25-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25Pre A ) $.
verina25-bit-set-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25BitSet A B ) $.
verina25-mask-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25MaskWordGraph A B C ) $.
verina25-subsequences-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25SubsequencesGraph A B ) $.
verina25-subsequences-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA25Subsequences A ) $.
verina25-strictly-increasing-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing A ) $.
verina25-increasing-lens-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25IncreasingLensGraph A B ) $.
verina25-increasing-lens-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA25IncreasingLens A ) $.
verina25-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA25Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i j s A B $.

  verina25-dp-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25DPGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        E. s e. Word NN0
          (
            (
              ( # ` s ) = ( i + 1 )
              /\
              ( s ` 0 ) = 1
            )
            /\
            (
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ i )
                (
                  s ` ( j + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  (
                    ( A ` j ) < ( A ` i )
                    /\
                    ( s ` j ) < ( ( B ` j ) + 1 )
                  ) ,
                  ( ( B ` j ) + 1 ) ,
                  ( s ` j )
                )
              /\
              ( B ` i ) = ( s ` i )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina25-dp-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25DP A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA25DPGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s A B $.

  verina25-max-in-array-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25MaxInArrayGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = 0
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              ( s ` k ) < ( A ` k ) ,
              ( A ` k ) ,
              ( s ` k )
            )
          /\
          B = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina25-max-in-array-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25MaxInArray A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA25MaxInArrayGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina25-length-of-lis-definition $a |- (
  VERINA25LengthOfLIS A
) = if (
  A = (/) ,
  0 ,
  ( VERINA25MaxInArray ( VERINA25DP A ) )
) $.

verina25-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA25Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

verina25-bit-set-definition $a |- (
  VERINA25BitSet A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2
  ) = 1
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina25-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25MaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( VERINA25BitSet B k )
              <->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B $.

  verina25-subsequences-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25SubsequencesGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )
      /\
      A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          VERINA25MaskWordGraph
            A
            r
            ( B ` r )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina25-subsequences-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25Subsequences A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA25SubsequencesGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina25-strictly-increasing-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) < ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina25-increasing-lens-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25IncreasingLensGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` i )
                <
                ( # ` ( VERINA25Subsequences A ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing
                  (
                    ( VERINA25Subsequences A )
                    ` ( p ` i )
                  )
                /\
                (
                  B ` i
                ) = (
                  # ` (
                    ( VERINA25Subsequences A )
                    ` ( p ` i )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. (
            0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA25Subsequences A ) )
          )
            (
              (
                VERINA25StrictlyIncreasing
                  ( ( VERINA25Subsequences A ) ` k )
              )
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina25-increasing-lens-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25IncreasingLens A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA25IncreasingLensGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina25-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA25Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      B e. ran ( VERINA25IncreasingLens A )
      /\
      A. k e. (
        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA25IncreasingLens A ) )
      )
        (
          ( VERINA25IncreasingLens A ) ` k
        ) <_ B
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-25-length-of-lis $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINA25Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA25Post
        w
        ( VERINA25LengthOfLIS w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_25, catalog title "lengthOfLIS": an exact finite-sequence
:: operational graph of the unconditional precondition, maxInArray helper,
:: dynamic-programming implementation, longest strictly increasing
:: subsequence postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1,
    XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    XXREAL_0, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Nat st
    0 = 0 &
    ((len nums = 0 & result = 0) or
     (0 < len nums &
      ex dp being FinSequence of NAT st
        len dp = len nums &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom nums holds
          1 <= dp/.i &
          (for j being Nat st
            j in dom nums & j < i & nums/.j < nums/.i
          holds dp/.j + 1 <= dp/.i) &
          (dp/.i = 1 or
           ex j being Nat st
             j in dom nums & j < i & nums/.j < nums/.i &
             dp/.i = dp/.j + 1)) &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom dp holds dp/.i <= result) &
        (result = 0 or
         ex i being Nat st i in dom dp & result = dp/.i)))
  holds
    (ex increasing being FinSequence of INT,
        positions being FinSequence of NAT st
      result = len increasing &
      len positions = len increasing &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
        positions/.k in dom nums &
        increasing/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
      holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len increasing holds
        increasing/.k < increasing/.(k + 1)) &
    (for increasing being FinSequence of INT st
      (ex positions being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positions = len increasing &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
          positions/.k in dom nums &
          increasing/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
        holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      (for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len increasing holds
        increasing/.k < increasing/.(k + 1))
    holds len increasing <= result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_25
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_25, catalog title "lengthOfLIS": computing the length of a
% longest strictly increasing integer subsequence with the specified dynamic-
% programming array loops and exhaustive-subsequence contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_25: THEORY
BEGIN

  lengthOfLIS_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          nat_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_set_bang(
      index, new_value: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(new_value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            nat_list_set_bang(
              index - 1,
              new_value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_array_mk(
      size, initial_value: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        initial_value,
        nat_array_mk(size - 1, initial_value))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE size

  maxInArray_fold(
      values: list[nat],
      accumulator: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        maxInArray_fold(
          tail,
          IF accumulator >= head THEN
            accumulator
          ELSE
            head
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxInArray(arr: list[nat]): nat =
    maxInArray_fold(arr, 0)

  lengthOfLIS_inner_loop(
      nums: list[int],
      i, j, remaining: nat,
      dp: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET candidate: nat =
            nat_list_get_bang(j, dp) + 1,
          updated_dp: list[nat] =
            IF int_list_get_bang(j, nums)
                 < int_list_get_bang(i, nums)
                 AND candidate
                   > nat_list_get_bang(i, dp)
            THEN
              nat_list_set_bang(i, candidate, dp)
            ELSE
              dp
            ENDIF
      IN
        lengthOfLIS_inner_loop(
          nums,
          i,
          j + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          updated_dp)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  lengthOfLIS_outer_loop(
      nums: list[int],
      i, remaining: nat,
      dp: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET updated_dp: list[nat] =
        lengthOfLIS_inner_loop(
          nums,
          i,
          0,
          i,
          dp)
      IN
        lengthOfLIS_outer_loop(
          nums,
          i + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          updated_dp)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  lengthOfLIS(nums: list[int]): nat =
    CASES nums OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        LET n: nat = int_list_length(nums),
            initial_dp: list[nat] = nat_array_mk(n, 1),
            final_dp: list[nat] =
              lengthOfLIS_outer_loop(
                nums,
                1,
                int_list_length(tail),
                initial_dp)
        IN
          maxInArray(final_dp)
    ENDCASES

  append_int_list_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_list_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_to_each(
      x: int,
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(x, head),
          prepend_to_each(x, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  all_subsequences_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      accumulator: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(x, rest):
        all_subsequences_fold(
          rest,
          append_int_list_lists(
            accumulator,
            prepend_to_each(x, accumulator)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null)

  reverse_each(
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          reverse_int_list(head),
          reverse_each(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  all_strictly_greater_than(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower < head
          AND all_strictly_greater_than(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_strictly_increasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_strictly_greater_than(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_strictly_increasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  increasing_subsequence_lengths(
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF pairwise_strictly_increasing(head) THEN
          cons(
            int_list_length(head),
            increasing_subsequence_lengths(tail))
        ELSE
          increasing_subsequence_lengths(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  nat_list_contains(
      values: list[nat],
      requested: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR nat_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[nat],
      upper_bound: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND nat_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  lengthOfLIS_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: nat): bool =
    LET allSubseq: list[list[int]] =
          reverse_each(
            all_subsequences_fold(
              nums,
              cons(null[int], null[list[int]]))),
        increasingSubseqLens: list[nat] =
          increasing_subsequence_lengths(allSubseq)
    IN
      nat_list_contains(increasingSubseqLens, result)
        AND nat_list_all_at_most(
          increasingSubseqLens,
          result)

  lengthOfLIS_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      lengthOfLIS_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        lengthOfLIS_postcond(
          nums,
          lengthOfLIS(nums))

END verina_advanced_25

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_26,
   catalog title "letterCombinations": the executable generation of telephone
   keypad letter combinations for a Unicode string, with empty or invalid
   inputs rejected, together with its correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | LeanAscii a, LeanAscii b =>
      Nat.eqb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) (Ascii.nat_of_ascii b)
  | LeanNonAscii xcode _ _, LeanNonAscii ycode _ _ =>
      N.eqb xcode ycode
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint lean_string_eqb
    (xs ys : lean_string) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (lean_char_eqb x y) (lean_string_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition lean_ascii_char (code : nat) : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat code).

Definition digitToLetters (c : lean_char) : list lean_char :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      let code := Ascii.nat_of_ascii a in
      if Nat.eqb code 50 then
        [lean_ascii_char 97; lean_ascii_char 98; lean_ascii_char 99]
      else if Nat.eqb code 51 then
        [lean_ascii_char 100; lean_ascii_char 101; lean_ascii_char 102]
      else if Nat.eqb code 52 then
        [lean_ascii_char 103; lean_ascii_char 104; lean_ascii_char 105]
      else if Nat.eqb code 53 then
        [lean_ascii_char 106; lean_ascii_char 107; lean_ascii_char 108]
      else if Nat.eqb code 54 then
        [lean_ascii_char 109; lean_ascii_char 110; lean_ascii_char 111]
      else if Nat.eqb code 55 then
        [lean_ascii_char 112; lean_ascii_char 113;
         lean_ascii_char 114; lean_ascii_char 115]
      else if Nat.eqb code 56 then
        [lean_ascii_char 116; lean_ascii_char 117; lean_ascii_char 118]
      else if Nat.eqb code 57 then
        [lean_ascii_char 119; lean_ascii_char 120;
         lean_ascii_char 121; lean_ascii_char 122]
      else []
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => []
  end.

Definition letterCombinations_precond
    (_digits : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint letterCombinations_go
    (chars : list lean_char) : list lean_string :=
  match chars with
  | [] => []
  | d :: ds =>
      let restCombinations := letterCombinations_go ds in
      let currentLetters := digitToLetters d in
      match restCombinations with
      | [] => map (fun c => [c]) currentLetters
      | _ =>
          flat_map
            (fun c =>
              map (fun s => [c] ++ s) restCombinations)
            currentLetters
      end
  end.

Definition letterCombinations
    (digits : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits)
    : list lean_string :=
  if existsb
       (fun c => lean_string_eqb (digitToLetters c) [])
       digits
  then []
  else letterCombinations_go digits.

Definition letterCombinations_valid_digit
    (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      let code := Ascii.nat_of_ascii a in
      orb (Nat.eqb code 50)
        (orb (Nat.eqb code 51)
          (orb (Nat.eqb code 52)
            (orb (Nat.eqb code 53)
              (orb (Nat.eqb code 54)
                (orb (Nat.eqb code 55)
                  (orb (Nat.eqb code 56)
                       (Nat.eqb code 57)))))))
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition letterCombinations_extend
    (acc : list lean_string)
    (letters : list lean_char) : list lean_string :=
  flat_map
    (fun s =>
      map (fun c => s ++ [c]) letters)
    acc.

Definition letterCombinations_expected
    (digits : lean_string) : list lean_string :=
  fold_left
    letterCombinations_extend
    (map digitToLetters digits)
    [[]].

Definition lean_string_mem
    (s : lean_string)
    (strings : list lean_string) : bool :=
  existsb (lean_string_eqb s) strings.

Definition letterCombinations_postcond
    (digits : lean_string)
    (result : list lean_string)
    (_h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits) : Prop :=
  match digits with
  | [] => result = []
  | _ =>
      if existsb
           (fun c => negb (letterCombinations_valid_digit c))
           digits
      then result = []
      else
        let expected := letterCombinations_expected digits in
        length result = length expected /\
        forallb (fun s => lean_string_mem s expected) result = true /\
        forallb (fun s => lean_string_mem s result) expected = true
  end.

Theorem letterCombinations_spec_satisfied
    (digits : lean_string)
    (h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits) :
  letterCombinations_postcond
    digits (letterCombinations digits h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_26,
  catalog title "letterCombinations": an executable Unicode-scalar string
  program generates telephone-keypad letter combinations, together with its
  precondition and extensional output contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_26
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_trit_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_trit" where
  "lean_trit_of_nat n =
    (if n mod 3 = 0 then Trit0
     else if n mod 3 = 1 then Trit1
     else Trit2)"

definition lean_bits3_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits3" where
  "lean_bits3_of_nat n =
    LeanBits3
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_byte_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_byte" where
  "lean_byte_of_nat n =
    LeanByte
      ((n div 128) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 64) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 32) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_low_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_low_char_of_nat n =
    (let q = n div 2048
     in BMP_Low
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q div 9))
          (lean_trit_of_nat ((q div 3) mod 3))
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q mod 3))
          (lean_bits3_of_nat ((n div 256) mod 8))
          (lean_byte_of_nat (n mod 256)))"

abbreviation ascii :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "ascii n \<equiv> lean_low_char_of_nat n"

definition digitToLetters :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "digitToLetters c =
    (if c = ascii 50 then map ascii [97, 98, 99]
     else if c = ascii 51 then map ascii [100, 101, 102]
     else if c = ascii 52 then map ascii [103, 104, 105]
     else if c = ascii 53 then map ascii [106, 107, 108]
     else if c = ascii 54 then map ascii [109, 110, 111]
     else if c = ascii 55 then map ascii [112, 113, 114, 115]
     else if c = ascii 56 then map ascii [116, 117, 118]
     else if c = ascii 57 then map ascii [119, 120, 121, 122]
     else [])"

definition letterCombinations_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "letterCombinations_precond digits \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun letterCombinations_go :: "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_string list" where
  "letterCombinations_go [] = []"
| "letterCombinations_go (d # ds) =
    (let restCombinations = letterCombinations_go ds;
         currentLetters = digitToLetters d
     in case restCombinations of
          [] \<Rightarrow> map (\<lambda>c. [c]) currentLetters
        | _ \<Rightarrow>
            concat
              (map
                (\<lambda>c. map (\<lambda>s. c # s) restCombinations)
                currentLetters))"

definition letterCombinations :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string list" where
  "letterCombinations digits =
    (if list_ex (\<lambda>c. digitToLetters c = []) digits
     then []
     else letterCombinations_go digits)"

definition valid_keypad_digit :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "valid_keypad_digit c \<longleftrightarrow>
    c \<in> set (map ascii [50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57])"

definition letterCombinations_expected_step ::
    "lean_string list \<Rightarrow> lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_string list" where
  "letterCombinations_expected_step acc ls =
    concat (map (\<lambda>s. map (\<lambda>c. s @ [c]) ls) acc)"

definition letterCombinations_expected ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string list" where
  "letterCombinations_expected digits =
    foldl letterCombinations_expected_step [[]]
      (map digitToLetters digits)"

definition letterCombinations_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "letterCombinations_postcond digits result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (if digits = []
     then result = []
     else if list_ex (\<lambda>c. \<not> valid_keypad_digit c) digits
     then result = []
     else
       (let expected = letterCombinations_expected digits
        in length result = length expected \<and>
           list_all (\<lambda>s. s \<in> set expected) result \<and>
           list_all (\<lambda>s. s \<in> set result) expected))"

theorem letterCombinations_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "letterCombinations_precond digits"
  shows
    "letterCombinations_postcond digits (letterCombinations digits)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_26,
  catalog title "letterCombinations": an executable recursive phone-keypad
  expansion maps a Unicode string of digits to all corresponding letter
  combinations, with its total precondition and extensional list
  postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let letterCombinations_validChar = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let letterCombinations_string = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_string (s:num list) <=>
     ALL letterCombinations_validChar s`;;

let digitToLetters = new_definition
  `digitToLetters (c:num) =
     if c = 50 then CONS 97 (CONS 98 (CONS 99 []))
     else if c = 51 then CONS 100 (CONS 101 (CONS 102 []))
     else if c = 52 then CONS 103 (CONS 104 (CONS 105 []))
     else if c = 53 then CONS 106 (CONS 107 (CONS 108 []))
     else if c = 54 then CONS 109 (CONS 110 (CONS 111 []))
     else if c = 55 then
       CONS 112 (CONS 113 (CONS 114 (CONS 115 [])))
     else if c = 56 then CONS 116 (CONS 117 (CONS 118 []))
     else if c = 57 then
       CONS 119 (CONS 120 (CONS 121 (CONS 122 [])))
     else []`;;

let letterCombinations_precond = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_precond (digits:num list) <=> T`;;

let letterCombinations_anyEmptyMapping =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(letterCombinations_anyEmptyMapping ([]:num list) = F) /\
     (!c:num. !cs:num list.
        letterCombinations_anyEmptyMapping (CONS c cs) =
        if digitToLetters c = []
        then T
        else letterCombinations_anyEmptyMapping cs)`;;

let letterCombinations_flatMapPrefix =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!rest:(num list)list.
        letterCombinations_flatMapPrefix ([]:num list) rest = []) /\
     (!c:num. !cs:num list. !rest:(num list)list.
        letterCombinations_flatMapPrefix (CONS c cs) rest =
        APPEND
          (MAP (\s:num list. CONS c s) rest)
          (letterCombinations_flatMapPrefix cs rest))`;;

let letterCombinations_go =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(letterCombinations_go ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!d:num. !ds:num list.
        letterCombinations_go (CONS d ds) =
        let restCombinations = letterCombinations_go ds in
        let currentLetters = digitToLetters d in
        if restCombinations = []
        then MAP (\c:num. CONS c []) currentLetters
        else
          letterCombinations_flatMapPrefix
            currentLetters restCombinations)`;;

let letterCombinations = new_definition
  `letterCombinations (digits:num list) =
     if letterCombinations_anyEmptyMapping digits
     then []
     else letterCombinations_go digits`;;

let letterCombinations_validDigit = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_validDigit (c:num) <=>
     MEM c
       (CONS 50
         (CONS 51
           (CONS 52
             (CONS 53
               (CONS 54
                 (CONS 55
                   (CONS 56 (CONS 57 []))))))))`;;

let letterCombinations_anyInvalidDigit =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(letterCombinations_anyInvalidDigit ([]:num list) = F) /\
     (!c:num. !cs:num list.
        letterCombinations_anyInvalidDigit (CONS c cs) =
        if ~letterCombinations_validDigit c
        then T
        else letterCombinations_anyInvalidDigit cs)`;;

let letterCombinations_expectedStep =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!letters:num list.
        letterCombinations_expectedStep
          ([]:(num list)list) letters = []) /\
     (!s:num list. !ss:(num list)list. !letters:num list.
        letterCombinations_expectedStep (CONS s ss) letters =
        APPEND
          (MAP
            (\c:num. APPEND s (CONS c []))
            letters)
          (letterCombinations_expectedStep ss letters))`;;

let letterCombinations_expectedFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(num list)list.
        letterCombinations_expectedFold
          acc ([]:(num list)list) = acc) /\
     (!letters:num list. !letterLists:(num list)list.
      !acc:(num list)list.
        letterCombinations_expectedFold
          acc (CONS letters letterLists) =
        letterCombinations_expectedFold
          (letterCombinations_expectedStep acc letters)
          letterLists)`;;

let letterCombinations_expected = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_expected (digits:num list) =
     letterCombinations_expectedFold
       (CONS ([]:num list) [])
       (MAP digitToLetters digits)`;;

let letterCombinations_postcond = new_definition
  `letterCombinations_postcond
      (digits:num list) (result:(num list)list) <=>
     if digits = [] then
       result = []
     else if letterCombinations_anyInvalidDigit digits then
       result = []
     else
       let expected = letterCombinations_expected digits in
       LENGTH result = LENGTH expected /\
       ALL (\s:num list. MEM s expected) result /\
       ALL (\s:num list. MEM s result) expected`;;

let letterCombinations_spec_satisfied =
  `!digits:num list.
     letterCombinations_string digits
     ==> letterCombinations_precond digits
     ==> letterCombinations_postcond
           digits (letterCombinations digits)`;;

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_26,
;; "letterCombinations": the executable telephone-keypad recursion generates
;; letter strings for a Unicode digit string, together with its independently
;; folded combination correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values. Thus a List String is a proper list of such scalar lists.

(defun verina-advanced-26-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-advanced-26-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-26-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-advanced-26-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-26-string-list-p (strings)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count strings)))
  (if (consp strings)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-26-string-p (car strings))
       (verina-advanced-26-string-list-p (cdr strings)))
    (equal strings nil)))

;; Character codes below are the Unicode scalar values of the source literals.

(defun verina-advanced-26-digit-to-letters (c)
  (cond
   ((equal c 50) (list 97 98 99))
   ((equal c 51) (list 100 101 102))
   ((equal c 52) (list 103 104 105))
   ((equal c 53) (list 106 107 108))
   ((equal c 54) (list 109 110 111))
   ((equal c 55) (list 112 113 114 115))
   ((equal c 56) (list 116 117 118))
   ((equal c 57) (list 119 120 121 122))
   (t nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-precond (digits)
  (declare (ignore digits))
  t)

;; This predicate is the implementation's chars.any test: it detects exactly
;; those characters whose digitToLetters image is empty.

(defun verina-advanced-26-has-empty-mapping-p (chars)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count chars)))
  (if (consp chars)
      (or
       (equal
        (verina-advanced-26-digit-to-letters (car chars))
        nil)
       (verina-advanced-26-has-empty-mapping-p (cdr chars)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-26-singleton-strings (letters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count letters)))
  (if (consp letters)
      (cons
       (list (car letters))
       (verina-advanced-26-singleton-strings (cdr letters)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-26-prepend-letter-to-strings
    (letter strings)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count strings)))
  (if (consp strings)
      (cons
       (cons letter (car strings))
       (verina-advanced-26-prepend-letter-to-strings
        letter
        (cdr strings)))
    nil))

;; This is currentLetters.flatMap over the recursively computed suffixes.

(defun verina-advanced-26-prepend-each-letter
    (letters strings)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count letters)))
  (if (consp letters)
      (append
       (verina-advanced-26-prepend-letter-to-strings
        (car letters)
        strings)
       (verina-advanced-26-prepend-each-letter
        (cdr letters)
        strings))
    nil))

;; Exact translation of the source's local right-recursive go function,
;; including its special empty-suffix branch.

(defun verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-go (chars)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count chars)))
  (if (consp chars)
      (let* ((rest-combinations
              (verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-go
               (cdr chars)))
             (current-letters
              (verina-advanced-26-digit-to-letters
               (car chars))))
        (if (equal rest-combinations nil)
            (verina-advanced-26-singleton-strings
             current-letters)
          (verina-advanced-26-prepend-each-letter
           current-letters
           rest-combinations)))
    nil))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; Under the canonical string representation, String.toList is the identity.

(defun verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations (digits)
  (if (verina-advanced-26-has-empty-mapping-p digits)
      nil
    (verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-go digits)))

;; The postcondition tests invalidity independently by membership in 2,...,9.

(defun verina-advanced-26-valid-digit-p (c)
  (or
   (equal c 50)
   (equal c 51)
   (equal c 52)
   (equal c 53)
   (equal c 54)
   (equal c 55)
   (equal c 56)
   (equal c 57)))

(defun verina-advanced-26-contains-invalid-digit-p (chars)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count chars)))
  (if (consp chars)
      (or
       (not
        (verina-advanced-26-valid-digit-p (car chars)))
       (verina-advanced-26-contains-invalid-digit-p
        (cdr chars)))
    nil))

;; The next three definitions reproduce the postcondition's List.map followed
;; by foldl from [""]. Each step flatMaps the accumulated strings and appends
;; one current digit letter to the right of each string.

(defun verina-advanced-26-append-each-letter
    (string letters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count letters)))
  (if (consp letters)
      (cons
       (append string (list (car letters)))
       (verina-advanced-26-append-each-letter
        string
        (cdr letters)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-26-expected-fold-step
    (accumulator letters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count accumulator)))
  (if (consp accumulator)
      (append
       (verina-advanced-26-append-each-letter
        (car accumulator)
        letters)
       (verina-advanced-26-expected-fold-step
        (cdr accumulator)
        letters))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-26-expected-fold
    (remaining-digits accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-digits)))
  (if (consp remaining-digits)
      (verina-advanced-26-expected-fold
       (cdr remaining-digits)
       (verina-advanced-26-expected-fold-step
        accumulator
        (verina-advanced-26-digit-to-letters
         (car remaining-digits))))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-26-expected-combinations (digits)
  (verina-advanced-26-expected-fold digits (list nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-26-all-members-of-p (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-advanced-26-all-members-of-p
        (cdr left)
        right))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-postcond
    (digits result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-26-string-p digits)
   (verina-advanced-26-string-list-p result)
   (if (equal digits nil)
       (equal result nil)
     (if (verina-advanced-26-contains-invalid-digit-p digits)
         (equal result nil)
       (let ((expected
              (verina-advanced-26-expected-combinations digits)))
         (and
          (equal (len result) (len expected))
          (verina-advanced-26-all-members-of-p
           result
           expected)
          (verina-advanced-26-all-members-of-p
           expected
           result)))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the Lean String binder and the source precondition.

(defun
    verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-spec-satisfied-statement
    (digits)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-26-string-p digits)
    (verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-precond digits))
   (verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations-postcond
    digits
    (verina-advanced-26-letter-combinations digits))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_26,
-- catalog title "letterCombinations": a deterministic recursive string program
-- generates telephone-keypad letter combinations, with empty or invalid input
-- producing the empty list. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced26 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using (Char; primCharEquality)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using
  (String; primStringAppend; primStringEquality; primStringFromList;
   primStringToList)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

listIsEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listIsEmpty [] = true
listIsEmpty (_ ∷ _) = false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

containsChar : Char → List Char → Bool
containsChar sought [] = false
containsChar sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if primCharEquality sought x
  then true
  else containsChar sought xs

containsString : String → List String → Bool
containsString sought [] = false
containsString sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if primStringEquality sought x
  then true
  else containsString sought xs

digitToLetters : Char → List Char
digitToLetters c =
  if primCharEquality c '2' then 'a' ∷ 'b' ∷ 'c' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '3' then 'd' ∷ 'e' ∷ 'f' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '4' then 'g' ∷ 'h' ∷ 'i' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '5' then 'j' ∷ 'k' ∷ 'l' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '6' then 'm' ∷ 'n' ∷ 'o' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '7' then 'p' ∷ 'q' ∷ 'r' ∷ 's' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '8' then 't' ∷ 'u' ∷ 'v' ∷ [] else
  if primCharEquality c '9' then 'w' ∷ 'x' ∷ 'y' ∷ 'z' ∷ [] else
  []

validDigits : List Char
validDigits =
  '2' ∷ '3' ∷ '4' ∷ '5' ∷ '6' ∷ '7' ∷ '8' ∷ '9' ∷ []

singletonString : Char → String
singletonString c = primStringFromList (c ∷ [])

letterCombinations-precond : String → Set
letterCombinations-precond digits = Top

prependCurrentLetters :
  List Char →
  List String →
  List String
prependCurrentLetters currentLetters [] =
  mapList singletonString currentLetters
prependCurrentLetters currentLetters rest@(_ ∷ _) =
  flatMapList
    (λ c →
      mapList
        (λ s → primStringAppend (singletonString c) s)
        rest)
    currentLetters

letterCombinationsGo : List Char → List String
letterCombinationsGo [] = []
letterCombinationsGo (d ∷ ds) =
  prependCurrentLetters
    (digitToLetters d)
    (letterCombinationsGo ds)

letterCombinations :
  (digits : String) →
  letterCombinations-precond digits →
  List String
letterCombinations digits h-precond =
  let chars = primStringToList digits
  in
    if anyList (λ c → listIsEmpty (digitToLetters c)) chars
    then []
    else letterCombinationsGo chars

expectedStep :
  List String →
  List Char →
  List String
expectedStep accumulator letters =
  flatMapList
    (λ s →
      mapList
        (λ c → primStringAppend s (singletonString c))
        letters)
    accumulator

expectedCombinations : String → List String
expectedCombinations digits =
  foldLeft
    expectedStep
    (primStringFromList [] ∷ [])
    (mapList digitToLetters (primStringToList digits))

letterCombinations-postcond :
  (digits : String) →
  (result : List String) →
  letterCombinations-precond digits →
  Set
letterCombinations-postcond digits result h-precond
  with listIsEmpty (primStringToList digits)
... | true = result ≡ []
... | false
  with anyList
    (λ c → notBool (containsChar c validDigits))
    (primStringToList digits)
... | true = result ≡ []
... | false =
  let expected = expectedCombinations digits
  in
    (listLength result ≡ listLength expected) ∧
    IsTrue (allList (λ s → containsString s expected) result) ∧
    IsTrue (allList (λ s → containsString s result) expected)

letterCombinations-spec-satisfied : Set
letterCombinations-spec-satisfied =
  (digits : String) →
  (h-precond : letterCombinations-precond digits) →
  letterCombinations-postcond
    digits
    (letterCombinations digits h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_26,
  cataloged as "letterCombinations": the executable program generates the
  telephone-keypad letter combinations for a Unicode-scalar digit string,
  returning the empty list for empty or invalid input. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val letterCombinations_isUnicodeScalar_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_isUnicodeScalar_def",
  ``letterCombinations_isUnicodeScalar (c : num) <=>
      c < 1114112 /\ ~(55296 <= c /\ c <= 57343)``
);

val letterCombinations_isUnicodeString_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_isUnicodeString_def",
  ``letterCombinations_isUnicodeString (s : num list) <=>
      EVERY letterCombinations_isUnicodeScalar s``
);

val digitToLetters_def = new_definition (
  "digitToLetters_def",
  ``digitToLetters (c : num) =
      if c = 50 then [97; 98; 99]
      else if c = 51 then [100; 101; 102]
      else if c = 52 then [103; 104; 105]
      else if c = 53 then [106; 107; 108]
      else if c = 54 then [109; 110; 111]
      else if c = 55 then [112; 113; 114; 115]
      else if c = 56 then [116; 117; 118]
      else if c = 57 then [119; 120; 121; 122]
      else []``
);

val letterCombinations_precond_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_precond_def",
  ``letterCombinations_precond (digits : num list) <=> T``
);

val letterCombinations_go_def = Define `
  (letterCombinations_go ([] : num list) = ([] : num list list)) /\
  (letterCombinations_go (d::ds) =
     let restCombinations = letterCombinations_go ds in
     let currentLetters = digitToLetters d in
       if restCombinations = [] then
         MAP (\c. [c]) currentLetters
       else
         FLAT
           (MAP
             (\c. MAP (\s. c::s) restCombinations)
             currentLetters))
`;

val letterCombinations_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_def",
  ``letterCombinations (digits : num list) =
      if EXISTS (\c. digitToLetters c = []) digits then
        []
      else
        letterCombinations_go digits``
);

val letterCombinations_expected_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_expected_def",
  ``letterCombinations_expected (digits : num list) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc ls.
           FLAT
             (MAP
               (\s. MAP (\c. s ++ [c]) ls)
               acc))
        ([[]] : num list list)
        (MAP digitToLetters digits)``
);

val letterCombinations_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "letterCombinations_postcond_def",
  ``letterCombinations_postcond
      (digits : num list) (result : num list list) <=>
      if digits = [] then
        result = []
      else if
        EXISTS
          (\c. ~MEM c [50; 51; 52; 53; 54; 55; 56; 57])
          digits
      then
        result = []
      else
        let expected = letterCombinations_expected digits
        in
          LENGTH result = LENGTH expected /\
          EVERY (\s. MEM s expected) result /\
          EVERY (\s. MEM s result) expected``
);

val letterCombinations_spec_satisfied =
  ``!digits : num list.
      letterCombinations_isUnicodeString digits ==>
      letterCombinations_precond digits ==>
      letterCombinations_postcond
        digits
        (letterCombinations digits)``;

title: verina_advanced_26
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_26 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_26), catalog title
  letterCombinations: the exact recursive telephone-keypad combination
  program and its independently folded output contract for arbitrary Unicode
  input strings. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINA26Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, so
  Word VERINA26Char represents arbitrary strings extensionally through
  String.toList. VERINA26DigitBase and VERINA26DigitLength encode the source
  digitToLetters table for characters 2 through 9, including the four-letter
  entries for 7 and 9; all other characters map to the empty word.

  VERINA26PrependGraph is the exact source branch that maps each current
  letter to a singleton string when the recursive tail result is empty, and
  otherwise flatMaps current letters in order over the tail combinations,
  prepending the current letter to every tail string. VERINA26GoGraph records
  the structurally recursive go computation from the empty suffix back
  through the input. VERINA26LetterCombinations first performs the source
  any-test for an empty digit mapping and returns the empty list on failure;
  otherwise it selects the unique go result. It is therefore the executable
  implementation, not an output chosen from the postcondition.

  VERINA26ExpectedStepGraph separately reproduces the postcondition's foldl:
  starting with the singleton list containing the empty string, it flatMaps
  each accumulated prefix in order over the next digit's letters and appends
  one character. VERINA26Expected selects that exact ordered fold result.
  VERINA26Pre is the source True precondition together with the String input
  type. VERINA26Post preserves the empty-input and invalid-character branches,
  then states the source length equality and both List.all membership tests.
  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and there is no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA26Char
  VERINA26ValidDigit
  VERINA26DigitBase VERINA26DigitLength
  VERINA26DigitToLettersGraph VERINA26DigitToLetters
  VERINA26HasInvalid
  VERINA26PrependGraph
  VERINA26GoGraph VERINA26Go
  VERINA26LetterCombinations VERINA26Pre
  VERINA26ExpectedStepGraph
  VERINA26ExpectedGraph VERINA26Expected
  VERINA26Post
$.

verina26-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA26Char $.
verina26-valid-digit-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26ValidDigit A ) $.
verina26-digit-base-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26DigitBase A ) $.
verina26-digit-length-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26DigitLength A ) $.
verina26-digit-to-letters-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26DigitToLettersGraph A B ) $.
verina26-digit-to-letters-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26DigitToLetters A ) $.
verina26-has-invalid-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26HasInvalid A ) $.
verina26-prepend-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26PrependGraph A B C ) $.
verina26-go-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26GoGraph A B ) $.
verina26-go-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26Go A ) $.
verina26-letter-combinations-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26LetterCombinations A ) $.
verina26-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26Pre A ) $.
verina26-expected-step-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26ExpectedStepGraph A B C ) $.
verina26-expected-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26ExpectedGraph A B ) $.
verina26-expected-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA26Expected A ) $.
verina26-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA26Post A B ) $.

verina26-char-definition $a |- VERINA26Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verina26-valid-digit-definition $a |- (
  VERINA26ValidDigit A
) <-> (
  (
    A e. VERINA26Char
    /\
    ; 5 0 <_ A
  )
  /\
  A <_ ; 5 7
) $.

verina26-digit-base-definition $a |- (
  VERINA26DigitBase A
) = if (
  A = ; 5 0 ,
  ; 9 7 ,
  if (
    A = ; 5 1 ,
    ; ; 1 0 0 ,
    if (
      A = ; 5 2 ,
      ; ; 1 0 3 ,
      if (
        A = ; 5 3 ,
        ; ; 1 0 6 ,
        if (
          A = ; 5 4 ,
          ; ; 1 0 9 ,
          if (
            A = ; 5 5 ,
            ; ; 1 1 2 ,
            if (
              A = ; 5 6 ,
              ; ; 1 1 6 ,
              if (
                A = ; 5 7 ,
                ; ; 1 1 9 ,
                0
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

verina26-digit-length-definition $a |- (
  VERINA26DigitLength A
) = if (
  (
    A = ; 5 5
    \/
    A = ; 5 7
  ) ,
  4 ,
  if (
    ( VERINA26ValidDigit A ) ,
    3 ,
    0
  )
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina26-digit-to-letters-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26DigitToLettersGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. VERINA26Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA26Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( VERINA26DigitLength A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          ( VERINA26DigitBase A ) + i
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina26-digit-to-letters-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26DigitToLetters A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA26Char
      ( VERINA26DigitToLettersGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verina26-has-invalid-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26HasInvalid A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA26Char
      /\
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        -. ( VERINA26ValidDigit ( A ` i ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j q A B C $.

  verina26-prepend-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26PrependGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA26Char
        /\
        B e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = (/)
        /\
        (
          ( # ` C ) = ( # ` A )
          /\
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
            (
              (
                # ` ( C ` q )
              ) = 1
              /\
              (
                ( C ` q ) ` 0
              ) = (
                A ` q
              )
            )
        )
      )
      \/
      (
        B =/= (/)
        /\
        (
          ( # ` C ) = (
            ( # ` A ) x. ( # ` B )
          )
          /\
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
            (
              (
                # ` ( C ` q )
              ) = (
                1 + (
                  # ` (
                    B ` ( q mod ( # ` B ) )
                  )
                )
              )
              /\
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( C ` q ) ) )
                (
                  ( C ` q ) ` j
                ) = if (
                  j = 0 ,
                  A ` (
                    |_ ` ( q / ( # ` B ) )
                  ) ,
                  (
                    B ` ( q mod ( # ` B ) )
                  ) ` ( j - 1 )
                )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verina26-go-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26GoGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA26Char
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ( Word VERINA26Char ) )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA26PrependGraph
                (
                  VERINA26DigitToLetters
                    (
                      A ` (
                        ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k
                      )
                    )
                )
                ( t ` k )
                ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina26-go-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26Go A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
      ( VERINA26GoGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina26-letter-combinations-definition $a |- (
  VERINA26LetterCombinations A
) = if (
  ( VERINA26HasInvalid A ) ,
  (/) ,
  ( VERINA26Go A )
) $.

verina26-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA26Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word VERINA26Char
) $.

${
  $d j q A B C $.

  verina26-expected-step-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26ExpectedStepGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
        /\
        B e. Word VERINA26Char
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = (/)
        /\
        C = (/)
      )
      \/
      (
        B =/= (/)
        /\
        (
          ( # ` C ) = (
            ( # ` A ) x. ( # ` B )
          )
          /\
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
            (
              (
                # ` ( C ` q )
              ) = (
                (
                  # ` (
                    A ` (
                      |_ ` ( q / ( # ` B ) )
                    )
                  )
                ) + 1
              )
              /\
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( C ` q ) ) )
                (
                  ( C ` q ) ` j
                ) = if (
                  j < (
                    # ` (
                      A ` (
                        |_ ` ( q / ( # ` B ) )
                      )
                    )
                  ) ,
                  (
                    A ` (
                      |_ ` ( q / ( # ` B ) )
                    )
                  ) ` j ,
                  B ` ( q mod ( # ` B ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verina26-expected-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA26ExpectedGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA26Char
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word VERINA26Char )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ( Word VERINA26Char ) )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          (
            (
              # ` ( t ` 0 )
            ) = 1
            /\
            (
              ( t ` 0 ) ` 0
            ) = (/)
          )
        )
        /\
        (

                ( VERINA26DigitToLetters ( A ` k ) )
                ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${

    VERINA26Expected A
