title: verina_advanced_29
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_29,
   catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": an executable sliding-window
   computation of the longest natural-number subarray whose element
   frequencies are at most a positive bound, together with its exhaustive
   contiguous-subarray maximality contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_precond
    (_nums : list nat) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  0 < k.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_freq := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint longestGoodSubarray_freq_get
    (key : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq) : nat :=
  match freq with
  | [] => 0
  | (stored_key, value) :: rest =>
      if Nat.eqb key stored_key
      then value
      else longestGoodSubarray_freq_get key rest
  end.

Fixpoint longestGoodSubarray_freq_insert
    (key value : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq)
    : longestGoodSubarray_freq :=
  match freq with
  | [] => [(key, value)]
  | (stored_key, stored_value) :: rest =>
      if Nat.eqb key stored_key
      then (key, value) :: rest
      else
        (stored_key, stored_value) ::
        longestGoodSubarray_freq_insert key value rest
  end.

Fixpoint longestGoodSubarray_freq_erase
    (key : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq)
    : longestGoodSubarray_freq :=
  match freq with
  | [] => []
  | (stored_key, value) :: rest =>
      if Nat.eqb key stored_key
      then rest
      else
        (stored_key, value) ::
        longestGoodSubarray_freq_erase key rest
  end.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_freq_has_excess
    (k : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq) : bool :=
  existsb
    (fun entry => Nat.ltb k (snd entry))
    freq.

Fixpoint longestGoodSubarray_shrink
    (nums : list nat)
    (k fuel left : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq)
    : nat * longestGoodSubarray_freq :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (left, freq)
  | S fuel' =>
      if longestGoodSubarray_freq_has_excess k freq
      then
        let left_num := nth left nums 0 in
        let left_count :=
          longestGoodSubarray_freq_get left_num freq in
        let next_freq :=
          if Nat.eqb left_count 1
          then longestGoodSubarray_freq_erase left_num freq
          else
            longestGoodSubarray_freq_insert
              left_num (left_count - 1) freq in
        longestGoodSubarray_shrink
          nums k fuel' (S left) next_freq
      else (left, freq)
  end.

Fixpoint longestGoodSubarray_scan
    (nums : list nat)
    (k : nat)
    (remaining : list nat)
    (right left : nat)
    (freq : longestGoodSubarray_freq)
    (max_len : nat) : nat :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => max_len
  | num :: rest =>
      let count :=
        longestGoodSubarray_freq_get num freq in
      let inserted :=
        longestGoodSubarray_freq_insert num (count + 1) freq in
      let shrunk :=
        longestGoodSubarray_shrink
          nums k (length nums) left inserted in
      let next_left := fst shrunk in
      let next_freq := snd shrunk in
      let next_max :=
        Nat.max max_len (right - next_left + 1) in
      longestGoodSubarray_scan
        nums k rest (S right) next_left next_freq next_max
  end.

Definition longestGoodSubarray
    (nums : list nat)
    (k : nat)
    (_h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) : nat :=
  longestGoodSubarray_scan nums k nums 0 0 [] 0.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_subarrays
    (nums : list nat) : list (list nat) :=
  let n := length nums in
  flat_map
    (fun start =>
      map
        (fun len => firstn len (skipn start nums))
        (seq 0 (n - start + 1)))
    (seq 0 (n + 1)).

Definition longestGoodSubarray_subarray_freqs
    (subarrays : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  map
    (fun arr =>
      map
        (fun x => count_occ Nat.eq_dec arr x)
        arr)
    subarrays.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_valid_freqs
    (k : nat)
    (subarray_freqs : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  filter
    (fun arr => forallb (fun x => Nat.leb x k) arr)
    subarray_freqs.

Definition longestGoodSubarray_postcond
    (nums : list nat)
    (k result : nat)
    (_h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) : Prop :=
  let subarrays := longestGoodSubarray_subarrays nums in
  let subarray_freqs :=
    longestGoodSubarray_subarray_freqs subarrays in
  let valid_subarrays :=
    longestGoodSubarray_valid_freqs k subarray_freqs in
  (nums = [] /\ result = 0) \/
  (nums <> [] /\
    existsb
      (fun arr => Nat.eqb (length arr) result)
      valid_subarrays = true /\
    forallb
      (fun arr => Nat.leb (length arr) result)
      valid_subarrays = true).

Theorem longestGoodSubarray_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list nat)
    (k : nat)
    (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) :
  longestGoodSubarray_postcond
    nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_29,
  catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": a deterministic sliding-window program
  computes the maximum length among contiguous subarrays whose value
  frequencies are at most a positive bound. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_29
  imports Main
begin

definition longestGoodSubarray_precond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k \<longleftrightarrow> k > 0"

fun longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault ::
    "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault d [] n = d"
| "longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault d (x # xs) 0 = x"
| "longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault d (x # xs) (Suc n) =
    longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault d xs n"

record longestGoodSubarray_state =
  lgs_left :: nat
  lgs_maxLen :: nat
  lgs_freq :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"

fun longestGoodSubarray_shrink ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      longestGoodSubarray_state \<Rightarrow> longestGoodSubarray_state" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_shrink 0 nums k state = state"
| "longestGoodSubarray_shrink (Suc fuel) nums k state =
    (if \<exists>x. lgs_freq state x > k
     then
       (let lnum =
              longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault 0 nums (lgs_left state);
            lcount = lgs_freq state lnum;
            reduced =
              (if lcount = 1
               then (lgs_freq state)(lnum := 0)
               else (lgs_freq state)(lnum := lcount - 1));
            next =
              state\<lparr>
                lgs_left := Suc (lgs_left state),
                lgs_freq := reduced
              \<rparr>
        in longestGoodSubarray_shrink fuel nums k next)
     else state)"

definition longestGoodSubarray_process ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      longestGoodSubarray_state \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      longestGoodSubarray_state" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_process nums k state right =
    (let num = longestGoodSubarray_nthDefault 0 nums right;
         count = lgs_freq state num;
         increased = (lgs_freq state)(num := count + 1);
         inserted = state\<lparr>lgs_freq := increased\<rparr>;
         shrunk =
           longestGoodSubarray_shrink (length nums) nums k inserted;
         currentLen = right - lgs_left shrunk + 1
     in shrunk\<lparr>
          lgs_maxLen := max (lgs_maxLen shrunk) currentLen
        \<rparr>)"

definition longestGoodSubarray :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "longestGoodSubarray nums k =
    (let initial =
       \<lparr>
         lgs_left = 0,
         lgs_maxLen = 0,
         lgs_freq = (\<lambda>_. 0)
       \<rparr>;
         final =
           foldl
             (longestGoodSubarray_process nums k)
             initial [0..<length nums]
     in lgs_maxLen final)"

definition longestGoodSubarray_subArrays ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list list" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_subArrays nums =
    concat
      (map
        (\<lambda>start.
          map
            (\<lambda>len. take len (drop start nums))
            [0..<(length nums - start + 1)])
        [0..<(length nums + 1)])"

definition longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list list" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs nums =
    map
      (\<lambda>arr. map (\<lambda>x. count_list arr x) arr)
      (longestGoodSubarray_subArrays nums)"

definition longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrays ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list list" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrays nums k =
    filter
      (list_all (\<lambda>x. x \<le> k))
      (longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs nums)"

definition longestGoodSubarray_postcond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "longestGoodSubarray_postcond nums k result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let validSubArrays = longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrays nums k
     in
       (nums = [] \<and> result = 0) \<or>
       (nums \<noteq> [] \<and>
         list_ex (\<lambda>arr. length arr = result) validSubArrays \<and>
         list_all (\<lambda>arr. length arr \<le> result) validSubArrays))"

theorem longestGoodSubarray_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k"
  shows
    "longestGoodSubarray_postcond
      nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_29,
  catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": an executable sliding-window frequency
  scan returns the maximum length of a contiguous natural-number subarray in
  which every value occurs at most k times. This file contains no proof.
*)

let longestGoodSubarray_precond = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_precond (nums:num list) (k:num) <=>
     k > 0`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_mapGet =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(longestGoodSubarray_mapGet
        (key:num) ([]:(num#num)list) = 0) /\
     (!entry:num#num. !rest:(num#num)list. !key:num.
        longestGoodSubarray_mapGet key (CONS entry rest) =
        if FST entry = key
        then SND entry
        else longestGoodSubarray_mapGet key rest)`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert
        (key:num) (value:num) ([]:(num#num)list) =
        CONS (key,value) []) /\
     (!entry:num#num. !rest:(num#num)list.
      !key:num. !value:num.
        longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert
          key value (CONS entry rest) =
        if FST entry = key
        then CONS (key,value) rest
        else
          CONS entry
            (longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert
              key value rest))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_mapErase =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(longestGoodSubarray_mapErase
        (key:num) ([]:(num#num)list) = []) /\
     (!entry:num#num. !rest:(num#num)list. !key:num.
        longestGoodSubarray_mapErase key (CONS entry rest) =
        if FST entry = key
        then rest
        else
          CONS entry
            (longestGoodSubarray_mapErase key rest))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_hasExcess =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(longestGoodSubarray_hasExcess
        (k:num) ([]:(num#num)list) <=> F) /\
     (!entry:num#num. !rest:(num#num)list. !k:num.
        longestGoodSubarray_hasExcess
          k (CONS entry rest) <=>
        SND entry > k \/
        longestGoodSubarray_hasExcess k rest)`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_get 0 nums =
        if nums = [] then 0 else HD nums) /\
     (!index:num. !nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_get (SUC index) nums =
        if nums = []
        then 0
        else longestGoodSubarray_get index (TL nums))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_shrink =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list. !k:num. !left:num.
      !freq:(num#num)list.
        longestGoodSubarray_shrink
          0 nums k left freq = (left,freq)) /\
     (!fuel:num. !nums:num list. !k:num. !left:num.
      !freq:(num#num)list.
        longestGoodSubarray_shrink
          (SUC fuel) nums k left freq =
        if longestGoodSubarray_hasExcess k freq then
          let lnum =
            longestGoodSubarray_get left nums in
          let lcount =
            longestGoodSubarray_mapGet lnum freq in
          let nextFreq =
            if lcount = 1
            then longestGoodSubarray_mapErase lnum freq
            else
              longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert
                lnum (lcount - 1) freq in
          longestGoodSubarray_shrink
            fuel nums k (SUC left) nextFreq
        else (left,freq))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_outer =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list. !k:num. !right:num. !left:num.
      !maxLen:num. !freq:(num#num)list.
        longestGoodSubarray_outer
          0 nums k right left maxLen freq = maxLen) /\
     (!fuel:num. !nums:num list. !k:num.
      !right:num. !left:num. !maxLen:num.
      !freq:(num#num)list.
        longestGoodSubarray_outer
          (SUC fuel) nums k right left maxLen freq =
        let num =
          longestGoodSubarray_get right nums in
        let count =
          longestGoodSubarray_mapGet num freq in
        let grownFreq =
          longestGoodSubarray_mapInsert
            num (count + 1) freq in
        let shrunk =
          longestGoodSubarray_shrink
            (LENGTH nums) nums k left grownFreq in
        let nextLeft = FST shrunk in
        let nextFreq = SND shrunk in
        let windowLen = right - nextLeft + 1 in
        let nextMax =
          if maxLen >= windowLen
          then maxLen
          else windowLen in
        longestGoodSubarray_outer
          fuel nums k (SUC right) nextLeft
          nextMax nextFreq)`;;

let longestGoodSubarray = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray (nums:num list) (k:num) =
     longestGoodSubarray_outer
       (LENGTH nums) nums k 0 0 0 []`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(longestGoodSubarray_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        longestGoodSubarray_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (longestGoodSubarray_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_drop 0 nums = nums) /\
     (!n:num. !nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_drop (SUC n) nums =
        if nums = []
        then []
        else longestGoodSubarray_drop n (TL nums))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_take 0 nums = []) /\
     (!n:num. !nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_take (SUC n) nums =
        if nums = []
        then []
        else
          CONS (HD nums)
            (longestGoodSubarray_take n (TL nums)))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_slicesAt = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_slicesAt
      (nums:num list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          longestGoodSubarray_take len
            (longestGoodSubarray_drop start nums))
       (longestGoodSubarray_range
         (LENGTH nums - start + 1))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_allSlicesFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_allSlicesFrom nums [] = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !nums:num list.
        longestGoodSubarray_allSlicesFrom
          nums (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (longestGoodSubarray_slicesAt nums start)
          (longestGoodSubarray_allSlicesFrom
            nums starts))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_allSlices = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_allSlices (nums:num list) =
     longestGoodSubarray_allSlicesFrom nums
       (longestGoodSubarray_range
         (LENGTH nums + 1))`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_count = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_count
      (x:num) (arr:num list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\y:num. y = x) arr)`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_frequencies = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_frequencies (arr:num list) =
     MAP
       (\x:num. longestGoodSubarray_count x arr)
       arr`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_postcond = new_definition
  `longestGoodSubarray_postcond
      (nums:num list) (k:num) (result:num) <=>
     let subArrays =
       longestGoodSubarray_allSlices nums in
     let subArrayFreqs =
       MAP longestGoodSubarray_frequencies subArrays in
     let validSubArrays =
       FILTER
         (\arr:num list.
            ALL (\count:num. count <= k) arr)
         subArrayFreqs in
     (nums = [] /\ result = 0) \/
     (~(nums = []) /\
       EX
         (\arr:num list. LENGTH arr = result)
         validSubArrays /\
       ALL
         (\arr:num list. LENGTH arr <= result)
         validSubArrays)`;;

let longestGoodSubarray_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:num list. !k:num.
     longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k
     ==> longestGoodSubarray_postcond
           nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k)`;;

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_29,
;; "longestGoodSubarray": a deterministic frequency-map sliding-window
;; computation returns the maximum length specified by an exhaustive
;; contiguous-subarray frequency contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-29-nat-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (natp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-29-nat-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is k > 0. The List Nat and Nat binder domains are
;; made explicit in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray-precond
    (nums k)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  (and
   (natp k)
   (< 0 k)))

;; A source HashMap Nat Nat is represented extensionally by a duplicate-free
;; association list. Only getD, insert, erase, and inspection of stored values
;; are observable, so association-list order and hash layout are irrelevant.

(defun verina-advanced-29-freq-get (key frequencies)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal key frequencies)))
    (if entry
        (cdr entry)
      0)))

(defun verina-advanced-29-freq-put
    (key value frequencies)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequencies)))
  (if (consp frequencies)
      (if (equal key (car (car frequencies)))
          (cons
           (cons key value)
           (cdr frequencies))
        (cons
         (car frequencies)
         (verina-advanced-29-freq-put
          key
          value
          (cdr frequencies))))
    (list (cons key value))))

(defun verina-advanced-29-freq-erase
    (key frequencies)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequencies)))
  (if (consp frequencies)
      (if (equal key (car (car frequencies)))
          (cdr frequencies)
        (cons
         (car frequencies)
         (verina-advanced-29-freq-erase
          key
          (cdr frequencies))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-29-freq-increment
    (key frequencies)
  (verina-advanced-29-freq-put
   key
   (+ 1
      (verina-advanced-29-freq-get
       key
       frequencies))
   frequencies))

(defun verina-advanced-29-freq-decrement
    (key frequencies)
  (let ((count
         (verina-advanced-29-freq-get
          key
          frequencies)))
    (if (equal count 1)
        (verina-advanced-29-freq-erase
         key
         frequencies)
      (verina-advanced-29-freq-put
       key
       (nfix (- count 1))
       frequencies))))

(defun verina-advanced-29-any-frequency-above-k-p
    (frequencies k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequencies)))
  (if (consp frequencies)
      (or
       (> (cdr (car frequencies)) k)
       (verina-advanced-29-any-frequency-above-k-p
        (cdr frequencies)
        k))
    nil))

;; Array indexing with ! returns the inhabited Nat default 0 out of bounds.
;; Reachable indices under the positive-k precondition are in bounds, while
;; this definition also preserves the source operation's total default.

(defun verina-advanced-29-array-read (index nums)
  (if (and
       (natp index)
       (< index (len nums)))
      (nth index nums)
    0))

;; The returned pair is (left . frequencies). FUEL is nums.length, exactly the
;; number of source List.range iterations. A good map implements break; a bad
;; map removes the current left element and advances left once.

(defun verina-advanced-29-shrink-loop
    (left frequencies nums k fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      (cons left frequencies)
    (if (verina-advanced-29-any-frequency-above-k-p
         frequencies
         k)
        (let* ((left-value
                (verina-advanced-29-array-read
                 left
                 nums))
               (next-frequencies
                (verina-advanced-29-freq-decrement
                 left-value
                 frequencies)))
          (verina-advanced-29-shrink-loop
           (+ left 1)
           next-frequencies
           nums
           k
           (- fuel 1)))
      (cons left frequencies))))

(defun verina-advanced-29-nat-max (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      right
    left))

;; REMAINING traverses the source array in increasing right-index order.
;; Natural subtraction is truncated with NFIX before adding one, exactly as
;; in the source expression right - left + 1.

(defun verina-advanced-29-scan-right
    (remaining nums k right left max-length frequencies inner-fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((next-frequencies
              (verina-advanced-29-freq-increment
               (car remaining)
               frequencies))
             (shrink-result
              (verina-advanced-29-shrink-loop
               left
               next-frequencies
               nums
               k
               inner-fuel))
             (next-left
              (car shrink-result))
             (shrunk-frequencies
              (cdr shrink-result))
             (window-length
              (+ 1
                 (nfix (- right next-left))))
             (next-max-length
              (verina-advanced-29-nat-max
               max-length
               window-length)))
        (verina-advanced-29-scan-right
         (cdr remaining)
         nums
         k
         (+ right 1)
         next-left
         next-max-length
         shrunk-frequencies
         inner-fuel))
    max-length))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; These definitions preserve Array conversion, mutable state initialization,
;; both bounded loops, HashMap updates, and Nat.max.

(defun verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray
    (nums k)
  (verina-advanced-29-scan-right
   nums
   nums
   k
   0
   0
   0
   nil
   (len nums)))

;; DROP and TAKE reproduce the source List.drop and List.take operations.

(defun verina-advanced-29-drop (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      xs
    (if (consp xs)
        (verina-advanced-29-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr xs))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-29-take (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-29-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr xs)))
      nil)))

;; This loop maps lengths 0,...,nums.length-start to drop/take subarrays at
;; one start. The outer loop covers starts 0,...,nums.length, reproducing the
;; source List.range/flatMap traversal including every empty subarray.

(defun verina-advanced-29-subarrays-at-start
    (nums start length remaining-lengths)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-29-take
      length
      (verina-advanced-29-drop start nums))
     (verina-advanced-29-subarrays-at-start
      nums
      start
      (+ length 1)
      (- remaining-lengths 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-29-all-subarrays-from
    (nums start remaining-starts total-length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (append
     (verina-advanced-29-subarrays-at-start
      nums
      start
      0
      (+ 1
         (nfix (- total-length start))))
     (verina-advanced-29-all-subarrays-from
      nums
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)
      total-length))))

(defun verina-advanced-29-all-subarrays (nums)
  (let ((length (len nums)))
    (verina-advanced-29-all-subarrays-from
     nums
     0
     (+ length 1)
     length)))

;; These definitions reproduce arr.map (fun x => arr.count x) for every
;; subarray, then filter precisely those count lists whose entries are <= k.

(defun verina-advanced-29-list-count (value xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (+
       (if (equal value (car xs)) 1 0)
       (verina-advanced-29-list-count
        value
        (cdr xs)))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-29-subarray-frequency-list
    (remaining whole)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-29-list-count
        (car remaining)
        whole)
       (verina-advanced-29-subarray-frequency-list
        (cdr remaining)
        whole))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-29-map-subarray-frequencies
    (subarrays)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarrays)))
  (if (consp subarrays)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-29-subarray-frequency-list
        (car subarrays)
        (car subarrays))
       (verina-advanced-29-map-subarray-frequencies
        (cdr subarrays)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-29-all-counts-at-most-k-p
    (counts k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count counts)))
  (if (consp counts)
      (and
       (<= (car counts) k)
       (verina-advanced-29-all-counts-at-most-k-p
        (cdr counts)
        k))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-29-filter-valid-frequency-lists
    (frequency-lists k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-lists)))
  (if (consp frequency-lists)
      (if (verina-advanced-29-all-counts-at-most-k-p
           (car frequency-lists)
           k)
          (cons
           (car frequency-lists)
           (verina-advanced-29-filter-valid-frequency-lists
            (cdr frequency-lists)
            k))
        (verina-advanced-29-filter-valid-frequency-lists
         (cdr frequency-lists)
         k))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-29-contains-length-p
    (frequency-lists result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-lists)))
  (if (consp frequency-lists)
      (or
       (equal (len (car frequency-lists)) result)
       (verina-advanced-29-contains-length-p
        (cdr frequency-lists)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-29-all-lengths-at-most-p
    (frequency-lists result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-lists)))
  (if (consp frequency-lists)
      (and
       (<= (len (car frequency-lists)) result)
       (verina-advanced-29-all-lengths-at-most-p
        (cdr frequency-lists)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray-postcond
    (nums k result)
  (let* ((subarrays
          (verina-advanced-29-all-subarrays nums))
         (subarray-frequencies
          (verina-advanced-29-map-subarray-frequencies
           subarrays))
         (valid-subarray-frequencies
          (verina-advanced-29-filter-valid-frequency-lists
           subarray-frequencies
           k)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-29-nat-listp nums)
     (natp k)
     (natp result)
     (or
      (and
       (equal nums nil)
       (equal result 0))
      (and
       (not (equal nums nil))
       (verina-advanced-29-contains-length-p
        valid-subarray-frequencies
        result)
       (verina-advanced-29-all-lengths-at-most-p
        valid-subarray-frequencies
        result))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves both source binder domains and k > 0, while its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums k)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-29-nat-listp nums)
    (natp k)
    (verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray-precond
     nums
     k))
   (verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray-postcond
    nums
    k
    (verina-advanced-29-longest-good-subarray
     nums
     k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_29,
-- catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": a deterministic sliding-window program
-- computes the maximum length among contiguous subarrays whose value
-- frequencies are at most a positive bound. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced29 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  or-left : A → A ∨ B
  or-right : B → A ∨ B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

natMax : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMax m n =
  if natLess m n
  then n
  else m

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

countNat : Nat → List Nat → Nat
countNat sought [] = zero
countNat sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if natEqual sought x
  then suc (countNat sought xs)
  else countNat sought xs

record Entry : Set where
  constructor entry
  field
    entryKey : Nat
    entryValue : Nat

FrequencyTable : Set
FrequencyTable = List Entry

lookupCount : Nat → FrequencyTable → Nat
lookupCount key [] = zero
lookupCount key (entry stored-key value ∷ rest) =
  if natEqual key stored-key
  then value
  else lookupCount key rest

insertCount : Nat → Nat → FrequencyTable → FrequencyTable
insertCount key value [] = entry key value ∷ []
insertCount key value (entry stored-key stored-value ∷ rest) =
  if natEqual key stored-key
  then (entry key value ∷ rest)
  else (entry stored-key stored-value ∷ insertCount key value rest)

eraseCount : Nat → FrequencyTable → FrequencyTable
eraseCount key [] = []
eraseCount key (entry stored-key value ∷ rest) =
  if natEqual key stored-key
  then rest
  else (entry stored-key value ∷ eraseCount key rest)

anyCountGreater : Nat → FrequencyTable → Bool
anyCountGreater bound [] = false
anyCountGreater bound (entry key value ∷ rest) =
  if natLess bound value
  then true
  else anyCountGreater bound rest

longestGoodSubarray-precond : List Nat → Nat → Set
longestGoodSubarray-precond nums k = zero < k

record WindowState : Set where
  constructor window
  field
    leftIndex : Nat
    maximumLength : Nat
    frequencyTable : FrequencyTable

open WindowState

shrinkOnce : List Nat → WindowState → WindowState
shrinkOnce nums (window left maximum frequencies) =
  let left-value = nthDefault zero left nums
      left-count = lookupCount left-value frequencies
      reduced-frequencies =
        if natEqual left-count (suc zero)
        then eraseCount left-value frequencies
        else
          insertCount
            left-value
            (natSubtract left-count (suc zero))
            frequencies
  in window (suc left) maximum reduced-frequencies

shrinkWindow :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  WindowState →
  WindowState
shrinkWindow zero nums k state = state
shrinkWindow
  (suc fuel)
  nums
  k
  (window left maximum frequencies) =
    if anyCountGreater k frequencies
    then
      shrinkWindow
        fuel
        nums
        k
        (shrinkOnce nums (window left maximum frequencies))
    else window left maximum frequencies

processRight :
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  WindowState →
  Nat →
  WindowState
processRight nums k (window left maximum frequencies) right-index =
  let current-value = nthDefault zero right-index nums
      current-count = lookupCount current-value frequencies
      increased-frequencies =
        insertCount current-value (suc current-count) frequencies
      shrunk =
        shrinkWindow
          (listLength nums)
          nums
          k
          (window left maximum increased-frequencies)
      current-length =
        suc (natSubtract right-index (leftIndex shrunk))
  in
    window
      (leftIndex shrunk)
      (natMax (maximumLength shrunk) current-length)
      (frequencyTable shrunk)

longestGoodSubarray :
  (nums : List Nat) →
  (k : Nat) →
  longestGoodSubarray-precond nums k →
  Nat
longestGoodSubarray nums k h-precond =
  maximumLength
    (foldLeft
      (processRight nums k)
      (window zero zero [])
      (range (listLength nums)))

allSubarrays : List Nat → List (List Nat)
allSubarrays nums =
  let n = listLength nums
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ start →
        mapList
          (λ length → takeList length (dropList start nums))
          (range (suc (natSubtract n start))))
      (range (suc n))

subarrayFrequencies : List Nat → List (List Nat)
subarrayFrequencies nums =
  mapList
    (λ subarray →
      mapList (λ x → countNat x subarray) subarray)
    (allSubarrays nums)

validSubarrayFrequencies : List Nat → Nat → List (List Nat)
validSubarrayFrequencies nums k =
  filterList
    (λ frequencies →
      allList (λ count → natLessOrEqual count k) frequencies)
    (subarrayFrequencies nums)

longestGoodSubarray-postcond :
  (nums : List Nat) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (result : Nat) →
  longestGoodSubarray-precond nums k →
  Set
longestGoodSubarray-postcond nums k result h-precond =
  let valid = validSubarrayFrequencies nums k
  in
    ((nums ≡ []) ∧ (result ≡ zero)) ∨
    (Not (nums ≡ []) ∧
      IsTrue
        (anyList
          (λ frequencies →
            natEqual (listLength frequencies) result)
          valid) ∧
      IsTrue
        (allList
          (λ frequencies →
            natLessOrEqual (listLength frequencies) result)
          valid))

longestGoodSubarray-spec-satisfied : Set
longestGoodSubarray-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Nat) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (h-precond : longestGoodSubarray-precond nums k) →
  longestGoodSubarray-postcond
    nums
    k
    (longestGoodSubarray nums k h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_29,
  cataloged as "longestGoodSubarray": the executable sliding-window program
  returns the maximum length of a contiguous natural-number subarray in which
  every value occurs at most k times. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val longestGoodSubarray_precond_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_precond_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_precond
      (nums : num list) (k : num) <=>
      0 < k``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup_def = Define `
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup
      (x : num) ([] : (num # num) list) =
     0) /\
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup
      x ((y, count)::rest) =
     if x = y then
       count
     else
       longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup x rest)
`;

val longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert_def = Define `
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert
      (x : num) (count : num) ([] : (num # num) list) =
     [(x, count)]) /\
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert
      x count ((y, oldCount)::rest) =
     if x = y then
       (x, count)::rest
     else
       (y, oldCount)::
         longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert x count rest)
`;

val longestGoodSubarray_freqErase_def = Define `
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqErase
      (x : num) ([] : (num # num) list) =
     ([] : (num # num) list)) /\
  (longestGoodSubarray_freqErase
      x ((y, count)::rest) =
     if x = y then
       rest
     else
       (y, count)::longestGoodSubarray_freqErase x rest)
`;

val longestGoodSubarray_tooFrequent_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_tooFrequent_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_tooFrequent
      (k : num) (freq : (num # num) list) <=>
      EXISTS (\entry. k < SND entry) freq``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_shrink_def = Define `
  (longestGoodSubarray_shrink
      0
      (nums : num list)
      (k : num)
      (left : num)
      (freq : (num # num) list) =
     (left, freq)) /\
  (longestGoodSubarray_shrink
      (SUC fuel)
      nums
      k
      left
      freq =
     if longestGoodSubarray_tooFrequent k freq then
       let leftNum = EL left nums in
       let leftCount =
         longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup leftNum freq in
       let nextFreq =
         if leftCount = 1 then
           longestGoodSubarray_freqErase leftNum freq
         else
           longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert
             leftNum (leftCount - 1) freq
       in
         longestGoodSubarray_shrink
           fuel nums k (left + 1) nextFreq
     else
       (left, freq))
`;

val longestGoodSubarray_natMax_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_natMax_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_natMax (m : num) (n : num) =
      if m < n then n else m``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_scan_def = Define `
  (longestGoodSubarray_scan
      (nums : num list)
      (k : num)
      ([] : num list)
      (right : num)
      (left : num)
      (maxLen : num)
      (freq : (num # num) list) =
     maxLen) /\
  (longestGoodSubarray_scan
      nums
      k
      (num::rest)
      right
      left
      maxLen
      freq =
     let count =
       longestGoodSubarray_freqLookup num freq in
     let insertedFreq =
       longestGoodSubarray_freqInsert num (count + 1) freq in
     let shrunk =
       longestGoodSubarray_shrink
         (LENGTH nums) nums k left insertedFreq in
     let nextLeft = FST shrunk in
     let nextFreq = SND shrunk in
     let windowLen = right - nextLeft + 1 in
     let nextMax =
       longestGoodSubarray_natMax maxLen windowLen
     in
       longestGoodSubarray_scan
         nums k rest (right + 1) nextLeft nextMax nextFreq)
`;

val longestGoodSubarray_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray (nums : num list) (k : num) =
      longestGoodSubarray_scan
        nums k nums 0 0 0 ([] : (num # num) list)``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_subArrays_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_subArrays_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_subArrays (nums : num list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\start.
             MAP
               (\len. TAKE len (DROP start nums))
               (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums - start + 1)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums + 1)))``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs (nums : num list) =
      MAP
        (\arr.
           MAP
             (\x. LENGTH (FILTER (\y. y = x) arr))
             arr)
        (longestGoodSubarray_subArrays nums)``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrayFreqs_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrayFreqs_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrayFreqs
      (nums : num list) (k : num) =
      FILTER
        (\freqs. EVERY (\count. count <= k) freqs)
        (longestGoodSubarray_subArrayFreqs nums)``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "longestGoodSubarray_postcond_def",
  ``longestGoodSubarray_postcond
      (nums : num list) (k : num) (result : num) <=>
      let validSubArrays =
        longestGoodSubarray_validSubArrayFreqs nums k
      in
        (nums = [] /\ result = 0) \/
        (nums <> [] /\
         EXISTS
           (\arr : num list. LENGTH arr = result)
           validSubArrays /\
         EVERY
           (\arr : num list. LENGTH arr <= result)
           validSubArrays)``
);

val longestGoodSubarray_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(nums : num list) (k : num).
      longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k ==>
      longestGoodSubarray_postcond
        nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k)``;

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_29 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_29), catalog title
  longestGoodSubarray: the exact bounded sliding-window program returns the
  maximum length of a contiguous subarray whose element frequencies are at
  most the positive natural bound. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and i ..^ j is the
  half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA29WindowCount is the multiplicity of a value in a half-open slice,
  and VERINA29WindowGood says every entry in that slice has multiplicity at
  most k. The source HashMap is represented extensionally by these counts:
  after insertion at right and each removal at left, its positive entries are
  exactly the multiplicities in nums[left .. right + 1]. HashMap bucket
  layout and capacity are unobservable.

  VERINA29StepLeft gives the exact result of the source's bounded inner loop.
  It chooses the least index at or after the previous left endpoint for which
  the current window is good. Because k is positive, the singleton ending at
  right is good, so this endpoint is reached within the source bound of
  nums.length iterations. VERINA29RunGraph threads these left endpoints and
  maxLen values through every right endpoint and applies the same natural
  subtraction, addition, and maximum update. VERINA29LongestGoodSubarray
  selects the unique final value, independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA29Extract is the exact drop-then-take operation on every valid range.
  VERINA29Subarrays enumerates the source pair order: starts from zero through
  nums.length, and for each start lengths from zero through the remaining
  length. VERINA29FreqWord maps every element occurrence to its count in that
  extracted word. VERINA29SubarrayFreqs performs that map over the complete
  subarray word. VERINA29ValidSubarrays is the exact stable filter retaining
  precisely the frequency words whose entries are all at most k, including
  every duplicate occurrence and every empty subarray occurrence.

  VERINA29Pre is the positive-k precondition. VERINA29Post reproduces the
  source empty-input branch and, for nonempty input, its List.any equality of
  a retained word length with the result and List.all upper-bound check. The
  proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and propositionally
  unused and is omitted from the target function and postcondition predicate.
  The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no
  $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA29WindowCount VERINA29WindowGood
  VERINA29StepLeft VERINA29RunGraph VERINA29LongestGoodSubarray
  VERINA29ExtractGraph VERINA29Extract
  VERINA29SubarraysGraph VERINA29Subarrays
  VERINA29Count VERINA29FreqWordGraph VERINA29FreqWord
  VERINA29SubarrayFreqsGraph VERINA29SubarrayFreqs
  VERINA29AllAtMost
  VERINA29ValidSubarraysGraph VERINA29ValidSubarrays
  VERINA29Pre VERINA29Post
$.

verina29-window-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29WindowCount A B C D ) $.
verina29-window-good-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29WindowGood A B C D ) $.
verina29-step-left-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29StepLeft A B C D E ) $.
verina29-run-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29RunGraph A B C ) $.
verina29-longest-good-subarray-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29LongestGoodSubarray A B ) $.
verina29-extract-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29ExtractGraph A B C D ) $.
verina29-extract-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29Extract A B C ) $.
verina29-subarrays-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29SubarraysGraph A B ) $.
verina29-subarrays-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29Subarrays A ) $.
verina29-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29Count A B ) $.
verina29-freq-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29FreqWordGraph A B ) $.
verina29-freq-word-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29FreqWord A ) $.
verina29-subarray-freqs-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqsGraph A B ) $.
verina29-subarray-freqs-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A ) $.
verina29-all-at-most-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29AllAtMost A B ) $.
verina29-valid-subarrays-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29ValidSubarraysGraph A B C ) $.
verina29-valid-subarrays-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA29ValidSubarrays A B ) $.
verina29-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29Pre A B ) $.
verina29-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA29Post A B C ) $.

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verina29-window-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29WindowCount A B C D
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( B ..^ C )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = D
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verina29-window-good-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29WindowGood A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. NN0
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B <_ C
        /\
        C <_ ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( B ..^ C )
        (
          VERINA29WindowCount A B C ( A ` i )
        ) <_ D
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d q A B C D E $.

  verina29-step-left-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29StepLeft A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. NN0
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      E e. NN0
      /\
      (
        (
          0 < B
          /\
          (
            C <_ E
            /\
            E <_ D
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          D < ( # ` A )
          /\
          (
            ( VERINA29WindowGood A E ( D + 1 ) B )
            /\
            A. q e. NN0
              (
                (
                  C <_ q
                  /\
                  q < E
                )
                ->
                -. ( VERINA29WindowGood A q ( D + 1 ) B )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r l m A B C $.

  verina29-run-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29RunGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        0 < B
        /\
        C e. NN0
      )
    )
    /\
    E. l e. Word NN0
      E. m e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` l ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( # ` m ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( l ` 0 ) = 0
              /\
              ( m ` 0 ) = 0
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                (
                  VERINA29StepLeft
                    A B ( l ` r ) r ( l ` ( r + 1 ) )
                )
                /\
                (
                  m ` ( r + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  ( m ` r ) < (
                    ( r - ( l ` ( r + 1 ) ) ) + 1
                  ) ,
                  ( ( r - ( l ` ( r + 1 ) ) ) + 1 ) ,
                  ( m ` r )
                )
              )
            /\
            C = ( m ` ( # ` A ) )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina29-longest-good-subarray-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29LongestGoodSubarray A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA29RunGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verina29-extract-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29ExtractGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. Word NN0
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B <_ ( # ` A )
        /\
        C <_ ( ( # ` A ) - B )
      )
      /\
      (
        ( # ` D ) = C
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          ( D ` i ) = ( A ` ( B + i ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina29-extract-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29Extract A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA29ExtractGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j q r p A B $.

  verina29-subarrays-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29SubarraysGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ (
                  ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                B ` i
              ) = (
                VERINA29Extract
                  A
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                    <
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                      =
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                      <
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. q e. NN0
            A. r e. NN0
              (
                (
                  q <_ ( # ` A )
                  /\
                  r <_ ( ( # ` A ) - q )
                )
                ->
                E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                  ( p ` i ) = <. q , r >.
              )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina29-subarrays-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29Subarrays A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA29SubarraysGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina29-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
      |
      ( B ` i ) = A
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina29-freq-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29FreqWordGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          VERINA29Count ( A ` i ) A
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina29-freq-word-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29FreqWord A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA29FreqWordGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina29-subarray-freqs-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29SubarrayFreqsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` ( VERINA29Subarrays A ) )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          VERINA29FreqWord
            ( ( VERINA29Subarrays A ) ` i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina29-subarray-freqs-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina29-all-at-most-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29AllAtMost A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      ( A ` i ) <_ B
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p A B C $.

  verina29-valid-subarrays-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA29ValidSubarraysGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` i ) < (
                  # ` ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A )
                )
                /\
                (
                  VERINA29AllAtMost
                    ( ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A ) ` ( p ` i ) )
                    B
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                C ` i
              ) = (
                ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A ) ` ( p ` i )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. j e. (
            0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A ) )
          )
            (
              (
                VERINA29AllAtMost
                  ( ( VERINA29SubarrayFreqs A ) ` j )
                  B
              )
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = j
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_29, catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": an exact finite-
:: sequence operational graph of the positive-k precondition, hash-map
:: frequency counting, bounded sliding-window implementation, all-subarray
:: maximum-frequency postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, XXREAL_0,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of NAT,
      k,result being Nat st
    0 < k &
    (ex leftStates,maxStates being FinSequence of NAT st
      len leftStates = len nums + 1 &
      len maxStates = len nums + 1 &
      leftStates/.1 = 0 &
      maxStates/.1 = 0 &
      result = maxStates/.(len nums + 1) &
      for i being Nat st i in dom nums holds
        ex shrinkStates being FinSequence of NAT st
          len shrinkStates = len nums + 1 &
          shrinkStates/.1 = leftStates/.i &
          (for t being Nat st 1 <= t & t <= len nums holds
            ((ex x being Nat st x in rng nums &
                k < len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
                  q in dom nums &
                  shrinkStates/.t < q & q <= i &
                  nums.q = x})) &
              shrinkStates/.(t + 1) = shrinkStates/.t + 1) or
             ((for x being Nat st x in rng nums holds
                len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
                  q in dom nums &
                  shrinkStates/.t < q & q <= i &
                  nums.q = x}) <= k) &
              shrinkStates/.(t + 1) = shrinkStates/.t)) &
          leftStates/.(i + 1) =
            shrinkStates/.(len nums + 1) &
          maxStates/.i <= maxStates/.(i + 1) &
          i -' leftStates/.(i + 1) <= maxStates/.(i + 1) &
          (maxStates/.(i + 1) = maxStates/.i or
           maxStates/.(i + 1) = i -' leftStates/.(i + 1)))
  holds
    (nums = <*>NAT & result = 0) or
    (nums <> <*>NAT &
      (ex start,span being Nat st
        start <= len nums &
        span <= len nums -' start &
        result = span &
        for p being Nat st 1 <= p & p <= span holds
          len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
            q in dom nums &
            start < q & q <= start + span &
            nums.q = nums.(start + p)}) <= k) &
      for start,span being Nat st
        start <= len nums &
        span <= len nums -' start &
        (for p being Nat st 1 <= p & p <= span holds
          len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
            q in dom nums &
            start < q & q <= start + span &
            nums.q = nums.(start + p)}) <= k)
      holds span <= result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_29
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_29, catalog title "longestGoodSubarray": computing the
% longest contiguous natural-number subarray whose element frequencies are at
% most a positive bound, using the specified sliding window. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_29: THEORY
BEGIN

  frequency_map: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  window_state: TYPE =
    [# left: nat, frequencies: frequency_map #]

  longestGoodSubarray_precond(
      nums: list[nat],
      k: nat): bool =
    k > 0

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          nat_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  empty_frequency_map: frequency_map =
    LAMBDA (value: nat): 0

  frequency_get(
      value: nat,
      frequencies: frequency_map): nat =
    frequencies(value)

  frequency_insert(
      value, count: nat,
      frequencies: frequency_map): frequency_map =
    LAMBDA (query: nat):
      IF query = value THEN
        count
      ELSE
        frequencies(query)
      ENDIF

  frequency_erase(
      value: nat,
      frequencies: frequency_map): frequency_map =
    LAMBDA (query: nat):
      IF query = value THEN
        0
      ELSE
        frequencies(query)
      ENDIF

  nat_sub(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  % Every key ever inserted into the source HashMap is drawn from nums.
  % Since k is positive, testing these values is extensionally equal to
  % HashMap.toList.any after erased keys are represented by count zero.
  any_frequency_over(
      values: list[nat],
      k: nat,
      frequencies: frequency_map): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        frequency_get(head, frequencies) > k
          OR any_frequency_over(
            tail,
            k,
            frequencies)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  longestGoodSubarray_shrink_loop(
      nums: list[nat],
      k, remaining: nat,
      state: window_state): RECURSIVE window_state =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      state
    ELSIF any_frequency_over(
        nums,
        k,
        frequencies(state))
    THEN
      LET left_number: nat =
            nat_list_get_bang(left(state), nums),
          left_count: nat =
            frequency_get(
              left_number,
              frequencies(state)),
          next_frequencies: frequency_map =
            IF left_count = 1 THEN
              frequency_erase(
                left_number,
                frequencies(state))
            ELSE
              frequency_insert(
                left_number,
                nat_sub(left_count, 1),
                frequencies(state))
            ENDIF
      IN
        longestGoodSubarray_shrink_loop(
          nums,
          k,
          remaining - 1,
          (# left := left(state) + 1,
             frequencies := next_frequencies #))
    ELSE
      state
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  nat_max(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  longestGoodSubarray_outer_loop(
      nums: list[nat],
      k, right, remaining, current_max: nat,
      state: window_state): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      current_max
    ELSE
      LET number: nat =
            nat_list_get_bang(right, nums),
          count: nat =
            frequency_get(
              number,
              frequencies(state)),
          inserted_state: window_state =
            (# left := left(state),
               frequencies :=
                 frequency_insert(
                   number,
                   count + 1,
                   frequencies(state)) #),
          shrunk_state: window_state =
            longestGoodSubarray_shrink_loop(
              nums,
              k,
              nat_list_length(nums),
              inserted_state),
          next_max: nat =
            nat_max(
              current_max,
              nat_sub(right, left(shrunk_state)) + 1)
      IN
        longestGoodSubarray_outer_loop(
          nums,
          k,
          right + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          next_max,
          shrunk_state)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  longestGoodSubarray(
      nums: list[nat],
      k: nat): nat =
    longestGoodSubarray_outer_loop(
      nums,
      k,
      0,
      nat_list_length(nums),
      0,
      (# left := 0,
         frequencies := empty_frequency_map #))

  nat_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          nat_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            nat_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_list_extract(
      start, count: nat,
      values: list[nat]): list[nat] =
    nat_list_take(
      count,
      nat_list_drop(start, values))

  nat_list_count(
      requested: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = requested THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + nat_list_count(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_element_counts_at_most(
      remaining, whole: list[nat],
      k: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_count(head, whole) <= k
          AND all_element_counts_at_most(
            tail,
            whole,
            k)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  good_subarray(
      values: list[nat],
      k: nat): bool =
    all_element_counts_at_most(values, values, k)

  % The Lean range/flatMap/map construction generates exactly the extracts
  % with 0 <= start <= length and 0 <= sublength <= length - start,
  % including its empty subarrays.
  longestGoodSubarray_postcond(
      nums: list[nat],
      k, result: nat): bool =
    LET length: nat = nat_list_length(nums)
    IN
      (nums = null AND result = 0)
        OR
      (nums /= null
        AND
        (EXISTS (start, sublength: nat):
          start <= length
            AND sublength <= nat_sub(length, start)
            AND good_subarray(
              nat_list_extract(
                start,
                sublength,
                nums),
              k)
            AND sublength = result)
        AND
        (FORALL (start, sublength: nat):
          (start <= length
            AND sublength <= nat_sub(length, start)
            AND good_subarray(
              nat_list_extract(
                start,
                sublength,
                nums),
              k))
          IMPLIES
            sublength <= result))

  longestGoodSubarray_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[nat], k: nat):
      longestGoodSubarray_precond(nums, k) IMPLIES
        longestGoodSubarray_postcond(
          nums,
          k,
          longestGoodSubarray(nums, k))

END verina_advanced_29

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_3,
   catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": an executable dynamic-programming
   computation of the longest common subsequence length for two integer arrays,
   together with its exhaustive-subsequence correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence_precond
    (_a _b : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition intMax (x y : Z) : Z :=
  if Z.ltb x y then y else x.

Fixpoint lcs_set_nth {A : Type}
    (index : nat) (value : A) (xs : list A) : list A :=
  match index, xs with
  | 0%nat, _ :: rest => value :: rest
  | S index', x :: rest =>
      x :: lcs_set_nth index' value rest
  | _, [] => []
  end.

Definition lcs_get_row
    (dp : list (list Z)) (i : nat) : list Z :=
  nth i dp [].

Definition lcs_get_cell
    (dp : list (list Z)) (i j : nat) : Z :=
  nth j (lcs_get_row dp i) 0.

Definition lcs_update_cell
    (a b : list Z)
    (i j : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  if orb (Nat.eqb i 0%nat) (Nat.eqb j 0%nat)
  then dp
  else
    let ai := nth (Nat.pred i) a 0 in
    let bj := nth (Nat.pred j) b 0 in
    let newVal :=
      if Z.eqb ai bj
      then lcs_get_cell dp (Nat.pred i) (Nat.pred j) + 1
      else
        intMax
          (lcs_get_cell dp (Nat.pred i) j)
          (lcs_get_cell dp i (Nat.pred j)) in
    let row := lcs_get_row dp i in
    lcs_set_nth i (lcs_set_nth j newVal row) dp.

Fixpoint lcs_run_columns
    (a b : list Z)
    (i remaining j : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  match remaining with
  | 0%nat => dp
  | S remaining' =>
      lcs_run_columns
        a b i remaining' (S j)
        (lcs_update_cell a b i j dp)
  end.

Fixpoint lcs_run_rows
    (a b : list Z)
    (column_count remaining i : nat)
    (dp : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  match remaining with
  | 0%nat => dp
  | S remaining' =>
      let dp' := lcs_run_columns a b i column_count 0%nat dp in
      lcs_run_rows
        a b column_count remaining' (S i) dp'
  end.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence
    (a b : list Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) : Z :=
  let m := length a in
  let n := length b in
  let dp0 := repeat (repeat 0 (S n)) (S m) in
  let dp :=
    lcs_run_rows a b (S n) (S m) 0%nat dp0 in
  lcs_get_cell dp m n.

Definition lcs_allSubseq (arr : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  map
    (fun sub : list Z => rev sub)
    (fold_left
      (fun acc x =>
        acc ++ map (fun sub => x :: sub) acc)
      arr [[]]).

Fixpoint lcs_list_Z_eqb
    (xs ys : list Z) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (Z.eqb x y) (lcs_list_Z_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition lcs_contains_subsequence
    (needle : list Z) (haystack : list (list Z)) : bool :=
  existsb (fun candidate => lcs_list_Z_eqb candidate needle) haystack.

Definition lcs_contains_length
    (needle : Z) (haystack : list Z) : bool :=
  existsb (fun candidate => Z.eqb candidate needle) haystack.

Definition LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
    (a b : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) : Prop :=
  let subseqA := lcs_allSubseq a in
  let subseqB := lcs_allSubseq b in
  let commonSubseqLens :=
    map
      (fun sub : list Z => Z.of_nat (length sub))
      (filter
        (fun sub => lcs_contains_subsequence sub subseqB)
        subseqA) in
  lcs_contains_length result commonSubseqLens = true /\
  forallb (fun candidate => Z.leb candidate result) commonSubseqLens = true.

Theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied
    (a b : list Z)
    (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) :
  LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
    a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_3,
  catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": an executable row-major dynamic
  program computes the longest common subsequence length of two integer
  sequences, with its precondition and subsequence-maximality postcondition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_3
  imports Main
begin

definition LongestCommonSubsequence_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition intMax :: "int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "intMax x y = (if x < y then y else x)"

definition list_getBang :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "list_getBang dflt xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else dflt)"

definition list_setBang :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

definition lcs_get :: "int list list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "lcs_get dp i j =
    list_getBang 0 (list_getBang [] dp i) j"

definition lcs_set ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_set dp i j value =
    list_setBang dp i
      (list_setBang (list_getBang [] dp i) j value)"

definition lcs_cell ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int list list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_cell a b i j dp =
    (if i = 0 \<or> j = 0 then dp
     else if list_getBang 0 a (i - 1) = list_getBang 0 b (j - 1)
     then lcs_set dp i j (lcs_get dp (i - 1) (j - 1) + 1)
     else lcs_set dp i j
       (intMax (lcs_get dp (i - 1) j) (lcs_get dp i (j - 1))))"

definition lcs_row ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int list list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "lcs_row a b i dp =
    foldl (\<lambda>table j. lcs_cell a b i j table)
      dp [0..<length b + 1]"

definition LongestCommonSubsequence ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence a b =
    (let initial =
       replicate (length a + 1) (replicate (length b + 1) 0);
         dp =
       foldl (\<lambda>table i. lcs_row a b i table)
         initial [0..<length a + 1]
     in lcs_get dp (length a) (length b))"

definition allSubseq :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "allSubseq arr =
    map rev
      (foldl
        (\<lambda>acc x. acc @ map (\<lambda>sub. x # sub) acc)
        [[]] arr)"

definition LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond a b result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subseqA = allSubseq a;
         subseqB = allSubseq b;
         commonSubseqLens =
           map (\<lambda>l. int (length l))
             (filter (\<lambda>l. l \<in> set subseqB) subseqA)
     in result \<in> set commonSubseqLens \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>k. k \<le> result) commonSubseqLens)"

theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b"
  shows
    "LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
      a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b)"
  sorry

end

(*
