  no proof.
*)

let LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt n (TL xs))`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!rows:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow 0 rows =
        if rows = [] then [] else HD rows) /\
     (!n:num. !rows:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow (SUC n) rows =
        if rows = [] then []
        else LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow n (TL rows))`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_setInt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!value:int. !xs:int list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_setInt 0 value xs =
        if xs = [] then [] else CONS value (TL xs)) /\
     (!n:num. !value:int. !xs:int list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_setInt (SUC n) value xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else CONS (HD xs)
          (LongestCommonSubsequence_setInt n value (TL xs)))`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_setRow =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!row:int list. !rows:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_setRow 0 row rows =
        if rows = [] then [] else CONS row (TL rows)) /\
     (!n:num. !row:int list. !rows:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_setRow (SUC n) row rows =
        if rows = [] then []
        else CONS (HD rows)
          (LongestCommonSubsequence_setRow n row (TL rows)))`;;

let intMax = new_definition
  `intMax (x:int) (y:int) = if x < y then y else x`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRow =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !j:num. !x:int. !dp:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRow i j x [] dp = dp) /\
     (!y:int. !ys:int list. !i:num. !j:num. !x:int.
      !dp:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRow
          i j x (CONS y ys) dp =
        let previousRow =
          LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow (i - 1) dp in
        let currentRow =
          LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow i dp in
        let newVal =
          if x = y then
            LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt (j - 1) previousRow + &1
          else
            intMax
              (LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt j previousRow)
              (LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt (j - 1) currentRow) in
        let updatedRow =
          LongestCommonSubsequence_setInt j newVal currentRow in
        let updatedDp =
          LongestCommonSubsequence_setRow i updatedRow dp in
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRow
          i (SUC j) x ys updatedDp)`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRows =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !b:int list. !dp:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRows i [] b dp = dp) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !i:num. !b:int list.
      !dp:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRows
          i (CONS x xs) b dp =
        let updatedDp =
          LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRow i 1 x b dp in
        LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRows
          (SUC i) xs b updatedDp)`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_precond = new_definition
  `LongestCommonSubsequence_precond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) <=> T`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence = new_definition
  `LongestCommonSubsequence (a:int list) (b:int list) =
     let initialRow =
       REPLICATE (LENGTH b + 1) (&0:int) in
     let initialDp =
       REPLICATE (LENGTH a + 1) initialRow in
     let finalDp =
       LongestCommonSubsequence_fillRows 1 a b initialDp in
     LongestCommonSubsequence_getInt
       (LENGTH b)
       (LongestCommonSubsequence_getRow (LENGTH a) finalDp)`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_subseqFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_subseqFold [] acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:(int list)list.
        LongestCommonSubsequence_subseqFold (CONS x xs) acc =
        LongestCommonSubsequence_subseqFold
          xs
          (APPEND acc
            (MAP (\sub:int list. CONS x sub) acc)))`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_allSubseq = new_definition
  `LongestCommonSubsequence_allSubseq (arr:int list) =
     MAP REVERSE
       (LongestCommonSubsequence_subseqFold
         arr (CONS ([]:int list) []))`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond = new_definition
  `LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let subseqA =
       LongestCommonSubsequence_allSubseq a in
     let subseqB =
       LongestCommonSubsequence_allSubseq b in
     let commonSubseqLens =
       MAP
         (\sub:int list. &(LENGTH sub))
         (FILTER (\sub:int list. MEM sub subseqB) subseqA) in
     MEM result commonSubseqLens /\
     ALL (\k:int. k <= result) commonSubseqLens`;;

let LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !b:int list.
     LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b
     ==> LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
           a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b)`;;

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_3,
;; "LongestCommonSubsequence": a row-by-row dynamic program computes the
;; maximum length among the common subsequences of two integer arrays.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-3-integer-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-3-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True; the Array Int domains are explicit in the
;; final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence-precond (a b)
  (declare (ignore a b))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-3-int-max (x y)
  (if (< x y) y x))

;; An Array is represented by its element list. The zero row has one entry
;; for column zero and one for every element of b.

(defun verina-advanced-3-zero-row (b)
  (if (consp b)
      (cons 0 (verina-advanced-3-zero-row (cdr b)))
    (list 0)))

;; PREVIOUS-TAIL begins at the previous row's entry for the column immediately
;; left of the current cell. Thus its first two entries are the diagonal and
;; upper neighbors, while LEFT is the already-updated current-row neighbor.
;; This is exactly the source's increasing-j inner loop.

(defun verina-advanced-3-build-row-aux
    (a-element remaining-b previous-tail left)
  (if (consp remaining-b)
      (let* ((diagonal (car previous-tail))
             (upper (car (cdr previous-tail)))
             (new-value
              (if (equal a-element (car remaining-b))
                  (+ diagonal 1)
                (verina-advanced-3-int-max upper left))))
        (cons
         new-value
         (verina-advanced-3-build-row-aux
          a-element
          (cdr remaining-b)
          (cdr previous-tail)
          new-value)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-3-build-row
    (a-element b previous-row)
  (cons
   0
   (verina-advanced-3-build-row-aux
    a-element b previous-row 0)))

;; Folding over a in order reproduces the source's increasing-i outer loop.

(defun verina-advanced-3-fold-dp-rows
    (remaining-a b previous-row)
  (if (consp remaining-a)
      (verina-advanced-3-fold-dp-rows
       (cdr remaining-a)
       b
       (verina-advanced-3-build-row
        (car remaining-a) b previous-row))
    previous-row))

(defun verina-advanced-3-last-value (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (consp (cdr xs))
          (verina-advanced-3-last-value (cdr xs))
        (car xs))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence (a b)
  (verina-advanced-3-last-value
   (verina-advanced-3-fold-dp-rows
    a b (verina-advanced-3-zero-row b))))

;; The following definitions reproduce the postcondition's local allSubseq
;; function. For each array element x, the fold appends to ACC a copy of ACC
;; with x prepended to every subsequence, then reverses every final subsequence.

(defun verina-advanced-3-prepend-to-each (x subsequences)
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (cons x (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-3-prepend-to-each
        x (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-3-all-subseq-fold
    (remaining-array accumulator)
  (if (consp remaining-array)
      (verina-advanced-3-all-subseq-fold
       (cdr remaining-array)
       (append
        accumulator
        (verina-advanced-3-prepend-to-each
         (car remaining-array) accumulator)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-3-reverse-each (subsequences)
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (reverse (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-3-reverse-each
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-3-all-subseq (array)
  (verina-advanced-3-reverse-each
   (verina-advanced-3-all-subseq-fold
    array (list nil))))

(defun verina-advanced-3-common-subseq
    (subsequences-a subsequences-b)
  (if (consp subsequences-a)
      (if (member-equal (car subsequences-a) subsequences-b)
          (cons
           (car subsequences-a)
           (verina-advanced-3-common-subseq
            (cdr subsequences-a) subsequences-b))
        (verina-advanced-3-common-subseq
         (cdr subsequences-a) subsequences-b))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-3-subseq-lengths (subsequences)
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (len (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-3-subseq-lengths
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-3-all-lengths-at-most-p
    (lengths result)
  (if (consp lengths)
      (and
       (<= (car lengths) result)
       (verina-advanced-3-all-lengths-at-most-p
        (cdr lengths) result))
    (equal lengths nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence-postcond
    (a b result)
  (let* ((subseq-a
          (verina-advanced-3-all-subseq a))
         (subseq-b
          (verina-advanced-3-all-subseq b))
         (common-subseq-lengths
          (verina-advanced-3-subseq-lengths
           (verina-advanced-3-common-subseq
            subseq-a subseq-b))))
    (and
     (integerp result)
     (if (member-equal result common-subseq-lengths)
         t
       nil)
     (verina-advanced-3-all-lengths-at-most-p
      common-subseq-lengths result))))

(defun
    verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence-spec-satisfied-statement
    (a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-3-integer-listp a)
    (verina-advanced-3-integer-listp b)
    (verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence-precond
     a b))
   (verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence-postcond
    a
    b
    (verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_3,
-- catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": a deterministic dynamic-programming
-- program computes the length of a longest common subsequence of two integer arrays.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _||_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y then y else x

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize = listLength

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

repeatList : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A
repeatList zero value = []
repeatList (suc n) value = value ∷ repeatList n value

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

setNth : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A → List A
setNth zero value [] = []
setNth zero value (_ ∷ xs) = value ∷ xs
setNth (suc n) value [] = []
setNth (suc n) value (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ setNth n value xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

predecessor : Nat → Nat
predecessor zero = zero
predecessor (suc n) = n

Matrix : Set
Matrix = List (List Int)

getCell : Matrix → Nat → Nat → Int
getCell matrix i j =
  nthDefault zeroInt j (nthDefault [] i matrix)

setCell : Nat → Nat → Int → Matrix → Matrix
setCell i j value matrix =
  let row = nthDefault [] i matrix
  in setNth i (setNth j value row) matrix

initialMatrix : Nat → Nat → Matrix
initialMatrix rowCount columnCount =
  repeatList rowCount (repeatList columnCount zeroInt)

updateCell :
  Array Int →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Matrix →
  Nat →
  Matrix
updateCell a b i matrix j =
  if natEqual i zero || natEqual j zero
  then matrix
  else
    let iPrev = predecessor i
        jPrev = predecessor j
        aValue = nthDefault zeroInt iPrev a
        bValue = nthDefault zeroInt jPrev b
        newValue =
          if intEqual aValue bValue
          then intSuccessor (getCell matrix iPrev jPrev)
          else
            intMax
              (getCell matrix iPrev j)
              (getCell matrix i jPrev)
    in setCell i j newValue matrix

updateRow :
  Array Int →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Matrix →
  Nat →
  Matrix
updateRow a b columnCount matrix i =
  foldLeft
    (updateCell a b i)
    matrix
    (range columnCount)

buildMatrix : Array Int → Array Int → Matrix
buildMatrix a b =
  let rowCount = suc (arraySize a)
      columnCount = suc (arraySize b)
      initial = initialMatrix rowCount columnCount
  in
    foldLeft
      (updateRow a b columnCount)
      initial
      (range rowCount)

LongestCommonSubsequence-precond :
  Array Int → Array Int → Set
LongestCommonSubsequence-precond a b = Top

LongestCommonSubsequence :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  LongestCommonSubsequence-precond a b →
  Int
LongestCommonSubsequence a b h-precond =
  getCell
    (buildMatrix a b)
    (arraySize a)
    (arraySize b)

allSubseqStep :
  List (List Int) → Int → List (List Int)
allSubseqStep accumulator x =
  appendList
    accumulator
    (mapList (λ subsequence → x ∷ subsequence) accumulator)

allSubseq : Array Int → List (List Int)
allSubseq array =
  mapList
    reverseList
    (foldLeft allSubseqStep ([] ∷ []) array)

listIntEqual : List Int → List Int → Bool
listIntEqual [] [] = true
listIntEqual [] (_ ∷ _) = false
listIntEqual (_ ∷ _) [] = false
listIntEqual (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  if intEqual x y
  then listIntEqual xs ys
  else false

containsIntList : List Int → List (List Int) → Bool
containsIntList sought [] = false
containsIntList sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if listIntEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsIntList sought xs

intLength : List Int → Int
intLength xs = pos (listLength xs)

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

allAtMost : Int → List Int → Bool
allAtMost bound [] = true
allAtMost bound (x ∷ xs) =
  if intLessOrEqual x bound
  then allAtMost bound xs
  else false

commonSubsequenceLengths :
  Array Int → Array Int → List Int
commonSubsequenceLengths a b =
  let subseqA = allSubseq a
      subseqB = allSubseq b
  in
    mapList
      intLength
      (filterList
        (λ subsequence → containsIntList subsequence subseqB)
        subseqA)

LongestCommonSubsequence-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  LongestCommonSubsequence-precond a b →
  Set
LongestCommonSubsequence-postcond a b result h-precond =
  let lengths = commonSubsequenceLengths a b
  in
    IsTrue (containsInt result lengths) ∧
    IsTrue (allAtMost result lengths)

LongestCommonSubsequence-spec-satisfied : Set
LongestCommonSubsequence-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : LongestCommonSubsequence-precond a b) →
  LongestCommonSubsequence-postcond
    a
    b
    (LongestCommonSubsequence a b h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_3,
  cataloged as "LongestCommonSubsequence": the dynamic-programming program
  returns the greatest length among common subsequences of two integer arrays.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val LongestCommonSubsequence_precond_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_precond_def",
  ``LongestCommonSubsequence_precond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) <=> T``
);

val intMax_def = new_definition (
  "intMax_def",
  ``intMax (x : int) (y : int) =
      if x < y then y else x``
);

val lcs_initial_table_def = new_definition (
  "lcs_initial_table_def",
  ``lcs_initial_table (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      GENLIST
        (\i. GENLIST (\j. (0 : int)) (LENGTH b + 1))
        (LENGTH a + 1)``
);

val lcs_update_cell_def = new_definition (
  "lcs_update_cell_def",
  ``lcs_update_cell
      (a : int list)
      (b : int list)
      (i : num)
      (j : num)
      (dp : int list list) =
      if i = 0 \/ j = 0 then
        dp
      else if EL (i - 1) a = EL (j - 1) b then
        let newVal = EL (j - 1) (EL (i - 1) dp) + 1
        in
          LUPDATE (LUPDATE newVal j (EL i dp)) i dp
      else
        let newVal =
          intMax
            (EL j (EL (i - 1) dp))
            (EL (j - 1) (EL i dp))
        in
          LUPDATE (LUPDATE newVal j (EL i dp)) i dp``
);

val lcs_process_row_def = new_definition (
  "lcs_process_row_def",
  ``lcs_process_row
      (a : int list)
      (b : int list)
      (dp : int list list)
      (i : num) =
      FOLDL
        (\table j. lcs_update_cell a b i j table)
        dp
        (GENLIST (\j. j) (LENGTH b + 1))``
);

val lcs_table_def = new_definition (
  "lcs_table_def",
  ``lcs_table (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      FOLDL
        (lcs_process_row a b)
        (lcs_initial_table a b)
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH a + 1))``
);

val LongestCommonSubsequence_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_def",
  ``LongestCommonSubsequence (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      EL (LENGTH b) (EL (LENGTH a) (lcs_table a b))``
);

val allSubseq_def = new_definition (
  "allSubseq_def",
  ``allSubseq (arr : int list) =
      MAP REVERSE
        (FOLDL
          (\acc x. acc ++ MAP (\s. x::s) acc)
          ([[]] : int list list)
          arr)``
);

val commonSubseqLens_def = new_definition (
  "commonSubseqLens_def",
  ``commonSubseqLens (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      MAP
        (\s. int_of_num (LENGTH s))
        (FILTER
          (\s : int list. MEM s (allSubseq b))
          (allSubseq a))``
);

val LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond_def",
  ``LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) (result : int) <=>
      MEM result (commonSubseqLens a b) /\
      EVERY
        (\len : int. len <= result)
        (commonSubseqLens a b)``
);

val LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (b : int list).
      LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b ==>
      LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
        a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_3 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_3), catalog title LongestCommonSubsequence: an executable
  dynamic-programming computation returns the maximum length of a common
  subsequence of two arbitrary finite integer arrays. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer arrays, viewed extensionally as zero-indexed
  words. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA3IntMax is the source intMax helper. VERINA3BitSet and
  VERINA3MaskWordGraph give a closed form for the source allSubseq fold:
  mask r selects precisely the input positions whose bits are one, in
  increasing position order. The masks occur in numeric order, so
  VERINA3AllSubseq is exactly the ordered, duplicate-preserving result of
  repeatedly appending acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub) and then reversing every
  sublist. VERINA3CommonLens is exactly the source filter by membership in
  the second subsequence word followed by the integer-valued length map.

  VERINA3DPGraph characterizes the complete rectangular table produced by
  the nested source loops. Its zero row and column remain initialized to
  zero; every other entry uses the diagonal-plus-one branch on equal input
  entries and VERINA3IntMax of the upper and left entries otherwise.
  These dependencies follow the source's row-major update order and uniquely
  determine the same table on every pair of typed inputs. VERINA3DP selects
  that unique table, and VERINA3LongestCommonSubsequence reads its final
  entry. Thus the target function preserves the executable implementation,
  rather than choosing an output from the postcondition.

  VERINA3Pre is the source True precondition together with the two Array Int
  input types. VERINA3Post reproduces contains and all on the exact common
  subsequence-length word. The proof-valued precondition argument is
  computationally unused and is omitted from the target function. The final
  $a declaration is the source correctness proposition; every earlier $a is
  syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA3IntMax
  VERINA3BitSet
  VERINA3MaskWordGraph
  VERINA3AllSubseqGraph VERINA3AllSubseq
  VERINA3CommonLensGraph VERINA3CommonLens
  VERINA3DPGraph VERINA3DP
  VERINA3Pre VERINA3LongestCommonSubsequence VERINA3Post
$.

verina3-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA3IntMax A B ) $.
verina3-bit-set-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3BitSet A B ) $.
verina3-mask-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3MaskWordGraph A B C ) $.
verina3-all-subseq-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3AllSubseqGraph A B ) $.
verina3-all-subseq-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA3AllSubseq A ) $.
verina3-common-lens-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3CommonLensGraph A B C ) $.
verina3-common-lens-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA3CommonLens A B ) $.
verina3-dp-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3DPGraph A B C ) $.
verina3-dp-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA3DP A B ) $.
verina3-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3Pre A B ) $.
verina3-longest-common-subsequence-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA3LongestCommonSubsequence A B ) $.
verina3-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA3Post A B C ) $.

verina3-int-max-definition $a |- (
  VERINA3IntMax A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  B ,
  A
) $.

verina3-bit-set-definition $a |- (
  VERINA3BitSet A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2
  ) = 1
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina3-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3MaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( VERINA3BitSet B k )
              <->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B $.

  verina3-all-subseq-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3AllSubseqGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )
      /\
      A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          VERINA3MaskWordGraph
            A
            r
            ( B ` r )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina3-all-subseq-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3AllSubseq A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA3AllSubseqGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina3-common-lens-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3CommonLensGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` i )
                <
                ( # ` ( VERINA3AllSubseq A ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( VERINA3AllSubseq A )
                  ` ( p ` i )
                ) e. ran ( VERINA3AllSubseq B )
                /\
                (
                  C ` i
                ) = (
                  # ` (
                    ( VERINA3AllSubseq A )
                    ` ( p ` i )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. (
            0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA3AllSubseq A ) )
          )
            (
              (
                ( VERINA3AllSubseq A )
                ` k
              ) e. ran ( VERINA3AllSubseq B )
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina3-common-lens-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3CommonLens A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA3CommonLensGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina3-dp-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3DPGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
          (
            # ` ( C ` i )
          ) = (
            ( # ` B ) + 1
          )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( C ` i ) ) )
          (
            ( ( C ` i ) ` j )
          ) = if (
            (
              i = 0
              \/
              j = 0
            ) ,
            0 ,
            if (
              (
                A ` ( i - 1 )
              ) = (
                B ` ( j - 1 )
              ) ,
              (
                (
                  C ` ( i - 1 )
                ) ` ( j - 1 )
              ) + 1 ,
              VERINA3IntMax
                (
                  ( C ` ( i - 1 ) )
                  ` j
                )
                (
                  ( C ` i )
                  ` ( j - 1 )
                )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina3-dp-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3DP A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA3DPGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina3-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA3Pre A B
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  B e. Word ZZ
) $.

verina3-longest-common-subsequence-definition $a |- (
  VERINA3LongestCommonSubsequence A B
) = (
  (
    VERINA3DP A B
  ) ` ( # ` A )
) ` ( # ` B ) $.

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina3-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA3Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      C e. ran ( VERINA3CommonLens A B )
      /\
      A. k e. (
        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA3CommonLens A B ) )
      )
        (
          ( VERINA3CommonLens A B ) ` k
        ) <_ C
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-3-longest-common-subsequence
  $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
    A. b e. Word ZZ
      (
        ( VERINA3Pre a b )
        ->
        (
          VERINA3Post
            a
            b
            ( VERINA3LongestCommonSubsequence a b )
        )
      )
  $.

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_3, catalog title "LongestCommonSubsequence": an exact
:: flattened-table encoding of the unconditional precondition, row-major
:: dynamic-programming implementation and intMax helper, subsequence
:: enumeration postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex dp being FinSequence of INT st
      len dp = (len a + 1) * (len b + 1) &
      (for i,j being Nat st i <= len a & j <= len b holds
        ((i = 0 or j = 0) &
          dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j + 1) = 0) or
        (i > 0 & j > 0 & a/.i = b/.j &
          dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j + 1) =
            dp/.((i - 1) * (len b + 1) + j) + 1) or
        (i > 0 & j > 0 & a/.i <> b/.j &
          ((dp/.((i - 1) * (len b + 1) + j + 1) <
              dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j) &
            dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j + 1) =
              dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j)) or
           (not dp/.((i - 1) * (len b + 1) + j + 1) <
                dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j) &
            dp/.(i * (len b + 1) + j + 1) =
              dp/.((i - 1) * (len b + 1) + j + 1))))) &
      result = dp/.(len a * (len b + 1) + len b + 1))
  holds
    (ex common being FinSequence of INT st
      result = len common &
      (ex positionsA being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positionsA = len common &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positionsA holds
          positionsA/.k in dom a &
          common/.k = a/.(positionsA/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positionsA & h in dom positionsA & k < h
        holds positionsA/.k < positionsA/.h) &
      (ex positionsB being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positionsB = len common &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positionsB holds
          positionsB/.k in dom b &
          common/.k = b/.(positionsB/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positionsB & h in dom positionsB & k < h
        holds positionsB/.k < positionsB/.h)) &
    (for common being FinSequence of INT st
      (ex positionsA being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positionsA = len common &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positionsA holds
          positionsA/.k in dom a &
          common/.k = a/.(positionsA/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positionsA & h in dom positionsA & k < h
        holds positionsA/.k < positionsA/.h) &
      (ex positionsB being FinSequence of NAT st
        len positionsB = len common &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom positionsB holds
          positionsB/.k in dom b &
          common/.k = b/.(positionsB/.k)) &
        for k,h being Nat st
          k in dom positionsB & h in dom positionsB & k < h
        holds positionsB/.k < positionsB/.h)
    holds len common <= result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_3, "LongestCommonSubsequence": row-major dynamic programming
% computes a longest-common-subsequence length for two finite integer arrays,
% specified by exhaustive subsequence enumeration. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_3: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists give the exact extensional contents and order of the Lean
  % arrays observed by this program.
  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  repeat_int(
      value: int,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(value, repeat_int(value, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  repeat_row(
      row: list[int],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(row, repeat_row(row, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  zero_matrix(rows, columns: nat): list[list[int]] =
    repeat_row(repeat_int(0, columns), rows)

  int_list_nth_default(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_nth_default(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_set_if_in_bounds(
      index: nat,
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_set_if_in_bounds(
              index - 1,
              value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  matrix_row_default(
      index: nat,
      matrix: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES matrix OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(row, rest):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          row
        ELSE
          matrix_row_default(index - 1, rest)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE matrix BY <<

  matrix_set_row_if_in_bounds(
      index: nat,
      row: list[int],
      matrix: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES matrix OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(row, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            matrix_set_row_if_in_bounds(
              index - 1,
              row,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE matrix BY <<

  matrix_cell(
      row_index, column_index: nat,
      matrix: list[list[int]]): int =
    int_list_nth_default(
      column_index,
      matrix_row_default(row_index, matrix))

  matrix_set_cell_if_in_bounds(
      row_index, column_index: nat,
      value: int,
      matrix: list[list[int]]): list[list[int]] =
    LET old_row: list[int] =
          matrix_row_default(row_index, matrix),
        new_row: list[int] =
          int_list_set_if_in_bounds(
            column_index,
            value,
            old_row)
    IN
      matrix_set_row_if_in_bounds(
        row_index,
        new_row,
        matrix)

  intMax(x, y: int): int =
    IF x < y THEN y ELSE x ENDIF

  LongestCommonSubsequence_precond(
      a, b: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  lcs_update_cell(
      a, b: list[int],
      i, j: nat,
      dp: list[list[int]]): list[list[int]] =
    IF i = 0 OR j = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET a_value: int =
            int_list_nth_default(i - 1, a),
          b_value: int =
            int_list_nth_default(j - 1, b),
          new_value: int =
            IF a_value = b_value THEN
              matrix_cell(i - 1, j - 1, dp) + 1
            ELSE
              intMax(
                matrix_cell(i - 1, j, dp),
                matrix_cell(i, j - 1, dp))
            ENDIF
      IN
        matrix_set_cell_if_in_bounds(
          i,
          j,
          new_value,
          dp)
    ENDIF

  lcs_columns(
      a, b: list[int],
      i, j, remaining_columns: nat,
      dp: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    IF remaining_columns = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET updated: list[list[int]] =
        lcs_update_cell(a, b, i, j, dp)
      IN
        lcs_columns(
          a,
          b,
          i,
          j + 1,
          remaining_columns - 1,
          updated)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_columns

  lcs_rows(
      a, b: list[int],
      i, remaining_rows, column_count: nat,
      dp: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    IF remaining_rows = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET after_row: list[list[int]] =
        lcs_columns(
          a,
          b,
          i,
          0,
          column_count,
          dp)
      IN
        lcs_rows(
          a,
          b,
          i + 1,
          remaining_rows - 1,
          column_count,
          after_row)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_rows

  LongestCommonSubsequence(
      a, b: list[int]): int =
    LET m: nat = int_list_length(a),
        n: nat = int_list_length(b),
        initial_dp: list[list[int]] =
          zero_matrix(m + 1, n + 1),
        final_dp: list[list[int]] =
          lcs_rows(
            a,
            b,
            0,
            m + 1,
            n + 1,
            initial_dp)
    IN
      matrix_cell(m, n, final_dp)

  append_subsequence_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_subsequence_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_to_each(
      value: int,
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(value, head),
          prepend_to_each(value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  allSubseq_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      accumulator: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(value, rest):
        allSubseq_fold(
          rest,
          append_subsequence_lists(
            accumulator,
            prepend_to_each(value, accumulator)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null)

  reverse_each(
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          reverse_int_list(head),
          reverse_each(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  allSubseq(values: list[int]): list[list[int]] =
    reverse_each(
      allSubseq_fold(
        values,
        cons(null[int], null[list[int]])))

  subsequence_member(
      candidate: list[int],
      subsequences: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        candidate = head
          OR subsequence_member(candidate, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  commonSubseqLens_from(
      subsequences_a, subsequences_b: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES subsequences_a OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF subsequence_member(head, subsequences_b) THEN
          cons(
            int_list_length(head),
            commonSubseqLens_from(tail, subsequences_b))
        ELSE
          commonSubseqLens_from(tail, subsequences_b)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences_a BY <<

  int_member(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR int_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_at_most(
      upper_bound: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND all_at_most(upper_bound, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond(
      a, b: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET subseqA: list[list[int]] = allSubseq(a),
        subseqB: list[list[int]] = allSubseq(b),
        commonSubseqLens: list[int] =
          commonSubseqLens_from(subseqA, subseqB)
    IN
      int_member(result, commonSubseqLens)
        AND all_at_most(result, commonSubseqLens)

  LongestCommonSubsequence_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: list[int]):
      LongestCommonSubsequence_precond(a, b) IMPLIES
        LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond(
          a,
          b,
          LongestCommonSubsequence(a, b))

END verina_advanced_3

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_30,
   catalog title "longestIncreasingStreak": an executable scan computing the
   longest strictly increasing contiguous streak in an integer list, together
   with its exact-streak and maximality contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition longestIncreasingStreak_precond
    (_nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint longestIncreasingStreak_aux
    (lst : list Z)
    (prev : option Z)
    (currLen maxLen : nat) : nat :=
  match lst with
  | [] => Nat.max currLen maxLen
  | x :: xs =>
      match prev with
      | None =>
          longestIncreasingStreak_aux
            xs (Some x) 1%nat (Nat.max 1%nat maxLen)
      | Some p =>
          if Z.gtb x p
          then
            longestIncreasingStreak_aux
              xs (Some x) (currLen + 1) (Nat.max (currLen + 1) maxLen)
          else
            longestIncreasingStreak_aux
              xs (Some x) 1%nat (Nat.max currLen maxLen)
      end
  end.

Definition longestIncreasingStreak
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums) : nat :=
  longestIncreasingStreak_aux nums None 0%nat 0%nat.

Definition longestIncreasingStreak_get
    (nums : list Z) (index : nat) : Z :=
  nth index nums 0%Z.

Definition longestIncreasingStreak_exact_streak
    (nums : list Z)
    (result start : nat) : bool :=
  andb
    (Nat.leb (start + result) (length nums))
    (andb
      (forallb
        (fun i =>
          Z.ltb
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums (start + i))
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums (start + i + 1)))
        (seq 0%nat (result - 1)))
      (andb
        (orb
          (Nat.eqb start 0%nat)
          (Z.geb
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums (start - 1))
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums start)))
        (orb
          (Nat.eqb (start + result) (length nums))
          (Z.geb
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get
              nums (start + result - 1))
            (longestIncreasingStreak_get
              nums (start + result)))))).

Definition longestIncreasingStreak_has_break
    (nums : list Z)
    (result start : nat) : bool :=
  existsb
    (fun i =>
      orb
        (Nat.leb (length nums) (start + i + 1))
        (Z.geb
          (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums (start + i))
          (longestIncreasingStreak_get nums (start + i + 1))))
    (seq 0%nat result).

Definition longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums) : Prop :=
  (nums = [] -> result = 0%nat) /\
  ((0 < result)%nat ->
    existsb
      (longestIncreasingStreak_exact_streak nums result)
      (seq 0%nat (length nums - result + 1)) = true) /\
  forallb
    (longestIncreasingStreak_has_break nums result)
    (seq 0%nat (length nums - result)) = true.

Theorem longestIncreasingStreak_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums) :
  longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
    nums
    (longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_30,
  catalog title "longestIncreasingStreak": an executable accumulator-based
  scan computes the longest strictly increasing contiguous streak in an
  integer list, together with its complete maximality contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_30
  imports Main
begin

definition longestIncreasingStreak_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun longestIncreasingStreak_aux ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int option \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "longestIncreasingStreak_aux [] prev currLen maxLen =
    max currLen maxLen"
| "longestIncreasingStreak_aux (x # xs) None currLen maxLen =
    longestIncreasingStreak_aux xs (Some x) 1 (max 1 maxLen)"
| "longestIncreasingStreak_aux (x # xs) (Some p) currLen maxLen =
    (if x > p
     then
       longestIncreasingStreak_aux
         xs (Some x) (currLen + 1) (max (currLen + 1) maxLen)
     else
       longestIncreasingStreak_aux
         xs (Some x) 1 (max currLen maxLen))"

definition longestIncreasingStreak :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "longestIncreasingStreak nums =
    longestIncreasingStreak_aux nums None 0 0"

definition longestIncreasingStreak_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums i =
    (if i < length nums then nums ! i else 0)"

definition longestIncreasingStreak_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "longestIncreasingStreak_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (nums = [] \<longrightarrow> result = 0) \<and>
    (result > 0 \<longrightarrow>
      list_ex
        (\<lambda>start.
          start + result \<le> length nums \<and>
          list_all
            (\<lambda>i.
              longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + i) <
              longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + i + 1))
            [0..<(result - 1)] \<and>
          (start = 0 \<or>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start - 1) \<ge>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums start) \<and>
          (start + result = length nums \<or>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + result - 1) \<ge>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + result)))
        [0..<(length nums - result + 1)]) \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>start.
        list_ex
          (\<lambda>i.
            start + i + 1 \<ge> length nums \<or>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + i) \<ge>
            longestIncreasingStreak_getBang nums (start + i + 1))
          [0..<result])
      [0..<(length nums - result)]"

theorem longestIncreasingStreak_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums"
  shows
    "longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
      nums (longestIncreasingStreak nums)"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_30,
  catalog title "longestIncreasingStreak": an executable recursive scan
  computes the maximum length of a strictly increasing contiguous streak in
  an integer list, with its boundary and maximality postcondition. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let longestIncreasingStreak_precond = new_definition
  `longestIncreasingStreak_precond (nums:int list) <=> T`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_optionValue = new_definition
  `longestIncreasingStreak_optionValue (value:int option) =
     @x:int. value = SOME x`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_aux =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!prev:int option. !currLen:num. !maxLen:num.
        longestIncreasingStreak_aux
          ([]:int list) prev currLen maxLen =
        if currLen >= maxLen then currLen else maxLen) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !prev:int option.
      !currLen:num. !maxLen:num.
        longestIncreasingStreak_aux
          (CONS x xs) prev currLen maxLen =
        if prev = NONE then
          longestIncreasingStreak_aux
            xs (SOME x) 1
            (if 1 >= maxLen then 1 else maxLen)
        else
          let p =
            longestIncreasingStreak_optionValue prev in
          if x > p then
            let nextLen = currLen + 1 in
            longestIncreasingStreak_aux
              xs (SOME x) nextLen
              (if nextLen >= maxLen
               then nextLen
               else maxLen)
          else
            longestIncreasingStreak_aux
              xs (SOME x) 1
              (if currLen >= maxLen
               then currLen
               else maxLen))`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak = new_definition
  `longestIncreasingStreak (nums:int list) =
     longestIncreasingStreak_aux nums NONE 0 0`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(longestIncreasingStreak_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        longestIncreasingStreak_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (longestIncreasingStreak_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:int list.
        longestIncreasingStreak_get 0 nums =
        if nums = [] then (&0:int) else HD nums) /\
     (!index:num. !nums:int list.
        longestIncreasingStreak_get (SUC index) nums =
        if nums = []
        then (&0:int)
        else longestIncreasingStreak_get index (TL nums))`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_postcond = new_definition
  `longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
      (nums:int list) (result:num) <=>
     (nums = [] ==> result = 0) /\
     (result > 0 ==>
       EX
         (\start:num.
            start + result <= LENGTH nums /\
            ALL
              (\i:num.
                 longestIncreasingStreak_get
                   (start + i) nums <
                 longestIncreasingStreak_get
                   (start + i + 1) nums)
              (longestIncreasingStreak_range
                (result - 1)) /\
            (start = 0 \/
             longestIncreasingStreak_get
               (start - 1) nums >=
             longestIncreasingStreak_get start nums) /\
            (start + result = LENGTH nums \/
             longestIncreasingStreak_get
               (start + result - 1) nums >=
             longestIncreasingStreak_get
               (start + result) nums))
         (longestIncreasingStreak_range
           (LENGTH nums - result + 1))) /\
     ALL
       (\start:num.
          EX
            (\i:num.
               start + i + 1 >= LENGTH nums \/
               longestIncreasingStreak_get
                 (start + i) nums >=
               longestIncreasingStreak_get
                 (start + i + 1) nums)
            (longestIncreasingStreak_range result))
       (longestIncreasingStreak_range
         (LENGTH nums - result))`;;

let longestIncreasingStreak_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums
     ==> longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
           nums (longestIncreasingStreak nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_30
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_30,
;; "longestIncreasingStreak": a deterministic recursive scan computes the
;; maximum length of a strictly increasing contiguous integer-list streak,
;; together with its exact maximal-streak contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-30-integer-listp (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (integerp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-30-integer-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Int binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-precond
    (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-30-nat-max (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      right
    left))

;; HAS-PREV distinguishes none from some PREV. Consuming one list cell per
;; call exactly reproduces the source local recursion and both state updates.

(defun verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-aux
    (lst has-prev prev curr-len max-len)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (let ((x (car lst))
            (xs (cdr lst)))
        (if has-prev
            (if (> x prev)
                (let ((next-curr-len (+ curr-len 1)))
                  (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-aux
                   xs
                   t
                   x
                   next-curr-len
                   (verina-advanced-30-nat-max
                    next-curr-len
                    max-len)))
              (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-aux
               xs
               t
               x
               1
               (verina-advanced-30-nat-max
                curr-len
                max-len)))
          (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-aux
           xs
           t
           x
           1
           (verina-advanced-30-nat-max 1 max-len))))
    (verina-advanced-30-nat-max curr-len max-len)))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.

(defun verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak
    (nums)
  (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-aux
   nums
   nil
   0
   0
   0))

;; List getElem! on Int returns the inhabited default 0 outside the list.

(defun verina-advanced-30-list-read (index nums)
  (if (and
       (natp index)
       (< index (len nums)))
      (nth index nums)
    0))

;; This is the postcondition's List.range (result - 1) followed by all:
;; every adjacent pair inside the candidate streak is strictly increasing.

(defun verina-advanced-30-streak-increasing-p
    (nums index remaining-pairs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-pairs)))
  (if (zp remaining-pairs)
      t
    (and
     (<
      (verina-advanced-30-list-read index nums)
      (verina-advanced-30-list-read (+ index 1) nums))
     (verina-advanced-30-streak-increasing-p
      nums
      (+ index 1)
      (- remaining-pairs 1)))))

;; The four conjuncts reproduce the bounds, internal comparisons, and the two
;; non-extendability tests for one start index.

(defun verina-advanced-30-maximal-streak-at-p
    (nums start result)
  (and
   (<= (+ start result) (len nums))
   (verina-advanced-30-streak-increasing-p
    nums
    start
    (nfix (- result 1)))
   (or
    (equal start 0)
    (>=
     (verina-advanced-30-list-read
      (nfix (- start 1))
      nums)
     (verina-advanced-30-list-read start nums)))
   (or
    (equal (+ start result) (len nums))
    (>=
     (verina-advanced-30-list-read
      (nfix (- (+ start result) 1))
      nums)
     (verina-advanced-30-list-read
      (+ start result)
      nums)))))

;; Iterating START over exactly REMAINING-STARTS values implements List.any.

(defun verina-advanced-30-exists-maximal-streak-p
    (nums result start remaining-starts)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (or
     (verina-advanced-30-maximal-streak-at-p
      nums
      start
      result)
     (verina-advanced-30-exists-maximal-streak-p
      nums
      result
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)))))

;; For a proposed streak of length result + 1, this is List.range result.any:
;; either the next index is out of bounds or one adjacent comparison fails.

(defun verina-advanced-30-window-has-break-p
    (nums start offset remaining-pairs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-pairs)))
  (if (zp remaining-pairs)
      nil
    (or
     (>= (+ start offset 1) (len nums))
     (>=
      (verina-advanced-30-list-read
       (+ start offset)
       nums)
      (verina-advanced-30-list-read
       (+ start offset 1)
       nums))
     (verina-advanced-30-window-has-break-p
      nums
      start
      (+ offset 1)
      (- remaining-pairs 1)))))

;; Iterating START over List.range (nums.length - result) implements the
;; postcondition's universal assertion that no longer streak exists.

(defun verina-advanced-30-no-longer-streak-p
    (nums result start remaining-starts)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      t
    (and
     (verina-advanced-30-window-has-break-p
      nums
      start
      0
      result)
     (verina-advanced-30-no-longer-streak-p
      nums
      result
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-postcond
    (nums result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-30-integer-listp nums)
   (natp result)
   (implies
    (equal nums nil)
    (equal result 0))
   (implies
    (> result 0)
    (verina-advanced-30-exists-maximal-streak-p
     nums
     result
     0
     (+ (nfix (- (len nums) result)) 1)))
   (verina-advanced-30-no-longer-streak-p
    nums
    result
    0
    (nfix (- (len nums) result)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and True precondition, and its
;; conclusion applies the full postcondition to the executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-30-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_30
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_30,
-- catalog title "longestIncreasingStreak": a deterministic integer-list
-- program computes the length of the longest strictly increasing contiguous
-- streak and is connected to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced30 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_
infixr 4 _||_
infix 4 _<_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  or-left : A → A ∨ B
  or-right : B → A ∨ B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natGreaterOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natGreaterOrEqual m n = natLessOrEqual n m

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

natMax : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMax m n =
  if natLess m n
  then n
  else m

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual m n = notBool (intLess m n)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

longestIncreasingStreak-precond : List Int → Set
longestIncreasingStreak-precond nums = Top

longestIncreasingStreak-aux :
  List Int → Maybe Int → Nat → Nat → Nat
longestIncreasingStreak-aux [] previous current maximum =
  natMax current maximum
longestIncreasingStreak-aux
  (x ∷ xs)
  nothing
  current
  maximum =
    longestIncreasingStreak-aux
      xs
      (just x)
      one
      (natMax one maximum)
longestIncreasingStreak-aux
  (x ∷ xs)
  (just previous)
  current
  maximum =
    if intLess previous x
    then
      longestIncreasingStreak-aux
        xs
        (just x)
        (current + one)
        (natMax (current + one) maximum)
    else
      longestIncreasingStreak-aux
        xs
        (just x)
        one
        (natMax current maximum)

longestIncreasingStreak :
  (nums : List Int) →
  longestIncreasingStreak-precond nums →
  Nat
longestIncreasingStreak nums h-precond =
  longestIncreasingStreak-aux nums nothing zero zero

strictlyIncreasingPairs :
  List Int → Nat → Nat → Bool
strictlyIncreasingPairs nums start result =
  allList
    (λ i →
      intLess
        (nthDefault zeroInt (start + i) nums)
        (nthDefault zeroInt (start + i + one) nums))
    (range (natSubtract result one))

maximalOnLeft :
  List Int → Nat → Bool
maximalOnLeft nums start =
  natEqual start zero ||
  intGreaterOrEqual
    (nthDefault zeroInt (natSubtract start one) nums)
    (nthDefault zeroInt start nums)

maximalOnRight :
  List Int → Nat → Nat → Bool
maximalOnRight nums start result =
  natEqual (start + result) (listLength nums) ||
  intGreaterOrEqual
    (nthDefault
      zeroInt
      (natSubtract (start + result) one)
      nums)
    (nthDefault zeroInt (start + result) nums)

isExactMaximalStreak :
  List Int → Nat → Nat → Bool
isExactMaximalStreak nums result start =
  natLessOrEqual (start + result) (listLength nums) &&
  strictlyIncreasingPairs nums start result &&
  maximalOnLeft nums start &&
  maximalOnRight nums start result

hasExactMaximalStreak :
  List Int → Nat → Bool
hasExactMaximalStreak nums result =
  anyList
    (isExactMaximalStreak nums result)
    (range (natSubtract (listLength nums) result + one))

hasFailureInLongerWindow :
  List Int → Nat → Nat → Bool
hasFailureInLongerWindow nums result start =
  anyList
    (λ i →
      natGreaterOrEqual
        (start + i + one)
        (listLength nums) ||
      intGreaterOrEqual
        (nthDefault zeroInt (start + i) nums)
        (nthDefault zeroInt (start + i + one) nums))
    (range result)

noLongerStreak :
  List Int → Nat → Bool
noLongerStreak nums result =
  allList
    (hasFailureInLongerWindow nums result)
    (range (natSubtract (listLength nums) result))

longestIncreasingStreak-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Nat) →
  longestIncreasingStreak-precond nums →
  Set
longestIncreasingStreak-postcond nums result h-precond =
  (nums ≡ [] → result ≡ zero) ∧
  (zero < result →
    IsTrue (hasExactMaximalStreak nums result)) ∧
  IsTrue (noLongerStreak nums result)

longestIncreasingStreak-spec-satisfied : Set
longestIncreasingStreak-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : longestIncreasingStreak-precond nums) →
  longestIncreasingStreak-postcond
    nums
    (longestIncreasingStreak nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_30
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_30,
  cataloged as "longestIncreasingStreak": the executable recursive scan
  returns the length of the longest strictly increasing contiguous streak
  in an integer list. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val longestIncreasingStreak_precond_def = new_definition (
  "longestIncreasingStreak_precond_def",
  ``longestIncreasingStreak_precond (nums : int list) <=> T``
);

val longestIncreasingStreak_natMax_def = new_definition (
  "longestIncreasingStreak_natMax_def",
  ``longestIncreasingStreak_natMax (m : num) (n : num) =
      if m < n then n else m``
);

val longestIncreasingStreak_aux_def = Define `
  (longestIncreasingStreak_aux
      ([] : int list)
      (prev : int option)
      (currLen : num)
      (maxLen : num) =
     longestIncreasingStreak_natMax currLen maxLen) /\
  (longestIncreasingStreak_aux
      (x::xs)
      prev
      currLen
      maxLen =
     case prev of
       NONE =>
         longestIncreasingStreak_aux
           xs (SOME x) 1
           (longestIncreasingStreak_natMax 1 maxLen)
     | SOME p =>
         if p < x then
           longestIncreasingStreak_aux
             xs (SOME x) (currLen + 1)
             (longestIncreasingStreak_natMax
                (currLen + 1) maxLen)
         else
           longestIncreasingStreak_aux
             xs (SOME x) 1
             (longestIncreasingStreak_natMax currLen maxLen))
`;

val longestIncreasingStreak_def = new_definition (
  "longestIncreasingStreak_def",
  ``longestIncreasingStreak (nums : int list) =
      longestIncreasingStreak_aux nums NONE 0 0``
);

val longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet_def = Define `
  (longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
      ([] : int list) (index : num) = (0 : int)) /\
  (longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
      (x::xs) 0 = x) /\
  (longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
      (x::xs) (SUC index) =
     longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet xs index)
`;

val longestIncreasingStreak_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "longestIncreasingStreak_postcond_def",
  ``longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : num) <=>
      (nums = [] ==> result = 0) /\
      (0 < result ==>
        EXISTS
          (\start.
             start + result <= LENGTH nums /\
             EVERY
               (\i.
                  longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                    nums (start + i) <
                  longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                    nums (start + i + 1))
               (COUNT_LIST (result - 1)) /\
             (start = 0 \/
              longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                nums (start - 1) >=
              longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                nums start) /\
             (start + result = LENGTH nums \/
              longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                nums (start + result - 1) >=
              longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                nums (start + result)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums - result + 1))) /\
      EVERY
        (\start.
           EXISTS
             (\i.
                start + i + 1 >= LENGTH nums \/
                longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                  nums (start + i) >=
                longestIncreasingStreak_safeGet
                  nums (start + i + 1))
             (COUNT_LIST result))
        (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums - result))``
);

val longestIncreasingStreak_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums ==>
      longestIncreasingStreak_postcond
        nums (longestIncreasingStreak nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_30
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_30 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_30), catalog title
  longestIncreasingStreak: the exact recursive scan returns the maximum
  length of a strictly increasing contiguous streak in an arbitrary finite
  integer list, with its range-based correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  i ..^ j is the half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA30RunGraph gives an exact operational graph for the source's local
  recursive auxiliary function at its sole call. The words c and m record
  currLen and maxLen before and after each consumed input entry. At index
  zero the source Option-valued prev is none; afterward it is some of the
  preceding entry, so the transition compares precisely the same adjacent
  integers. Each branch performs the source additions, resets, and Nat.max
  updates. The graph's output also applies the source empty-list branch's
  final Nat.max after all entries have been consumed.

  VERINA30LongestIncreasingStreak selects the unique output of that graph,
  independently of the postcondition. VERINA30Pre is the source True
  precondition together with the List Int input type.

  VERINA30Post reproduces the three source clauses. Its bounded existential
  is List.range(...).any for a maximal streak of exactly the returned length;
  its bounded universals are the two List.range(...).all expressions, and
  the inner existential is the nested List.any. SetMM subtraction on natural
  operands is ordinary integer subtraction, not Lean's truncated Nat.sub.
  The uses are nevertheless equivalent under their guards: B - 1 occurs
  under 0 < B; k - 1 and s - 1 matter only when their minuends are positive;
  s + B is positive under 0 < B, so ( s + B ) - 1 is nonnegative and agrees
  with Nat.sub; and when B exceeds # ` A, the relevant SetMM intervals are
  empty, while the sole index zero in the source range
  (nums.length - result + 1) cannot satisfy
  start + result <= nums.length. Thus every selected branch and satisfiable
  bounded quantifier has the same meaning.
  Every potentially out-of-range get! lookup is behind the same bound or
  disjunction that makes its value irrelevant, while all semantically
  selected lookups are valid.

  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  postcondition predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA30RunGraph VERINA30LongestIncreasingStreak
  VERINA30Pre VERINA30Post
$.

verina30-run-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA30RunGraph A B ) $.
verina30-longest-increasing-streak-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA30LongestIncreasingStreak A ) $.
verina30-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA30Pre A ) $.
verina30-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA30Post A B ) $.

${
  $d k c m A B $.

  verina30-run-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA30RunGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. c e. Word NN0
      E. m e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` c ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( # ` m ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( c ` 0 ) = 0
              /\
              ( m ` 0 ) = 0
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                (
                  c ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  k = 0 ,
                  1 ,
                  if (
                    ( A ` ( k - 1 ) ) < ( A ` k ) ,
                    ( ( c ` k ) + 1 ) ,
                    1
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  m ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  k = 0 ,
                  if (
                    ( m ` k ) < 1 ,
                    1 ,
                    ( m ` k )
                  ) ,
                  if (
                    ( A ` ( k - 1 ) ) < ( A ` k ) ,
                    if (
                      ( m ` k ) < ( ( c ` k ) + 1 ) ,
                      ( ( c ` k ) + 1 ) ,
                      ( m ` k )
                    ) ,
                    if (
                      ( m ` k ) < ( c ` k ) ,
                      ( c ` k ) ,
                      ( m ` k )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            /\
            B = if (
              ( c ` ( # ` A ) ) < ( m ` ( # ` A ) ) ,
              ( m ` ( # ` A ) ) ,
              ( c ` ( # ` A ) )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina30-longest-increasing-streak-definition $a |- (
    VERINA30LongestIncreasingStreak A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA30RunGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina30-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA30Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d i s A B $.

  verina30-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA30Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        A = (/)
        ->
        B = 0
      )
      /\
      (
        0 < B
        ->
        E. s e. (
          0 ..^ ( ( ( # ` A ) - B ) + 1 )
        )
          (
            (
              ( s + B ) <_ ( # ` A )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( B - 1 ) )
                (
                  A ` ( s + i )
                ) < (
                  A ` ( ( s + i ) + 1 )
                )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                s = 0
                \/
                ( A ` s ) <_ ( A ` ( s - 1 ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                ( s + B ) = ( # ` A )
                \/
                (
                  A ` ( s + B )
                ) <_ (
                  A ` ( ( s + B ) - 1 )
                )
              )
            )
          )
      )
      /\
      A. s e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` A ) - B ) )
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ B )
          (
            ( # ` A ) <_ ( ( s + i ) + 1 )
            \/
            (
              A ` ( ( s + i ) + 1 )
            ) <_ (
              A ` ( s + i )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-30-longest-increasing-streak
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA30Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA30Post
          w
          ( VERINA30LongestIncreasingStreak w )
      )
    )
  $.

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_30, catalog title "longestIncreasingStreak": an exact
:: finite-sequence operational graph of the unconditional precondition,
:: recursive contiguous-streak scan, maximal-streak postcondition, and final
:: correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1,

  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,

    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    XXREAL_0, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
