  verina_advanced_35 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_35), catalog title
  majorityElement: the exact hash-map counting program returns the unique
  integer occurring more than half the length of an arbitrary nonempty
  finite integer list, with the stated majority and uniqueness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set. VERINA35Count is List.count.
  The floor expression is Lean's natural-number division by two.

  VERINA35CountsGraph is the exact finite execution trace of the source
  mutable HashMap loop. Row k records getD values after the first k input
  entries have been inserted, for every integer key that occurs in the
  input. The initial row is zero, and processing input[k] increments exactly
  the slots representing that same integer. Thus its final row is the
  source map extensionally on every stored key; absent keys have getD value
  zero and are irrelevant to toList.

  VERINA35SearchGraph reproduces counts.toList.find? followed by the source
  default zero. A strict majority key is unique, so HashMap bucket and toList
  order cannot affect the selected key; if no strict majority exists, every
  stored key fails the test and the result is zero. VERINA35ProgramGraph
  composes this search with the counting trace, and VERINA35MajorityElement
  selects its unique result. The implementation is therefore determined by
  the source computation, not by the postcondition.

  VERINA35Pre is exactly the positive-length conjunction with List.any of a
  value whose List.count exceeds floor(length / 2). VERINA35Post is exactly
  the returned-value count bound and the universal bound for every unequal
  input element. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally
  and propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA35Count
  VERINA35CountsGraph
  VERINA35SearchGraph
  VERINA35ProgramGraph VERINA35MajorityElement
  VERINA35Pre VERINA35Post
$.

verina35-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA35Count A B ) $.
verina35-counts-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA35CountsGraph A B ) $.
verina35-search-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA35SearchGraph A B C ) $.
verina35-program-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA35ProgramGraph A B ) $.
verina35-majority-element-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA35MajorityElement A ) $.
verina35-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA35Pre A ) $.
verina35-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA35Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina35-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = B
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k t A B $.

  verina35-counts-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35CountsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` t ) )
            ( # ` ( t ` k ) ) = ( # ` A )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            ( ( t ` 0 ) ` j ) = 0
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  ( t ` ( k + 1 ) ) ` j
                ) = if (
                  ( A ` j ) = ( A ` k ) ,
                  ( ( ( t ` k ) ` j ) + 1 ) ,
                  ( ( t ` k ) ` j )
                )
            /\
            B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verina35-search-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35SearchGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      (
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            (
              |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
            ) < ( B ` i )
            /\
            C = ( A ` i )
          )
        \/
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            ( B ` i ) <_ (
              |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
            )
          /\
          C = 0
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d q A B $.

  verina35-program-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35ProgramGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. q e. Word NN0
      (
        ( VERINA35CountsGraph A q )
        /\
        ( VERINA35SearchGraph A q B )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina35-majority-element-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35MajorityElement A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA35ProgramGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verina35-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35Pre A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      0 < ( # ` A )
    )
    /\
    E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
      ) < (
        VERINA35Count A ( A ` i )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina35-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA35Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
      ) < (
        VERINA35Count A B
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          ( A ` i ) =/= B
          ->
          (
            VERINA35Count A ( A ` i )
          ) <_ (
            |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-35-majority-element
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA35Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA35Post
          w
          ( VERINA35MajorityElement w )
      )
    )
  $.

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_35, catalog title "majorityElement": an exact finite-map
:: operational graph of integer frequency counting, the nonempty-majority
:: precondition, the majority-element postcondition, and the final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, XXREAL_0,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 < len nums &
    (ex x being Integer st x in rng nums &
      len nums div 2 <
        len Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom nums & nums.i = x})) &
    (ex keys being FinSequence of INT,
        counts being FinSequence of NAT st
      len keys = len counts &
      keys is one-to-one &
      rng keys = rng nums &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom keys holds
        counts/.i =
          len Seq (nums | {j where j is Nat :
            j in dom nums & nums.j = keys/.i})) &
      ((ex i being Nat st
          i in dom keys &
          result = keys/.i &
          len nums div 2 < counts/.i &
          (for j being Nat st j in dom keys & j < i holds
            counts/.j <= len nums div 2)) or
       (result = 0 &
        for i being Nat st i in dom keys holds
          counts/.i <= len nums div 2)))
  holds
    len nums div 2 <
      len Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom nums & nums.i = result}) &
    for x being Integer st x in rng nums & x <> result holds
      len Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom nums & nums.i = x}) <= len nums div 2
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_35
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_35, catalog title "majorityElement": counting integer-list
% frequencies with the specified map-building program and returning the unique
% value occurring more than half the list length. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_35: THEORY
BEGIN

  frequency_map: TYPE = [int -> nat]

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  occurrence_count(
      requested: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = requested THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Exact floor division by two on natural numbers.
  nat_half(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value < 2 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      nat_half(value - 2) + 1
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  has_majority_value(
      remaining, whole: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        occurrence_count(head, whole)
            > nat_half(int_list_length(whole))
          OR has_majority_value(tail, whole)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  majorityElement_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(nums) > 0
      AND has_majority_value(nums, nums)

  empty_frequency_map: frequency_map =
    LAMBDA (value: int): 0

  frequency_get(
      value: int,
      frequencies: frequency_map): nat =
    frequencies(value)

  frequency_insert(
      value: int,
      count: nat,
      frequencies: frequency_map): frequency_map =
    LAMBDA (query: int):
      IF query = value THEN
        count
      ELSE
        frequencies(query)
      ENDIF

  % This fold is the extensional integer-key semantics of the source HashMap
  % loop: every input occurrence increments exactly its key's stored count.
  build_frequency_map(
      remaining: list[int],
      frequencies: frequency_map): RECURSIVE frequency_map =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        frequencies,
      cons(head, tail):
        build_frequency_map(
          tail,
          frequency_insert(
            head,
            frequency_get(head, frequencies) + 1,
            frequencies))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % HashMap.toList may enumerate keys in an implementation-specific order.
  % Under majorityElement_precond, at most one key has count greater than
  % floor(n/2), so scanning the input keys returns exactly the same key.
  find_majority_key(
      keys: list[int],
      frequencies: frequency_map,
      threshold: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES keys OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF frequency_get(head, frequencies) > threshold THEN
          head
        ELSE
          find_majority_key(
            tail,
            frequencies,
            threshold)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE keys BY <<

  majorityElement(nums: list[int]): int =
    LET counts: frequency_map =
          build_frequency_map(
            nums,
            empty_frequency_map),
        n: nat = int_list_length(nums)
    IN
      find_majority_key(
        nums,
        counts,
        nat_half(n))

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  majorityElement_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET threshold: nat =
          nat_half(int_list_length(nums))
    IN
      occurrence_count(result, nums) > threshold
        AND
      (FORALL (x: int):
        (int_list_contains(nums, x)
          AND x /= result)
        IMPLIES
          occurrence_count(x, nums) <= threshold)

  majorityElement_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      majorityElement_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        majorityElement_postcond(
          nums,
          majorityElement(nums))

END verina_advanced_35

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_36,
   catalog title "majorityElement": an executable recursive candidate scan
   over a nonempty natural-number list guaranteed to contain an element
   occurring strictly more than half the time, together with its correctness
   contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint countOccurrences
    (target : nat)
    (lst : list nat) : nat :=
  match lst with
  | [] => 0
  | y :: ys =>
      if Nat.eqb y target
      then 1 + countOccurrences target ys
      else countOccurrences target ys
  end.

Fixpoint findCandidate
    (lst : list nat)
    (candidate : option nat)
    (count : nat) : nat :=
  match lst with
  | [] =>
      match candidate with
      | Some c => c
      | None => 0
      end
  | x :: xs =>
      match candidate with
      | Some c =>
          if Nat.eqb x c
          then findCandidate xs (Some c) (count + 1)
          else if Nat.eqb count 0
          then findCandidate xs (Some x) 1
          else findCandidate xs (Some c) (count - 1)
      | None =>
          findCandidate xs (Some x) 1
      end
  end.

Definition majorityElement_precond
    (xs : list nat) : Prop :=
  Nat.lt 0 (length xs) /\
  existsb
    (fun x =>
      Nat.ltb
        (Nat.div (length xs) 2)
        (count_occ Nat.eq_dec xs x))
    xs = true.

Definition majorityElement
    (xs : list nat)
    (_h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs) : nat :=
  findCandidate xs None 0.

Definition majorityElement_postcond
    (xs : list nat)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs) : Prop :=
  Nat.lt
    (Nat.div (length xs) 2)
    (count_occ Nat.eq_dec xs result).

Theorem majorityElement_spec_satisfied
    (xs : list nat)
    (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs) :
  majorityElement_postcond
    xs (majorityElement xs h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_36,
  catalog title "majorityElement": an executable candidate-cancellation
  program returns a natural number occurring strictly more than half the
  input-list length when such an element exists, together with its
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_36
  imports Main
begin

definition majorityElement_precond :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "majorityElement_precond xs \<longleftrightarrow>
    length xs > 0 \<and>
    list_ex
      (\<lambda>x. count_list xs x > length xs div 2)
      xs"

fun majorityElement_countOccurrences ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "majorityElement_countOccurrences target [] = 0"
| "majorityElement_countOccurrences target (y # ys) =
    (if y = target
     then 1 + majorityElement_countOccurrences target ys
     else majorityElement_countOccurrences target ys)"

fun majorityElement_findCandidate ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat option \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "majorityElement_findCandidate [] candidate count =
    (case candidate of Some c \<Rightarrow> c | None \<Rightarrow> 0)"
| "majorityElement_findCandidate (x # xs) candidate count =
    (case candidate of
       Some c \<Rightarrow>
         (if x = c
          then majorityElement_findCandidate xs (Some c) (count + 1)
          else if count = 0
               then majorityElement_findCandidate xs (Some x) 1
               else majorityElement_findCandidate xs (Some c) (count - 1))
     | None \<Rightarrow> majorityElement_findCandidate xs (Some x) 1)"

definition majorityElement :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "majorityElement xs = majorityElement_findCandidate xs None 0"

definition majorityElement_postcond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "majorityElement_postcond xs result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let count = count_list xs result
     in count > length xs div 2)"

theorem majorityElement_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "majorityElement_precond xs"
  shows "majorityElement_postcond xs (majorityElement xs)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_36,
  catalog title "majorityElement": an executable Boyer-Moore-style scan on
  natural-number lists returns a value occurring strictly more than half the
  time under the nonempty-majority precondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let majorityElement_countOccurrences =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(majorityElement_countOccurrences
        (target:num) ([]:num list) = 0) /\
     (!y:num. !ys:num list. !target:num.
        majorityElement_countOccurrences
          target (CONS y ys) =
        if y = target
        then SUC (majorityElement_countOccurrences target ys)
        else majorityElement_countOccurrences target ys)`;;

let majorityElement_precond = new_definition
  `majorityElement_precond (xs:num list) <=>
     0 < LENGTH xs /\
     EX
       (\x:num.
          majorityElement_countOccurrences x xs >
          LENGTH xs DIV 2)
       xs`;;

let majorityElement_optionValue =
  new_recursive_definition option_RECURSION
    `(majorityElement_optionValue (NONE:num option) = 0) /\
     (!c:num.
        majorityElement_optionValue (SOME c) = c)`;;

let majorityElement_findCandidate =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!candidate:num option. !count:num.
        majorityElement_findCandidate
          ([]:num list) candidate count =
        if candidate = NONE
        then 0
        else majorityElement_optionValue candidate) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list.
      !candidate:num option. !count:num.
        majorityElement_findCandidate
          (CONS x xs) candidate count =
        if candidate = NONE then
          majorityElement_findCandidate xs (SOME x) 1
        else
          let c = majorityElement_optionValue candidate in
          if x = c then
            majorityElement_findCandidate
              xs (SOME c) (count + 1)
          else if count = 0 then
            majorityElement_findCandidate xs (SOME x) 1
          else
            majorityElement_findCandidate
              xs (SOME c) (count - 1))`;;

let majorityElement = new_definition
  `majorityElement (xs:num list) =
     majorityElement_findCandidate xs NONE 0`;;

let majorityElement_postcond = new_definition
  `majorityElement_postcond
      (xs:num list) (result:num) <=>
     majorityElement_countOccurrences result xs >
     LENGTH xs DIV 2`;;

let majorityElement_spec_satisfied =
  `!xs:num list.
     majorityElement_precond xs
     ==> majorityElement_postcond
           xs (majorityElement xs)`;;

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_36,
;; "majorityElement": a deterministic Boyer-Moore candidate scan on a
;; nonempty list of natural numbers returns an element occurring strictly more
;; than half the list length. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-36-nat-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (natp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-36-nat-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; This is the source local countOccurrences helper. It is retained even
;; though the executable candidate scan does not call it.

(defun verina-advanced-36-count-occurrences (target lst)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (+
       (if (equal (car lst) target) 1 0)
       (verina-advanced-36-count-occurrences
        target
        (cdr lst)))
    0))

;; This predicate is List.any applied to the strict-majority test.

(defun verina-advanced-36-any-majority-p
    (remaining whole threshold)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (< threshold
          (verina-advanced-36-count-occurrences
           (car remaining)
           whole))
       (verina-advanced-36-any-majority-p
        (cdr remaining)
        whole
        threshold))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-36-majority-element-precond (xs)
  (and
   (< 0 (len xs))
   (verina-advanced-36-any-majority-p
    xs
    xs
    (floor (len xs) 2))))

;; CANDIDATE-PRESENTP and CANDIDATE represent Option Nat exactly on reachable
;; calls: NIL is none, and non-NIL is some CANDIDATE. COUNT is the source Nat
;; counter. NFIX implements truncated Nat subtraction in the decrement branch.

(defun verina-advanced-36-find-candidate
    (lst candidate-presentp candidate count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (let ((x (car lst))
            (tail (cdr lst)))
        (if candidate-presentp
            (if (equal x candidate)
                (verina-advanced-36-find-candidate
                 tail
                 t
                 candidate
                 (+ count 1))
              (if (equal count 0)
                  (verina-advanced-36-find-candidate
                   tail
                   t
                   x
                   1)
                (verina-advanced-36-find-candidate
                 tail
                 t
                 candidate
                 (nfix (- count 1)))))
          (verina-advanced-36-find-candidate
           tail
           t
           x
           1)))
    (if candidate-presentp candidate 0)))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant, so
;; this function is the exact executable content of the source definition.

(defun verina-advanced-36-majority-element (xs)
  (verina-advanced-36-find-candidate xs nil 0 0))

(defun verina-advanced-36-majority-element-postcond
    (xs result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-36-nat-listp xs)
   (natp result)
   (< (floor (len xs) 2)
      (verina-advanced-36-count-occurrences
       result
       xs))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Nat binder and complete source precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun verina-advanced-36-majority-element-spec-satisfied-statement
    (xs)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-36-nat-listp xs)
    (verina-advanced-36-majority-element-precond xs))
   (verina-advanced-36-majority-element-postcond
    xs
    (verina-advanced-36-majority-element xs))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_36,
-- catalog title "majorityElement": the Boyer-Moore candidate-selection program
-- returns a natural number occurring strictly more than half the time in a
-- nonempty list that has a majority element. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced36 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

predecessor : Nat → Nat
predecessor zero = zero
predecessor (suc n) = n

half : Nat → Nat
half zero = zero
half (suc zero) = zero
half (suc (suc n)) = suc (half n)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

countNat : Nat → List Nat → Nat
countNat sought [] = zero
countNat sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if natEqual sought x
  then suc (countNat sought xs)
  else countNat sought xs

anyMajority : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
anyMajority original [] = false
anyMajority original (x ∷ xs) =
  if natLess (half (listLength original)) (countNat x original)
  then true
  else anyMajority original xs

record majorityElement-precond (xs : List Nat) : Set where
  constructor precondition
  field
    nonempty : zero < listLength xs
    majority-exists : IsTrue (anyMajority xs xs)

countOccurrences : Nat → List Nat → Nat
countOccurrences target [] = zero
countOccurrences target (y ∷ ys) =
  if natEqual y target
  then suc (countOccurrences target ys)
  else countOccurrences target ys

findCandidate : List Nat → Maybe Nat → Nat → Nat
findCandidate [] (just candidate) count = candidate
findCandidate [] nothing count = zero
findCandidate (x ∷ xs) (just candidate) count =
  if natEqual x candidate
  then findCandidate xs (just candidate) (count + suc zero)
  else
    if natEqual count zero
    then findCandidate xs (just x) (suc zero)
    else findCandidate xs (just candidate) (predecessor count)
findCandidate (x ∷ xs) nothing count =
  findCandidate xs (just x) (suc zero)

majorityElement :
  (xs : List Nat) →
  majorityElement-precond xs →
  Nat
majorityElement xs h-precond =
  findCandidate xs nothing zero

majorityElement-postcond :
  (xs : List Nat) →
  (result : Nat) →
  majorityElement-precond xs →
  Set
majorityElement-postcond xs result h-precond =
  half (listLength xs) < countNat result xs

majorityElement-spec-satisfied : Set
majorityElement-spec-satisfied =
  (xs : List Nat) →
  (h-precond : majorityElement-precond xs) →
  majorityElement-postcond
    xs
    (majorityElement xs h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_36,
  cataloged as "majorityElement": the executable Boyer-Moore-style scan
  returns a natural number occurring strictly more than half the input-list
  length when such an element is guaranteed. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val countOccurrences_def = Define `
  (countOccurrences
      (target : num) ([] : num list) = 0) /\
  (countOccurrences target (y::ys) =
     if y = target then
       1 + countOccurrences target ys
     else
       countOccurrences target ys)
`;

val majorityElement_precond_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_precond_def",
  ``majorityElement_precond (xs : num list) <=>
      LENGTH xs > 0 /\
      EXISTS
        (\x : num.
          countOccurrences x xs > LENGTH xs DIV 2)
        xs``
);

val findCandidate_def = Define `
  (findCandidate
      ([] : num list)
      (candidate : num option)
      (count : num) =
     case candidate of
       NONE => 0
     | SOME c => c) /\
  (findCandidate (x::xs) candidate count =
     case candidate of
       NONE =>
         findCandidate xs (SOME x) 1
     | SOME c =>
         if x = c then
           findCandidate xs (SOME c) (count + 1)
         else if count = 0 then
           findCandidate xs (SOME x) 1
         else
           findCandidate xs (SOME c) (count - 1))
`;

val majorityElement_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_def",
  ``majorityElement (xs : num list) =
      findCandidate xs NONE 0``
);

val majorityElement_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_postcond_def",
  ``majorityElement_postcond
      (xs : num list) (result : num) <=>
      countOccurrences result xs > LENGTH xs DIV 2``
);

val majorityElement_spec_satisfied =
  ``!xs : num list.
      majorityElement_precond xs ==>
      majorityElement_postcond xs (majorityElement xs)``;

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_36 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_36), catalog title
  majorityElement: the exact Boyer-Moore-style candidate and counter scan
  returns a natural number occurring more than half the length of an
  arbitrary nonempty finite natural-number list that has a majority element.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA36CountOccurrences is the source countOccurrences recursion,
  extensionally represented by the number of input positions equal to the
  target. VERINA36None, VERINA36Some, and VERINA36OptionNat give a disjoint
  tagged encoding of Option Nat.

  VERINA36FindStep is exactly one nonempty-list branch of findCandidate. With
  no candidate it installs the current input and count one. With some
  candidate, equality increments the count; inequality replaces the
  candidate at count zero, and otherwise decrements the count while retaining
  the candidate. VERINA36FindCandidateGraph records the option and count
  before and after every input entry and applies the source empty-list return:
  the final candidate value, or zero for none. This gives the exact helper
  computation for arbitrary typed list, initial candidate, and initial count.
  VERINA36FindCandidate selects its unique output, and
  VERINA36MajorityElement calls it with none and zero exactly as the source
  executable implementation does.

  VERINA36Pre is exactly positive length together with List.any of a value
  whose occurrence count exceeds floor(length / 2). VERINA36Post is exactly
  that same strict count bound for the returned result. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally and propositionally unused and is
  omitted from the target function and postcondition. The final $a
  declaration is the source correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is
  syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA36CountOccurrences
  VERINA36None VERINA36Some VERINA36OptionNat
  VERINA36FindStep
  VERINA36FindCandidateGraph VERINA36FindCandidate
  VERINA36MajorityElement
  VERINA36Pre VERINA36Post
$.

verina36-count-occurrences-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA36CountOccurrences A B ) $.
verina36-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA36None $.
verina36-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA36Some A ) $.
verina36-option-nat-syntax
  $a class VERINA36OptionNat $.
verina36-find-step-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA36FindStep A B C D E ) $.
verina36-find-candidate-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA36FindCandidateGraph A B C D ) $.
verina36-find-candidate-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA36FindCandidate A B C ) $.
verina36-majority-element-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA36MajorityElement A ) $.
verina36-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA36Pre A ) $.
verina36-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA36Post A B ) $.

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina36-count-occurrences-definition $a |- (
    VERINA36CountOccurrences A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
      |
      ( B ` k ) = A
    }
  ) $.
$}

verina36-none-definition $a |- VERINA36None = (/) $.

verina36-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA36Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina36-option-nat-definition $a |- VERINA36OptionNat =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA36None
        \/
        E. y e. NN0 x = ( VERINA36Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d c A B C D E $.

  verina36-find-step-definition $a |- (
    VERINA36FindStep A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. NN0
            /\
            B e. VERINA36OptionNat
          )
          /\
          C e. NN0
        )
        /\
        D e. VERINA36OptionNat
      )
      /\
      E e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = VERINA36None
        /\
        (
          D = ( VERINA36Some A )
          /\
          E = 1
        )
      )
      \/
      E. c e. NN0
        (
          B = ( VERINA36Some c )
          /\
          (
            (
              A = c
              /\
              (
                D = ( VERINA36Some c )
                /\
                E = ( C + 1 )
              )
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A =/= c
                /\
                C = 0
              )
              /\
              (
                D = ( VERINA36Some A )
                /\
                E = 1
              )
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A =/= c
                /\
                C =/= 0
              )
              /\
              (
                D = ( VERINA36Some c )
                /\
                E = ( C - 1 )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c k o q A B C D $.

  verina36-find-candidate-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA36FindCandidateGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word NN0
          /\
          B e. VERINA36OptionNat
        )
        /\
        C e. NN0
      )
      /\
      D e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. o e. Word VERINA36OptionNat
      E. q e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` o ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( # ` q ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( o ` 0 ) = B
              /\
              ( q ` 0 ) = C
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                VERINA36FindStep
                  ( A ` k )
                  ( o ` k )
                  ( q ` k )
                  ( o ` ( k + 1 ) )
                  ( q ` ( k + 1 ) )
              )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( o ` ( # ` A ) ) = VERINA36None
                /\
                D = 0
              )
              \/
              E. c e. NN0
                (
                  ( o ` ( # ` A ) ) = ( VERINA36Some c )
                  /\
                  D = c
                )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina36-find-candidate-definition $a |- (
    VERINA36FindCandidate A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA36FindCandidateGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verina36-majority-element-definition $a |- (
  VERINA36MajorityElement A
) = (
  VERINA36FindCandidate A VERINA36None 0
) $.

${
  $d i A $.

  verina36-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA36Pre A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      0 < ( # ` A )
    )
    /\
    E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
      ) < (
        VERINA36CountOccurrences
          ( A ` i )
          A
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina36-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA36Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
  ) < (
    VERINA36CountOccurrences B A
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-36-majority-element
  $a |- A. w e. Word NN0
    (
      ( VERINA36Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA36Post
          w
          ( VERINA36MajorityElement w )
      )
    )
  $.

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_36, catalog title "majorityElement": the exact occurrence-
:: count helper, nonempty-majority precondition, Boyer-Moore-style recursive
:: candidate computation, majority postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,

    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, XXREAL_0,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for xs being FinSequence of NAT,
      result being Nat st
    0 < len xs &
    (ex x being Nat st x in rng xs &
      len xs div 2 <
        len Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom xs & xs.i = x})) &
    (ex candidatePresent,candidateValues,tallies
        being FinSequence of NAT st
      len candidatePresent = len xs + 1 &
      len candidateValues = len xs + 1 &
      len tallies = len xs + 1 &
      candidatePresent/.1 = 0 &
      candidateValues/.1 = 0 &
      tallies/.1 = 0 &
      ((candidatePresent/.(len xs + 1) = 0 & result = 0) or
       (candidatePresent/.(len xs + 1) = 1 &
        result = candidateValues/.(len xs + 1))) &
      for i being Nat st i in dom xs holds
        (candidatePresent/.i = 0 &
          candidatePresent/.(i + 1) = 1 &
          candidateValues/.(i + 1) = xs/.i &
          tallies/.(i + 1) = 1) or
        (candidatePresent/.i = 1 &
          ((xs/.i = candidateValues/.i &
            candidatePresent/.(i + 1) = 1 &
            candidateValues/.(i + 1) = candidateValues/.i &
            tallies/.(i + 1) = tallies/.i + 1) or
           (xs/.i <> candidateValues/.i &
            tallies/.i = 0 &
            candidatePresent/.(i + 1) = 1 &
            candidateValues/.(i + 1) = xs/.i &
            tallies/.(i + 1) = 1) or
           (xs/.i <> candidateValues/.i &
            tallies/.i <> 0 &
            candidatePresent/.(i + 1) = 1 &
            candidateValues/.(i + 1) = candidateValues/.i &
            tallies/.(i + 1) = tallies/.i -' 1))))
  holds
    len xs div 2 <
      len Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom xs & xs.i = result})
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_36
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_36, catalog title "majorityElement": computing a natural-
% number list's majority element with the specified Boyer-Moore candidate
% update recursion and majority-frequency correctness contract.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_36: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoNat: NoNat?
    SomeNat(option_value: nat): SomeNat?
  END nat_option

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  countOccurrences(
      target: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = target THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + countOccurrences(target, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Exact floor division by two on natural numbers.
  nat_half(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value < 2 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      nat_half(value - 2) + 1
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  has_majority_value(
      remaining, whole: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        countOccurrences(head, whole)
            > nat_half(nat_list_length(whole))
          OR has_majority_value(tail, whole)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  majorityElement_precond(xs: list[nat]): bool =
    nat_list_length(xs) > 0
      AND has_majority_value(xs, xs)

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  findCandidate(
      values: list[nat],
      candidate: nat_option,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        CASES candidate OF
          NoNat:
            0,
          SomeNat(c):
            c
        ENDCASES,
      cons(head, tail):
        CASES candidate OF
          NoNat:
            findCandidate(
              tail,
              SomeNat(head),
              1),
          SomeNat(c):
            IF head = c THEN
              findCandidate(
                tail,
                SomeNat(c),
                count + 1)
            ELSIF count = 0 THEN
              findCandidate(
                tail,
                SomeNat(head),
                1)
            ELSE
              findCandidate(
                tail,
                SomeNat(c),
                nat_subtract(count, 1))
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  majorityElement(xs: list[nat]): nat =
    findCandidate(xs, NoNat, 0)

  majorityElement_postcond(
      xs: list[nat],
      result: nat): bool =
    countOccurrences(result, xs)
      > nat_half(nat_list_length(xs))

  majorityElement_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (xs: list[nat]):
      majorityElement_precond(xs) IMPLIES
        majorityElement_postcond(
          xs,
          majorityElement(xs))

END verina_advanced_36

-- Statement-only formalization of "majorityElement" from VERINA item verina_advanced_37. This
-- file contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux

-- !benchmark @end solution_aux

-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible, simp]
def majorityElement_precond (nums : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  nums.length > 0 ∧ nums.any (fun x => nums.count x > nums.length / 2)  -- majority element must exist
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def majorityElement (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond (nums)) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let rec insert (x : Int) (xs : List Int) : List Int :=
    match xs with
    | [] => [x]
    | h :: t =>
      if x ≤ h then
        x :: h :: t
      else
        h :: insert x t

  let rec insertionSort (xs : List Int) : List Int :=
    match xs with
    | [] => []
    | h :: t =>
      let sortedTail := insertionSort t
      let sorted := insert h sortedTail
      sorted

  let getAt := fun (xs : List Int) (i : Nat) =>
    match xs.drop i with
    | [] => 0
    | h :: _ => h

  let sorted := insertionSort nums

  let len := sorted.length
  let mid := len / 2
  getAt sorted mid
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible, simp]
def majorityElement_postcond (nums : List Int) (result: Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond (nums)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let n := nums.length
  (List.count result nums > n / 2) ∧
  nums.all (fun x => x = result ∨ List.count x nums ≤ n / 2)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem majorityElement_spec_satisfied (nums: List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond (nums)) :
    majorityElement_postcond (nums) (majorityElement (nums) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_37,
   catalog title "majorityElement": insertion-sort computation of the middle
   integer in a nonempty list guaranteed to have a strict majority element,
   together with its majority and uniqueness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition majorityElement_count (x : Z) (nums : list Z) : nat :=
  count_occ Z.eq_dec nums x.

Definition majorityElement_precond (nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  Nat.lt 0 (length nums) /\
  existsb
    (fun x =>
      Nat.ltb
        (Nat.div (length nums) 2)
        (majorityElement_count x nums))
    nums = true.

Fixpoint majorityElement_insert
    (x : Z) (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => [x]
  | h :: t =>
      if Z.leb x h
      then x :: h :: t
      else h :: majorityElement_insert x t
  end.

Fixpoint majorityElement_insertionSort
    (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | h :: t =>
      let sortedTail := majorityElement_insertionSort t in
      let sorted := majorityElement_insert h sortedTail in
      sorted
  end.

Definition majorityElement_getAt
    (xs : list Z) (i : nat) : Z :=
  match skipn i xs with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | h :: _ => h
  end.

Definition majorityElement
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) : Z :=
  let sorted := majorityElement_insertionSort nums in
  let len := length sorted in
  let mid := Nat.div len 2 in
  majorityElement_getAt sorted mid.

Definition majorityElement_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let n := length nums in
  Nat.lt
    (Nat.div n 2)
    (majorityElement_count result nums) /\
  forallb
    (fun x =>
      orb
        (Z.eqb x result)
        (Nat.leb
          (majorityElement_count x nums)
          (Nat.div n 2)))
    nums = true.

Theorem majorityElement_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) :
  majorityElement_postcond
    nums (majorityElement nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_37,
  catalog title "majorityElement": an executable insertion-sort program
  returns the middle integer of a nonempty list having a majority element,
  with a contract stating that the result is that majority element. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_37
  imports Main
begin

definition majorityElement_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "majorityElement_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow>
    length nums > 0 \<and>
    list_ex
      (\<lambda>x. count_list nums x > length nums div 2)
      nums"

fun majorityElement_insert :: "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "majorityElement_insert x [] = [x]"
| "majorityElement_insert x (h # t) =
    (if x \<le> h
     then x # h # t
     else h # majorityElement_insert x t)"

fun majorityElement_insertionSort :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "majorityElement_insertionSort [] = []"
| "majorityElement_insertionSort (h # t) =
    majorityElement_insert h (majorityElement_insertionSort t)"

fun majorityElement_getAt :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "majorityElement_getAt [] i = 0"
| "majorityElement_getAt (h # t) 0 = h"
| "majorityElement_getAt (h # t) (Suc i) = majorityElement_getAt t i"

definition majorityElement :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "majorityElement nums =
    (let sorted = majorityElement_insertionSort nums;
         len = length sorted;
         mid = len div 2
     in majorityElement_getAt sorted mid)"

definition majorityElement_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "majorityElement_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let n = length nums
     in count_list nums result > n div 2 \<and>
        list_all
          (\<lambda>x. x = result \<or> count_list nums x \<le> n div 2)
          nums)"

theorem majorityElement_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "majorityElement_precond nums"
  shows "majorityElement_postcond nums (majorityElement nums)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_37,
  catalog title "majorityElement": executable insertion sorting of an integer
  list followed by middle-element selection returns its majority element under
  the nonempty-majority precondition, with the full occurrence postcondition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let majorityElement_count =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(majorityElement_count (value:int) ([]:int list) = 0) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !value:int.
        majorityElement_count value (CONS x xs) =
        if x = value
        then SUC (majorityElement_count value xs)
        else majorityElement_count value xs)`;;

let majorityElement_precond = new_definition
  `majorityElement_precond (nums:int list) <=>
     0 < LENGTH nums /\
     EX
       (\x:int.
          majorityElement_count x nums > LENGTH nums DIV 2)
       nums`;;

let majorityElement_insert =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(majorityElement_insert (x:int) ([]:int list) = CONS x []) /\
     (!h:int. !t:int list. !x:int.
        majorityElement_insert x (CONS h t) =
        if x <= h
        then CONS x (CONS h t)
        else CONS h (majorityElement_insert x t))`;;

let majorityElement_insertionSort =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(majorityElement_insertionSort ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!h:int. !t:int list.
        majorityElement_insertionSort (CONS h t) =
        majorityElement_insert
          h (majorityElement_insertionSort t))`;;

let majorityElement_getAt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        majorityElement_getAt 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!i:num. !xs:int list.
        majorityElement_getAt (SUC i) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else majorityElement_getAt i (TL xs))`;;

let majorityElement = new_definition
  `majorityElement (nums:int list) =
     let sorted = majorityElement_insertionSort nums in
     let len = LENGTH sorted in
     let mid = len DIV 2 in
     majorityElement_getAt mid sorted`;;

let majorityElement_postcond = new_definition
  `majorityElement_postcond
      (nums:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let n = LENGTH nums in
     majorityElement_count result nums > n DIV 2 /\
     ALL
       (\x:int.
          x = result \/
          majorityElement_count x nums <= n DIV 2)
       nums`;;

let majorityElement_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     majorityElement_precond nums
     ==> majorityElement_postcond
           nums (majorityElement nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_37,
;; "majorityElement": insertion sorting an integer list and selecting its
;; middle entry returns the strict majority element under the stated
;; existence precondition. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-37-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-37-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; This recursive count is the source List.count operation on integer lists.

(defun verina-advanced-37-list-count (value xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (+
       (if (equal value (car xs)) 1 0)
       (verina-advanced-37-list-count
        value
        (cdr xs)))
    0))

;; This predicate is List.any applied to the strict-majority test.

(defun verina-advanced-37-any-majority-p
    (remaining whole threshold)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (< threshold
          (verina-advanced-37-list-count
           (car remaining)
           whole))
       (verina-advanced-37-any-majority-p
        (cdr remaining)
        whole
        threshold))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-37-majority-element-precond (nums)
  (and
   (< 0 (len nums))
   (verina-advanced-37-any-majority-p
    nums
    nums
    (floor (len nums) 2))))

;; INSERT and INSERTION-SORT reproduce the source local recursive helpers.
;; The comparison is integer order, and equal elements are inserted before
;; the existing equal element exactly as in the Lean definition.

(defun verina-advanced-37-insert (x xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (let ((head (car xs))
            (tail (cdr xs)))
        (if (<= x head)
            (cons x (cons head tail))
          (cons
           head
           (verina-advanced-37-insert x tail))))
    (list x)))

(defun verina-advanced-37-insertion-sort (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-advanced-37-insert
       (car xs)
       (verina-advanced-37-insertion-sort
        (cdr xs)))
    nil))

;; This is the source getAt based on List.drop: index zero returns the head,
;; and every missing index returns the integer default zero.

(defun verina-advanced-37-get-at (xs index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (zp index)
          (car xs)
        (verina-advanced-37-get-at
         (cdr xs)
         (- index 1)))
    0))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; Sorting, length computation, midpoint division, and lookup remain connected
;; exactly as in the source executable definition.

(defun verina-advanced-37-majority-element (nums)
  (let* ((sorted
          (verina-advanced-37-insertion-sort nums))
         (length (len sorted))
         (middle (floor length 2)))
    (verina-advanced-37-get-at sorted middle)))

;; This universal list recursion is the source List.all condition: every
;; input entry either equals RESULT or occurs at most half as often as the
;; list length.

(defun verina-advanced-37-all-result-or-nonmajority-p
    (remaining whole result threshold)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or
        (equal (car remaining) result)
        (<=
         (verina-advanced-37-list-count
          (car remaining)
          whole)
         threshold))
       (verina-advanced-37-all-result-or-nonmajority-p
        (cdr remaining)
        whole
        result
        threshold))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-37-majority-element-postcond
    (nums result)
  (let ((threshold (floor (len nums) 2)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-37-integer-listp nums)
     (integerp result)
     (< threshold
        (verina-advanced-37-list-count result nums))
     (verina-advanced-37-all-result-or-nonmajority-p
      nums
      nums
      result
      threshold))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and complete source precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the executable result.

(defun verina-advanced-37-majority-element-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-37-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-37-majority-element-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-37-majority-element-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-37-majority-element nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_37,
-- catalog title "majorityElement": the insertion-sort midpoint program on
-- integer lists, its majority-element precondition and postcondition, and its
-- final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced37 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolOr : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolOr true right = true
boolOr false right = right

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

half : Nat → Nat
half zero = zero
half (suc zero) = zero
half (suc (suc n)) = suc (half n)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

countInt : Int → List Int → Nat
countInt sought [] = zero
countInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then suc (countInt sought xs)
  else countInt sought xs

anyMajority : List Int → List Int → Bool
anyMajority original [] = false
anyMajority original (x ∷ xs) =
  if natLess (half (listLength original)) (countInt x original)
  then true
  else anyMajority original xs

record majorityElement-precond (nums : List Int) : Set where
  constructor precondition
  field
    nonempty : zero < listLength nums
    majority-exists : IsTrue (anyMajority nums nums)

insert : Int → List Int → List Int
insert x [] = x ∷ []
insert x (head ∷ tail) =
  if intLessOrEqual x head
  then (x ∷ head ∷ tail)
  else (head ∷ insert x tail)

insertionSort : List Int → List Int
insertionSort [] = []
insertionSort (head ∷ tail) =
  insert head (insertionSort tail)

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

getAt : List Int → Nat → Int
getAt xs index with dropList index xs
... | [] = zeroInt
... | head ∷ tail = head

majorityElement :
  (nums : List Int) →
  majorityElement-precond nums →
  Int
majorityElement nums h-precond =
  let sorted = insertionSort nums
      len = listLength sorted
      mid = half len
  in
    getAt sorted mid

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

majorityElement-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  majorityElement-precond nums →
  Set
majorityElement-postcond nums result h-precond =
  (half (listLength nums) < countInt result nums) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ x →
        boolOr
          (intEqual x result)
          (natLessOrEqual
            (countInt x nums)
            (half (listLength nums))))
      nums)

majorityElement-spec-satisfied : Set
majorityElement-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : majorityElement-precond nums) →
  majorityElement-postcond
    nums
    (majorityElement nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_37,
  cataloged as "majorityElement": insertion-sorting an integer list and
  returning its middle element yields the guaranteed majority element and
  satisfies the stated occurrence-count contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val majorityElement_count_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_count_def",
  ``majorityElement_count (x : int) (nums : int list) =
      LENGTH (FILTER (\y : int. y = x) nums)``
);

val majorityElement_precond_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_precond_def",
  ``majorityElement_precond (nums : int list) <=>
      LENGTH nums > 0 /\
      EXISTS
        (\x : int.
          majorityElement_count x nums > LENGTH nums DIV 2)
        nums``
);

val majorityElement_insert_def = Define `
  (majorityElement_insert (x : int) ([] : int list) = [x]) /\
  (majorityElement_insert x (h::t) =
     if x <= h then
       x::h::t
     else
       h::majorityElement_insert x t)
`;

val majorityElement_insertionSort_def = Define `
  (majorityElement_insertionSort ([] : int list) = ([] : int list)) /\
  (majorityElement_insertionSort (h::t) =
     majorityElement_insert h (majorityElement_insertionSort t))
`;

val majorityElement_getAt_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_getAt_def",
  ``majorityElement_getAt (xs : int list) (i : num) =
      case DROP i xs of
        [] => (0 : int)
      | h::t => h``
);

val majorityElement_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_def",
  ``majorityElement (nums : int list) =
      let sorted = majorityElement_insertionSort nums
      in
        majorityElement_getAt sorted (LENGTH sorted DIV 2)``
);

val majorityElement_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "majorityElement_postcond_def",
  ``majorityElement_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : int) <=>
      let n = LENGTH nums
      in
        majorityElement_count result nums > n DIV 2 /\
        EVERY
          (\x : int.
            x = result \/ majorityElement_count x nums <= n DIV 2)
          nums``
);

val majorityElement_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      majorityElement_precond nums ==>
      majorityElement_postcond nums (majorityElement nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_37
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_37 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_37), catalog title
  majorityElement: exact recursive insertion sorting followed by middle-index
  lookup returns the majority integer of an arbitrary nonempty finite integer
  list satisfying the stated majority-existence precondition and correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set. VERINA37Count is List.count,
  and VERINA37Half is Lean natural-number division by two.

  VERINA37InsertGraph gives the exact computation of the local insert
  recursion. Its position p is the first input position whose value is at
  least the inserted integer, or the word length when there is no such
  position. The output copies the prefix, places the new integer at p, and
  shifts the remaining suffix by one. VERINA37Insert selects the unique word
  described by this graph.

  VERINA37SortGraph gives the exact computation of the local insertionSort
  recursion. Its trace begins with the empty word and inserts the input
  entries from right to left, matching
  insertionSort (h :: t) = insert h (insertionSort t).
  VERINA37InsertionSort selects the unique final trace value.

  VERINA37GetAt is exactly the local getAt helper: it returns the entry at a
  natural index when that index is in range and returns integer zero
  otherwise, matching the head of List.drop with the source default.
  VERINA37MajorityElement sorts the input, computes half of the sorted
  length, and applies that helper, exactly preserving the executable source
  program rather than selecting an output from the postcondition.

  VERINA37Pre is exactly positive length together with List.any of a value
  whose count exceeds floor(length / 2). VERINA37Post is exactly the strict
  majority bound for the result and List.all of the source disjunction for
  every input entry. The proof-valued precondition argument is
  computationally and propositionally unused and is omitted from the target
  function and postcondition. The final $a declaration is the source
  correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA37Count VERINA37Half
  VERINA37InsertGraph VERINA37Insert
  VERINA37SortGraph VERINA37InsertionSort
  VERINA37GetAt VERINA37MajorityElement
  VERINA37Pre VERINA37Post
$.

verina37-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37Count A B ) $.
verina37-half-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37Half A ) $.
verina37-insert-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA37InsertGraph A B C ) $.
verina37-insert-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37Insert A B ) $.
verina37-sort-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA37SortGraph A B ) $.
verina37-insertion-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37InsertionSort A ) $.
verina37-get-at-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37GetAt A B ) $.
verina37-majority-element-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA37MajorityElement A ) $.
verina37-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA37Pre A ) $.
verina37-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA37Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina37-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA37Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = B
    }
  ) $.
$}

verina37-half-definition $a |- (
  VERINA37Half A
) = (
  |_ ` ( ( # ` A ) / 2 )
) $.

${
  $d j p A B C $.

  verina37-insert-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA37InsertGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              -. A <_ ( B ` j )
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` B )
              ->
              A <_ ( B ` p )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
            /\
            (
              ( C ` p ) = A
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
                  ( C ` j ) = ( B ` j )
                /\
                A. j e. ( p ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( C ` ( j + 1 ) ) = ( B ` j )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina37-insert-definition $a |- (
    VERINA37Insert A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA37InsertGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verina37-sort-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA37SortGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA37InsertGraph
                ( A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k ) )
                ( t ` k )
                ( t ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina37-insertion-sort-definition $a |- (
    VERINA37InsertionSort A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA37SortGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina37-get-at-definition $a |- (
  VERINA37GetAt A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verina37-majority-element-definition $a |- (
  VERINA37MajorityElement A
) = (
  VERINA37GetAt
    ( VERINA37InsertionSort A )
    ( VERINA37Half ( VERINA37InsertionSort A ) )
) $.

${
  $d i A $.

  verina37-precondition-definition $a |- (

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 < len nums &
    (ex x being Integer st x in rng nums &
      len nums div 2 <
        len Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom nums & nums.i = x})) &
    (ex sorted being FinSequence of INT,
        states being FinSequence of INT* st
      len states = len nums + 1 &
      states/.1 = <*>INT &

      (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_37, catalog title "majorityElement": insertion-sorting an
% integer list and returning its middle element under a majority-existence
% precondition, with the specified majority-frequency contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_37: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  occurrence_count(
      requested: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = requested THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Exact floor division by two on natural numbers.
  nat_half(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value < 2 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      nat_half(value - 2) + 1
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  has_majority_value(
      remaining, whole: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        occurrence_count(head, whole)
            > nat_half(int_list_length(whole))
          OR has_majority_value(tail, whole)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  majorityElement_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(nums) > 0
      AND has_majority_value(nums, nums)

  insert_int(
      x: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(x, null),
      cons(head, tail):
        IF x <= head THEN
          cons(x, cons(head, tail))
        ELSE
          cons(head, insert_int(x, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  insertionSort(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        insert_int(head, insertionSort(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is exactly the source getAt defined by drop: out-of-range indices
  % return zero, and otherwise the element at the requested index is returned.
  int_list_nth_default(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_nth_default(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  majorityElement(nums: list[int]): int =
    LET sorted: list[int] = insertionSort(nums),
        length: nat = int_list_length(sorted),
        middle: nat = nat_half(length)
    IN
      int_list_nth_default(middle, sorted)

  all_nonmajority_or_result(
      result: int,
      original, remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (head = result
          OR occurrence_count(head, original)
               <= nat_half(int_list_length(original)))
          AND all_nonmajority_or_result(
            result,
            original,
            tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  majorityElement_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    occurrence_count(result, nums)
        > nat_half(int_list_length(nums))
      AND all_nonmajority_or_result(
        result,
        nums,
        nums)

  majorityElement_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      majorityElement_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        majorityElement_postcond(
          nums,
          majorityElement(nums))

END verina_advanced_37
