title: verina_advanced_4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_4,
   catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": an executable dynamic-
   programming computation of the longest strictly increasing subsequence
   length of an integer array, together with its exhaustive-subsequence
   maximality contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond
    (_a : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition intMax (x y : Z) : Z :=
  if Z.ltb x y then y else x.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_get
    (xs : list Z) (index : nat) : Z :=
  nth index xs 0.

Fixpoint LongestIncreasingSubsequence_set
    (index : nat) (value : Z) (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  match index, xs with
  | 0%nat, _ :: rest => value :: rest
  | S index', x :: rest =>
      x :: LongestIncreasingSubsequence_set index' value rest
  | _, [] => []
  end.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_cell
    (a : list Z)
    (i : nat)
    (dp : list Z)
    (j : nat) : list Z :=
  if Z.ltb
       (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_get a j)
       (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_get a i)
  then
    let newVal :=
      intMax
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_get dp i)
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_get dp j + 1) in
    LongestIncreasingSubsequence_set i newVal dp
  else dp.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_row
    (a : list Z)
    (dp : list Z)
    (i : nat) : list Z :=
  fold_left
    (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_cell a i)
    (seq 0%nat i)
    dp.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence
    (a : list Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a) : Z :=
  let n := length a in
  let initial := repeat 1 n in
  let dp :=
    fold_left
      (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_row a)
      (seq 1%nat (Nat.pred n))
      initial in
  match dp with
  | [] => 0
  | _ => fold_left intMax dp 0
  end.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq
    (a : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  map
    (fun sub : list Z => rev sub)
    (fold_left
      (fun acc x =>
        acc ++ map (fun sub => x :: sub) acc)
      a [[]]).

Fixpoint LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess
    (xs : list Z) : bool :=
  match xs with
  | [] => true
  | x :: rest =>
      andb
        (forallb (fun y => Z.ltb x y) rest)
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess rest)
  end.

Definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
    (a : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a) : Prop :=
  let allSubseq :=
    LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq a in
  let increasingSubseqLens :=
    map
      (fun xs : list Z => Z.of_nat (length xs))
      (filter LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess allSubseq) in
  existsb (Z.eqb result) increasingSubseqLens = true /\
  forallb
    (fun candidate => Z.leb candidate result)
    increasingSubseqLens = true.

Theorem LongestIncreasingSubsequence_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (h_precond : LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a) :
  LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
    a
    (LongestIncreasingSubsequence a h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_4,
  catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": an executable row-major
  dynamic program computes the length of a longest strictly increasing
  subsequence of an integer array, with its precondition and maximality
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_4
  imports Main
begin

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition intMax :: "int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "intMax x y = (if x < y then y else x)"

definition list_getBang ::
    "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "list_getBang dflt xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else dflt)"

definition list_setBang ::
    "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_cell ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat
      \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_cell a i dp j =
    (if list_getBang 0 a j < list_getBang 0 a i
     then
       list_setBang dp i
         (intMax (list_getBang 0 dp i) (list_getBang 0 dp j + 1))
     else dp)"

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_row ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_row a dp i =
    foldl (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_cell a i) dp [0..<i]"

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence a =
    (let n = length a;
         initial = replicate n 1;
         dp =
           foldl (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_row a)
             initial [1..<n]
     in case dp of
          [] \<Rightarrow> 0
        | _ \<Rightarrow> foldl intMax 0 dp)"

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq a =
    map rev
      (foldl
        (\<lambda>acc x. acc @ map (\<lambda>sub. x # sub) acc)
        [[]] a)"

fun LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess [] = True"
| "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x < y) xs \<and>
     LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess xs)"

definition LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond a result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let allSubseq = LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq a;
         increasingSubseqLens =
           map (\<lambda>subseq. int (length subseq))
             (filter LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLess allSubseq)
     in result \<in> set increasingSubseqLens \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>subseqLen. subseqLen \<le> result)
          increasingSubseqLens)"

theorem LongestIncreasingSubsequence_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a"
  shows
    "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
      a (LongestIncreasingSubsequence a)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_4,
  catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": an executable dynamic-
  programming array computation returns the length of a longest strictly
  increasing integer subsequence, with its total precondition and exhaustive-
  subsequence maximality postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond = new_definition
  `LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (a:int list) <=> T`;;

let intMax = new_definition
  `intMax (x:int) (y:int) = if x < y then y else x`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt n (TL xs))`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_setInt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!value:int. !xs:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_setInt 0 value xs =
        if xs = [] then [] else CONS value (TL xs)) /\
     (!n:num. !value:int. !xs:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_setInt (SUC n) value xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else CONS (HD xs)
          (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_setInt n value (TL xs)))`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillInner =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !a:int list. !dp:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillInner 0 i a dp = dp) /\
     (!j:num. !i:num. !a:int list. !dp:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillInner (SUC j) i a dp =
        let previous =
          LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillInner j i a dp in
        if LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt j a <
             LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt i a
        then
          let newVal =
            intMax
              (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt i previous)
              (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_getInt j previous + &1) in
          LongestIncreasingSubsequence_setInt i newVal previous
        else previous)`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillOuter =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list. !dp:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillOuter 0 a dp = dp) /\
     (!k:num. !a:int list. !dp:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillOuter (SUC k) a dp =
        let previous =
          LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillOuter k a dp in
        let i = SUC k in
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillInner i i a previous)`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_maxFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_maxFold acc [] = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_maxFold acc (CONS x xs) =
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_maxFold
          (intMax acc x) xs)`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence = new_definition
  `LongestIncreasingSubsequence (a:int list) =
     let n = LENGTH a in
     let initialDp = REPLICATE n (&1:int) in
     let finalDp =
       LongestIncreasingSubsequence_fillOuter (n - 1) a initialDp in
     LongestIncreasingSubsequence_maxFold (&0:int) finalDp`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_subseqFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int list)list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_subseqFold
          ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:(int list)list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_subseqFold
          (CONS x xs) acc =
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_subseqFold
          xs
          (APPEND acc
            (MAP (\sub:int list. CONS x sub) acc)))`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq = new_definition
  `LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq (a:int list) =
     MAP REVERSE
       (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_subseqFold
         a (CONS ([]:int list) []))`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseIncreasing =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseIncreasing
        ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseIncreasing
          (CONS x xs) <=>
        ALL (\y:int. x < y) xs /\
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseIncreasing xs)`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond = new_definition
  `LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
      (a:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let allSubseq =
       LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq a in
     let increasingSubseqLens =
       MAP (\l:int list. (&(LENGTH l):int))
         (FILTER
           LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseIncreasing
           allSubseq) in
     MEM result increasingSubseqLens /\
     ALL (\k:int. k <= result) increasingSubseqLens`;;

let LongestIncreasingSubsequence_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list.
     LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a
     ==> LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
           a (LongestIncreasingSubsequence a)`;;

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_4,
;; "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": a deterministic array dynamic program
;; returns the length of a longest strictly increasing subsequence, with its
;; exhaustive subsequence correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean Array Int is represented canonically by a proper ACL2 list of
;; integers.

(defun verina-advanced-4-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-4-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence-precond
    (a)
  (declare (ignore a))
  t)

;; Exact translation of the source helper on integers.

(defun verina-advanced-4-int-max (x y)
  (if (< x y)
      y
    x))

;; Array.mkArray n 1 is represented by a proper list of n integer ones.

(defun verina-advanced-4-make-ones (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     1
     (verina-advanced-4-make-ones
      (- count 1)))))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns zero outside the array. All reads reached by
;; the source loops are in bounds, while this definition also preserves the
;; source operation's total default behavior.

(defun verina-advanced-4-array-read (index array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (car array)
          (verina-advanced-4-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr array)))
      0)))

;; Array.set! at a valid index replaces exactly that entry. The reachable
;; source indices are valid; out-of-bounds indices leave the array unchanged.

(defun verina-advanced-4-array-set
    (index value array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      array
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons value (cdr array))
          (cons
           (car array)
           (verina-advanced-4-array-set
            (- index 1)
            value
            (cdr array))))
      nil)))

;; This is one complete source inner loop, processing j = 0,...,i-1 in order.
;; The mutable DP state is updated immediately after each successful
;; comparison, exactly as in the Id.run computation.

(defun verina-advanced-4-dp-inner-loop
    (a i j remaining dp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      dp
    (let* ((a-j
            (verina-advanced-4-array-read j a))
           (a-i
            (verina-advanced-4-array-read i a))
           (next-dp
            (if (< a-j a-i)
                (let* ((dp-i
                        (verina-advanced-4-array-read i dp))
                       (dp-j
                        (verina-advanced-4-array-read j dp))
                       (new-value
                        (verina-advanced-4-int-max
                         dp-i
                         (+ dp-j 1))))
                  (verina-advanced-4-array-set
                   i
                   new-value
                   dp))
              dp)))
      (verina-advanced-4-dp-inner-loop
       a
       i
       (+ j 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       next-dp))))

;; This is the source outer loop i = 1,...,n-1. At each index, the inner loop
;; consumes the already established prefix of DP entries.

(defun verina-advanced-4-dp-outer-loop
    (a i remaining dp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      dp
    (let ((next-dp
           (verina-advanced-4-dp-inner-loop
            a
            i
            0
            i
            dp)))
      (verina-advanced-4-dp-outer-loop
       a
       (+ i 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       next-dp))))

;; Exact left fold of intMax with initial value zero.

(defun verina-advanced-4-fold-int-max
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-4-fold-int-max
       (cdr remaining)
       (verina-advanced-4-int-max
        accumulator
        (car remaining)))
    accumulator))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; These bindings reproduce Array.mkArray, both sequential ranges, the empty
;; array match, and the final fold of the source implementation.

(defun verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence
    (a)
  (let* ((n (len a))
         (initial-dp
          (verina-advanced-4-make-ones n))
         (final-dp
          (verina-advanced-4-dp-outer-loop
           a
           1
           (nfix (- n 1))
           initial-dp)))
    (if (endp final-dp)
        0
      (verina-advanced-4-fold-int-max
       final-dp
       0))))

;; The next definitions reproduce the postcondition's local allSubseq. At
;; each input element, the accumulator is followed by a mapped copy with that
;; element prepended; every final subsequence is then reversed.

(defun verina-advanced-4-prepend-to-each
    (value subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (cons value (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-4-prepend-to-each
        value
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-4-all-subseq-fold
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-4-all-subseq-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (append
        accumulator
        (verina-advanced-4-prepend-to-each
         (car remaining)
         accumulator)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-4-reverse-each
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (reverse (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-4-reverse-each
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-4-all-subseq (a)
  (verina-advanced-4-reverse-each
   (verina-advanced-4-all-subseq-fold
    a
    (list nil))))

;; These predicates are a direct Boolean rendering of List.Pairwise (<):
;; every head is less than every later element, recursively.

(defun verina-advanced-4-head-less-than-all-p
    (head tail)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count tail)))
  (if (consp tail)
      (and
       (< head (car tail))
       (verina-advanced-4-head-less-than-all-p
        head
        (cdr tail)))
    (equal tail nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-4-strictly-increasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-4-head-less-than-all-p
        (car xs)
        (cdr xs))
       (verina-advanced-4-strictly-increasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-4-filter-increasing
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (if (verina-advanced-4-strictly-increasing-p
           (car subsequences))
          (cons
           (car subsequences)
           (verina-advanced-4-filter-increasing
            (cdr subsequences)))
        (verina-advanced-4-filter-increasing
         (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-4-map-lengths
    (subsequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsequences)))
  (if (consp subsequences)
      (cons
       (len (car subsequences))
       (verina-advanced-4-map-lengths
        (cdr subsequences)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-4-contains-length-p
    (lengths result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lengths)))
  (if (consp lengths)
      (or
       (equal (car lengths) result)
       (verina-advanced-4-contains-length-p
        (cdr lengths)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-4-all-lengths-at-most-p
    (lengths result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lengths)))
  (if (consp lengths)
      (and
       (<= (car lengths) result)
       (verina-advanced-4-all-lengths-at-most-p
        (cdr lengths)
        result))
    t))

(defun
    verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence-postcond
    (a result)
  (let* ((all-subseq
          (verina-advanced-4-all-subseq a))
         (increasing-subseq
          (verina-advanced-4-filter-increasing
           all-subseq))
         (increasing-subseq-lengths
          (verina-advanced-4-map-lengths
           increasing-subseq)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-4-integer-listp a)
     (integerp result)
     (verina-advanced-4-contains-length-p
      increasing-subseq-lengths
      result)
     (verina-advanced-4-all-lengths-at-most-p
      increasing-subseq-lengths
      result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the Array Int binder and True precondition, while its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence-spec-satisfied-statement
    (a)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-4-integer-listp a)
    (verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence-precond
     a))
   (verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence-postcond
    a
    (verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence
     a))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_4,
-- catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": a deterministic dynamic-programming
-- program computes a longest strictly increasing integer-array subsequence length
-- and is connected to its exhaustive maximality contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

oneInt : Int
oneInt = pos (suc zero)

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y then y else x

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize = listLength

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

repeatList : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A
repeatList zero value = []
repeatList (suc n) value = value ∷ repeatList n value

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

setNth : {A : Set} → Nat → A → List A → List A
setNth zero value [] = []
setNth zero value (_ ∷ xs) = value ∷ xs
setNth (suc n) value [] = []
setNth (suc n) value (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ setNth n value xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

indicesAfterZero : Nat → List Nat
indicesAfterZero zero = []
indicesAfterZero (suc count) = rangeFrom (suc zero) count

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

LongestIncreasingSubsequence-precond : Array Int → Set
LongestIncreasingSubsequence-precond a = Top

updateDPEntry :
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  List Int
updateDPEntry a i dp j =
  if (intLess
        (nthDefault zeroInt j a)
        (nthDefault zeroInt i a))
  then
    (let newValue =
           intMax
             (nthDefault zeroInt i dp)
             (intSuccessor (nthDefault zeroInt j dp))
     in setNth i newValue dp)
  else dp

updateDPAtIndex :
  Array Int →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  List Int
updateDPAtIndex a dp i =
  foldLeft (updateDPEntry a i) dp (range i)

buildDP : Array Int → List Int
buildDP a =
  foldLeft
    (updateDPAtIndex a)
    (repeatList (arraySize a) oneInt)
    (indicesAfterZero (arraySize a))

LongestIncreasingSubsequence :
  (a : Array Int) →
  LongestIncreasingSubsequence-precond a →
  Int
LongestIncreasingSubsequence a h-precond with buildDP a
... | [] = zeroInt
... | x ∷ xs = foldLeft intMax zeroInt (x ∷ xs)

allSubseqStep :
  List (List Int) →
  Int →
  List (List Int)
allSubseqStep accumulator x =
  appendList
    accumulator
    (mapList (λ subsequence → x ∷ subsequence) accumulator)

allSubseq : Array Int → List (List Int)
allSubseq a =
  mapList
    reverseList
    (foldLeft allSubseqStep ([] ∷ []) a)

pairwiseIntLess : List Int → Bool
pairwiseIntLess [] = true
pairwiseIntLess (x ∷ xs) =
  allList (intLess x) xs && pairwiseIntLess xs

increasingSubsequenceLengths : Array Int → List Int
increasingSubsequenceLengths a =
  mapList
    (λ subsequence → pos (listLength subsequence))
    (filterList pairwiseIntLess (allSubseq a))

LongestIncreasingSubsequence-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  LongestIncreasingSubsequence-precond a →
  Set
LongestIncreasingSubsequence-postcond a result h-precond =
  let increasing-lengths = increasingSubsequenceLengths a
  in
    IsTrue (containsInt result increasing-lengths) ∧
    IsTrue
      (allList
        (λ length → intLessOrEqual length result)
        increasing-lengths)

LongestIncreasingSubsequence-spec-satisfied : Set
LongestIncreasingSubsequence-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : LongestIncreasingSubsequence-precond a) →
  LongestIncreasingSubsequence-postcond
    a
    (LongestIncreasingSubsequence a h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_4,
  cataloged as "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": the executable dynamic-
  programming program returns an attained maximal length of a strictly
  increasing subsequence of an integer array. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (a : int list) <=> T``
);

val intMax_def = new_definition (
  "intMax_def",
  ``intMax (x : int) (y : int) =
      if x < y then y else x``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_update_cell_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_update_cell_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_update_cell
      (a : int list)
      (i : num)
      (dp : int list)
      (j : num) =
      if EL j a < EL i a then
        let newVal = intMax (EL i dp) (EL j dp + 1)
        in
          LUPDATE newVal i dp
      else
        dp``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_process_index_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_process_index_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_process_index
      (a : int list)
      (dp : int list)
      (i : num) =
      FOLDL
        (\table j.
           LongestIncreasingSubsequence_update_cell a i table j)
        dp
        (GENLIST (\j. j) i)``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_table_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_table_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_table (a : int list) =
      let n = LENGTH a in
      FOLDL
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_process_index a)
        (GENLIST (\k. (1 : int)) n)
        (GENLIST (\k. k + 1) (n - 1))``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence (a : int list) =
      FOLDL intMax 0 (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_table a)``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq (a : int list) =
      MAP REVERSE
        (FOLDL
          (\acc x. acc ++ MAP (\sub. x::sub) acc)
          ([[]] : int list list)
          a)``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLt_def = Define `
  (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLt ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLt (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x < y) xs /\
      LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLt xs))
`;

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_increasingSubseqLens_def =
  new_definition (
    "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_increasingSubseqLens_def",
    ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_increasingSubseqLens
        (a : int list) =
        MAP
          (\sub : int list. int_of_num (LENGTH sub))
          (FILTER
            LongestIncreasingSubsequence_pairwiseLt
            (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_allSubseq a))``
  );

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond_def",
  ``LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
      (a : int list) (result : int) <=>
      MEM result
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_increasingSubseqLens a) /\
      EVERY
        (\len : int. len <= result)
        (LongestIncreasingSubsequence_increasingSubseqLens a)``
);

val LongestIncreasingSubsequence_spec_satisfied =
  ``!a : int list.
      LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a ==>
      LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
        a (LongestIncreasingSubsequence a)``;

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_4 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_4), catalog title
  LongestIncreasingSubsequence: the exact nested-loop dynamic-programming
  program returns the integer length of a longest strictly increasing
  subsequence of an arbitrary finite integer array, with its exhaustive
  maximality contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains.
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays, and
  Word ( Word ZZ ) is the type of finite lists of such arrays. For a word w,
  # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA4IntMax is exactly the source integer maximum helper.
  VERINA4DPGraph is an exact graph of the mutable nested-loop computation.
  For each outer index i, its witness s records the successive values of
  dp[i] while the inner loop visits j = 0,...,i-1. It starts at the
  Array.mkArray value one and, precisely when a[j] < a[i], changes by the
  source intMax applied to the current cell and the already-final dp[j] + 1.
  The i = 0 instance records the untouched initial cell. These well-founded
  recurrences uniquely determine exactly the final mutable array, and
  VERINA4DP selects it.

  VERINA4MaxFoldGraph reproduces dp.foldl intMax 0 entry by entry, and
  VERINA4MaxFold selects its unique integer output.
  VERINA4LongestIncreasingSubsequence preserves the source empty-array match
  explicitly and otherwise applies that fold to VERINA4DP. Thus its result is
  fixed by the executable program rather than selected from the postcondition.

  VERINA4BitSet and VERINA4MaskWordGraph give an exact indexed account of the
  source allSubseq fold
    acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)
  from [[]], followed by List.reverse. Mask r selects exactly input position
  k when bit k of r is one; numeric mask order is the fold's append order, and
  the selected positions occur in increasing input order after reversal.
  Hence VERINA4Subsequences preserves the order, duplicates, and all
  2^(length a) occurrences produced by that executable list computation.
  VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing is exactly List.Pairwise (<).
  VERINA4IncreasingLensGraph is the stable filter by that predicate followed
  by List.length, with each natural length canonically embedded in ZZ as
  required by the source's Int result comparison. VERINA4Post then reproduces
  List.contains and List.all without collapsing the computed list.

  VERINA4Pre is the source True precondition together with the Array Int input
  type. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA4IntMax
  VERINA4DPGraph VERINA4DP
  VERINA4MaxFoldGraph VERINA4MaxFold
  VERINA4LongestIncreasingSubsequence VERINA4Pre
  VERINA4BitSet VERINA4MaskWordGraph
  VERINA4SubsequencesGraph VERINA4Subsequences
  VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing
  VERINA4IncreasingLensGraph VERINA4IncreasingLens
  VERINA4Post
$.

verina4-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4IntMax A B ) $.
verina4-dp-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4DPGraph A B ) $.
verina4-dp-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4DP A ) $.
verina4-max-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4MaxFoldGraph A B ) $.
verina4-max-fold-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4MaxFold A ) $.
verina4-longest-increasing-subsequence-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4LongestIncreasingSubsequence A ) $.
verina4-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4Pre A ) $.
verina4-bit-set-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4BitSet A B ) $.
verina4-mask-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4MaskWordGraph A B C ) $.
verina4-subsequences-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4SubsequencesGraph A B ) $.
verina4-subsequences-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4Subsequences A ) $.
verina4-strictly-increasing-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing A ) $.
verina4-increasing-lens-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4IncreasingLensGraph A B ) $.
verina4-increasing-lens-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA4IncreasingLens A ) $.
verina4-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA4Post A B ) $.

verina4-int-max-definition $a |- (
  VERINA4IntMax A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  B ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d i j s A B $.

  verina4-dp-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4DPGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        E. s e. Word ZZ
          (
            (
              ( # ` s ) = ( i + 1 )
              /\
              ( s ` 0 ) = 1
            )
            /\
            (
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ i )
                (
                  s ` ( j + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  ( A ` j ) < ( A ` i ) ,
                  (
                    VERINA4IntMax
                      ( s ` j )
                      ( ( B ` j ) + 1 )
                  ) ,
                  ( s ` j )
                )
              /\
              ( B ` i ) = ( s ` i )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina4-dp-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4DP A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA4DPGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s A B $.

  verina4-max-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4MaxFoldGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word ZZ
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = 0
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = (
              VERINA4IntMax
                ( s ` k )
                ( A ` k )
            )
          /\
          B = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina4-max-fold-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4MaxFold A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA4MaxFoldGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina4-longest-increasing-subsequence-definition $a |- (
  VERINA4LongestIncreasingSubsequence A
) = if (
  ( VERINA4DP A ) = (/) ,
  0 ,
  ( VERINA4MaxFold ( VERINA4DP A ) )
) $.

verina4-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA4Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

verina4-bit-set-definition $a |- (
  VERINA4BitSet A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2
  ) = 1
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina4-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4MaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( VERINA4BitSet B k )
              <->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B $.

  verina4-subsequences-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4SubsequencesGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )
      /\
      A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          VERINA4MaskWordGraph
            A
            r
            ( B ` r )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina4-subsequences-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4Subsequences A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA4SubsequencesGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina4-strictly-increasing-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) < ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina4-increasing-lens-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4IncreasingLensGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` i )
                <
                ( # ` ( VERINA4Subsequences A ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing
                  (
                    ( VERINA4Subsequences A )
                    ` ( p ` i )
                  )
                /\
                (
                  B ` i
                ) = (
                  # ` (
                    ( VERINA4Subsequences A )
                    ` ( p ` i )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. (
            0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA4Subsequences A ) )
          )
            (
              (
                VERINA4StrictlyIncreasing
                  ( ( VERINA4Subsequences A ) ` k )
              )
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina4-increasing-lens-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4IncreasingLens A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA4IncreasingLensGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina4-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA4Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      B e. ran ( VERINA4IncreasingLens A )
      /\
      A. k e. (
        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA4IncreasingLens A ) )
      )
        (
          ( VERINA4IncreasingLens A ) ` k
        ) <_ B
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-4-longest-increasing-subsequence
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA4Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA4Post
          w
          ( VERINA4LongestIncreasingSubsequence w )
      )
    )
  $.

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_4, catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": an exact
:: finite-sequence operational graph of the unconditional precondition,
:: intMax helper, nested-loop dynamic-programming implementation, exhaustive
:: increasing-subsequence postcondition, and final correctness contract.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, FINSEQOP,
    XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 = 0 &
    ((len a = 0 & result = 0) or
     (0 < len a &
      ex outerStates being FinSequence of INT*,
         finalDP being FinSequence of INT st
        len outerStates = len a &
        (ex initial being FinSequence of INT st
          initial = outerStates/.1 &
          len initial = len a &
          for r being Nat st r in dom initial holds initial/.r = 1) &
        finalDP = outerStates/.(len a) &
        (for p being Nat st p in dom a & 1 < p holds
          ex current,next being FinSequence of INT,
             innerStates being FinSequence of INT* st
            current = outerStates/.(p -' 1) &
            next = outerStates/.p &
            len innerStates = p &
            innerStates/.1 = current &
            innerStates/.p = next &
            for q being Nat st 1 <= q & q < p holds
              ex before,after being FinSequence of INT st
                before = innerStates/.q &
                after = innerStates/.(q + 1) &
                len after = len before &
                ((a/.q < a/.p &
                  ((before/.p < before/.q + 1 &
                    after/.p = before/.q + 1) or
                   (not before/.p < before/.q + 1 &
                    after/.p = before/.p)) &
                  for r being Nat st r in dom after & r <> p holds
                    after/.r = before/.r) or
                 (not a/.q < a/.p & after = before))) &
        (ex maxStates being FinSequence of INT st
          len maxStates = len finalDP + 1 &
          maxStates/.1 = 0 &
          result = maxStates/.(len finalDP + 1) &
          for k being Nat st k in dom finalDP holds
            ((maxStates/.k < finalDP/.k &
              maxStates/.(k + 1) = finalDP/.k) or
             (not maxStates/.k < finalDP/.k &
              maxStates/.(k + 1) = maxStates/.k)))))
  holds
    ex postStates being Function of NAT,(INT*)*,
       rawPost,allSubseq,postIncreasing being FinSequence of INT*,
       postSelected being FinSequence of NAT,
       lens being FinSequence of INT st
      (ex initial being FinSequence of INT* st
        initial = postStates/.1 &
        len initial = 1 &
        initial/.1 = <*>INT) &
      rawPost = postStates/.(len a + 1) &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom a holds
        ex current,next being FinSequence of INT* st
          current = postStates/.k &
          next = postStates/.(k + 1) &
          len next = 2 * len current &
          for j being Nat st j in dom current holds
            ex tail being FinSequence of INT st
              tail = current/.j &
              next/.j = tail &
              next/.(len current + j) = (<*a/.k*> ^ tail)) &
      len allSubseq = len rawPost &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom allSubseq holds
        ex s being FinSequence of INT st
          s = rawPost/.j &
          allSubseq/.j = Rev s) &
      len postSelected = len postIncreasing &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom postSelected holds
        postSelected/.k in dom allSubseq &
        ex s being FinSequence of INT st
          s = allSubseq/.(postSelected/.k) &
          postIncreasing/.k = s) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom postSelected & h in dom postSelected & k < h
      holds postSelected/.k < postSelected/.h) &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom allSubseq holds
        (j in rng postSelected iff
          ex s being FinSequence of INT st
            s = allSubseq/.j &
            for q being Nat st 1 <= q & q < len s holds
              s/.q < s/.(q + 1))) &
      len lens = len postIncreasing &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom lens holds
        ex s being FinSequence of INT st
          s = postIncreasing/.k &
          lens/.k = len s) &
      result in rng lens &
      for k being Nat st k in dom lens holds lens/.k <= result
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_4, catalog title "LongestIncreasingSubsequence": computing
% the length of a longest strictly increasing integer subsequence with the
% specified dynamic-programming array loops and exhaustive-subsequence
% correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_4: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists give the exact extensional contents and order of the Lean
  % arrays observed by this program.
  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_set_bang(
      index: nat,
      new_value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(new_value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_set_bang(
              index - 1,
              new_value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_array_mk(
      size: nat,
      initial_value: int): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        initial_value,
        int_array_mk(size - 1, initial_value))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE size

  intMax(x, y: int): int =
    IF x < y THEN y ELSE x ENDIF

  int_max_fold(
      values: list[int],
      accumulator: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_max_fold(tail, intMax(accumulator, head))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond(
      a: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  lis_inner_loop(
      a: list[int],
      i, j, remaining: nat,
      dp: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET updated_dp: list[int] =
        IF int_list_get_bang(j, a)
             < int_list_get_bang(i, a)
        THEN
          int_list_set_bang(
            i,
            intMax(
              int_list_get_bang(i, dp),
              int_list_get_bang(j, dp) + 1),
            dp)
        ELSE
          dp
        ENDIF
      IN
        lis_inner_loop(
          a,
          i,
          j + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          updated_dp)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  lis_outer_loop(
      a: list[int],
      i, remaining: nat,
      dp: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      dp
    ELSE
      LET updated_dp: list[int] =
        lis_inner_loop(
          a,
          i,
          0,
          i,
          dp)
      IN
        lis_outer_loop(
          a,
          i + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          updated_dp)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  dp_result(dp: list[int]): int =
    CASES dp OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_max_fold(dp, 0)
    ENDCASES

  LongestIncreasingSubsequence(
      a: list[int]): int =
    LET n: nat = int_list_length(a),
        initial_dp: list[int] =
          int_array_mk(n, 1),
        final_dp: list[int] =
          lis_outer_loop(
            a,
            1,
            IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n - 1 ENDIF,
            initial_dp)
    IN
      dp_result(final_dp)

  append_int_list_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_list_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_to_each(
      x: int,
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(x, head),
          prepend_to_each(x, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  all_subsequences_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      accumulator: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(x, rest):
        all_subsequences_fold(
          rest,
          append_int_list_lists(
            accumulator,
            prepend_to_each(x, accumulator)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null)

  reverse_each(
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          reverse_int_list(head),
          reverse_each(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  all_strictly_greater_than(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower < head
          AND all_strictly_greater_than(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_strictly_increasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_strictly_greater_than(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_strictly_increasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  increasing_subsequence_lengths(
      subsequences: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES subsequences OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF pairwise_strictly_increasing(head) THEN
          cons(
            int_list_length(head),
            increasing_subsequence_lengths(tail))
        ELSE
          increasing_subsequence_lengths(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsequences BY <<

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[int],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND int_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET allSubseq: list[list[int]] =
          reverse_each(
            all_subsequences_fold(
              a,
              cons(null[int], null[list[int]]))),
        increasingSubseqLens: list[int] =
          increasing_subsequence_lengths(allSubseq)
    IN
      int_list_contains(increasingSubseqLens, result)
        AND int_list_all_at_most(
          increasingSubseqLens,
          result)

  LongestIncreasingSubsequence_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int]):
      LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond(a) IMPLIES
        LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond(
          a,
          LongestIncreasingSubsequence(a))

END verina_advanced_4

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_40,
   catalog title "maxOfList": an executable recursive computation of the
   maximum element of a nonempty natural-number list, together with its
   membership and upper-bound correctness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition maxOfList_precond (lst : list nat) : Prop :=
  lst <> [].

Fixpoint maxOfList_helper (lst : list nat) : nat :=
  match lst with
  | [] => 0
  | [x] => x
  | x :: xs =>
      let maxTail := maxOfList_helper xs in
      if Nat.ltb maxTail x then x else maxTail
  end.

Definition maxOfList
    (lst : list nat)
    (_h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst) : nat :=
  maxOfList_helper lst.

Definition maxOfList_postcond
    (lst : list nat)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst) : Prop :=
  In result lst /\
  forall x : nat, In x lst -> Nat.le x result.

Theorem maxOfList_spec_satisfied
    (lst : list nat)
    (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst) :
  maxOfList_postcond
    lst (maxOfList lst h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

  `!lst:num list.

;; "maxOfList": the recursive program returns a member of a nonempty list of
;; natural numbers that is at least every element. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-40-nat-listp (lst)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (and
       (natp (car lst))
       (verina-advanced-40-nat-listp (cdr lst)))
    (equal lst nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-precond (lst)
  (not (equal lst nil)))

;; This is the source local helper: the empty branch returns zero, the
;; singleton branch returns its element, and a longer list compares its head
;; with the recursively computed maximum of its tail.

(defun verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-helper (lst)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (if (consp (cdr lst))
          (let ((max-tail
                 (verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-helper
                  (cdr lst))))
            (if (> (car lst) max-tail)
                (car lst)
              max-tail))
        (car lst))
    0))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant, so
;; this wrapper is exactly the executable content of the source definition.

(defun verina-advanced-40-max-of-list (lst)
  (verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-helper lst))

;; This recursion is the bounded universal quantifier over list membership in
;; the source postcondition.

(defun verina-advanced-40-all-elements-at-most-p
    (lst result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (and
       (<= (car lst) result)
       (verina-advanced-40-all-elements-at-most-p
        (cdr lst)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-postcond
    (lst result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-40-nat-listp lst)
   (natp result)
   (member-equal result lst)
   (verina-advanced-40-all-elements-at-most-p
    lst
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Nat binder and nonempty-list precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-spec-satisfied-statement
    (lst)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-40-nat-listp lst)
    (verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-precond lst))
   (verina-advanced-40-max-of-list-postcond
    lst
    (verina-advanced-40-max-of-list lst))))

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_40,
-- catalog title "maxOfList": a deterministic recursive program returns a
-- maximum member of a nonempty list of natural numbers. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced40 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _∈_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

data _∈_ (x : Nat) : List Nat → Set where
  here : {xs : List Nat} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : Nat} {xs : List Nat} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

maxOfList-precond : List Nat → Set
maxOfList-precond lst = Not (lst ≡ [])

maxOfListHelper : List Nat → Nat
maxOfListHelper [] = zero
maxOfListHelper (x ∷ []) = x
maxOfListHelper (x ∷ y ∷ xs) =
  let maxTail = maxOfListHelper (y ∷ xs)
  in
    if natLess maxTail x
    then x
    else maxTail

maxOfList :
  (lst : List Nat) →
  maxOfList-precond lst →
  Nat
maxOfList lst h-precond = maxOfListHelper lst

maxOfList-postcond :
  (lst : List Nat) →
  (result : Nat) →
  maxOfList-precond lst →
  Set
maxOfList-postcond lst result h-precond =
  (result ∈ lst) ∧
  ((x : Nat) → x ∈ lst → x ≤ result)

maxOfList-spec-satisfied : Set
maxOfList-spec-satisfied =
  (lst : List Nat) →
  (h-precond : maxOfList-precond lst) →
  maxOfList-postcond
    lst
    (maxOfList lst h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_40 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_40), catalog title
  maxOfList: the exact recursive natural-number list program returns an
  element of every nonempty input list that bounds all its elements above.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA40HelperGraph gives the exact computation of the source local helper.
  Its trace begins at zero, the result for the empty list, and visits the
  input from right to left. At each step it returns the current element when
  that element is greater than the recursively computed tail result, and
  otherwise retains the tail result. For a singleton, comparison with the
  initial zero returns its sole natural-number element, exactly matching the
  source singleton branch. VERINA40Helper selects the unique trace result,
  and VERINA40MaxOfList is the source executable implementation.

  VERINA40Pre is the nonempty-list precondition. VERINA40Post says that the
  result occurs at an input position and that every input position contains
  a value at most the result, exactly representing List membership and the
  source boundedness clause. The proof-valued precondition argument is
  computationally and propositionally unused and is omitted from the target
  function and predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA40HelperGraph VERINA40Helper
  VERINA40Pre VERINA40MaxOfList VERINA40Post
$.

verina40-helper-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA40HelperGraph A B ) $.
verina40-helper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA40Helper A ) $.
verina40-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA40Pre A ) $.
verina40-max-of-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA40MaxOfList A ) $.
verina40-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA40Post A B ) $.

${
  $d k s A B $.

  verina40-helper-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA40HelperGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = 0
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = (
              if (
                (
                  s ` k
                ) < (
                  A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k )
                )
                ,
                (
                  A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k )
                )
                ,
                ( s ` k )
              )
            )
          /\
          B = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina40-helper-definition $a |- (
    VERINA40Helper A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA40HelperGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina40-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA40Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word NN0
  /\
  0 < ( # ` A )
) $.

verina40-max-of-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINA40MaxOfList A
) = (
  VERINA40Helper A
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verina40-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA40Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( A ` i ) = B
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( A ` j ) <_ B
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-40-max-of-list $a |- A. w e. Word NN0
  (
    ( VERINA40Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA40Post
        w
        ( VERINA40MaxOfList w )
    )
  )
$.

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_40, catalog title "maxOfList": recursively computing the
% maximum element of a nonempty list of natural numbers and specifying
% membership and upper-bound correctness. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_40: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_member(
      value: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR nat_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxOfList_precond(lst: list[nat]): bool =
    nat_list_length(lst) > 0

  maxOfList_helper(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null:
            head,
          cons(next, rest):
            LET max_tail: nat = maxOfList_helper(tail)
            IN
              IF head > max_tail THEN
                head
              ELSE
                max_tail
              ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxOfList(lst: list[nat]): nat =
    maxOfList_helper(lst)

  maxOfList_postcond(
      lst: list[nat],
      result: nat): bool =
    nat_member(result, lst)
      AND (FORALL (value: nat):
        nat_member(value, lst) IMPLIES value <= result)

  maxOfList_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (lst: list[nat]):
      maxOfList_precond(lst) IMPLIES
        maxOfList_postcond(
          lst,
          maxOfList(lst))

END verina_advanced_40

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_41,
;; "maxOfThree": the deterministic integer program returns one of three inputs
;; and a value at least as large as each input. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The Int binder domains are explicit in the
;; final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-41-max-of-three-precond (a b c)
  (declare (ignore a b c))
  t)

;; This preserves the source's ordered conditional computation: choose a when
;; it is at least b and c, otherwise choose b when it is at least a and c, and
;; otherwise choose c. The proof-valued precondition argument is erased because
;; it has no computational effect.

(defun verina-advanced-41-max-of-three (a b c)
  (if (and (>= a b)
           (>= a c))
      a
    (if (and (>= b a)
             (>= b c))
        b
      c)))

(defun verina-advanced-41-max-of-three-postcond
    (a b c result)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (integerp c)
   (integerp result)
   (>= result a)
   (>= result b)
   (>= result c)
   (or
    (equal result a)
    (equal result b)
    (equal result c))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its antecedent
;; preserves the three Int binders and True precondition; its conclusion applies
;; the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun verina-advanced-41-max-of-three-spec-satisfied-statement
    (a b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (integerp a)
    (integerp b)
    (integerp c)
    (verina-advanced-41-max-of-three-precond a b c))
   (verina-advanced-41-max-of-three-postcond
    a
    b
    c
    (verina-advanced-41-max-of-three a b c))))

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_41,
-- catalog title "maxOfThree": a deterministic nested-comparison program
-- returns the greatest of three integers and is connected to its maximum-value
-- correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced41 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual x y = intLessOrEqual y x

IntGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntGreaterOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intGreaterOrEqual x y)

maxOfThree-precond : Int → Int → Int → Set
maxOfThree-precond a b c = Top

maxOfThree :
  (a b c : Int) →
  maxOfThree-precond a b c →
  Int
maxOfThree a b c h-precond =
  if intGreaterOrEqual a b && intGreaterOrEqual a c
  then a
  else
    if intGreaterOrEqual b a && intGreaterOrEqual b c
    then b
    else c

maxOfThree-postcond :
  (a b c result : Int) →
  maxOfThree-precond a b c →
  Set
maxOfThree-postcond a b c result h-precond =
  (IntGreaterOrEqual result a ∧
   IntGreaterOrEqual result b ∧
   IntGreaterOrEqual result c) ∧
  (result ≡ a ∨ result ≡ b ∨ result ≡ c)

maxOfThree-spec-satisfied : Set
maxOfThree-spec-satisfied =
  (a b c : Int) →
  (h-precond : maxOfThree-precond a b c) →
  maxOfThree-postcond
    a
    b
    c
    (maxOfThree a b c h-precond)
    h-precond
