title: verina_advanced_42
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_42,
   catalog title "maxProfit": an executable scan computing the maximum profit
   from one purchase followed by one later sale, together with its indexed
   optimality and zero-profit correctness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition maxProfit_precond (_prices : list nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition updateMinAndProfit
    (price minSoFar maxProfit : nat) : nat * nat :=
  let newMin := Nat.min minSoFar price in
  let profit :=
    if Nat.ltb minSoFar price
    then price - minSoFar
    else 0%nat in
  let newMaxProfit := Nat.max maxProfit profit in
  (newMin, newMaxProfit).

Fixpoint maxProfitAux
    (prices : list nat)
    (minSoFar maxProfit : nat) : nat :=
  match prices with
  | [] => maxProfit
  | price :: rest =>
      let '(newMin, newProfit) :=
        updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar maxProfit in
      maxProfitAux rest newMin newProfit
  end.

Definition maxProfit
    (prices : list nat)
    (_h_precond : maxProfit_precond prices) : nat :=
  match prices with
  | [] => 0%nat
  | price :: rest => maxProfitAux rest price 0%nat
  end.

Fixpoint maxProfit_zipIdxFrom
    (prices : list nat)
    (index : nat) : list (nat * nat) :=
  match prices with
  | [] => []
  | price :: rest =>
      (price, index) :: maxProfit_zipIdxFrom rest (S index)
  end.

Definition maxProfit_zipIdx
    (prices : list nat) : list (nat * nat) :=
  maxProfit_zipIdxFrom prices 0%nat.

Fixpoint maxProfit_pairwise
    {A : Type}
    (relation : A -> A -> Prop)
    (xs : list A) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | [] => True
  | x :: rest =>
      Forall (relation x) rest /\
      maxProfit_pairwise relation rest
  end.

Definition maxProfit_noProfitableTransaction
    (indexed : list (nat * nat)) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun buy =>
      let '(buyPrice, buyIndex) := buy in
      forallb
        (fun sell =>
          let '(sellPrice, sellIndex) := sell in
          orb
            (Nat.leb sellIndex buyIndex)
            (Nat.leb sellPrice buyPrice))
        indexed)
    indexed.

Definition maxProfit_achievesResult
    (indexed : list (nat * nat))
    (result : nat) : bool :=
  existsb
    (fun buy =>
      let '(buyPrice, buyIndex) := buy in
      existsb
        (fun sell =>
          let '(sellPrice, sellIndex) := sell in
          andb
            (Nat.ltb buyIndex sellIndex)
            (Nat.eqb (sellPrice - buyPrice) result))
        indexed)
    indexed.

Definition maxProfit_postcond
    (prices : list nat)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : maxProfit_precond prices) : Prop :=
  let indexed := maxProfit_zipIdx prices in
  maxProfit_pairwise
    (fun buy sell =>
      let '(buyPrice, buyIndex) := buy in
      let '(sellPrice, sellIndex) := sell in
      (buyIndex < sellIndex)%nat ->
      (sellPrice - buyPrice <= result)%nat)
    indexed /\
  (result = 0%nat <->
    (length prices <= 1)%nat \/
    maxProfit_noProfitableTransaction indexed = true) /\
  ((result > 0)%nat ->
    maxProfit_achievesResult indexed result = true).

Theorem maxProfit_spec_satisfied
    (prices : list nat)
    (h_precond : maxProfit_precond prices) :
  maxProfit_postcond
    prices (maxProfit prices h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_42,
  catalog title "maxProfit": an executable natural-number list scan computes
  the maximum profit from buying at an earlier index and selling later,
  together with its precondition and full correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_42
  imports Main
begin

definition maxProfit_precond :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxProfit_precond prices \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition updateMinAndProfit ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat" where
  "updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar currentMaxProfit =
    (let newMin = min minSoFar price;
         profit = (if price > minSoFar then price - minSoFar else 0);
         newMaxProfit = max currentMaxProfit profit
     in (newMin, newMaxProfit))"

fun maxProfitAux :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "maxProfitAux [] minSoFar currentMaxProfit = currentMaxProfit"
| "maxProfitAux (p # ps) minSoFar currentMaxProfit =
    (case updateMinAndProfit p minSoFar currentMaxProfit of
       (newMin, newProfit) \<Rightarrow> maxProfitAux ps newMin newProfit)"

definition maxProfit :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "maxProfit prices =
    (case prices of
       [] \<Rightarrow> 0
     | p # ps \<Rightarrow> maxProfitAux ps p 0)"

definition maxProfit_zipIdx :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> (nat \<times> nat) list" where
  "maxProfit_zipIdx prices = zip prices [0..<length prices]"

fun maxProfit_pairwise ::
    "((nat \<times> nat) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<times> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<times> nat) list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxProfit_pairwise relation [] = True"
| "maxProfit_pairwise relation (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. relation x y) xs \<and>
     maxProfit_pairwise relation xs)"

definition maxProfit_postcond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxProfit_postcond prices result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let indexedPrices = maxProfit_zipIdx prices
     in
       maxProfit_pairwise
         (\<lambda>x y.
           snd x < snd y \<longrightarrow> fst y - fst x \<le> result)
         indexedPrices \<and>
       (result = 0 \<longleftrightarrow>
         (length prices \<le> 1 \<or>
          list_all
            (\<lambda>x.
              list_all
                (\<lambda>y. snd x \<ge> snd y \<or> fst y \<le> fst x)
                indexedPrices)
            indexedPrices)) \<and>
       (result > 0 \<longrightarrow>
         list_ex
           (\<lambda>x.
             list_ex
               (\<lambda>y.
                 snd x < snd y \<and> fst y - fst x = result)
               indexedPrices)
           indexedPrices))"

theorem maxProfit_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "maxProfit_precond prices"
  shows "maxProfit_postcond prices (maxProfit prices)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_42,
  catalog title "maxProfit": an executable natural-number list scan computes
  the greatest profit from buying at an earlier index and selling later, or
  zero when no profitable transaction exists. This file contains no proof.
*)

let maxProfit_precond = new_definition
  `maxProfit_precond (prices:num list) <=> T`;;

let updateMinAndProfit = new_definition
  `updateMinAndProfit
      (price:num) (minSoFar:num) (bestProfit:num) =
     let newMin =
       if minSoFar <= price then minSoFar else price in
     let profit =
       if price > minSoFar then price - minSoFar else 0 in
     let newBestProfit =
       if bestProfit <= profit then profit else bestProfit in
     (newMin,newBestProfit)`;;

let maxProfitAux =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!minSoFar:num. !bestProfit:num.
        maxProfitAux ([]:num list) minSoFar bestProfit =
        bestProfit) /\
     (!price:num. !prices:num list.
      !minSoFar:num. !bestProfit:num.
        maxProfitAux (CONS price prices) minSoFar bestProfit =
        let next =
          updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar bestProfit in
        maxProfitAux prices (FST next) (SND next))`;;

let maxProfit = new_definition
  `maxProfit (prices:num list) =
     if prices = [] then 0
     else maxProfitAux (TL prices) (HD prices) 0`;;

let maxProfit_zipIdxFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!start:num.
        maxProfit_zipIdxFrom start ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!price:num. !prices:num list. !start:num.
        maxProfit_zipIdxFrom start (CONS price prices) =
        CONS (price,start)
          (maxProfit_zipIdxFrom (SUC start) prices))`;;

let maxProfit_zipIdx = new_definition
  `maxProfit_zipIdx (prices:num list) =
     maxProfit_zipIdxFrom 0 prices`;;

let maxProfit_pairwiseBound =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!result:num.
        maxProfit_pairwiseBound
          ([]:(num#num)list) result <=> T) /\
     (!current:num#num. !rest:(num#num)list. !result:num.
        maxProfit_pairwiseBound (CONS current rest) result <=>
        ALL
          (\later:num#num.
             SND current < SND later
             ==> FST later - FST current <= result)
          rest /\
        maxProfit_pairwiseBound rest result)`;;

let maxProfit_postcond = new_definition
  `maxProfit_postcond (prices:num list) (result:num) <=>
     let indexed = maxProfit_zipIdx prices in
     maxProfit_pairwiseBound indexed result /\
     (result = 0 <=>
       LENGTH prices <= 1 \/
       ALL
         (\earlier:num#num.
            ALL
              (\later:num#num.
                 SND earlier >= SND later \/
                 FST later <= FST earlier)
              indexed)
         indexed) /\
     (result > 0
      ==> EX
            (\earlier:num#num.
               EX
                 (\later:num#num.
                    SND earlier < SND later /\
                    FST later - FST earlier = result)
                 indexed)
            indexed)`;;

let maxProfit_spec_satisfied =
  `!prices:num list.
     maxProfit_precond prices
     ==> maxProfit_postcond prices (maxProfit prices)`;;

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_42,
;; "maxProfit": the deterministic list program computes the maximum profit
;; from buying before selling, with the complete indexed-list correctness
;; contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-42-nat-listp (prices)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count prices)))
  (if (consp prices)
      (and
       (natp (car prices))
       (verina-advanced-42-nat-listp (cdr prices)))
    (equal prices nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Nat binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-42-max-profit-precond (prices)
  (declare (ignore prices))
  t)

;; A cons pair represents the source Nat product: its car is the updated
;; minimum price and its cdr is the updated maximum profit. NFIX preserves
;; Lean natural-number subtraction.

(defun verina-advanced-42-update-min-and-profit
    (price min-so-far max-profit)
  (let* ((new-min
          (if (<= min-so-far price)
              min-so-far
            price))
         (profit
          (if (> price min-so-far)
              (nfix (- price min-so-far))
            0))
         (new-max-profit
          (if (>= max-profit profit)
              max-profit
            profit)))
    (cons new-min new-max-profit)))

(defun verina-advanced-42-max-profit-aux
    (prices min-so-far max-profit)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count prices)))
  (if (consp prices)
      (let ((updated
             (verina-advanced-42-update-min-and-profit
              (car prices)
              min-so-far
              max-profit)))
        (verina-advanced-42-max-profit-aux
         (cdr prices)
         (car updated)
         (cdr updated)))
    max-profit))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument has no computational effect.
;; This preserves the source empty-list branch and initialization from the
;; first list element.

(defun verina-advanced-42-max-profit (prices)
  (if (consp prices)
      (verina-advanced-42-max-profit-aux
       (cdr prices)
       (car prices)
       0)
    0))

;; Each indexed entry is a cons pair whose car is the price and whose cdr is
;; its zero-based natural index, exactly representing List.zipIdx.

(defun verina-advanced-42-zip-idx-aux (prices index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count prices)))
  (if (consp prices)
      (cons
       (cons (car prices) index)
       (verina-advanced-42-zip-idx-aux
        (cdr prices)
        (+ index 1)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-42-zip-idx (prices)
  (verina-advanced-42-zip-idx-aux prices 0))

;; These two predicates reproduce List.Pairwise on the indexed price list.

(defun verina-advanced-42-pairwise-with-first-p
    (first remaining result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((later (car remaining)))
        (and
         (implies
          (< (cdr first) (cdr later))
          (<= (nfix (- (car later) (car first)))
              result))
         (verina-advanced-42-pairwise-with-first-p
          first
          (cdr remaining)
          result)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-42-all-valid-profits-at-most-p
    (indexed-prices result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count indexed-prices)))
  (if (consp indexed-prices)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-42-pairwise-with-first-p
        (car indexed-prices)
        (cdr indexed-prices)
        result)
       (verina-advanced-42-all-valid-profits-at-most-p
        (cdr indexed-prices)
        result))
    t))

;; These predicates reproduce the nested List.all test stating that no
;; earlier/later pair has a strictly increasing price.

(defun verina-advanced-42-no-profit-with-first-p
    (first indexed-prices)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count indexed-prices)))
  (if (consp indexed-prices)
      (let ((second (car indexed-prices)))
        (and
         (or
          (>= (cdr first) (cdr second))
          (<= (car second) (car first)))
         (verina-advanced-42-no-profit-with-first-p
          first
          (cdr indexed-prices))))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-42-no-profitable-transaction-p
    (remaining indexed-prices)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-42-no-profit-with-first-p
        (car remaining)
        indexed-prices)
       (verina-advanced-42-no-profitable-transaction-p
        (cdr remaining)
        indexed-prices))
    t))

;; These predicates reproduce the nested List.any test for a transaction
;; attaining a positive result.

(defun verina-advanced-42-achieves-with-first-p
    (first indexed-prices result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count indexed-prices)))
  (if (consp indexed-prices)
      (let ((second (car indexed-prices)))
        (or
         (and
          (< (cdr first) (cdr second))
          (equal
           (nfix (- (car second) (car first)))
           result))
         (verina-advanced-42-achieves-with-first-p
          first
          (cdr indexed-prices)
          result)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-42-achieving-transaction-p
    (remaining indexed-prices result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (verina-advanced-42-achieves-with-first-p
        (car remaining)
        indexed-prices
        result)
       (verina-advanced-42-achieving-transaction-p
        (cdr remaining)
        indexed-prices
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-42-max-profit-postcond
    (prices result)
  (let ((indexed-prices
         (verina-advanced-42-zip-idx prices)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-42-nat-listp prices)
     (natp result)
     (verina-advanced-42-all-valid-profits-at-most-p
      indexed-prices
      result)
     (iff
      (equal result 0)
      (or
       (<= (len prices) 1)
       (verina-advanced-42-no-profitable-transaction-p
        indexed-prices
        indexed-prices)))
     (implies
      (> result 0)
      (verina-advanced-42-achieving-transaction-p
       indexed-prices
       indexed-prices
       result)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Nat binder and True precondition; its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun verina-advanced-42-max-profit-spec-satisfied-statement
    (prices)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-42-nat-listp prices)
    (verina-advanced-42-max-profit-precond prices))
   (verina-advanced-42-max-profit-postcond
    prices
    (verina-advanced-42-max-profit prices))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_42,
-- catalog title "maxProfit": a deterministic list program computes the greatest
-- profit from buying at an earlier stock price and selling at a later one, and
-- is connected to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced42 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 2 _∨_ _↔_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_ _||_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natGreaterOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natGreaterOrEqual m n = natLessOrEqual n m

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natSub : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSub n zero = n
natSub zero (suc _) = zero
natSub (suc m) (suc n) = natSub m n

natMin : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMin m n =
  if natLessOrEqual m n
  then m
  else n

natMax : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMax m n =
  if natLessOrEqual m n
  then n
  else m

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} →
  (A → A → Set) →
  List A →
  Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

record NatPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : Nat
    pairSecond : Nat

maxProfit-precond : List Nat → Set
maxProfit-precond prices = Top

updateMinAndProfit :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  NatPair
updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar currentMaxProfit =
  let newMin = natMin minSoFar price
      profit =
        if natLess minSoFar price
        then natSub price minSoFar
        else zero
      newMaxProfit = natMax currentMaxProfit profit
  in pair newMin newMaxProfit

maxProfitAux : List Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
maxProfitAux [] minSoFar currentMaxProfit = currentMaxProfit
maxProfitAux (price ∷ prices) minSoFar currentMaxProfit
  with updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar currentMaxProfit
... | pair newMin newMaxProfit =
  maxProfitAux prices newMin newMaxProfit

maxProfit :
  (prices : List Nat) →
  maxProfit-precond prices →
  Nat
maxProfit [] h-precond = zero
maxProfit (price ∷ prices) h-precond =
  maxProfitAux prices price zero

record IndexedNat : Set where
  constructor indexed
  field
    indexedValue : Nat
    indexedPosition : Nat

open IndexedNat public

zipIdxFrom : Nat → List Nat → List IndexedNat
zipIdxFrom position [] = []
zipIdxFrom position (value ∷ values) =
  indexed value position ∷ zipIdxFrom (suc position) values

zipIdx : List Nat → List IndexedNat
zipIdx values = zipIdxFrom zero values

profitBound :
  Nat →
  IndexedNat →
  IndexedNat →
  Set
profitBound result earlier later =
  indexedPosition earlier < indexedPosition later →
  natSub (indexedValue later) (indexedValue earlier) ≤ result

noProfitableTransaction : List IndexedNat → Bool
noProfitableTransaction entries =
  allList
    (λ earlier →
      allList
        (λ later →
          natGreaterOrEqual
            (indexedPosition earlier)
            (indexedPosition later)
          ||
          natLessOrEqual
            (indexedValue later)
            (indexedValue earlier))
        entries)
    entries

achievesProfit : Nat → IndexedNat → IndexedNat → Bool
achievesProfit result earlier later =
  natLess
    (indexedPosition earlier)
    (indexedPosition later)
  &&
  natEqual
    (natSub (indexedValue later) (indexedValue earlier))
    result

someTransactionAchieves : Nat → List IndexedNat → Bool
someTransactionAchieves result entries =
  anyList
    (λ earlier →
      anyList
        (λ later → achievesProfit result earlier later)
        entries)
    entries

one : Nat
one = suc zero

maxProfit-postcond :
  (prices : List Nat) →
  (result : Nat) →
  maxProfit-precond prices →
  Set
maxProfit-postcond prices result h-precond =
  let entries = zipIdx prices
  in
    Pairwise (profitBound result) entries
    ∧
    ((result ≡ zero)
      ↔
      ((listLength prices ≤ one)
        ∨ IsTrue (noProfitableTransaction entries)))
    ∧
    (zero < result →
      IsTrue (someTransactionAchieves result entries))

maxProfit-spec-satisfied : Set
maxProfit-spec-satisfied =
  (prices : List Nat) →
  (h-precond : maxProfit-precond prices) →
  maxProfit-postcond
    prices
    (maxProfit prices h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_42,
  cataloged as "maxProfit": the executable one-pass program returns the
  maximum natural-number profit from buying on one day and selling on a
  later day, or zero when no profitable transaction exists. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val maxProfit_precond_def = new_definition (
  "maxProfit_precond_def",
  ``maxProfit_precond (prices : num list) <=> T``
);

val updateMinAndProfit_def = new_definition (
  "updateMinAndProfit_def",
  ``updateMinAndProfit
      (price : num) (minSoFar : num) (currentMaxProfit : num) =
      let newMin =
        if minSoFar <= price then minSoFar else price
      in
      let profit =
        if price > minSoFar then price - minSoFar else 0
      in
      let newMaxProfit =
        if currentMaxProfit < profit then profit else currentMaxProfit
      in
        (newMin,newMaxProfit)``
);

val maxProfitAux_def = Define `
  (maxProfitAux
      ([] : num list) (minSoFar : num) (currentMaxProfit : num) =
     currentMaxProfit) /\
  (maxProfitAux
      (price::prices) minSoFar currentMaxProfit =
     let updated =
       updateMinAndProfit price minSoFar currentMaxProfit
     in
       maxProfitAux prices (FST updated) (SND updated))
`;

val maxProfit_def = Define `
  (maxProfit ([] : num list) = 0) /\
  (maxProfit (price::prices) =
     maxProfitAux prices price 0)
`;

val maxProfit_zipIdxFrom_def = Define `
  (maxProfit_zipIdxFrom
      (index : num) ([] : num list) =
     ([] : (num # num) list)) /\
  (maxProfit_zipIdxFrom index (price::prices) =
     (price,index)::maxProfit_zipIdxFrom (SUC index) prices)
`;

val maxProfit_zipIdx_def = new_definition (
  "maxProfit_zipIdx_def",
  ``maxProfit_zipIdx (prices : num list) =
      maxProfit_zipIdxFrom 0 prices``
);

val maxProfit_pairwiseBound_def = Define `
  (maxProfit_pairwiseBound
      ([] : (num # num) list) (result : num) = T) /\
  (maxProfit_pairwiseBound (pricedDay::pricedDays) result =
     (EVERY
        (\laterPricedDay : num # num.
           SND pricedDay < SND laterPricedDay ==>
           FST laterPricedDay - FST pricedDay <= result)
        pricedDays /\
      maxProfit_pairwiseBound pricedDays result))
`;

val maxProfit_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "maxProfit_postcond_def",
  ``maxProfit_postcond
      (prices : num list) (result : num) <=>
      let pricedDays = maxProfit_zipIdx prices
      in
        maxProfit_pairwiseBound pricedDays result /\
        (result = 0 <=>
          LENGTH prices <= 1 \/
          EVERY
            (\pricedDay : num # num.
               EVERY
                 (\otherPricedDay : num # num.
                    SND pricedDay >= SND otherPricedDay \/
                    FST otherPricedDay <= FST pricedDay)
                 pricedDays)
            pricedDays) /\
        (result > 0 ==>
          EXISTS
            (\pricedDay : num # num.
               EXISTS
                 (\laterPricedDay : num # num.
                    SND pricedDay < SND laterPricedDay /\
                    FST laterPricedDay - FST pricedDay = result)
                 pricedDays)
            pricedDays)``
);

val maxProfit_spec_satisfied =
  ``!prices : num list.
      maxProfit_precond prices ==>
      maxProfit_postcond prices (maxProfit prices)``;

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_42 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_42), catalog title
  maxProfit: an exact executable scan of an arbitrary finite natural-number
  price list computes the greatest profit from buying before selling, with
  the zero-profit and attaining-transaction correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  SetMM subtraction is ordinary integer subtraction, so VERINA42NatSub
  explicitly restores Lean's truncated Nat.sub on natural arguments. When
  A < B it returns zero; otherwise B <= A and the ordinary integer A - B is
  nonnegative and equals Nat.sub. Every source subtraction is represented by
  this definition: the current transaction profit, the tail length (including
  the empty-list case), and both postcondition transaction profits. Thus each
  subtraction remains equivalent for all natural inputs, not only when the
  minuend happens to exceed the subtrahend.

  VERINA42State is the pair (minimum price so far, maximum profit so far).
  VERINA42Update is exactly updateMinAndProfit: it replaces the minimum by
  the lesser of the old minimum and current price, computes current price
  minus the old minimum only when the price is larger, and retains the
  larger of that profit and the old maximum.

  VERINA42AuxGraph records the unique complete left-to-right trace of those
  updates for arbitrary helper arguments. VERINA42MaxProfitAux selects the
  final profit component, exactly implementing maxProfitAux.
  VERINA42TailGraph and VERINA42Tail give List.tail. VERINA42MaxProfit is the
  source match: zero on the empty list, and otherwise the helper on the tail
  initialized with the head price and zero profit.

  VERINA42Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Nat
  input type. VERINA42Post expands zipIdx over the complete index range. Its
  first clause is List.Pairwise on all earlier/later entries, its second
  clause characterizes zero result by absence of a profitable ordered
  transaction (including the explicit length-at-most-one disjunct), and its
  third clause requires a positive result to be attained by an ordered
  transaction. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally
  and propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  predicate. The final $a declaration is the source correctness
  proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and
  this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA42NatSub VERINA42State VERINA42Update
  VERINA42AuxGraph VERINA42MaxProfitAux
  VERINA42TailGraph VERINA42Tail
  VERINA42Pre VERINA42MaxProfit VERINA42Post
$.

verina42-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA42NatSub A B ) $.
verina42-state-syntax
  $a class VERINA42State $.
verina42-update-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA42Update A B C ) $.
verina42-aux-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA42AuxGraph A B C D ) $.
verina42-max-profit-aux-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA42MaxProfitAux A B C ) $.
verina42-tail-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA42TailGraph A B ) $.
verina42-tail-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA42Tail A ) $.
verina42-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA42Pre A ) $.
verina42-max-profit-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA42MaxProfit A ) $.
verina42-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA42Post A B ) $.

verina42-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA42NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verina42-state-definition $a |- VERINA42State = (
  NN0 X. NN0
) $.

verina42-update-definition $a |- (
  VERINA42Update A B C
) = <.
  if (
    A < B ,
    A ,
    B
  )
  ,
  if (
    C < if (
      B < A ,
      ( VERINA42NatSub A B ) ,
      0
    )
    ,
    if (
      B < A ,
      ( VERINA42NatSub A B ) ,
      0
    )
    ,
    C
  )
>. $.

${
  $d k t A B C D $.

  verina42-aux-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA42AuxGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. NN0
      )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word VERINA42State
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = <. B , C >.
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = (
              VERINA42Update
                ( A ` k )
                ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
            )
          /\
          D = ( 2nd ` ( t ` ( # ` A ) ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina42-max-profit-aux-definition $a |- (
    VERINA42MaxProfitAux A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA42AuxGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B $.

  verina42-tail-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA42TailGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( VERINA42NatSub ( # ` A ) 1 )
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( j + 1 ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina42-tail-definition $a |- (
    VERINA42Tail A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA42TailGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina42-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA42Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word NN0
) $.

verina42-max-profit-definition $a |- (
  VERINA42MaxProfit A
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) = 0 ,
  0 ,
  (
    VERINA42MaxProfitAux
      ( VERINA42Tail A )
      ( A ` 0 )
      0
  )
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verina42-postcondition-definition $a |- (

:: verina_advanced_42, catalog title "maxProfit": the unconditional

:: scan, maximum one-transaction-profit postcondition, and final correctness

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,

    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for prices being FinSequence of NAT,
      result being Nat st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex updateMin,updateBest being Function of [:NAT,NAT,NAT:],NAT,
        maxProfitAux being Function of [:NAT*,NAT,NAT:],NAT st
      (for price,minSoFar,maxSoFar being Nat holds
        updateMin/.[price,minSoFar,maxSoFar] = min(minSoFar,price) &
        ((minSoFar < price &
          updateBest/.[price,minSoFar,maxSoFar] =
            max(maxSoFar,price -' minSoFar)) or
         (price <= minSoFar &
          updateBest/.[price,minSoFar,maxSoFar] =
            max(maxSoFar,0)))) &
      (for minSoFar,maxSoFar being Nat holds
        maxProfitAux/.[<*>NAT,minSoFar,maxSoFar] = maxSoFar) &
      (for price,minSoFar,maxSoFar being Nat,
           tail,whole being FinSequence of NAT st
        whole = <*price*> ^ tail
      holds
        maxProfitAux/.[whole,minSoFar,maxSoFar] =
          maxProfitAux/.[tail,
            updateMin/.[price,minSoFar,maxSoFar],
            updateBest/.[price,minSoFar,maxSoFar]]) &
      ((prices = <*>NAT & result = 0) or
       (ex price being Nat, tail being FinSequence of NAT st
        prices = <*price*> ^ tail &
        result = maxProfitAux/.[tail,price,0])))
  holds
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom prices & j in dom prices & i < j
    holds prices/.j -' prices/.i <= result) &
    (result = 0 iff
      (len prices <= 1 or
       (for i,j being Nat st i in dom prices & j in dom prices holds
        j <= i or prices/.j <= prices/.i))) &
    (0 < result implies
      ex i,j being Nat st
        i in dom prices & j in dom prices & i < j &
        prices/.j -' prices/.i = result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_42
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_42, catalog title "maxProfit": computing the maximum
% single-transaction stock profit with the specified one-pass minimum-tracking
% program and its ordered-day optimality contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_42: THEORY
BEGIN

  min_profit_state: TYPE =
    [# minimum_so_far: nat, maximum_profit: nat #]

  nat_min(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first <= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  nat_max(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxProfit_precond(prices: list[nat]): bool =
    TRUE

  updateMinAndProfit(
      price, minSoFar, currentMaxProfit: nat):
        min_profit_state =
    LET newMin: nat =
          nat_min(minSoFar, price),
        profit: nat =
          IF price > minSoFar THEN
            nat_subtract(price, minSoFar)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF,
        newMaxProfit: nat =
          nat_max(currentMaxProfit, profit)
    IN
      (# minimum_so_far := newMin,
         maximum_profit := newMaxProfit #)

  maxProfitAux(
      prices: list[nat],
      minSoFar, currentMaxProfit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES prices OF
      null:
        currentMaxProfit,
      cons(price, remaining):
        LET updated: min_profit_state =
              updateMinAndProfit(
                price,
                minSoFar,
                currentMaxProfit)
        IN
          maxProfitAux(
            remaining,
            minimum_so_far(updated),
            maximum_profit(updated))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE prices BY <<

  maxProfit(prices: list[nat]): nat =
    CASES prices OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(first_price, remaining):
        maxProfitAux(remaining, first_price, 0)
    ENDCASES

  all_later_profits_bounded(
      buy_price: nat,
      later_prices: list[nat],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later_prices OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(sell_price, remaining):
        nat_subtract(sell_price, buy_price) <= result
          AND all_later_profits_bounded(
            buy_price,
            remaining,
            result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later_prices BY <<

  all_transaction_profits_bounded(
      prices: list[nat],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES prices OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(buy_price, later_prices):
        all_later_profits_bounded(
          buy_price,
          later_prices,
          result)
          AND all_transaction_profits_bounded(
            later_prices,
            result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE prices BY <<

  all_later_prices_at_most(
      buy_price: nat,
      later_prices: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later_prices OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(sell_price, remaining):
        sell_price <= buy_price
          AND all_later_prices_at_most(
            buy_price,
            remaining)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later_prices BY <<

  no_profitable_transaction(
      prices: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES prices OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(buy_price, later_prices):
        all_later_prices_at_most(
          buy_price,
          later_prices)
          AND no_profitable_transaction(later_prices)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE prices BY <<

  later_price_achieves_profit(
      buy_price: nat,
      later_prices: list[nat],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later_prices OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(sell_price, remaining):
        nat_subtract(sell_price, buy_price) = result
          OR later_price_achieves_profit(
            buy_price,
            remaining,
            result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later_prices BY <<

  transaction_achieves_profit(
      prices: list[nat],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES prices OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(buy_price, later_prices):
        later_price_achieves_profit(
          buy_price,
          later_prices,
          result)
          OR transaction_achieves_profit(
            later_prices,
            result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE prices BY <<

  maxProfit_postcond(
      prices: list[nat],
      result: nat): bool =
    all_transaction_profits_bounded(prices, result)
      AND
        ((result = 0)
          IFF
            (nat_list_length(prices) <= 1
              OR no_profitable_transaction(prices)))
      AND
        (result > 0 IMPLIES
          transaction_achieves_profit(prices, result))

  maxProfit_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (prices: list[nat]):
      maxProfit_precond(prices) IMPLIES
        maxProfit_postcond(
          prices,
          maxProfit(prices))

END verina_advanced_42

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_43,
   catalog title "maxStrength": executable enumeration of every nonempty
   index-selected subset of an integer list and computation of its maximum
   product, together with its membership and maximality correctness contract.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition maxStrength_precond (nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  nums <> [].

Fixpoint maxStrength_addHeadChoices
    (x : Z)
    (subsets : list (list Z)) : list (list Z) :=
  match subsets with
  | [] => []
  | subset :: remaining =>
      subset :: (x :: subset) ::
        maxStrength_addHeadChoices x remaining
  end.

Fixpoint maxStrength_powerSet
    (nums : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  match nums with
  | [] => [[]]
  | x :: rest =>
      maxStrength_addHeadChoices x (maxStrength_powerSet rest)
  end.

Definition maxStrength_nonempty (subset : list Z) : bool :=
  match subset with
  | [] => false
  | _ :: _ => true
  end.

Definition maxStrength_product (subset : list Z) : Z :=
  fold_left Z.mul subset 1.

Definition maxStrength_products (nums : list Z) : list Z :=
  map maxStrength_product
    (filter maxStrength_nonempty (maxStrength_powerSet nums)).

Fixpoint maxStrength_maxOption (products : list Z) : option Z :=
  match products with
  | [] => None
  | product :: remaining =>
      match maxStrength_maxOption remaining with
      | None => Some product
      | Some currentMax => Some (Z.max product currentMax)
      end
  end.

Definition maxStrength
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : maxStrength_precond nums) : Z :=
  match maxStrength_maxOption (maxStrength_products nums) with
  | Some maximum => maximum
  | None => -1000000
  end.

Definition maxStrength_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : maxStrength_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let products := maxStrength_products nums in
  existsb (Z.eqb result) products = true /\
  forallb (fun product => Z.leb product result) products = true.

Theorem maxStrength_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : maxStrength_precond nums) :
  maxStrength_postcond
    nums (maxStrength nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_43,
  catalog title "maxStrength": an executable exhaustive subset computation
  returns the maximum product of a nonempty subset of an integer list,
  together with its nonempty-input precondition and maximality contract. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_43
  imports Main
begin

definition maxStrength_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxStrength_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> nums \<noteq> []"

fun maxStrength_subsets :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list list" where
  "maxStrength_subsets [] = [[]]"
| "maxStrength_subsets (x # xs) =
    (let rest = maxStrength_subsets xs
     in rest @ map (\<lambda>subset. x # subset) rest)"

definition maxStrength_products :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxStrength_products nums =
    map (\<lambda>subset. foldl (\<lambda>acc x. acc * x) 1 subset)
      (filter (\<lambda>subset. subset \<noteq> []) (maxStrength_subsets nums))"

fun maxStrength_listMaxDefault :: "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxStrength_listMaxDefault dflt [] = dflt"
| "maxStrength_listMaxDefault dflt (x # xs) = foldl max x xs"

definition maxStrength :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxStrength nums =
    maxStrength_listMaxDefault (-1000000) (maxStrength_products nums)"

definition maxStrength_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxStrength_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let products = maxStrength_products nums
     in result \<in> set products \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>product. product \<le> result) products)"

theorem maxStrength_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "maxStrength_precond nums"
  shows "maxStrength_postcond nums (maxStrength nums)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_43,
  catalog title "maxStrength": an executable bitmask enumeration computes the
  greatest product of a nonempty subset of a nonempty integer list, and the
  postcondition characterizes that maximum via nonempty sublists. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let maxStrength_precond = new_definition
  `maxStrength_precond (nums:int list) <=>
     ~(nums = [])`;;

let maxStrength_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(maxStrength_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        maxStrength_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND (maxStrength_range n) (CONS n []))`;;

let maxStrength_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nums:int list.
        maxStrength_get 0 nums =
        if nums = [] then (&0:int) else HD nums) /\
     (!i:num. !nums:int list.
        maxStrength_get (SUC i) nums =
        if nums = [] then (&0:int)
        else maxStrength_get i (TL nums))`;;

let maxStrength_select =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums:int list. !mask:num.
        maxStrength_select nums mask ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!i:num. !indices:num list. !nums:int list. !mask:num.
        maxStrength_select nums mask (CONS i indices) =
        if (mask DIV (2 EXP i)) MOD 2 = 1 then
          CONS (maxStrength_get i nums)
            (maxStrength_select nums mask indices)
        else
          maxStrength_select nums mask indices)`;;

let maxStrength_powerSet = new_definition
  `maxStrength_powerSet (nums:int list) =
     MAP
       (\mask:num.
          maxStrength_select nums mask
            (maxStrength_range (LENGTH nums)))
       (maxStrength_range (2 EXP (LENGTH nums)))`;;

let maxStrength_productFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        maxStrength_productFold ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        maxStrength_productFold (CONS x xs) acc =
        maxStrength_productFold xs (acc * x))`;;

let maxStrength_product = new_definition
  `maxStrength_product (xs:int list) =
     maxStrength_productFold xs (&1:int)`;;

let maxStrength_maxFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        maxStrength_maxFold ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        maxStrength_maxFold (CONS x xs) acc =
        maxStrength_maxFold xs
          (if acc <= x then x else acc))`;;

let maxStrength_maximum = new_definition
  `maxStrength_maximum (products:int list) =
     if products = [] then (-- &1000000:int)
     else maxStrength_maxFold (TL products) (HD products)`;;

let maxStrength = new_definition
  `maxStrength (nums:int list) =
     let subsets = maxStrength_powerSet nums in
     let nonEmpty = FILTER (\subset:int list. ~(subset = [])) subsets in
     let products = MAP maxStrength_product nonEmpty in
     maxStrength_maximum products`;;

let maxStrength_sublists =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(maxStrength_sublists ([]:int list) = CONS [] []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        maxStrength_sublists (CONS x xs) =
        let rest = maxStrength_sublists xs in
        APPEND rest
          (MAP (\sub:int list. CONS x sub) rest))`;;

let maxStrength_postcond = new_definition
  `maxStrength_postcond (nums:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let sublists =
       FILTER
         (\sub:int list. ~(sub = []))
         (maxStrength_sublists nums) in
     let products = MAP maxStrength_product sublists in
     MEM result products /\
     ALL (\p:int. p <= result) products`;;

let maxStrength_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list.
     maxStrength_precond nums
     ==> maxStrength_postcond nums (maxStrength nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_43,
;; "maxStrength": the deterministic bitmask program computes the maximum
;; product of a nonempty subset of an integer list, with its exhaustive
;; subsequence-product correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-43-integer-listp (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (integerp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-43-integer-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-strength-precond (nums)
  (not (equal nums nil)))

;; Traversing NUMS from left to right while dividing MASK by two reproduces
;; the source foldr over List.range: the current low bit is exactly the bit at
;; the current list index, and selected elements retain their original order.

(defun verina-advanced-43-subset-for-mask (nums mask)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (if (equal (mod mask 2) 1)
          (cons
           (car nums)
           (verina-advanced-43-subset-for-mask
            (cdr nums)
            (floor mask 2)))
        (verina-advanced-43-subset-for-mask
         (cdr nums)
         (floor mask 2)))
    nil))

;; REMAINING is the length of List.range (2 ^ nums.length). Starting MASK at
;; zero therefore enumerates precisely the source masks in increasing order.

(defun verina-advanced-43-enumerate-masked-subsets
    (nums mask remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-43-subset-for-mask nums mask)
     (verina-advanced-43-enumerate-masked-subsets
      nums
      (+ mask 1)
      (- remaining 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-43-power-set (nums)
  (verina-advanced-43-enumerate-masked-subsets
   nums
   0
   (expt 2 (len nums))))

(defun verina-advanced-43-filter-nonempty
    (subsets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsets)))
  (if (consp subsets)
      (if (consp (car subsets))
          (cons
           (car subsets)
           (verina-advanced-43-filter-nonempty
            (cdr subsets)))
        (verina-advanced-43-filter-nonempty
         (cdr subsets)))
    nil))

;; This accumulator recursion is List.foldl multiplication with initial value
;; one, including the empty-list result.

(defun verina-advanced-43-product-foldl
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-43-product-foldl
       (cdr remaining)
       (* accumulator (car remaining)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-43-map-products
    (subsets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subsets)))
  (if (consp subsets)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-43-product-foldl
        (car subsets)
        1)
       (verina-advanced-43-map-products
        (cdr subsets)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-tail
    (remaining current)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-43-max-tail
       (cdr remaining)
       (if (> (car remaining) current)
           (car remaining)
         current))
    current))

;; This is List.max? followed by Option.getD (-1000000).

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-get-default
    (values default)
  (if (consp values)
      (verina-advanced-43-max-tail
       (cdr values)
       (car values))
    default))

;; The proof-valued nonempty precondition argument is computationally
;; irrelevant. Every remaining definition is the exact executable content of
;; the source maxStrength body.

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-strength (nums)
  (let* ((subsets
          (verina-advanced-43-power-set nums))
         (nonempty
          (verina-advanced-43-filter-nonempty
           subsets))
         (products
          (verina-advanced-43-map-products
           nonempty)))
    (verina-advanced-43-max-get-default
     products
     -1000000)))

;; This direct recursion reproduces List.sublists: first all sublists of the
;; tail, then the same sublists with the current head prepended.

(defun verina-advanced-43-prepend-to-each
    (value sublists)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sublists)))
  (if (consp sublists)
      (cons
       (cons value (car sublists))
       (verina-advanced-43-prepend-to-each
        value
        (cdr sublists)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-43-sublists (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (let ((tail-sublists
             (verina-advanced-43-sublists
              (cdr nums))))
        (append
         tail-sublists
         (verina-advanced-43-prepend-to-each
          (car nums)
          tail-sublists)))
    (list nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-43-contains-value-p
    (values result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (or
       (equal (car values) result)
       (verina-advanced-43-contains-value-p
        (cdr values)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-43-all-at-most-p
    (values result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (<= (car values) result)
       (verina-advanced-43-all-at-most-p
        (cdr values)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-strength-postcond
    (nums result)
  (let* ((sublists
          (verina-advanced-43-filter-nonempty
           (verina-advanced-43-sublists nums)))
         (products
          (verina-advanced-43-map-products
           sublists)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-43-integer-listp nums)
     (integerp result)
     (verina-advanced-43-contains-value-p
      products
      result)
     (verina-advanced-43-all-at-most-p
      products
      result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and nonempty-list precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun verina-advanced-43-max-strength-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-43-integer-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-43-max-strength-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-43-max-strength-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-43-max-strength nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_43,
-- catalog title "maxStrength": a deterministic bitmask program computes the
-- maximum product of a nonempty subset of an integer list and is connected to
-- its full maximality contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced43 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natHalf : Nat → Nat
natHalf zero = zero
natHalf (suc zero) = zero
natHalf (suc (suc n)) = suc (natHalf n)

natOdd : Nat → Bool
natOdd zero = false
natOdd (suc zero) = true
natOdd (suc (suc n)) = natOdd n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

intMultiply : Int → Int → Int
intMultiply (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
intMultiply (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

two : Nat
two = suc (suc zero)

powTwo : Nat → Nat
powTwo zero = suc zero
powTwo (suc n) = two * powTwo n

selectByMask : List Int → Nat → List Int
selectByMask [] mask = []
selectByMask (x ∷ xs) mask =
  if natOdd mask
  then x ∷ selectByMask xs (natHalf mask)
  else selectByMask xs (natHalf mask)

powerSetByMasks : List Int → List (List Int)
powerSetByMasks nums =
  mapList
    (selectByMask nums)
    (range (powTwo (listLength nums)))

listNonEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listNonEmpty [] = false
listNonEmpty (_ ∷ _) = true

oneInt : Int
oneInt = pos (suc zero)

productList : List Int → Int
productList xs = foldLeft intMultiply oneInt xs

maximumWithDefault : Int → List Int → Int
maximumWithDefault default [] = default
maximumWithDefault default (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft intMax x xs

minusOneMillion : Int
minusOneMillion = negsuc 999999

maxStrength-precond : List Int → Set
maxStrength-precond nums = Not (nums ≡ [])

maxStrength :
  (nums : List Int) →
  maxStrength-precond nums →
  Int
maxStrength nums h-precond =
  let subsets = powerSetByMasks nums
      nonempty = filterList listNonEmpty subsets
      products = mapList productList nonempty
  in maximumWithDefault minusOneMillion products

allSublists : List Int → List (List Int)
allSublists [] = [] ∷ []
allSublists (x ∷ xs) =
  let tails = allSublists xs
  in
    appendList
      tails
      (mapList (λ tail → x ∷ tail) tails)

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

maxStrength-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  maxStrength-precond nums →
  Set
maxStrength-postcond nums result h-precond =
  let sublists =
        filterList listNonEmpty (allSublists nums)
      products =
        mapList productList sublists
  in
    IsTrue (containsInt result products) ∧
    IsTrue
      (allList
        (λ product → intLessOrEqual product result)
        products)

maxStrength-spec-satisfied : Set
maxStrength-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : maxStrength-precond nums) →
  maxStrength-postcond
    nums
    (maxStrength nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_43,
  cataloged as "maxStrength": the executable subset-enumeration program
  returns the maximum product of a nonempty subset of a nonempty integer
  list. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val maxStrength_precond_def = new_definition (
  "maxStrength_precond_def",
  ``maxStrength_precond (nums : int list) <=>
      ~(nums = [])``
);

val maxStrength_interleave_def = Define `
  (maxStrength_interleave
      (x : int) ([] : int list list) =
     ([] : int list list)) /\
  (maxStrength_interleave x (subset::subsets) =
     subset :: (x::subset) :: maxStrength_interleave x subsets)
`;

val maxStrength_powerSet_def = Define `
  (maxStrength_powerSet ([] : int list) =
     ([[]] : int list list)) /\
  (maxStrength_powerSet (x::xs) =
     maxStrength_interleave x (maxStrength_powerSet xs))
`;

val maxStrength_product_def = new_definition (
  "maxStrength_product_def",
  ``maxStrength_product (subset : int list) =
      FOLDL (\acc x. acc * x) (1 : int) subset``
);

val maxStrength_maxOpt_def = Define `
  (maxStrength_maxOpt ([] : int list) =
     (NONE : int option)) /\
  (maxStrength_maxOpt (x::xs) =
     case maxStrength_maxOpt xs of
       NONE => SOME x
     | SOME best => SOME (if x < best then best else x))
`;

val maxStrength_def = new_definition (
  "maxStrength_def",
  ``maxStrength (nums : int list) =
      let subsets = maxStrength_powerSet nums in
      let nonEmpty =
        FILTER (\subset : int list. ~(subset = [])) subsets
      in
      let products = MAP maxStrength_product nonEmpty
      in
        case maxStrength_maxOpt products of
          NONE => (-1000000 : int)
        | SOME result => result``
);

val maxStrength_sublists_def = Define `
  (maxStrength_sublists ([] : int list) =
     ([[]] : int list list)) /\
  (maxStrength_sublists (x::xs) =
     let rest = maxStrength_sublists xs
     in
       rest ++ MAP (\subset. x::subset) rest)
`;

val maxStrength_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "maxStrength_postcond_def",
  ``maxStrength_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : int) <=>
      let sublists =
        FILTER
          (\subset : int list. ~(subset = []))
          (maxStrength_sublists nums)
      in
      let products = MAP maxStrength_product sublists
      in
        MEM result products /\
        EVERY (\product : int. product <= result) products``
);

val maxStrength_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      maxStrength_precond nums ==>
      maxStrength_postcond nums (maxStrength nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_43 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_43), catalog title
  maxStrength: exact bitmask subset enumeration, nonempty filtering, integer
  product folds, and a defaulted maximum compute the greatest product of a
  nonempty subsequence of an arbitrary nonempty finite integer list. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA43BitSet expresses the source test
    (mask.shiftRight i).land 1 == 1.
  VERINA43ImplMaskWordGraph selects precisely the input positions whose
  same-numbered mask bits are set, in increasing input-index order. Thus
  VERINA43PowerSetGraph records, in numeric mask order from zero through
  2^n-1, exactly the word produced by the local powerSet helper's range,
  map, and foldr. VERINA43NonEmptySubsetsGraph is its stable filter by
  nonemptiness; mask zero is the unique removed entry.

  VERINA43ProductGraph records List.foldl multiplication from integer one.
  VERINA43ProductsGraph maps that exact fold over the filtered subsets.
  VERINA43MaxGetDGraph is List.max? followed by getD (-1000000): it returns
  the default exactly on an empty product word and otherwise the occurring
  integer that bounds every entry above. VERINA43MaxStrength composes these
  independently specified executable stages.

  The source postcondition uses List.sublists, whose recursive ordering is
  represented by VERINA43PostMaskWordGraph: input position k corresponds
  to mask bit n-1-k. VERINA43SublistsGraph lists all such subsequences in
  numeric mask order, VERINA43NonEmptySublistsGraph performs the exact
  stable nonempty filter, and VERINA43PostProductsGraph maps the same
  product fold. VERINA43Post then reproduces List.contains for the result
  and List.all asserting that every product is at most it.

  VERINA43Pre is the source nonempty-list precondition. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally and propositionally unused and
  is omitted from the target function and postcondition predicate. The final
  $a declaration is the source correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is
  syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA43BitSet
  VERINA43ImplMaskWordGraph
  VERINA43PowerSetGraph VERINA43PowerSet
  VERINA43NonEmptySubsetsGraph VERINA43NonEmptySubsets
  VERINA43ProductGraph VERINA43Product
  VERINA43ProductsGraph VERINA43Products
  VERINA43MaxGetDGraph VERINA43MaxGetD
  VERINA43Pre VERINA43MaxStrength
  VERINA43PostMaskWordGraph
  VERINA43SublistsGraph VERINA43Sublists
  VERINA43NonEmptySublistsGraph VERINA43NonEmptySublists
  VERINA43PostProductsGraph VERINA43PostProducts
  VERINA43Post
$.

verina43-bit-set-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43BitSet A B ) $.
verina43-impl-mask-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43ImplMaskWordGraph A B C ) $.
verina43-power-set-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43PowerSetGraph A B ) $.
verina43-power-set-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43PowerSet A ) $.
verina43-nonempty-subsets-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43NonEmptySubsetsGraph A B ) $.
verina43-nonempty-subsets-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43NonEmptySubsets A ) $.
verina43-product-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43ProductGraph A B ) $.
verina43-product-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43Product A ) $.
verina43-products-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43ProductsGraph A B ) $.
verina43-products-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43Products A ) $.
verina43-max-get-d-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43MaxGetDGraph A B ) $.
verina43-max-get-d-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43MaxGetD A ) $.
verina43-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43Pre A ) $.
verina43-max-strength-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43MaxStrength A ) $.
verina43-post-mask-word-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43PostMaskWordGraph A B C ) $.
verina43-sublists-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43SublistsGraph A B ) $.
verina43-sublists-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43Sublists A ) $.
verina43-nonempty-sublists-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43NonEmptySublistsGraph A B ) $.
verina43-nonempty-sublists-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43NonEmptySublists A ) $.
verina43-post-products-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43PostProductsGraph A B ) $.
verina43-post-products-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA43PostProducts A ) $.
verina43-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA43Post A B ) $.

verina43-bit-set-definition $a |- (
  VERINA43BitSet A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2
  ) = 1
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina43-impl-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43ImplMaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( VERINA43BitSet B k )
              <->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B $.

  verina43-power-set-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43PowerSetGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )
      /\
      A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          VERINA43ImplMaskWordGraph
            A
            r
            ( B ` r )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-power-set-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43PowerSet A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA43PowerSetGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B $.

  verina43-nonempty-subsets-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43NonEmptySubsetsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( ( # ` ( VERINA43PowerSet A ) ) - 1 )
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          B ` j
        ) = (
          ( VERINA43PowerSet A ) ` ( j + 1 )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-nonempty-subsets-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43NonEmptySubsets A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA43NonEmptySubsetsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s A B $.

  verina43-product-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43ProductGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word ZZ
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = 1
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = (
              ( s ` k ) x. ( A ` k )
            )
          /\
          B = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-product-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43Product A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA43ProductGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina43-products-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43ProductsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` k
        ) = (
          VERINA43Product ( A ` k )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-products-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43Products A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA43ProductsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina43-max-get-d-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43MaxGetDGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` A ) = 0
        /\
        B = ( -u ( ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 0 0 0 0 0 0 ) )
      )
      \/
      (
        (
          0 < ( # ` A )
          /\
          B e. ran A
        )
        /\
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( A ` k ) <_ B
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-max-get-d-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43MaxGetD A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA43MaxGetDGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina43-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA43Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  0 < ( # ` A )
) $.

verina43-max-strength-definition $a |- (
  VERINA43MaxStrength A
) = (
  VERINA43MaxGetD
    (
      VERINA43Products
        ( VERINA43NonEmptySubsets A )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B C $.

  verina43-post-mask-word-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43PostMaskWordGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) ) )
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              (
                VERINA43BitSet
                  B
                  ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - k )
              )
              <->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = k
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B $.

  verina43-sublists-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43SublistsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( 2 ^ ( # ` A ) )
      /\
      A. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          VERINA43PostMaskWordGraph
            A
            r
            ( B ` r )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina43-sublists-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43Sublists A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA43SublistsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B $.

  verina43-nonempty-sublists-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA43NonEmptySublistsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( ( # ` ( VERINA43Sublists A ) ) - 1 )
      /\
