:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_43, catalog title "maxStrength": an exact finite-sequence
:: operational graph of the nonempty precondition, interleaved numeric-mask
:: power-set helper, filtering, product and maximum folds, the maximum-subset-
:: product postcondition, and the final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, FINSEQOP,
    XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    len nums <> 0 &
    (ex powerStates being Function of NAT,(INT*)*,
        subsets,nonEmpty being FinSequence of INT*,
        selected being FinSequence of NAT,
        products being FinSequence of INT st
      (ex initial being FinSequence of INT* st
        initial = powerStates/.1 &
        len initial = 1 &
        initial/.1 = <*>INT) &
      subsets = powerStates/.(len nums + 1) &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
        ex current,next being FinSequence of INT* st
          current = powerStates/.k &
          next = powerStates/.(k + 1) &
          len next = 2 * len current &
          for j being Nat st j in dom current holds
            ex tail being FinSequence of INT st
              tail = current/.j &
              next/.(2 * j - 1) = tail &
              next/.(2 * j) =
                (<*nums/.(len nums + 1 - k)*> ^ tail)) &
      len selected = len nonEmpty &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom selected holds
        selected/.k in dom subsets &
        nonEmpty/.k = subsets/.(selected/.k)) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom selected & h in dom selected & k < h
      holds selected/.k < selected/.h) &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom subsets holds
        (j in rng selected iff
          ex s being FinSequence of INT st
            s = subsets/.j & len s <> 0)) &
      len products = len nonEmpty &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom products holds
        ex s,productStates being FinSequence of INT st
          s = nonEmpty/.k &
          len productStates = len s + 1 &
          productStates/.1 = 1 &
          (for q being Nat st q in dom s holds
            productStates/.(q + 1) =
              productStates/.q * s/.q) &
          products/.k = productStates/.(len s + 1)) &
      ((len products = 0 & result + 1000000 = 0) or
       (0 < len products &
        ex maxStates being FinSequence of INT st
          len maxStates = len products &
          maxStates/.1 = products/.1 &
          result = maxStates/.(len products) &
          for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len products holds
            ((maxStates/.k < products/.(k + 1) &
              maxStates/.(k + 1) = products/.(k + 1)) or
             (not maxStates/.k < products/.(k + 1) &
              maxStates/.(k + 1) = maxStates/.k)))))
  holds
    (ex chosen being FinSequence of INT,
        positions being FinSequence of NAT,
        productStates being FinSequence of INT st
      len chosen <> 0 &
      len positions = len chosen &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
        positions/.k in dom nums &
        chosen/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
      holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      len productStates = len chosen + 1 &
      productStates/.1 = 1 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom chosen holds
        productStates/.(k + 1) =
          productStates/.k * chosen/.k) &
      result = productStates/.(len chosen + 1)) &
    (for candidate being FinSequence of INT,
         positions being FinSequence of NAT,
         candidateProduct being Integer st
      len candidate <> 0 &
      len positions = len candidate &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
        positions/.k in dom nums &
        candidate/.k = nums/.(positions/.k)) &
      (for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
      holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
      (ex productStates being FinSequence of INT st
        len productStates = len candidate + 1 &
        productStates/.1 = 1 &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom candidate holds
          productStates/.(k + 1) =
            productStates/.k * candidate/.k) &
        candidateProduct = productStates/.(len candidate + 1))
    holds candidateProduct <= result)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_43
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_43, catalog title "maxStrength": computing the maximum
% product of a nonempty index-subset of an integer list with the specified
% exhaustive program and its membership-and-maximality contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_43: THEORY
BEGIN

  maxStrength_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    nums /= null[int]

  append_subsequence_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_subsequence_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_to_each(
      value: int,
      subsets: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsets OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(value, head),
          prepend_to_each(value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsets BY <<

  all_subsequences_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      accumulator: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_subsequences_fold(
          tail,
          append_subsequence_lists(
            accumulator,
            prepend_to_each(head, accumulator)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null)

  reverse_each(
      subsets: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsets OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          reverse_int_list(head),
          reverse_each(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsets BY <<

  powerSet(nums: list[int]): list[list[int]] =
    reverse_each(
      all_subsequences_fold(
        nums,
        cons(null[int], null[list[int]])))

  sublists(nums: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES nums OF
      null:
        cons(null[int], null[list[int]]),
      cons(head, tail):
        LET tail_sublists: list[list[int]] = sublists(tail)
        IN
          append_subsequence_lists(
            tail_sublists,
            prepend_to_each(head, tail_sublists))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE nums BY <<

  filter_nonempty(
      subsets: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subsets OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head /= null[int] THEN
          cons(head, filter_nonempty(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_nonempty(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsets BY <<

  product_fold(
      values: list[int],
      accumulator: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        product_fold(
          tail,
          accumulator * head)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  subset_products(
      subsets: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES subsets OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          product_fold(head, 1),
          subset_products(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subsets BY <<

  max_int_list_fold(
      values: list[int],
      current_maximum: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        current_maximum,
      cons(head, tail):
        max_int_list_fold(
          tail,
          IF head > current_maximum THEN
            head
          ELSE
            current_maximum
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  max_int_list_getD(
      values: list[int],
      default_value: int): int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        default_value,
      cons(head, tail):
        max_int_list_fold(tail, head)
    ENDCASES

  maxStrength(nums: list[int]): int =
    LET subsets: list[list[int]] = powerSet(nums),
        nonEmpty: list[list[int]] =
          filter_nonempty(subsets),
        products: list[int] =
          subset_products(nonEmpty)
    IN
      max_int_list_getD(products, -1000000)

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[int],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND int_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxStrength_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET nonempty_sublists: list[list[int]] =
          filter_nonempty(sublists(nums)),
        products: list[int] =
          subset_products(nonempty_sublists)
    IN
      int_list_contains(products, result)
        AND int_list_all_at_most(products, result)

  maxStrength_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      maxStrength_precond(nums) IMPLIES
        maxStrength_postcond(
          nums,
          maxStrength(nums))

END verina_advanced_43

-- !benchmark @start code_aux

def maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK (arr : Array Int) (k : Int) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let n := arr.size
  if n = 0 || k = 0 then 0
  else
    --compute prefix sums for efficient subarray sum calculation
    let prefixSums := Id.run do
      let mut prefixSums := Array.mkArray (n + 1) 0
      for i in [0:n] do
        prefixSums := prefixSums.set! (i+1) (prefixSums[i]! + arr[i]!)
      prefixSums

    let result := Id.run do
      let mut best : Option Int := none
      for len in List.range (n+1) do
        if len % k = 0 && len > 0 then
          for start in [0:(n - len + 1)] do
            let endIdx := start + len
            let subarraySum := prefixSums[endIdx]! - prefixSums[start]!
            best := match best with
              | none => some subarraySum
              | some b => some (max b subarraySum)
      best

    match result with
    | none => 0
    | some s => s
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond (arr : Array Int) (k : Int) (result: Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let subarrays := List.range (arr.size) |>.flatMap (fun start =>
    List.range (arr.size - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => arr.extract start (start + len)))
  let divisibleSubarrays := subarrays.filter (fun subarray => subarray.size % k.toNat = 0 && subarray.size > 0)
  let subarraySums := divisibleSubarrays.map (fun subarray => subarray.toList.sum)
  -- No valid subarrays -> result is 0
  (subarraySums.length = 0 → result = 0) ∧
  -- Valid subarrays exist -> result is the maximum sum
  (subarraySums.length > 0 → result ∈ subarraySums ∧ subarraySums.all (fun sum => sum ≤ result))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied (arr: Array Int) (k: Int) :
    maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond (arr) (k) (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK (arr) (k)) := by

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_44,
   catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": executable prefix-sum
   enumeration of contiguous integer subarrays whose lengths are divisible by
   an integer k, together with the declared positive-k precondition and the
   maximum-sum correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond
    (_arr : list Z)
    (k : Z) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%Z.

Fixpoint maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsFrom
    (accumulator : Z)
    (arr : list Z) : list Z :=
  match arr with
  | [] => [accumulator]
  | x :: remaining =>
      accumulator ::
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsFrom
          (accumulator + x)%Z remaining
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums
    (arr : list Z) : list Z :=
  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsFrom 0%Z arr.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_validLength
    (len : nat)
    (k : Z) : bool :=
  andb
    (Z.eqb (Z.rem (Z.of_nat len) k) 0%Z)
    (Nat.ltb 0 len).

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sumsForLength
    (prefixSums : list Z)
    (n len : nat) : list Z :=
  map
    (fun start =>
      (nth (Nat.add start len) prefixSums 0%Z -
       nth start prefixSums 0%Z)%Z)
    (seq 0 (Nat.add (Nat.sub n len) 1)).

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_candidateSums
    (arr : list Z)
    (k : Z) : list Z :=
  let n := length arr in
  let prefixSums := maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums arr in
  flat_map
    (fun len =>
      if maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_validLength len k
      then
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sumsForLength
          prefixSums n len
      else [])
    (seq 0 (S n)).

Fixpoint maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_maxOption
    (values : list Z) : option Z :=
  match values with
  | [] => None
  | value :: remaining =>
      match maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_maxOption remaining with
      | None => Some value
      | Some currentMaximum => Some (Z.max value currentMaximum)
      end
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK
    (arr : list Z)
    (k : Z) : Z :=
  let n := length arr in
  if orb (Nat.eqb n 0) (Z.eqb k 0%Z)
  then 0%Z
  else
    match
      maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_maxOption
        (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_candidateSums arr k)
    with
    | None => 0%Z
    | Some maximum => maximum
    end.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_extract
    (arr : list Z)
    (start len : nat) : list Z :=
  firstn len (skipn start arr).

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays
    (arr : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  let n := length arr in
  flat_map
    (fun start =>
      map
        (fun len =>
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_extract arr start len)
        (seq 0 (Nat.add (Nat.sub n start) 1)))
    (seq 0 n).

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleNonempty
    (k : Z)
    (subarray : list Z) : bool :=
  andb
    (Nat.eqb
      (Nat.modulo (length subarray) (Z.to_nat k))
      0)
    (Nat.ltb 0 (length subarray)).

Fixpoint maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum
    (subarray : list Z) : Z :=
  match subarray with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: remaining =>
      (x + maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum remaining)%Z
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
    (arr : list Z)
    (k result : Z) : Prop :=
  let subarrays :=
    maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays arr in
  let divisibleSubarrays :=
    filter
      (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleNonempty k)
      subarrays in
  let subarraySums :=
    map maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum divisibleSubarrays in
  (length subarraySums = 0%nat -> result = 0%Z) /\
  ((0 < length subarraySums)%nat ->
    In result subarraySums /\
    forallb (fun sum => Z.leb sum result) subarraySums = true).

Theorem maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied
    (arr : list Z)
    (k : Z) :
  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
    arr k (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k).
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_44,
  catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": an executable prefix-sum program
  returns the maximum sum among nonempty contiguous subarrays whose length is
  divisible by an integer parameter, together with its positive-parameter
  precondition and maximality postcondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_44
  imports Main
begin

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond arr k \<longleftrightarrow> k > 0"

fun maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux acc [] = [acc]"
| "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux acc (x # xs) =
    acc # maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux (acc + x) xs"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums arr =
    maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux 0 arr"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int option \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int option" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest prefixSums len best start =
    (let endIdx = start + len;
         subarraySum = prefixSums ! endIdx - prefixSums ! start
     in case best of
          None \<Rightarrow> Some subarraySum
        | Some b \<Rightarrow> Some (max b subarraySum))"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLen ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow>
      int option \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int option" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLen arr prefixSums k best len =
    (if int len mod k = 0 \<and> len > 0
     then
       foldl
         (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest prefixSums len)
         best [0..<(length arr - len + 1)]
     else best)"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k =
    (let n = length arr
     in if n = 0 \<or> k = 0
        then 0
        else
          (let prefixSums =
                 maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums arr;
               result =
                 foldl
                   (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLen
                     arr prefixSums k)
                   None [0..<n + 1]
           in case result of None \<Rightarrow> 0 | Some s \<Rightarrow> s))"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays arr =
    concat
      (map
        (\<lambda>start.
          map
            (\<lambda>len. take len (drop start arr))
            [0..<(length arr - start + 1)])
        [0..<length arr])"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays arr k =
    filter
      (\<lambda>subarray.
        length subarray mod nat k = 0 \<and> length subarray > 0)
      (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays arr)"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums arr k =
    map sum_list (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays arr k)"

definition maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond arr k result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subarraySums =
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums arr k
     in
       (length subarraySums = 0 \<longrightarrow> result = 0) \<and>
       (length subarraySums > 0 \<longrightarrow>
         result \<in> set subarraySums \<and>
         list_all (\<lambda>subarraySum. subarraySum \<le> result)
           subarraySums))"

theorem maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied:
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
    arr k (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k)"
  sorry

end

  catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": a prefix-sum enumeration computes
  the maximum sum of a contiguous integer subarray whose positive length is
  divisible by k, with its positive-k precondition, exhaustive postcondition,
  and unconditional correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond
      (arr:int list) (k:int) <=>
     k > &0`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!index:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get (SUC index) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get index (TL xs))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixBuild =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!current:int. !acc:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixBuild
          ([]:int list) current acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !current:int. !acc:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixBuild
          (CONS x xs) current acc =
        let next = current + x in
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixBuild
          xs next (APPEND acc (CONS next [])))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums (arr:int list) =
     maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixBuild
       arr (&0:int) (CONS (&0:int) [])`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_optionValue =
  new_recursive_definition option_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_optionValue
        (NONE:int option) = (&0:int)) /\
     (!x:int.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_optionValue (SOME x) = x)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest
      (best:int option) (candidate:int) =
     if best = NONE then SOME candidate
     else
       let previous =
         maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_optionValue best in
       SOME
         (if previous <= candidate
          then candidate
          else previous)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanStarts =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!len:num. !prefixSums:int list. !best:int option.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanStarts
          ([]:num list) len prefixSums best = best) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !len:num.
      !prefixSums:int list. !best:int option.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanStarts
          (CONS start starts) len prefixSums best =
        let subarraySum =
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get
            (start + len) prefixSums -
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_get
            start prefixSums in
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanStarts
          starts len prefixSums
          (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest
            best subarraySum))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_lengthDivisible = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_lengthDivisible
      (len:num) (k:int) <=>
     ?q:int. (&len:int) = k * q`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanLengths =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!n:num. !k:int. !prefixSums:int list. !best:int option.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanLengths
          ([]:num list) n k prefixSums best = best) /\
     (!len:num. !lens:num list. !n:num. !k:int.
      !prefixSums:int list. !best:int option.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanLengths
          (CONS len lens) n k prefixSums best =
        let nextBest =
          if
            maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_lengthDivisible len k /\
            len > 0
          then
            maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanStarts
              (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range
                (n - len + 1))
              len prefixSums best
          else best in
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanLengths
          lens n k prefixSums nextBest)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK (arr:int list) (k:int) =
     let n = LENGTH arr in
     if n = 0 \/ k = &0 then (&0:int)
     else
       let prefixSums =
         maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums arr in
       let result =
         maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_scanLengths
           (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range (n + 1))
           n k prefixSums (NONE:int option) in
       if result = NONE then (&0:int)
       else maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_optionValue result`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_drop 0 xs = xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_drop (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_drop n (TL xs))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_take 0 xs = []) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_take (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD xs)
            (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_take n (TL xs)))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_slicesAt = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_slicesAt
      (arr:int list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_take len
            (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_drop start arr))
       (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range
         (LENGTH arr - start + 1))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlicesFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!arr:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlicesFrom
          arr ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !arr:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlicesFrom
          arr (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_slicesAt arr start)
          (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlicesFrom
            arr starts))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlices = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlices (arr:int list) =
     maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlicesFrom
       arr
       (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_range (LENGTH arr))`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_validSlice = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_validSlice
      (k:int) (subarray:int list) <=>
     LENGTH subarray > 0 /\
     k > &0 /\
     (?q:int. (&(LENGTH subarray):int) = k * q)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum ([]:int list) = (&0:int)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum (CONS x xs) =
        x + maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum xs)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
      (arr:int list) (k:int) (result:int) <=>
     let subarrays =
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_allSlices arr in
     let divisibleSubarrays =
       FILTER
         (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_validSlice k)
         subarrays in
     let subarraySums =
       MAP maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_sum
         divisibleSubarrays in
     (LENGTH subarraySums = 0 ==> result = &0) /\
     (LENGTH subarraySums > 0
      ==> MEM result subarraySums /\
          ALL (\s:int. s <= result) subarraySums)`;;

let maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied =
  `!arr:int list. !k:int.
     maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
       arr k (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k)`;;

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_44,
;; "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": the deterministic prefix-sum program computes
;; a maximum sum among nonempty contiguous integer subarrays whose length is
;; divisible by k, with its complete correctness contract. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-44-integer-listp (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (and
       (integerp (car arr))
       (verina-advanced-44-integer-listp
        (cdr arr)))
    (equal arr nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-precond
    (arr k)
  (declare (ignore arr))
  (> k 0))

;; Starting with RUNNING = 0, this produces exactly the source prefixSums
;; array [0, arr[0], arr[0] + arr[1], ...].

(defun verina-advanced-44-prefix-sums-aux
    (remaining running)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons
       running
       (verina-advanced-44-prefix-sums-aux
        (cdr remaining)
        (+ running (car remaining))))
    (list running)))

(defun verina-advanced-44-prefix-sums (arr)
  (verina-advanced-44-prefix-sums-aux arr 0))

;; This is integer-array get! with the source default zero. Every call made by
;; the translated executable loops is in bounds.

(defun verina-advanced-44-integer-nth
    (index values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (if (consp values)
          (car values)
        0)
    (if (consp values)
        (verina-advanced-44-integer-nth
         (- index 1)
         (cdr values))
      0)))

;; A non-nil dotted pair (t . sum) represents Option.some sum; nil represents
;; Option.none. This update is exactly the source match followed by integer
;; max.

(defun verina-advanced-44-update-best
    (best subarray-sum)
  (if (consp best)
      (cons
       t
       (if (> (cdr best) subarray-sum)
           (cdr best)
         subarray-sum))
    (cons t subarray-sum)))

;; For one accepted length, START and REMAINING-STARTS traverse precisely
;; 0,...,n-len. Each sum is prefixSums[start+len] - prefixSums[start].

(defun verina-advanced-44-scan-starts
    (prefix-sums subarray-length start remaining-starts best)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      best
    (let* ((end-index
            (+ start subarray-length))
           (subarray-sum
            (-
             (verina-advanced-44-integer-nth
              end-index
              prefix-sums)
             (verina-advanced-44-integer-nth
              start
              prefix-sums)))
           (next-best
            (verina-advanced-44-update-best
             best
             subarray-sum)))
      (verina-advanced-44-scan-starts
       prefix-sums
       subarray-length
       (+ start 1)
       (- remaining-starts 1)
       next-best))))

;; LENGTH and REMAINING-LENGTHS traverse List.range (n+1) in increasing order.
;; A length enters the inner loop exactly when it is positive and its integer
;; remainder modulo the nonzero k is zero.

(defun verina-advanced-44-scan-lengths
    (prefix-sums total-length k length remaining-lengths best)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      best
    (let ((next-best
           (if (and
                (> length 0)
                (not (equal k 0))
                (equal (mod length k) 0))
               (verina-advanced-44-scan-starts
                prefix-sums
                length
                0
                (+ (- total-length length) 1)
                best)
             best)))
      (verina-advanced-44-scan-lengths
       prefix-sums
       total-length
       k
       (+ length 1)
       (- remaining-lengths 1)
       next-best))))

;; This preserves both source early-return branches, the prefix-sum
;; construction, the nested loop bounds and order, and Option.getD 0.

(defun verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k
    (arr k)
  (let ((total-length (len arr)))
    (if (or
         (equal total-length 0)
         (equal k 0))
        0
      (let* ((prefix-sums
              (verina-advanced-44-prefix-sums arr))
             (best
              (verina-advanced-44-scan-lengths
               prefix-sums
               total-length
               k
               0
               (+ total-length 1)
               nil)))
        (if (consp best)
            (cdr best)
          0)))))

;; DROP and TAKE reconstruct Array.extract start (start + length) on the valid
;; bounds generated by the postcondition's two List.range expressions.

(defun verina-advanced-44-drop
    (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      values
    (if (consp values)
        (verina-advanced-44-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr values))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-44-take
    (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp values)
        (cons
         (car values)
         (verina-advanced-44-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr values)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-44-extract
    (arr start length)
  (verina-advanced-44-take
   length
   (verina-advanced-44-drop start arr)))

;; At a fixed start this enumerates lengths 0,...,n-start. The outer recursion
;; enumerates starts 0,...,n-1, matching List.range arr.size and flatMap.

(defun verina-advanced-44-subarrays-at-start
    (arr start length remaining-lengths)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-44-extract
      arr
      start
      length)
     (verina-advanced-44-subarrays-at-start
      arr
      start
      (+ length 1)
      (- remaining-lengths 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-44-all-subarrays-from
    (arr start remaining-starts total-length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (append
     (verina-advanced-44-subarrays-at-start
      arr
      start
      0
      (+ (- total-length start) 1))
     (verina-advanced-44-all-subarrays-from
      arr
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)
      total-length))))

(defun verina-advanced-44-all-subarrays (arr)
  (let ((total-length (len arr)))
    (verina-advanced-44-all-subarrays-from
     arr
     0
     total-length
     total-length)))

;; Lean Int.toNat maps nonpositive integers to zero. Lean natural remainder by
;; zero returns its dividend, so no nonempty subarray passes the filter when
;; k.toNat is zero.

(defun verina-advanced-44-int-to-nat (k)
  (if (> k 0)
      k
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-44-nat-mod
    (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

(defun verina-advanced-44-filter-divisible-subarrays
    (subarrays k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarrays)))
  (if (consp subarrays)
      (let* ((subarray (car subarrays))
             (subarray-length (len subarray))
             (divisor
              (verina-advanced-44-int-to-nat k)))
        (if (and
             (equal
              (verina-advanced-44-nat-mod
               subarray-length
               divisor)
              0)
             (> subarray-length 0))
            (cons
             subarray
             (verina-advanced-44-filter-divisible-subarrays
              (cdr subarrays)
              k))
          (verina-advanced-44-filter-divisible-subarrays
           (cdr subarrays)
           k)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-44-list-sum (values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (+
       (car values)
       (verina-advanced-44-list-sum
        (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-44-map-subarray-sums
    (subarrays)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarrays)))
  (if (consp subarrays)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-44-list-sum
        (car subarrays))
       (verina-advanced-44-map-subarray-sums
        (cdr subarrays)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-44-all-sums-at-most-p
    (sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sums)))
  (if (consp sums)
      (and
       (<= (car sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-44-all-sums-at-most-p
        (cdr sums)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-postcond
    (arr k result)
  (let* ((subarrays
          (verina-advanced-44-all-subarrays arr))
         (divisible-subarrays
          (verina-advanced-44-filter-divisible-subarrays
           subarrays
           k))
         (subarray-sums
          (verina-advanced-44-map-subarray-sums
           divisible-subarrays)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-44-integer-listp arr)
     (integerp k)
     (integerp result)
     (implies
      (equal (len subarray-sums) 0)
      (equal result 0))
     (implies
      (> (len subarray-sums) 0)
      (and
       (member-equal result subarray-sums)
       (verina-advanced-44-all-sums-at-most-p
        subarray-sums
        result))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. The source
;; defines k > 0 as a separate precondition, but its final Lean theorem does
;; not assume that precondition. Accordingly, this antecedent contains only
;; the Array Int and Int binder domains and applies the complete postcondition
;; to the exact executable result for every integer k.

(defun
    verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-spec-satisfied-statement
    (arr k)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-44-integer-listp arr)
    (integerp k))
   (verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-postcond
    arr
    k
    (verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k
     arr
     k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_44,
-- catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": a deterministic prefix-sum
-- program computes the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous integer subarray
-- whose length is divisible by k, with its full contract. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced44 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _&&_ _||_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_
infix 4 _∈_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

intNatAbs : Int → Nat
intNatAbs (pos n) = n
intNatAbs (negsuc n) = suc n

intToNat : Int → Nat
intToNat (pos n) = n
intToNat (negsuc n) = zero

listIsEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listIsEmpty [] = true
listIsEmpty (_ ∷ _) = false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

sumList : List Int → Int
sumList xs = foldLeft intAdd (pos zero) xs

data PositiveInt : Int → Set where
  positive-int : {n : Nat} → PositiveInt (pos (suc n))

maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-precond :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Set
maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-precond arr k =
  PositiveInt k

prefixSumsFrom : Int → List Int → List Int
prefixSumsFrom accumulator [] =
  accumulator ∷ []
prefixSumsFrom accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  accumulator ∷
  prefixSumsFrom (intAdd accumulator x) xs

prefixSums : List Int → List Int
prefixSums arr = prefixSumsFrom (pos zero) arr

lengthDivisibleByInt : Nat → Int → Bool
lengthDivisibleByInt length k =
  natEqual
    (naturalMod length (intNatAbs k))
    zero

updateBest : Maybe Int → Int → Maybe Int
updateBest nothing value = just value
updateBest (just best) value =
  just (intMax best value)

processStart :
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Maybe Int →
  Nat →
  Maybe Int
processStart sums length best start =
  let finish = start + length
      subarray-sum =
        intSubtract
          (nthDefault (pos zero) finish sums)
          (nthDefault (pos zero) start sums)
  in updateBest best subarray-sum

processLength :
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Int →
  Maybe Int →
  Nat →
  Maybe Int
processLength n sums k best length =
  if
    lengthDivisibleByInt length k &&
    natLess zero length
  then
    foldLeft
      (processStart sums length)
      best
      (range (suc (natSubtract n length)))
  else best

maybeIntOrZero : Maybe Int → Int
maybeIntOrZero nothing = pos zero
maybeIntOrZero (just value) = value

maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Int
maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k =
  let n = listLength arr
  in
    if
      listIsEmpty arr ||
      intEqual k (pos zero)
    then pos zero
    else
      maybeIntOrZero
        (foldLeft
          (processLength n (prefixSums arr) k)
          nothing
          (range (suc n)))

allSubarrays : List Int → List (List Int)
allSubarrays arr =
  let n = listLength arr
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ start →
        mapList
          (λ length →
            takeList length (dropList start arr))
          (range (suc (natSubtract n start))))
      (range n)

subarrayLengthDivisibleByNat : Nat → List Int → Bool
subarrayLengthDivisibleByNat divisor subarray =
  natEqual
    (naturalMod (listLength subarray) divisor)
    zero &&
  natLess zero (listLength subarray)

divisibleSubarrays :
  List Int →
  Int →
  List (List Int)
divisibleSubarrays arr k =
  filterList
    (subarrayLengthDivisibleByNat (intToNat k))
    (allSubarrays arr)

subarraySums :
  List Int →
  Int →
  List Int
subarraySums arr k =
  mapList sumList (divisibleSubarrays arr k)

data _∈_ (x : Int) : List Int → Set where
  here : {xs : List Int} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there :
    {y : Int} →
    {xs : List Int} →
    x ∈ xs →
    x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-postcond :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Int →
  Set
maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-postcond arr k result =
  let sums = subarraySums arr k
  in
    (listLength sums ≡ zero →
     result ≡ pos zero) ∧
    (zero < listLength sums →
     result ∈ sums ∧
     IsTrue
       (allList
         (λ sum → intLessOrEqual sum result)
         sums))

maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-spec-satisfied : Set
maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-spec-satisfied =
  (arr : List Int) →
  (k : Int) →
  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK-postcond
    arr
    k
    (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k)

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_44,
  cataloged as "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": the executable prefix-sum
  program returns the maximum sum among nonempty contiguous integer
  subarrays whose length is divisible by k, defaulting to zero when no such
  subarray is found. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond
      (arr : int list) (k : int) <=>
      k > 0``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux
      (acc : int) ([] : int list) =
     [acc]) /\
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux
      acc (x::xs) =
     acc ::
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux
         (acc + x) xs)
`;

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums (arr : int list) =
      maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSumsAux 0 arr``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest
      (best : int option) (subarraySum : int) =
      case best of
        NONE => SOME subarraySum
      | SOME b =>
          SOME (if b < subarraySum then subarraySum else b)``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processStarts_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processStarts
      (prefixSums : int list)
      (len : num)
      ([] : num list)
      (best : int option) =
     best) /\
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processStarts
      prefixSums len (start::starts) best =
     let endIdx = start + len in
     let subarraySum =
       EL endIdx prefixSums - EL start prefixSums in
     let nextBest =
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_updateBest best subarraySum
     in
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processStarts
         prefixSums len starts nextBest)
`;

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLengths_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLengths
      (prefixSums : int list)
      (k : int)
      (n : num)
      ([] : num list)
      (best : int option) =
     best) /\
  (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLengths
      prefixSums k n (len::lens) best =
     let nextBest =
       if int_of_num len % k = 0 /\ 0 < len then
         maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processStarts
           prefixSums len (COUNT_LIST (n - len + 1)) best
       else
         best
     in
       maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLengths
         prefixSums k n lens nextBest)
`;

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK
      (arr : int list) (k : int) =
      let n = LENGTH arr in
      if n = 0 \/ k = 0 then
        0
      else
        let prefixSums =
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_prefixSums arr in
        let result =
          maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_processLengths
            prefixSums k n (COUNT_LIST (n + 1)) NONE
        in
          case result of
            NONE => 0
          | SOME s => s``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_intToNat_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_intToNat_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_intToNat (k : int) =
      if k < 0 then 0 else Num k``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays (arr : int list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\start.
             MAP
               (\len. TAKE len (DROP start arr))
               (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH arr - start + 1)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH arr)))``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays_def =
  new_definition (
    "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays_def",
    ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays
        (arr : int list) (k : int) =
        FILTER
          (\subarray : int list.
             LENGTH subarray MOD
                 maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_intToNat k = 0 /\
             0 < LENGTH subarray)
          (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarrays arr)``
  );

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySum_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySum_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySum
      (subarray : int list) =
      FOLDL (\acc x. acc + x) 0 subarray``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums
      (arr : int list) (k : int) =
      MAP
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySum
        (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_divisibleSubarrays arr k)``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
      (arr : int list) (k : int) (result : int) <=>
      let subarraySums =
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_subarraySums arr k
      in
        (LENGTH subarraySums = 0 ==> result = 0) /\
        (LENGTH subarraySums > 0 ==>
          MEM result subarraySums /\
          EVERY (\sum : int. sum <= result) subarraySums)``
);

val maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(arr : int list) (k : int).
      maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond
        arr k (maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK arr k)``;

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_44 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_44), catalog title
  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK: the exact prefix-sum and nested-loop program
  computes a defaulted maximum sum of contiguous subarrays with eligible
  lengths, together with its independently enumerated divisibility
  postcondition for arbitrary finite integer arrays and integer k. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  i ..^ j is the half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA44PrefixGraph is the exact trace produced by Array.mkArray followed
  by the source loop of set! updates: it starts at integer zero and records
  every successive array prefix sum. VERINA44IntRemainderZero captures
  ((len : Int) % k = 0) exactly on natural len, including Lean's behavior
  len % 0 = len.

  VERINA44ImplSumsGraph enumerates precisely the successful iterations of the
  implementation's outer List.range (n + 1) and inner
  List.range (n - len + 1), in length-major and then start-major order. Each
  output is the same difference of prefix sums. VERINA44None,
  VERINA44Some, and VERINA44OptionInt encode Option Int.
  VERINA44BestOptionGraph is the exact mutable best trace: it remains none on
  an empty candidate word, starts with the first sum otherwise, and applies
  integer max left-to-right. VERINA44OptionGetD performs the final match with
  default zero. VERINA44MaxSubarraySumDivisibleByK also preserves the source
  early return when the array is empty or k is zero.

  VERINA44ToNat is Lean Int.toNat. VERINA44PostLengthEligible therefore
  reproduces the postcondition's
    subarray.size % k.toNat = 0 && subarray.size > 0,
  including the absence of eligible positive lengths when k is nonpositive.
  VERINA44Extract is Array.extract on the in-range endpoints generated here.
  VERINA44PostSubarraysGraph preserves the source flatMap order: starts are
  zero through n - 1, and lengths for each start are zero through n - start.
  VERINA44DivisibleSubarraysGraph is the exact stable filter, retaining
  duplicate occurrences. VERINA44Sum is List.sum from integer zero, and
  VERINA44SubarraySumsGraph maps it over the filtered word.

  VERINA44Pre is the source positive-k precondition. The official final Lean
  proposition does not assume that precondition, so the final $a likewise
  quantifies unconditionally over every integer k. VERINA44Post preserves
  both source implications: an empty sum word forces result zero, while a
  nonempty sum word requires the result to occur and to bound every sum.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this root
  statement file introduces no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA44PrefixGraph VERINA44Prefix
  VERINA44IntRemainderZero
  VERINA44ImplSumsGraph VERINA44ImplSums
  VERINA44None VERINA44Some VERINA44OptionInt
  VERINA44BestOptionGraph VERINA44BestOption VERINA44OptionGetD
  VERINA44Pre VERINA44MaxSubarraySumDivisibleByK
  VERINA44ToNat VERINA44PostLengthEligible
  VERINA44ExtractGraph VERINA44Extract
  VERINA44PostSubarraysGraph VERINA44PostSubarrays
  VERINA44DivisibleSubarraysGraph VERINA44DivisibleSubarrays
  VERINA44Sum
  VERINA44SubarraySumsGraph VERINA44SubarraySums
  VERINA44Post
$.

verina44-prefix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44PrefixGraph A B ) $.
verina44-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44Prefix A ) $.
verina44-int-remainder-zero-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44IntRemainderZero A B ) $.
verina44-impl-sums-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44ImplSumsGraph A B C ) $.
verina44-impl-sums-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44ImplSums A B ) $.
verina44-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA44None $.
verina44-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44Some A ) $.
verina44-option-int-syntax
  $a class VERINA44OptionInt $.
verina44-best-option-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44BestOptionGraph A B ) $.
verina44-best-option-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44BestOption A ) $.
verina44-option-get-d-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44OptionGetD A ) $.
verina44-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44Pre A B ) $.
verina44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44MaxSubarraySumDivisibleByK A B ) $.
verina44-to-nat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44ToNat A ) $.
verina44-post-length-eligible-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44PostLengthEligible A B ) $.
verina44-extract-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44ExtractGraph A B C D ) $.
verina44-extract-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44Extract A B C ) $.
verina44-post-subarrays-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44PostSubarraysGraph A B ) $.
verina44-post-subarrays-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44PostSubarrays A ) $.
verina44-divisible-subarrays-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44DivisibleSubarraysGraph A B C ) $.
verina44-divisible-subarrays-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44DivisibleSubarrays A B ) $.
verina44-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44Sum A ) $.
verina44-subarray-sums-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44SubarraySumsGraph A B C ) $.
verina44-subarray-sums-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA44SubarraySums A B ) $.
verina44-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA44Post A B C ) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina44-prefix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44PrefixGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` B ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
        /\
        ( B ` 0 ) = 0
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` ( i + 1 )
        ) = (
          ( B ` i ) + ( A ` i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina44-prefix-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44Prefix A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA44PrefixGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d q A B $.

  verina44-int-remainder-zero-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44IntRemainderZero A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. q e. ZZ
      A = ( B x. q )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j l p q s A B C $.

  verina44-impl-sums-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44ImplSumsGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ ( # ` A )
                  /\
                  (
                    VERINA44IntRemainderZero
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                      B
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  0 < ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                  /\
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ (
                    ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                  )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                C ` i
              ) = (
                (
                  VERINA44Prefix A
                ) ` (
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) ) +
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
                -
                (
                  VERINA44Prefix A
                ) ` (
                  2nd ` ( p ` i )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    1st ` ( p ` i )
                  ) < (
                    1st ` ( p ` j )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      1st ` ( p ` i )
                    ) = (
                      1st ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      2nd ` ( p ` i )
                    ) < (
                      2nd ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. l e. NN0
            A. s e. NN0
              (
                (
                  (
                    l <_ ( # ` A )
                    /\
                    ( VERINA44IntRemainderZero l B )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    0 < l
                    /\
                    s <_ ( ( # ` A ) - l )
                  )
                )
                ->
                E. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                  ( p ` q ) = <. l , s >.
              )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina44-impl-sums-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44ImplSums A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA44ImplSumsGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina44-none-definition $a |- VERINA44None = (/) $.

verina44-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina44-option-int-definition $a |- VERINA44OptionInt =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA44None
        \/
        E. y e. ZZ x = ( VERINA44Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d i s A B $.

  verina44-best-option-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44BestOptionGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. VERINA44OptionInt
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        A = (/)
        /\
        B = VERINA44None
      )
      \/
      (
        A =/= (/)
        /\
        E. s e. Word ZZ
          (
            (
              (
                ( # ` s ) = ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( s ` 0 ) = ( A ` 0 )
              )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 1 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  s ` i
                ) = if (
                  ( s ` ( i - 1 ) ) < ( A ` i ) ,
                  ( A ` i ) ,
                  ( s ` ( i - 1 ) )
                )
            )
            /\
            B = (
              VERINA44Some
                ( s ` ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina44-best-option-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44BestOption A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINA44OptionInt
      ( VERINA44BestOptionGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina44-option-get-d-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44OptionGetD A
) = if (
  A = VERINA44None ,
  0 ,
  ( 2nd ` A )
) $.

verina44-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. ZZ
  )
  /\
  0 < B
) $.

verina44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44MaxSubarraySumDivisibleByK A B
) = if (
  (
    ( # ` A ) = 0
    \/
    B = 0
  )
  ,
  0
  ,
  (
    VERINA44OptionGetD
      ( VERINA44BestOption ( VERINA44ImplSums A B ) )
  )
) $.

verina44-to-nat-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44ToNat A
) = if (
  A < 0 ,
  0 ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d q A B $.

  verina44-post-length-eligible-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44PostLengthEligible A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      0 < A
      /\
      E. q e. NN0
        A = ( ( VERINA44ToNat B ) x. q )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verina44-extract-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44ExtractGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. Word ZZ
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B <_ ( # ` A )
        /\
        C <_ ( ( # ` A ) - B )
      )
      /\
      (
        ( # ` D ) = C
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          ( D ` i ) = ( A ` ( B + i ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina44-extract-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44Extract A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA44ExtractGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p q r A B $.

  verina44-post-subarrays-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44PostSubarraysGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ (
                  ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                B ` i
              ) = (
                VERINA44Extract
                  A
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    1st ` ( p ` i )
                  ) < (
                    1st ` ( p ` j )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      1st ` ( p ` i )
                    ) = (
                      1st ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      2nd ` ( p ` i )
                    ) < (
                      2nd ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. q e. NN0
            A. r e. NN0
              (
                (
                  q < ( # ` A )
                  /\
                  r <_ ( ( # ` A ) - q )
                )
                ->
                E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                  ( p ` i ) = <. q , r >.
              )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina44-post-subarrays-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44PostSubarrays A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      ( VERINA44PostSubarraysGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p A B C $.

  verina44-divisible-subarrays-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44DivisibleSubarraysGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )

              (

$}

${

  verina44-divisible-subarrays-definition $a |- (

      ( VERINA44DivisibleSubarraysGraph A B y )

verina44-sum-definition $a |- (
  VERINA44Sum A
) = (
  ( VERINA44Prefix A ) ` ( # ` A )
) $.

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verina44-subarray-sums-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA44SubarraySumsGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (

        A e. Word ZZ

      )

    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = (
        # ` ( VERINA44DivisibleSubarrays A B )
      )
      /\

        (
          C ` i

            ( ( VERINA44DivisibleSubarrays A B ) ` i )

$}

${

verina-advanced-44-max-subarray-sum-divisible-by-k
