title: verina_advanced_44
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_44, catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": an exact
:: finite-sequence operational graph of the positive-k precondition, prefix
:: sums, nested length/start loops and optional-maximum state, together with
:: the divisible-length subarray-sum postcondition and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0,
    XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for arr being FinSequence of INT,
      k,result being Integer st
    (ex preconditionValue being Element of BOOLEAN st
      (preconditionValue = TRUE & 0 < k) or
      (preconditionValue = FALSE & k <= 0)) &
    (((len arr = 0 or k = 0) & result = 0) or
     (len arr <> 0 & k <> 0 &
      ex prefixSums,outerBests being FinSequence of INT,
         outerHasBest being FinSequence of BOOLEAN st
        len prefixSums = len arr + 1 &
        prefixSums/.1 = 0 &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom arr holds
          prefixSums/.(i + 1) = prefixSums/.i + arr/.i) &
        len outerHasBest = len arr + 2 &
        len outerBests = len arr + 2 &
        outerHasBest/.1 = FALSE &
        outerBests/.1 = 0 &
        (for ell being Nat st ell <= len arr holds
          (((ell = 0 or
              not ex q being Integer st
                (ell qua Integer) = q * k) &
            outerHasBest/.(ell + 2) =
              outerHasBest/.(ell + 1) &
            outerBests/.(ell + 2) =
              outerBests/.(ell + 1)) or
           (0 < ell &
            (ex q being Integer st
              (ell qua Integer) = q * k) &
            ex innerBests being FinSequence of INT,
               innerHasBest being FinSequence of BOOLEAN st
              len innerHasBest = (len arr -' ell) + 2 &
              len innerBests = (len arr -' ell) + 2 &
              innerHasBest/.1 = outerHasBest/.(ell + 1) &
              innerBests/.1 = outerBests/.(ell + 1) &
              innerHasBest/.((len arr -' ell) + 2) =
                outerHasBest/.(ell + 2) &
              innerBests/.((len arr -' ell) + 2) =
                outerBests/.(ell + 2) &
              for start being Nat st start <= len arr -' ell holds
                (innerHasBest/.(start + 1) = FALSE &
                  innerHasBest/.(start + 2) = TRUE &
                  innerBests/.(start + 2) =
                    prefixSums/.(start + ell + 1) -
                      prefixSums/.(start + 1)) or
                (innerHasBest/.(start + 1) = TRUE &
                  innerHasBest/.(start + 2) = TRUE &
                  ((innerBests/.(start + 1) <
                      prefixSums/.(start + ell + 1) -
                        prefixSums/.(start + 1) &
                    innerBests/.(start + 2) =
                      prefixSums/.(start + ell + 1) -
                        prefixSums/.(start + 1)) or
                   (not innerBests/.(start + 1) <
                      prefixSums/.(start + ell + 1) -
                        prefixSums/.(start + 1) &
                    innerBests/.(start + 2) =
                      innerBests/.(start + 1))))))) &
        ((outerHasBest/.(len arr + 2) = FALSE & result = 0) or
         (outerHasBest/.(len arr + 2) = TRUE &
          result = outerBests/.(len arr + 2)))))
  holds
    ((not ex start,span being Nat st
        start < len arr &
        0 < span &
        start + span <= len arr &
        0 < k &
        ex q being Integer st
          (span qua Integer) = q * k)
      implies result = 0) &
    ((ex start,span being Nat st
        start < len arr &
        0 < span &
        start + span <= len arr &
        0 < k &
        ex q being Integer st
          (span qua Integer) = q * k)
      implies
        (ex start,span being Nat,
            sumStates being FinSequence of INT st
          start < len arr &
          0 < span &
          start + span <= len arr &
          0 < k &
          (ex q being Integer st
            (span qua Integer) = q * k) &
          len sumStates = span + 1 &
          sumStates/.1 = 0 &
          (for t being Nat st 1 <= t & t <= span holds
            sumStates/.(t + 1) =
              sumStates/.t + arr/.(start + t)) &
          result = sumStates/.(span + 1)) &
        (for start,span being Nat,
             sumStates being FinSequence of INT st
          start < len arr &
          0 < span &
          start + span <= len arr &
          0 < k &
          (ex q being Integer st
            (span qua Integer) = q * k) &
          len sumStates = span + 1 &
          sumStates/.1 = 0 &
          (for t being Nat st 1 <= t & t <= span holds
            sumStates/.(t + 1) =
              sumStates/.t + arr/.(start + t))
        holds sumStates/.(span + 1) <= result))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_44
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_44, catalog title "maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK": the specified
% prefix-sum program computes a maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous integer
% subarray whose length is divisible by k, with its full contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_44: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoneInt: NoneInt?
    SomeInt(option_value: int): SomeInt?
  END int_option

  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_precond(
      arr: list[int],
      k: int): bool =
    k > 0

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  prefix_sums_aux(
      running: int,
      remaining: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        cons(running, null),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          running,
          prefix_sums_aux(running + head, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  prefix_sums(arr: list[int]): list[int] =
    prefix_sums_aux(0, arr)

  int_max(first, second: int): int =
    IF first >= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  update_best(
      best: int_option,
      subarray_sum: int): int_option =
    CASES best OF
      NoneInt:
        SomeInt(subarray_sum),
      SomeInt(current_best):
        SomeInt(int_max(current_best, subarray_sum))
    ENDCASES

  % For every integer k, this is equivalent to the source test
  % (length : Int) % k = 0, including k = 0 and negative k.
  length_divisible_by_int(
      length: nat,
      k: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      (length :: int) = k * quotient

  scan_starts(
      sums: list[int],
      subarray_length, start, remaining_starts: nat,
      best: int_option): RECURSIVE int_option =
    IF remaining_starts = 0 THEN
      best
    ELSE
      LET finish: nat = start + subarray_length,
          subarray_sum: int =
            int_list_get_bang(finish, sums)
              - int_list_get_bang(start, sums),
          next_best: int_option =
            update_best(best, subarray_sum)
      IN
        scan_starts(
          sums,
          subarray_length,
          start + 1,
          remaining_starts - 1,
          next_best)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_starts

  scan_lengths(
      sums: list[int],
      total_length: nat,
      k: int,
      length, remaining_lengths: nat,
      best: int_option): RECURSIVE int_option =
    IF remaining_lengths = 0 THEN
      best
    ELSE
      LET next_best: int_option =
        IF length_divisible_by_int(length, k)
             AND length > 0
        THEN
          scan_starts(
            sums,
            length,
            0,
            nat_subtract(total_length, length) + 1,
            best)
        ELSE
          best
        ENDIF
      IN
        scan_lengths(
          sums,
          total_length,
          k,
          length + 1,
          remaining_lengths - 1,
          next_best)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_lengths

  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK(
      arr: list[int],
      k: int): int =
    LET total_length: nat = int_list_length(arr)
    IN
      IF total_length = 0 OR k = 0 THEN
        0
      ELSE
        LET sums: list[int] = prefix_sums(arr),
            outcome: int_option =
              scan_lengths(
                sums,
                total_length,
                k,
                0,
                total_length + 1,
                NoneInt)
        IN
          CASES outcome OF
            NoneInt:
              0,
            SomeInt(value):
              value
          ENDCASES
      ENDIF

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_extract(
      values: list[int],
      start, length: nat): list[int] =
    int_list_take(
      length,
      int_list_drop(start, values))

  append_int_list_lists(
      first, second: list[list[int]]):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_list_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  subarrays_at_start(
      arr: list[int],
      start, length, remaining_lengths: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    IF remaining_lengths = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        int_list_extract(arr, start, length),
        subarrays_at_start(
          arr,
          start,
          length + 1,
          remaining_lengths - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_lengths

  all_subarrays_from(
      arr: list[int],
      start, remaining_starts, total_length: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    IF remaining_starts = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      append_int_list_lists(
        subarrays_at_start(
          arr,
          start,
          0,
          nat_subtract(total_length, start) + 1),
        all_subarrays_from(
          arr,
          start + 1,
          remaining_starts - 1,
          total_length))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_starts

  all_subarrays(arr: list[int]): list[list[int]] =
    LET total_length: nat = int_list_length(arr)
    IN
      all_subarrays_from(
        arr,
        0,
        total_length,
        total_length)

  % This combines the source filter's positive-length test with natural
  % remainder by k.toNat. For k <= 0, no positive length is accepted.
  positive_length_divisible_by_to_nat(
      length: nat,
      k: int): bool =
    length > 0
      AND k > 0
      AND (EXISTS (quotient: int):
        (length :: int) = k * quotient)

  filter_divisible_subarrays(
      subarrays: list[list[int]],
      k: int): RECURSIVE list[list[int]] =
    CASES subarrays OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF positive_length_divisible_by_to_nat(
             int_list_length(head),
             k)
        THEN
          cons(
            head,
            filter_divisible_subarrays(tail, k))
        ELSE
          filter_divisible_subarrays(tail, k)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subarrays BY <<

  int_list_sum(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        head + int_list_sum(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  map_subarray_sums(
      subarrays: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES subarrays OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          int_list_sum(head),
          map_subarray_sums(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE subarrays BY <<

  divisible_subarray_sums(
      arr: list[int],
      k: int): list[int] =
    map_subarray_sums(
      filter_divisible_subarrays(
        all_subarrays(arr),
        k))

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[int],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND int_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond(
      arr: list[int],
      k, result: int): bool =
    LET subarray_sums: list[int] =
          divisible_subarray_sums(arr, k)
    IN
      (int_list_length(subarray_sums) = 0
        IMPLIES result = 0)
      AND
      (int_list_length(subarray_sums) > 0
        IMPLIES
          int_list_contains(subarray_sums, result)
            AND int_list_all_at_most(
                  subarray_sums,
                  result))

  % The source theorem defines the positive-k precondition separately but does
  % not assume it in the final proposition, so this quantifies over every k.
  maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (arr: list[int], k: int):
      maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK_postcond(
        arr,
        k,
        maxSubarraySumDivisibleByK(arr, k))

END verina_advanced_44

def maxSubarraySum (xs : List Int) (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond (xs)) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let rec helper (lst : List Int) (curMax : Int) (globalMax : Int) : Int :=

    | x :: rest =>
      let newCurMax := max x (curMax + x)
      let newGlobal := max globalMax newCurMax
      helper rest newCurMax newGlobal
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => helper rest x x
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible, simp]
def maxSubarraySum_postcond (xs : List Int) (result: Int) (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond (xs)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  -- Find all possible subarrays and their sums
  let subarray_sums := List.range (xs.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start =>
    List.range' 1 (xs.length - start) |>.map (fun len =>
      ((xs.drop start).take len).sum
    ))

  -- Check if there exists a subarray with sum equal to result
  let has_result_subarray := subarray_sums.any (fun sum => sum == result)


  -- Check if result is the maximum among all subarray sums
  let is_maximum := subarray_sums.all (· ≤ result)

  match xs with
  | [] => result == 0
  | _ => has_result_subarray ∧ is_maximum
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied (xs: List Int) (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond (xs)) :
    maxSubarraySum_postcond (xs) (maxSubarraySum (xs) h_precond) h_precond := by

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_45,
   catalog title "maxSubarraySum": an executable Kadane scan computing the
   maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous integer subarray, with zero for the
   empty list, together with its exact subarray-enumeration correctness
   contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition maxSubarraySum_precond (_xs : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint maxSubarraySum_helper
    (lst : list Z)
    (curMax globalMax : Z) : Z :=
  match lst with
  | [] => globalMax
  | x :: rest =>
      let newCurMax := Z.max x (curMax + x)%Z in
      let newGlobal := Z.max globalMax newCurMax in
      maxSubarraySum_helper rest newCurMax newGlobal
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySum
    (xs : list Z)
    (_h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond xs) : Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: rest => maxSubarraySum_helper rest x x
  end.

Fixpoint maxSubarraySum_sum (xs : list Z) : Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: rest => (x + maxSubarraySum_sum rest)%Z
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySum_subarraySums
    (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  flat_map
    (fun start =>
      map
        (fun len =>
          maxSubarraySum_sum
            (firstn len (skipn start xs)))
        (seq 1 (length xs - start)))
    (seq 0 (S (length xs))).

Definition maxSubarraySum_postcond
    (xs : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond xs) : Prop :=
  let subarray_sums := maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs in
  let has_result_subarray :=
    existsb (fun sum => Z.eqb sum result) subarray_sums in
  let is_maximum :=
    forallb (fun sum => Z.leb sum result) subarray_sums in
  match xs with
  | [] => Z.eqb result 0%Z = true
  | _ :: _ =>
      has_result_subarray = true /\
      is_maximum = true
  end.

Theorem maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied
    (xs : list Z)
    (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond xs) :
  maxSubarraySum_postcond
    xs (maxSubarraySum xs h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_45,
  catalog title "maxSubarraySum": an executable integer-list scan computes the
  maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray, returning zero for the empty
  list, together with its precondition and maximality contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_45
  imports Main
begin

definition maxSubarraySum_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySum_precond xs \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun maxSubarraySum_helper ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxSubarraySum_helper [] curMax globalMax = globalMax"
| "maxSubarraySum_helper (x # rest) curMax globalMax =
    (let newCurMax = max x (curMax + x);
         newGlobal = max globalMax newCurMax
     in maxSubarraySum_helper rest newCurMax newGlobal)"

definition maxSubarraySum :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxSubarraySum xs =
    (case xs of
       [] \<Rightarrow> 0
     | x # rest \<Rightarrow> maxSubarraySum_helper rest x x)"

definition maxSubarraySum_subarraySums :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs =
    concat
      (map
        (\<lambda>start.
          map
            (\<lambda>len. sum_list (take len (drop start xs)))
            [1..<(length xs - start + 1)])
        [0..<(length xs + 1)])"

definition maxSubarraySum_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySum_postcond xs result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subarraySums = maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs
     in case xs of
          [] \<Rightarrow> result = 0
        | _ \<Rightarrow>
            list_ex (\<lambda>subarraySum. subarraySum = result) subarraySums \<and>
            list_all (\<lambda>subarraySum. subarraySum \<le> result)
              subarraySums)"

theorem maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "maxSubarraySum_precond xs"
  shows "maxSubarraySum_postcond xs (maxSubarraySum xs)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_45,
  catalog title "maxSubarraySum": an executable Kadane scan computes the
  maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray of an integer list, returning
  zero on the empty list, with an exhaustive maximality postcondition. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let maxSubarraySum_precond = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_precond (xs:int list) <=> T`;;

let maxSubarraySum_max = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_max (a:int) (b:int) =
     if a <= b then b else a`;;

let maxSubarraySum_helper =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!curMax:int. !globalMax:int.
        maxSubarraySum_helper
          ([]:int list) curMax globalMax =
        globalMax) /\
     (!x:int. !rest:int list. !curMax:int. !globalMax:int.
        maxSubarraySum_helper
          (CONS x rest) curMax globalMax =
        let newCurMax =
          maxSubarraySum_max x (curMax + x) in
        let newGlobal =
          maxSubarraySum_max globalMax newCurMax in
        maxSubarraySum_helper
          rest newCurMax newGlobal)`;;

let maxSubarraySum = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum (xs:int list) =
     if xs = [] then (&0:int)
     else
       maxSubarraySum_helper
         (TL xs) (HD xs) (HD xs)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySum_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        maxSubarraySum_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySum_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_positiveLengths = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_positiveLengths (n:num) =
     MAP SUC (maxSubarraySum_range n)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_drop 0 xs = xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_drop (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else maxSubarraySum_drop n (TL xs))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_take 0 xs = []) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_take (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD xs)
            (maxSubarraySum_take n (TL xs)))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_sum =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySum_sum ([]:int list) = (&0:int)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_sum (CONS x xs) =
        x + maxSubarraySum_sum xs)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_sumsAt = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_sumsAt
      (xs:int list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          maxSubarraySum_sum
            (maxSubarraySum_take len
              (maxSubarraySum_drop start xs)))
       (maxSubarraySum_positiveLengths
         (LENGTH xs - start))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
          xs ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
          xs (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySum_sumsAt xs start)
          (maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom xs starts))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_subarraySums = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_subarraySums (xs:int list) =
     maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
       xs
       (maxSubarraySum_range (LENGTH xs + 1))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_postcond = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_postcond
      (xs:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let subarraySums =
       maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs in
     if xs = [] then result = (&0:int)
     else
       MEM result subarraySums /\
       ALL (\s:int. s <= result) subarraySums`;;

let maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied =
  `!xs:int list.
     maxSubarraySum_precond xs
     ==> maxSubarraySum_postcond
           xs (maxSubarraySum xs)`;;

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_45,
;; "maxSubarraySum": the deterministic Kadane-style integer-list program
;; computes a sum that occurs among the nonempty contiguous subarrays and is
;; at least every such sum, returning zero on an empty list. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-45-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-45-integer-listp
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Int binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-precond (xs)
  (declare (ignore xs))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-45-int-max (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      right
    left))

;; This is the source local helper. For each element, NEW-CURRENT is the larger
;; of starting a new subarray and extending the current one, and NEW-GLOBAL is
;; the larger of the previous global maximum and NEW-CURRENT.

(defun verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-helper
    (lst current-maximum global-maximum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lst)))
  (if (consp lst)
      (let* ((x (car lst))
             (new-current
              (verina-advanced-45-int-max
               x
               (+ current-maximum x)))
             (new-global
              (verina-advanced-45-int-max
               global-maximum
               new-current)))
        (verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-helper
         (cdr lst)
         new-current
         new-global))
    global-maximum))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument has no computational effect.
;; This preserves the empty-list branch and initializes both helper
;; accumulators from the first element exactly as in the source program.

(defun verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-helper
       (cdr xs)
       (car xs)
       (car xs))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-45-drop (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      xs
    (if (consp xs)
        (verina-advanced-45-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr xs))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-45-take (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-45-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr xs)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-45-list-sum (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (+
       (car xs)
       (verina-advanced-45-list-sum
        (cdr xs)))
    0))

;; At a fixed START, LENGTH and REMAINING-LENGTHS reproduce
;; List.range' 1 (xs.length - start), hence lengths
;; 1,...,xs.length-start in increasing order.

(defun verina-advanced-45-subarray-sums-at-start
    (xs start length remaining-lengths)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-45-list-sum
      (verina-advanced-45-take
       length
       (verina-advanced-45-drop
        start
        xs)))
     (verina-advanced-45-subarray-sums-at-start
      xs
      start
      (+ length 1)
      (- remaining-lengths 1)))))

;; START and REMAINING-STARTS reproduce List.range (xs.length + 1).
;; APPEND implements flatMap, so this is exactly the postcondition's ordered
;; list of sums of all nonempty contiguous subarrays.

(defun verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-from
    (xs start remaining-starts total-length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (append
     (verina-advanced-45-subarray-sums-at-start
      xs
      start
      1
      (nfix (- total-length start)))
     (verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-from
      xs
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)
      total-length))))

(defun verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums (xs)
  (let ((total-length (len xs)))
    (verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-from
     xs
     0
     (+ total-length 1)
     total-length)))

;; These recursions are respectively List.any equality and List.all (· <=
;; result) over the exact subarray-sum list.

(defun verina-advanced-45-has-result-subarray-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (or
       (equal (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-45-has-result-subarray-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-at-most-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (and
       (<= (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-at-most-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-postcond
    (xs result)
  (let* ((subarray-sums
          (verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums xs))
         (has-result-subarray
          (verina-advanced-45-has-result-subarray-p
           subarray-sums
           result))
         (is-maximum
          (verina-advanced-45-all-subarray-sums-at-most-p
           subarray-sums
           result)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-45-integer-listp xs)
     (integerp result)
     (if (equal xs nil)
         (equal result 0)
       (and
        has-result-subarray
        is-maximum)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and True precondition; its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-spec-satisfied-statement
    (xs)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-45-integer-listp xs)
    (verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-precond xs))
   (verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum-postcond
    xs
    (verina-advanced-45-max-subarray-sum xs))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_45,
-- catalog title "maxSubarraySum": Kadane's deterministic integer-list program
-- computes a maximum nonempty contiguous-subarray sum, returning zero on the
-- empty list, and is connected to its full contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced45 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

sumList : List Int → Int
sumList [] = pos zero
sumList (x ∷ xs) = intAdd x (sumList xs)

maxSubarraySum-precond : List Int → Set
maxSubarraySum-precond xs = Top

maxSubarraySum-helper : List Int → Int → Int → Int
maxSubarraySum-helper [] curMax globalMax = globalMax
maxSubarraySum-helper (x ∷ rest) curMax globalMax =
  let newCurMax = intMax x (intAdd curMax x)
      newGlobal = intMax globalMax newCurMax
  in maxSubarraySum-helper rest newCurMax newGlobal

maxSubarraySum :
  (xs : List Int) →
  maxSubarraySum-precond xs →
  Int
maxSubarraySum [] h-precond = pos zero
maxSubarraySum (x ∷ rest) h-precond =
  maxSubarraySum-helper rest x x

subarraySums : List Int → List Int
subarraySums xs =
  let n = listLength xs
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ start →
        mapList
          (λ length →
            sumList
              (takeList length (dropList start xs)))
          (rangeFrom
            (suc zero)
            (natSubtract n start)))
      (range (suc n))

maxSubarraySum-postcond :
  (xs : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  maxSubarraySum-precond xs →
  Set
maxSubarraySum-postcond [] result h-precond =
  IsTrue (intEqual result (pos zero))
maxSubarraySum-postcond (x ∷ rest) result h-precond =
  IsTrue
    (anyList
      (λ sum → intEqual sum result)
      (subarraySums (x ∷ rest))) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ sum → intLessOrEqual sum result)
      (subarraySums (x ∷ rest)))

maxSubarraySum-spec-satisfied : Set
maxSubarraySum-spec-satisfied =
  (xs : List Int) →
  (h-precond : maxSubarraySum-precond xs) →
  maxSubarraySum-postcond
    xs
    (maxSubarraySum xs h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_45,
  cataloged as "maxSubarraySum": the executable Kadane scan returns the
  maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray of an integer list, with
  result zero for the empty list. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val maxSubarraySum_precond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_precond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_precond (xs : int list) <=> T``
);

val maxSubarraySum_intMax_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_intMax_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_intMax (a : int) (b : int) =
      if a < b then b else a``
);

val maxSubarraySum_helper_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySum_helper
      ([] : int list) (curMax : int) (globalMax : int) =
     globalMax) /\
  (maxSubarraySum_helper
      (x::xs) curMax globalMax =
     let newCurMax =
       maxSubarraySum_intMax x (curMax + x)
     in
     let newGlobal =
       maxSubarraySum_intMax globalMax newCurMax
     in
       maxSubarraySum_helper xs newCurMax newGlobal)
`;

val maxSubarraySum_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySum ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (maxSubarraySum (x::xs) =
     maxSubarraySum_helper xs x x)
`;

val maxSubarraySum_subarraySum_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_subarraySum_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_subarraySum (subarray : int list) =
      FOLDL (\acc x. acc + x) 0 subarray``
);

val maxSubarraySum_subarraySums_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_subarraySums_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_subarraySums (xs : int list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\start.
             MAP
               (\len.
                  maxSubarraySum_subarraySum
                    (TAKE len (DROP start xs)))
               (GENLIST
                 (\offset. offset + 1)
                 (LENGTH xs - start)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH xs + 1)))``
);

val maxSubarraySum_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_postcond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_postcond
      (xs : int list) (result : int) <=>
      if xs = [] then
        result = 0
      else
        MEM result (maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs) /\
        EVERY
          (\sum : int. sum <= result)
          (maxSubarraySum_subarraySums xs)``
);

val maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied =
  ``!xs : int list.
      maxSubarraySum_precond xs ==>
      maxSubarraySum_postcond xs (maxSubarraySum xs)``;

title: verina_advanced_45
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_45 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_45), catalog title
  maxSubarraySum: the exact recursive Kadane scan computes an integer result
  for every finite integer list, with the independently enumerated
  nonempty-contiguous-subarray maximum postcondition and the empty-list
  result zero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  i ..^ j is the half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA45IntMax is integer max. VERINA45HelperGraph is the exact complete
  trace of the source local recursive helper on arbitrary helper arguments.
  Its c and g words record curMax and globalMax before and after every
  consumed entry. Each transition computes
    newCurMax = max x (curMax + x)
  and then
    newGlobal = max globalMax newCurMax.
  VERINA45Helper selects the final global maximum from that unique trace.

  VERINA45NatSub restores Lean's truncated Nat.sub on natural arguments.
  VERINA45TailGraph and VERINA45Tail give List.tail, including the empty-list
  case. VERINA45MaxSubarraySum is the exact source match: it returns integer
  zero on the empty word, and otherwise invokes the helper on the tail with
  both initial maxima equal to the head.

  VERINA45PrefixGraph records the unique integer prefix sums starting at
  zero. VERINA45SubarraySumsGraph reproduces the source postcondition's
  List.range and List.range' flatMap order. Its index-pair word lists, in
  increasing start and then increasing positive length, every pair with
  start + length at most the input length. Each output is the sum of exactly
  the same drop/take contiguous subarray, expressed as a prefix difference;
  duplicate sums are retained.

  VERINA45Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int
  input type. VERINA45Post preserves the source match: an empty input
  requires result zero, while a nonempty input requires the result to occur
  in the independently generated subarray-sum word and to bound every entry
  above. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is omitted from the target function and
  postcondition predicate. The final $a declaration is the source
  correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA45IntMax
  VERINA45HelperGraph VERINA45Helper
  VERINA45NatSub
  VERINA45TailGraph VERINA45Tail
  VERINA45Pre VERINA45MaxSubarraySum
  VERINA45PrefixGraph VERINA45Prefix
  VERINA45SubarraySumsGraph VERINA45SubarraySums
  VERINA45Post
$.

verina45-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45IntMax A B ) $.
verina45-helper-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA45HelperGraph A B C D ) $.
verina45-helper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45Helper A B C ) $.
verina45-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45NatSub A B ) $.
verina45-tail-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA45TailGraph A B ) $.
verina45-tail-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45Tail A ) $.
verina45-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA45Pre A ) $.
verina45-max-subarray-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45MaxSubarraySum A ) $.
verina45-prefix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA45PrefixGraph A B ) $.
verina45-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45Prefix A ) $.
verina45-subarray-sums-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA45SubarraySumsGraph A B ) $.
verina45-subarray-sums-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA45SubarraySums A ) $.

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_45, catalog title "maxSubarraySum": the specified recursive
% program computes the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous integer subarray,
% returning zero for an empty input, with its full contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_45: THEORY
BEGIN

  maxSubarraySum_precond(xs: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_max(first, second: int): int =
    IF first >= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  maxSubarraySum_helper(
      remaining: list[int],
      curMax, globalMax: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        globalMax,
      cons(x, rest):
        LET newCurMax: int =
              int_max(x, curMax + x),
            newGlobal: int =
              int_max(globalMax, newCurMax)
        IN
          maxSubarraySum_helper(
            rest,
            newCurMax,
            newGlobal)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  maxSubarraySum(xs: list[int]): int =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(x, rest):
        maxSubarraySum_helper(rest, x, x)
    ENDCASES

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_sum(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        head + int_list_sum(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_subarray_sum(
      values: list[int],
      start, length: nat): int =
    int_list_sum(
      int_list_take(
        length,
        int_list_drop(start, values)))

  append_int_lists(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  subarray_sums_at_start(
      values: list[int],
      start, length, remaining_lengths: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining_lengths = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        int_subarray_sum(values, start, length),
        subarray_sums_at_start(
          values,
          start,
          length + 1,
          remaining_lengths - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_lengths

  all_subarray_sums_from(
      values: list[int],
      start, remaining_starts, total_length: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining_starts = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      append_int_lists(
        subarray_sums_at_start(
          values,
          start,
          1,
          nat_subtract(total_length, start)),
        all_subarray_sums_from(
          values,
          start + 1,
          remaining_starts - 1,
          total_length))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_starts

  all_subarray_sums(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    LET total_length: nat = int_list_length(values)
    IN
      all_subarray_sums_from(
        values,
        0,
        total_length + 1,
        total_length)

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[int],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND int_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  maxSubarraySum_postcond(
      xs: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        result = 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        LET subarray_sums: list[int] =
              all_subarray_sums(xs)
        IN
          int_list_contains(
            subarray_sums,
            result)
            AND int_list_all_at_most(
                  subarray_sums,
                  result)
    ENDCASES

  maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (xs: list[int]):
      maxSubarraySum_precond(xs) IMPLIES
        maxSubarraySum_postcond(
          xs,
          maxSubarraySum(xs))

END verina_advanced_45

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_46,
   catalog title "maxSubarraySum": an executable Kadane-style scan over
   integer lists, including its all-negative and integer-to-natural conversion
   behavior, together with the exhaustive contiguous-subarray maximum
   correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition maxSubarraySum_precond
    (_numbers : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative
    (numbers : list Z) : bool :=
  match numbers with
  | [] => true
  | x :: xs =>
      if Z.geb x 0%Z
      then false
      else maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative xs
  end.

Fixpoint maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
    (numbers : list Z)
    (currMax currSum : Z) {struct numbers} : Z :=
  match numbers with
  | [] => currMax
  | [x] => Z.max currMax x
  | x :: (y :: rest as tail) =>
      let newSum := Z.max y (currSum + y)%Z in
      let newMax := Z.max currMax newSum in
      maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct tail newMax newSum
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySum_handleList
    (numbers : list Z) : nat :=
  match maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative numbers with
  | true => 0
  | false =>
      match numbers with
      | [] => 0
      | x :: rest =>
          let initialMax := Z.max 0%Z x in
          let startSum := Z.max 0%Z x in
          let result :=
            maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
              (x :: rest) initialMax startSum in
          Z.to_nat result
      end
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySum
    (numbers : list Z)
    (_h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond numbers) : Z :=
  Z.of_nat (maxSubarraySum_handleList numbers).

Fixpoint maxSubarraySum_sum
    (numbers : list Z) : Z :=
  match numbers with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: xs => (x + maxSubarraySum_sum xs)%Z
  end.

Definition maxSubarraySum_subArraySums
    (numbers : list Z) : list Z :=
  flat_map
    (fun start =>
      map
        (fun len =>
          maxSubarraySum_sum
            (firstn len (skipn start numbers)))
        (seq 0 (Nat.add (Nat.sub (length numbers) start) 1)))
    (seq 0 (Nat.add (length numbers) 1)).

Definition maxSubarraySum_postcond
    (numbers : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond numbers) : Prop :=
  let subArraySums := maxSubarraySum_subArraySums numbers in
  existsb (fun sum => Z.eqb sum result) subArraySums = true /\
  forallb (fun sum => Z.leb sum result) subArraySums = true.

Theorem maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied
    (numbers : list Z)
    (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond numbers) :
  maxSubarraySum_postcond
    numbers (maxSubarraySum numbers h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_46,
  catalog title "maxSubarraySum": an executable integer-list scan with an
  all-negative check computes a nonnegative contiguous-subarray maximum,
  together with its unconditional precondition and maximality postcondition
  over all contiguous slices, including the empty slice. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_46
  imports Main
begin

definition maxSubarraySum_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySum_precond numbers \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative [] = True"
| "maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative (x # xs) =
    (if x \<ge> 0 then False else maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative xs)"

fun maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct [] currMax currSum = currMax"
| "maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct [x] currMax currSum = max currMax x"
| "maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct (x # y # rest) currMax currSum =
    (let newSum = max y (currSum + y);
         newMax = max currMax newSum
     in maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct (y # rest) newMax newSum)"

definition maxSubarraySum_handleList :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "maxSubarraySum_handleList numbers =
    (case numbers of
       [] \<Rightarrow> 0
     | x # rest \<Rightarrow>
         if maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative (x # rest)
         then 0
         else
           nat
             (maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
               (x # rest) (max 0 x) (max 0 x)))"

definition maxSubarraySum :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "maxSubarraySum numbers = int (maxSubarraySum_handleList numbers)"

definition maxSubarraySum_subArraySums :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "maxSubarraySum_subArraySums numbers =
    concat
      (map
        (\<lambda>start.
          map
            (\<lambda>len. sum_list (take len (drop start numbers)))
            [0..<(length numbers - start + 1)])
        [0..<(length numbers + 1)])"

definition maxSubarraySum_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "maxSubarraySum_postcond numbers result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subArraySums = maxSubarraySum_subArraySums numbers
     in
       list_ex (\<lambda>subArraySum. subArraySum = result) subArraySums \<and>
       list_all (\<lambda>subArraySum. subArraySum \<le> result) subArraySums)"

theorem maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "maxSubarraySum_precond numbers"
  shows "maxSubarraySum_postcond numbers (maxSubarraySum numbers)"
  sorry

end

        if &0 <= x then F
        else maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative xs)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!currMax:int. !currSum:int.
        maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
          ([]:int list) currMax currSum =
        currMax) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !currMax:int. !currSum:int.
        maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
          (CONS x xs) currMax currSum =
        if xs = [] then
          maxSubarraySum_max currMax x
        else
          let y = HD xs in
          let newSum =
            maxSubarraySum_max y (currSum + y) in
          let newMax =
            maxSubarraySum_max currMax newSum in
          maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
            xs newMax newSum)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_intToNat = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_intToNat (z:int) =
     if z < &0 then 0 else num_of_int z`;;

let maxSubarraySum_handleList = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_handleList (numbers:int list) =
     if numbers = [] then 0
     else if maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative numbers then 0
     else
       let x = HD numbers in
       let initialMax =
         maxSubarraySum_max (&0:int) x in
       let startSum =
         maxSubarraySum_max (&0:int) x in
       let result =
         maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
           numbers initialMax startSum in
       maxSubarraySum_intToNat result`;;

let maxSubarraySum = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum (numbers:int list) =
     (&(maxSubarraySum_handleList numbers):int)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySum_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        maxSubarraySum_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySum_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_drop 0 xs = xs) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_drop (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else maxSubarraySum_drop n (TL xs))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_take 0 xs = []) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_take (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD xs)
            (maxSubarraySum_take n (TL xs)))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_sum =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(maxSubarraySum_sum ([]:int list) = (&0:int)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_sum (CONS x xs) =
        x + maxSubarraySum_sum xs)`;;

let maxSubarraySum_sumsAt = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_sumsAt
      (numbers:int list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          maxSubarraySum_sum
            (maxSubarraySum_take len
              (maxSubarraySum_drop start numbers)))
       (maxSubarraySum_range
         (LENGTH numbers - start + 1))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!numbers:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
          numbers ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !numbers:int list.
        maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
          numbers (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (maxSubarraySum_sumsAt numbers start)
          (maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom numbers starts))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_subarraySums = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_subarraySums (numbers:int list) =
     maxSubarraySum_allSumsFrom
       numbers
       (maxSubarraySum_range (LENGTH numbers + 1))`;;

let maxSubarraySum_postcond = new_definition
  `maxSubarraySum_postcond
      (numbers:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let subArraySums =
       maxSubarraySum_subarraySums numbers in
     MEM result subArraySums /\
     ALL (\s:int. s <= result) subArraySums`;;

let maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied =
  `!numbers:int list.
     maxSubarraySum_precond numbers
     ==> maxSubarraySum_postcond
           numbers (maxSubarraySum numbers)`;;

title: verina_advanced_46
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_46,
;; "maxSubarraySum": the deterministic integer-list program computes the
;; maximum sum among all contiguous subarrays, including the empty subarray,
;; and returns zero when every input integer is negative. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-46-integer-listp (numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count numbers)))
  (if (consp numbers)
      (and
       (integerp (car numbers))
       (verina-advanced-46-integer-listp
        (cdr numbers)))
    (equal numbers nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Int binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum-precond
    (numbers)
  (declare (ignore numbers))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-46-int-max (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      right
    left))

;; Exact translation of the source local isAllNegative recursion. Its empty
;; case is true, and any nonnegative element makes the result false.

(defun verina-advanced-46-is-all-negative (numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count numbers)))
  (if (consp numbers)
      (if (>= (car numbers) 0)
          nil
        (verina-advanced-46-is-all-negative
         (cdr numbers)))
    t))

;; Exact translation of findMaxProduct. For a list with at least two elements,
;; the recursion processes the second element and continues from that same
;; element, just as the source recurses on y :: rest.

(defun verina-advanced-46-find-max-product
    (numbers current-maximum current-sum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count numbers)))
  (if (consp numbers)
      (if (consp (cdr numbers))
          (let* ((next (car (cdr numbers)))
                 (new-sum
                  (verina-advanced-46-int-max
                   next
                   (+ current-sum next)))
                 (new-maximum
                  (verina-advanced-46-int-max
                   current-maximum
                   new-sum)))
            (verina-advanced-46-find-max-product
             (cdr numbers)
             new-maximum
             new-sum))
        (verina-advanced-46-int-max
         current-maximum
         (car numbers)))
    current-maximum))

;; This preserves handleList as a separate executable helper. NFIX is exactly
;; Int.toNat on the integer result: it is the identity for nonnegative
;; integers and zero for negative integers.

(defun verina-advanced-46-handle-list (numbers)
  (if (consp numbers)
      (if (verina-advanced-46-is-all-negative numbers)
          0
        (let* ((initial-maximum
                (verina-advanced-46-int-max
                 0
                 (car numbers)))
               (start-sum
                (verina-advanced-46-int-max
                 0
                 (car numbers)))
               (result
                (verina-advanced-46-find-max-product
                 numbers
                 initial-maximum
                 start-sum)))
          (nfix result)))
    0))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument has no computational effect.
;; ACL2 naturals are integers, so the source coercion of handleList's Nat
;; result back to Int is represented by the identity.

(defun verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum (numbers)
  (verina-advanced-46-handle-list numbers))

(defun verina-advanced-46-drop (count numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      numbers
    (if (consp numbers)
        (verina-advanced-46-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr numbers))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-46-take (count numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp numbers)
        (cons
         (car numbers)
         (verina-advanced-46-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr numbers)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-46-list-sum (numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count numbers)))
  (if (consp numbers)
      (+
       (car numbers)
       (verina-advanced-46-list-sum
        (cdr numbers)))
    0))

;; At a fixed START, the initial LENGTH zero and REMAINING-LENGTHS equal to
;; numbers.length - start + 1 reproduce the inner List.range exactly. Thus
;; every start contributes its empty subarray before its positive lengths.

(defun verina-advanced-46-subarray-sums-at-start
    (numbers start length remaining-lengths)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-46-list-sum
      (verina-advanced-46-take
       length
       (verina-advanced-46-drop
        start
        numbers)))
     (verina-advanced-46-subarray-sums-at-start
      numbers
      start
      (+ length 1)
      (- remaining-lengths 1)))))

;; START and REMAINING-STARTS reproduce List.range (numbers.length + 1).
;; APPEND implements flatMap, preserving the source's ordered list of all
;; contiguous-subarray sums, including every generated empty sum.

(defun verina-advanced-46-all-subarray-sums-from
    (numbers start remaining-starts total-length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (append
     (verina-advanced-46-subarray-sums-at-start
      numbers
      start
      0
      (+ (nfix (- total-length start)) 1))
     (verina-advanced-46-all-subarray-sums-from
      numbers
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)
      total-length))))

(defun verina-advanced-46-all-subarray-sums (numbers)
  (let ((total-length (len numbers)))
    (verina-advanced-46-all-subarray-sums-from
     numbers
     0
     (+ total-length 1)
     total-length)))

;; These recursions are respectively List.contains result and
;; List.all (fun sum => sum <= result) over the exact flatMap result.

(defun verina-advanced-46-contains-result-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (or
       (equal (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-46-contains-result-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-46-all-sums-at-most-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (and
       (<= (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-46-all-sums-at-most-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum-postcond
    (numbers result)
  (let ((subarray-sums
         (verina-advanced-46-all-subarray-sums
          numbers)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-46-integer-listp numbers)
     (integerp result)
     (verina-advanced-46-contains-result-p
      subarray-sums
      result)
     (verina-advanced-46-all-sums-at-most-p
      subarray-sums
      result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and True precondition; its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum-spec-satisfied-statement
    (numbers)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-46-integer-listp numbers)
    (verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum-precond
     numbers))
   (verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum-postcond
    numbers
    (verina-advanced-46-max-subarray-sum numbers))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_46
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_46,
-- catalog title "maxSubarraySum": the deterministic integer-list program uses
-- an all-negative shortcut and a recursive maximum-subarray scan, and is
-- connected to its complete correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced46 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

intToNat : Int → Nat
intToNat (pos n) = n
intToNat (negsuc n) = zero

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

sumList : List Int → Int
sumList [] = pos zero
sumList (x ∷ xs) = intAdd x (sumList xs)

maxSubarraySum-precond : List Int → Set
maxSubarraySum-precond numbers = Top

isAllNegative : List Int → Bool
isAllNegative [] = true
isAllNegative (x ∷ xs) =
  if intLess x (pos zero)
  then isAllNegative xs
  else false

findMaxProduct : List Int → Int → Int → Int
findMaxProduct [] currMax currSum = currMax
findMaxProduct (x ∷ []) currMax currSum =
  intMax currMax x
findMaxProduct (x ∷ y ∷ rest) currMax currSum =
  let newSum = intMax y (intAdd currSum y)
      newMax = intMax currMax newSum
  in findMaxProduct (y ∷ rest) newMax newSum

handleList : List Int → Nat
handleList [] = zero
handleList (x ∷ rest) =
  if isAllNegative (x ∷ rest)
  then zero
  else
    let initialMax = intMax (pos zero) x
        startSum = intMax (pos zero) x
        result =
          findMaxProduct
            (x ∷ rest)
            initialMax
            startSum
    in intToNat result

maxSubarraySum :
  (numbers : List Int) →
  maxSubarraySum-precond numbers →
  Int
maxSubarraySum numbers h-precond =
  pos (handleList numbers)

subarraySums : List Int → List Int
subarraySums numbers =
  let n = listLength numbers
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ start →
        mapList
          (λ length →
            sumList
              (takeList length (dropList start numbers)))
          (range
            (suc (natSubtract n start))))
      (range (suc n))

maxSubarraySum-postcond :
  (numbers : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  maxSubarraySum-precond numbers →
  Set
maxSubarraySum-postcond numbers result h-precond =
  IsTrue (containsInt result (subarraySums numbers)) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ subarraySum → intLessOrEqual subarraySum result)
      (subarraySums numbers))

maxSubarraySum-spec-satisfied : Set
maxSubarraySum-spec-satisfied =
  (numbers : List Int) →
  (h-precond : maxSubarraySum-precond numbers) →
  maxSubarraySum-postcond
    numbers
    (maxSubarraySum numbers h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_46
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_46,
  cataloged as "maxSubarraySum": the executable all-negative check and
  Kadane-style scan return the greatest sum among all contiguous integer
  subarrays, including the empty subarray. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val maxSubarraySum_precond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_precond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_precond (numbers : int list) <=> T``
);

val maxSubarraySum_intMax_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_intMax_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_intMax (a : int) (b : int) =
      if a < b then b else a``
);

val maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative (x::xs) =
     if 0 <= x then F else maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative xs)
`;

val maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
      ([] : int list) (currMax : int) (currSum : int) =
     currMax) /\
  (maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
      [x] currMax currSum =
     maxSubarraySum_intMax currMax x) /\
  (maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
      (x::y::rest) currMax currSum =
     let newSum =
       maxSubarraySum_intMax y (currSum + y)
     in
     let newMax =
       maxSubarraySum_intMax currMax newSum
     in
       maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
         (y::rest) newMax newSum)
`;

val maxSubarraySum_intToNat_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_intToNat_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_intToNat (value : int) =
      if value < 0 then 0 else Num value``
);

val maxSubarraySum_handleList_def = Define `
  (maxSubarraySum_handleList ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (maxSubarraySum_handleList (x::xs) =
     if maxSubarraySum_isAllNegative (x::xs) then
       0
     else
       let initialMax = maxSubarraySum_intMax 0 x in
       let startSum = maxSubarraySum_intMax 0 x in
       let result =
         maxSubarraySum_findMaxProduct
           (x::xs) initialMax startSum
       in
         maxSubarraySum_intToNat result)
`;

val maxSubarraySum_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum (numbers : int list) =
      int_of_num (maxSubarraySum_handleList numbers)``
);

val maxSubarraySum_subarraySum_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_subarraySum_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_subarraySum (subarray : int list) =
      FOLDL (\acc x. acc + x) 0 subarray``
);

val maxSubarraySum_subarraySums_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_subarraySums_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_subarraySums (numbers : int list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\start.
             MAP
               (\len.
                  maxSubarraySum_subarraySum
                    (TAKE len (DROP start numbers)))
               (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH numbers - start + 1)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH numbers + 1)))``
);

val maxSubarraySum_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "maxSubarraySum_postcond_def",
  ``maxSubarraySum_postcond
      (numbers : int list) (result : int) <=>
      let subArraySums = maxSubarraySum_subarraySums numbers
      in
        MEM result subArraySums /\
        EVERY (\sum : int. sum <= result) subArraySums``
);

val maxSubarraySum_spec_satisfied =
  ``!numbers : int list.
      maxSubarraySum_precond numbers ==>
      maxSubarraySum_postcond
        numbers (maxSubarraySum numbers)``;

title: verina_advanced_46
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_46 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_46), catalog title
  maxSubarraySum: the exact all-negative test and recursive Kadane-style scan
  compute the maximum sum of an empty or contiguous subarray of an arbitrary
  finite integer list. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  i ..^ j is the half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA46IsAllNegative is exactly the source Boolean recursion: it is true
  precisely when every entry is strictly negative, including vacuous truth
  on the empty list. VERINA46FindMaxProductGraph records the exact finite
  execution of findMaxProduct. On an empty helper input it returns currMax.
  On a nonempty input, c and g record currSum and currMax: the first entries
  are the supplied accumulators, every later entry performs the source update
    newSum = max y (currSum + y)
    newMax = max currMax newSum,
  and the final max with the last list entry is the singleton branch.
  VERINA46FindMaxProduct selects the unique result of this graph.

  VERINA46ToNat is Lean Int.toNat. VERINA46MaxSubarraySum preserves the exact
  handleList branches: the empty and all-negative cases return zero; otherwise
  both initial accumulators are max 0 head, the helper runs on the original
  nonempty list, and its result is converted to Nat and then back to Int.

  VERINA46PrefixGraph gives the unique integer prefix sums beginning at zero.
  VERINA46SubarraySumsGraph reproduces the two List.range calls in the
  postcondition. Its pair word contains, in increasing start and then length
  order, every pair with start at most the input length and length at most the
  remaining suffix length. Thus it retains all duplicate sums and all empty
  subarray occurrences, including the one at the end of the list.

  VERINA46Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int input
  type. VERINA46Post is exactly List.contains followed by List.all on the
  independently enumerated subarray sums. The proof-valued precondition
  argument is computationally and propositionally unused and is omitted from
  the target function and predicate. The final $a declaration is the source
  correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA46IntMax VERINA46IsAllNegative
  VERINA46FindMaxProductGraph VERINA46FindMaxProduct
  VERINA46ToNat VERINA46Pre VERINA46MaxSubarraySum
  VERINA46PrefixGraph VERINA46Prefix
  VERINA46SubarraySumsGraph VERINA46SubarraySums
  VERINA46Post
$.

verina46-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA46IntMax A B ) $.
verina46-is-all-negative-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA46IsAllNegative A ) $.
verina46-find-max-product-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA46FindMaxProductGraph A B C D ) $.
verina46-find-max-product-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA46FindMaxProduct A B C ) $.
verina46-to-nat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA46ToNat A ) $.
verina46-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA46Pre A ) $.
verina46-max-subarray-sum-syntax

${
