content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_50,
  catalog title "mergeSorted": an executable index-and-accumulator merge of
  two sorted natural-number arrays, followed by suffix drains, with a
  sorted-permutation correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let mergeSorted_precond = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_precond
      (a1:num list) (a2:num list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:num. x <= y) a1 /\
     PAIRWISE (\x y:num. x <= y) a2`;;

let mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a1:num list. !a2:num list. !i:num. !j:num.
      !result:num list.
        mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel 0 a1 a2 i j result =
        (i,(j,result))) /\
     (!fuel:num. !a1:num list. !a2:num list.
      !i:num. !j:num. !result:num list.
        mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel (SUC fuel) a1 a2 i j result =
        if i < LENGTH a1 /\ j < LENGTH a2 then
          if EL i a1 <= EL j a2 then
            mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel fuel a1 a2
              (i + 1) j
              (APPEND result (CONS (EL i a1) []))
          else
            mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel fuel a1 a2
              i (j + 1)
              (APPEND result (CONS (EL j a2) []))
        else
          (i,(j,result)))`;;

let mergeSorted_mergeLoop = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_mergeLoop
      (a1:num list) (a2:num list)
      (i:num) (j:num) (result:num list) =
     mergeSorted_mergeLoopFuel
       ((LENGTH a1 - i) + (LENGTH a2 - j))
       a1 a2 i j result`;;

let mergeSorted_drainFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!arr:num list. !i:num. !result:num list.
        mergeSorted_drainFuel 0 arr i result = result) /\
     (!fuel:num. !arr:num list. !i:num. !result:num list.
        mergeSorted_drainFuel (SUC fuel) arr i result =
        if i < LENGTH arr then
          mergeSorted_drainFuel fuel arr (i + 1)
            (APPEND result (CONS (EL i arr) []))
        else
          result)`;;

let mergeSorted_drain = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_drain
      (arr:num list) (i:num) (result:num list) =
     mergeSorted_drainFuel (LENGTH arr - i) arr i result`;;

let mergeSorted = new_definition
  `mergeSorted (a1:num list) (a2:num list) =
     let loopState =
       mergeSorted_mergeLoop a1 a2 0 0 [] in
     let i = FST loopState in
     let j = FST (SND loopState) in
     let merged = SND (SND loopState) in
     let withA1 = mergeSorted_drain a1 i merged in
     mergeSorted_drain a2 j withA1`;;

let mergeSorted_count = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_count (z:num) (xs:num list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:num. x = z) xs)`;;

let mergeSorted_isPerm = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_isPerm
      (xs:num list) (ys:num list) <=>
     !z:num.
       mergeSorted_count z xs =
       mergeSorted_count z ys`;;

let mergeSorted_postcond = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_postcond
      (a1:num list) (a2:num list)
      (result:num list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:num. x <= y) result /\
     mergeSorted_isPerm result (APPEND a1 a2)`;;

let mergeSorted_spec_satisfied =
  `!a1:num list. !a2:num list.
     mergeSorted_precond a1 a2
     ==> mergeSorted_postcond
           a1 a2 (mergeSorted a1 a2)`;;

title: verina_advanced_50
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_50,
;; "mergeSorted": the indexed merge loop and drain operations merge two
;; nondecreasing arrays of natural numbers into a sorted permutation of their
;; concatenation. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean Array Nat is represented exactly by its finite sequence of entries,
;; namely an ACL2 true list whose elements are natural numbers.

(defun verina-advanced-50-nat-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (natp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y) requires each head to be at most every
;; later entry and recursively imposes the same condition on the tail.

(defun verina-advanced-50-head-at-most-all-p (x xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (<= x (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-50-head-at-most-all-p
        x
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-50-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-50-head-at-most-all-p
        (car xs)
        (cdr xs))
       (verina-advanced-50-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted-precond (a1 a2)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp a1)
   (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp a2)
   (verina-advanced-50-pairwise-nondecreasing-p a1)
   (verina-advanced-50-pairwise-nondecreasing-p a2)))

;; This structural worker is the exact transition system of mergeLoop after
;; dropping the already-consumed prefixes. Array.push is represented by
;; appending one entry, so RESULT has the same order as the source array.

(defun verina-advanced-50-merge-loop-suffixes
    (xs ys i j result)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (+ (acl2-count xs)
       (acl2-count ys))))
  (if (and (consp xs) (consp ys))
      (if (<= (car xs) (car ys))
          (verina-advanced-50-merge-loop-suffixes
           (cdr xs)
           ys
           (+ 1 i)
           j
           (append result (list (car xs))))
        (verina-advanced-50-merge-loop-suffixes
         xs
         (cdr ys)
         i
         (+ 1 j)
         (append result (list (car ys)))))
    (list i j result)))

(defun verina-advanced-50-merge-loop
    (a1 a2 i j result)
  (verina-advanced-50-merge-loop-suffixes
   (nthcdr (nfix i) a1)
   (nthcdr (nfix j) a2)
   (nfix i)
   (nfix j)
   result))

;; This worker and wrapper preserve drain: append every array entry from index
;; I onward to RESULT, in increasing index order.

(defun verina-advanced-50-drain-suffix (remaining result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-50-drain-suffix
       (cdr remaining)
       (append result (list (car remaining))))
    result))

(defun verina-advanced-50-drain (arr i result)
  (verina-advanced-50-drain-suffix
   (nthcdr (nfix i) arr)
   result))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant. This
;; definition otherwise follows mergeSorted exactly: run mergeLoop from empty
;; state, drain A1, then drain A2.

(defun verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted (a1 a2)
  (let* ((state
          (verina-advanced-50-merge-loop
           a1 a2 0 0 nil))
         (i (car state))
         (j (cadr state))
         (result0 (caddr state))
         (result1
          (verina-advanced-50-drain
           a1 i result0))
         (result2
          (verina-advanced-50-drain
           a2 j result1)))
    result2))

;; Removing one matching occurrence at each step gives exact finite-list
;; multiset equality, including multiplicities, and hence List.isPerm.

(defun verina-advanced-50-remove-first (value xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal value (car xs))
          (cdr xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-50-remove-first
          value
          (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-50-permutation-p (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-advanced-50-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-advanced-50-remove-first
         (car left)
         right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted-postcond
    (a1 a2 result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp a1)
   (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp a2)
   (verina-advanced-50-nat-listp result)
   (verina-advanced-50-pairwise-nondecreasing-p result)
   (verina-advanced-50-permutation-p
    result
    (append a1 a2))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent is the complete source precondition over the two Array Nat
;; inputs, and its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable mergeSorted result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted-spec-satisfied-statement
    (a1 a2)
  (implies
   (verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted-precond
    a1
    a2)
   (verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted-postcond
    a1
    a2
    (verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted
     a1
     a2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_50
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_50,
-- catalog title "mergeSorted": a deterministic program merges two
-- nondecreasing natural-number arrays into a nondecreasing permutation of
-- their concatenation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced50 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

NatLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Set
NatLessOrEqual m n = IsTrue (natLessOrEqual m n)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

snoc : {A : Set} → List A → A → List A
snoc xs x = appendList xs (x ∷ [])

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A → List A → Set where
  permutationNil :
    Permutation [] []

  permutationSkip :
    {x : A} {xs ys : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

  permutationSwap :
    {x y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Permutation (y ∷ x ∷ xs) (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

  permutationTrans :
    {xs ys zs : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation ys zs →
    Permutation xs zs

mergeSorted-precond :
  List Nat → List Nat → Set
mergeSorted-precond a1 a2 =
  Pairwise NatLessOrEqual a1 ∧
  Pairwise NatLessOrEqual a2

record MergeState : Set where
  constructor merge-state
  field
    firstIndex : Nat
    secondIndex : Nat
    mergedResult : List Nat

open MergeState public

mergeLoopWithFuel :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  MergeState
mergeLoopWithFuel zero xs ys i j result =
  merge-state i j result
mergeLoopWithFuel (suc fuel) [] ys i j result =
  merge-state i j result
mergeLoopWithFuel (suc fuel) xs [] i j result =
  merge-state i j result
mergeLoopWithFuel
  (suc fuel)
  (x ∷ xs)
  (y ∷ ys)
  i
  j
  result =
    if natLessOrEqual x y
    then
      mergeLoopWithFuel
        fuel
        xs
        (y ∷ ys)
        (suc i)
        j
        (snoc result x)
    else
      mergeLoopWithFuel
        fuel
        (x ∷ xs)
        ys
        i
        (suc j)
        (snoc result y)

mergeLoop :
  List Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  MergeState
mergeLoop a1 a2 i j result =
  let remaining1 = dropList i a1
      remaining2 = dropList j a2
  in
    mergeLoopWithFuel
      (listLength remaining1 + listLength remaining2)
      remaining1
      remaining2
      i
      j
      result

drainFrom :
  List Nat →
  List Nat →
  List Nat
drainFrom [] result = result
drainFrom (x ∷ xs) result =
  drainFrom xs (snoc result x)

drain :
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  List Nat
drain array i result =
  drainFrom (dropList i array) result

mergeSorted :
  (a1 a2 : List Nat) →
  mergeSorted-precond a1 a2 →
  List Nat
mergeSorted a1 a2 h-precond =
  let state = mergeLoop a1 a2 zero zero []
      after-first =
        drain a1 (firstIndex state) (mergedResult state)
  in
    drain a2 (secondIndex state) after-first

mergeSorted-postcond :
  (a1 a2 : List Nat) →
  (result : List Nat) →
  mergeSorted-precond a1 a2 →
  Set
mergeSorted-postcond a1 a2 result h-precond =
  Pairwise NatLessOrEqual result ∧
  Permutation result (appendList a1 a2)

mergeSorted-spec-satisfied : Set
mergeSorted-spec-satisfied =
  (a1 a2 : List Nat) →
  (h-precond : mergeSorted-precond a1 a2) →
  mergeSorted-postcond
    a1
    a2
    (mergeSorted a1 a2 h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_50
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_50,
  cataloged as "mergeSorted": the executable indexed merge loop and drain
  functions combine two pairwise nondecreasing natural-number arrays into a
  pairwise nondecreasing permutation of their concatenation. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory sortingTheory;

val mergeSorted_pairwise_def = Define `
  (mergeSorted_pairwise ([] : num list) = T) /\
  (mergeSorted_pairwise (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : num. x <= y) xs /\
      mergeSorted_pairwise xs))
`;

val mergeSorted_precond_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_precond_def",
  ``mergeSorted_precond
      (a1 : num list) (a2 : num list) <=>
      mergeSorted_pairwise a1 /\
      mergeSorted_pairwise a2``
);

val mergeLoopFuel_def = Define `
  (mergeLoopFuel
      0
      (a1 : num list) (a2 : num list)
      (i : num) (j : num) (result : num list) =
     ((i,j),result)) /\
  (mergeLoopFuel
      (SUC fuel) a1 a2 i j result =
     if i < LENGTH a1 /\ j < LENGTH a2 then
       if EL i a1 <= EL j a2 then
         mergeLoopFuel fuel a1 a2 (i + 1) j
           (result ++ [EL i a1])
       else
         mergeLoopFuel fuel a1 a2 i (j + 1)
           (result ++ [EL j a2])
     else
       ((i,j),result))
`;

val mergeLoop_def = new_definition (
  "mergeLoop_def",
  ``mergeLoop
      (a1 : num list) (a2 : num list)
      (i : num) (j : num) (result : num list) =
      mergeLoopFuel
        ((LENGTH a1 - i) + (LENGTH a2 - j))
        a1 a2 i j result``
);

val drainFuel_def = Define `
  (drainFuel
      0 (arr : num list) (i : num) (result : num list) =
     result) /\
  (drainFuel
      (SUC fuel) arr i result =
     if i < LENGTH arr then
       drainFuel fuel arr (i + 1) (result ++ [EL i arr])
     else
       result)
`;

val drain_def = new_definition (
  "drain_def",
  ``drain
      (arr : num list) (i : num) (result : num list) =
      drainFuel (LENGTH arr - i) arr i result``
);

val mergeSorted_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_def",
  ``mergeSorted (a1 : num list) (a2 : num list) =
      let loopResult = mergeLoop a1 a2 0 0 [] in
      let i = FST (FST loopResult) in
      let j = SND (FST loopResult) in
      let merged = SND loopResult in
      let withA1 = drain a1 i merged in
        drain a2 j withA1``
);

val mergeSorted_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_postcond_def",
  ``mergeSorted_postcond
      (a1 : num list) (a2 : num list) (result : num list) <=>
      mergeSorted_pairwise result /\
      PERM result (a1 ++ a2)``
);

val mergeSorted_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a1 : num list) (a2 : num list).
      mergeSorted_precond a1 a2 ==>
      mergeSorted_postcond a1 a2 (mergeSorted a1 a2)``;

title: verina_advanced_50
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_50 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_50), catalog title
  mergeSorted: the exact indexed merge loop and two suffix drains combine
  arbitrary finite pairwise nondecreasing natural-number arrays into a
  pairwise nondecreasing permutation of their concatenation. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number arrays. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set. The empty word (/) represents
  the empty array.

  VERINA50NatSub restores Lean's truncated Nat.sub on natural arguments.
  VERINA50ConcatGraph and VERINA50Concat give exact array/list concatenation.

  VERINA50MergeLoopGraph is an exact operational graph for mergeLoop with all
  five arbitrary helper arguments. Its state trace contains the two current
  indices, starts at the supplied indices, and continues exactly while both
  are in bounds. Each transition emits the first-array entry exactly when it
  is <= the second-array entry, matching the source tie behavior, and advances
  only that entry's index. The final state is the first state at which either
  input is exhausted. Concatenating the supplied result with the emitted word
  is exactly the repeated Array.push accumulator. VERINA50MergeLoop selects
  the unique returned index-index-array triple.

  VERINA50DrainGraph appends precisely the suffix beginning at its arbitrary
  natural index, with the empty suffix when that index is at least the array
  length. VERINA50Drain selects this unique output. VERINA50MergeSorted runs
  mergeLoop at indices zero with the empty result, then drains the first input
  and the second input in the source order. The proof-valued precondition
  argument is computationally unused and is omitted from the target function.

  VERINA50Pairwise is List.Pairwise with natural-number <=. VERINA50Pre is its
  conjunction for the two typed inputs. VERINA50Perm is List.isPerm,
  represented by equality of the multiplicity of every natural number, and
  VERINA50Post requires the computed result to be pairwise nondecreasing and
  a permutation of the concatenated inputs. The postcondition's proof-valued
  precondition argument is propositionally unused and is likewise omitted.
  The final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA50NatSub
  VERINA50ConcatGraph VERINA50Concat
  VERINA50MergeLoopGraph VERINA50MergeLoop
  VERINA50DrainGraph VERINA50Drain
  VERINA50Pairwise VERINA50Pre
  VERINA50MergeSorted
  VERINA50Perm VERINA50Post
$.

verina50-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA50NatSub A B ) $.
verina50-concat-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50ConcatGraph A B C ) $.
verina50-concat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA50Concat A B ) $.
verina50-merge-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50MergeLoopGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verina50-merge-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA50MergeLoop A B C D E ) $.
verina50-drain-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50DrainGraph A B C D ) $.
verina50-drain-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA50Drain A B C ) $.
verina50-pairwise-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50Pairwise A ) $.
verina50-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50Pre A B ) $.
verina50-merge-sorted-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA50MergeSorted A B ) $.
verina50-permutation-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50Perm A B ) $.
verina50-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA50Post A B C ) $.

verina50-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA50NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina50-concat-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50ConcatGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
      /\
      (
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( C ` k ) = ( A ` k )
        /\
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          (
            C ` ( ( # ` A ) + k )
          ) = (
            B ` k
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina50-concat-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50Concat A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA50ConcatGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t u A B C D E F $.

  verina50-merge-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50MergeLoopGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word NN0
          /\
          B e. Word NN0
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. NN0
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        E e. Word NN0
        /\
        F e. ( NN0 X. ( NN0 X. Word NN0 ) )
      )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      E. u e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` u ) + 1 )
            /\
            ( t ` 0 ) = <. C , D >.
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` u ) )
              (
                (
                  ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) < ( # ` A )
                  /\
                  ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) ) < ( # ` B )
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    u ` k
                  ) = if (
                    (
                      A ` ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ) <_ (
                      B ` ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ) ,
                    ( A ` ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) ) ,
                    ( B ` ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) ) )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    t ` ( k + 1 )
                  ) = if (
                    (
                      A ` ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ) <_ (
                      B ` ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ) ,
                    <.
                      ( ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) + 1 ) ,
                      ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                    >. ,
                    <.
                      ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) ,
                      ( ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) ) + 1 )
                    >.
                  )
                )
              )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( # ` A ) <_ ( 1st ` ( t ` ( # ` u ) ) )
                \/
                ( # ` B ) <_ ( 2nd ` ( t ` ( # ` u ) ) )
              )
              /\
              F = <.
                ( 1st ` ( t ` ( # ` u ) ) ) ,
                <.
                  ( 2nd ` ( t ` ( # ` u ) ) ) ,
                  ( VERINA50Concat E u )
                >.
              >.
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verina50-merge-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50MergeLoop A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ( NN0 X. ( NN0 X. Word NN0 ) )
      ( VERINA50MergeLoopGraph A B C D E y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k u A B C D $.

  verina50-drain-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50DrainGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word NN0
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        C e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      D e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. u e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` u ) = ( VERINA50NatSub ( # ` A ) B )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` u ) )
            ( u ` k ) = ( A ` ( B + k ) )
        )
        /\
        D = ( VERINA50Concat C u )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina50-drain-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50Drain A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA50DrainGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina50-pairwise-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50Pairwise A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina50-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA50Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word NN0
    /\
    B e. Word NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA50Pairwise A )
    /\
    ( VERINA50Pairwise B )
  )
) $.

verina50-merge-sorted-definition $a |- (
  VERINA50MergeSorted A B
) = (
  VERINA50Drain
    B
    (
      1st ` (
        2nd ` ( VERINA50MergeLoop A B 0 0 (/) )
      )
    )
    (
      VERINA50Drain
        A
        ( 1st ` ( VERINA50MergeLoop A B 0 0 (/) ) )
        (
          2nd ` (
            2nd ` ( VERINA50MergeLoop A B 0 0 (/) )
          )
        )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j x A B $.

  verina50-permutation-definition $a |- (
    VERINA50Perm A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    A. x e. NN0
      (
        # ` {
          i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          |
          ( A ` i ) = x
        }
      ) = (
        # ` {
          j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          |
          ( B ` j ) = x
        }
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina50-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA50Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    C e. Word NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA50Pairwise C )
    /\
    (
      VERINA50Perm
        C
        ( VERINA50Concat A B )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-50-merge-sorted $a |- A. a e. Word NN0
  A. b e. Word NN0
    (
      ( VERINA50Pre a b )
      ->
      (
        VERINA50Post
          a
          b
          ( VERINA50MergeSorted a b )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_advanced_50
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_50, catalog title "mergeSorted": the sorted-natural-array
:: precondition, exact merge-loop and drain execution, sorted-permutation
:: postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1,
    XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_50, catalog title "mergeSorted": an executable indexed
% merge loop and suffix-draining program combines two pairwise nondecreasing
% natural-number arrays into a sorted permutation of their concatenation.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_50: THEORY
BEGIN

  merge_state: TYPE =
    [# first_index: nat,
       second_index: nat,
       merged_values: list[nat] #]

  nat_list_length(
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_nat_lists(
      first, second: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_nat_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  push_nat(
      values: list[nat],
      value: nat): list[nat] =
    append_nat_lists(
      values,
      cons(value, null))

  nat_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null,
        cons(head, tail):
          nat_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  all_at_least_nat(
      lower: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND all_at_least_nat(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing_nat(
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_at_least_nat(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing_nat(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  mergeSorted_precond(
      a1, a2: list[nat]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing_nat(a1)
      AND pairwise_nondecreasing_nat(a2)

  % This structural worker is the exact mergeLoop transition system after
  % dropping the prefixes already consumed at indices i and j.
  mergeLoop_remaining(
      remaining_a1, remaining_a2: list[nat],
      i, j: nat,
      result: list[nat]): RECURSIVE merge_state =
    CASES remaining_a1 OF
      null:
        (# first_index := i,
           second_index := j,
           merged_values := result #),
      cons(head_a1, tail_a1):
        CASES remaining_a2 OF
          null:
            (# first_index := i,
               second_index := j,
               merged_values := result #),
          cons(head_a2, tail_a2):
            IF head_a1 <= head_a2 THEN
              mergeLoop_remaining(
                tail_a1,
                remaining_a2,
                i + 1,
                j,
                push_nat(result, head_a1))
            ELSE
              mergeLoop_remaining(
                remaining_a1,
                tail_a2,
                i,
                j + 1,
                push_nat(result, head_a2))
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE
    nat_list_length(remaining_a1)
      + nat_list_length(remaining_a2)

  mergeLoop(
      a1, a2: list[nat],
      i, j: nat,
      result: list[nat]): merge_state =
    mergeLoop_remaining(
      nat_list_drop(i, a1),
      nat_list_drop(j, a2),
      i,
      j,
      result)

  drain_remaining(
      remaining: list[nat],
      result: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        result,
      cons(head, tail):
        drain_remaining(
          tail,
          push_nat(result, head))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  drain(
      arr: list[nat],
      i: nat,
      result: list[nat]): list[nat] =
    drain_remaining(
      nat_list_drop(i, arr),
      result)

  % The Lean proof argument is computationally irrelevant. Otherwise this
  % follows mergeSorted exactly: merge from empty, drain a1, then drain a2.
  mergeSorted(
      a1, a2: list[nat]): list[nat] =
    LET state: merge_state =
          mergeLoop(a1, a2, 0, 0, null),
        after_a1: list[nat] =
          drain(
            a1,
            first_index(state),
            merged_values(state))
    IN
      drain(
        a2,
        second_index(state),
        after_a1)

  occurrence_count_nat(
      value: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count_nat(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_is_permutation(
      first, second: list[nat]): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      occurrence_count_nat(value, first)
        = occurrence_count_nat(value, second)

  mergeSorted_postcond(
      a1, a2, result: list[nat]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing_nat(result)
      AND nat_list_is_permutation(
        result,
        append_nat_lists(a1, a2))

  mergeSorted_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a1, a2: list[nat]):
      mergeSorted_precond(a1, a2)
        IMPLIES
          mergeSorted_postcond(
            a1,
            a2,
            mergeSorted(a1, a2))

END verina_advanced_50

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_51,
   catalog title "mergeSorted": an executable stable merge of two
   nondecreasing integer lists, together with nondecreasing sortedness and
   permutation-of-concatenation correctness. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Sorting.Permutation Sorting.Sorted ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition mergeSorted_precond
    (a b : list Z) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le a /\
  StronglySorted Z.le b.

Fixpoint mergeSortedAux_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (a b : list Z) : list Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => a ++ b
  | S fuel' =>
      match a, b with
      | [], _ => b
      | _, [] => a
      | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
          if Z.leb x y
          then x :: mergeSortedAux_fuel fuel' xs (y :: ys)
          else y :: mergeSortedAux_fuel fuel' (x :: xs) ys
      end
  end.

Definition mergeSortedAux
    (a b : list Z) : list Z :=
  mergeSortedAux_fuel (Nat.add (length a) (length b)) a b.

Definition mergeSorted
    (a b : list Z)
    (_h_precond : mergeSorted_precond a b) : list Z :=
  let merged := mergeSortedAux a b in
  merged.

Definition mergeSorted_postcond
    (a b result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : mergeSorted_precond a b) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le result /\
  Permutation result (a ++ b).

Theorem mergeSorted_spec_satisfied
    (a b : list Z)
    (h_precond : mergeSorted_precond a b) :
  mergeSorted_postcond
    a b
    (mergeSorted a b h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_51,
  catalog title "mergeSorted": an executable head-comparison merge combines
  two pairwise nondecreasing integer lists into a pairwise nondecreasing
  permutation of their concatenation. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_51
  imports Main
begin

fun mergeSorted_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mergeSorted_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "mergeSorted_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     mergeSorted_pairwise_le xs)"

definition mergeSorted_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mergeSorted_precond a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    mergeSorted_pairwise_le a \<and>
    mergeSorted_pairwise_le b"

fun mergeSortedAux :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "mergeSortedAux [] ys = ys"
| "mergeSortedAux xs [] = xs"
| "mergeSortedAux (x # xs) (y # ys) =
    (if x \<le> y
     then x # mergeSortedAux xs (y # ys)
     else y # mergeSortedAux (x # xs) ys)"

definition mergeSorted ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "mergeSorted a b = mergeSortedAux a b"

definition mergeSorted_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mergeSorted_postcond a b result \<longleftrightarrow>
    mergeSorted_pairwise_le result \<and>
    (\<forall>z. count_list result z = count_list (a @ b) z)"

theorem mergeSorted_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "mergeSorted_precond a b"
  shows "mergeSorted_postcond a b (mergeSorted a b)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_51,
  catalog title "mergeSorted": an executable left-biased merge combines two
  non-decreasing integer lists, with a sorted-permutation correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let mergeSorted_precond = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_precond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) a /\
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) b`;;

let mergeSortedAuxFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list. !ys:int list.
        mergeSortedAuxFuel 0 xs ys =
        if xs = [] then ys
        else if ys = [] then xs
        else []) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:int list. !ys:int list.
        mergeSortedAuxFuel (SUC n) xs ys =
        if xs = [] then ys
        else if ys = [] then xs
        else if HD xs <= HD ys then
          CONS (HD xs)
            (mergeSortedAuxFuel n (TL xs) ys)
        else
          CONS (HD ys)
            (mergeSortedAuxFuel n xs (TL ys)))`;;

let mergeSortedAux = new_definition
  `mergeSortedAux
      (xs:int list) (ys:int list) =
     mergeSortedAuxFuel
       (LENGTH xs + LENGTH ys) xs ys`;;

let mergeSorted = new_definition
  `mergeSorted
      (a:int list) (b:int list) =
     mergeSortedAux a b`;;

let mergeSorted_count = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_count
      (z:int) (xs:int list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = z) xs)`;;

let mergeSorted_isPerm = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_isPerm
      (xs:int list) (ys:int list) <=>
     !z:int.
       mergeSorted_count z xs =
       mergeSorted_count z ys`;;

let mergeSorted_postcond = new_definition
  `mergeSorted_postcond
      (a:int list) (b:int list)
      (result:int list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) result /\
     mergeSorted_isPerm result (APPEND a b)`;;

let mergeSorted_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !b:int list.
     mergeSorted_precond a b
     ==> mergeSorted_postcond
           a b (mergeSorted a b)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_51,
;; "mergeSorted": the recursive merge of two nondecreasing integer lists is
;; nondecreasing and is a permutation of their concatenation. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-51-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; Lean's List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y) requires each head to be at most
;; every later element, recursively.

(defun verina-advanced-51-head-at-most-all-p (x xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (<= x (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-51-head-at-most-all-p
        x
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-51-head-at-most-all-p
        (car xs)
        (cdr xs))
       (verina-advanced-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-precond (a b)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p a)
   (verina-advanced-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p b)))

;; This recursion is exactly mergeSortedAux. When both lists are nonempty it
;; emits the left head on equality, just as the source's x <= y branch does.

(defun verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-aux (xs ys)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (+ (acl2-count xs) (acl2-count ys))))
  (if (endp xs)
      ys
    (if (endp ys)
        xs
      (let ((x (car xs))
            (y (car ys)))
        (if (<= x y)
            (cons
             x
             (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-aux
              (cdr xs)
              ys))
          (cons
           y
           (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-aux
            xs
            (cdr ys))))))))

;; The source wrapper only binds the helper result. Its proof-valued
;; precondition argument has no computational effect and is erased here.

(defun verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted (a b)
  (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-aux a b))

;; Removing one matching occurrence at each step gives exact finite-list
;; multiset equality, including multiplicities, and hence List.isPerm.

(defun verina-advanced-51-remove-first (value xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal value (car xs))
          (cdr xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-51-remove-first
          value
          (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-51-permutation-p (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-advanced-51-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-advanced-51-remove-first
         (car left)
         right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-postcond
    (a b result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp a)
   (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp b)
   (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp result)
   (verina-advanced-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p result)
   (verina-advanced-51-permutation-p
    result
    (append a b))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves both List Int binders and the source precondition,
;; while its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-spec-satisfied-statement
    (a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp a)
    (verina-advanced-51-integer-listp b)
    (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-precond a b))
   (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted-postcond
    a
    b
    (verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_51
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_51,
-- catalog title "mergeSorted": a deterministic recursive merge combines two
-- nondecreasing integer lists into a nondecreasing permutation of their
-- concatenation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced51 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natAdd : Nat → Nat → Nat
natAdd zero n = n
natAdd (suc m) n = suc (natAdd m n)

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) = predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A → List A → Set where
  permutationNil :
    Permutation [] []

  permutationSkip :
    {x : A} {xs ys : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

  permutationSwap :
    {x y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Permutation (y ∷ x ∷ xs) (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

  permutationTrans :
    {xs ys zs : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation ys zs →
    Permutation xs zs

mergeSorted-precond :
  List Int → List Int → Set
mergeSorted-precond a b =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual a ∧
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual b

mergeSortedAuxWithFuel :
  Nat → List Int → List Int → List Int
mergeSortedAuxWithFuel zero xs ys = appendList xs ys
mergeSortedAuxWithFuel (suc fuel) [] ys = ys
mergeSortedAuxWithFuel (suc fuel) xs [] = xs
mergeSortedAuxWithFuel (suc fuel) (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  if intLessOrEqual x y
  then
    (x ∷ mergeSortedAuxWithFuel fuel xs (y ∷ ys))
  else
    (y ∷ mergeSortedAuxWithFuel fuel (x ∷ xs) ys)

mergeSortedAux : List Int → List Int → List Int
mergeSortedAux xs ys =
  mergeSortedAuxWithFuel
    (natAdd (listLength xs) (listLength ys))
    xs
    ys

mergeSorted :
  (a b : List Int) →
  mergeSorted-precond a b →
  List Int
mergeSorted a b h-precond = mergeSortedAux a b

mergeSorted-postcond :
  (a b : List Int) →
  (result : List Int) →
  mergeSorted-precond a b →
  Set
mergeSorted-postcond a b result h-precond =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual result ∧
  Permutation result (appendList a b)

mergeSorted-spec-satisfied : Set
mergeSorted-spec-satisfied =
  (a b : List Int) →
  (h-precond : mergeSorted-precond a b) →
  mergeSorted-postcond
    a
    b
    (mergeSorted a b h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_51,
  cataloged as "mergeSorted": the executable recursive merge program combines
  two pairwise nondecreasing integer lists into a pairwise nondecreasing
  permutation of their concatenation. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open integerTheory listTheory sortingTheory;

val mergeSorted_pairwise_def = Define `
  (mergeSorted_pairwise ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (mergeSorted_pairwise (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
      mergeSorted_pairwise xs))
`;

val mergeSorted_precond_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_precond_def",
  ``mergeSorted_precond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) <=>
      mergeSorted_pairwise a /\
      mergeSorted_pairwise b``
);

val mergeSortedAux_def = Define `
  (mergeSortedAux
      ([] : int list) (ys : int list) =
     ys) /\
  (mergeSortedAux
      (x::xs) ([] : int list) =
     x::xs) /\
  (mergeSortedAux
      (x::xs) (y::ys) =
     if x <= y then
       x::mergeSortedAux xs (y::ys)
     else
       y::mergeSortedAux (x::xs) ys)
`;

val mergeSorted_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_def",
  ``mergeSorted
      (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      mergeSortedAux a b``
);

val mergeSorted_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "mergeSorted_postcond_def",
  ``mergeSorted_postcond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      mergeSorted_pairwise result /\
      PERM result (a ++ b)``
);

val mergeSorted_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (b : int list).
      mergeSorted_precond a b ==>
      mergeSorted_postcond a b (mergeSorted a b)``;

title: verina_advanced_51
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_51 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_51), catalog title
  mergeSorted: the exact executable recursive merge of two arbitrary finite
  nondecreasing integer lists returns a nondecreasing permutation of their
  concatenation. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its length, w ` k
  is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA51Next and VERINA51Pick encode one exact step of mergeSortedAux. A
  state is the pair of current zero-based positions in the two input words.
  If the first input is exhausted, the next element is taken from the second;
  if only the second is exhausted, it is taken from the first; otherwise the
  first element is taken exactly when it is <= the second, matching the
  source tie behavior.

  VERINA51MergeAuxGraph records the unique complete state trace and every
  emitted integer for exactly #A + #B steps. Processing an exhausted
  remainder one element at a time has exactly the same output as the source
  base cases returning that remainder. VERINA51MergeSortedAux selects the
  unique output of this graph, exactly representing the source helper, and
  VERINA51MergeSorted is the source executable wrapper. Thus neither is an
  unconstrained function or selected from the postcondition.

  VERINA51Pairwise is List.Pairwise with integer <=. VERINA51Pre is the
  conjunction of that property for the two typed inputs. VERINA51Concat is
  exact word concatenation, and VERINA51Perm is List.isPerm, represented by
  equality of the multiplicity of every integer. VERINA51Post requires the
  result to be pairwise nondecreasing and a permutation of the concatenated
  inputs. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally unused
  and is omitted from the target function; the postcondition's corresponding
  proof argument is propositionally unused and is likewise omitted. The
  final $a declaration is the source correctness proposition. Every earlier
  $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA51Next VERINA51Pick
  VERINA51MergeAuxGraph VERINA51MergeSortedAux VERINA51MergeSorted
  VERINA51Pairwise VERINA51Pre
  VERINA51ConcatGraph VERINA51Concat
  VERINA51Perm VERINA51Post
$.

verina51-next-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA51Next A B C ) $.
verina51-pick-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA51Pick A B C ) $.
verina51-merge-aux-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51MergeAuxGraph A B C ) $.
verina51-merge-sorted-aux-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA51MergeSortedAux A B ) $.
verina51-merge-sorted-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA51MergeSorted A B ) $.
verina51-pairwise-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51Pairwise A ) $.
verina51-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51Pre A B ) $.
verina51-concat-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51ConcatGraph A B C ) $.
verina51-concat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA51Concat A B ) $.
verina51-permutation-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51Perm A B ) $.
verina51-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA51Post A B C ) $.

verina51-next-definition $a |- (
  VERINA51Next A B C
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) = ( 1st ` C ) ,
  <. ( 1st ` C ) , ( ( 2nd ` C ) + 1 ) >. ,
  if (
    ( # ` B ) = ( 2nd ` C ) ,
    <. ( ( 1st ` C ) + 1 ) , ( 2nd ` C ) >. ,
    if (
      ( A ` ( 1st ` C ) ) <_ ( B ` ( 2nd ` C ) ) ,
      <. ( ( 1st ` C ) + 1 ) , ( 2nd ` C ) >. ,
      <. ( 1st ` C ) , ( ( 2nd ` C ) + 1 ) >.
    )
  )
) $.

verina51-pick-definition $a |- (
  VERINA51Pick A B C
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) = ( 1st ` C ) ,
  ( B ` ( 2nd ` C ) ) ,
  if (
    ( # ` B ) = ( 2nd ` C ) ,
    ( A ` ( 1st ` C ) ) ,
    if (
      ( A ` ( 1st ` C ) ) <_ ( B ` ( 2nd ` C ) ) ,
      ( A ` ( 1st ` C ) ) ,
      ( B ` ( 2nd ` C ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d k t A B C $.

  verina51-merge-aux-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51MergeAuxGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = <. 0 , 0 >.
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
            /\
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
              (
                (
                  t ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINA51Next A B ( t ` k )
                )
                /\
                (
                  C ` k
                ) = (
                  VERINA51Pick A B ( t ` k )
                )
              )
          )
          /\
          (
            t ` ( # ` C )
          ) = <. ( # ` A ) , ( # ` B ) >.
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina51-merge-sorted-aux-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51MergeSortedAux A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA51MergeAuxGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina51-merge-sorted-definition $a |- (
  VERINA51MergeSorted A B
) = (
  VERINA51MergeSortedAux A B
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina51-pairwise-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51Pairwise A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina51-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA51Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA51Pairwise A )
    /\
    ( VERINA51Pairwise B )
  )
) $.

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina51-concat-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51ConcatGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
      /\
      (
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( C ` k ) = ( A ` k )
        /\
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          (
            C ` ( ( # ` A ) + k )
          ) = (
            B ` k
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina51-concat-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51Concat A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA51ConcatGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j x A B $.

  verina51-permutation-definition $a |- (
    VERINA51Perm A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    A. x e. ZZ
      (
        # ` {
          i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          |
          ( A ` i ) = x
        }
      ) = (
        # ` {
          j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          |
          ( B ` j ) = x
        }
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina51-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA51Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    C e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA51Pairwise C )
    /\
    (
      VERINA51Perm
        C
        ( VERINA51Concat A B )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-51-merge-sorted $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
  A. b e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA51Pre a b )
      ->
      (
        VERINA51Post
          a
          b
          ( VERINA51MergeSorted a b )
      )
    )
$.

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_51, catalog title "mergeSorted": the sorted-integer-list
:: precondition, exact recursive merge execution, sorted-permutation
:: postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1,
    XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    XXREAL_0, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b,result being FinSequence of INT st
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom a & j in dom a & i < j
    holds a/.i <= a/.j) &
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom b & j in dom b & i < j
    holds b/.i <= b/.j) &
    (ex leftStates,rightStates,outputStates being FinSequence of INT* st
      len leftStates = len rightStates &
      len leftStates = len outputStates &
      1 <= len leftStates &
      leftStates/.1 = a &
      rightStates/.1 = b &
      outputStates/.1 = <*>INT &
      (leftStates/.(len leftStates) = <*>INT or
        rightStates/.(len rightStates) = <*>INT) &
      result =
        outputStates/.(len outputStates) ^
        leftStates/.(len leftStates) ^
        rightStates/.(len rightStates) &
      for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len leftStates holds
        ex leftTail,rightTail,currentOutput being FinSequence of INT,
           x,y being Integer st
          leftStates/.k = <*x*> ^ leftTail &
          rightStates/.k = <*y*> ^ rightTail &
          currentOutput = outputStates/.k &
          ((x <= y &
            leftStates/.(k + 1) = leftTail &
            rightStates/.(k + 1) = rightStates/.k &
            outputStates/.(k + 1) = currentOutput ^ <*x*>) or
           (not x <= y &
            leftStates/.(k + 1) = leftStates/.k &
            rightStates/.(k + 1) = rightTail &
            outputStates/.(k + 1) = currentOutput ^ <*y*>)))
  holds
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
    holds result/.i <= result/.j) &
    result,a ^ b are_fiberwise_equipotent
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_51
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_51, catalog title "mergeSorted": the executable recursive
% merge of two pairwise nondecreasing integer lists is nondecreasing and is a
% permutation of their concatenation. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_51: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_int_lists(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  mergeSorted_precond(
      a, b: list[int]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing(a)
      AND pairwise_nondecreasing(b)

  mergeSortedAux(
      a, b: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES a OF
      null:
        b,
      cons(x, xs):
        CASES b OF
          null:
            cons(x, xs),
          cons(y, ys):
            IF x <= y THEN
              cons(
                x,
                mergeSortedAux(xs, cons(y, ys)))
            ELSE
              cons(
                y,
                mergeSortedAux(cons(x, xs), ys))
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE int_list_length(a) + int_list_length(b)

  % The Lean precondition proof is computationally irrelevant; the source
  % implementation returns mergeSortedAux applied to the two input lists.
  mergeSorted(
      a, b: list[int]): list[int] =
    mergeSortedAux(a, b)

  occurrence_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_is_permutation(
      first, second: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      occurrence_count(value, first)
        = occurrence_count(value, second)

  mergeSorted_postcond(
      a, b, result: list[int]): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing(result)
      AND int_list_is_permutation(
        result,
        append_int_lists(a, b))

  mergeSorted_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: list[int]):
      mergeSorted_precond(a, b)
        IMPLIES
          mergeSorted_postcond(
            a,
            b,
            mergeSorted(a, b))

END verina_advanced_51
