(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_56,
  catalog title "moveZeroes": an executable stable partition moves all zeroes
  in an integer list to the end while preserving the relative order of the
  nonzero elements, together with its full correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let moveZeroes_precond = new_definition
  `moveZeroes_precond (xs:int list) <=> T`;;

let moveZeroes = new_definition
  `moveZeroes (xs:int list) =
     APPEND
       (FILTER (\x:int. ~(x = (&0:int))) xs)
       (FILTER (\x:int. x = (&0:int)) xs)`;;

let countVal =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!val:int.
        countVal val ([]:int list) = 0) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !val:int.
        countVal val (CONS x xs) =
        let rest = countVal val xs in
        if x = val then rest + 1 else rest)`;;

let isSubsequence =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        isSubsequence xs ([]:int list) <=> xs = []) /\
     (!y:int. !ys:int list. !xs:int list.
        isSubsequence xs (CONS y ys) <=>
        if xs = [] then T
        else if HD xs = y
        then isSubsequence (TL xs) ys
        else isSubsequence xs ys)`;;

let moveZeroes_dropWhileNonzero =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(moveZeroes_dropWhileNonzero ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        moveZeroes_dropWhileNonzero (CONS x xs) =
        if ~(x = (&0:int))
        then moveZeroes_dropWhileNonzero xs
        else CONS x xs)`;;

let moveZeroes_postcond = new_definition
  `moveZeroes_postcond (xs:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     isSubsequence
       (FILTER (\x:int. ~(x = (&0:int))) xs)
       result /\
     ALL
       (\x:int. x = (&0:int))
       (moveZeroes_dropWhileNonzero result) /\
     countVal (&0:int) xs = countVal (&0:int) result /\
     LENGTH xs = LENGTH result`;;

let moveZeroes_spec_satisfied =
  `!xs:int list.
     moveZeroes_precond xs
     ==> moveZeroes_postcond xs (moveZeroes xs)`;;

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_56,
;; "moveZeroes": moving every zero in an integer list to the end while
;; preserving the relative order of the nonzero elements. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2 is untyped, so this predicate represents the Lean domain List Int.
(defun verina-advanced-56-int-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and (integerp (car xs))
           (verina-advanced-56-int-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; The Lean precondition is True on its typed input domain.
(defun verina-advanced-56-movezeroes-precond (xs)
  (verina-advanced-56-int-listp xs))

(defun verina-advanced-56-filter-nonzero (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal (car xs) 0)
          (verina-advanced-56-filter-nonzero (cdr xs))
        (cons (car xs)
              (verina-advanced-56-filter-nonzero (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-56-filter-zero (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal (car xs) 0)
          (cons (car xs)
                (verina-advanced-56-filter-zero (cdr xs)))
        (verina-advanced-56-filter-zero (cdr xs)))
    nil))

;; Exact executable translation of filter-nonzero(xs) ++ filter-zero(xs).
(defun verina-advanced-56-movezeroes (xs)
  (append (verina-advanced-56-filter-nonzero xs)
          (verina-advanced-56-filter-zero xs)))

(defun verina-advanced-56-count-val (val xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal (car xs) val)
          (+ 1 (verina-advanced-56-count-val val (cdr xs)))
        (verina-advanced-56-count-val val (cdr xs)))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-56-is-subsequence (xs ys)
  (cond ((atom xs) t)
        ((atom ys) nil)
        ((equal (car xs) (car ys))
         (verina-advanced-56-is-subsequence (cdr xs) (cdr ys)))
        (t
         (verina-advanced-56-is-subsequence xs (cdr ys)))))

(defun verina-advanced-56-drop-while-nonzero (xs)
  (if (and (consp xs)
           (not (equal (car xs) 0)))
      (verina-advanced-56-drop-while-nonzero (cdr xs))
    xs))

(defun verina-advanced-56-all-zero-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and (equal (car xs) 0)
           (verina-advanced-56-all-zero-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-56-movezeroes-postcond (xs result)
  (and (verina-advanced-56-int-listp xs)
       (verina-advanced-56-int-listp result)
       (verina-advanced-56-is-subsequence
        (verina-advanced-56-filter-nonzero xs)
        result)
       (verina-advanced-56-all-zero-p
        (verina-advanced-56-drop-while-nonzero result))
       (equal (verina-advanced-56-count-val 0 xs)
              (verina-advanced-56-count-val 0 result))
       (equal (len xs) (len result))))

(defun verina-advanced-56-movezeroes-spec-satisfied-statement (xs)
  (implies
   (verina-advanced-56-movezeroes-precond xs)
   (verina-advanced-56-movezeroes-postcond
    xs
    (verina-advanced-56-movezeroes xs))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_56,
-- catalog title "moveZeroes": a deterministic list program stably moves all
-- integer zeroes to the end, preserving the zero count and list length.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced56 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intZero : Int
intZero = pos zero

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

dropWhileList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
dropWhileList predicate [] = []
dropWhileList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then dropWhileList predicate xs
  else (x ∷ xs)

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

moveZeroes-precond : List Int → Set
moveZeroes-precond xs = Top

moveZeroes :
  (xs : List Int) →
  moveZeroes-precond xs →
  List Int
moveZeroes xs h-precond =
  let nonzeros =
        filterList
          (λ x → boolNot (intEqual x intZero))
          xs
      zeros =
        filterList
          (λ x → intEqual x intZero)
          xs
  in appendList nonzeros zeros

countVal : Int → List Int → Nat
countVal val [] = zero
countVal val (x ∷ xs) =
  let rest = countVal val xs
  in
    if intEqual x val
    then suc rest
    else rest

isSubsequence : List Int → List Int → Bool
isSubsequence [] ys = true
isSubsequence (_ ∷ _) [] = false
isSubsequence (x ∷ xt) (y ∷ yt) =
  if intEqual x y
  then isSubsequence xt yt
  else isSubsequence (x ∷ xt) yt

moveZeroes-postcond :
  (xs : List Int) →
  (result : List Int) →
  moveZeroes-precond xs →
  Set
moveZeroes-postcond xs result h-precond =
  (isSubsequence
    (filterList (λ x → boolNot (intEqual x intZero)) xs)
    result ≡ true) ∧
  (allList
    (λ x → intEqual x intZero)
    (dropWhileList
      (λ x → boolNot (intEqual x intZero))
      result) ≡ true) ∧
  (countVal intZero xs ≡ countVal intZero result) ∧
  (listLength xs ≡ listLength result)

moveZeroes-spec-satisfied : Set
moveZeroes-spec-satisfied =
  (xs : List Int) →
  (h-precond : moveZeroes-precond xs) →
  moveZeroes-postcond
    xs
    (moveZeroes xs h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_56,
  cataloged as "moveZeroes": the executable stable partition moves all zeroes
  in an integer list to the end while preserving the nonzero order, together
  with its stated subsequence, suffix, count, and length contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val moveZeroes_precond_def = new_definition (
  "moveZeroes_precond_def",
  ``moveZeroes_precond (xs : int list) <=> T``
);

val countVal_def = Define `
  (countVal (val : int) ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (countVal val (x::xs) =
     let rest = countVal val xs in
       if x = val then rest + 1 else rest)
`;

val isSubsequence_def = Define `
  (isSubsequence ([] : int list) (ys : int list) = T) /\
  (isSubsequence (x::xt) ([] : int list) = F) /\
  (isSubsequence (x::xt) (y::yt) =
     if x = y then
       isSubsequence xt yt
     else
       isSubsequence (x::xt) yt)
`;

val moveZeroes_def = new_definition (
  "moveZeroes_def",
  ``moveZeroes (xs : int list) =
      FILTER (\x : int. ~(x = 0)) xs ++
      FILTER (\x : int. x = 0) xs``
);

val moveZeroes_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "moveZeroes_postcond_def",
  ``moveZeroes_postcond
      (xs : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      isSubsequence
        (FILTER (\x : int. ~(x = 0)) xs)
        result = T /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int. x = 0)
        (dropWhile (\x : int. ~(x = 0)) result) /\
      countVal 0 xs = countVal 0 result /\
      LENGTH xs = LENGTH result``
);

val moveZeroes_spec_satisfied =
  ``!xs : int list.
      moveZeroes_precond xs ==>
      moveZeroes_postcond xs (moveZeroes xs)``;

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_56 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_56), catalog title
  moveZeroes: the exact filter-and-append program moves every zero in an
  arbitrary finite integer list to the end while preserving the nonzero
  order, together with its complete correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number
  length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete
  index set.

  VERINA56FilterNonzeroGraph and VERINA56FilterZeroGraph select exactly all
  matching source positions in strictly increasing order. Their unique-choice
  functions therefore reproduce the two source List.filter calls, including
  duplicates. VERINA56AppendGraph gives the exact indexed concatenation, and
  VERINA56MoveZeroes explicitly composes these operations, fixing the
  executable result independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA56Count is the recursive countVal helper, expressed equivalently as
  the cardinality of the matching index set. VERINA56Subsequence is equivalent
  to the true result of the source greedy isSubsequence Boolean recursion:
  it gives an order-preserving embedding of every first-list position into
  an equal second-list position. VERINA56IsSubsequence is its exact Boolean
  indicator, with 1 and 0 representing true and false.

  VERINA56DropWhileNonzeroGraph returns the suffix beginning at the first zero,
  or the empty suffix when no zero occurs, exactly as List.dropWhile with the
  nonzero predicate. VERINA56AllZero is the exact Boolean indicator of
  List.all equality-to-zero. VERINA56Pre is the source True precondition on
  typed inputs. VERINA56Post is the four-part source postcondition, and the
  final assertion is the source correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is
  syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA56FilterNonzeroGraph VERINA56FilterNonzero
  VERINA56FilterZeroGraph VERINA56FilterZero
  VERINA56AppendGraph VERINA56Append
  VERINA56Count
  VERINA56Subsequence VERINA56IsSubsequence
  VERINA56DropWhileNonzeroGraph VERINA56DropWhileNonzero
  VERINA56AllZero
  VERINA56Pre VERINA56MoveZeroes VERINA56Post
$.

verina56-filter-nonzero-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56FilterNonzeroGraph A B ) $.
verina56-filter-nonzero-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56FilterNonzero A ) $.
verina56-filter-zero-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56FilterZeroGraph A B ) $.
verina56-filter-zero-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56FilterZero A ) $.
verina56-append-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56AppendGraph A B C ) $.
verina56-append-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56Append A B ) $.
verina56-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56Count A B ) $.
verina56-subsequence-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56Subsequence A B ) $.
verina56-is-subsequence-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56IsSubsequence A B ) $.
verina56-drop-while-nonzero-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56DropWhileNonzeroGraph A B ) $.
verina56-drop-while-nonzero-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56DropWhileNonzero A ) $.
verina56-all-zero-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56AllZero A ) $.
verina56-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56Pre A ) $.
verina56-move-zeroes-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA56MoveZeroes A ) $.
verina56-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA56Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina56-filter-nonzero-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56FilterNonzeroGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) =/= 0
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( A ` i ) =/= 0
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina56-filter-nonzero-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56FilterNonzero A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA56FilterNonzeroGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina56-filter-zero-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56FilterZeroGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) = 0
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( A ` i ) = 0
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina56-filter-zero-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56FilterZero A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA56FilterZeroGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina56-append-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56AppendGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( C ` i ) = ( A ` i )
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( C ` ( ( # ` A ) + j ) ) = ( B ` j )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina56-append-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56Append A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA56AppendGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina56-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = B
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina56-subsequence-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56Subsequence A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` A )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` B )
              /\
              ( A ` i ) = ( B ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
          /\
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                j < k
                ->
                ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
              )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina56-is-subsequence-definition $a |- (
  VERINA56IsSubsequence A B
) = if (
  ( VERINA56Subsequence A B ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i j k A B $.

  verina56-drop-while-nonzero-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56DropWhileNonzeroGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0
      (
        (
          k <_ ( # ` A )
          /\
          ( ( # ` B ) + k ) = ( # ` A )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( k + j ) )
          /\
          (
            (
              (
                k < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( A ` k ) = 0
              )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                ( A ` i ) =/= 0
            )
            \/
            (
              k = ( # ` A )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                ( A ` i ) =/= 0
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina56-drop-while-nonzero-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56DropWhileNonzero A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA56DropWhileNonzeroGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verina56-all-zero-definition $a |- (
    VERINA56AllZero A
  ) = if (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( A ` i ) = 0
    ) ,
    1 ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

verina56-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA56Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

verina56-move-zeroes-definition $a |- (
  VERINA56MoveZeroes A
) = (
  VERINA56Append
    ( VERINA56FilterNonzero A )
    ( VERINA56FilterZero A )
) $.

verina56-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA56Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      (
        VERINA56IsSubsequence
          ( VERINA56FilterNonzero A )
          B
      ) = 1
      /\
      (
        VERINA56AllZero
          ( VERINA56DropWhileNonzero B )
      ) = 1
    )
    /\
    (
      ( VERINA56Count A 0 ) = ( VERINA56Count B 0 )
      /\
      ( # ` A ) = ( # ` B )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-56-move-zeroes
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA56Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA56Post
          w
          ( VERINA56MoveZeroes w )
      )
    )
  $.

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_56, catalog title "moveZeroes": the unconditional
:: precondition, exact nonzero/zero filtering-and-append implementation,
:: occurrence-count and subsequence helpers, zero-suffix postcondition, and
:: final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, XXREAL_0,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CLASSES1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, NAT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for xs,result being FinSequence of INT st
    0 = 0 &
    ex nonzeros,zeros being FinSequence of INT st
      nonzeros = Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom xs & xs.i <> 0}) &
      zeros = Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom xs & xs.i = 0}) &
      result = nonzeros ^ zeros
  holds
    (ex nonzeros being FinSequence of INT,
        positions being FinSequence of NAT st
      nonzeros = Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom xs & xs.i <> 0}) &
      len positions = len nonzeros &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom positions holds
        positions/.k in dom result &
        nonzeros/.k = result/.(positions/.k)) &
      for k,h being Nat st
        k in dom positions & h in dom positions & k < h
      holds positions/.k < positions/.h) &
    (ex p being Nat st
      p <= len result &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom result & i <= p holds
        result/.i <> 0) &
      for i being Nat st i in dom result & p < i holds
        result/.i = 0) &
    len Seq (xs | {i where i is Nat :
      i in dom xs & xs.i = 0}) =
      len Seq (result | {i where i is Nat :
        i in dom result & result.i = 0}) &
    len xs = len result
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_56
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_56, catalog title "moveZeroes": stably moving all zeroes in
% an integer list to the end while preserving the full executable computation
% and correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_56: THEORY
BEGIN

  moveZeroes_precond(xs: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  filter_nonzero(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head /= 0 THEN
          cons(head, filter_nonzero(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_nonzero(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  filter_zero(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head = 0 THEN
          cons(head, filter_zero(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_zero(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_int_lists(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, append_int_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  % The Lean precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant. This
  % definition is its exact proof-erased executable computation.
  moveZeroes(xs: list[int]): list[int] =
    append_int_lists(
      filter_nonzero(xs),
      filter_zero(xs))

  countVal(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        LET rest: nat = countVal(value, tail)
        IN
          IF head = value THEN rest + 1 ELSE rest ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  isSubsequence(
      xs, ys: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(x, xt):
        CASES ys OF
          null:
            FALSE,
          cons(y, yt):
            IF x = y THEN
              isSubsequence(xt, yt)
            ELSE
              isSubsequence(xs, yt)
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE ys BY <<

  drop_while_nonzero(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head /= 0 THEN
          drop_while_nonzero(tail)
        ELSE
          cons(head, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_zero(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = 0 AND all_zero(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  moveZeroes_postcond(
      xs: list[int],
      result: list[int]): bool =
    isSubsequence(filter_nonzero(xs), result)
      AND all_zero(drop_while_nonzero(result))
      AND countVal(0, xs) = countVal(0, result)
      AND int_list_length(xs) = int_list_length(result)

  moveZeroes_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (xs: list[int]):
      moveZeroes_precond(xs)
        IMPLIES
          moveZeroes_postcond(
            xs,
            moveZeroes(xs))

END verina_advanced_56

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "nextGreaterElement" from VERINA item verina_advanced_57.
-- This file contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux

-- !benchmark @end solution_aux

-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible]
def nextGreaterElement_precond (nums1 : List Int) (nums2 : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  List.Nodup nums1 ∧
  List.Nodup nums2 ∧
  nums1.all (fun x => x ∈ nums2)
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def nextGreaterElement (nums1 : List Int) (nums2 : List Int) (h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond (nums1) (nums2)) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let len1 := nums1.length

  let buildNextGreaterMap : List (Int × Int) :=
    let rec mapLoop (index : Nat) (stack : List Nat) (map : List (Int × Int)) : List (Int × Int) :=
      if h : index >= nums2.length then
        stack.foldl (fun acc pos => (nums2[pos]!, -1) :: acc) map
      else
        let currentValue := nums2[index]!

        let rec processStack (s : List Nat) (m : List (Int × Int)) : List Nat × List (Int × Int) :=
          match s with
          | [] => ([], m)
          | topIndex :: rest =>
              let topValue := nums2[topIndex]!
              if currentValue > topValue then
                let newMap := (topValue, currentValue) :: m
                processStack rest newMap
              else
                (s, m)

        let (newStack, newMap) := processStack stack map

        mapLoop (index + 1) (index :: newStack) newMap
      termination_by nums2.length - index

    mapLoop 0 [] []

  let buildResult : List Int :=
    let rec resultLoop (i : Nat) (result : List Int) : List Int :=
      if i >= len1 then
        result.reverse
      else
        let val := nums1[i]!
        let rec findInMap (m : List (Int × Int)) : Int :=
          match m with
          | [] => -1
          | (num, nextGreater) :: rest =>
              if num == val then nextGreater
              else findInMap rest

        let nextGreater := findInMap buildNextGreaterMap
        resultLoop (i + 1) (nextGreater :: result)
      termination_by len1 - i

    resultLoop 0 []

  buildResult
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def nextGreaterElement_postcond (nums1 : List Int) (nums2 : List Int) (result: List Int) (h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond (nums1) (nums2)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = nums1.length ∧

  (List.range nums1.length |>.all (fun i =>
    let val := nums1[i]!
    let resultVal := result[i]!

    let j := nums2.findIdx? (fun x => x == val)
    match j with
    | none => false
    | some idx =>
      let nextGreater := (List.range (nums2.length - idx - 1)).find? (fun k =>
        let pos := idx + k + 1
        nums2[pos]! > val
      )

      match nextGreater with
      | none => resultVal = -1
      | some offset => resultVal = nums2[idx + offset + 1]!
  )) ∧
  (result.all (fun val =>
    val = -1 ∨ val ∈ nums2
  ))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem nextGreaterElement_spec_satisfied (nums1: List Int) (nums2: List Int) (h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond (nums1) (nums2)) :
    nextGreaterElement_postcond (nums1) (nums2) (nextGreaterElement (nums1) (nums2) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_57,
   catalog title "nextGreaterElement": an executable monotonic-stack
   computation of the first greater integer to the right for each requested
   distinct value, together with its correctness contract. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition nextGreaterElement_precond
    (nums1 nums2 : list Z) : Prop :=
  NoDup nums1 /\
  NoDup nums2 /\
  forallb
    (fun x => existsb (Z.eqb x) nums2)
    nums1 = true.

Definition nextGreaterElement_nth
    (xs : list Z)
    (index : nat) : Z :=
  nth index xs 0%Z.

Definition nextGreaterElement_map := list (Z * Z).

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_processStack
    (nums2 : list Z)
    (currentValue : Z)
    (stack : list nat)
    (entries : nextGreaterElement_map)
    {struct stack}
    : list nat * nextGreaterElement_map :=
  match stack with
  | [] => ([], entries)
  | topIndex :: rest =>
      let topValue := nextGreaterElement_nth nums2 topIndex in
      if Z.gtb currentValue topValue
      then
        nextGreaterElement_processStack
          nums2 currentValue rest
          ((topValue, currentValue) :: entries)
      else (stack, entries)
  end.

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
    (nums2 remaining : list Z)
    (index : nat)
    (stack : list nat)
    (entries : nextGreaterElement_map)
    {struct remaining}
    : nextGreaterElement_map :=
  match remaining with
  | [] =>
      fold_left
        (fun acc pos =>
          (nextGreaterElement_nth nums2 pos, (-1)%Z) :: acc)
        stack entries
  | currentValue :: rest =>
      let '(newStack, newEntries) :=
        nextGreaterElement_processStack
          nums2 currentValue stack entries in
      nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
        nums2 rest (S index) (index :: newStack) newEntries
  end.

Definition nextGreaterElement_buildNextGreaterMap
    (nums2 : list Z) : nextGreaterElement_map :=
  nextGreaterElement_mapLoop nums2 nums2 0%nat [] [].

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_findInMap
    (value : Z)
    (entries : nextGreaterElement_map) : Z :=
  match entries with
  | [] => (-1)%Z
  | (num, nextGreater) :: rest =>
      if Z.eqb num value
      then nextGreater
      else nextGreaterElement_findInMap value rest
  end.

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
    (remaining : list Z)
    (entries : nextGreaterElement_map)
    (result : list Z)
    {struct remaining}
    : list Z :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => rev result
  | value :: rest =>
      let nextGreater :=
        nextGreaterElement_findInMap value entries in
      nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
        rest entries (nextGreater :: result)
  end.

Definition nextGreaterElement
    (nums1 nums2 : list Z)
    (_h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2)
    : list Z :=
  let entries :=
    nextGreaterElement_buildNextGreaterMap nums2 in
  nextGreaterElement_resultLoop nums1 entries [].

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_findIdxFrom
    (value : Z)
    (xs : list Z)
    (index : nat) : option nat :=
  match xs with
  | [] => None
  | x :: rest =>
      if Z.eqb x value
      then Some index
      else nextGreaterElement_findIdxFrom value rest (S index)
  end.

Definition nextGreaterElement_findIdx
    (value : Z)
    (xs : list Z) : option nat :=
  nextGreaterElement_findIdxFrom value xs 0%nat.

Fixpoint nextGreaterElement_findOffset
    (nums2 : list Z)
    (value : Z)
    (offsets : list nat) : option nat :=
  match offsets with
  | [] => None
  | offset :: rest =>
      match nextGreaterElement_findIdx value nums2 with
      | None => None
      | Some index =>
          let position := index + offset + 1 in
          if Z.gtb
               (nextGreaterElement_nth nums2 position)
               value
          then Some offset
          else
            nextGreaterElement_findOffset nums2 value rest
      end
  end.

Definition nextGreaterElement_indexCorrect
    (nums2 : list Z)
    (value resultValue : Z) : bool :=
  match nextGreaterElement_findIdx value nums2 with
  | None => false
  | Some index =>
      let offsets :=
        seq 0%nat (length nums2 - index - 1) in
      match
        nextGreaterElement_findOffset nums2 value offsets
      with
      | None => Z.eqb resultValue (-1)%Z
      | Some offset =>
          Z.eqb
            resultValue
            (nextGreaterElement_nth
              nums2 (index + offset + 1))
      end
  end.

Definition nextGreaterElement_postcond
    (nums1 nums2 result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2)
    : Prop :=
  length result = length nums1 /\
  forallb
    (fun index =>
      let value := nextGreaterElement_nth nums1 index in
      let resultValue :=
        nextGreaterElement_nth result index in
      nextGreaterElement_indexCorrect
        nums2 value resultValue)
    (seq 0%nat (length nums1)) = true /\
  forallb
    (fun value =>
      orb
        (Z.eqb value (-1)%Z)
        (existsb (Z.eqb value) nums2))
    result = true.

Theorem nextGreaterElement_spec_satisfied
    (nums1 nums2 : list Z)
    (h_precond : nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2) :
  nextGreaterElement_postcond
    nums1 nums2
    (nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2 h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_57,
  catalog title "nextGreaterElement": an executable monotone-stack scan finds
  for each selected distinct integer the first greater integer to its right
  in a containing distinct list, or -1 when none exists. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_57
  imports Main
begin

definition nextGreaterElement_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    distinct nums1 \<and>
    distinct nums2 \<and>
    list_all (\<lambda>x. x \<in> set nums2) nums1"

fun nge_processStack ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list
      \<Rightarrow> int list \<times> (int \<times> int) list" where
  "nge_processStack current [] m = ([], m)"
| "nge_processStack current (topValue # rest) m =
    (if current > topValue
     then nge_processStack current rest ((topValue, current) # m)
     else (topValue # rest, m))"

fun nge_mapLoop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list
      \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list" where
  "nge_mapLoop [] stack m =
    foldl (\<lambda>acc value. (value, -1) # acc) m stack"
| "nge_mapLoop (current # remaining) stack m =
    (case nge_processStack current stack m of
       (newStack, newMap) \<Rightarrow>
         nge_mapLoop remaining (current # newStack) newMap)"

fun nge_findInMap ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "nge_findInMap value [] = -1"
| "nge_findInMap value ((number, nextGreater) # remaining) =
    (if number = value
     then nextGreater
     else nge_findInMap value remaining)"

fun nge_resultLoop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow> int list
      \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "nge_resultLoop [] m result = rev result"
| "nge_resultLoop (value # remaining) m result =
    nge_resultLoop remaining m (nge_findInMap value m # result)"

definition nextGreaterElement ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2 =
    nge_resultLoop nums1 (nge_mapLoop nums2 [] []) []"

fun nge_findIndexFrom ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat option" where
  "nge_findIndexFrom value index [] = None"
| "nge_findIndexFrom value index (x # xs) =
    (if x = value
     then Some index
     else nge_findIndexFrom value (Suc index) xs)"

definition nge_findIndex ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat option" where
  "nge_findIndex value xs = nge_findIndexFrom value 0 xs"

fun nge_findGreaterOffset ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat
      \<Rightarrow> nat option" where
  "nge_findGreaterOffset nums value position 0 = None"
| "nge_findGreaterOffset nums value position (Suc remaining) =
    (if nums ! position > value
     then Some 0
     else
       (case nge_findGreaterOffset nums value (Suc position) remaining of
          None \<Rightarrow> None
        | Some offset \<Rightarrow> Some (Suc offset)))"

definition nextGreaterElement_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "nextGreaterElement_postcond nums1 nums2 result \<longleftrightarrow>
    length result = length nums1 \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i.
        let value = nums1 ! i;
            resultValue = result ! i
        in case nge_findIndex value nums2 of
             None \<Rightarrow> False
           | Some index \<Rightarrow>
               (case nge_findGreaterOffset
                       nums2 value (Suc index)
                       (length nums2 - index - 1) of
                  None \<Rightarrow> resultValue = -1
                | Some offset \<Rightarrow>
                    resultValue = nums2 ! (index + offset + 1)))
      [0..<length nums1] \<and>
    list_all (\<lambda>value. value = -1 \<or> value \<in> set nums2) result"

theorem nextGreaterElement_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2"
  shows
    "nextGreaterElement_postcond
      nums1 nums2 (nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_57,
  catalog title "nextGreaterElement": an executable monotone-stack scan maps
  each distinct integer in a list to the first greater integer to its right,
  then looks up those answers for a distinct query list drawn from it, together
  with the full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let nextGreaterElement_nodup =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(nextGreaterElement_nodup ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        nextGreaterElement_nodup (CONS x xs) <=>
        ~MEM x xs /\ nextGreaterElement_nodup xs)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_precond = new_definition
  `nextGreaterElement_precond
      (nums1:int list) (nums2:int list) <=>
     nextGreaterElement_nodup nums1 /\
     nextGreaterElement_nodup nums2 /\
     ALL (\x:int. MEM x nums2) nums1`;;

let nextGreaterElement_getAt =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:int list.
        nextGreaterElement_getAt 0 xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int) else HD xs) /\
     (!i:num. !xs:int list.
        nextGreaterElement_getAt (SUC i) xs =
        if xs = [] then (&0:int)
        else nextGreaterElement_getAt i (TL xs))`;;

let nextGreaterElement_processStack =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums2:int list. !currentValue:int.
      !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_processStack
          nums2 currentValue ([]:num list) map =
        (([]:num list),map)) /\
     (!topIndex:num. !rest:num list. !nums2:int list.
      !currentValue:int. !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_processStack
          nums2 currentValue (CONS topIndex rest) map =
        let topValue =
          nextGreaterElement_getAt topIndex nums2 in
        if currentValue > topValue then
          nextGreaterElement_processStack
            nums2 currentValue rest
            (CONS (topValue,currentValue) map)
        else
          (CONS topIndex rest,map))`;;

let nextGreaterElement_finishMap =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums2:int list. !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_finishMap
          nums2 ([]:num list) map = map) /\
     (!pos:num. !rest:num list. !nums2:int list.
      !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_finishMap
          nums2 (CONS pos rest) map =
        nextGreaterElement_finishMap nums2 rest
          (CONS
            (nextGreaterElement_getAt pos nums2,-- &1)
            map))`;;

let nextGreaterElement_mapLoop =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums2:int list. !index:num. !stack:num list.
      !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
          nums2 ([]:int list) index stack map =
        nextGreaterElement_finishMap nums2 stack map) /\
     (!currentValue:int. !remaining:int list.
      !nums2:int list. !index:num. !stack:num list.
      !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
          nums2 (CONS currentValue remaining)
          index stack map =
        let processed =
          nextGreaterElement_processStack
            nums2 currentValue stack map in
        nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
          nums2 remaining (index + 1)
          (CONS index (FST processed))
          (SND processed))`;;

let nextGreaterElement_buildNextGreaterMap = new_definition
  `nextGreaterElement_buildNextGreaterMap
      (nums2:int list) =
     nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
       nums2 nums2 0 ([]:num list) ([]:(int#int)list)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_findInMap =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!value:int.
        nextGreaterElement_findInMap
          ([]:(int#int)list) value = (-- &1:int)) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list. !value:int.
        nextGreaterElement_findInMap
          (CONS entry rest) value =
        if FST entry = value then SND entry
        else nextGreaterElement_findInMap rest value)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_buildResult =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_buildResult
          map ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!value:int. !rest:int list. !map:(int#int)list.
        nextGreaterElement_buildResult
          map (CONS value rest) =
        CONS
          (nextGreaterElement_findInMap map value)
          (nextGreaterElement_buildResult map rest))`;;

let nextGreaterElement = new_definition
  `nextGreaterElement
      (nums1:int list) (nums2:int list) =
     let nextMap =
       nextGreaterElement_buildNextGreaterMap nums2 in
     nextGreaterElement_buildResult nextMap nums1`;;

let nextGreaterElement_findGreater =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!value:int.
        nextGreaterElement_findGreater
          value ([]:int list) = (NONE:int option)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !value:int.
        nextGreaterElement_findGreater
          value (CONS x xs) =
        if x > value then SOME x
        else nextGreaterElement_findGreater value xs)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_optionMatches = new_definition
  `nextGreaterElement_optionMatches
      (candidate:int option) (resultValue:int) <=>
     (candidate = NONE /\ resultValue = -- &1) \/
     (?x:int. candidate = SOME x /\ resultValue = x)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_matchesValue =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!value:int. !resultValue:int.
        nextGreaterElement_matchesValue
          value resultValue ([]:int list) <=> F) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !value:int. !resultValue:int.
        nextGreaterElement_matchesValue
          value resultValue (CONS x xs) <=>
        if x = value then
          nextGreaterElement_optionMatches
            (nextGreaterElement_findGreater value xs)
            resultValue
        else
          nextGreaterElement_matchesValue
            value resultValue xs)`;;

let nextGreaterElement_matchesResult =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums2:int list. !result:int list.
        nextGreaterElement_matchesResult
          nums2 ([]:int list) result <=> T) /\
     (!value:int. !values:int list. !nums2:int list.
      !result:int list.
        nextGreaterElement_matchesResult
          nums2 (CONS value values) result <=>
        ~(result = []) /\
        nextGreaterElement_matchesValue
          value (HD result) nums2 /\
        nextGreaterElement_matchesResult
          nums2 values (TL result))`;;

let nextGreaterElement_postcond = new_definition
  `nextGreaterElement_postcond
      (nums1:int list) (nums2:int list)
      (result:int list) <=>
     LENGTH result = LENGTH nums1 /\
     nextGreaterElement_matchesResult nums2 nums1 result /\
     ALL
       (\value:int.
          value = -- &1 \/ MEM value nums2)
       result`;;

let nextGreaterElement_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums1:int list. !nums2:int list.
     nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2
     ==> nextGreaterElement_postcond
           nums1 nums2
           (nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2)`;;

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_57,
;; "nextGreaterElement": a monotonic-stack computation returns, for each
;; requested distinct integer, its first greater value to the right in the
;; containing distinct integer list, or -1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-57-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-no-duplicates-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car xs) (cdr xs)))
       (verina-advanced-57-no-duplicates-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-all-members-p (xs ys)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (member-equal (car xs) ys)
       (verina-advanced-57-all-members-p (cdr xs) ys))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element-precond
    (nums1 nums2)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-57-no-duplicates-p nums1)
   (verina-advanced-57-no-duplicates-p nums2)
   (verina-advanced-57-all-members-p nums1 nums2)))

;; List.get! on List Int returns the default integer 0 outside the list.

(defun verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero (index xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp xs)
        (if (zp index)
            (car xs)
          (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
           (- index 1)
           (cdr xs)))
      0)))

;; A map entry (Int x Int) is represented by a cons pair. This is the source
;; stack.foldl finalization, including its accumulator order.

(defun verina-advanced-57-finalize-stack
    (stack map nums2)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count stack)))
  (if (consp stack)
      (verina-advanced-57-finalize-stack
       (cdr stack)
       (cons
        (cons
         (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
          (car stack)
          nums2)
         -1)
        map)
       nums2)
    map))

;; The return value is the pair (newStack, newMap), represented by a cons whose
;; car is the stack and whose cdr is the association-list map.

(defun verina-advanced-57-process-stack
    (stack map current-value nums2)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count stack)))
  (if (consp stack)
      (let* ((top-index (car stack))
             (top-value
              (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
               top-index
               nums2)))
        (if (> current-value top-value)
            (verina-advanced-57-process-stack
             (cdr stack)
             (cons
              (cons top-value current-value)
              map)
             current-value
             nums2)
          (cons stack map)))
    (cons nil map)))

;; REMAINING is nums2.length - INDEX. This reparameterizes the source guard
;; INDEX >= nums2.length without changing any reachable computation.

(defun verina-advanced-57-map-loop
    (index remaining stack map nums2)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-57-finalize-stack
       stack
       map
       nums2)
    (let* ((current-value
            (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
             index
             nums2))
           (processed
            (verina-advanced-57-process-stack
             stack
             map
             current-value
             nums2))
           (new-stack (car processed))
           (new-map (cdr processed)))
      (verina-advanced-57-map-loop
       (+ index 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       (cons index new-stack)
       new-map
       nums2))))

(defun verina-advanced-57-build-next-greater-map (nums2)
  (verina-advanced-57-map-loop
   0
   (len nums2)
   nil
   nil
   nums2))

(defun verina-advanced-57-find-in-map (value map)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count map)))
  (if (consp map)
      (if (equal (car (car map)) value)
          (cdr (car map))
        (verina-advanced-57-find-in-map
         value
         (cdr map)))
    -1))

;; Traversing NUMS1 directly is equivalent to the source index loop on a
;; proper list. The accumulator and final reverse are preserved exactly.

(defun verina-advanced-57-result-loop
    (remaining map result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-57-result-loop
       (cdr remaining)
       map
       (cons
        (verina-advanced-57-find-in-map
         (car remaining)
         map)
        result))
    (reverse result)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element
    (nums1 nums2)
  (verina-advanced-57-result-loop
   nums1
   (verina-advanced-57-build-next-greater-map nums2)
   nil))

;; These option-valued searches reproduce findIdx? and find?. NIL is none;
;; (T . value) is some value, so index or offset zero remains distinguishable.

(defun verina-advanced-57-find-index-option
    (value index xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (equal (car xs) value)
          (cons t index)
        (verina-advanced-57-find-index-option
         value
         (+ index 1)
         (cdr xs)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-57-drop (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      xs
    (if (consp xs)
        (verina-advanced-57-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr xs))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-find-greater-offset-option
    (value offset xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (> (car xs) value)
          (cons t offset)
        (verina-advanced-57-find-greater-offset-option
         value
         (+ offset 1)
         (cdr xs)))
    nil))

;; This is List.range nums1.length followed by List.all in the source
;; postcondition. For each index it separately performs the source findIdx?
;; and the bounded first-greater search to its right.

(defun verina-advanced-57-all-indices-correct-p
    (index remaining nums1 nums2 result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let* ((value
            (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
             index
             nums1))
           (result-value
            (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
             index
             result))
           (location
            (verina-advanced-57-find-index-option
             value
             0
             nums2)))
      (and
       (consp location)
       (let* ((found-index (cdr location))
              (right-suffix
               (cdr
                (verina-advanced-57-drop
                 found-index
                 nums2)))
              (next-greater
               (verina-advanced-57-find-greater-offset-option
                value
                0
                right-suffix)))
         (if (consp next-greater)
             (equal
              result-value
              (verina-advanced-57-nth-default-zero
               (+ found-index
                  (cdr next-greater)
                  1)
               nums2))
           (equal result-value -1)))
       (verina-advanced-57-all-indices-correct-p
        (+ index 1)
        (- remaining 1)
        nums1
        nums2
        result)))))

(defun verina-advanced-57-result-values-valid-p
    (result nums2)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count result)))
  (if (consp result)
      (and
       (or
        (equal (car result) -1)
        (member-equal (car result) nums2))
       (verina-advanced-57-result-values-valid-p
        (cdr result)
        nums2))
    (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element-postcond
    (nums1 nums2 result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp nums1)
   (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp nums2)
   (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp result)
   (equal (len result) (len nums1))
   (verina-advanced-57-all-indices-correct-p
    0
    (len nums1)
    nums1
    nums2
    result)
   (verina-advanced-57-result-values-valid-p
    result
    nums2)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves both List Int binders and the complete precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; monotonic-stack result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums1 nums2)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp nums1)
    (verina-advanced-57-integer-listp nums2)
    (verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element-precond
     nums1
     nums2))
   (verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element-postcond
    nums1
    nums2
    (verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element
     nums1
     nums2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_57,
-- catalog title "nextGreaterElement": a deterministic monotonic-stack program
-- returns the first greater integer to the right for each requested value.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced57 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _∈_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolOr : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolOr true right = true
boolOr false right = right

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

minusOne : Int
minusOne = negsuc zero

one : Nat
one = suc zero

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

data _∈_ (x : Int) : List Int → Set where
  here : {xs : List Int} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : Int} {xs : List Int} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

NoDuplicates : List Int → Set
NoDuplicates [] = Top
NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs) =
  Not (x ∈ xs) ∧ NoDuplicates xs

nextGreaterElement-precond :
  List Int → List Int → Set
nextGreaterElement-precond nums1 nums2 =
  NoDuplicates nums1 ∧
  NoDuplicates nums2 ∧
  IsTrue (allList (λ x → containsInt x nums2) nums1)

record IntPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : Int
    pairSecond : Int

record StackProcess : Set where
  constructor processed
  field
    remainingStack : List Nat
    updatedMap : List IntPair

open StackProcess

processStack :
  List Int →
  Int →
  List Nat →
  List IntPair →
  StackProcess
processStack nums2 current [] mapping =
  processed [] mapping
processStack nums2 current (top-index ∷ rest) mapping =
  let top-value = nthDefault zeroInt top-index nums2
  in
    if intLess top-value current
    then
      processStack
        nums2
        current
        rest
        (pair top-value current ∷ mapping)
    else processed (top-index ∷ rest) mapping

finalizeStack :
  List Int →
  List Nat →
  List IntPair →
  List IntPair
finalizeStack nums2 stack mapping =
  foldLeft
    (λ accumulator position →
      pair
        (nthDefault zeroInt position nums2)
        minusOne ∷
      accumulator)
    mapping
    stack

mapLoopWithFuel :
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  List IntPair →
  List IntPair
mapLoopWithFuel zero nums2 index stack mapping =
  finalizeStack nums2 stack mapping
mapLoopWithFuel (suc fuel) nums2 index stack mapping =
  let current-value = nthDefault zeroInt index nums2
      stack-result =
        processStack nums2 current-value stack mapping
  in
    mapLoopWithFuel
      fuel
      nums2
      (suc index)
      (index ∷ remainingStack stack-result)
      (updatedMap stack-result)

buildNextGreaterMap : List Int → List IntPair
buildNextGreaterMap nums2 =
  mapLoopWithFuel
    (listLength nums2)
    nums2
    zero
    []
    []

findInMap : Int → List IntPair → Int
findInMap sought [] = minusOne
findInMap sought (pair number next-greater ∷ rest) =
  if intEqual number sought
  then next-greater
  else findInMap sought rest

resultLoopWithFuel :
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  List Int →
  List IntPair →
  List Int
resultLoopWithFuel zero nums1 index result mapping =
  reverseList result
resultLoopWithFuel (suc fuel) nums1 index result mapping =
  let value = nthDefault zeroInt index nums1
      next-greater = findInMap value mapping
  in
    resultLoopWithFuel
      fuel
      nums1
      (suc index)
      (next-greater ∷ result)
      mapping

nextGreaterElement :
  (nums1 nums2 : List Int) →
  nextGreaterElement-precond nums1 nums2 →
  List Int
nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2 h-precond =
  let next-greater-map = buildNextGreaterMap nums2
  in
    resultLoopWithFuel
      (listLength nums1)
      nums1
      zero
      []
      next-greater-map

findIndexFrom :
  Int → Nat → List Int → Maybe Nat
findIndexFrom sought index [] = nothing
findIndexFrom sought index (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then just index
  else findIndexFrom sought (suc index) xs

findIndex : Int → List Int → Maybe Nat
findIndex sought xs = findIndexFrom sought zero xs

findNat :
  (Nat → Bool) → List Nat → Maybe Nat
findNat predicate [] = nothing
findNat predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then just x
  else findNat predicate xs

indexSpecification :
  List Int →
  List Int →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Bool
indexSpecification nums1 nums2 result i
  with findIndex (nthDefault zeroInt i nums1) nums2
... | nothing = false
... | just index
  with
    findNat
      (λ offset →
        intLess
          (nthDefault zeroInt i nums1)
          (nthDefault
            zeroInt
            (index + offset + one)
            nums2))
      (range
        (natSubtract
          (natSubtract (listLength nums2) index)
          one))
...   | nothing =
  intEqual (nthDefault zeroInt i result) minusOne
...   | just offset =
  intEqual
    (nthDefault zeroInt i result)
    (nthDefault zeroInt (index + offset + one) nums2)

validResultValue : List Int → Int → Bool
validResultValue nums2 value =
  boolOr
    (intEqual value minusOne)
    (containsInt value nums2)

nextGreaterElement-postcond :
  (nums1 nums2 result : List Int) →
  nextGreaterElement-precond nums1 nums2 →
  Set
nextGreaterElement-postcond nums1 nums2 result h-precond =
  (listLength result ≡ listLength nums1) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (indexSpecification nums1 nums2 result)
      (range (listLength nums1))) ∧
  IsTrue (allList (validResultValue nums2) result)

nextGreaterElement-spec-satisfied : Set
nextGreaterElement-spec-satisfied =
  (nums1 nums2 : List Int) →
  (h-precond : nextGreaterElement-precond nums1 nums2) →
  nextGreaterElement-postcond
    nums1
    nums2
    (nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2 h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_57,
  cataloged as "nextGreaterElement": the executable monotonic-stack program
  returns, for each distinct requested integer, the first greater integer to
  its right in the containing distinct list, or -1 when none exists. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory pairTheory;

val nextGreaterElement_precond_def = new_definition (
  "nextGreaterElement_precond_def",
  ``nextGreaterElement_precond
      (nums1 : int list) (nums2 : int list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT nums1 /\
      ALL_DISTINCT nums2 /\
      EVERY (\x : int. MEM x nums2) nums1``
);

val nextGreaterElement_processStack_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_processStack
      (current : int)
      ([] : int list)
      (nextMap : (int # int) list) =
     (([] : int list), nextMap)) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_processStack
      current
      (top::rest)
      nextMap =
     if current > top then
       nextGreaterElement_processStack
         current rest ((top, current)::nextMap)
     else
       (top::rest, nextMap))
`;

val nextGreaterElement_mapLoop_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
      ([] : int list)
      (stack : int list)
      (nextMap : (int # int) list) =
     FOLDL
       (\acc top. (top, (-1 : int))::acc)
       nextMap
       stack) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
      (current::remaining)
      stack
      nextMap =
     let processed =
       nextGreaterElement_processStack current stack nextMap
     in
       nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
         remaining
         (current::FST processed)
         (SND processed))
`;

val nextGreaterElement_buildMap_def = new_definition (
  "nextGreaterElement_buildMap_def",
  ``nextGreaterElement_buildMap (nums2 : int list) =
      nextGreaterElement_mapLoop
        nums2
        ([] : int list)
        ([] : (int # int) list)``
);

val nextGreaterElement_findInMap_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_findInMap
      ([] : (int # int) list)
      (value : int) =
     (-1 : int)) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_findInMap
      ((key, nextGreater)::rest)
      value =
     if key = value then
       nextGreater
     else
       nextGreaterElement_findInMap rest value)
`;

val nextGreaterElement_resultLoop_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
      ([] : int list)
      (nextMap : (int # int) list)
      (acc : int list) =
     REVERSE acc) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
      (value::remaining)
      nextMap
      acc =
     nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
       remaining
       nextMap
       (nextGreaterElement_findInMap nextMap value::acc))
`;

val nextGreaterElement_def = new_definition (
  "nextGreaterElement_def",
  ``nextGreaterElement
      (nums1 : int list) (nums2 : int list) =
      nextGreaterElement_resultLoop
        nums1
        (nextGreaterElement_buildMap nums2)
        ([] : int list)``
);

val nextGreaterElement_findIndexFrom_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_findIndexFrom
      (value : int)
      (index : num)
      ([] : int list) =
     NONE) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_findIndexFrom
      value
      index
      (x::xs) =
     if x = value then
       SOME index
     else
       nextGreaterElement_findIndexFrom value (index + 1) xs)
`;

val nextGreaterElement_findGreaterOffset_def = Define `
  (nextGreaterElement_findGreaterOffset
      (value : int)
      (offset : num)
      ([] : int list) =
     NONE) /\
  (nextGreaterElement_findGreaterOffset
      value
      offset
      (x::xs) =
     if x > value then
       SOME offset
     else
       nextGreaterElement_findGreaterOffset value (offset + 1) xs)
`;

val nextGreaterElement_resultAt_def = new_definition (
  "nextGreaterElement_resultAt_def",
  ``nextGreaterElement_resultAt
      (nums2 : int list)
      (value : int)
      (resultValue : int) <=>
      case nextGreaterElement_findIndexFrom value 0 nums2 of
        NONE => F
      | SOME index =>
          case
            nextGreaterElement_findGreaterOffset
              value 0 (DROP (index + 1) nums2)
          of
            NONE => resultValue = -1
          | SOME offset =>
              resultValue = EL (index + offset + 1) nums2``
);

val nextGreaterElement_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "nextGreaterElement_postcond_def",
  ``nextGreaterElement_postcond
      (nums1 : int list)
      (nums2 : int list)
      (result : int list) <=>
      LENGTH result = LENGTH nums1 /\
      EVERY
        (\index : num.
           nextGreaterElement_resultAt
             nums2 (EL index nums1) (EL index result))
        (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums1)) /\
      EVERY
        (\value : int. value = -1 \/ MEM value nums2)
        result``
);

val nextGreaterElement_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(nums1 : int list) (nums2 : int list).
      nextGreaterElement_precond nums1 nums2 ==>
      nextGreaterElement_postcond
        nums1 nums2 (nextGreaterElement nums1 nums2)``;

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_57 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_57), catalog title
  nextGreaterElement: the exact monotonic-stack program computes, for every
  entry of an arbitrary finite distinct integer query list whose values occur
  in a distinct integer reference list, the first greater reference-list value
  to its right, or -1 when none exists, together with its complete correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup,
  ran w is its membership set, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA57GetDInt is Lean List.get! on an integer list, including its zero
  default outside the list. VERINA57ConsNat, VERINA57ConsInt, and
  VERINA57ReverseInt are exact list operations.

  VERINA57ProcessStackGraph is the local processStack recursion. Its witness r
  is exactly the number of consecutive stack heads whose source values are
  smaller than the current value. The remaining stack is the corresponding
  suffix, while the popped key-value pairs are prepended to the old map in
  recursive order. VERINA57FinalizeMapGraph is the terminal stack.foldl that
  prepends a pair with value -1 for every unresolved position.

  VERINA57MapStepGraph performs one nonterminal mapLoop iteration:
  processStack followed by pushing the current source index.
  VERINA57MapLoopGraph records every such deterministic state transition from
  arbitrary helper arguments and then performs the terminal fold.
  VERINA57BuildNextGreaterMap is the source invocation at index zero with
  empty stack and map.

  VERINA57FindInMapGraph is the exact first matching-pair search with default
  -1. VERINA57ResultLoopGraph records the source accumulator recursion from
  arbitrary index and accumulator arguments and reverses the final
  accumulator. VERINA57NextGreaterElement explicitly composes the exact map
  construction and result loop, so its output is fixed independently of the
  postcondition.

  VERINA57Nodup and VERINA57Pre reproduce the two List.Nodup assumptions and
  the all-membership subset assumption. VERINA57FindIndex is findIdx?, and
  VERINA57ExpectedAt reproduces the range/find? search for the first greater
  value strictly to the right, including the -1 case. VERINA57Post is the
  complete three-part source postcondition. The proof-valued precondition
  arguments are computationally and propositionally unused and are represented
  by the explicit antecedent of the final correctness assertion. Every earlier
  $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA57GetDInt
  VERINA57ConsNatGraph VERINA57ConsNat
  VERINA57ConsIntGraph VERINA57ConsInt
  VERINA57ReverseIntGraph VERINA57ReverseInt
  VERINA57ProcessStackGraph
  VERINA57FinalizeMapGraph VERINA57FinalizeMap
  VERINA57MapStepGraph VERINA57MapLoopGraph VERINA57MapLoop
  VERINA57BuildNextGreaterMap
  VERINA57FindInMapGraph VERINA57FindInMap
  VERINA57ResultLoopGraph VERINA57ResultLoop VERINA57NextGreaterElement
  VERINA57Nodup VERINA57Pre
  VERINA57FindIndex VERINA57ExpectedAt VERINA57Post
$.

verina57-get-default-int-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57GetDInt A B ) $.
verina57-cons-nat-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57ConsNatGraph A B C ) $.
verina57-cons-nat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57ConsNat A B ) $.

verina57-cons-int-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57ConsInt A B ) $.

  $a wff ( VERINA57ReverseIntGraph A B ) $.
verina57-reverse-int-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57ReverseInt A ) $.
verina57-process-stack-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57ProcessStackGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verina57-finalize-map-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57FinalizeMapGraph A B C D ) $.
verina57-finalize-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57FinalizeMap A B C ) $.
verina57-map-step-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57MapStepGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verina57-map-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57MapLoopGraph A B C D E ) $.
verina57-map-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57MapLoop A B C D ) $.
verina57-build-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57BuildNextGreaterMap A ) $.
verina57-find-in-map-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57FindInMapGraph A B C ) $.
verina57-find-in-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57FindInMap A B ) $.
verina57-result-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57ResultLoopGraph A B C D E ) $.
verina57-result-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57ResultLoop A B C D ) $.
verina57-next-greater-element-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA57NextGreaterElement A B ) $.
verina57-nodup-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57Nodup A ) $.
verina57-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57Pre A B ) $.
verina57-find-index-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA57FindIndex A B C ) $.
