verina57-get-default-int-definition $a |- (
  VERINA57GetDInt A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina57-cons-nat-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ConsNatGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
      /\
      (
        ( C ` 0 ) = A
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( C ` ( j + 1 ) ) = ( B ` j )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina57-cons-nat-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ConsNat A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA57ConsNatGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina57-cons-int-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ConsIntGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
      /\
      (
        ( C ` 0 ) = A
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( C ` ( j + 1 ) ) = ( B ` j )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina57-cons-int-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ConsInt A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA57ConsIntGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina57-reverse-int-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ReverseIntGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina57-reverse-int-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ReverseInt A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA57ReverseIntGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j q r A B C D E F $.

  verina57-process-stack-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ProcessStackGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. Word NN0
          /\
          D e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        E e. Word NN0
        /\
        F e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      )
    )
    /\
    E. r e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` C ) + 1 ) )
      (
        (
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ r )
            (
              VERINA57GetDInt A ( C ` q )
            ) < B
          /\
          (
            r = ( # ` C )
            \/
            (
              r < ( # ` C )
              /\
              B <_ ( VERINA57GetDInt A ( C ` r ) )
            )
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( # ` E ) = ( ( # ` C ) - r )
            /\
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` E ) )
              ( E ` j ) = ( C ` ( r + j ) )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` F ) = ( r + ( # ` D ) )
            /\
            (
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ r )
                (
                  F ` j
                ) = <.
                  (
                    VERINA57GetDInt
                      A
                      ( C ` ( ( r - 1 ) - j ) )
                  ) ,
                  B
                >.
              /\
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` D ) )
                ( F ` ( r + j ) ) = ( D ` j )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B C D $.

  verina57-finalize-map-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57FinalizeMapGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word NN0
        )
        /\
        C e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      )
      /\
      D e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( ( # ` B ) + ( # ` C ) )
      /\
      (
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          (
            D ` j
          ) = <.
            (
              VERINA57GetDInt
                A
                ( B ` ( ( ( # ` B ) - 1 ) - j ) )
            ) ,
            ( -u 1 )
          >.
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
          ( D ` ( ( # ` B ) + j ) ) = ( C ` j )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina57-finalize-map-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57FinalizeMap A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      ( VERINA57FinalizeMapGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d s A B C D E F $.

  verina57-map-step-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57MapStepGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. Word NN0
          /\
          D e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        E e. Word NN0
        /\
        F e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      B < ( # ` A )
      /\
      E. s e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            VERINA57ProcessStackGraph
              A
              ( VERINA57GetDInt A B )
              C
              D
              s
              F
          )
          /\
          E = ( VERINA57ConsNat B s )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E $.

  verina57-map-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57MapLoopGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. Word NN0
          /\
          D e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` A ) <_ B
        /\
        E = ( VERINA57FinalizeMap A C D )
      )
      \/
      (
        B < ( # ` A )
        /\
        E. t e. Word
          ( ( Word NN0 ) X. ( Word ( ZZ X. ZZ ) ) )
          (
            (
              (
                # ` t
              ) = (
                ( ( # ` A ) - B ) + 1
              )
              /\
              ( t ` 0 ) = <. C , D >.
            )
            /\
            (
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` A ) - B ) )
                (
                  VERINA57MapStepGraph
                    A
                    ( B + k )
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
                    ( 2nd ` ( t ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
                )
              /\
              E = (
                VERINA57FinalizeMap
                  A
                  (
                    1st ` (
                      t ` ( ( # ` A ) - B )
                    )
                  )
                  (
                    2nd ` (
                      t ` ( ( # ` A ) - B )
                    )
                  )
              )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verina57-map-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57MapLoop A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      ( VERINA57MapLoopGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

verina57-build-map-definition $a |- (
  VERINA57BuildNextGreaterMap A
) = (
  VERINA57MapLoop A 0 (/) (/)
) $.

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina57-find-in-map-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57FindInMapGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          (
            ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) = B
            /\
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ i )
              ( 1st ` ( A ` j ) ) =/= B
          )
          /\
          C = ( 2nd ` ( A ` i ) )
        )
      \/
      (
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) =/= B
        )
        /\
        C = ( -u 1 )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina57-find-in-map-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57FindInMap A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA57FindInMapGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E $.

  verina57-result-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ResultLoopGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. NN0
          /\
          D e. Word ZZ
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` A ) <_ C
        /\
        E = ( VERINA57ReverseInt D )
      )
      \/
      (
        C < ( # ` A )
        /\
        E. t e. Word ( Word ZZ )
          (
            (
              (
                # ` t
              ) = (
                ( ( # ` A ) - C ) + 1
              )
              /\
              ( t ` 0 ) = D
            )
            /\
            (
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` A ) - C ) )
                (
                  t ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINA57ConsInt
                    (
                      VERINA57FindInMap
                        B
                        (
                          VERINA57GetDInt
                            A
                            ( C + k )
                        )
                    )
                    ( t ` k )
                )
              /\
              E = (
                VERINA57ReverseInt
                  (
                    t ` ( ( # ` A ) - C )
                  )
              )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verina57-result-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ResultLoop A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA57ResultLoopGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

verina57-next-greater-element-definition $a |- (
  VERINA57NextGreaterElement A B
) = (
  VERINA57ResultLoop
    A
    ( VERINA57BuildNextGreaterMap B )
    0
    (/)
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verina57-nodup-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57Nodup A
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) =/= ( A ` j )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina57-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57Pre A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      (
        ( VERINA57Nodup A )
        /\
        ( VERINA57Nodup B )
      )
    )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      ( A ` i ) e. ran B
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina57-find-index-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57FindIndex A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        C < ( # ` A )
        /\
        ( A ` C ) = B
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ C )
        ( A ` i ) =/= B
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k q A B C $.

  verina57-expected-at-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57ExpectedAt A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        ( VERINA57FindIndex A B j )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. k e. ( ( j + 1 ) ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              ( A ` k ) <_ B
            /\
            C = ( -u 1 )
          )
          \/
          E. k e. ( ( j + 1 ) ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              (
                B < ( A ` k )
                /\
                A. q e. ( ( j + 1 ) ..^ k )
                  ( A ` q ) <_ B
              )
              /\
              C = ( A ` k )
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verina57-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA57Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word ZZ
        )
        /\
        C e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      ( # ` C ) = ( # ` A )
    )
    /\
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          VERINA57ExpectedAt
            B
            ( A ` i )
            ( C ` i )
        )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          ( C ` i ) = ( -u 1 )
          \/
          ( C ` i ) e. ran B
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-57-next-greater-element
  $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
    A. b e. Word ZZ
      (
        ( VERINA57Pre a b )
        ->
        (
          VERINA57Post
            a
            b
            ( VERINA57NextGreaterElement a b )
        )
      )
  $.

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_57, catalog title "nextGreaterElement": the uniqueness
:: and subset precondition, exact monotonic-stack map construction,
:: stack-processing and first-match lookup helpers, result-building
:: implementation, next-greater postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums1,nums2,result being FinSequence of INT st
    nums1 is one-to-one &
    nums2 is one-to-one &
    rng nums1 c= rng nums2 &
    (ex nextMap being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:],
        stackStates being FinSequence of NAT*,
        mapStates being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:]*,
        resultStates being FinSequence of INT* st
      len stackStates = len nums2 + 1 &
      len mapStates = len nums2 + 1 &
      stackStates/.1 = <*>NAT &
      mapStates/.1 = <*>[:INT,INT:] &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom nums2 holds
        ex oldStack,newStack,remainingStack being FinSequence of NAT,
           oldMap,newMap,poppedPairs being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:],
           p being Nat, current being Integer st
          oldStack = stackStates/.k &
          oldMap = mapStates/.k &
          current = nums2/.k &
          p <= len oldStack &
          len poppedPairs = p &
          (for q being Nat st q in dom poppedPairs holds
            ex position being Nat st
              position = oldStack/.q &
              position + 1 in dom nums2 &
              poppedPairs/.q = [nums2/.(position + 1),current] &
              nums2/.(position + 1) < current) &
          (p = len oldStack or
            ex topPosition being Nat st
              p + 1 in dom oldStack &
              topPosition = oldStack/.(p + 1) &
              topPosition + 1 in dom nums2 &
              current <= nums2/.(topPosition + 1)) &
          len remainingStack = len oldStack - p &
          (for q being Nat st q in dom remainingStack holds
            remainingStack/.q = oldStack/.(p + q)) &
          newStack = <*(k - 1)*> ^ remainingStack &
          newMap = Rev poppedPairs ^ oldMap &
          stackStates/.(k + 1) = newStack &
          mapStates/.(k + 1) = newMap) &
      (ex finalStack being FinSequence of NAT,
          processedMap,defaultPairs being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:] st
        finalStack = stackStates/.(len nums2 + 1) &
        processedMap = mapStates/.(len nums2 + 1) &
        len defaultPairs = len finalStack &
        (for q being Nat st q in dom defaultPairs holds
          ex position being Nat st
            position = finalStack/.q &
            position + 1 in dom nums2 &
            defaultPairs/.q = [nums2/.(position + 1),-1]) &
        nextMap = Rev defaultPairs ^ processedMap) &
      len resultStates = len nums1 + 1 &
      resultStates/.1 = <*>INT &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom nums1 holds
        ex accumulator,nextAccumulator being FinSequence of INT,
           val,resultVal being Integer st
          accumulator = resultStates/.k &
          nextAccumulator = resultStates/.(k + 1) &
          val = nums1/.k &
          (((not ex q being Nat, w being Integer st
                q in dom nextMap & nextMap/.q = [val,w]) &
              resultVal = -1) or
           (ex q being Nat st
              q in dom nextMap &
              nextMap/.q = [val,resultVal] &
              (for h being Nat, w being Integer st
                h in dom nextMap & h < q
              holds nextMap/.h <> [val,w]))) &
          nextAccumulator = <*resultVal*> ^ accumulator) &
      result = Rev (resultStates/.(len nums1 + 1)))
  holds
    len result = len nums1 &
    (for k being Nat st k in dom nums1 holds
      ex val being Integer, j being Nat st
        val = nums1/.k &
        j in dom nums2 &
        nums2/.j = val &
        (for h being Nat st h in dom nums2 & h < j holds
          nums2/.h <> val) &
        (((not ex r being Nat st
              r in dom nums2 & j < r & val < nums2/.r) &
            result/.k = -1) or
         (ex r being Nat st
            r in dom nums2 &
            j < r &
            val < nums2/.r &
            result/.k = nums2/.r &
            (for h being Nat st
              h in dom nums2 & j < h & h < r
            holds nums2/.h <= val)))) &
    (for k being Nat st k in dom result holds
      result/.k = -1 or result/.k in rng nums2)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_57
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_57, catalog title "nextGreaterElement": computing for each
% selected integer the first greater integer to its right in a duplicate-free
% containing list, using the specified monotonic-stack program and correctness
% contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_57: THEORY
BEGIN

  map_entry: TYPE =
    [# mapped_value: int, next_greater: int #]

  stack_map_state: TYPE =
    [# remaining_stack: list[nat],
       built_map: list[map_entry] #]

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_member(
      requested: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_member(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicate_ints(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT int_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_ints(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_members(
      selected_values,
      containing_values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES selected_values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_member(head, containing_values)
          AND all_members(tail, containing_values)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE selected_values BY <<

  nextGreaterElement_precond(
      nums1, nums2: list[int]): bool =
    no_duplicate_ints(nums1)
      AND no_duplicate_ints(nums2)
      AND all_members(nums1, nums2)

  processStack(
      current_value: int,
      nums2: list[int],
      stack_positions: list[nat],
      entries: list[map_entry]): RECURSIVE stack_map_state =
    CASES stack_positions OF
      null:
        (# remaining_stack := null[nat],
           built_map := entries #),
      cons(top_index, rest):
        LET top_value: int =
              int_list_get_bang(top_index, nums2)
        IN
          IF current_value > top_value THEN
            processStack(
              current_value,
              nums2,
              rest,
              cons(
                (# mapped_value := top_value,
                   next_greater := current_value #),
                entries))
          ELSE
            (# remaining_stack := stack_positions,
               built_map := entries #)
          ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE stack_positions BY <<

  finalizeStack(
      nums2: list[int],
      stack_positions: list[nat],
      entries: list[map_entry]): RECURSIVE list[map_entry] =
    CASES stack_positions OF
      null:
        entries,
      cons(position, rest):
        finalizeStack(
          nums2,
          rest,
          cons(
            (# mapped_value :=
                 int_list_get_bang(position, nums2),
               next_greater := -1 #),
            entries))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE stack_positions BY <<

  mapLoop(
      nums2: list[int],
      index, remaining: nat,
      stack_positions: list[nat],
      entries: list[map_entry]): RECURSIVE list[map_entry] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      finalizeStack(nums2, stack_positions, entries)
    ELSE
      LET current_value: int =
            int_list_get_bang(index, nums2),
          processed: stack_map_state =
            processStack(
              current_value,

      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):

            source_value,

  result_positions_match(
      nums1, nums2, result: list[int],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE

  MEASURE remaining

  result_values_valid(
      result, nums2: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =

      null:

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_58,
   catalog title "nthUglyNumber": an executable three-pointer generation of
   the nth positive integer whose only prime factors are 2, 3, and 5, together
   with its factor-stripping correctness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition nthUglyNumber_precond (n : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < n)%nat.

Definition nextUgly
    (values : list nat)
    (c2 c3 c5 : nat) : nat * nat * nat * nat :=
  let i2 := nth c2 values 0 * 2 in
  let i3 := nth c3 values 0 * 3 in
  let i5 := nth c5 values 0 * 5 in
  let next := Nat.min i2 (Nat.min i3 i5) in
  let c2' := if Nat.eqb next i2 then S c2 else c2 in
  let c3' := if Nat.eqb next i3 then S c3 else c3 in
  let c5' := if Nat.eqb next i5 then S c5 else c5 in
  (next, c2', c3', c5').

Fixpoint nthUglyNumber_loop
    (i : nat)
    (values : list nat)
    (c2 c3 c5 : nat)
    {struct i} : list nat :=
  match i with
  | 0 => values
  | S i' =>
      let '(next, c2', c3', c5') :=
        nextUgly values c2 c3 c5 in
      nthUglyNumber_loop
        i' (values ++ [next]) c2' c3' c5'
  end.

Definition nthUglyNumber
    (n : nat)
    (_h_precond : nthUglyNumber_precond n) : nat :=
  let index := n - 1 in
  nth index
    (nthUglyNumber_loop index [1] 0 0 0)
    0.

Fixpoint divideOut_fuel
    (fuel n p : nat)
    {struct fuel} : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => n
  | S fuel' =>
      if andb
           (Nat.ltb 1 p)
           (andb
             (Nat.ltb 0 n)
             (Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n p) 0))
      then divideOut_fuel fuel' (Nat.div n p) p
      else n
  end.

Definition divideOut (n p : nat) : nat :=
  divideOut_fuel n n p.

Definition isUgly (x : nat) : bool :=
  if Nat.eqb x 0
  then false
  else
    let n1 := divideOut x 2 in
    let n2 := divideOut n1 3 in
    let n3 := divideOut n2 5 in
    Nat.eqb n3 1.

Definition nthUglyNumber_postcond
    (n result : nat)
    (_h_precond : nthUglyNumber_precond n) : Prop :=
  isUgly result = true /\
  length (filter isUgly (seq 0 result)) = n - 1.

Theorem nthUglyNumber_spec_satisfied
    (n : nat)
    (h_precond : nthUglyNumber_precond n) :
  nthUglyNumber_postcond
    n (nthUglyNumber n h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_58,
  catalog title "nthUglyNumber": an executable three-index dynamic program
  returns the nth positive natural number whose prime factors are only 2, 3,
  and 5, with its counting-based correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_58
  imports Main
begin

definition nthUglyNumber_precond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "nthUglyNumber_precond n \<longleftrightarrow> n > 0"

fun uglyListGet :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "uglyListGet [] i = 0"
| "uglyListGet (x # xs) 0 = x"
| "uglyListGet (x # xs) (Suc i) = uglyListGet xs i"

definition nextUgly ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat
      \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat \<times> nat \<times> nat" where
  "nextUgly seq c2 c3 c5 =
    (let i2 = uglyListGet seq c2 * 2;
         i3 = uglyListGet seq c3 * 3;
         i5 = uglyListGet seq c5 * 5;
         next = min i2 (min i3 i5);
         c2' = (if next = i2 then c2 + 1 else c2);
         c3' = (if next = i3 then c3 + 1 else c3);
         c5' = (if next = i5 then c5 + 1 else c5)
     in (next, c2', c3', c5'))"

fun nthUglyNumber_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat
      \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "nthUglyNumber_loop 0 seq c2 c3 c5 = seq"
| "nthUglyNumber_loop (Suc i) seq c2 c3 c5 =
    (case nextUgly seq c2 c3 c5 of
       (next, c2', c3', c5') \<Rightarrow>
         nthUglyNumber_loop i (seq @ [next]) c2' c3' c5')"

definition nthUglyNumber :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "nthUglyNumber n =
    uglyListGet
      (nthUglyNumber_loop (n - 1) [1] 0 0 0)
      (n - 1)"

fun divideOutFuel :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "divideOutFuel 0 n p = n"
| "divideOutFuel (Suc fuel) n p =
    (if p > 1 \<and> n > 0 \<and> n mod p = 0
     then divideOutFuel fuel (n div p) p
     else n)"

definition divideOut :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "divideOut n p = divideOutFuel n n p"

definition isUgly :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isUgly x =
    (if x = 0
     then False
     else
       (let n1 = divideOut x 2;
            n2 = divideOut n1 3;
            n3 = divideOut n2 5
        in n3 = 1))"

definition nthUglyNumber_postcond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "nthUglyNumber_postcond n result \<longleftrightarrow>
    isUgly result \<and>
    length (filter isUgly [0..<result]) = n - 1"

theorem nthUglyNumber_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "nthUglyNumber_precond n"
  shows "nthUglyNumber_postcond n (nthUglyNumber n)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_58,
  catalog title "nthUglyNumber": an executable three-counter sequence
  computation returns the nth ugly number, with ugliness characterized by
  repeated division by 2, 3, and 5 and by its zero-based rank among smaller
  natural numbers. This file contains no proof.
*)

let nthUglyNumber_precond = new_definition
  `nthUglyNumber_precond (n:num) <=>
     n > 0`;;

let nthUglyNumber_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!seq:num list.
        nthUglyNumber_get 0 seq =
        if seq = [] then 0 else HD seq) /\
     (!index:num. !seq:num list.
        nthUglyNumber_get (SUC index) seq =
        if seq = [] then 0
        else nthUglyNumber_get index (TL seq))`;;

let nextUgly = new_definition
  `nextUgly
      (seq:num list) (c2:num) (c3:num) (c5:num) =
     let i2 = nthUglyNumber_get c2 seq * 2 in
     let i3 = nthUglyNumber_get c3 seq * 3 in
     let i5 = nthUglyNumber_get c5 seq * 5 in
     let next = MIN i2 (MIN i3 i5) in
     let c2' = if next = i2 then c2 + 1 else c2 in
     let c3' = if next = i3 then c3 + 1 else c3 in
     let c5' = if next = i5 then c5 + 1 else c5 in
     (next,(c2',(c3',c5')))`;;

let nthUglyNumber_loop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!seq:num list. !c2:num. !c3:num. !c5:num.
        nthUglyNumber_loop 0 seq c2 c3 c5 = seq) /\
     (!iterations:num. !seq:num list.
      !c2:num. !c3:num. !c5:num.
        nthUglyNumber_loop
          (SUC iterations) seq c2 c3 c5 =
        let step = nextUgly seq c2 c3 c5 in
        let next = FST step in
        let c2' = FST (SND step) in
        let c3' = FST (SND (SND step)) in
        let c5' = SND (SND (SND step)) in
        nthUglyNumber_loop
          iterations
          (APPEND seq (CONS next []))
          c2' c3' c5')`;;

let nthUglyNumber = new_definition
  `nthUglyNumber (n:num) =
     nthUglyNumber_get (n - 1)
       (nthUglyNumber_loop
          (n - 1) (CONS 1 []) 0 0 0)`;;

let divideOut = define
  `divideOut(n,p) =
     if 1 < p /\ 0 < n /\ n MOD p = 0
     then divideOut(n DIV p,p)
     else n`;;

let isUgly = new_definition
  `isUgly (x:num) =
     if x = 0 then F
     else
       let n1 = divideOut(x,2) in
       let n2 = divideOut(n1,3) in
       let n3 = divideOut(n2,5) in
       n3 = 1`;;

let nthUglyNumber_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(nthUglyNumber_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        nthUglyNumber_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND (nthUglyNumber_range n) (CONS n []))`;;

let nthUglyNumber_postcond = new_definition
  `nthUglyNumber_postcond (n:num) (result:num) <=>
     isUgly result /\
     LENGTH
       (FILTER isUgly (nthUglyNumber_range result)) =
       n - 1`;;

let nthUglyNumber_spec_satisfied =
  `!n:num.
     nthUglyNumber_precond n
     ==> nthUglyNumber_postcond n (nthUglyNumber n)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_58,
;; "nthUglyNumber": the deterministic three-index sequence program returns the
;; nth natural number whose only prime factors are 2, 3, and 5. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The Nat input domain is explicit in the final correctness predicate.

(defun verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number-precond (n)
  (< 0 n))

(defun verina-advanced-58-nat-min (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      left
    right))

;; Lean's List.get! on List Nat returns zero when the index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero (seq index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (if (consp seq)
          (car seq)
        0)
    (if (consp seq)
        (verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero
         (cdr seq)
         (- index 1))
      0)))

;; The four-entry list represents the source quadruple
;; (next, c2', c3', c5') without changing any component.

(defun verina-advanced-58-next-ugly (seq c2 c3 c5)
  (let* ((i2
          (* (verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero seq c2)
             2))
         (i3
          (* (verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero seq c3)
             3))
         (i5
          (* (verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero seq c5)
             5))
         (next
          (verina-advanced-58-nat-min
           i2
           (verina-advanced-58-nat-min i3 i5)))
         (c2-next
          (if (equal next i2) (+ c2 1) c2))
         (c3-next
          (if (equal next i3) (+ c3 1) c3))
         (c5-next
          (if (equal next i5) (+ c5 1) c5)))
    (list next c2-next c3-next c5-next)))

;; This is the source local loop. Each transition appends NEXT and advances
;; every index whose multiple equals NEXT.

(defun verina-advanced-58-loop (i seq c2 c3 c5)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix i)))
  (if (zp i)
      seq
    (let* ((state
            (verina-advanced-58-next-ugly
             seq c2 c3 c5))
           (next (car state))
           (c2-next (cadr state))
           (c3-next (caddr state))
           (c5-next (cadddr state)))
      (verina-advanced-58-loop
       (- i 1)
       (append seq (list next))
       c2-next
       c3-next
       c5-next))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally erased. NFIX
;; implements Lean's truncated Nat subtraction before both loop iteration and
;; final List.get! indexing.

(defun verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number (n)
  (let* ((index (nfix (- n 1)))
         (seq
          (verina-advanced-58-loop
           index
           (list 1)
           0
           0
           0)))
    (verina-advanced-58-nth-default-zero seq index)))

;; On a recursive branch, p > 1 and n is positive and divisible by p, so
;; floor(n/p) is strictly smaller than n. Fuel initialized to n therefore
;; cannot expire and gives exactly the source well-founded recursion.

(defun verina-advanced-58-divide-out-aux (n p fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (and
       (natp n)
       (natp p)
       (< 1 p)
       (< 0 n)
       (equal (mod n p) 0))
      (if (zp fuel)
          n
        (verina-advanced-58-divide-out-aux
         (floor n p)
         p
         (- fuel 1)))
    n))

(defun verina-advanced-58-divide-out (n p)
  (verina-advanced-58-divide-out-aux
   n
   p
   (nfix n)))

(defun verina-advanced-58-is-ugly (x)
  (if (equal x 0)
      nil
    (let* ((n1
            (verina-advanced-58-divide-out x 2))
           (n2
            (verina-advanced-58-divide-out n1 3))
           (n3
            (verina-advanced-58-divide-out n2 5)))
      (equal n3 1))))

;; CURRENT through CURRENT + REMAINING - 1 is a List.range segment. Counting
;; entries accepted by IS-UGLY is therefore the length of the source filter.

(defun verina-advanced-58-count-ugly-from
    (current remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+
     (if (verina-advanced-58-is-ugly current)
         1
       0)
     (verina-advanced-58-count-ugly-from
      (+ current 1)
      (- remaining 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-58-count-ugly-below (result)
  (verina-advanced-58-count-ugly-from
   0
   (nfix result)))

(defun verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number-postcond
    (n result)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp result)
   (verina-advanced-58-is-ugly result)
   (equal
    (verina-advanced-58-count-ugly-below result)
    (nfix (- n 1)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the Nat binder and positive-index precondition, and
;; its conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number-spec-satisfied-statement
    (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number-precond n))
   (verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number-postcond
    n
    (verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number n))))

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_58,
-- catalog title "nthUglyNumber": a deterministic three-index sequence program
-- returns the nth ugly number and is connected to its ugly-factor and rank
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced58 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalDiv : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero = zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

five : Nat
five = suc (suc three)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

natMin : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMin m n =
  if natLessOrEqual m n
  then m
  else n

nthUglyNumber-precond : Nat → Set
nthUglyNumber-precond n = IsTrue (natLess zero n)

record NextUglyResult : Set where
  constructor next-result
  field
    nextValue : Nat
    nextC2 : Nat
    nextC3 : Nat
    nextC5 : Nat

open NextUglyResult

nextUgly :
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  NextUglyResult
nextUgly sequence c2 c3 c5 =
  let i2 = nthDefault zero c2 sequence * two
      i3 = nthDefault zero c3 sequence * three
      i5 = nthDefault zero c5 sequence * five
      next = natMin i2 (natMin i3 i5)
      c2′ =
        if natEqual next i2
        then c2 + one
        else c2
      c3′ =
        if natEqual next i3
        then c3 + one
        else c3
      c5′ =
        if natEqual next i5
        then c5 + one
        else c5
  in next-result next c2′ c3′ c5′

nthUglyLoop :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat
nthUglyLoop zero sequence c2 c3 c5 = sequence
nthUglyLoop (suc remaining) sequence c2 c3 c5 =
  let step = nextUgly sequence c2 c3 c5
  in
    nthUglyLoop
      remaining
      (appendList sequence (nextValue step ∷ []))
      (nextC2 step)
      (nextC3 step)
      (nextC5 step)

nthUglyNumber :
  (n : Nat) →
  nthUglyNumber-precond n →
  Nat
nthUglyNumber n h-precond =
  let index = natSubtract n one
      sequence =
        nthUglyLoop
          index
          (one ∷ [])
          zero
          zero
          zero
  in nthDefault zero index sequence

divideOutWithFuel : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
divideOutWithFuel zero n p = n
divideOutWithFuel (suc fuel) n p =
  if natLess one p
  then
    if natLess zero n
    then
      if natEqual (naturalMod n p) zero
      then divideOutWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv n p) p
      else n
    else n
  else n

divideOut : Nat → Nat → Nat
divideOut n p = divideOutWithFuel n n p

isUgly : Nat → Bool
isUgly x =
  if natEqual x zero
  then false
  else
    let n1 = divideOut x two
        n2 = divideOut n1 three
        n3 = divideOut n2 five
    in natEqual n3 one

nthUglyNumber-postcond :
  (n : Nat) →
  (result : Nat) →
  nthUglyNumber-precond n →
  Set
nthUglyNumber-postcond n result h-precond =
  (isUgly result ≡ true) ∧
  (listLength (filterList isUgly (range result)) ≡
   natSubtract n one)

nthUglyNumber-spec-satisfied : Set
nthUglyNumber-spec-satisfied =
  (n : Nat) →
  (h-precond : nthUglyNumber-precond n) →
  nthUglyNumber-postcond
    n
    (nthUglyNumber n h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_58
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_58,
  cataloged as "nthUglyNumber": the executable three-index generator returns
  the requested positive natural number whose only prime factors are 2, 3,
  and 5, with exactly n - 1 smaller ugly numbers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pairTheory;

val nthUglyNumber_precond_def = new_definition (
  "nthUglyNumber_precond_def",
  ``nthUglyNumber_precond (n : num) <=> 0 < n``
);

val nthUglyNumber_getAt_def = new_definition (
  "nthUglyNumber_getAt_def",
  ``nthUglyNumber_getAt (seq : num list) (index : num) =
      case DROP index seq of
        [] => 0
      | x::xs => x``
);

val nextUgly_def = new_definition (
  "nextUgly_def",
  ``nextUgly
      (seq : num list) (c2 : num) (c3 : num) (c5 : num) =
      let i2 = nthUglyNumber_getAt seq c2 * 2 in
      let i3 = nthUglyNumber_getAt seq c3 * 3 in
      let i5 = nthUglyNumber_getAt seq c5 * 5 in
      let min35 = if i3 <= i5 then i3 else i5 in
      let next = if i2 <= min35 then i2 else min35 in
      let c2' = if next = i2 then c2 + 1 else c2 in
      let c3' = if next = i3 then c3 + 1 else c3 in
      let c5' = if next = i5 then c5 + 1 else c5 in
        (next,(c2',(c3',c5')))``
);

val nthUglyNumber_loop_def = Define `
  (nthUglyNumber_loop
      0
      (seq : num list)
      (c2 : num)
      (c3 : num)
      (c5 : num) =
     seq) /\
  (nthUglyNumber_loop
      (SUC i) seq c2 c3 c5 =
     let updated = nextUgly seq c2 c3 c5 in
       nthUglyNumber_loop
         i
         (seq ++ [FST updated])
         (FST (SND updated))
         (FST (SND (SND updated)))
         (SND (SND (SND updated))))
`;

val nthUglyNumber_def = new_definition (
  "nthUglyNumber_def",
  ``nthUglyNumber (n : num) =
      nthUglyNumber_getAt
        (nthUglyNumber_loop (n - 1) [1] 0 0 0)
        (n - 1)``
);

val divideOutFuel_def = Define `
  (divideOutFuel 0 (n : num) (p : num) = n) /\
  (divideOutFuel (SUC fuel) n p =
     if 1 < p /\ 0 < n /\ n MOD p = 0 then
       divideOutFuel fuel (n DIV p) p
     else
       n)
`;

val divideOut_def = new_definition (
  "divideOut_def",
  ``divideOut (n : num) (p : num) = divideOutFuel n n p``
);

val isUgly_def = new_definition (
  "isUgly_def",
  ``isUgly (x : num) <=>
      if x = 0 then
        F
      else
        let n1 = divideOut x 2 in
        let n2 = divideOut n1 3 in
        let n3 = divideOut n2 5 in
          n3 = 1``
);

val nthUglyNumber_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "nthUglyNumber_postcond_def",
  ``nthUglyNumber_postcond (n : num) (result : num) <=>
      isUgly result /\
      LENGTH (FILTER isUgly (COUNT_LIST result)) = n - 1``
);

val nthUglyNumber_spec_satisfied =
  ``!n : num.
      nthUglyNumber_precond n ==>
      nthUglyNumber_postcond n (nthUglyNumber n)``;

title: verina_advanced_58
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_58 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_58), catalog title
  nthUglyNumber: the exact three-counter sequence-generation program returns
  the requested positive-indexed ugly number, characterized by divisibility
  only by two, three, and five and by the count of earlier ugly numbers. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA58GetD is Lean List.get! on a natural-number list, including its zero
  default outside the list. VERINA58NatSub restores Lean's truncated Nat.sub.
  VERINA58Snoc is exact append of a singleton to a word.

  VERINA58NextUgly is the source nextUgly helper. It reads the entries at the
  three counters, multiplies them by two, three, and five, chooses their
  minimum, and increments every counter whose candidate equals that minimum.
  VERINA58LoopGraph records the complete deterministic state trace of the
  recursive loop for arbitrary helper arguments. VERINA58NthUglyNumber runs
  that loop for n - 1 steps from the singleton word [1] and counters zero,
  then performs the source zero-default lookup at index n - 1. Thus the
  executable result is fixed independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA58DivideOutGraph exactly represents divideOut. For positive n and
  p greater than one, its unique residual removes the maximal power of p;
  otherwise it returns n unchanged. VERINA58IsUgly applies this helper for
  two, three, and five and returns true exactly when the final residual is
  one, with { 0 , 1 } representing Bool. VERINA58UglyCount is the length of
  the source filter of List.range, expressed as the cardinality of precisely
  those indices below the result where VERINA58IsUgly is true.

  VERINA58Pre, VERINA58Post, and the final assertion retain the source
  precondition, postcondition, and correctness proposition. The proof-valued
  precondition arguments are computationally and propositionally unused and
  are represented by the explicit antecedent. Every earlier $a is syntax or
  a faithful definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA58NatSub
  VERINA58GetD
  VERINA58SnocGraph VERINA58Snoc
  VERINA58Min VERINA58NextValue VERINA58NextUgly
  VERINA58State VERINA58Step
  VERINA58LoopGraph VERINA58Loop
  VERINA58OneWord VERINA58NthUglyNumber
  VERINA58DivideOutGraph VERINA58DivideOut
  VERINA58IsUgly VERINA58UglyCount
  VERINA58Pre VERINA58Post
$.

verina58-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58NatSub A B ) $.
verina58-get-default-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58GetD A B ) $.
verina58-snoc-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA58SnocGraph A B C ) $.
verina58-snoc-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58Snoc A B ) $.
verina58-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58Min A B ) $.
verina58-next-value-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58NextValue A B C D ) $.
verina58-next-ugly-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58NextUgly A B C D ) $.
verina58-state-syntax
  $a class VERINA58State $.
verina58-step-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58Step A ) $.
verina58-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA58LoopGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verina58-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58Loop A B C D E ) $.
verina58-one-word-syntax
  $a class VERINA58OneWord $.
verina58-nth-ugly-number-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58NthUglyNumber A ) $.
verina58-divide-out-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA58DivideOutGraph A B C ) $.
verina58-divide-out-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58DivideOut A B ) $.
verina58-is-ugly-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58IsUgly A ) $.
verina58-ugly-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA58UglyCount A ) $.
verina58-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA58Pre A ) $.
verina58-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA58Post A B ) $.

verina58-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verina58-get-default-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58GetD A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina58-snoc-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58SnocGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
      /\
      (
        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( C ` k ) = ( A ` k )
        /\
        ( C ` ( # ` A ) ) = B
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina58-snoc-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58Snoc A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA58SnocGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina58-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58Min A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

verina58-next-value-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58NextValue A B C D
) = (
  VERINA58Min
    ( ( VERINA58GetD A B ) x. 2 )
    (
      VERINA58Min
        ( ( VERINA58GetD A C ) x. 3 )
        ( ( VERINA58GetD A D ) x. 5 )
    )
) $.

verina58-next-ugly-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58NextUgly A B C D
) = <.
  ( VERINA58NextValue A B C D )
  ,
  <.
    if (
      ( VERINA58NextValue A B C D )
        = ( ( VERINA58GetD A B ) x. 2 ) ,
      ( B + 1 ) ,
      B
    )
    ,
    <.
      if (
        ( VERINA58NextValue A B C D )
          = ( ( VERINA58GetD A C ) x. 3 ) ,
        ( C + 1 ) ,
        C
      )
      ,
      if (
        ( VERINA58NextValue A B C D )
          = ( ( VERINA58GetD A D ) x. 5 ) ,
        ( D + 1 ) ,
        D
      )
    >.
  >.
>. $.

verina58-state-definition $a |- VERINA58State = (
  Word NN0 X. ( NN0 X. ( NN0 X. NN0 ) )
) $.

verina58-step-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58Step A
) = <.
  (
    VERINA58Snoc
      ( 1st ` A )
      (
        1st ` (
          VERINA58NextUgly
            ( 1st ` A )
            ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
            ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
            ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
        )
      )
  )
  ,
  <.
    (
      1st ` (
        2nd ` (
          VERINA58NextUgly
            ( 1st ` A )
            ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
            ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
            ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
        )
      )
    )
    ,
    <.
      (
        1st ` (
          2nd ` (
            2nd ` (
              VERINA58NextUgly
                ( 1st ` A )
                ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
                ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
                ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
            )
          )
        )
      )
      ,
      (
        2nd ` (
          2nd ` (
            2nd ` (
              VERINA58NextUgly
                ( 1st ` A )
                ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
                ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
                ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    >.
  >.
>. $.

${
  $d k t A B C D E F $.

  verina58-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58LoopGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            (
              A e. NN0
              /\
              B e. Word NN0
            )
            /\
            C e. NN0
          )
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
        /\
        E e. NN0
      )
      /\
      F e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word VERINA58State
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( A + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = <. B , <. C , <. D , E >. >. >.
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ A )
            ( t ` ( k + 1 ) ) = ( VERINA58Step ( t ` k ) )
          /\
          F = ( 1st ` ( t ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verina58-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58Loop A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA58LoopGraph A B C D E y )
  ) $.
$}

verina58-one-word-definition $a |- VERINA58OneWord = (
  iota_ y e. Word NN0
    (
      ( # ` y ) = 1
      /\
      ( y ` 0 ) = 1
    )
) $.

verina58-nth-ugly-number-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58NthUglyNumber A
) = (
  VERINA58GetD
    (
      VERINA58Loop
        ( VERINA58NatSub A 1 )
        VERINA58OneWord
        0
        0
        0
    )
    ( VERINA58NatSub A 1 )
) $.

${
  $d e r A B C $.

  verina58-divide-out-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58DivideOutGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        (
          0 < A
          /\
          1 < B
        )
        /\
        E. e e. NN0 E. r e. NN0
          (
            (
              A = ( ( B ^ e ) x. r )
              /\
              ( r mod B ) =/= 0
            )
            /\
            C = r
          )
      )
      \/
      (
        -.
        (
          0 < A
          /\
          1 < B
        )
        /\
        C = A
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina58-divide-out-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58DivideOut A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINA58DivideOutGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina58-is-ugly-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58IsUgly A
) = if (
  A = 0 ,
  0 ,
  if (
    (
      VERINA58DivideOut
        (
          VERINA58DivideOut
            ( VERINA58DivideOut A 2 )
            3
        )
        5
    ) = 1 ,
    1 ,
    0
  )
) $.

${
  $d i A $.

  verina58-ugly-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA58UglyCount A
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ A )
      |
      ( VERINA58IsUgly i ) = 1
    }
  ) $.
$}

verina58-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
  /\
  0 < A
) $.

verina58-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA58Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA58IsUgly B ) = 1
    /\
    (
      VERINA58UglyCount B
    ) = (
      VERINA58NatSub A 1
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-58-nth-ugly-number $a |- A. n e. NN0
  (
    ( VERINA58Pre n )
    ->
    (
      VERINA58Post
        n
        ( VERINA58NthUglyNumber n )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_advanced_58
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_58, catalog title "nthUglyNumber": the positive-index
:: precondition, exact three-cursor ugly-number sequence implementation,
:: repeated-factor-removal helpers, ugly-number counting postcondition, and
:: final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n,result being Nat st
    n > 0 &
    (ex seqStates being FinSequence of NAT*,
        finalSeq being FinSequence of NAT,
        c2States,c3States,c5States being FinSequence of NAT st
      len seqStates = n &
      len c2States = n &
      len c3States = n &
      len c5States = n &
      seqStates/.1 = <*1*> &
      c2States/.1 = 0 &
      c3States/.1 = 0 &
      c5States/.1 = 0 &
      (for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < n holds
        ex seq being FinSequence of NAT,
           c2,c3,c5,v2,v3,v5,i2,i3,i5,next being Nat st
          seq = seqStates/.k &
          c2 = c2States/.k &
          c3 = c3States/.k &
          c5 = c5States/.k &
          ((c2 + 1 in dom seq & v2 = seq/.(c2 + 1)) or
           (not c2 + 1 in dom seq & v2 = 0)) &
          ((c3 + 1 in dom seq & v3 = seq/.(c3 + 1)) or
           (not c3 + 1 in dom seq & v3 = 0)) &
          ((c5 + 1 in dom seq & v5 = seq/.(c5 + 1)) or
           (not c5 + 1 in dom seq & v5 = 0)) &
          i2 = v2 * 2 &
          i3 = v3 * 3 &
          i5 = v5 * 5 &
          next = min(i2,min(i3,i5)) &
          seqStates/.(k + 1) = seq ^ <*next*> &
          ((next = i2 & c2States/.(k + 1) = c2 + 1) or
           (next <> i2 & c2States/.(k + 1) = c2)) &
          ((next = i3 & c3States/.(k + 1) = c3 + 1) or
           (next <> i3 & c3States/.(k + 1) = c3)) &
          ((next = i5 & c5States/.(k + 1) = c5 + 1) or
           (next <> i5 & c5States/.(k + 1) = c5))) &
      finalSeq = seqStates/.n &
      result = finalSeq/.n)
  holds
    (result <> 0 &
      ex n1,n2,n3 being Nat,
         trace2,trace3,trace5 being FinSequence of NAT st
        0 < len trace2 &
        trace2/.1 = result &
        trace2/.(len trace2) = n1 &
        (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len trace2 holds
          trace2/.j > 0 &
          trace2/.j mod (2 qua Nat) = 0 &
          trace2/.(j + 1) = trace2/.j div (2 qua Nat)) &
        (n1 = 0 or n1 mod (2 qua Nat) <> 0) &
        0 < len trace3 &
        trace3/.1 = n1 &
        trace3/.(len trace3) = n2 &
        (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len trace3 holds
          trace3/.j > 0 &
          trace3/.j mod (3 qua Nat) = 0 &
          trace3/.(j + 1) = trace3/.j div (3 qua Nat)) &
        (n2 = 0 or n2 mod (3 qua Nat) <> 0) &
        0 < len trace5 &
        trace5/.1 = n2 &
        trace5/.(len trace5) = n3 &
        (for j being Nat st 1 <= j & j < len trace5 holds
          trace5/.j > 0 &
          trace5/.j mod (5 qua Nat) = 0 &
          trace5/.(j + 1) = trace5/.j div (5 qua Nat)) &
        (n3 = 0 or n3 mod (5 qua Nat) <> 0) &
        n3 = 1) &

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_58, catalog title "nthUglyNumber": computing the nth positive
% natural number whose only prime factors are 2, 3, and 5 with the specified
% three-pointer list program and its rank correctness contract. This file
% contains no proof.

verina_advanced_58: THEORY
BEGIN

  ugly_step_state: TYPE =
    [# next_value: nat,
       next_c2: nat,
       next_c3: nat,
       next_c5: nat #]

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  nat_min(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first <= second THEN first ELSE second ENDIF

  nat_list_length(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        nat_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          nat_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_list_push(
      values: list[nat],
      value: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(value, null[nat]),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, nat_list_push(tail, value))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nthUglyNumber_precond(n: nat): bool =
    n > 0

  nextUgly(
      seq: list[nat],
      c2, c3, c5: nat): ugly_step_state =
    LET i2: nat = nat_list_get_bang(c2, seq) * 2,
        i3: nat = nat_list_get_bang(c3, seq) * 3,
        i5: nat = nat_list_get_bang(c5, seq) * 5,
        candidate: nat = nat_min(i2, nat_min(i3, i5))
    IN
      (# next_value := candidate,
         next_c2 := IF candidate = i2 THEN c2 + 1 ELSE c2 ENDIF,
         next_c3 := IF candidate = i3 THEN c3 + 1 ELSE c3 ENDIF,
         next_c5 := IF candidate = i5 THEN c5 + 1 ELSE c5 ENDIF #)

  nthUglyNumber_loop(
      remaining: nat,
      seq: list[nat],
      c2, c3, c5: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      seq
    ELSE
      LET step: ugly_step_state =
            nextUgly(seq, c2, c3, c5)
      IN
        nthUglyNumber_loop(
          remaining - 1,
          nat_list_push(seq, next_value(step)),
          next_c2(step),
          next_c3(step),
          next_c5(step))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  % The Lean precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant. This
  % definition is the exact proof-erased three-pointer list computation.
  nthUglyNumber(n: nat): nat =
    LET index: nat = nat_subtract(n, 1),
        seq: list[nat] =
          nthUglyNumber_loop(
            index,
            cons(1, null[nat]),
            0,
            0,
            0)
    IN
      nat_list_get_bang(index, seq)

  % Fuel n is exact: whenever the source recurses, p > 1 and ndiv(n, p) < n,
  % so at most n recursive divisions can occur.
  divideOut_fuel(
      n, p, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p > 1 AND n > 0 AND mod(n, p) = 0 THEN
      IF fuel = 0 THEN
        n
      ELSE
        divideOut_fuel(
          ndiv(n, p),
          p,
          fuel - 1)
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      n
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  divideOut(n, p: nat): nat =
    divideOut_fuel(n, p, n)

  isUgly(x: nat): bool =
    IF x = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      LET n1: nat = divideOut(x, 2),
          n2: nat = divideOut(n1, 3),
          n3: nat = divideOut(n2, 5)
      IN
        n3 = 1
    ENDIF

  nat_range_from(
      start, count: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[nat]
    ELSE
      cons(
        start,
        nat_range_from(start + 1, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_range(count: nat): list[nat] =
    nat_range_from(0, count)

  filter_ugly(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[nat],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF isUgly(head) THEN
          cons(head, filter_ugly(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_ugly(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nthUglyNumber_postcond(
      n, result: nat): bool =
    isUgly(result)
      AND nat_list_length(
            filter_ugly(nat_range(result)))
          = nat_subtract(n, 1)

  nthUglyNumber_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      nthUglyNumber_precond(n)
        IMPLIES
          nthUglyNumber_postcond(
            n,
            nthUglyNumber(n))

END verina_advanced_58

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_59,
   catalog title "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": an executable Unicode-string
   palindrome test that ignores non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters and ASCII
   case differences, together with its correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition palindrome_isUpperAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 65 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 90)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition palindrome_isLowerAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 97 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 122)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition palindrome_isAlpha (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  orb (palindrome_isUpperAlpha c) (palindrome_isLowerAlpha c).

Definition palindrome_isDigit (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 48 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 57)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition palindrome_toLower (c : lean_char) : lean_char :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      if palindrome_isUpperAlpha (LeanAscii a)
      then
        LeanAscii
          (Ascii.ascii_of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a + 32))
      else LeanAscii a
  | LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid =>
      LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid
  end.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | LeanAscii a, LeanAscii b =>
      Nat.eqb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) (Ascii.nat_of_ascii b)
  | LeanNonAscii xcode _ _, LeanNonAscii ycode _ _ =>
      N.eqb xcode ycode
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition lean_char_option_eqb
    (x y : option lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | None, None => true
  | Some x', Some y' => lean_char_eqb x' y'
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean
    (s : lean_string) : list lean_char :=
  map palindrome_toLower
    (filter
      (fun c => orb (palindrome_isAlpha c) (palindrome_isDigit c))
      s).

Definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond
    (_s : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check_fuel
    (fuel left right : nat)
    (cleaned : list lean_char) : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | O => true
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.leb right left
      then true
      else if lean_char_option_eqb
                (nth_error cleaned left)
                (nth_error cleaned right)
           then
             palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check_fuel
               fuel' (S left) (Nat.pred right) cleaned
           else false
  end.

Definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum
    (s : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s) : bool :=
  let cleaned := palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean s in
  let n := length cleaned in
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check_fuel
    n 0 (Nat.pred n) cleaned.

Definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond
    (s : lean_string)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s) : Prop :=
  let cleaned := palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean s in
  let forward := cleaned in
  let backward := rev cleaned in
  if result
  then forward = backward
  else forward <> backward.

Theorem palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (h_precond : palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s) :
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond
    s (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_59,
  catalog title "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": an executable Unicode-scalar
  string program filters to ASCII letters and digits, lowercases ASCII
  capitals, and checks the resulting list from both ends, together with its
  precondition and Boolean palindrome contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_59
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_trit_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_trit" where
  "lean_trit_of_nat n =
    (if n mod 3 = 0 then Trit0
     else if n mod 3 = 1 then Trit1
     else Trit2)"

definition lean_bits3_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits3" where
  "lean_bits3_of_nat n =
    LeanBits3
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_byte_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_byte" where
  "lean_byte_of_nat n =
    LeanByte
      ((n div 128) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 64) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 32) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_low_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_low_char_of_nat n =
    (let q = n div 2048
     in BMP_Low
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q div 9))
          (lean_trit_of_nat ((q div 3) mod 3))
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q mod 3))
          (lean_bits3_of_nat ((n div 256) mod 8))
          (lean_byte_of_nat (n mod 256)))"

definition isUpperAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isUpperAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow>
    65 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 90"

definition isLowerAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isLowerAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow>
    97 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 122"

definition isAlpha :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isAlpha c \<longleftrightarrow> isUpperAlpha c \<or> isLowerAlpha c"

definition isDigit :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isDigit c \<longleftrightarrow>
    48 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 57"

definition toLower :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "toLower c =
    (if isUpperAlpha c
     then lean_low_char_of_nat (lean_char_to_nat c + 32)
     else c)"

definition cleanedChars :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "cleanedChars s =
    map toLower (filter (\<lambda>c. isAlpha c \<or> isDigit c) s)"

definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun lean_list_get_opt :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option" where
  "lean_list_get_opt [] i = None"
| "lean_list_get_opt (x # xs) 0 = Some x"
| "lean_list_get_opt (x # xs) (Suc i) = lean_list_get_opt xs i"

fun palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check chars left 0 = True"
| "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check chars left (Suc right) =
    (if left \<ge> Suc right
     then True
     else if lean_list_get_opt chars left =
             lean_list_get_opt chars (Suc right)
          then palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check chars (left + 1) right
          else False)"

definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s =
    (let cleaned = cleanedChars s;
         n = length cleaned;
         startIndex = 0;
         endIndex = (if n = 0 then 0 else n - 1)
     in palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_check cleaned startIndex endIndex)"

definition palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond s result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let cleaned = cleanedChars s;
         forward = cleaned;
         backward = rev cleaned
     in if result then forward = backward else forward \<noteq> backward)"

theorem palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s"
  shows
    "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond s (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s)"
  sorry

end

let palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_getOpt = new_definition

      (xs:num list) (index:num) =

       palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_getOpt cleaned right
     then

         (left + 1,right - 1,cleaned)

let palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond = new_definition
  `palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond (s:num list) <=> T`;;

let palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum = new_definition

     let cleaned = palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_cleaned s in
     let n = LENGTH cleaned in

       (startIndex,endIndex,cleaned)`;;

let palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond = new_definition
  `palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond
      (s:num list) (result:bool) <=>
     let cleaned = palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_cleaned s in
     let forward = cleaned in

     if result then forward = backward
     else ~(forward = backward)`;;
