content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_59,
;; "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": a deterministic Unicode-string program removes
;; non-alphanumeric characters, lowercases ASCII letters, and decides whether
;; the cleaned character list is a palindrome. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values. This preserves characters beyond ACL2's host character set.

(defun verina-advanced-59-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-advanced-59-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-59-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-advanced-59-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-is-upper-alpha (c)
  (and
   (<= 65 c)
   (<= c 90)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-is-lower-alpha (c)
  (and
   (<= 97 c)
   (<= c 122)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-is-alpha (c)
  (or
   (verina-advanced-59-is-upper-alpha c)
   (verina-advanced-59-is-lower-alpha c)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-is-digit (c)
  (and
   (<= 48 c)
   (<= c 57)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-is-alphanumeric (c)
  (or
   (verina-advanced-59-is-alpha c)
   (verina-advanced-59-is-digit c)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-to-lower (c)
  (if (verina-advanced-59-is-upper-alpha c)
      (+ c 32)
    c))

;; These two recursions are respectively the source List.filter and List.map.

(defun verina-advanced-59-filter-alphanumeric (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (if (verina-advanced-59-is-alphanumeric
           (car characters))
          (cons
           (car characters)
           (verina-advanced-59-filter-alphanumeric
            (cdr characters)))
        (verina-advanced-59-filter-alphanumeric
         (cdr characters)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-59-map-to-lower (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-59-to-lower (car characters))
       (verina-advanced-59-map-to-lower
        (cdr characters)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-59-cleaned (s)
  (verina-advanced-59-map-to-lower
   (verina-advanced-59-filter-alphanumeric s)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum-precond
    (s)
  (declare (ignore s))
  t)

;; Option Char is represented by :none or the tagged pair (:some . code).

(defun verina-advanced-59-nth-option (index characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      :none
    (if (consp characters)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons :some (car characters))
          (verina-advanced-59-nth-option
           (- index 1)
           (cdr characters)))
      :none)))

;; This is the source local check recursion, including optional indexed access,
;; inward index movement, and truncated natural-number subtraction.

(defun verina-advanced-59-check (left right cleaned)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix right)))
  (if (or
       (not (natp left))
       (not (natp right)))
      nil
    (if (>= left right)
        t
      (if (equal
           (verina-advanced-59-nth-option left cleaned)
           (verina-advanced-59-nth-option right cleaned))
          (verina-advanced-59-check
           (+ left 1)
           (- right 1)
           cleaned)
        nil))))

;; The source proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally
;; irrelevant. The final statement retains its predicate explicitly.

(defun verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum (s)
  (let* ((cleaned
          (verina-advanced-59-cleaned s))
         (n (len cleaned))
         (start-index 0)
         (end-index
          (if (equal n 0)
              0
            (- n 1))))
    (verina-advanced-59-check
     start-index
     end-index
     cleaned)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-reverse-list (characters)
  (reverse characters))

(defun verina-advanced-59-bool-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result t)
   (equal result nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum-postcond
    (s result)
  (let* ((cleaned
          (verina-advanced-59-cleaned s))
         (forward cleaned)
         (backward
          (verina-advanced-59-reverse-list cleaned)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-59-string-p s)
     (verina-advanced-59-bool-p result)
     (if (equal result t)
         (equal forward backward)
       (not (equal forward backward))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum-spec-satisfied-statement
    (s)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-59-string-p s)
    (verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum-precond s))
   (verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum-postcond
    s
    (verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-nonalnum s))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_59,
-- catalog title "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": a deterministic string program
-- filters non-alphanumeric characters, lowercases letters, and checks whether
-- the resulting character list is a palindrome. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced59 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primCharToNat; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using (String; primStringToList)

infixr 5 _&&_ _||_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natGreaterOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natGreaterOrEqual m n = natLessOrEqual n m

isUpperAlpha : Char → Bool
isUpperAlpha c =
  natLessOrEqual 65 (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) 90

isLowerAlpha : Char → Bool
isLowerAlpha c =
  natLessOrEqual 97 (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) 122

isAlpha : Char → Bool
isAlpha c = isUpperAlpha c || isLowerAlpha c

isDigit : Char → Bool
isDigit c =
  natLessOrEqual 48 (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) 57

isAlphanumeric : Char → Bool
isAlphanumeric c = isAlpha c || isDigit c

toLower : Char → Char
toLower c =
  if isUpperAlpha c
  then primNatToChar (primCharToNat c + 32)
  else c

filterList :
  {A : Set} →
  (A → Bool) →
  List A →
  List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

mapList :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B) →
  List A →
  List B
mapList function [] = []
mapList function (x ∷ xs) =
  function x ∷ mapList function xs

cleanString : String → List Char
cleanString s =
  mapList
    toLower
    (filterList isAlphanumeric (primStringToList s))

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

predecessor : Nat → Nat
predecessor zero = zero
predecessor (suc n) = n

listIndex : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → Maybe A
listIndex zero [] = nothing
listIndex zero (x ∷ xs) = just x
listIndex (suc n) [] = nothing
listIndex (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = listIndex n xs

maybeCharEqual : Maybe Char → Maybe Char → Bool
maybeCharEqual nothing nothing = true
maybeCharEqual nothing (just _) = false
maybeCharEqual (just _) nothing = false
maybeCharEqual (just x) (just y) = primCharEquality x y

charactersEqualAt :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Char →
  Bool
charactersEqualAt left right chars =
  maybeCharEqual
    (listIndex left chars)
    (listIndex right chars)

checkIndices :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Char →
  Bool
checkIndices left zero chars = true
checkIndices left (suc right) chars =
  if natGreaterOrEqual left (suc right)
  then true
  else
    if charactersEqualAt left (suc right) chars
    then checkIndices (suc left) right chars
    else false

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

chooseSet : Bool → Set → Set → Set
chooseSet true when-true when-false = when-true
chooseSet false when-true when-false = when-false

palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-precond : String → Set
palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-precond s = Top

palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum :
  (s : String) →
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-precond s →
  Bool
palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s h-precond =
  let cleaned = cleanString s
      n = listLength cleaned
      start-index = zero
      end-index = predecessor n
  in checkIndices start-index end-index cleaned

palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (result : Bool) →
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-precond s →
  Set
palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-postcond s result h-precond =
  let cleaned = cleanString s
      forward = cleaned
      backward = reverseList cleaned
  in
    chooseSet
      result
      (forward ≡ backward)
      (Not (forward ≡ backward))

palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-spec-satisfied : Set
palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (h-precond : palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-precond s) →
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum-postcond
    s
    (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_59,
  cataloged as "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": the executable Boolean program
  tests whether a Unicode-scalar string is a palindrome after removing
  non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters and lowercasing ASCII letters.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeScalar_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeScalar_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeScalar (c : num) <=>
      c < 1114112 /\ ~(55296 <= c /\ c <= 57343)``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeString_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeString_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeString (s : num list) <=>
      EVERY palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeScalar s``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUpperAlpha_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUpperAlpha_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUpperAlpha (c : num) <=>
      65 <= c /\ c <= 90``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isLowerAlpha_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isLowerAlpha_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isLowerAlpha (c : num) <=>
      97 <= c /\ c <= 122``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isAlpha_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isAlpha_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isAlpha (c : num) <=>
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUpperAlpha c \/
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isLowerAlpha c``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isDigit_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isDigit_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isDigit (c : num) <=>
      48 <= c /\ c <= 57``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_toLower_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_toLower_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_toLower (c : num) =
      if palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUpperAlpha c then c + 32 else c``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean_def = Define `
  (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean ([] : num list) = ([] : num list)) /\
  (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean (c::cs) =
     if palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isAlpha c \/
        palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isDigit c
     then
       palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_toLower c::
         palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean cs
     else
       palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean cs)
`;

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond (s : num list) <=> T``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_checkFuel_def = Define `
  (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_checkFuel
      0
      (left : num)
      (right : num)
      (cleaned : num list) =
     F) /\
  (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_checkFuel
      (SUC fuel)
      left
      right
      cleaned =
     if left >= right then
       T
     else if LLOOKUP cleaned left = LLOOKUP cleaned right then
       palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_checkFuel
         fuel (left + 1) (right - 1) cleaned
     else
       F)
`;

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum (s : num list) =
      let cleaned = palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean s in
      let n = LENGTH cleaned in
      let startIndex = 0 in
      let endIndex = if n = 0 then 0 else n - 1
      in
        palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_checkFuel
          (SUC endIndex) startIndex endIndex cleaned``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond_def",
  ``palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond
      (s : num list) (result : bool) <=>
      let cleaned = palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_clean s in
      let forward = cleaned in
      let backward = REVERSE cleaned
      in
        if result then forward = backward else forward <> backward``
);

val palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_spec_satisfied =
  ``!s : num list.
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_isUnicodeString s ==>
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond s ==>
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond
        s (palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum s)``;

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_59 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_59), catalog title
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum: the exact program filters ASCII alphanumeric
  characters from an arbitrary Unicode string, lowercases them, and runs its
  two-index Boolean palindrome checker, together with the complete correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINA59Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINA59Char represents arbitrary Lean strings extensionally through
  String.data. VERINA59IsAlpha, VERINA59IsDigit, VERINA59IsAlnum, and
  VERINA59ToLower reproduce the source Char operations exactly: their tests
  use the basic-Latin ASCII ranges and lowercasing adds 32 only for A through
  Z.

  VERINA59FilterGraph retains exactly the alphanumeric input characters in
  their original order. VERINA59MapLowerGraph lowercases every retained
  character, so VERINA59Cleaned is exactly the source filter followed by map.

  VERINA59None, VERINA59Some, VERINA59OptionChar, and VERINA59GetOption encode
  List.get? exactly, including none outside the word. VERINA59CheckContinue
  and VERINA59CheckStop reproduce the local recursive check branches.
  VERINA59CheckGraph records the complete deterministic execution trace from
  arbitrary natural indices, including the source equality test on option
  values, and VERINA59Check selects its unique Boolean result.
  VERINA59EndIndex preserves the explicit empty-list branch, and
  VERINA59PalindromeIgnoreNonAlnum composes the exact cleaned word with the
  checker starting at zero and that end index. Its output is therefore fixed
  independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA59ReverseGraph is exact list reversal. VERINA59Pre is the source True
  precondition on typed string inputs. VERINA59Post is the source conditional
  equality-versus-inequality contract for the cleaned word and its reversal.
  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent of the
  final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA59Char
  VERINA59IsUpper VERINA59IsLower VERINA59IsAlpha VERINA59IsDigit
  VERINA59IsAlnum VERINA59ToLower
  VERINA59FilterGraph VERINA59Filter
  VERINA59MapLowerGraph VERINA59MapLower VERINA59Cleaned
  VERINA59None VERINA59Some VERINA59OptionChar VERINA59GetOption
  VERINA59CheckContinue VERINA59CheckStop
  VERINA59CheckGraph VERINA59Check
  VERINA59EndIndex VERINA59PalindromeIgnoreNonAlnum
  VERINA59ReverseGraph VERINA59Reverse
  VERINA59Pre VERINA59Post
$.

verina59-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA59Char $.
verina59-is-upper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59IsUpper A ) $.
verina59-is-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59IsLower A ) $.
verina59-is-alpha-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59IsAlpha A ) $.
verina59-is-digit-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59IsDigit A ) $.
verina59-is-alnum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59IsAlnum A ) $.
verina59-to-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59ToLower A ) $.
verina59-filter-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59FilterGraph A B ) $.
verina59-filter-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59Filter A ) $.
verina59-map-lower-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59MapLowerGraph A B ) $.
verina59-map-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59MapLower A ) $.
verina59-cleaned-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59Cleaned A ) $.
verina59-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA59None $.
verina59-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59Some A ) $.
verina59-option-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA59OptionChar $.
verina59-get-option-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59GetOption A B ) $.
verina59-check-continue-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59CheckContinue A B C ) $.
verina59-check-stop-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59CheckStop A B C ) $.
verina59-check-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59CheckGraph A B C D ) $.
verina59-check-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59Check A B C ) $.
verina59-end-index-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59EndIndex A ) $.
verina59-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59PalindromeIgnoreNonAlnum A ) $.
verina59-reverse-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59ReverseGraph A B ) $.
verina59-reverse-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA59Reverse A ) $.
verina59-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59Pre A ) $.
verina59-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA59Post A B ) $.

verina59-char-definition $a |- VERINA59Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verina59-is-upper-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59IsUpper A
) = if (
  (
    ; 6 5 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; 9 0
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina59-is-lower-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59IsLower A
) = if (
  (
    ; 9 7 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; ; 1 2 2
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina59-is-alpha-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59IsAlpha A
) = if (
  (
    ( VERINA59IsUpper A ) = 1
    \/
    ( VERINA59IsLower A ) = 1
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina59-is-digit-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59IsDigit A
) = if (
  (
    ; 4 8 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; 5 7
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina59-is-alnum-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59IsAlnum A
) = if (
  (
    ( VERINA59IsAlpha A ) = 1
    \/
    ( VERINA59IsDigit A ) = 1
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina59-to-lower-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59ToLower A
) = if (
  ( VERINA59IsUpper A ) = 1 ,
  ( A + ; 3 2 ) ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina59-filter-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59FilterGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA59Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA59Char
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( VERINA59IsAlnum ( A ` ( p ` i ) ) ) = 1
              )
              /\
              ( B ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  i < j
                  ->
                  ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
                )
            /\
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( VERINA59IsAlnum ( A ` k ) ) = 1
                ->
                E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` i ) = k
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina59-filter-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59Filter A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA59Char
      ( VERINA59FilterGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina59-map-lower-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59MapLowerGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA59Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA59Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( B ` i ) = ( VERINA59ToLower ( A ` i ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina59-map-lower-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59MapLower A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA59Char
      ( VERINA59MapLowerGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina59-cleaned-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59Cleaned A
) = (
  VERINA59MapLower
    ( VERINA59Filter A )
) $.

verina59-none-definition $a |- VERINA59None = (/) $.

verina59-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina59-option-char-definition $a |- VERINA59OptionChar =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA59None
        \/
        E. y e. VERINA59Char
          x = ( VERINA59Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

verina59-get-option-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59GetOption A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( VERINA59Some ( A ` B ) ) ,
  VERINA59None
) $.

verina59-check-continue-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59CheckContinue A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA59Char
      /\
      B e. ( NN0 X. NN0 )
    )
    /\
    C e. ( NN0 X. NN0 )
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      ( 1st ` B ) < ( 2nd ` B )
      /\
      (
        VERINA59GetOption A ( 1st ` B )
      ) = (
        VERINA59GetOption A ( 2nd ` B )
      )
    )
    /\
    C = <.
      ( ( 1st ` B ) + 1 ) ,
      ( ( 2nd ` B ) - 1 )
    >.
  )
) $.

verina59-check-stop-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59CheckStop A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA59Char
      /\
      B e. ( NN0 X. NN0 )
    )
    /\
    C e. { 0 , 1 }
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      C = 1
      /\
      ( 2nd ` B ) <_ ( 1st ` B )
    )
    \/
    (
      C = 0
      /\
      (
        ( 1st ` B ) < ( 2nd ` B )
        /\
        (
          VERINA59GetOption A ( 1st ` B )
        ) =/= (
          VERINA59GetOption A ( 2nd ` B )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d i k t A B C D $.

  verina59-check-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59CheckGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. Word VERINA59Char
        /\
        D e. { 0 , 1 }
      )
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. t e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = <. A , B >.
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              VERINA59CheckContinue
                C
                ( t ` i )
                ( t ` ( i + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            VERINA59CheckStop
              C
              ( t ` k )
              D
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina59-check-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59Check A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. { 0 , 1 }
      ( VERINA59CheckGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verina59-end-index-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59EndIndex A
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) = 0 ,
  0 ,
  ( ( # ` A ) - 1 )
) $.

verina59-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59PalindromeIgnoreNonAlnum A
) = (
  VERINA59Check
    0
    ( VERINA59EndIndex ( VERINA59Cleaned A ) )
    ( VERINA59Cleaned A )
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina59-reverse-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59ReverseGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA59Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA59Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina59-reverse-definition $a |- (
    VERINA59Reverse A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA59Char
      ( VERINA59ReverseGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina59-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word VERINA59Char
) $.

verina59-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA59Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word VERINA59Char
    /\
    B e. { 0 , 1 }
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      B = 1
      ->
      (
        VERINA59Cleaned A
      ) = (
        VERINA59Reverse
          ( VERINA59Cleaned A )
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      B = 0
      ->
      (
        VERINA59Cleaned A
      ) =/= (
        VERINA59Reverse
          ( VERINA59Cleaned A )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-59-palindrome-ignore-non-alnum
  $a |- A. w e. Word VERINA59Char
    (
      ( VERINA59Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINA59Post
          w
          ( VERINA59PalindromeIgnoreNonAlnum w )
      )
    )
  $.

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_59, catalog title "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": an exact
:: Unicode-scalar finite-sequence encoding of the unconditional precondition,
:: alphanumeric filtering and ASCII lowercasing helpers, deterministic
:: inward-index recursive Boolean implementation, palindrome postcondition,
:: and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, NEWTON, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, NEWTON, WSIERP_1, XXREAL_0, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, WSIERP_1, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for s being FinSequence of NAT,
      result being Element of BOOLEAN st
    (for i being Nat st i in dom s holds
      s/.i < 1114112 &
      (s/.i < 55296 or 57343 < s/.i)) &
    0 = 0 &
    (ex positions,cleaned,lefts,rights being FinSequence of NAT st
      len positions = len cleaned &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom positions holds
        positions/.j in dom s &
        ((65 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
          s/.(positions/.j) <= 90 &
          cleaned/.j = s/.(positions/.j) + 32) or
         (((97 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
            s/.(positions/.j) <= 122) or
           (48 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
            s/.(positions/.j) <= 57)) &
          cleaned/.j = s/.(positions/.j)))) &
      (for j,k being Nat st
        j in dom positions & k in dom positions & j < k
      holds positions/.j < positions/.k) &
      (for i being Nat st
        i in dom s &
        ((65 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 90) or
         (97 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 122) or
         (48 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 57))
      holds i in rng positions) &
      0 < len lefts &
      len lefts = len rights &
      lefts/.1 = 0 &
      ((len cleaned = 0 & rights/.1 = 0) or
       (0 < len cleaned & rights/.1 = len cleaned -' 1)) &
      (for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len lefts holds
        lefts/.k < rights/.k &
        lefts/.k + 1 in dom cleaned &
        rights/.k + 1 in dom cleaned &
        cleaned/.(lefts/.k + 1) = cleaned/.(rights/.k + 1) &
        lefts/.(k + 1) = lefts/.k + 1 &
        rights/.(k + 1) = rights/.k -' 1) &
      ((rights/.(len rights) <= lefts/.(len lefts) &
        result = TRUE) or
       (lefts/.(len lefts) < rights/.(len rights) &
        lefts/.(len lefts) + 1 in dom cleaned &
        rights/.(len rights) + 1 in dom cleaned &
        cleaned/.(lefts/.(len lefts) + 1) <>
          cleaned/.(rights/.(len rights) + 1) &
        result = FALSE)))
  holds
    ex positions,cleaned being FinSequence of NAT st
      len positions = len cleaned &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom positions holds
        positions/.j in dom s &
        ((65 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
          s/.(positions/.j) <= 90 &
          cleaned/.j = s/.(positions/.j) + 32) or
         (((97 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
            s/.(positions/.j) <= 122) or
           (48 <= s/.(positions/.j) &
            s/.(positions/.j) <= 57)) &
          cleaned/.j = s/.(positions/.j)))) &
      (for j,k being Nat st
        j in dom positions & k in dom positions & j < k
      holds positions/.j < positions/.k) &
      (for i being Nat st
        i in dom s &
        ((65 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 90) or
         (97 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 122) or
         (48 <= s/.i & s/.i <= 57))
      holds i in rng positions) &
      ((result = TRUE & cleaned = Rev cleaned) or
       (result = FALSE & cleaned <> Rev cleaned))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_59
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_59, catalog title "palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum": deciding
% whether a Unicode-scalar string is a palindrome after filtering to ASCII
% alphanumeric characters and lowercasing ASCII letters. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_59: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Lean String.data is observed extensionally as its finite list of Unicode
  % scalar characters.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]

  lean_char_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoLeanChar: NoLeanChar?
    SomeLeanChar(option_value: lean_char): SomeLeanChar?
  END lean_char_option

  is_upper_alpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 65 AND c <= 90

  is_lower_alpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 97 AND c <= 122

  lean_char_is_alpha(c: lean_char): bool =
    is_upper_alpha(c) OR is_lower_alpha(c)

  lean_char_is_digit(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 48 AND c <= 57

  lean_char_to_lower(c: lean_char): lean_char =
    IF is_upper_alpha(c) THEN c + 32 ELSE c ENDIF

  filter_alphanumeric(
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF lean_char_is_alpha(head) OR lean_char_is_digit(head) THEN
          cons(head, filter_alphanumeric(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_alphanumeric(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  map_to_lower(
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          lean_char_to_lower(head),
          map_to_lower(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  cleaned_string(s: lean_string): list[lean_char] =
    map_to_lower(filter_alphanumeric(s))

  lean_char_list_length(
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        lean_char_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  lean_char_at(
      index: nat,
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE lean_char_option =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        NoLeanChar,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          SomeLeanChar(head)
        ELSE
          lean_char_at(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  palindrome_check(
      left, right: nat,
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF left >= right THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      IF lean_char_at(left, chars) = lean_char_at(right, chars) THEN
        palindrome_check(left + 1, right - 1, chars)
      ELSE
        FALSE
      ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE right

  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond(s: lean_string): bool =
    TRUE

  % The Lean precondition proof is computationally irrelevant. This is the
  % exact proof-erased filter/map and inward-index executable computation.
  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum(s: lean_string): bool =
    LET cleaned: list[lean_char] = cleaned_string(s),
        length: nat = lean_char_list_length(cleaned),
        start_index: nat = 0,
        end_index: nat =
          IF length = 0 THEN 0 ELSE length - 1 ENDIF
    IN
      palindrome_check(
        start_index,
        end_index,
        cleaned)

  reverse_lean_char_list_acc(
      chars, accumulator: list[lean_char]):
      RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_lean_char_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  reverse_lean_char_list(
      chars: list[lean_char]): list[lean_char] =
    reverse_lean_char_list_acc(chars, null[lean_char])

  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      result: bool): bool =
    LET cleaned: list[lean_char] = cleaned_string(s),
        forward: list[lean_char] = cleaned,
        backward: list[lean_char] =
          reverse_lean_char_list(cleaned)
    IN
      IF result THEN
        forward = backward
      ELSE
        forward /= backward
      ENDIF

  palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string):
      palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_precond(s)
        IMPLIES
          palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum_postcond(
            s,
            palindromeIgnoreNonAlnum(s))

END verina_advanced_59

title: verina_advanced_6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_6,
   catalog title "allVowels": an executable case-insensitive ASCII-vowel
   containment test over Unicode strings, together with its correctness
   contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition allVowels_isUpperAscii (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      andb
        (Nat.leb 65 (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a))
        (Nat.leb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) 90)
  | LeanNonAscii _ _ _ => false
  end.

Definition toLower (c : lean_char) : lean_char :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a =>
      if allVowels_isUpperAscii (LeanAscii a)
      then
        LeanAscii
          (Ascii.ascii_of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a + 32))
      else LeanAscii a
  | LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid =>
      LeanNonAscii code hlarge hvalid
  end.

Definition normalize_str (s : lean_string) : list lean_char :=
  map toLower s.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | LeanAscii a, LeanAscii b =>
      Nat.eqb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) (Ascii.nat_of_ascii b)
  | LeanNonAscii xcode _ _, LeanNonAscii ycode _ _ =>
      N.eqb xcode ycode
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition allVowels_ascii_char (code : nat) : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat code).

Definition allVowels_vowelSet : list lean_char :=
  [allVowels_ascii_char 97;
   allVowels_ascii_char 101;
   allVowels_ascii_char 105;
   allVowels_ascii_char 111;
   allVowels_ascii_char 117].

Definition allVowels_contains
    (v : lean_char) (chars : list lean_char) : bool :=
  existsb (fun c => lean_char_eqb c v) chars.

Definition allVowels_precond (_s : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition allVowels
    (s : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : allVowels_precond s) : bool :=
  let chars := normalize_str s in
  forallb
    (fun v => allVowels_contains v chars)
    allVowels_vowelSet.

Definition allVowels_postcond
    (s : lean_string)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : allVowels_precond s) : Prop :=
  let chars := normalize_str s in
  result = true <->
  forallb
    (fun v => allVowels_contains v chars)
    allVowels_vowelSet = true.

Theorem allVowels_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (h_precond : allVowels_precond s) :
  allVowels_postcond
    s (allVowels s h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_6,
  catalog title "allVowels": an executable Unicode-scalar string program
  lowercases ASCII capitals and checks whether all five lowercase English
  vowels occur in the normalized string. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_6
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_trit_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_trit" where
  "lean_trit_of_nat n =
    (if n mod 3 = 0 then Trit0
     else if n mod 3 = 1 then Trit1
     else Trit2)"

definition lean_bits3_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits3" where
  "lean_bits3_of_nat n =
    LeanBits3
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_byte_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_byte" where
  "lean_byte_of_nat n =
    LeanByte
      ((n div 128) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 64) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 32) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_low_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_low_char_of_nat n =
    (let q = n div 2048
     in BMP_Low
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q div 9))
          (lean_trit_of_nat ((q div 3) mod 3))
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q mod 3))
          (lean_bits3_of_nat ((n div 256) mod 8))
          (lean_byte_of_nat (n mod 256)))"

abbreviation ascii :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "ascii n \<equiv> lean_low_char_of_nat n"

definition toLower :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "toLower c =
    (if 65 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 90
     then lean_low_char_of_nat (lean_char_to_nat c + 32)
     else c)"

definition normalize_str :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "normalize_str s = map toLower s"

definition allVowels_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "allVowels_precond s \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition allVowels :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "allVowels s =
    (let chars = normalize_str s;
         vowelSet = [ascii 97, ascii 101, ascii 105, ascii 111, ascii 117]
     in list_all (\<lambda>v. v \<in> set chars) vowelSet)"

definition allVowels_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "allVowels_postcond s result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let chars = normalize_str s
     in result \<longleftrightarrow>
       list_all
         (\<lambda>v. v \<in> set chars)

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_6,
;; "allVowels": a deterministic case-insensitive Unicode-string scan checks
;; whether all five English vowels occur, together with its Boolean correctness
;; contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values. This preserves characters beyond ACL2's host character set.

(defun verina-advanced-6-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-advanced-6-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-6-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-advanced-6-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

;; This is the source toLower helper: precisely the ASCII uppercase range is
;; shifted to the corresponding lowercase Unicode scalar value.

(defun verina-advanced-6-to-lower (c)
  (if (and
       (<= 65 c)
       (<= c 90))
      (+ c 32)
    c))

;; Under the canonical representation, String.data is the represented list,
;; so this recursive map is exactly normalize_str.

(defun verina-advanced-6-normalize-str (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-6-to-lower (car s))
       (verina-advanced-6-normalize-str (cdr s)))
    nil))

;; The source precondition is True. The String binder domain is explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-advanced-6-all-vowels-precond (s)
  (declare (ignore s))
  t)

(defun verina-advanced-6-contains-code-p (code chars)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count chars)))
  (if (consp chars)
      (or
       (equal code (car chars))
       (verina-advanced-6-contains-code-p
        code
        (cdr chars)))
    nil))

;; This is List.all over the source vowelSet. The codes are the Unicode scalar
;; values for a, e, i, o, and u, in the same order as the Lean list.

(defun verina-advanced-6-all-contained-p (vowels chars)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count vowels)))
  (if (consp vowels)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-6-contains-code-p
        (car vowels)
        chars)
       (verina-advanced-6-all-contained-p
        (cdr vowels)
        chars))
    t))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant;
;; the final statement supplies the corresponding predicate explicitly.

(defun verina-advanced-6-all-vowels (s)
  (let ((chars
         (verina-advanced-6-normalize-str s))
        (vowel-set
         (list 97 101 105 111 117)))
    (verina-advanced-6-all-contained-p
     vowel-set
     chars)))

(defun verina-advanced-6-bool-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result t)
   (equal result nil)))

;; Equality of ACL2's t/nil Boolean values is the source postcondition's
;; propositional equivalence between result and the independent List.all test.

(defun verina-advanced-6-all-vowels-postcond (s result)
  (let ((chars
         (verina-advanced-6-normalize-str s))
        (vowel-set
         (list 97 101 105 111 117)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-6-string-p s)
     (verina-advanced-6-bool-p result)
     (equal
      result
      (verina-advanced-6-all-contained-p
       vowel-set
       chars)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition connecting the
;; complete precondition and postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-6-all-vowels-spec-satisfied-statement
    (s)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-6-string-p s)
    (verina-advanced-6-all-vowels-precond s))
   (verina-advanced-6-all-vowels-postcond
    s
    (verina-advanced-6-all-vowels s))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_6,
-- catalog title "allVowels": a deterministic case-insensitive string program
-- decides whether all five English vowels occur. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primCharToNat; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using (String; primStringToList)

infix 2 _↔_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

toLower : Char → Char
toLower c =
  if
    natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat 'A') (primCharToNat c) &&
    natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) (primCharToNat 'Z')
  then primNatToChar (primCharToNat c + 32)
  else c

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

normalize-str : String → List Char
normalize-str s = mapList toLower (primStringToList s)

containsChar : Char → List Char → Bool
containsChar sought [] = false
containsChar sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if primCharEquality sought x
  then true
  else containsChar sought xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

vowelSet : List Char
vowelSet = 'a' ∷ 'e' ∷ 'i' ∷ 'o' ∷ 'u' ∷ []

allVowels-precond : String → Set
allVowels-precond s = Top

allVowels :
  (s : String) →
  allVowels-precond s →
  Bool
allVowels s h-precond =
  let chars = normalize-str s
  in allList (λ v → containsChar v chars) vowelSet

allVowels-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (result : Bool) →
  allVowels-precond s →
  Set
allVowels-postcond s result h-precond =
  let chars = normalize-str s
  in
    IsTrue result ↔
    IsTrue (allList (λ v → containsChar v chars) vowelSet)

allVowels-spec-satisfied : Set
allVowels-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (h-precond : allVowels-precond s) →
  allVowels-postcond
    s
    (allVowels s h-precond)
    h-precond

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_6 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_6), catalog title
  allVowels: the exact case-insensitive program lowercases ASCII uppercase
  characters in an arbitrary Unicode string and returns true exactly when
  the normalized string contains all five English vowels, together with its
  complete correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINA6Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINA6Char represents arbitrary Lean strings extensionally through
  String.data. VERINA6IsUpper and VERINA6ToLower reproduce the source helper:
  only basic-Latin A through Z are changed, by adding 32, while every other
  Unicode scalar value is unchanged.

  VERINA6NormalizeGraph maps that helper pointwise over the complete input
  word, and VERINA6Normalize selects its unique output; this is exactly
  normalize_str. VERINA6Contains is List.contains for a character, expressed
  by occurrence at an input index. VERINA6HasAllVowels is the exact Boolean
  conjunction produced by List.all on the source list
  ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'], using code points 97, 101, 105, 111, and 117.

  VERINA6AllVowels returns one precisely when that conjunction holds for the
  normalized input and zero otherwise, so its result is fixed by the source
  computation independently of the postcondition. VERINA6Pre is the source
  True precondition on typed string inputs. VERINA6Post states the source
  Boolean equivalence between the result and the same five-vowel test. The
  proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and propositionally
  unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent of the final
  correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition,
  and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA6Char
  VERINA6IsUpper VERINA6ToLower
  VERINA6NormalizeGraph VERINA6Normalize
  VERINA6Contains VERINA6HasAllVowels
  VERINA6Pre VERINA6AllVowels VERINA6Post
$.

verina6-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA6Char $.
verina6-is-upper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA6IsUpper A ) $.
verina6-to-lower-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA6ToLower A ) $.
verina6-normalize-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA6NormalizeGraph A B ) $.
verina6-normalize-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA6Normalize A ) $.
verina6-contains-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA6Contains A B ) $.
verina6-has-all-vowels-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA6HasAllVowels A ) $.
verina6-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA6Pre A ) $.
verina6-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA6AllVowels A ) $.
verina6-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA6Post A B ) $.

verina6-char-definition $a |- VERINA6Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verina6-is-upper-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6IsUpper A
) = if (
  (
    ; 6 5 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; 9 0
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina6-to-lower-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6ToLower A
) = if (
  ( VERINA6IsUpper A ) = 1 ,
  ( A + ; 3 2 ) ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina6-normalize-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA6NormalizeGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA6Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA6Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( B ` i ) = ( VERINA6ToLower ( A ` i ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina6-normalize-definition $a |- (
    VERINA6Normalize A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA6Char
      ( VERINA6NormalizeGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina6-contains-definition $a |- (
    VERINA6Contains A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA6Char
      /\
      B e. VERINA6Char
    )
    /\
    E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      ( A ` i ) = B
  ) $.
$}

verina6-has-all-vowels-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6HasAllVowels A
) <-> (
  A e. Word VERINA6Char
  /\
  (
    ( VERINA6Contains A ; 9 7 )
    /\
    (
      ( VERINA6Contains A ; ; 1 0 1 )
      /\
      (
        ( VERINA6Contains A ; ; 1 0 5 )
        /\
        (
          ( VERINA6Contains A ; ; 1 1 1 )
          /\
          ( VERINA6Contains A ; ; 1 1 7 )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

verina6-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word VERINA6Char
) $.

verina6-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6AllVowels A
) = if (
  ( VERINA6HasAllVowels ( VERINA6Normalize A ) ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verina6-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA6Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word VERINA6Char
    /\
    B e. { 0 , 1 }
  )
  /\
  (
    B = 1
    <->
    ( VERINA6HasAllVowels ( VERINA6Normalize A ) )
  )
) $.

verina-advanced-6-all-vowels $a |- A. w e. Word VERINA6Char
  (
    ( VERINA6Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA6Post
        w
        ( VERINA6AllVowels w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_advanced_6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_6, catalog title "allVowels": deciding whether a
% Unicode-scalar string contains all five English vowels after lowercasing
% ASCII uppercase letters. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_6: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Lean String.data is observed extensionally as its finite list of Unicode
  % scalar characters.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]

  toLower(c: lean_char): lean_char =
    IF c >= 65 AND c <= 90 THEN c + 32 ELSE c ENDIF

  normalize_str(
      s: lean_string): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES s OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(toLower(head), normalize_str(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE s BY <<

  lean_char_list_contains(
      chars: list[lean_char],
      requested: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR lean_char_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  every_vowel_occurs(
      vowels: list[nat],
      chars: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES vowels OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(vowel, remaining):
        lean_char_list_contains(chars, vowel)
          AND every_vowel_occurs(remaining, chars)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE vowels BY <<

  vowelSet: list[nat] =
    cons(
      97,
      cons(
        101,
        cons(
          105,
          cons(
            111,
            cons(117, null[nat])))))

  allVowels_precond(s: lean_string): bool =
    TRUE

  % The Lean precondition proof is computationally irrelevant. This is the
  % exact proof-erased map, membership, and list-all executable computation.
  allVowels(s: lean_string): bool =
    LET chars: list[lean_char] = normalize_str(s)
    IN
      every_vowel_occurs(vowelSet, chars)

  allVowels_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      result: bool): bool =
    LET chars: list[lean_char] = normalize_str(s)
    IN
      result = every_vowel_occurs(vowelSet, chars)

  allVowels_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string):
      allVowels_precond(s)
        IMPLIES
          allVowels_postcond(
            s,
            allVowels(s))

END verina_advanced_6

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_60,
   catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": an executable stable partition of a
   list of natural numbers into its even and odd elements, together with its
   filtering and parity correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition partitionEvensOdds_precond
    (_nums : list nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint partitionEvensOdds_helper
    (nums : list nat) : list nat * list nat :=
  match nums with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | x :: xs =>
      let '(evens, odds) := partitionEvensOdds_helper xs in
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo x 2) 0
      then (x :: evens, odds)
      else (evens, x :: odds)
  end.

Definition partitionEvensOdds
    (nums : list nat)
    (_h_precond : partitionEvensOdds_precond nums)
    : list nat * list nat :=
  partitionEvensOdds_helper nums.

Definition partitionEvensOdds_postcond
    (nums : list nat)
    (result : list nat * list nat)
    (_h_precond : partitionEvensOdds_precond nums) : Prop :=
  let evens := fst result in
  let odds := snd result in
  evens ++ odds =
    filter (fun n => Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n 2) 0) nums ++
    filter (fun n => Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n 2) 1) nums /\
  forallb (fun n => Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n 2) 0) evens = true /\
  forallb (fun n => Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n 2) 1) odds = true.

Theorem partitionEvensOdds_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list nat)
    (h_precond : partitionEvensOdds_precond nums) :
  partitionEvensOdds_postcond
    nums (partitionEvensOdds nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_60,
  catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": an executable recursive list program
  partitions natural numbers into order-preserving even and odd sublists,
  together with its precondition and correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_60
  imports Main
begin

definition partitionEvensOdds_precond :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "partitionEvensOdds_precond nums \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun partitionEvensOdds_helper ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<times> nat list" where
  "partitionEvensOdds_helper [] = ([], [])"
| "partitionEvensOdds_helper (x # xs) =
    (case partitionEvensOdds_helper xs of
       (evens, odds) \<Rightarrow>
         if x mod 2 = 0
         then (x # evens, odds)
         else (evens, x # odds))"

definition partitionEvensOdds ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<times> nat list" where
  "partitionEvensOdds nums = partitionEvensOdds_helper nums"

definition partitionEvensOdds_postcond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> (nat list \<times> nat list) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "partitionEvensOdds_postcond nums result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let evens = fst result;
         odds = snd result
     in evens @ odds =
          filter (\<lambda>n. n mod 2 = 0) nums @
          filter (\<lambda>n. n mod 2 = 1) nums \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>n. n mod 2 = 0) evens \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>n. n mod 2 = 1) odds)"

theorem partitionEvensOdds_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "partitionEvensOdds_precond nums"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_60,
  catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": an executable recursive stable partition
  separates a list of natural numbers into its even and odd elements, together
  with its total correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let partitionEvensOdds_precond = new_definition
  `partitionEvensOdds_precond (nums:num list) <=> T`;;

let partitionEvensOdds_helper =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(partitionEvensOdds_helper ([]:num list) =
        (([]:num list),([]:num list))) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list.
        partitionEvensOdds_helper (CONS x xs) =
        let result = partitionEvensOdds_helper xs in
        if x MOD 2 = 0 then
          (CONS x (FST result),SND result)
        else
          (FST result,CONS x (SND result)))`;;

let partitionEvensOdds = new_definition
  `partitionEvensOdds (nums:num list) =
     partitionEvensOdds_helper nums`;;

let partitionEvensOdds_postcond = new_definition
  `partitionEvensOdds_postcond
      (nums:num list) (result:num list#num list) <=>
     let evens = FST result in
     let odds = SND result in
     APPEND evens odds =
       APPEND
         (FILTER (\n:num. n MOD 2 = 0) nums)
         (FILTER (\n:num. n MOD 2 = 1) nums) /\
     ALL (\n:num. n MOD 2 = 0) evens /\
     ALL (\n:num. n MOD 2 = 1) odds`;;

let partitionEvensOdds_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:num list.
     partitionEvensOdds_precond nums
     ==> partitionEvensOdds_postcond
           nums (partitionEvensOdds nums)`;;

title: verina_advanced_60
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_60,
;; "partitionEvensOdds": a deterministic recursive traversal stably partitions
;; a list of natural numbers into its even and odd elements. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun verina-advanced-60-nat-listp (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (natp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-60-nat-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The List Nat binder is represented
;; separately in the final correctness predicate.

(defun verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds-precond (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

;; A Lean product of two lists is represented by the ACL2 cons pair
;; (evens . odds), with CAR and CDR as the two projections.

(defun verina-advanced-60-nat-list-pair-p (result)
  (and
   (consp result)
   (verina-advanced-60-nat-listp (car result))
   (verina-advanced-60-nat-listp (cdr result))))

;; This is the source local helper. It first partitions the tail, then
;; prepends the head to exactly one component, preserving order in both.

(defun verina-advanced-60-partition-helper (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (let ((tail-result
             (verina-advanced-60-partition-helper
              (cdr nums))))
        (if (equal (mod (car nums) 2) 0)
            (cons
             (cons (car nums) (car tail-result))
             (cdr tail-result))
          (cons
           (car tail-result)
           (cons (car nums) (cdr tail-result)))))
    (cons nil nil)))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.

(defun verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds (nums)
  (verina-advanced-60-partition-helper nums))

(defun verina-advanced-60-filter-even (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (if (equal (mod (car nums) 2) 0)
          (cons
           (car nums)
           (verina-advanced-60-filter-even (cdr nums)))
        (verina-advanced-60-filter-even (cdr nums)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-60-filter-odd (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (if (equal (mod (car nums) 2) 1)
          (cons
           (car nums)
           (verina-advanced-60-filter-odd (cdr nums)))
        (verina-advanced-60-filter-odd (cdr nums)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-60-all-even-p (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (equal (mod (car nums) 2) 0)
       (verina-advanced-60-all-even-p (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-60-all-odd-p (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (equal (mod (car nums) 2) 1)
       (verina-advanced-60-all-odd-p (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds-postcond
    (nums result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-60-nat-listp nums)
   (verina-advanced-60-nat-list-pair-p result)
   (equal
    (append (car result) (cdr result))
    (append
     (verina-advanced-60-filter-even nums)
     (verina-advanced-60-filter-odd nums)))
   (verina-advanced-60-all-even-p (car result))
   (verina-advanced-60-all-odd-p (cdr result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition connecting
;; the complete precondition and postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-60-nat-listp nums)
    (verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds-precond nums))
   (verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds-postcond
    nums
    (verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds nums))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_60
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_60,
-- catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": a deterministic list program stably
-- partitions natural numbers into even and odd sublists and is connected to
-- its filtering and parity-classification contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced60 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

record NatListPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : List Nat
    pairSecond : List Nat

open NatListPair public

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

isEven : Nat → Bool
isEven n = natEqual (naturalMod n two) zero

isOdd : Nat → Bool
isOdd n = natEqual (naturalMod n two) one

partitionEvensOdds-precond : List Nat → Set
partitionEvensOdds-precond nums = Top

partitionEvensOdds-helper : List Nat → NatListPair
partitionEvensOdds-helper [] = pair [] []
partitionEvensOdds-helper (x ∷ xs) =
  let rest = partitionEvensOdds-helper xs
  in
    if isEven x
    then pair (x ∷ pairFirst rest) (pairSecond rest)
    else pair (pairFirst rest) (x ∷ pairSecond rest)

partitionEvensOdds :
  (nums : List Nat) →
  partitionEvensOdds-precond nums →
  NatListPair
partitionEvensOdds nums h-precond =
  partitionEvensOdds-helper nums

partitionEvensOdds-postcond :
  (nums : List Nat) →
  (result : NatListPair) →
  partitionEvensOdds-precond nums →
  Set
partitionEvensOdds-postcond nums result h-precond =
  (appendList (pairFirst result) (pairSecond result) ≡
   appendList
     (filterList isEven nums)
     (filterList isOdd nums)) ∧
  (allList isEven (pairFirst result) ≡ true) ∧
  (allList isOdd (pairSecond result) ≡ true)

partitionEvensOdds-spec-satisfied : Set
partitionEvensOdds-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Nat) →
  (h-precond : partitionEvensOdds-precond nums) →
  partitionEvensOdds-postcond
    nums
    (partitionEvensOdds nums h-precond)
    h-precond

  cataloged as "partitionEvensOdds": the executable recursive program stably
  partitions a natural-number list into its even and odd elements and satisfies
  the stated filter and parity contract. This file contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;

  (partitionEvensOdds_helper (x::xs) =
     let result = partitionEvensOdds_helper xs
     in
       if x MOD 2 = 0 then

`;

        FILTER (\n : num. n MOD 2 = 0) nums ++
        FILTER (\n : num. n MOD 2 = 1) nums /\
      EVERY (\n : num. n MOD 2 = 0) (FST result) /\
      EVERY (\n : num. n MOD 2 = 1) (SND result)``
);

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_60 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_60), catalog title
  partitionEvensOdds: the exact executable recursive partition of an
  arbitrary finite natural-number list into its even and odd entries in
  source order, together with its complete correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA60Even and VERINA60Odd are exactly the source remainder tests
  n % 2 == 0 and n % 2 == 1. VERINA60FilterEvenGraph and
  VERINA60FilterOddGraph retain precisely all matching input positions in
  strictly increasing order, including repeated values. Their unique-choice
  functions therefore reproduce the two stable List.filter computations.

  VERINA60HelperGraph returns the pair of those two filtered words, and
  VERINA60Helper selects that unique pair. This is exactly the source local
  recursive helper: on the empty word both filters are empty, while on
  x :: xs the matching filter is x :: filter xs and the other is filter xs.
  Thus the graph has the same base case and both recursive branches as the
  Lean helper. VERINA60PartitionEvensOdds is the source public executable
  implementation, so its result is fixed independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA60AppendGraph is exact word concatenation. VERINA60Pre is the source
  True precondition on typed inputs. VERINA60Post reproduces the equality of
  result concatenation with the concatenated even and odd source filters,
  followed by the source List.all even and List.all odd clauses. The
  proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and propositionally
  unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent of the final
  correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA60Even VERINA60Odd
  VERINA60FilterEvenGraph VERINA60FilterEven
  VERINA60FilterOddGraph VERINA60FilterOdd
  VERINA60HelperGraph VERINA60Helper VERINA60PartitionEvensOdds
  VERINA60AppendGraph VERINA60Append
  VERINA60Pre VERINA60Post
$.

verina60-even-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60Even A ) $.
verina60-odd-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60Odd A ) $.
verina60-filter-even-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60FilterEvenGraph A B ) $.
verina60-filter-even-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA60FilterEven A ) $.
verina60-filter-odd-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60FilterOddGraph A B ) $.
verina60-filter-odd-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA60FilterOdd A ) $.
verina60-helper-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60HelperGraph A B ) $.
verina60-helper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA60Helper A ) $.
verina60-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA60PartitionEvensOdds A ) $.
verina60-append-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60AppendGraph A B C ) $.
verina60-append-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA60Append A B ) $.
verina60-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60Pre A ) $.
verina60-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA60Post A B ) $.

verina60-even-definition $a |- (
  VERINA60Even A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
  /\
  ( A mod 2 ) = 0
) $.

verina60-odd-definition $a |- (
  VERINA60Odd A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
  /\
  ( A mod 2 ) = 1
) $.

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina60-filter-even-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60FilterEvenGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( VERINA60Even ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) )
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( VERINA60Even ( A ` i ) )
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina60-filter-even-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60FilterEven A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA60FilterEvenGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verina60-filter-odd-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60FilterOddGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( VERINA60Odd ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) )
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( VERINA60Odd ( A ` i ) )
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina60-filter-odd-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60FilterOdd A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA60FilterOddGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina60-helper-graph-definition $a |- (
  VERINA60HelperGraph A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word NN0
    /\
    B e. ( Word NN0 X. Word NN0 )
  )
  /\
  B = <.
    ( VERINA60FilterEven A ) ,
    ( VERINA60FilterOdd A )
  >.
) $.

${
  $d y A $.

  verina60-helper-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60Helper A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ( Word NN0 X. Word NN0 )
      ( VERINA60HelperGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina60-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA60PartitionEvensOdds A
) = (
  VERINA60Helper A
) $.

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina60-append-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60AppendGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word NN0
        /\
        B e. Word NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( C ` i ) = ( A ` i )
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( C ` ( ( # ` A ) + j ) ) = ( B ` j )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina60-append-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60Append A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINA60AppendGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina60-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA60Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word NN0
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verina60-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA60Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word NN0
      /\
      B e. ( Word NN0 X. Word NN0 )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        VERINA60Append
          ( 1st ` B )
          ( 2nd ` B )
      ) = (
        VERINA60Append
          ( VERINA60FilterEven A )
          ( VERINA60FilterOdd A )
      )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( 1st ` B ) ) )
          ( VERINA60Even ( ( 1st ` B ) ` i ) )
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) )
          ( VERINA60Odd ( ( 2nd ` B ) ` j ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-60-partition-evens-odds $a |- A. w e. Word NN0
  (
    ( VERINA60Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA60Post
        w
        ( VERINA60PartitionEvensOdds w )
    )
  )
$.
