content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_60, catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": the unconditional
:: precondition, exact recursive stable even/odd partition implementation,
:: filtered-list postcondition, and final correctness contract.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0,
    FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of NAT,
      result being Element of [:NAT*,NAT*:] st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex evenStates,oddStates being FinSequence of NAT*,
        finalEvens,finalOdds being FinSequence of NAT st
      len evenStates = len nums + 1 &
      len oddStates = len nums + 1 &
      evenStates/.(len nums + 1) = <*>NAT &
      oddStates/.(len nums + 1) = <*>NAT &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
        ex x being Nat,
           tailEvens,tailOdds being FinSequence of NAT st
          x = nums/.k &
          tailEvens = evenStates/.(k + 1) &
          tailOdds = oddStates/.(k + 1) &
          ((x mod (2 qua Nat) = 0 &
            evenStates/.k = <*x*> ^ tailEvens &
            oddStates/.k = tailOdds) or
           (x mod (2 qua Nat) <> 0 &
            evenStates/.k = tailEvens &
            oddStates/.k = <*x*> ^ tailOdds))) &
      finalEvens = evenStates/.1 &
      finalOdds = oddStates/.1 &
      result = [finalEvens,finalOdds])
  holds
    ex evens,odds being FinSequence of NAT st
      result = [evens,odds] &
      evens ^ odds =
        Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom nums & nums/.i mod (2 qua Nat) = 0}) ^
        Seq (nums | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom nums & nums/.i mod (2 qua Nat) = 1}) &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom evens holds
        evens/.i mod (2 qua Nat) = 0) &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom odds holds
        odds/.i mod (2 qua Nat) = 1)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_60
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_60, catalog title "partitionEvensOdds": partitioning a
% natural-number list into its order-preserving even and odd sublists and
% stating the executable program's correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_60: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_list_pair: TYPE =
    [# evens: list[nat],
       odds: list[nat] #]

  append_nat_lists(
      first, second: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_nat_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  filter_even(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[nat],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF mod(head, 2) = 0 THEN
          cons(head, filter_even(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_even(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  filter_odd(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[nat],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF mod(head, 2) = 1 THEN
          cons(head, filter_odd(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_odd(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_even(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        mod(head, 2) = 0
          AND all_even(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_odd(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        mod(head, 2) = 1
          AND all_odd(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  partitionEvensOdds_precond(nums: list[nat]): bool =
    TRUE

  partitionEvensOdds_helper(
      nums: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat_list_pair =
    CASES nums OF
      null:
        (# evens := null[nat],
           odds := null[nat] #),
      cons(head, tail):

              partitionEvensOdds_helper(tail)

          IF mod(head, 2) = 0 THEN
            (# evens := cons(head, evens(partitioned_tail)),
               odds := odds(partitioned_tail) #)
          ELSE
            (# evens := evens(partitioned_tail),
               odds := cons(head, odds(partitioned_tail)) #)
          ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE nums BY <<

  % The Lean precondition proof is computationally irrelevant. This is the
  % exact proof-erased recursive partition computation.
  partitionEvensOdds(nums: list[nat]): nat_list_pair =
    partitionEvensOdds_helper(nums)

  partitionEvensOdds_postcond(
      nums: list[nat],
      result: nat_list_pair): bool =
    append_nat_lists(evens(result), odds(result))
        =
      append_nat_lists(filter_even(nums), filter_odd(nums))
      AND all_even(evens(result))
      AND all_odd(odds(result))

  partitionEvensOdds_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[nat]):
      partitionEvensOdds_precond(nums)
        IMPLIES
          partitionEvensOdds_postcond(
            nums,
            partitionEvensOdds(nums))

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_61,
   catalog title "productExceptSelf": executable prefix-and-suffix product
   computation returning at each index the product of all other integers,
   together with its length and indexed-product correctness contract. This
   file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition productExceptSelf_precond (_nums : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition computepref (nums : list Z) : list Z :=
  fold_left
    (fun acc x => acc ++ [last acc 0 * x])
    nums [1].

Definition computeSuffix (nums : list Z) : list Z :=
  rev
    (fold_left
      (fun acc x => acc ++ [last acc 0 * x])
      (rev nums) [1]).

Definition productExceptSelf
    (nums : list Z)
    (_h_precond : productExceptSelf_precond nums) : list Z :=
  let n := length nums in
  if Nat.eqb n 0%nat
  then []
  else
    let pref := computepref nums in
    let suffix := computeSuffix nums in
    map
      (fun i => nth i pref 0 * nth (S i) suffix 0)
      (seq 0%nat n).

Fixpoint list_myprod (xs : list Z) : Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 1
  | x :: rest => x * list_myprod rest
  end.

Definition productExceptSelf_postcond
    (nums result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : productExceptSelf_precond nums) : Prop :=
  length nums = length result /\
  forallb
    (fun i =>
      Z.eqb
        (nth i result 0)
        (list_myprod (firstn i nums) *
         list_myprod (skipn (S i) nums)))
    (seq 0%nat (length nums)) = true.

Theorem productExceptSelf_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (h_precond : productExceptSelf_precond nums) :
  productExceptSelf_postcond
    nums (productExceptSelf nums h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

     if n = 0 then []

            productExceptSelf_getDefault suffix (i + 1))
         (productExceptSelf_range n)`;;

let productExceptSelf_myprod =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(productExceptSelf_myprod ([]:int list) = (&1:int)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.

     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        productExceptSelf_take (SUC n) xs =

     (!n:num. !xs:int list.
        productExceptSelf_drop (SUC n) xs =

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Int domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of integers.

(defun verina-advanced-61-integer-listp (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (integerp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-61-integer-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-61-product-except-self-precond (nums)
  (declare (ignore nums))
  t)

;; List.getLast! on List Int returns zero on the empty list. The source folds
;; start from [1], so every operational use below is on a nonempty list.

(defun verina-advanced-61-get-last-default-zero (values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (if (consp (cdr values))
          (verina-advanced-61-get-last-default-zero
           (cdr values))
        (car values))
    0))

;; This is the source foldl step acc ++ [acc.getLast! * x], retaining the
;; append-based accumulator semantics and traversal order.

(defun verina-advanced-61-prefix-fold (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-61-prefix-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (append
        accumulator
        (list
         (*
          (verina-advanced-61-get-last-default-zero
           accumulator)
          (car remaining)))))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-61-computepref (nums)
  (verina-advanced-61-prefix-fold nums (list 1)))

;; The suffix helper reverses the input, performs the identical fold from
;; [1], and reverses the complete accumulated list, exactly as in the source.

(defun verina-advanced-61-compute-suffix (nums)
  (reverse
   (verina-advanced-61-prefix-fold
    (reverse nums)
    (list 1))))

;; List.get! on List Int returns zero when the index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-advanced-61-nth-default-zero (index values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp values)
        (if (zp index)
            (car values)
          (verina-advanced-61-nth-default-zero
           (- index 1)
           (cdr values)))
      0)))

;; INDEX and REMAINING enumerate List.range n in increasing order and map the
;; source expression pref[i]! * suffix[i+1]! over that range.

(defun verina-advanced-61-build-result
    (index remaining pref suffix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (*
      (verina-advanced-61-nth-default-zero
       index
       pref)
      (verina-advanced-61-nth-default-zero
       (+ index 1)
       suffix))
     (verina-advanced-61-build-result
      (+ index 1)
      (- remaining 1)
      pref
      suffix))))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; The empty branch and both helper computations remain explicit.

(defun verina-advanced-61-product-except-self (nums)
  (let ((n (len nums)))
    (if (equal n 0)
        nil
      (let ((pref
             (verina-advanced-61-computepref nums))
            (suffix
             (verina-advanced-61-compute-suffix nums)))
        (verina-advanced-61-build-result
         0
         n
         pref
         suffix)))))

;; This is the source-local List.myprod definition.

(defun verina-advanced-61-myprod (values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (*
       (car values)
       (verina-advanced-61-myprod (cdr values)))
    1))

(defun verina-advanced-61-take (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (not (natp count))
      nil
    (if (zp count)
        nil
      (if (consp values)
          (cons
           (car values)
           (verina-advanced-61-take
            (- count 1)
            (cdr values)))
        nil))))

(defun verina-advanced-61-drop (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (not (natp count))
      nil
    (if (zp count)
        values
      (if (consp values)
          (verina-advanced-61-drop

        nil))))

;; Option Int is represented by :none or the tagged pair (:some . value).

(defun verina-advanced-61-nth-option (index values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      :none

        (if (zp index)

           (- index 1)
           (cdr values)))
      :none)))

(defun verina-advanced-61-all-products-correct-p
    (index remaining nums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (verina-advanced-61-nth-option index result)
      (cons
       :some
       (*
        (verina-advanced-61-myprod
         (verina-advanced-61-take index nums))
        (verina-advanced-61-myprod

(defun

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_61,
-- catalog title "productExceptSelf": a deterministic prefix-and-suffix product
-- program returns, at each integer-list index, the product of all other entries
-- and is connected to its pointwise correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced61 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

intMultiply : Int → Int → Int
intMultiply (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
intMultiply (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

oneInt : Int
oneInt = pos (suc zero)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  dropList n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

getLastDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → A
getLastDefault default [] = default
getLastDefault default (x ∷ []) = x
getLastDefault default (x ∷ y ∷ ys) =
  getLastDefault default (y ∷ ys)

prefixStep : List Int → Int → List Int
prefixStep accumulator x =
  appendList
    accumulator
    (intMultiply
      (getLastDefault zeroInt accumulator)
      x ∷ [])

computepref : List Int → List Int
computepref nums =
  foldLeft prefixStep (oneInt ∷ []) nums

computeSuffix : List Int → List Int
computeSuffix nums =
  reverseList
    (foldLeft
      prefixStep
      (oneInt ∷ [])
      (reverseList nums))

productExceptSelf-precond : List Int → Set
productExceptSelf-precond nums = Top

productExceptSelf :
  (nums : List Int) →
  productExceptSelf-precond nums →
  List Int
productExceptSelf nums h-precond with listLength nums
... | zero = []
... | suc n =
  let pref = computepref nums
      suffix = computeSuffix nums
  in
    mapList
      (λ i →
        intMultiply
          (nthDefault zeroInt i pref)
          (nthDefault zeroInt (suc i) suffix))
      (range (suc n))

productList : List Int → Int
productList [] = oneInt
productList (x ∷ xs) =
  intMultiply x (productList xs)

productExceptSelf-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (result : List Int) →
  productExceptSelf-precond nums →
  Set
productExceptSelf-postcond nums result h-precond =
  (listLength nums ≡ listLength result) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ i →
        intEqual
          (nthDefault zeroInt i result)
          (intMultiply
            (productList (takeList i nums))
            (productList (dropList (suc i) nums))))
      (range (listLength nums)))

productExceptSelf-spec-satisfied : Set
productExceptSelf-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (h-precond : productExceptSelf-precond nums) →
  productExceptSelf-postcond
    nums
    (productExceptSelf nums h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_61
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_61,
  cataloged as "productExceptSelf": the executable prefix-and-suffix product
  program returns, at each integer-list index, the product of every other
  entry and satisfies its stated length and indexing contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val productExceptSelf_precond_def = new_definition (
  "productExceptSelf_precond_def",
  ``productExceptSelf_precond (nums : int list) <=> T``
);

val productExceptSelf_lastDefault_def = Define `
  (productExceptSelf_lastDefault ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (productExceptSelf_lastDefault (x::xs) =
     if xs = [] then x
     else productExceptSelf_lastDefault xs)
`;

val productExceptSelf_prefixFold_def = Define `
  (productExceptSelf_prefixFold
      ([] : int list)
      (acc : int list) =
     acc) /\
  (productExceptSelf_prefixFold
      (x::xs)
      acc =
     productExceptSelf_prefixFold
       xs
       (acc ++ [productExceptSelf_lastDefault acc * x]))
`;

val computepref_def = new_definition (
  "computepref_def",
  ``computepref (nums : int list) =
      productExceptSelf_prefixFold nums [1]``
);

val computeSuffix_def = new_definition (
  "computeSuffix_def",
  ``computeSuffix (nums : int list) =
      REVERSE (computepref (REVERSE nums))``
);

val productExceptSelf_getDefault_def = new_definition (
  "productExceptSelf_getDefault_def",
  ``productExceptSelf_getDefault
      (xs : int list) (index : num) =
      if index < LENGTH xs then EL index xs else (0 : int)``
);

val productExceptSelf_def = new_definition (
  "productExceptSelf_def",
  ``productExceptSelf (nums : int list) =
      let n = LENGTH nums in
      if n = 0 then
        []
      else
        let pref = computepref nums in
        let suffix = computeSuffix nums in
          MAP
            (\i : num.
               productExceptSelf_getDefault pref i *
               productExceptSelf_getDefault suffix (i + 1))
            (COUNT_LIST n)``
);

val productExceptSelf_myprod_def = Define `
  (productExceptSelf_myprod ([] : int list) = (1 : int)) /\
  (productExceptSelf_myprod (x::xs) =
     x * productExceptSelf_myprod xs)
`;

val productExceptSelf_getOpt_def = new_definition (
  "productExceptSelf_getOpt_def",
  ``productExceptSelf_getOpt
      (xs : int list) (index : num) =
      if index < LENGTH xs then
        SOME (EL index xs)
      else
        (NONE : int option)``
);

val productExceptSelf_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "productExceptSelf_postcond_def",
  ``productExceptSelf_postcond
      (nums : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      LENGTH nums = LENGTH result /\
      EVERY
        (\i : num.
           productExceptSelf_getOpt result i =
           SOME
             (productExceptSelf_myprod (TAKE i nums) *
              productExceptSelf_myprod (DROP (i + 1) nums)))
        (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH nums))``
);

val productExceptSelf_spec_satisfied =
  ``!nums : int list.
      productExceptSelf_precond nums ==>
      productExceptSelf_postcond
        nums (productExceptSelf nums)``;

title: verina_advanced_61
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_61 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_61), catalog title
  productExceptSelf: exact prefix-product and reversed suffix-product folds
  compute, for every position of an arbitrary finite integer list, the
  product of all other entries, together with the complete correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set. The empty word (/) represents
  the empty list.

  VERINA61ComputePrefGraph is the exact source computepref fold trace. It
  starts with integer one and appends the previous last accumulator entry
  times the next input entry. VERINA61ReverseGraph is exact list reversal.
  VERINA61ComputeSuffixGraph first reverses the input, performs the same
  append-at-the-end product fold from one, and reverses that complete trace,
  exactly reproducing computeSuffix.

  VERINA61ResultGraph maps every input index i to prefix[i] times
  suffix[i+1]. VERINA61ProductExceptSelf preserves the source's explicit
  empty-input branch and otherwise selects the unique result of this graph.
  Thus the executable result is fixed independently of the postcondition,
  uses the same two linear product folds, and performs no division.

  VERINA61TakeGraph and VERINA61DropGraph reproduce List.take and List.drop
  for every natural count, including counts beyond the input length.
  VERINA61MyProdGraph is the exact recursive List.myprod computation: its
  trace has terminal value one and each preceding value is the current entry
  times the product of the remaining suffix.
  VERINA61Post has the source result-length equality and the complete
  List.range/List.all clause. Under that length equality every ranged lookup
  is in bounds, so the source option equality result[i]! = some(value) is
  bidirectionally equivalent to the displayed word-entry equality.

  VERINA61Pre is the source True precondition on typed List Int inputs. The
  proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and propositionally
  unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent of the final
  correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition,
  and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA61ComputePrefGraph VERINA61ComputePref
  VERINA61ReverseGraph
  VERINA61ComputeSuffixGraph VERINA61ComputeSuffix
  VERINA61ResultGraph
  VERINA61Pre VERINA61ProductExceptSelf
  VERINA61NatMin
  VERINA61TakeGraph VERINA61Take
  VERINA61DropGraph VERINA61Drop
  VERINA61MyProdGraph VERINA61MyProd
  VERINA61Post
$.

verina61-compute-pref-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61ComputePrefGraph A B ) $.
verina61-compute-pref-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61ComputePref A ) $.
verina61-reverse-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61ReverseGraph A B ) $.
verina61-compute-suffix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61ComputeSuffixGraph A B ) $.
verina61-compute-suffix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61ComputeSuffix A ) $.
verina61-result-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61ResultGraph A B ) $.
verina61-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61Pre A ) $.
verina61-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61ProductExceptSelf A ) $.
verina61-nat-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61NatMin A B ) $.
verina61-take-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61TakeGraph A B C ) $.
verina61-take-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61Take A B ) $.
verina61-drop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61DropGraph A B C ) $.
verina61-drop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61Drop A B ) $.
verina61-myprod-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61MyProdGraph A B ) $.
verina61-myprod-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA61MyProd A ) $.
verina61-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA61Post A B ) $.

${
  $d k A B $.

  verina61-compute-pref-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ComputePrefGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` B ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
        /\
        ( B ` 0 ) = 1
      )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` ( k + 1 )
        ) = (
          ( B ` k ) x. ( A ` k )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina61-compute-pref-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ComputePref A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA61ComputePrefGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina61-reverse-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ReverseGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          A ` ( ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) - i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k r s A B $.

  verina61-compute-suffix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ComputeSuffixGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. r e. Word ZZ
      E. s e. Word ZZ
        (
          (
            ( VERINA61ReverseGraph A r )
            /\
            (
              ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` r ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( s ` 0 ) = 1
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` r ) )
              (
                s ` ( k + 1 )
              ) = (
                ( s ` k ) x. ( r ` k )
              )
            /\
            ( VERINA61ReverseGraph s B )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina61-compute-suffix-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ComputeSuffix A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA61ComputeSuffixGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina61-result-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ResultGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          ( B ` i )
        ) = (
          ( ( VERINA61ComputePref A ) ` i )
          x.
          ( ( VERINA61ComputeSuffix A ) ` ( i + 1 ) )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina61-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA61Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d y A $.

  verina61-program-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61ProductExceptSelf A
  ) = if (
    ( # ` A ) = 0 ,
    (/) ,
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA61ResultGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina61-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA61NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina61-take-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61TakeGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        # ` C
      ) = (
        VERINA61NatMin B ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        ( C ` j ) = ( A ` j )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina61-take-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61Take A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA61TakeGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verina61-drop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61DropGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        # ` C
      ) = (
        ( # ` A ) - ( VERINA61NatMin B ( # ` A ) )
      )
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          C ` j
        ) = (
          A ` ( ( VERINA61NatMin B ( # ` A ) ) + j )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina61-drop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61Drop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA61DropGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s A B $.

  verina61-myprod-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61MyProdGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word ZZ
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` ( # ` A ) ) = 1
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` k
            ) = (
              ( A ` k ) x. ( s ` ( k + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( s ` 0 )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina61-myprod-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61MyProd A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA61MyProdGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina61-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA61Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` A ) = ( # ` B )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` i
        ) = (
          (
            VERINA61MyProd
              ( VERINA61Take A i )
          )
          x.
          (
            VERINA61MyProd
              ( VERINA61Drop A ( i + 1 ) )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-61-product-except-self $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINA61Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINA61Post
        w
        ( VERINA61ProductExceptSelf w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_advanced_61
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_61, catalog title "productExceptSelf": the unconditional
:: precondition, exact prefix- and suffix-product folds, executable
:: product-except-self implementation, recursive list-product postcondition,
:: and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, FINSEQOP,
    XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums,result being FinSequence of INT st
    0 = 0 &
    ((len nums = 0 & result = <*>INT) or
     (len nums <> 0 &
      ex pref,suffix being FinSequence of INT st
        len pref = len nums + 1 &
        pref/.1 = 1 &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
          pref/.(k + 1) = pref/.k * nums/.k) &
        len suffix = len nums + 1 &
        suffix/.(len nums + 1) = 1 &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
          suffix/.k = suffix/.(k + 1) * nums/.k) &
        len result = len nums &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
          result/.k = pref/.k * suffix/.(k + 1))))
  holds
    len nums = len result &
    (for k being Nat st k in dom nums holds
      ex leftPart,rightPart being FinSequence of INT,
         leftProducts,rightProducts being FinSequence of INT st
        leftPart =
          Seq (nums | {j where j is Nat :
            j in dom nums & j < k}) &
        rightPart =
          Seq (nums | {j where j is Nat :
            j in dom nums & k < j}) &
        len leftProducts = len leftPart + 1 &
        leftProducts/.1 = 1 &
        (for q being Nat st q in dom leftPart holds
          leftProducts/.(q + 1) =
            leftProducts/.q * leftPart/.q) &
        len rightProducts = len rightPart + 1 &
        rightProducts/.1 = 1 &
        (for q being Nat st q in dom rightPart holds
          rightProducts/.(q + 1) =
            rightProducts/.q * rightPart/.q) &
        result/.k =
          leftProducts/.(len leftPart + 1) *
          rightProducts/.(len rightPart + 1))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_61
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_61, catalog title "productExceptSelf": computing at each
% integer-list index the product of all other entries with the specified
% prefix/suffix program and its correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_61: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoneInt: NoneInt?
    SomeInt(option_value: int): SomeInt?
  END int_option

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean's proof-erased getElem! on an integer list returns zero outside the
  % list. All calls made by the executable program are in range.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_option(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int_option =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        NoneInt,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          SomeInt(head)
        ELSE
          int_list_get_option(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_int_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  reverse_int_list(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list_acc(values, null[int])

  % This accumulator form is extensionally the source foldl that starts from
  % [1] and appends the previous last product multiplied by each next entry.
  computepref_from(
      values: list[int],
      running_product: int): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(running_product, null[int]),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          running_product,
          computepref_from(
            tail,
            running_product * head))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  computepref(nums: list[int]): list[int] =
    computepref_from(nums, 1)

  computeSuffix(nums: list[int]): list[int] =
    reverse_int_list(
      computepref(reverse_int_list(nums)))

  productExceptSelf_precond(nums: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  productExceptSelf_build(
      index, remaining: nat,
      pref, suffix: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      cons(
        int_list_get_bang(index, pref)
          * int_list_get_bang(index + 1, suffix),
        productExceptSelf_build(
          index + 1,
          remaining - 1,
          pref,
          suffix))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  % The source precondition proof is computationally irrelevant. This is the
  % exact proof-erased prefix/suffix and indexed-map computation.
  productExceptSelf(nums: list[int]): list[int] =
    LET length: nat = int_list_length(nums)
    IN
      IF length = 0 THEN
        null[int]
      ELSE
        LET pref: list[int] = computepref(nums),
            suffix: list[int] = computeSuffix(nums)
        IN
          productExceptSelf_build(
            0,
            length,
            pref,
            suffix)
      ENDIF

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_myprod(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        1,
      cons(head, tail):
        head * int_list_myprod(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % In the source Bool-valued List.all, result[i]! elaborates to optional
  % indexing, so the comparison below retains the explicit Some value.
  productExceptSelf_entries_ok(
      nums, result: list[int],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      int_list_get_option(index, result)
        =
      SomeInt(
        int_list_myprod(int_list_take(index, nums))
          * int_list_myprod(
              int_list_drop(index + 1, nums)))
      AND productExceptSelf_entries_ok(
            nums,
            result,
            index + 1,
            remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  productExceptSelf_postcond(
      nums, result: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(nums) = int_list_length(result)
      AND productExceptSelf_entries_ok(
            nums,
            result,
            0,
            int_list_length(nums))

  productExceptSelf_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int]):
      productExceptSelf_precond(nums)
        IMPLIES
          productExceptSelf_postcond(
            nums,
            productExceptSelf(nums))

END verina_advanced_61

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "rain" from VERINA item verina_advanced_62. This file
-- contains no proof.

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux

-- !benchmark @end solution_aux

-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible]
def rain_precond (heights : List (Int)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  heights.all (fun h => h >= 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def rain (heights : List (Int)) (h_precond : rain_precond (heights)) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  -- Handle edge cases: need at least 3 elements to trap water
  if heights.length < 3 then 0 else
    let n := heights.length

    -- Use two pointers approach for O(n) time with O(1) space
    let rec aux (left : Nat) (right : Nat) (leftMax : Int) (rightMax : Int) (water : Int) : Int :=
      if left >= right then
        water  -- Base case: all elements processed
      else if heights[left]! <= heights[right]! then
        -- Process from the left
        let newLeftMax := max leftMax (heights[left]!)
        let newWater := water + max 0 (leftMax - heights[left]!)
        aux (left+1) right newLeftMax rightMax newWater
      else
        -- Process from the right
        let newRightMax := max rightMax (heights[right]!)
        let newWater := water + max 0 (rightMax - heights[right]!)
        aux left (right-1) leftMax newRightMax newWater
      termination_by right - left
    -- Initialize with two pointers at the ends
    aux 0 (n-1) (heights[0]!) (heights[n-1]!) 0
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def rain_postcond (heights : List (Int)) (result: Int) (h_precond : rain_precond (heights)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  -- The result is the total amount of rainwater trapped by the given terrain
  -- If there are fewer than 3 elements, no water can be trapped
  result >= 0 ∧
  -- The result is non-negative
  if heights.length < 3 then result = 0 else
    -- Water trapped at each position is min(maxLeft, maxRight) - height
    result =
      let max_left_at := λ i =>
        let rec ml (j : Nat) (max_so_far : Int) : Int :=
          if j > i then max_so_far
          else ml (j+1) (max max_so_far (heights[j]!))
          termination_by i + 1 - j
        ml 0 0

      let max_right_at := λ i =>
        let rec mr (j : Nat) (max_so_far : Int) : Int :=
          if j >= heights.length then max_so_far
          else mr (j+1) (max max_so_far (heights[j]!))
          termination_by heights.length - j
        mr i 0

      let water_at := λ i =>
        max 0 (min (max_left_at i) (max_right_at i) - heights[i]!)

      let rec sum_water (i : Nat) (acc : Int) : Int :=
        if i >= heights.length then acc
        else sum_water (i+1) (acc + water_at i)
        termination_by heights.length - i

      sum_water 0 0
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem rain_spec_satisfied (heights: List (Int)) (h_precond : rain_precond (heights)) :
    rain_postcond (heights) (rain (heights) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_62,
   catalog title "rain": an executable two-pointer computation of trapped
   rainwater over nonnegative integer heights, together with its prefix- and
   suffix-maximum correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition rain_precond (heights : list Z) : Prop :=
  forallb (fun height => Z.leb 0 height) heights = true.

Fixpoint rain_aux_fuel
    (fuel left right : nat)
    (leftMax rightMax water : Z)
    (heights : list Z) : Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => water
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.leb right left
      then water
      else
        let leftHeight := nth left heights 0%Z in
        let rightHeight := nth right heights 0%Z in
        if Z.leb leftHeight rightHeight
        then
          let newLeftMax := Z.max leftMax leftHeight in
          let newWater :=
            (water + Z.max 0 (leftMax - leftHeight))%Z in
          rain_aux_fuel
            fuel' (S left) right newLeftMax rightMax newWater heights
        else
          let newRightMax := Z.max rightMax rightHeight in
          let newWater :=
            (water + Z.max 0 (rightMax - rightHeight))%Z in
          rain_aux_fuel
            fuel' left (Nat.pred right) leftMax newRightMax newWater heights
  end.

Definition rain
    (heights : list Z)
    (_h_precond : rain_precond heights) : Z :=
  if Nat.ltb (length heights) 3
  then 0%Z
  else
    let n := length heights in
    let right := Nat.pred n in
    rain_aux_fuel
      (Nat.sub right 0)
      0 right
      (nth 0 heights 0%Z)
      (nth right heights 0%Z)
      0%Z heights.

Fixpoint rain_max_left_fuel
    (fuel i j : nat)
    (max_so_far : Z)
    (heights : list Z) : Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => max_so_far
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb i j
      then max_so_far
      else
        rain_max_left_fuel
          fuel' i (S j)
          (Z.max max_so_far (nth j heights 0%Z))
          heights
  end.

Definition rain_max_left_at
    (heights : list Z)
    (i : nat) : Z :=
  rain_max_left_fuel (S i) i 0 0%Z heights.

Fixpoint rain_max_right_fuel
    (fuel j : nat)
    (max_so_far : Z)
    (heights : list Z) : Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => max_so_far
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.leb (length heights) j
      then max_so_far
      else
        rain_max_right_fuel
          fuel' (S j)
          (Z.max max_so_far (nth j heights 0%Z))
          heights
  end.

Definition rain_max_right_at
    (heights : list Z)
    (i : nat) : Z :=
  rain_max_right_fuel
    (Nat.sub (length heights) i) i 0%Z heights.

Definition rain_water_at
    (heights : list Z)
    (i : nat) : Z :=
  Z.max 0
    (Z.min
      (rain_max_left_at heights i)
      (rain_max_right_at heights i) -
     nth i heights 0%Z).

Fixpoint rain_sum_water_fuel
    (fuel i : nat)
    (accumulator : Z)
    (heights : list Z) : Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => accumulator
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.leb (length heights) i
      then accumulator
      else
        rain_sum_water_fuel
          fuel' (S i)
          (accumulator + rain_water_at heights i)%Z
          heights
  end.

Definition rain_total_by_maxima (heights : list Z) : Z :=
  rain_sum_water_fuel (length heights) 0 0%Z heights.

Definition rain_postcond
    (heights : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : rain_precond heights) : Prop :=
  (0 <= result)%Z /\
  if Nat.ltb (length heights) 3
  then result = 0%Z
  else result = rain_total_by_maxima heights.

Theorem rain_spec_satisfied
    (heights : list Z)
    (h_precond : rain_precond heights) :
  rain_postcond heights (rain heights h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_62,
  catalog title "rain": a deterministic two-pointer program computes trapped
  rainwater over a list of nonnegative integer heights, together with its
  prefix/suffix-maximum postcondition and correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_62
  imports Main
begin

definition rain_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "rain_precond heights \<longleftrightarrow>
    list_all (\<lambda>h. h \<ge> 0) heights"

fun rain_getBang :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_getBang [] i = 0"
| "rain_getBang (h # heights) 0 = h"
| "rain_getBang (h # heights) (Suc i) = rain_getBang heights i"

fun rain_aux ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_aux 0 heights left right leftMax rightMax water = water"
| "rain_aux (Suc fuel) heights left right leftMax rightMax water =
    (if left \<ge> right
     then water
     else if rain_getBang heights left \<le> rain_getBang heights right
     then
       (let newLeftMax = max leftMax (rain_getBang heights left);
            newWater =
              water + max 0 (leftMax - rain_getBang heights left)
        in rain_aux fuel heights (left + 1) right
             newLeftMax rightMax newWater)
     else
       (let newRightMax = max rightMax (rain_getBang heights right);
            newWater =
              water + max 0 (rightMax - rain_getBang heights right)
        in rain_aux fuel heights left (right - 1)
             leftMax newRightMax newWater))"

definition rain :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain heights =
    (if length heights < 3
     then 0
     else
       (let n = length heights
        in rain_aux (n - 1) heights 0 (n - 1)
             (rain_getBang heights 0)
             (rain_getBang heights (n - 1)) 0))"

fun rain_max_left_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_max_left_loop 0 heights j maxSoFar = maxSoFar"
| "rain_max_left_loop (Suc fuel) heights j maxSoFar =
    rain_max_left_loop fuel heights (j + 1)
      (max maxSoFar (rain_getBang heights j))"

definition rain_max_left_at :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_max_left_at heights i =
    rain_max_left_loop (i + 1) heights 0 0"

fun rain_max_right_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_max_right_loop 0 heights j maxSoFar = maxSoFar"
| "rain_max_right_loop (Suc fuel) heights j maxSoFar =
    rain_max_right_loop fuel heights (j + 1)
      (max maxSoFar (rain_getBang heights j))"

definition rain_max_right_at :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_max_right_at heights i =
    rain_max_right_loop (length heights - i) heights i 0"

definition rain_water_at :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_water_at heights i =
    max 0
      (min (rain_max_left_at heights i) (rain_max_right_at heights i) -
        rain_getBang heights i)"

fun rain_sum_water_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_sum_water_loop 0 heights i acc = acc"
| "rain_sum_water_loop (Suc fuel) heights i acc =
    rain_sum_water_loop fuel heights (i + 1)
      (acc + rain_water_at heights i)"

definition rain_sum_water :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "rain_sum_water heights =
    rain_sum_water_loop (length heights) heights 0 0"

definition rain_postcond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "rain_postcond heights result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result \<ge> 0 \<and>
    (if length heights < 3
     then result = 0
     else result = rain_sum_water heights)"

theorem rain_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "rain_precond heights"
  shows "rain_postcond heights (rain heights)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_62,
  catalog title "rain": an executable two-pointer scan computes trapped
  rainwater for a nonnegative integer elevation list, together with the
  independently summed per-index postcondition and total correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let rain_precond = new_definition
  `rain_precond (heights:int list) <=>
     ALL (\height:int. (&0:int) <= height) heights`;;

let rain_int_max = new_definition
  `rain_int_max (a:int) (b:int) =
     if a <= b then b else a`;;

let rain_int_min = new_definition
  `rain_int_min (a:int) (b:int) =
     if a <= b then a else b`;;

let rain_getDefault = new_definition
  `rain_getDefault (heights:int list) (index:num) =
     if index < LENGTH heights then EL index heights else (&0:int)`;;

let rain_aux =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!heights:int list. !left:num. !right:num.
      !leftMax:int. !rightMax:int. !water:int.
        rain_aux 0 heights left right leftMax rightMax water = water) /\
     (!fuel:num. !heights:int list. !left:num. !right:num.
      !leftMax:int. !rightMax:int. !water:int.
        rain_aux (SUC fuel) heights left right leftMax rightMax water =
        if right <= left then water
        else if rain_getDefault heights left <=
                rain_getDefault heights right then
          let current = rain_getDefault heights left in
          let newLeftMax = rain_int_max leftMax current in
          let newWater =
            water + rain_int_max (&0:int) (leftMax - current) in
          rain_aux fuel heights (left + 1) right
            newLeftMax rightMax newWater
        else
          let current = rain_getDefault heights right in
          let newRightMax = rain_int_max rightMax current in
          let newWater =
            water + rain_int_max (&0:int) (rightMax - current) in
          rain_aux fuel heights left (right - 1)
            leftMax newRightMax newWater)`;;

let rain = new_definition
  `rain (heights:int list) =
     if LENGTH heights < 3 then (&0:int)
     else
       let n = LENGTH heights in
       rain_aux n heights 0 (n - 1)
         (rain_getDefault heights 0)
         (rain_getDefault heights (n - 1))
         (&0:int)`;;

let rain_maxSteps =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!heights:int list. !index:num. !maxSoFar:int.
        rain_maxSteps 0 heights index maxSoFar = maxSoFar) /\
     (!steps:num. !heights:int list. !index:num. !maxSoFar:int.
        rain_maxSteps (SUC steps) heights index maxSoFar =
        rain_maxSteps steps heights (index + 1)
          (rain_int_max maxSoFar
            (rain_getDefault heights index)))`;;

let rain_maxLeftAt = new_definition
  `rain_maxLeftAt (heights:int list) (index:num) =
     rain_maxSteps (index + 1) heights 0 (&0:int)`;;

let rain_maxRightAt = new_definition
  `rain_maxRightAt (heights:int list) (index:num) =
     rain_maxSteps (LENGTH heights - index)
       heights index (&0:int)`;;

let rain_waterAt = new_definition
  `rain_waterAt (heights:int list) (index:num) =
     rain_int_max (&0:int)
       (rain_int_min
          (rain_maxLeftAt heights index)
          (rain_maxRightAt heights index) -
        rain_getDefault heights index)`;;

let rain_sumWater =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!heights:int list. !index:num. !acc:int.
        rain_sumWater 0 heights index acc = acc) /\
     (!steps:num. !heights:int list. !index:num. !acc:int.
        rain_sumWater (SUC steps) heights index acc =
        rain_sumWater steps heights (index + 1)
          (acc + rain_waterAt heights index))`;;

let rain_postcond = new_definition
  `rain_postcond (heights:int list) (result:int) <=>
     (&0:int) <= result /\
     (if LENGTH heights < 3 then result = (&0:int)
      else
        result =
          rain_sumWater (LENGTH heights) heights 0 (&0:int))`;;

let rain_spec_satisfied =
  `!heights:int list.
     rain_precond heights
     ==> rain_postcond heights (rain heights)`;;

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_62,
;; "rain": a deterministic two-pointer program computes trapped rainwater for
;; a nonnegative integer elevation list, with its result specified by the
;; corresponding prefix-and-suffix maximum sum. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Int domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of integers.

(defun verina-advanced-62-integer-listp (heights)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count heights)))
  (if (consp heights)
      (and
       (integerp (car heights))
       (verina-advanced-62-integer-listp (cdr heights)))
    (equal heights nil)))

;; This is List.all (fun h => h >= 0) on the typed input list.

(defun verina-advanced-62-rain-precond (heights)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count heights)))
  (if (consp heights)
      (and
       (<= 0 (car heights))
       (verina-advanced-62-rain-precond (cdr heights)))
    (equal heights nil)))

;; Lean's List.get! on List Int returns zero when the index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero (index values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp values)
        (if (zp index)
            (car values)
          (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
           (- index 1)
           (cdr values)))
      0)))

(defun verina-advanced-62-int-max (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      right
    left))

(defun verina-advanced-62-int-min (left right)
  (if (< left right)
      left
    right))

;; FUEL is initialized to RIGHT - LEFT and decreases with every pointer move.
;; On the typed top-level call it is therefore zero exactly when the source
;; recursion reaches LEFT >= RIGHT. The two branches otherwise preserve the
;; source pointer, maximum, and accumulated-water transitions exactly.

(defun verina-advanced-62-rain-aux
    (heights left right left-max right-max water fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (zp fuel)
       (<= right left))
      water
    (let ((left-height
           (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
            left
            heights))
          (right-height
           (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
            right
            heights)))
      (if (<= left-height right-height)
          (let ((new-left-max
                 (verina-advanced-62-int-max
                  left-max
                  left-height))
                (new-water
                 (+
                  water
                  (verina-advanced-62-int-max
                   0
                   (- left-max left-height)))))
            (verina-advanced-62-rain-aux
             heights
             (+ left 1)
             right
             new-left-max
             right-max
             new-water
             (- fuel 1)))
        (let ((new-right-max
               (verina-advanced-62-int-max
                right-max
                right-height))
              (new-water
               (+
                water
                (verina-advanced-62-int-max
                 0
                 (- right-max right-height)))))
          (verina-advanced-62-rain-aux
           heights
           left
           (- right 1)
           left-max
           new-right-max
           new-water
           (- fuel 1)))))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; This preserves the short-list branch and the source initialization from
;; both endpoints.

(defun verina-advanced-62-rain (heights)
  (let ((n (len heights)))
    (if (< n 3)
        0
      (let ((right (- n 1)))
        (verina-advanced-62-rain-aux
         heights
         0
         right
         (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero 0 heights)
         (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero right heights)
         0
         right)))))

;; These recursions encode the postcondition's local ML and MR functions.
;; MAX-LEFT-AT includes indices 0 through I. MAX-RIGHT-AT includes indices I
;; through the final list position.

(defun verina-advanced-62-max-left-loop
    (heights index remaining max-so-far)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      max-so-far
    (verina-advanced-62-max-left-loop
     heights
     (+ index 1)
     (- remaining 1)
     (verina-advanced-62-int-max
      max-so-far
      (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
       index
       heights)))))

(defun verina-advanced-62-max-left-at (heights index)
  (if (natp index)
      (verina-advanced-62-max-left-loop
       heights
       0
       (+ index 1)
       0)
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-62-max-right-loop
    (heights index remaining max-so-far)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      max-so-far
    (verina-advanced-62-max-right-loop
     heights
     (+ index 1)
     (- remaining 1)
     (verina-advanced-62-int-max
      max-so-far
      (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
       index
       heights)))))

(defun verina-advanced-62-max-right-at (heights index)
  (if (natp index)
      (verina-advanced-62-max-right-loop
       heights
       index
       (nfix (- (len heights) index))
       0)
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-62-water-at (heights index)
  (verina-advanced-62-int-max
   0
   (-
    (verina-advanced-62-int-min
     (verina-advanced-62-max-left-at heights index)
     (verina-advanced-62-max-right-at heights index))
    (verina-advanced-62-nth-default-zero
     index
     heights))))

;; INDEX and REMAINING reproduce the postcondition's SUM-WATER recursion over
;; every index of the list in increasing order.

(defun verina-advanced-62-sum-water-loop
    (heights index remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      accumulator
    (verina-advanced-62-sum-water-loop
     heights
     (+ index 1)
     (- remaining 1)
     (+
      accumulator
      (verina-advanced-62-water-at
       heights
       index)))))

(defun verina-advanced-62-sum-water (heights)
  (verina-advanced-62-sum-water-loop
   heights
   0
   (len heights)
   0))

(defun verina-advanced-62-rain-postcond
    (heights result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-62-integer-listp heights)
   (integerp result)
   (<= 0 result)
   (if (< (len heights) 3)
       (equal result 0)
     (equal
      result
      (verina-advanced-62-sum-water heights)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition connecting
;; the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun verina-advanced-62-rain-spec-satisfied-statement
    (heights)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-62-integer-listp heights)
    (verina-advanced-62-rain-precond heights))
   (verina-advanced-62-rain-postcond
    heights
    (verina-advanced-62-rain heights))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_62,
-- catalog title "rain": a deterministic two-pointer program computes trapped
-- rainwater on a nonnegative integer elevation list and is connected to the
-- prefix/suffix-maximum summation contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced62 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

chooseSet : Bool → Set → Set → Set
chooseSet true when-true when-false = when-true
chooseSet false when-true when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natGreaterOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natGreaterOrEqual m n = natLessOrEqual n m

predecessor : Nat → Nat
predecessor zero = zero
predecessor (suc n) = n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

intMin : Int → Int → Int
intMin x y =
  if intLess x y
  then x
  else y

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

nthDefault : {A : Set} → A → Nat → List A → A
nthDefault default zero [] = default
nthDefault default zero (x ∷ xs) = x
nthDefault default (suc n) [] = default
nthDefault default (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  nthDefault default n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

nonnegative : Int → Bool
nonnegative value = intLessOrEqual zeroInt value

rain-precond : List Int → Set
rain-precond heights =
  IsTrue (allList nonnegative heights)

rainAuxWithFuel :
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Int →
  Int →
  Int →
  Int
rainAuxWithFuel zero heights left right leftMax rightMax water =
  water
rainAuxWithFuel
  (suc fuel)
  heights
  left
  right
  leftMax
  rightMax
  water =
  if natGreaterOrEqual left right
  then water
  else
    let left-height = nthDefault zeroInt left heights
        right-height = nthDefault zeroInt right heights
    in
      if intLessOrEqual left-height right-height
      then (
        let new-left-max = intMax leftMax left-height
            new-water =
              intAdd
                water
                (intMax
                  zeroInt
                  (intSubtract leftMax left-height))
        in
          rainAuxWithFuel
            fuel
            heights
            (suc left)
            right
            new-left-max
            rightMax
            new-water)
      else (
        let new-right-max = intMax rightMax right-height
            new-water =
              intAdd
                water
                (intMax
                  zeroInt
                  (intSubtract rightMax right-height))
        in
          rainAuxWithFuel
            fuel
            heights
            left
            (predecessor right)
            leftMax
            new-right-max
            new-water)

three : Nat
three = suc (suc (suc zero))

rain :
  (heights : List Int) →
  rain-precond heights →
  Int
rain heights h-precond =
  let n = listLength heights
  in
    if natLess n three
    then zeroInt
    else
      rainAuxWithFuel
        n
        heights
        zero
        (predecessor n)
        (nthDefault zeroInt zero heights)
        (nthDefault zeroInt (predecessor n) heights)
        zeroInt

maxLeftLoop :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Int →
  Int →
  Int
maxLeftLoop zero index heights maximum = maximum
maxLeftLoop (suc fuel) index heights maximum =
  maxLeftLoop
    fuel
    (suc index)
    heights
    (intMax maximum (nthDefault zeroInt index heights))

maxLeftAt : List Int → Nat → Int
maxLeftAt heights index =
  maxLeftLoop (suc index) zero heights zeroInt

maxListFromZero : List Int → Int
maxListFromZero [] = zeroInt
maxListFromZero (x ∷ xs) =
  intMax x (maxListFromZero xs)

maxRightAt : List Int → Nat → Int
maxRightAt heights index =
  maxListFromZero (dropList index heights)

waterAt : List Int → Nat → Int
waterAt heights index =
  intMax
    zeroInt
    (intSubtract
      (intMin
        (maxLeftAt heights index)
        (maxRightAt heights index))
      (nthDefault zeroInt index heights))

sumWaterFrom :
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Int →
  List Int →
  Int
sumWaterFrom heights index accumulator [] = accumulator
sumWaterFrom heights index accumulator (_ ∷ xs) =
  sumWaterFrom
    heights
    (suc index)
    (intAdd accumulator (waterAt heights index))
    xs

sumWater : List Int → Int
sumWater heights =
  sumWaterFrom heights zero zeroInt heights

rain-postcond :
  (heights : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  rain-precond heights →
  Set
rain-postcond heights result h-precond =
  IsTrue (intLessOrEqual zeroInt result) ∧
  chooseSet
    (natLess (listLength heights) three)
    (result ≡ zeroInt)
    (result ≡ sumWater heights)

rain-spec-satisfied : Set
rain-spec-satisfied =
  (heights : List Int) →
  (h-precond : rain-precond heights) →
  rain-postcond
    heights
    (rain heights h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_62,
  cataloged as "rain": the executable two-pointer program computes trapped
  rainwater for a nonnegative integer elevation list and satisfies the stated
  prefix/suffix-maximum summation contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val rain_precond_def = new_definition (
  "rain_precond_def",
  ``rain_precond (heights : int list) <=>
      EVERY (\h : int. 0 <= h) heights``
);

val rain_getDefault_def = new_definition (
  "rain_getDefault_def",
  ``rain_getDefault (heights : int list) (index : num) =
      if index < LENGTH heights then EL index heights else (0 : int)``
);

val rain_intMax_def = new_definition (
  "rain_intMax_def",
  ``rain_intMax (x : int) (y : int) =
      if x <= y then y else x``
);

val rain_intMin_def = new_definition (
  "rain_intMin_def",
  ``rain_intMin (x : int) (y : int) =
      if x <= y then x else y``
);

val rain_nonnegativePart_def = new_definition (
  "rain_nonnegativePart_def",
  ``rain_nonnegativePart (x : int) =
      if 0 <= x then x else 0``
);

val rain_aux_def = Define `
  (rain_aux
      0
      (heights : int list)
      (left : num)
      (right : num)
      (leftMax : int)
      (rightMax : int)
      (water : int) =
     water) /\
  (rain_aux
      (SUC fuel)
      heights
      left
      right
      leftMax
      rightMax
      water =
     if right <= left then
       water
     else if
       rain_getDefault heights left <=
       rain_getDefault heights right
     then
       let height = rain_getDefault heights left in
         rain_aux
           fuel
           heights
           (left + 1)
           right
           (rain_intMax leftMax height)
           rightMax
           (water + rain_nonnegativePart (leftMax - height))
     else
       let height = rain_getDefault heights right in
         rain_aux
           fuel
           heights
           left
           (right - 1)
           leftMax
           (rain_intMax rightMax height)
           (water + rain_nonnegativePart (rightMax - height)))
`;

val rain_def = new_definition (
  "rain_def",
  ``rain (heights : int list) =
      if LENGTH heights < 3 then
        (0 : int)
      else
        let n = LENGTH heights in
          rain_aux
            (n - 1)
            heights
            0
            (n - 1)
            (rain_getDefault heights 0)
            (rain_getDefault heights (n - 1))
            0``
);

val rain_leftMaxLoop_def = Define `
  (rain_leftMaxLoop
      0
      (heights : int list)
      (index : num)
      (maximum : int) =
     maximum) /\
  (rain_leftMaxLoop
      (SUC fuel)
      heights
      index
      maximum =
     rain_leftMaxLoop
       fuel
       heights
       (index + 1)
       (rain_intMax maximum (rain_getDefault heights index)))
`;

val rain_maxLeftAt_def = new_definition (
  "rain_maxLeftAt_def",
  ``rain_maxLeftAt (heights : int list) (index : num) =
      rain_leftMaxLoop (index + 1) heights 0 0``
);

val rain_rightMaxLoop_def = Define `
  (rain_rightMaxLoop ([] : int list) (maximum : int) =
     maximum) /\
  (rain_rightMaxLoop (height::remaining) maximum =
     rain_rightMaxLoop
       remaining
       (rain_intMax maximum height))
`;

val rain_maxRightAt_def = new_definition (
  "rain_maxRightAt_def",
  ``rain_maxRightAt (heights : int list) (index : num) =
      rain_rightMaxLoop (DROP index heights) 0``
);

val rain_waterAt_def = new_definition (
  "rain_waterAt_def",
  ``rain_waterAt (heights : int list) (index : num) =
      rain_nonnegativePart
        (rain_intMin
           (rain_maxLeftAt heights index)
           (rain_maxRightAt heights index) -
         rain_getDefault heights index)``
);

val rain_sumWater_def = Define `
  (rain_sumWater
      0
      (heights : int list)
      (index : num)
      (accumulator : int) =
     accumulator) /\
  (rain_sumWater
      (SUC fuel)
      heights
      index
      accumulator =
     rain_sumWater
       fuel
       heights
       (index + 1)
       (accumulator + rain_waterAt heights index))
`;

val rain_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "rain_postcond_def",
  ``rain_postcond (heights : int list) (result : int) <=>
      0 <= result /\
      (if LENGTH heights < 3 then
         result = 0
       else
         result =
           rain_sumWater (LENGTH heights) heights 0 0)``
);

val rain_spec_satisfied =
  ``!heights : int list.
      rain_precond heights ==>
      rain_postcond heights (rain heights)``;

title: verina_advanced_62
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_62 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_62), catalog title
  rain: the exact two-pointer program computes trapped rainwater for an
  arbitrary finite list of nonnegative integer heights, with the independent
  per-position maximum-and-sum correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA62GetBang reproduces Lean's zero-default list indexing. VERINA62NatSub
  is truncated natural subtraction, while VERINA62IntMin and VERINA62IntMax
  are integer minimum and maximum.

  VERINA62State stores, in order, left, right, leftMax, rightMax, and water.
  VERINA62Step is exactly one nonterminal branch of the source aux recursion:
  it processes the left entry when that height is at most the right entry,
  and otherwise processes the right entry. VERINA62AuxGraph records the
  complete deterministic trace until left is at least right, and returns the
  terminal water component. VERINA62Rain preserves the source branch returning
  zero below length three and otherwise initializes aux at both endpoints.

  VERINA62MaxLeftGraph is the exact ml recursion from zero through index i.
  VERINA62MaxRightGraph is the exact mr recursion from index i through the end.
  VERINA62WaterAt applies the source max-zero formula, and
  VERINA62SumWaterGraph is the exact sum_water recursion from index zero and
  accumulator zero. These traces define the postcondition independently of
  the two-pointer implementation.

  VERINA62Pre is precisely the source List.all nonnegativity requirement on a
  typed List Int input. VERINA62Post preserves nonnegativity of the result and
  both branches of the source postcondition. The proof-valued precondition
  argument is computationally and propositionally unused and is represented
  by the explicit antecedent of the final correctness assertion. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition, and this database has no
  $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA62GetBang VERINA62NatSub
  VERINA62IntMin VERINA62IntMax
  VERINA62State VERINA62Step
  VERINA62AuxGraph VERINA62Aux
  VERINA62Pre VERINA62Rain
  VERINA62MaxLeftGraph VERINA62MaxLeftAt
  VERINA62MaxRightGraph VERINA62MaxRightAt
  VERINA62WaterAt
  VERINA62SumWaterGraph VERINA62SumWater
  VERINA62Post
$.

verina62-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62GetBang A B ) $.
verina62-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62NatSub A B ) $.
verina62-int-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62IntMin A B ) $.
verina62-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62IntMax A B ) $.
verina62-state-syntax
  $a class VERINA62State $.
verina62-step-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62Step A B ) $.
verina62-aux-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62AuxGraph A B C ) $.
verina62-aux-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62Aux A B ) $.
verina62-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62Pre A ) $.
verina62-rain-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62Rain A ) $.
verina62-max-left-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62MaxLeftGraph A B C ) $.
verina62-max-left-at-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62MaxLeftAt A B ) $.
verina62-max-right-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62MaxRightGraph A B C ) $.
verina62-max-right-at-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62MaxRightAt A B ) $.
verina62-water-at-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62WaterAt A B ) $.
verina62-sum-water-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62SumWaterGraph A B ) $.
verina62-sum-water-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA62SumWater A ) $.
verina62-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA62Post A B ) $.

verina62-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verina62-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verina62-int-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62IntMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

verina62-int-max-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62IntMax A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  B ,
  A
) $.

verina62-state-definition $a |- VERINA62State = (
  NN0 X. ( NN0 X. ( ZZ X. ( ZZ X. ZZ ) ) )
) $.

verina62-step-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62Step A B
) = if (
  (
    VERINA62GetBang
      A
      ( 1st ` B )
  ) <_ (
    VERINA62GetBang
      A
      ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` B ) )
  )
  ,
  <.
    ( ( 1st ` B ) + 1 )
    ,
    <.
      ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` B ) )
      ,
      <.
        (
          VERINA62IntMax
            ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) )
            (
              VERINA62GetBang
                A
                ( 1st ` B )
            )
        )
        ,
        <.
          ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) ) )
          ,
          (
            ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) ) )
            +
            (
              VERINA62IntMax
                0
                (
                  ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) )
                  -
                  (
                    VERINA62GetBang
                      A
                      ( 1st ` B )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
        >.
      >.
    >.
  >.
  ,
  <.
    ( 1st ` B )
    ,
    <.
      (
        VERINA62NatSub
          ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` B ) )
          1
      )
      ,
      <.
        ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) )
        ,
        <.
          (
            VERINA62IntMax
              ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) ) )
              (
                VERINA62GetBang
                  A
                  ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` B ) )
              )
          )
          ,
          (
            ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) ) )
            +
            (
              VERINA62IntMax
                0
                (
                  ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` B ) ) ) )
                  -
                  (
                    VERINA62GetBang
                      A
                      ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` B ) )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
        >.
      >.
    >.
  >.
) $.

${
  $d i k t A B C $.

  verina62-aux-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA62AuxGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. VERINA62State
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. t e. Word VERINA62State
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = B
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              (
                1st ` ( t ` i )
              ) < (
                1st ` ( 2nd ` ( t ` i ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                t ` ( i + 1 )
              ) = (
                VERINA62Step A ( t ` i )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            (
              1st ` ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
            ) <_ (
              1st ` ( t ` k )
            )
            /\
            C = (
              2nd ` (
                2nd ` (
                  2nd ` (
                    2nd ` ( t ` k )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina62-aux-definition $a |- (
    VERINA62Aux A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA62AuxGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verina62-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA62Pre A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      0 <_ ( A ` i )
  ) $.
$}

verina62-rain-definition $a |- (
  VERINA62Rain A
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) < 3 ,
  0 ,
  (
    VERINA62Aux
      A
      <.
        0
        ,
        <.
          ( VERINA62NatSub ( # ` A ) 1 )
          ,
          <.
            ( VERINA62GetBang A 0 )
            ,
            <.
              (
                VERINA62GetBang
                  A
                  ( VERINA62NatSub ( # ` A ) 1 )
              )
              ,
              0
            >.
          >.
        >.
      >.
  )
) $.

${
  $d k m A B C $.

  verina62-max-left-graph-definition $a |- (
