(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
   catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": executable enumeration and
   selection of the shortest binary substring containing exactly k ones, with
   lexicographic tie-breaking and its optimality contract. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition lean_char_code (c : lean_char) : N :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a => N.of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a)
  | LeanNonAscii code _ _ => code
  end.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  N.eqb (lean_char_code x) (lean_char_code y).

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_zero : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 48).

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_one : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 49).

Fixpoint lean_string_eqb (xs ys : lean_string) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (lean_char_eqb x y) (lean_string_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint lean_string_ltb (xs ys : lean_string) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => false
  | [], _ :: _ => true
  | _ :: _, [] => false
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      if lean_char_eqb x y
      then lean_string_ltb xs' ys'
      else N.ltb (lean_char_code x) (lean_char_code y)
  end.

Fixpoint lean_string_leb (xs ys : lean_string) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], _ => true
  | _ :: _, [] => false
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      if lean_char_eqb x y
      then lean_string_leb xs' ys'
      else N.ltb (lean_char_code x) (lean_char_code y)
  end.

Definition countOnes (lst : list lean_char) : nat :=
  fold_left
    (fun acc c =>
      if lean_char_eqb c shortestBeautifulSubstring_one
      then S acc
      else acc)
    lst 0.

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond
    (s : lean_string) (_k : nat) : Prop :=
  forallb
    (fun c =>
      orb
        (lean_char_eqb c shortestBeautifulSubstring_zero)
        (lean_char_eqb c shortestBeautifulSubstring_one))
    s = true.

Definition listToString (lst : list lean_char) : lean_string :=
  lst.

Definition isLexSmaller
    (a b : list lean_char) : bool :=
  lean_string_ltb (listToString a) (listToString b).

Definition allSubstrings
    (s : list lean_char) : list (list lean_char) :=
  let n := length s in
  flat_map
    (fun i =>
      map
        (fun j => firstn (S j) (skipn i s))
        (seq 0 (n - i)))
    (seq 0 n).

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare
    (a b : list lean_char) : bool :=
  orb
    (Nat.ltb (length a) (length b))
    (andb
      (Nat.eqb (length a) (length b))
      (isLexSmaller a b)).

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring
    (s : lean_string)
    (k : nat)
    (_h_precond : shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k)
    : lean_string :=
  let chars := s in
  let candidates :=
    filter
      (fun sub => Nat.eqb (countOnes sub) k)
      (allSubstrings chars) in
  let best :=
    fold_left
      (fun acc cur =>
        match acc with
        | None => Some cur
        | Some currentBest =>
            if shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare cur currentBest
            then Some cur
            else Some currentBest
        end)
      candidates None in
  match best with
  | Some b => listToString b
  | None => []
  end.

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_postSubstrings
    (chars : list lean_char) : list (list lean_char) :=
  flat_map
    (fun i =>
      map
        (fun len => firstn len (skipn i chars))
        (seq 0 (length chars - i + 1)))
    (seq 0 (length chars)).

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyb
    (s : lean_string) : bool :=
  match s with
  | [] => false
  | _ :: _ => true
  end.

Definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
    (s : lean_string)
    (k : nat)
    (result : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k) : Prop :=
  let chars := s in
  let substrings :=
    shortestBeautifulSubstring_postSubstrings chars in
  let beautiful :=
    filter
      (fun sub => Nat.eqb (countOnes sub) k)
      substrings in
  let targets :=
    filter
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyb
      (map listToString beautiful) in
  (result = [] /\ targets = []) \/
  (In result targets /\
   forall r,
     In r targets ->
     (length result < length r)%nat \/
     (length r = length result /\
      lean_string_leb result r = true)).

Theorem shortestBeautifulSubstring_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (k : nat)
    (h_precond : shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k) :
  shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
    s k (shortestBeautifulSubstring s k h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
  catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": an executable Unicode-scalar
  string program enumerates nonempty contiguous substrings and selects the
  shortest one containing exactly k ones, breaking length ties
  lexicographically, together with its binary-input precondition, postcondition,
  and final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_71
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_zero :: lean_char where
  "lean_zero =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True True False False False False)"

definition lean_one :: lean_char where
  "lean_one =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True True False False False True)"

fun lean_string_lt :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "lean_string_lt [] [] = False"
| "lean_string_lt [] (y # ys) = True"
| "lean_string_lt (x # xs) [] = False"
| "lean_string_lt (x # xs) (y # ys) =
    (lean_char_to_nat x < lean_char_to_nat y \<or>
     (x = y \<and> lean_string_lt xs ys))"

definition lean_string_le :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
  "lean_string_le a b \<longleftrightarrow> \<not> lean_string_lt b a"

definition countOnes :: "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countOnes lst =
    foldl (\<lambda>acc c. if c = lean_one then acc + 1 else acc) 0 lst"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k \<longleftrightarrow>
    list_all (\<lambda>c. c = lean_zero \<or> c = lean_one) s"

definition listToString :: "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "listToString lst = lst"

definition isLexSmaller ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_char list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isLexSmaller a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    lean_string_lt (listToString a) (listToString b)"

definition allSubstrings ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_char list list" where
  "allSubstrings s =
    (let n = length s
     in concat
       (map
         (\<lambda>i.
           map (\<lambda>j. take (j + 1) (drop i s)) [0..<n - i])
         [0..<n]))"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_char list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    length a < length b \<or>
    (length a = length b \<and> isLexSmaller a b)"

fun shortestBeautifulSubstring_select ::
    "lean_char list option \<Rightarrow>
     lean_char list \<Rightarrow>
     lean_char list option" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_select None cur = Some cur"
| "shortestBeautifulSubstring_select (Some best) cur =
    (if shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare cur best
     then Some cur
     else Some best)"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring s k =
    (let chars = s;
         candidates =
           filter (\<lambda>sub. countOnes sub = k) (allSubstrings chars);
         best = foldl shortestBeautifulSubstring_select None candidates
     in case best of
          Some b \<Rightarrow> listToString b
        | None \<Rightarrow> [])"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_post_substrings ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list list" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_post_substrings s =
    (let chars = s
     in concat
       (map
         (\<lambda>i.
           map
             (\<lambda>len. take len (drop i chars))
             [0..<length chars - i + 1])
         [0..<length chars]))"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_string list" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets s k =
    (let substrings = shortestBeautifulSubstring_post_substrings s;
         beautiful = filter (\<lambda>sub. countOnes sub = k) substrings
     in filter (\<lambda>target. target \<noteq> [])
          (map listToString beautiful))"

definition shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond s k result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let targets = shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets s k
     in (result = [] \<and> targets = []) \<or>
        (result \<in> set targets \<and>
         (\<forall>r \<in> set targets.
           length r > length result \<or>
           (length r = length result \<and>
            lean_string_le result r))))"

theorem shortestBeautifulSubstring_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k"
  shows
    "shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
      s k (shortestBeautifulSubstring s k)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
  catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": an executable binary-string
  search returns the shortest nonempty contiguous substring containing exactly
  k ones, breaking length ties lexicographically, together with its correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_validChar = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_string = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_string (s:num list) <=>
     ALL shortestBeautifulSubstring_validChar s`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes ([]:num list) = 0) /\
     (!c:num. !cs:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes (CONS c cs) =
        (if c = 49 then 1 else 0) +
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes cs)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond
      (s:num list) (k:num) <=>
     ALL (\c:num. c = 48 \/ c = 49) s`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString
      (chars:num list) = chars`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!b:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller
          ([]:num list) b <=> ~(b = [])) /\
     (!a:num. !as':num list. !b:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller
          (CONS a as') b <=>
        if b = [] then F
        else
          a < HD b \/
          (a = HD b /\
           shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller
             as' (TL b)))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe
     (a:num list) (b:num list) <=>
     a = b \/
     shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller a b`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(shortestBeautifulSubstring_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop 0 chars = chars) /\
     (!n:num. !chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop (SUC n) chars =
        if chars = [] then []
        else
          shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop n (TL chars))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_take 0 chars = []) /\
     (!n:num. !chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_take (SUC n) chars =
        if chars = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD chars)
            (shortestBeautifulSubstring_take n (TL chars)))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyAt = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyAt
      (chars:num list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\j:num.
          shortestBeautifulSubstring_take (j + 1)
            (shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop start chars))
       (shortestBeautifulSubstring_range
         (LENGTH chars - start))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyFrom
          chars ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyFrom
          chars (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyAt
            chars start)
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyFrom
            chars starts))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings
      (chars:num list) =
     shortestBeautifulSubstring_nonemptyFrom
       chars
       (shortestBeautifulSubstring_range
         (LENGTH chars))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare
      (a:num list) (b:num list) <=>
     LENGTH a < LENGTH b \/
     (LENGTH a = LENGTH b /\
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller a b)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_optionValue =
  new_recursive_definition option_RECURSION
    `(shortestBeautifulSubstring_optionValue
        (NONE:(num list)option) = []) /\
     (!chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_optionValue
          (SOME chars) = chars)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_updateBest = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_updateBest
      (best:(num list)option) (current:num list) =
     if best = NONE then SOME current
     else
       let previous =
         shortestBeautifulSubstring_optionValue best in
       if shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare
            current previous
       then SOME current
       else SOME previous`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_foldCandidates =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!best:(num list)option.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_foldCandidates
          ([]:(num list)list) best = best) /\
     (!current:num list. !rest:(num list)list.
      !best:(num list)option.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_foldCandidates
          (CONS current rest) best =
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_foldCandidates
          rest
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_updateBest
            best current))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring
      (s:num list) (k:num) =
     let chars = s in
     let candidates =
       FILTER
         (\sub:num list.
            shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes sub = k)
         (shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings
           chars) in
     let best =
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_foldCandidates
         candidates (NONE:(num list)option) in
     if best = NONE then []
     else
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString
         (shortestBeautifulSubstring_optionValue best)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesAt = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesAt
      (chars:num list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          shortestBeautifulSubstring_take len
            (shortestBeautifulSubstring_drop
              start chars))
       (shortestBeautifulSubstring_range
         (LENGTH chars - start + 1))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesFrom
          chars ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !chars:num list.
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesFrom
          chars (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesAt
            chars start)
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesFrom
            chars starts))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_postSubstrings =
  new_definition
    `shortestBeautifulSubstring_postSubstrings
        (chars:num list) =
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_slicesFrom
         chars
         (shortestBeautifulSubstring_range
           (LENGTH chars))`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond = new_definition
  `shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
      (s:num list) (k:num) (result:num list) <=>
     let chars = s in
     let substrings =
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_postSubstrings
         chars in
     let beautiful =
       FILTER
         (\sub:num list.
            shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes sub = k)
         substrings in
     let targets =
       FILTER
         (\target:num list. ~(target = []))
         (MAP
           shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString
           beautiful) in
     (result = [] /\ targets = []) \/
     (MEM result targets /\
      ALL
        (\r:num list.
           LENGTH r > LENGTH result \/
           (LENGTH r = LENGTH result /\
            shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe result r))
        targets)`;;

let shortestBeautifulSubstring_spec_satisfied =
  `!s:num list. !k:num.
     shortestBeautifulSubstring_string s
     ==> shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k
     ==> shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
           s k (shortestBeautifulSubstring s k)`;;

title: verina_advanced_71
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
;; "shortestBeautifulSubstring": a deterministic binary-string program selects
;; the shortest substring with exactly k ones, breaking ties lexicographically,
;; together with its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values. This preserves the full Char domain rather than restricting
;; strings to ACL2's host character set.

(defun verina-advanced-71-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-advanced-71-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-71-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-advanced-71-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

;; This accumulator recursion is countOnes: List.foldl increments exactly for
;; the Unicode scalar value of '1'.

(defun verina-advanced-71-count-ones-fold
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-71-count-ones-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (if (equal (car remaining) 49)
           (+ accumulator 1)
         accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-71-count-ones (characters)
  (verina-advanced-71-count-ones-fold characters 0))

;; The source precondition is String.toList.all over the two binary characters.
;; Its k argument is present but computationally unused, exactly as in Lean.

(defun verina-advanced-71-binary-characters-p (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (and
       (or
        (equal (car characters) 48)
        (equal (car characters) 49))
       (verina-advanced-71-binary-characters-p
        (cdr characters)))
    (equal characters nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring-precond
    (s k)
  (declare (ignore k))
  (verina-advanced-71-binary-characters-p s))

;; Under the canonical representation, String.mk and List.asString preserve
;; the represented scalar sequence exactly.

(defun verina-advanced-71-list-to-string (characters)
  characters)

;; UTF-8 string order on valid scalar sequences is the lexicographic scalar
;; order below. This is the source isLexSmaller helper.

(defun verina-advanced-71-lex-smaller-p (a b)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (+ (acl2-count a) (acl2-count b))))
  (if (consp a)
      (if (consp b)
          (if (< (car a) (car b))
              t
            (if (< (car b) (car a))
                nil
              (verina-advanced-71-lex-smaller-p
               (cdr a)
               (cdr b))))
        nil)
    (if (consp b) t nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-71-is-lex-smaller (a b)
  (verina-advanced-71-lex-smaller-p
   (verina-advanced-71-list-to-string a)
   (verina-advanced-71-list-to-string b)))

;; For a nonempty suffix, this constructs its prefixes in lengths 1, 2, ... .
;; Consequently all-substrings appends exactly the source List.range/flatMap
;; sequence: increasing start position, then increasing positive length.

(defun verina-advanced-71-prepend-to-each
    (char-code lists)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count lists)))
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons
       (cons char-code (car lists))
       (verina-advanced-71-prepend-to-each
        char-code
        (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-nonempty-prefixes (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (cons
       (list (car characters))
       (verina-advanced-71-prepend-to-each
        (car characters)
        (verina-advanced-71-nonempty-prefixes
         (cdr characters))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-all-substrings (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (append
       (verina-advanced-71-nonempty-prefixes characters)
       (verina-advanced-71-all-substrings
        (cdr characters)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-filter-by-count
    (substrings k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count substrings)))
  (if (consp substrings)
      (if (equal
           (verina-advanced-71-count-ones
            (car substrings))
           k)
          (cons
           (car substrings)
           (verina-advanced-71-filter-by-count
            (cdr substrings)
            k))
        (verina-advanced-71-filter-by-count
         (cdr substrings)
         k))
    nil))

;; This is the local compare function: strictly shorter first, followed by
;; strictly lexicographically smaller when lengths agree.

(defun verina-advanced-71-better-candidate-p (a b)
  (or
   (< (len a) (len b))
   (and
    (equal (len a) (len b))
    (verina-advanced-71-is-lex-smaller a b))))

;; The option is represented as nil for none and (:some . substring) for some.
;; The recursion is precisely candidates.foldl, including retention of the
;; earlier best candidate whenever compare is false.

(defun verina-advanced-71-best-fold
    (candidates best-option)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count candidates)))
  (if (consp candidates)
      (let ((current (car candidates)))
        (verina-advanced-71-best-fold
         (cdr candidates)
         (if (consp best-option)
             (if
                 (verina-advanced-71-better-candidate-p
                  current
                  (cdr best-option))
                 (cons :some current)
               best-option)
           (cons :some current))))
    best-option))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and is
;; erased. All source helper calls, filtering, folding, and the none/empty
;; fallback remain explicit.

(defun verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring
    (s k)
  (let* ((characters s)
         (candidates
          (verina-advanced-71-filter-by-count
           (verina-advanced-71-all-substrings characters)
           k))
         (best
          (verina-advanced-71-best-fold candidates nil)))
    (if (consp best)
        (verina-advanced-71-list-to-string (cdr best))
      nil)))

;; The postcondition has a distinct substring enumeration. For every source
;; start index it includes lengths 0 through the remaining length, so each
;; nonempty suffix contributes nil followed by all of its nonempty prefixes.

(defun verina-advanced-71-post-all-substrings (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (append
       (cons
        nil
        (verina-advanced-71-nonempty-prefixes characters))
       (verina-advanced-71-post-all-substrings
        (cdr characters)))
    nil))

;; This recursive map preserves the source beautiful.map List.asString,
;; including list order and duplicates.

(defun verina-advanced-71-map-list-to-string (substrings)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count substrings)))
  (if (consp substrings)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-71-list-to-string
        (car substrings))
       (verina-advanced-71-map-list-to-string
        (cdr substrings)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-filter-nonempty-strings (strings)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count strings)))
  (if (consp strings)
      (if (consp (car strings))
          (cons
           (car strings)
           (verina-advanced-71-filter-nonempty-strings
            (cdr strings)))
        (verina-advanced-71-filter-nonempty-strings
         (cdr strings)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-targets (s k)
  (verina-advanced-71-filter-nonempty-strings
   (verina-advanced-71-map-list-to-string
    (verina-advanced-71-filter-by-count
     (verina-advanced-71-post-all-substrings s)
     k))))

(defun verina-advanced-71-target-member-p
    (result targets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count targets)))
  (if (consp targets)
      (or
       (equal result (car targets))
       (verina-advanced-71-target-member-p
        result
        (cdr targets)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-71-lex-at-most-p (a b)
  (or
   (equal a b)
   (verina-advanced-71-lex-smaller-p a b)))

;; This is the postcondition's universal quantifier over target membership.

(defun verina-advanced-71-minimal-against-all-targets-p
    (result targets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count targets)))
  (if (consp targets)
      (and
       (or
        (< (len result) (len (car targets)))
        (and
         (equal (len result) (len (car targets)))
         (verina-advanced-71-lex-at-most-p
          result
          (car targets))))
       (verina-advanced-71-minimal-against-all-targets-p
        result
        (cdr targets)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring-postcond
    (s k result)
  (let ((targets (verina-advanced-71-targets s k)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-71-string-p s)
     (natp k)
     (verina-advanced-71-string-p result)
     (or
      (and
       (equal result nil)
       (equal targets nil))
      (and
       (verina-advanced-71-target-member-p result targets)
       (verina-advanced-71-minimal-against-all-targets-p
        result
        targets))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves both typed source binders and the complete precondition;
;; its conclusion applies the full postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring-spec-satisfied-statement
    (s k)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-71-string-p s)
    (natp k)
    (verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring-precond
     s
     k))
   (verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring-postcond
    s
    k
    (verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring s k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_71
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
-- catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": a deterministic substring search
-- returns the shortest binary substring containing exactly k ones, breaking
-- length ties lexicographically, and is connected to its full correctness
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced71 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primCharToNat)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using
  (String; primStringEquality; primStringFromList; primStringToList)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

boolAnd : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolAnd true value = value
boolAnd false value = false

boolOr : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolOr true value = true
boolOr false value = value

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

isBinaryChar : Char → Bool
isBinaryChar c =
  boolOr
    (primCharEquality c '0')
    (primCharEquality c '1')

countOnes : List Char → Nat
countOnes [] = zero
countOnes (c ∷ cs) =
  if primCharEquality c '1'
  then suc (countOnes cs)
  else countOnes cs

shortestBeautifulSubstring-precond : String → Nat → Set
shortestBeautifulSubstring-precond s k =
  IsTrue (allList isBinaryChar (primStringToList s))

charListLexLess : List Char → List Char → Bool
charListLexLess [] [] = false
charListLexLess [] (_ ∷ _) = true
charListLexLess (_ ∷ _) [] = false
charListLexLess (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  if natLess (primCharToNat x) (primCharToNat y)
  then true
  else
    if natEqual (primCharToNat x) (primCharToNat y)
    then charListLexLess xs ys
    else false

charListLexLessOrEqual : List Char → List Char → Bool
charListLexLessOrEqual xs ys =
  boolNot (charListLexLess ys xs)

listToString : List Char → String
listToString = primStringFromList

isLexSmaller : List Char → List Char → Bool
isLexSmaller a b = charListLexLess a b

allSubstrings : List Char → List (List Char)
allSubstrings chars =
  let n = listLength chars
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ i →
        mapList
          (λ j →
            takeList (suc j) (dropList i chars))
          (range (natSubtract n i)))
      (range n)

compareCandidates : List Char → List Char → Bool
compareCandidates a b =
  boolOr
    (natLess (listLength a) (listLength b))
    (boolAnd
      (natEqual (listLength a) (listLength b))
      (isLexSmaller a b))

foldBest :
  Maybe (List Char) →
  List (List Char) →
  Maybe (List Char)
foldBest best [] = best
foldBest nothing (current ∷ rest) =
  foldBest (just current) rest
foldBest (just best) (current ∷ rest) =
  if compareCandidates current best
  then foldBest (just current) rest
  else foldBest (just best) rest

shortestBeautifulSubstring :
  (s : String) →
  (k : Nat) →
  shortestBeautifulSubstring-precond s k →
  String
shortestBeautifulSubstring s k h-precond =
  let chars = primStringToList s
      candidates =
        filterList
          (λ substring →
            natEqual (countOnes substring) k)
          (allSubstrings chars)
      best = foldBest nothing candidates
  in resultString best
  where
  resultString : Maybe (List Char) → String
  resultString nothing = primStringFromList []
  resultString (just chars) = listToString chars

allSubstringsIncludingEmpty : List Char → List (List Char)
allSubstringsIncludingEmpty chars =
  let n = listLength chars
  in
    flatMapList
      (λ i →
        mapList
          (λ length →
            takeList length (dropList i chars))
          (range (suc (natSubtract n i))))
      (range n)

stringNotEmpty : String → Bool
stringNotEmpty s =
  boolNot (primStringEquality s (primStringFromList []))

stringMember : String → List String → Bool
stringMember sought [] = false
stringMember sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if primStringEquality sought x
  then true
  else stringMember sought xs

StringLessOrEqual : String → String → Set
StringLessOrEqual x y =
  IsTrue
    (charListLexLessOrEqual
      (primStringToList x)
      (primStringToList y))

TargetNoShorter : String → String → Set
TargetNoShorter result target =
  IsTrue
    (natLess
      (listLength (primStringToList result))
      (listLength (primStringToList target))) ∨
  ((listLength (primStringToList target) ≡
      listLength (primStringToList result)) ∧
    StringLessOrEqual result target)

AllTargetsNoShorter : String → List String → Set
AllTargetsNoShorter result [] = Top
AllTargetsNoShorter result (target ∷ targets) =
  TargetNoShorter result target ∧
  AllTargetsNoShorter result targets

shortestBeautifulSubstring-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (result : String) →
  shortestBeautifulSubstring-precond s k →
  Set
shortestBeautifulSubstring-postcond s k result h-precond =
  let chars = primStringToList s
      substrings = allSubstringsIncludingEmpty chars
      beautiful =
        filterList
          (λ substring →
            natEqual (countOnes substring) k)
          substrings
      targets =
        filterList
          stringNotEmpty
          (mapList listToString beautiful)
      emptyString = primStringFromList []
  in
    ((result ≡ emptyString) ∧ (targets ≡ [])) ∨
    (IsTrue (stringMember result targets) ∧
      AllTargetsNoShorter result targets)

shortestBeautifulSubstring-spec-satisfied : Set
shortestBeautifulSubstring-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (h-precond : shortestBeautifulSubstring-precond s k) →
  shortestBeautifulSubstring-postcond
    s
    k
    (shortestBeautifulSubstring s k h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_71
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_71,
  catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": the executable program selects
  the shortest nonempty contiguous substring of a binary string containing
  exactly k ones, breaking equal-length ties lexicographically and returning
  the empty string when none exists. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes_def = Define `
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes ([] : num list) = 0) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes (c::cs) =
     (if c = 49 then 1 else 0) +
     shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes cs)
`;

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond
      (s : num list) (k : num) <=>
      EVERY (\c : num. c = 48 \/ c = 49) s``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt_def = Define `
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt
      ([] : num list) ([] : num list) = F) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt
      ([] : num list) (y::ys) = T) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt
      (x::xs) ([] : num list) = F) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt
      (x::xs) (y::ys) =
     if x < y then
       T
     else if x = y then
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt xs ys
     else
       F)
`;

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe_def = Define `
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe
      ([] : num list) (ys : num list) = T) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe
      (x::xs) ([] : num list) = F) /\
  (shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe
      (x::xs) (y::ys) =
     if x < y then
       T
     else if x = y then
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe xs ys
     else
       F)
`;

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString (lst : num list) = lst``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller
      (a : num list) (b : num list) <=>
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLt
        (shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString a)
        (shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString b)``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings (s : num list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\i : num.
            MAP
              (\j : num. TAKE (j + 1) (DROP i s))
              (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH s - i)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH s)))``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare
      (a : num list) (b : num list) <=>
      LENGTH a < LENGTH b \/
      (LENGTH a = LENGTH b /\
       shortestBeautifulSubstring_isLexSmaller a b)``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_step_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_step_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_step
      (acc : num list option) (cur : num list) =
      case acc of
        NONE => SOME cur
      | SOME best =>
          if shortestBeautifulSubstring_compare cur best then
            SOME cur
          else
            SOME best``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring (s : num list) (k : num) =
      let chars = s in
      let candidates =
        FILTER
          (\sub : num list.
            shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes sub = k)
          (shortestBeautifulSubstring_allSubstrings chars)
      in
      let best =
        FOLDL
          shortestBeautifulSubstring_step
          (NONE : num list option)
          candidates
      in
        case best of
          NONE => ([] : num list)
        | SOME b => b``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_specSubstrings_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_specSubstrings_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_specSubstrings (s : num list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\i : num.
            MAP
              (\len : num. TAKE len (DROP i s))
              (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH s - i + 1)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH s)))``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets
      (s : num list) (k : num) =
      let substrings =
        shortestBeautifulSubstring_specSubstrings s
      in
      let beautiful =
        FILTER
          (\sub : num list.
            shortestBeautifulSubstring_countOnes sub = k)
          substrings
      in
        FILTER
          (\str : num list. str <> [])
          (MAP shortestBeautifulSubstring_listToString beautiful)``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond_def",
  ``shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
      (s : num list)
      (k : num)
      (result : num list) <=>
      let targets = shortestBeautifulSubstring_targets s k in
        (result = [] /\ targets = []) \/
        (MEM result targets /\
         EVERY
           (\r : num list.
             LENGTH result < LENGTH r \/
             (LENGTH r = LENGTH result /\
              shortestBeautifulSubstring_lexLe result r))
           targets)``
);

val shortestBeautifulSubstring_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(s : num list) (k : num).
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k ==>
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
        s k (shortestBeautifulSubstring s k)``;

title: verina_advanced_71
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_71 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_71), catalog title
  shortestBeautifulSubstring: the exact substring enumeration, stable
  filtering, and option-valued minimum fold return the shortest nonempty
  binary substring containing exactly k ones, breaking length ties
  lexicographically, together with the full correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINA71Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINA71Char represents arbitrary Lean strings extensionally through
  String.data and String.toList. VERINA71Chars, VERINA71ListToString, and
  VERINA71StringMk are therefore the exact source conversions on this word
  representation. The natural values ; 4 8 and ; 4 9 represent '0' and '1'.

  VERINA71CountOnes is the source foldl countOnes: it is the cardinality of
  precisely the input positions containing '1'. VERINA71Slice is exact
  List.drop followed by List.take, including arbitrary natural arguments.

  VERINA71AllSubstringsGraph reproduces the implementation helper's nested
  List.range/flatMap/map order: starts increase first and, at each start,
  positive lengths increase from one through the remaining suffix length.
  VERINA71CandidatesGraph is the exact stable filter retaining occurrences
  whose countOnes value is k.

  VERINA71LexLT is Lean's lexicographic List Char and String order: a proper
  prefix is smaller, otherwise the first differing Unicode scalar value
  decides. VERINA71IsLexSmaller is the source helper on String.mk results,
  and VERINA71Compare is the implementation's strict length-first order.
  VERINA71BestGraph records the exact left fold from none: the first
  candidate becomes the best, and every later candidate replaces it exactly
  when VERINA71Compare holds. VERINA71ShortestBeautifulSubstring performs
  the source final option match, so its output is fixed independently of the
  postcondition and the graph admits no extra program results.

  VERINA71PostSubstringsGraph separately reproduces the postcondition's
  nested enumeration, including length zero before filtering.
  VERINA71TargetsGraph then performs its countOnes filter, String.asString
  map, and nonempty filter stably and occurrence-by-occurrence.
  VERINA71Post preserves both source disjuncts and the non-strict
  lexicographic tie condition. VERINA71Pre is the complete binary-string
  precondition with typed String and Nat arguments. The proof-valued
  precondition parameters are computationally and propositionally unused and
  are represented by the explicit antecedent of the final correctness
  assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by
  this rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA71Char
  VERINA71Chars VERINA71ListToString VERINA71StringMk
  VERINA71CountOnes VERINA71NatMin
  VERINA71SliceGraph VERINA71Slice
  VERINA71AllSubstringsGraph VERINA71AllSubstrings
  VERINA71CandidatesGraph VERINA71Candidates
  VERINA71LexLT VERINA71LexLE VERINA71IsLexSmaller VERINA71Compare
  VERINA71None VERINA71Some VERINA71OptionString
  VERINA71BestGraph VERINA71Best
  VERINA71Pre VERINA71ShortestBeautifulSubstring
  VERINA71PostSubstringsGraph VERINA71PostSubstrings
  VERINA71TargetsGraph VERINA71Targets
  VERINA71Post
$.

verina71-char-syntax
  $a class VERINA71Char $.
verina71-chars-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Chars A ) $.
verina71-list-to-string-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71ListToString A ) $.
verina71-string-mk-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71StringMk A ) $.
verina71-count-ones-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71CountOnes A ) $.
verina71-nat-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71NatMin A B ) $.
verina71-slice-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71SliceGraph A B C D ) $.
verina71-slice-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Slice A B C ) $.
verina71-all-substrings-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71AllSubstringsGraph A B ) $.
verina71-all-substrings-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71AllSubstrings A ) $.
verina71-candidates-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71CandidatesGraph A B C ) $.
verina71-candidates-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Candidates A B ) $.
verina71-lex-lt-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71LexLT A B ) $.
verina71-lex-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71LexLE A B ) $.
verina71-is-lex-smaller-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71IsLexSmaller A B ) $.
verina71-compare-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71Compare A B ) $.
verina71-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA71None $.
verina71-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Some A ) $.
verina71-option-string-syntax
  $a class VERINA71OptionString $.
verina71-best-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71BestGraph A B ) $.
verina71-best-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Best A ) $.
verina71-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71Pre A B ) $.
verina71-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71ShortestBeautifulSubstring A B ) $.
verina71-post-substrings-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71PostSubstringsGraph A B ) $.
verina71-post-substrings-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71PostSubstrings A ) $.
verina71-targets-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71TargetsGraph A B C ) $.
verina71-targets-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA71Targets A B ) $.
verina71-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA71Post A B C ) $.

verina71-char-definition $a |- VERINA71Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verina71-chars-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71Chars A
) = A $.

verina71-list-to-string-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71ListToString A
) = A $.

verina71-string-mk-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71StringMk A
) = A $.

${
  $d i A $.

  verina71-count-ones-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71CountOnes A
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = ; 4 9
    }
  ) $.
$}

verina71-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verina71-slice-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71SliceGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA71Char
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. NN0
        /\
        D e. Word VERINA71Char
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        # ` D
      ) = (
        VERINA71NatMin
          C
          (
            ( # ` A )
            -
            ( VERINA71NatMin B ( # ` A ) )
          )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` D ) )
        (
          D ` i
        ) = (
          A ` (
            ( VERINA71NatMin B ( # ` A ) ) + i
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina71-slice-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Slice A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA71Char
      ( VERINA71SliceGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j l p q A B $.

  verina71-all-substrings-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71AllSubstringsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA71Char
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                (
                  1 <_ ( 2nd ` ( p ` q ) )
                  /\
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` q ) ) <_ (
                    ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) )
                  )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                B ` q
              ) = (
                VERINA71Slice
                  A
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) )
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` q ) )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                    <
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                      =
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                      <
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            A. l e. (
              1 ..^ ( ( ( # ` A ) - i ) + 1 )
            )
              E. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` q ) = <. i , l >.
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina71-all-substrings-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71AllSubstrings A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
      ( VERINA71AllSubstringsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p q A B C $.

  verina71-candidates-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71CandidatesGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA71Char
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                p ` i
              ) < (
                # ` ( VERINA71AllSubstrings A )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  C ` i
                ) = (
                  ( VERINA71AllSubstrings A ) ` ( p ` i )
                )
                /\
                (
                  VERINA71CountOnes ( C ` i )
                ) = B
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. q e. (
            0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINA71AllSubstrings A ) )
          )
            (
              (
                VERINA71CountOnes
                  ( ( VERINA71AllSubstrings A ) ` q )
              ) = B
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = q
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina71-candidates-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Candidates A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
      ( VERINA71CandidatesGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i p A B $.

  verina71-lex-lt-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71LexLT A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA71Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA71Char
    )
    /\
    (
      E. p e. (
        0 ..^ (
          VERINA71NatMin ( # ` A ) ( # ` B )
        )
      )
        (
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              ( A ` i ) = ( B ` i )
          )
          /\
          ( A ` p ) < ( B ` p )
        )
      \/
      (
        ( # ` A ) < ( # ` B )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( A ` i ) = ( B ` i )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina71-lex-le-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71LexLE A B
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA71Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA71Char
    )
    /\
    -. ( VERINA71LexLT B A )
  )
) $.

verina71-is-lex-smaller-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71IsLexSmaller A B
) <-> (
  VERINA71LexLT
    ( VERINA71ListToString A )
    ( VERINA71ListToString B )
) $.

verina71-compare-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71Compare A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word VERINA71Char
    /\
    B e. Word VERINA71Char
  )
  /\
  (
    ( # ` A ) < ( # ` B )
    \/
    (
      ( # ` A ) = ( # ` B )
      /\
      ( VERINA71IsLexSmaller A B )
    )
  )
) $.

verina71-none-definition $a |- VERINA71None = (/) $.

verina71-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina71-option-string-definition $a |- VERINA71OptionString =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA71None
        \/
        E. y e. Word VERINA71Char
          x = ( VERINA71Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d i t A B $.

  verina71-best-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71BestGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
      /\
      B e. VERINA71OptionString
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        A = (/)
        /\
        B = VERINA71None
      )
      \/
      (
        A =/= (/)
        /\
        E. t e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
          (
            (
              (
                ( # ` t ) = ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( t ` 0 ) = ( A ` 0 )
              )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 1 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  t ` i
                ) = if (
                  (
                    VERINA71Compare
                      ( A ` i )
                      ( t ` ( i - 1 ) )
                  ) ,
                  ( A ` i ) ,
                  ( t ` ( i - 1 ) )
                )
            )
            /\
            B = (
              VERINA71Some
                ( t ` ( ( # ` A ) - 1 ) )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina71-best-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Best A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINA71OptionString
      ( VERINA71BestGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina71-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Pre A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA71Char
      /\
      B e. NN0
    )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        ( A ` i ) = ; 4 8
        \/
        ( A ` i ) = ; 4 9
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina71-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA71ShortestBeautifulSubstring A B
) = if (
  (
    VERINA71Best
      ( VERINA71Candidates ( VERINA71Chars A ) B )
  ) = VERINA71None ,
  (/) ,
  (
    2nd ` (
      VERINA71Best
        ( VERINA71Candidates ( VERINA71Chars A ) B )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d i j l p q A B $.

  verina71-post-substrings-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71PostSubstringsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA71Char
      /\
      B e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( 2nd ` ( p ` q ) ) <_ (
                  ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                B ` q
              ) = (
                VERINA71Slice
                  A
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` q ) )
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` q ) )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                    <
                    ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                      =
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                      <
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` j ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            A. l e. (
              0 ..^ ( ( ( # ` A ) - i ) + 1 )
            )
              E. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` q ) = <. i , l >.
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina71-post-substrings-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71PostSubstrings A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
      ( VERINA71PostSubstringsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p q A B C $.

  verina71-targets-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71TargetsGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA71Char
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` C )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                p ` i
              ) < (
                # ` ( VERINA71PostSubstrings ( VERINA71Chars A ) )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  VERINA71CountOnes
                    (
                      ( VERINA71PostSubstrings
                          ( VERINA71Chars A ) ) ` ( p ` i )
                    )
                ) = B
                /\
                (
                  (
                    VERINA71PostSubstrings
                      ( VERINA71Chars A )
                  ) ` ( p ` i )
                ) =/= (/)
              )
              /\
              (
                C ` i
              ) = (
                VERINA71StringMk
                  (
                    (
                      VERINA71PostSubstrings
                        ( VERINA71Chars A )
                    ) ` ( p ` i )
                  )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
              )
          /\
          A. q e. (
            0 ..^ (
              # ` (
                VERINA71PostSubstrings ( VERINA71Chars A )
              )
            )
          )
            (
              (
                (
                  VERINA71CountOnes
                    (
                      ( VERINA71PostSubstrings
                          ( VERINA71Chars A ) ) ` q
                    )
                ) = B
                /\
                (
                  (
                    VERINA71PostSubstrings
                      ( VERINA71Chars A )
                  ) ` q
                ) =/= (/)
              )
              ->
              E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                ( p ` i ) = q
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina71-targets-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Targets A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( Word VERINA71Char )
      ( VERINA71TargetsGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r A B C $.

  verina71-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA71Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA71Char
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word VERINA71Char
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        C = (/)
        /\
        ( VERINA71Targets A B ) = (/)
      )
      \/
      (
        C e. ran ( VERINA71Targets A B )
        /\
        A. r e. ran ( VERINA71Targets A B )
          (
            ( # ` C ) < ( # ` r )
            \/
            (
              ( # ` C ) = ( # ` r )
              /\
              ( VERINA71LexLE C r )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s $.

  verina-advanced-71-shortest-beautiful-substring $a |-
    A. s e. Word VERINA71Char
      A. k e. NN0
        (
          ( VERINA71Pre s k )
          ->
          (
            VERINA71Post
              s
              k
              ( VERINA71ShortestBeautifulSubstring s k )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for s,result being FinSequence of NAT,
      k being Nat st
    (for p being Nat st p in dom s holds
      s/.p = 48 or s/.p = 49) &
    (ex countOnes being Function of NAT*,NAT,
        listToString being Function of NAT*,NAT*,
        isLexSmaller being Function of [:NAT*,NAT*:],BOOLEAN,
        allStarts,allWidths,candidatePositions being FinSequence of NAT,
        allSubstrings,candidates,bestStates being FinSequence of NAT*,
        hasBest being FinSequence of BOOLEAN st
      countOnes/.(<*>NAT) = 0 &
      (for c being Nat, tail being FinSequence of NAT holds
        ((c = 49 &
          countOnes/.(<*c*> ^ tail) = countOnes/.tail + 1) or
         (c <> 49 &
          countOnes/.(<*c*> ^ tail) = countOnes/.tail))) &
      (for chars being FinSequence of NAT holds
        listToString/.chars = chars) &
      (for a,b being FinSequence of NAT holds
        (isLexSmaller/.[a,b] = TRUE iff
          (ex p being Nat st
            p in dom a & p in dom b &
            (for q being Nat st 1 <= q & q < p holds
              a/.q = b/.q) &
            a/.p < b/.p) or
          (len a < len b &
            for q being Nat st q in dom a holds a/.q = b/.q))) &
      len allStarts = len allWidths &
      len allSubstrings = len allStarts &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom allStarts holds
        ex sub being FinSequence of NAT st
          sub = allSubstrings/.q &
          allStarts/.q < len s &
          1 <= allWidths/.q &
          allWidths/.q <= len s -' allStarts/.q &
          len sub = allWidths/.q &
          (for p being Nat st p in dom sub holds
            sub/.p = s/.(allStarts/.q + p))) &
      (for i,width being Nat st
        i < len s & 1 <= width & width <= len s -' i
      holds
        ex q being Nat st
          q in dom allStarts &
          allStarts/.q = i &
          allWidths/.q = width) &
      (for q,r being Nat st
        q in dom allStarts & r in dom allStarts & q < r
      holds
        allStarts/.q < allStarts/.r or
        (allStarts/.q = allStarts/.r &
          allWidths/.q < allWidths/.r)) &
      len candidatePositions = len candidates &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom candidatePositions holds
        candidatePositions/.q in dom allSubstrings &
        candidates/.q = allSubstrings/.(candidatePositions/.q) &
        countOnes/.(candidates/.q) = k) &
      (for q,r being Nat st
        q in dom candidatePositions &
        r in dom candidatePositions & q < r
      holds candidatePositions/.q < candidatePositions/.r) &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom allSubstrings holds
        (q in rng candidatePositions iff
          countOnes/.(allSubstrings/.q) = k)) &
      len bestStates = len candidates + 1 &
      len hasBest = len candidates + 1 &
      bestStates/.1 = <*>NAT &
      hasBest/.1 = FALSE &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom candidates holds
        hasBest/.(q + 1) = TRUE &
        ((hasBest/.q = FALSE &
            bestStates/.(q + 1) = candidates/.q) or
         (hasBest/.q = TRUE &
          (((len (candidates/.q) < len (bestStates/.q) or
              (len (candidates/.q) = len (bestStates/.q) &
                isLexSmaller/.[candidates/.q,bestStates/.q] = TRUE)) &
              bestStates/.(q + 1) = candidates/.q) or
           (not (len (candidates/.q) < len (bestStates/.q) or
              (len (candidates/.q) = len (bestStates/.q) &
                isLexSmaller/.[candidates/.q,bestStates/.q] = TRUE)) &
              bestStates/.(q + 1) = bestStates/.q))))) &
      ((hasBest/.(len candidates + 1) = TRUE &
          result = listToString/.(bestStates/.(len candidates + 1))) or
       (hasBest/.(len candidates + 1) = FALSE &
          result = <*>NAT)))
  holds
    ex countOnes being Function of NAT*,NAT,
       listToString being Function of NAT*,NAT*,
       isLexSmaller being Function of [:NAT*,NAT*:],BOOLEAN,
       postStarts,postWidths,beautifulPositions,targetPositions
         being FinSequence of NAT,
       postSubstrings,beautiful,targets being FinSequence of NAT* st
      countOnes/.(<*>NAT) = 0 &
      (for c being Nat, tail being FinSequence of NAT holds
        ((c = 49 &
          countOnes/.(<*c*> ^ tail) = countOnes/.tail + 1) or
         (c <> 49 &
          countOnes/.(<*c*> ^ tail) = countOnes/.tail))) &
      (for chars being FinSequence of NAT holds
        listToString/.chars = chars) &
      (for a,b being FinSequence of NAT holds
        (isLexSmaller/.[a,b] = TRUE iff
          (ex p being Nat st
            p in dom a & p in dom b &
            (for q being Nat st 1 <= q & q < p holds
              a/.q = b/.q) &
            a/.p < b/.p) or
          (len a < len b &
            for q being Nat st q in dom a holds a/.q = b/.q))) &
      len postStarts = len postWidths &
      len postSubstrings = len postStarts &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom postStarts holds
        ex sub being FinSequence of NAT st
          sub = postSubstrings/.q &
          postStarts/.q < len s &
          postWidths/.q <= len s -' postStarts/.q &
          len sub = postWidths/.q &
          (for p being Nat st p in dom sub holds
            sub/.p = s/.(postStarts/.q + p))) &
      (for i,width being Nat st
        i < len s & width <= len s -' i
      holds
        ex q being Nat st
          q in dom postStarts &
          postStarts/.q = i &
          postWidths/.q = width) &
      (for q,r being Nat st
        q in dom postStarts & r in dom postStarts & q < r
      holds
        postStarts/.q < postStarts/.r or
        (postStarts/.q = postStarts/.r &
          postWidths/.q < postWidths/.r)) &
      len beautifulPositions = len beautiful &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom beautifulPositions holds
        beautifulPositions/.q in dom postSubstrings &
        beautiful/.q = postSubstrings/.(beautifulPositions/.q) &
        countOnes/.(beautiful/.q) = k) &
      (for q,r being Nat st
        q in dom beautifulPositions &
        r in dom beautifulPositions & q < r
      holds beautifulPositions/.q < beautifulPositions/.r) &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom postSubstrings holds
        (q in rng beautifulPositions iff
          countOnes/.(postSubstrings/.q) = k)) &
      len targetPositions = len targets &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom targetPositions holds
        targetPositions/.q in dom beautiful &
        len (beautiful/.(targetPositions/.q)) <> 0 &
        targets/.q =
          listToString/.(beautiful/.(targetPositions/.q))) &
      (for q,r being Nat st
        q in dom targetPositions &
        r in dom targetPositions & q < r
      holds targetPositions/.q < targetPositions/.r) &
      (for q being Nat st q in dom beautiful holds
        (q in rng targetPositions iff len (beautiful/.q) <> 0)) &
      ((result = <*>NAT & len targets = 0) or
       (result in rng targets &
        for q being Nat st q in dom targets holds
          len (targets/.q) > len result or
          (len (targets/.q) = len result &
            (result = targets/.q or
              isLexSmaller/.[result,targets/.q] = TRUE))))
proof
end;

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_71, catalog title "shortestBeautifulSubstring": computing
% the shortest contiguous binary substring with exactly k ones, breaking ties
% lexicographically, with its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_71: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Lean String values are represented extensionally by their finite lists of
  % Unicode scalar characters, preserving the complete source string domain.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]
  lean_string_list: TYPE = list[lean_string]

  lean_string_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoLeanString: NoLeanString?
    SomeLeanString(string_value: lean_string): SomeLeanString?
  END lean_string_option

  countOnes(chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = 49 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + countOnes(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  all_binary(chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (head = 48 OR head = 49)
          AND all_binary(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond(
      s: lean_string,
      k: nat): bool =
    all_binary(s)

  listToString(chars: lean_string): lean_string =
    chars

  lean_string_length(chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        lean_string_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  % Lean's String order is the lexicographic order on its character list.
  lean_string_less(
      first, second: lean_string): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        CASES second OF
          null: FALSE,
          cons(second_head, second_tail): TRUE
        ENDCASES,
      cons(first_head, first_tail):
        CASES second OF
          null:
            FALSE,
          cons(second_head, second_tail):
            first_head < second_head
              OR
            (first_head = second_head
              AND lean_string_less(first_tail, second_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  isLexSmaller(a, b: lean_string): bool =
    lean_string_less(listToString(a), listToString(b))

  append_string_lists(
      first, second: lean_string_list):
        RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_string_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  prepend_char_to_each(
      requested: lean_char,
      values: lean_string_list):
        RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(requested, head),
          prepend_char_to_each(requested, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % For a nonempty character list this produces its prefixes of lengths
  % 1, 2, ..., length, in precisely the source List.range/map order.
  nonempty_prefixes(
      chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          cons(head, null[lean_char]),
          prepend_char_to_each(
            head,
            nonempty_prefixes(tail)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  % This is extensionally the source range/flatMap construction: all nonempty
  % substrings, ordered first by start index and then by increasing length.
  allSubstrings(
      chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        append_string_lists(
          nonempty_prefixes(chars),
          allSubstrings(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  filter_beautiful(
      values: lean_string_list,
      k: nat): RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF countOnes(head) = k THEN
          cons(head, filter_beautiful(tail, k))
        ELSE
          filter_beautiful(tail, k)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  compare_substrings(a, b: lean_string): bool =
    lean_string_length(a) < lean_string_length(b)
      OR
    (lean_string_length(a) = lean_string_length(b)
      AND isLexSmaller(a, b))

  % This recursion is exactly candidates.foldl with the source option-valued
  % accumulator and its strict comparison, including first-seen tie behavior.
  fold_best(
      candidates: lean_string_list,
      accumulator: lean_string_option):
        RECURSIVE lean_string_option =
    CASES candidates OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(current, remaining):
        CASES accumulator OF
          NoLeanString:
            fold_best(
              remaining,
              SomeLeanString(current)),
          SomeLeanString(best):
            IF compare_substrings(current, best) THEN
              fold_best(
                remaining,
                SomeLeanString(current))
            ELSE
              fold_best(
                remaining,
                SomeLeanString(best))
            ENDIF
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE candidates BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % This is the exact proof-erased executable substring/filter/fold program.
  shortestBeautifulSubstring(
      s: lean_string,
      k: nat): lean_string =
    LET chars: lean_string = s,
        candidates: lean_string_list =
          filter_beautiful(allSubstrings(chars), k),
        best: lean_string_option =
          fold_best(candidates, NoLeanString)
    IN
      CASES best OF
        NoLeanString:
          null[lean_char],
        SomeLeanString(value):
          listToString(value)
      ENDCASES

  % The postcondition's inner range includes the empty prefix as well as every
  % nonempty prefix of each suffix.
  prefixes_including_empty(
      chars: lean_string): lean_string_list =
    cons(
      null[lean_char],
      nonempty_prefixes(chars))

  postcondition_substrings(
      chars: lean_string): RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES chars OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        append_string_lists(
          prefixes_including_empty(chars),
          postcondition_substrings(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE chars BY <<

  map_listToString(
      values: lean_string_list):
        RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          listToString(head),
          map_listToString(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  filter_nonempty(
      values: lean_string_list):
        RECURSIVE lean_string_list =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_string],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head /= null[lean_char] THEN
          cons(head, filter_nonempty(tail))
        ELSE
          filter_nonempty(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  lean_string_member(
      requested: lean_string,
      values: lean_string_list): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        requested = head
          OR lean_string_member(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  lean_string_le(first, second: lean_string): bool =
    NOT lean_string_less(second, first)

  result_is_minimal(
      result: lean_string,
      targets: lean_string_list): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES targets OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (lean_string_length(head) > lean_string_length(result)
          OR
        (lean_string_length(head) = lean_string_length(result)
          AND lean_string_le(result, head)))
          AND result_is_minimal(result, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE targets BY <<

  shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      k: nat,
      result: lean_string): bool =
    LET chars: lean_string = s,
        substrings: lean_string_list =
          postcondition_substrings(chars),
        beautiful: lean_string_list =
          filter_beautiful(substrings, k),
        targets: lean_string_list =
          filter_nonempty(map_listToString(beautiful))
    IN
      (result = null[lean_char]
        AND targets = null[lean_string])
        OR
      (lean_string_member(result, targets)
        AND result_is_minimal(result, targets))

  shortestBeautifulSubstring_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string, k: nat):
      shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond(s, k)
        IMPLIES
          shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond(
            s,
            k,
            shortestBeautifulSubstring(s, k))

END verina_advanced_71
