title: verina_advanced_75
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
   catalog title "task_code": Kadane's executable maximum contiguous-subarray
   sum for a nonempty integer sequence, with the exhaustive subarray
   postcondition and final correctness proposition. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition task_code_precond (sequence : list Z) : Prop :=
  (0 < length sequence)%nat.

Definition task_code_step
    (acc : Z * Z)
    (x : Z) : Z * Z :=
  let '(cur, maxSoFar) := acc in
  let curPlusX := (cur + x)%Z in
  let newCur :=
    if Z.geb curPlusX x then curPlusX else x in
  let newMax :=
    if Z.geb maxSoFar newCur then maxSoFar else newCur in
  (newCur, newMax).

Definition task_code
    (sequence : list Z)
    (_h_precond : task_code_precond sequence) : Z :=
  match sequence with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: xs =>
      snd (fold_left task_code_step xs (x, x))
  end.

Definition task_code_subarrays
    (sequence : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  flat_map
    (fun start =>
      map
        (fun len => firstn len (skipn start sequence))
        (seq 0%nat (length sequence - start + 1)))
    (seq 0%nat (length sequence + 1)).

Definition task_code_nonempty (values : list Z) : bool :=
  match values with
  | [] => false
  | _ :: _ => true
  end.

Definition task_code_sum (values : list Z) : Z :=
  fold_right Z.add 0%Z values.

Definition task_code_subarray_sums
    (sequence : list Z) : list Z :=
  map task_code_sum
    (filter task_code_nonempty
      (task_code_subarrays sequence)).

Definition task_code_postcond
    (sequence : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : task_code_precond sequence) : Prop :=
  let subArraySums := task_code_subarray_sums sequence in
  existsb (Z.eqb result) subArraySums = true /\
  forallb (fun total => Z.leb total result) subArraySums = true.

Theorem task_code_spec_satisfied
    (sequence : list Z)
    (h_precond : task_code_precond sequence) :
  task_code_postcond
    sequence (task_code sequence h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
  catalog title "task_code": Kadane's executable integer-list scan computes
  the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray, together with its
  nonempty-input precondition and maximality postcondition. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_75
  imports Main
begin

definition task_code_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "task_code_precond sequence \<longleftrightarrow> length sequence > 0"

definition task_code_step :: "int \<times> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<times> int" where
  "task_code_step acc x =
    (let cur = fst acc;
         maxSoFar = snd acc;
         newCur = (if cur + x \<ge> x then cur + x else x);
         newMax = (if maxSoFar \<ge> newCur then maxSoFar else newCur)
     in (newCur, newMax))"

fun task_code :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "task_code [] = 0"
| "task_code (x # xs) = snd (foldl task_code_step (x, x) xs)"

definition task_code_subArrays :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list list" where
  "task_code_subArrays sequence =
    concat
      (map
        (\<lambda>start.
          map
            (\<lambda>len. take len (drop start sequence))
            [0..<(length sequence - start + 1)])
        [0..<(length sequence + 1)])"

definition task_code_subArraySums :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "task_code_subArraySums sequence =
    map sum_list (filter (\<lambda>subArray. subArray \<noteq> [])
      (task_code_subArrays sequence))"

definition task_code_postcond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "task_code_postcond sequence result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let subArraySums = task_code_subArraySums sequence
     in result \<in> set subArraySums \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>subArraySum. subArraySum \<le> result) subArraySums)"

theorem task_code_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "task_code_precond sequence"
  shows "task_code_postcond sequence (task_code sequence)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
  catalog title "task_code": an executable Kadane scan computes the maximum
  sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray of a nonempty integer sequence, with
  an exhaustive membership-and-maximality correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let task_code_precond = new_definition
  `task_code_precond (sequence:int list) <=>
     0 < LENGTH sequence`;;

let task_code_max = new_definition
  `task_code_max (a:int) (b:int) =
     if a <= b then b else a`;;

let task_code_fold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!cur:int. !maxSoFar:int.
        task_code_fold
          ([]:int list) cur maxSoFar =
        maxSoFar) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !cur:int. !maxSoFar:int.
        task_code_fold
          (CONS x xs) cur maxSoFar =
        let newCur =
          task_code_max x (cur + x) in
        let newMax =
          task_code_max maxSoFar newCur in
        task_code_fold xs newCur newMax)`;;

let task_code = new_definition
  `task_code (sequence:int list) =
     if sequence = [] then (&0:int)
     else
       task_code_fold
         (TL sequence) (HD sequence) (HD sequence)`;;

let task_code_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(task_code_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        task_code_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (task_code_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let task_code_positiveLengths = new_definition
  `task_code_positiveLengths (n:num) =
     MAP SUC (task_code_range n)`;;

let task_code_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!sequence:int list.
        task_code_drop 0 sequence = sequence) /\
     (!n:num. !sequence:int list.
        task_code_drop (SUC n) sequence =
        if sequence = [] then []
        else task_code_drop n (TL sequence))`;;

let task_code_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!sequence:int list.
        task_code_take 0 sequence = []) /\
     (!n:num. !sequence:int list.
        task_code_take (SUC n) sequence =
        if sequence = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD sequence)
            (task_code_take n (TL sequence)))`;;

let task_code_sum =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(task_code_sum ([]:int list) = (&0:int)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        task_code_sum (CONS x xs) =
        x + task_code_sum xs)`;;

let task_code_sumsAt = new_definition
  `task_code_sumsAt
      (sequence:int list) (start:num) =
     MAP
       (\len:num.
          task_code_sum
            (task_code_take len
              (task_code_drop start sequence)))
       (task_code_positiveLengths
         (LENGTH sequence - start))`;;

let task_code_allSumsFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!sequence:int list.
        task_code_allSumsFrom
          sequence ([]:num list) = []) /\
     (!start:num. !starts:num list. !sequence:int list.
        task_code_allSumsFrom
          sequence (CONS start starts) =
        APPEND
          (task_code_sumsAt sequence start)
          (task_code_allSumsFrom sequence starts))`;;

let task_code_subArraySums = new_definition
  `task_code_subArraySums (sequence:int list) =
     task_code_allSumsFrom
       sequence
       (task_code_range (LENGTH sequence + 1))`;;

let task_code_postcond = new_definition
  `task_code_postcond
      (sequence:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let subArraySums =
       task_code_subArraySums sequence in
     MEM result subArraySums /\
     ALL (\s:int. s <= result) subArraySums`;;

let task_code_spec_satisfied =
  `!sequence:int list.
     task_code_precond sequence
     ==> task_code_postcond
           sequence (task_code sequence)`;;

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
;; "task_code": the deterministic Kadane-style integer-list program returns
;; the greatest sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray of a nonempty input
;; sequence, with its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Int domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of integers.

(defun verina-advanced-75-integer-listp (sequence)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sequence)))
  (if (consp sequence)
      (and
       (integerp (car sequence))
       (verina-advanced-75-integer-listp
        (cdr sequence)))
    (equal sequence nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-75-task-code-precond (sequence)
  (< 0 (len sequence)))

(defun verina-advanced-75-task-code-fold
    (remaining current maximum-so-far)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((x (car remaining))
             (extended (+ current x))
             (new-current
              (if (>= extended x)
                  extended
                x))
             (new-maximum
              (if (>= maximum-so-far new-current)
                  maximum-so-far
                new-current)))
        (verina-advanced-75-task-code-fold
         (cdr remaining)
         new-current
         new-maximum))
    maximum-so-far))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant in
;; Lean and is erased here. The empty branch, first-element initialization,
;; and every left-fold update are otherwise exactly the source implementation.

(defun verina-advanced-75-task-code (sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (verina-advanced-75-task-code-fold
       (cdr sequence)
       (car sequence)
       (car sequence))
    0))

(defun verina-advanced-75-drop (count sequence)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      sequence
    (if (consp sequence)
        (verina-advanced-75-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr sequence))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-75-take (count sequence)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp sequence)
        (cons
         (car sequence)
         (verina-advanced-75-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr sequence)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-75-list-sum (sequence)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sequence)))
  (if (consp sequence)
      (+
       (car sequence)
       (verina-advanced-75-list-sum
        (cdr sequence)))
    0))

;; For each source start index, the postcondition first constructs lengths
;; 0 through n-start and then filters out the unique empty length-zero slice.
;; The following recursion therefore produces exactly the surviving sums, in
;; the same order, for lengths 1 through n-start.

(defun verina-advanced-75-subarray-sums-at-start
    (sequence start length remaining-lengths)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-lengths)))
  (if (zp remaining-lengths)
      nil
    (cons
     (verina-advanced-75-list-sum
      (verina-advanced-75-take
       length
       (verina-advanced-75-drop
        start
        sequence)))
     (verina-advanced-75-subarray-sums-at-start
      sequence
      start
      (+ length 1)
      (- remaining-lengths 1)))))

;; START ranges from zero through n, as in List.range (n + 1). At start n the
;; source produces only an empty slice, which its filter removes; hence that
;; iteration contributes nil here. APPEND preserves flatMap traversal order.

(defun verina-advanced-75-all-subarray-sums-from
    (sequence start remaining-starts total-length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-starts)))
  (if (zp remaining-starts)
      nil
    (append
     (verina-advanced-75-subarray-sums-at-start
      sequence
      start
      1
      (nfix (- total-length start)))
     (verina-advanced-75-all-subarray-sums-from
      sequence
      (+ start 1)
      (- remaining-starts 1)
      total-length))))

(defun verina-advanced-75-all-subarray-sums (sequence)
  (let ((total-length (len sequence)))
    (verina-advanced-75-all-subarray-sums-from
     sequence
     0
     (+ total-length 1)
     total-length)))

(defun verina-advanced-75-contains-result-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (or
       (equal (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-75-contains-result-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-75-all-sums-at-most-result-p
    (subarray-sums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count subarray-sums)))
  (if (consp subarray-sums)
      (and
       (<= (car subarray-sums) result)
       (verina-advanced-75-all-sums-at-most-result-p
        (cdr subarray-sums)
        result))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-75-task-code-postcond
    (sequence result)
  (let ((subarray-sums
         (verina-advanced-75-all-subarray-sums
          sequence)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-75-integer-listp sequence)
     (integerp result)
     (verina-advanced-75-contains-result-p
      subarray-sums
      result)
     (verina-advanced-75-all-sums-at-most-result-p
      subarray-sums
      result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int binder and nonempty precondition; its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun verina-advanced-75-task-code-spec-satisfied-statement
    (sequence)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-75-integer-listp sequence)
    (verina-advanced-75-task-code-precond sequence))
   (verina-advanced-75-task-code-postcond
    sequence
    (verina-advanced-75-task-code sequence))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
-- catalog title "task_code": Kadane's deterministic integer-list program
-- computes the largest sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray and is connected
-- to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced75 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y =
  if intLess y x
  then false
  else true

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intMax : Int → Int → Int
intMax x y =
  if intLess x y
  then y
  else x

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

flatMapList : {A B : Set} → (A → List B) → List A → List B
flatMapList f [] = []
flatMapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  appendList (f x) (flatMapList f xs)

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

listNonEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listNonEmpty [] = false
listNonEmpty (_ ∷ xs) = true

sumList : List Int → Int
sumList [] = pos zero
sumList (x ∷ xs) = intAdd x (sumList xs)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

task-code-precond : List Int → Set
task-code-precond sequence =
  IsTrue (natLess zero (listLength sequence))

task-code-helper : List Int → Int → Int → Int
task-code-helper [] current maximum = maximum
task-code-helper (x ∷ xs) current maximum =
  let new-current = intMax (intAdd current x) x
      new-maximum = intMax maximum new-current
  in task-code-helper xs new-current new-maximum

task-code :
  (sequence : List Int) →
  task-code-precond sequence →
  Int
task-code [] h-precond = pos zero
task-code (x ∷ xs) h-precond =
  task-code-helper xs x x

subArrays : List Int → List (List Int)
subArrays sequence =
  flatMapList
    (λ start →
      mapList
        (λ length →
          takeList length (dropList start sequence))
        (range
          (natSubtract
            (listLength sequence)
            start
           + one)))
    (range (listLength sequence + one))

subArraySums : List Int → List Int
subArraySums sequence =
  mapList
    sumList
    (filterList listNonEmpty (subArrays sequence))

task-code-postcond :
  (sequence : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  task-code-precond sequence →
  Set
task-code-postcond sequence result h-precond =
  IsTrue (containsInt result (subArraySums sequence)) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ sum → intLessOrEqual sum result)
      (subArraySums sequence))

task-code-spec-satisfied : Set
task-code-spec-satisfied =
  (sequence : List Int) →
  (h-precond : task-code-precond sequence) →
  task-code-postcond
    sequence
    (task-code sequence h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_75,
  catalog title "task_code": the executable Kadane fold returns the greatest
  sum among all nonempty contiguous subarrays of a nonempty integer list.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val task_code_precond_def = new_definition (
  "task_code_precond_def",
  ``task_code_precond (sequence : int list) <=>
      0 < LENGTH sequence``
);

val task_code_step_def = new_definition (
  "task_code_step_def",
  ``task_code_step
      (acc : int # int) (x : int) =
      let cur = FST acc in
      let maxSoFar = SND acc in
      let newCur =
        if x <= cur + x then cur + x else x
      in
      let newMax =
        if newCur <= maxSoFar then maxSoFar else newCur
      in
        (newCur, newMax)``
);

val task_code_def = Define `
  (task_code ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (task_code (x::xs) =
     SND (FOLDL task_code_step (x, x) xs))
`;

val task_code_subarrays_def = new_definition (
  "task_code_subarrays_def",
  ``task_code_subarrays (sequence : int list) =
      FLAT
        (MAP
          (\start.
             MAP
               (\len. TAKE len (DROP start sequence))
               (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH sequence - start + 1)))
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH sequence + 1)))``
);

val task_code_subarraySums_def = new_definition (
  "task_code_subarraySums_def",
  ``task_code_subarraySums (sequence : int list) =
      MAP
        (\subarray : int list.
           FOLDL (\acc : int. \x : int. acc + x) 0 subarray)
        (FILTER
          (\subarray : int list. subarray <> [])
          (task_code_subarrays sequence))``
);

val task_code_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "task_code_postcond_def",
  ``task_code_postcond
      (sequence : int list) (result : int) <=>
      MEM result (task_code_subarraySums sequence) /\
      EVERY
        (\sum : int. sum <= result)
        (task_code_subarraySums sequence)``
);

val task_code_spec_satisfied =
  ``!sequence : int list.
      task_code_precond sequence ==>
      task_code_postcond sequence (task_code sequence)``;

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_75 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_75), catalog title
  task_code: the exact pair-state Kadane fold computes the maximum sum of a
  nonempty contiguous subarray of an arbitrary nonempty finite integer list,
  together with its independently enumerated correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  i ..^ j is the half-open natural interval from i through j - 1.

  VERINA75IntMax is the source integer maximum operation.
  VERINA75FoldGraph is the exact trace of the source List.foldl on the tail
  of a nonempty input. Its c and m words record the pair components cur and
  maxSoFar before and after every consumed entry. Each transition computes
    newCur = if cur + x >= x then cur + x else x
  and then
    newMax = if maxSoFar >= newCur then maxSoFar else newCur.
  VERINA75Fold selects the final maxSoFar from that unique trace.

  VERINA75NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINA75TailGraph and VERINA75Tail give List.tail, including the empty-list
  case. VERINA75TaskCode is the exact source match: it returns integer zero
  on the empty word, and otherwise folds the tail with both initial pair
  components equal to the head. The proof-valued precondition argument is
  computationally unused, so the target function is defined on every typed
  word and is invoked under VERINA75Pre in the final assertion.

  VERINA75PrefixGraph records the unique integer prefix sums starting at
  zero. VERINA75SubarraySumsGraph reproduces the postcondition's outer
  List.range (length + 1), inner List.range (length - start + 1), drop/take,
  filter of the empty subarrays, and map of List.sum. After that filter its
  index-pair word contains, in increasing start and then increasing length,
  exactly the pairs with start below the input length and positive length at
  most length - start. Prefix differences are exactly the corresponding
  drop/take sums, and duplicate sum values are retained.

  VERINA75Pre is precisely the typed nonempty-list precondition.
  VERINA75Post says that the result occurs in the independently generated
  subarray-sum word and every entry of that word is at most the result,
  exactly reproducing List.contains and List.all. The final $a declaration is
  the source correctness proposition. Every earlier $a is syntax or a
  faithful definition required by this rendering, and this database has no
  $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA75IntMax
  VERINA75FoldGraph VERINA75Fold
  VERINA75NatSub
  VERINA75TailGraph VERINA75Tail
  VERINA75Pre VERINA75TaskCode
  VERINA75PrefixGraph VERINA75Prefix
  VERINA75SubarraySumsGraph VERINA75SubarraySums
  VERINA75Post
$.

verina75-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75IntMax A B ) $.
verina75-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75FoldGraph A B C D ) $.
verina75-fold-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75Fold A B C ) $.
verina75-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75NatSub A B ) $.
verina75-tail-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75TailGraph A B ) $.
verina75-tail-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75Tail A ) $.
verina75-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75Pre A ) $.
verina75-task-code-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75TaskCode A ) $.
verina75-prefix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75PrefixGraph A B ) $.
verina75-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75Prefix A ) $.
verina75-subarray-sums-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75SubarraySumsGraph A B ) $.
verina75-subarray-sums-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA75SubarraySums A ) $.
verina75-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA75Post A B ) $.

verina75-int-max-definition $a |- (
  VERINA75IntMax A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  B ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d k c m A B C D $.

  verina75-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75FoldGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. ZZ
        /\
        D e. ZZ
      )
    )
    /\
    E. c e. Word ZZ
      E. m e. Word ZZ
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` c ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( # ` m ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( c ` 0 ) = B
              /\
              ( m ` 0 ) = C
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                (
                  c ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINA75IntMax
                    ( ( c ` k ) + ( A ` k ) )
                    ( A ` k )
                )
                /\
                (
                  m ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINA75IntMax
                    ( m ` k )
                    ( c ` ( k + 1 ) )
                )
              )
            /\
            D = ( m ` ( # ` A ) )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verina75-fold-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75Fold A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA75FoldGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verina75-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA75NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

${
  $d j A B $.

  verina75-tail-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75TailGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( VERINA75NatSub ( # ` A ) 1 )
      /\
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( j + 1 ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina75-tail-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75Tail A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA75TailGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verina75-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA75Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  0 < ( # ` A )
) $.

verina75-task-code-definition $a |- (
  VERINA75TaskCode A
) = if (
  ( # ` A ) = 0 ,
  0 ,
  (
    VERINA75Fold
      ( VERINA75Tail A )
      ( A ` 0 )
      ( A ` 0 )
  )
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina75-prefix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75PrefixGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( # ` B ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
        /\
        ( B ` 0 ) = 0
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` ( i + 1 )
        ) = (
          ( B ` i ) + ( A ` i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina75-prefix-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75Prefix A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA75PrefixGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j l p q s A B $.

  verina75-subarray-sums-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75SubarraySumsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word ( NN0 X. NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) ) < ( # ` A )
                  /\
                  0 < ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
                /\
                ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) ) <_ (
                  ( # ` A ) - ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                B ` i
              ) = (
                (
                  VERINA75Prefix A
                ) ` (
                  ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) ) +
                  ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                )
                -
                (
                  VERINA75Prefix A
                ) ` (
                  1st ` ( p ` i )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                (
                  (
                    1st ` ( p ` i )
                  ) < (
                    1st ` ( p ` j )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      1st ` ( p ` i )
                    ) = (
                      1st ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      2nd ` ( p ` i )
                    ) < (
                      2nd ` ( p ` j )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          /\
          A. s e. NN0
            A. l e. NN0
              (
                (
                  (
                    s < ( # ` A )
                    /\
                    0 < l
                  )
                  /\
                  l <_ ( ( # ` A ) - s )
                )
                ->
                E. q e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` p ) )
                  ( p ` q ) = <. s , l >.
              )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina75-subarray-sums-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75SubarraySums A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA75SubarraySumsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina75-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA75Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (

title: verina_advanced_75
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_75, catalog title "task_code": Kadane's algorithm computes
% the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous integer subarray under its full
% program-verification contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_75: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  task_code_precond(sequence: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(sequence) > 0

  task_code_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      current, max_so_far: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        max_so_far,
      cons(x, xs):
        LET new_current: int =
              IF current + x >= x THEN
                current + x
              ELSE
                x
              ENDIF,
            new_max: int =
              IF max_so_far >= new_current THEN
                max_so_far
              ELSE
                new_current
              ENDIF
        IN
          task_code_fold(
            xs,
            new_current,
            new_max)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % The source proof argument is computationally irrelevant, so the target
  % function exposes the exact proof-erased list computation.
  task_code(sequence: list[int]): int =
    CASES sequence OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(x, xs):
        task_code_fold(xs, x, x)
    ENDCASES

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_sum(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        head + int_list_sum(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_subarray_sum(
      values: list[int],
      start, length: nat): int =
    int_list_sum(
      int_list_take(
        length,
        int_list_drop(start, values)))

  append_int_lists(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_int_lists(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  subarray_sums_at_start(
      values: list[int],
      start, length, remaining_lengths: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining_lengths = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      cons(
        int_subarray_sum(values, start, length),
        subarray_sums_at_start(
          values,
          start,
          length + 1,
          remaining_lengths - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_lengths

  all_subarray_sums_from(
      values: list[int],
      start, remaining_starts, total_length: nat):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF remaining_starts = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      append_int_lists(
        subarray_sums_at_start(
          values,
          start,
          1,
          nat_subtract(total_length, start)),
        all_subarray_sums_from(
          values,
          start + 1,
          remaining_starts - 1,
          total_length))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_starts

  % The Lean postcondition enumerates all slices and then removes empty lists.
  % Starting each length enumeration at one gives exactly that filtered list.
  nonempty_subarray_sums(values: list[int]): list[int] =
    LET total_length: nat = int_list_length(values)
    IN
      all_subarray_sums_from(
        values,
        0,
        total_length + 1,
        total_length)

  int_list_contains(
      values: list[int],
      requested: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_list_contains(tail, requested)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_most(
      values: list[int],
      upper_bound: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head <= upper_bound
          AND int_list_all_at_most(tail, upper_bound)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  task_code_postcond(
      sequence: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    LET subarray_sums: list[int] =
          nonempty_subarray_sums(sequence)
    IN
      int_list_contains(subarray_sums, result)
        AND int_list_all_at_most(
              subarray_sums,
              result)

  task_code_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: list[int]):
      task_code_precond(sequence) IMPLIES
        task_code_postcond(
          sequence,
          task_code(sequence))

END verina_advanced_75

-- !benchmark @start import type=solution

-- !benchmark @end import

-- !benchmark @start solution_aux
