-- !benchmark @start precond_aux

-- !benchmark @end precond_aux
@[reducible]
def topKFrequent_precond (nums : List Int) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  k ≤ nums.eraseDups.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def topKFrequent (nums : List Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : topKFrequent_precond (nums) (k)) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  -- Build frequency list maintaining first occurrence order (deterministic)
  let freqList : List (Int × Nat) :=
    nums.foldl (init := []) fun acc n =>
      match acc.find? (fun (key, _) => key == n) with
      | some _ => acc.map (fun (key, cnt) => if key == n then (key, cnt + 1) else (key, cnt))
      | none => acc ++ [(n, 1)]
  -- Sort by frequency (descending), stable sort preserves first-occurrence order for ties
  let sorted := freqList.foldl
    (fun acc pair =>
      let (x, cx) := pair
      let rec insertSorted (xs : List (Int × Nat)) : List (Int × Nat) :=
        match xs with
        | [] => [pair]
        | (y, cy) :: ys =>
          if cx > cy then
            pair :: (y, cy) :: ys
          else
            (y, cy) :: insertSorted ys
      insertSorted acc
    ) []

  sorted.take k |>.map (fun (n, _) => n)
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def topKFrequent_postcond (nums : List Int) (k : Nat) (result: List Int) (h_precond : topKFrequent_precond (nums) (k)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  -- Result contains exactly k elements
  result.length = k ∧

  -- All elements in result appear in the original list
  result.all (· ∈ nums) ∧

  -- All elements in result are distinct
  List.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) result ∧

  -- For any element in result and any element not in result, the frequency of the
  -- element in result is greater or equal (simplified: no tie-breaking constraint on ordering)
  (result.all (fun x =>
    nums.all (fun y =>
      y ∈ result ∨ nums.count x ≥ nums.count y
    ))) ∧

  -- Elements in result are ordered by non-increasing frequency
  List.Pairwise (fun (x, i) (y, j) =>
    i < j → nums.count x ≥ nums.count y
  ) result.zipIdx
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem topKFrequent_spec_satisfied (nums: List Int) (k: Nat) (h_precond : topKFrequent_precond (nums) (k)) :
    topKFrequent_postcond (nums) (k) (topKFrequent (nums) (k) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  sorry
  -- !benchmark @end proof

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
   catalog title "topKFrequent": deterministic frequency counting and stable
   descending selection of the k most frequent integers, together with its
   membership, distinctness, frequency, and ordering correctness contract.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition topKFrequent_precond
    (nums : list Z) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  (k <= length (nodup Z.eq_dec nums))%nat.

Definition topKFrequent_find_key
    (n : Z)
    (frequencies : list (Z * nat)) : option (Z * nat) :=
  find (fun entry => Z.eqb (fst entry) n) frequencies.

Definition topKFrequent_increment_key
    (n : Z)
    (frequencies : list (Z * nat)) : list (Z * nat) :=
  map
    (fun entry =>
      let '(key, count) := entry in
      if Z.eqb key n
      then (key, S count)
      else (key, count))
    frequencies.

Definition topKFrequent_add_frequency
    (frequencies : list (Z * nat))
    (n : Z) : list (Z * nat) :=
  match topKFrequent_find_key n frequencies with
  | Some _ => topKFrequent_increment_key n frequencies
  | None => frequencies ++ [(n, 1%nat)]
  end.

Definition topKFrequent_frequency_list
    (nums : list Z) : list (Z * nat) :=
  fold_left topKFrequent_add_frequency nums [].

Fixpoint topKFrequent_insert_sorted
    (entry : Z * nat)
    (frequencies : list (Z * nat)) : list (Z * nat) :=
  match frequencies with
  | [] => [entry]
  | current :: rest =>
      if Nat.ltb (snd current) (snd entry)
      then entry :: current :: rest
      else current :: topKFrequent_insert_sorted entry rest
  end.

Definition topKFrequent_sorted_frequencies
    (nums : list Z) : list (Z * nat) :=
  fold_left
    (fun acc entry => topKFrequent_insert_sorted entry acc)
    (topKFrequent_frequency_list nums)
    [].

Definition topKFrequent
    (nums : list Z)
    (k : nat)
    (_h_precond : topKFrequent_precond nums k) : list Z :=
  map fst (firstn k (topKFrequent_sorted_frequencies nums)).

Fixpoint topKFrequent_pairwise
    {A : Type}
    (relation : A -> A -> Prop)
    (xs : list A) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | [] => True
  | x :: rest =>
      Forall (relation x) rest /\
      topKFrequent_pairwise relation rest
  end.

Fixpoint topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom
    (xs : list Z)
    (index : nat) : list (Z * nat) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      (x, index) :: topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom rest (S index)
  end.

Definition topKFrequent_zipIdx
    (xs : list Z) : list (Z * nat) :=
  topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom xs 0%nat.

Definition topKFrequent_mem
    (x : Z) (xs : list Z) : bool :=
  existsb (Z.eqb x) xs.

Definition topKFrequent_count
    (x : Z) (xs : list Z) : nat :=
  count_occ Z.eq_dec xs x.

Definition topKFrequent_postcond
    (nums : list Z)
    (k : nat)
    (result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : topKFrequent_precond nums k) : Prop :=
  length result = k /\
  forallb (fun x => topKFrequent_mem x nums) result = true /\
  topKFrequent_pairwise (fun x y => x <> y) result /\
  forallb
    (fun x =>
      forallb
        (fun y =>
          orb
            (topKFrequent_mem y result)
            (Nat.leb
              (topKFrequent_count y nums)
              (topKFrequent_count x nums)))
        nums)
    result = true /\
  topKFrequent_pairwise
    (fun first later =>
      let '(x, i) := first in
      let '(y, j) := later in
      (i < j)%nat ->
      (topKFrequent_count y nums <=
       topKFrequent_count x nums)%nat)
    (topKFrequent_zipIdx result).

Theorem topKFrequent_spec_satisfied
    (nums : list Z)
    (k : nat)
    (h_precond : topKFrequent_precond nums k) :
  topKFrequent_postcond
    nums k (topKFrequent nums k h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
  catalog title "topKFrequent": an executable stable frequency-counting and
  insertion-sorting program returns the k most frequent distinct integers,
  together with its precondition and full correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_76
  imports Main
begin

definition topKFrequent_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "topKFrequent_precond nums k \<longleftrightarrow>
    k \<le> length (remdups nums)"

definition topKFrequent_freqStep ::
    "(int \<times> nat) list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow>
      (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "topKFrequent_freqStep acc n =
    (if list_ex (\<lambda>entry. fst entry = n) acc
     then
       map
         (\<lambda>entry.
           if fst entry = n
           then (fst entry, snd entry + 1)
           else entry)
         acc
     else acc @ [(n, 1)])"

definition topKFrequent_freqList ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "topKFrequent_freqList nums =
    foldl topKFrequent_freqStep [] nums"

fun topKFrequent_insertSorted ::
    "(int \<times> nat) \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list \<Rightarrow>
      (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "topKFrequent_insertSorted pair [] = [pair]"
| "topKFrequent_insertSorted pair ((y, cy) # ys) =
    (if snd pair > cy
     then pair # (y, cy) # ys
     else (y, cy) # topKFrequent_insertSorted pair ys)"

definition topKFrequent_sorted ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "topKFrequent_sorted nums =
    foldl
      (\<lambda>acc pair. topKFrequent_insertSorted pair acc)
      [] (topKFrequent_freqList nums)"

definition topKFrequent ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "topKFrequent nums k =
    map fst (take k (topKFrequent_sorted nums))"

definition topKFrequent_zipIdx ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list" where
  "topKFrequent_zipIdx xs = zip xs [0..<length xs]"

fun topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> nat) list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed nums [] = True"
| "topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed nums (p # ps) =
    (list_all
       (\<lambda>q.
         snd p < snd q \<longrightarrow>
         count_list nums (fst p) \<ge> count_list nums (fst q))
       ps \<and>
     topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed nums ps)"

definition topKFrequent_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "topKFrequent_postcond nums k result \<longleftrightarrow>
    length result = k \<and>
    list_all (\<lambda>x. x \<in> set nums) result \<and>
    distinct result \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x.
        list_all
          (\<lambda>y.
            y \<in> set result \<or>
            count_list nums x \<ge> count_list nums y)
          nums)
      result \<and>
    topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed nums (topKFrequent_zipIdx result)"

theorem topKFrequent_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "topKFrequent_precond nums k"
  shows "topKFrequent_postcond nums k (topKFrequent nums k)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
  catalog title "topKFrequent": a deterministic frequency-counting program
  stably sorts distinct integers by descending occurrence count and returns
  the first k, together with its full correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let topKFrequent_distinctFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!seen:int list.
        topKFrequent_distinctFold ([]:int list) seen = seen) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !seen:int list.
        topKFrequent_distinctFold (CONS x xs) seen =
        topKFrequent_distinctFold xs
          (if MEM x seen then seen
           else APPEND seen (CONS x [])))`;;

let topKFrequent_distinct = new_definition
  `topKFrequent_distinct (nums:int list) =
     topKFrequent_distinctFold nums []`;;

let topKFrequent_precond = new_definition
  `topKFrequent_precond (nums:int list) (k:num) <=>
     k <= LENGTH (topKFrequent_distinct nums)`;;

let topKFrequent_hasKey =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!key:int.
        topKFrequent_hasKey ([]:(int#num)list) key <=> F) /\
     (!entry:int#num. !rest:(int#num)list. !key:int.
        topKFrequent_hasKey (CONS entry rest) key <=>
        FST entry = key \/ topKFrequent_hasKey rest key)`;;

let topKFrequent_increment =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!key:int.
        topKFrequent_increment ([]:(int#num)list) key = []) /\
     (!entry:int#num. !rest:(int#num)list. !key:int.
        topKFrequent_increment (CONS entry rest) key =
        if FST entry = key then
          CONS (FST entry,SND entry + 1)
            (topKFrequent_increment rest key)
        else
          CONS entry (topKFrequent_increment rest key))`;;

let topKFrequent_buildFreq =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_buildFreq ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_buildFreq (CONS x xs) acc =
        topKFrequent_buildFreq xs
          (if topKFrequent_hasKey acc x then
             topKFrequent_increment acc x
           else
             APPEND acc (CONS (x,1) [])))`;;

let topKFrequent_insertSorted =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!pair:int#num.
        topKFrequent_insertSorted
          ([]:(int#num)list) pair = CONS pair []) /\
     (!entry:int#num. !rest:(int#num)list. !pair:int#num.
        topKFrequent_insertSorted (CONS entry rest) pair =
        if SND pair > SND entry then
          CONS pair (CONS entry rest)
        else
          CONS entry
            (topKFrequent_insertSorted rest pair))`;;

let topKFrequent_sortFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_sortFold
          ([]:(int#num)list) acc = acc) /\
     (!pair:int#num. !pairs:(int#num)list.
      !acc:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_sortFold (CONS pair pairs) acc =
        topKFrequent_sortFold pairs
          (topKFrequent_insertSorted acc pair))`;;

let topKFrequent_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!xs:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_take 0 xs = []) /\
     (!n:num. !xs:(int#num)list.
        topKFrequent_take (SUC n) xs =
        if xs = [] then []
        else
          CONS (HD xs)
            (topKFrequent_take n (TL xs)))`;;

let topKFrequent = new_definition
  `topKFrequent (nums:int list) (k:num) =
     let freqList =
       topKFrequent_buildFreq nums ([]:(int#num)list) in
     let sorted =
       topKFrequent_sortFold freqList ([]:(int#num)list) in
     MAP (\entry:int#num. FST entry)
       (topKFrequent_take k sorted)`;;

let topKFrequent_count =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!target:int.
        topKFrequent_count ([]:int list) target = 0) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !target:int.
        topKFrequent_count (CONS x xs) target =
        if x = target then
          SUC (topKFrequent_count xs target)
        else
          topKFrequent_count xs target)`;;

let topKFrequent_nodup =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(topKFrequent_nodup ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        topKFrequent_nodup (CONS x xs) <=>
        ~(MEM x xs) /\ topKFrequent_nodup xs)`;;

let topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom
        (start:num) ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !start:num.
        topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom start (CONS x xs) =
        CONS (x,start)
          (topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom (SUC start) xs))`;;

let topKFrequent_zipIdx = new_definition
  `topKFrequent_zipIdx (result:int list) =
     topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom 0 result`;;

let topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!nums:int list.
        topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed
          nums ([]:(int#num)list) <=> T) /\
     (!indexed:int#num. !rest:(int#num)list. !nums:int list.
        topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed
          nums (CONS indexed rest) <=>
        ALL
          (\later:int#num.
             SND indexed < SND later
             ==> topKFrequent_count nums (FST indexed) >=
                 topKFrequent_count nums (FST later))
          rest /\
        topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed nums rest)`;;

let topKFrequent_postcond = new_definition
  `topKFrequent_postcond
      (nums:int list) (k:num) (result:int list) <=>
     LENGTH result = k /\
     ALL (\x:int. MEM x nums) result /\
     topKFrequent_nodup result /\
     ALL
       (\x:int.
          ALL
            (\y:int.
               MEM y result \/
               topKFrequent_count nums x >=
               topKFrequent_count nums y)
            nums)
       result /\
     topKFrequent_pairwiseIndexed
       nums (topKFrequent_zipIdx result)`;;

let topKFrequent_spec_satisfied =
  `!nums:int list. !k:num.
     topKFrequent_precond nums k
     ==> topKFrequent_postcond
           nums k (topKFrequent nums k)`;;

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
;; catalog title "topKFrequent": a deterministic integer-list program returns
;; k distinct highest-frequency elements in non-increasing frequency order.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Int domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of integers.

(defun verina-advanced-76-integer-listp (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (integerp (car xs))
       (verina-advanced-76-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; Only the length of eraseDups is observed by the source precondition.
;; Keeping the last occurrence yields exactly the same distinct-element count.

(defun verina-advanced-76-erase-dups (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (if (member-equal (car xs) (cdr xs))
          (verina-advanced-76-erase-dups (cdr xs))
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-76-erase-dups (cdr xs))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent-precond (nums k)
  (<= k (len (verina-advanced-76-erase-dups nums))))

;; Frequency-list entries are dotted pairs (integer . natural-count).
;; The following lookup is the source acc.find? key test.

(defun verina-advanced-76-frequency-key-present-p
    (key frequency-list)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-list)))
  (if (consp frequency-list)
      (or
       (equal key (car (car frequency-list)))
       (verina-advanced-76-frequency-key-present-p
        key
        (cdr frequency-list)))
    nil))

;; When find? succeeds, the source maps over the complete accumulator and
;; increments every entry with the matching key.

(defun verina-advanced-76-increment-matching
    (key frequency-list)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-list)))
  (if (consp frequency-list)
      (let ((entry (car frequency-list)))
        (cons
         (if (equal key (car entry))
             (cons (car entry) (+ (cdr entry) 1))
           entry)
         (verina-advanced-76-increment-matching
          key
          (cdr frequency-list))))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-76-frequency-step
    (frequency-list value)
  (if (verina-advanced-76-frequency-key-present-p
       value
       frequency-list)
      (verina-advanced-76-increment-matching
       value
       frequency-list)
    (append frequency-list (list (cons value 1)))))

;; This accumulator recursion is nums.foldl with initial value [].

(defun verina-advanced-76-build-frequency-list-fold
    (remaining frequency-list)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-76-build-frequency-list-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (verina-advanced-76-frequency-step
        frequency-list
        (car remaining)))
    frequency-list))

(defun verina-advanced-76-build-frequency-list (nums)
  (verina-advanced-76-build-frequency-list-fold nums nil))

;; This is the source local insertSorted. A strictly larger count is inserted
;; before the current entry; equal counts pass it, preserving stable order.

(defun verina-advanced-76-insert-frequency-entry
    (entry sorted)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sorted)))
  (if (consp sorted)
      (if (> (cdr entry) (cdr (car sorted)))
          (cons entry sorted)
        (cons
         (car sorted)
         (verina-advanced-76-insert-frequency-entry
          entry
          (cdr sorted))))
    (list entry)))

;; This accumulator recursion is freqList.foldl with initial value [].

(defun verina-advanced-76-sort-frequency-list-fold
    (remaining sorted)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-advanced-76-sort-frequency-list-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (verina-advanced-76-insert-frequency-entry
        (car remaining)
        sorted))
    sorted))

(defun verina-advanced-76-sort-frequency-list
    (frequency-list)
  (verina-advanced-76-sort-frequency-list-fold
   frequency-list
   nil))

(defun verina-advanced-76-take (count xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp xs)
        (cons
         (car xs)
         (verina-advanced-76-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr xs)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-76-frequency-keys (frequency-list)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count frequency-list)))
  (if (consp frequency-list)
      (cons
       (car (car frequency-list))
       (verina-advanced-76-frequency-keys
        (cdr frequency-list)))
    nil))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally erased. The two
;; left folds, stable insertion sort, take, and projection otherwise reproduce
;; the complete source implementation.

(defun verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent (nums k)
  (let* ((frequency-list
          (verina-advanced-76-build-frequency-list nums))
         (sorted
          (verina-advanced-76-sort-frequency-list
           frequency-list)))
    (verina-advanced-76-frequency-keys
     (verina-advanced-76-take k sorted))))

(defun verina-advanced-76-count-equal (value xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (+
       (if (equal value (car xs)) 1 0)
       (verina-advanced-76-count-equal
        value
        (cdr xs)))
    0))

;; This is result.all (fun x => x in nums).

(defun verina-advanced-76-all-members-p (result nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count result)))
  (if (consp result)
      (and
       (member-equal (car result) nums)
       (verina-advanced-76-all-members-p
        (cdr result)
        nums))
    t))

;; This is List.Pairwise (fun x y => x != y) result.

(defun verina-advanced-76-pairwise-distinct-p (result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count result)))
  (if (consp result)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car result) (cdr result)))
       (verina-advanced-76-pairwise-distinct-p
        (cdr result)))
    t))

;; These predicates reproduce the nested result.all / nums.all frequency
;; comparison, including its membership disjunction for each source element.

(defun verina-advanced-76-all-source-elements-dominated-p
    (x remaining-nums nums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-nums)))
  (if (consp remaining-nums)
      (let ((y (car remaining-nums)))
        (and
         (or
          (member-equal y result)
          (>=
           (verina-advanced-76-count-equal x nums)
           (verina-advanced-76-count-equal y nums)))
         (verina-advanced-76-all-source-elements-dominated-p
          x
          (cdr remaining-nums)
          nums
          result)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-76-all-result-elements-dominant-p
    (remaining-result nums result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-result)))
  (if (consp remaining-result)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-76-all-source-elements-dominated-p
        (car remaining-result)
        nums
        nums
        result)
       (verina-advanced-76-all-result-elements-dominant-p
        (cdr remaining-result)
        nums
        result))
    t))

;; Each entry is (value . zero-based-index), exactly representing List.zipIdx.

(defun verina-advanced-76-zip-index-from (xs index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (cons
       (cons (car xs) index)
       (verina-advanced-76-zip-index-from
        (cdr xs)
        (+ index 1)))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-76-zip-index (xs)
  (verina-advanced-76-zip-index-from xs 0))

;; These predicates exactly reproduce List.Pairwise on result.zipIdx with the
;; implication i < j -> count x >= count y.

(defun verina-advanced-76-ordered-after-first-p
    (first remaining-indexed nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-indexed)))
  (if (consp remaining-indexed)
      (let ((later (car remaining-indexed)))
        (and
         (implies
          (< (cdr first) (cdr later))
          (>=
           (verina-advanced-76-count-equal
            (car first)
            nums)
           (verina-advanced-76-count-equal
            (car later)
            nums)))
         (verina-advanced-76-ordered-after-first-p
          first
          (cdr remaining-indexed)
          nums)))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-76-pairwise-frequency-ordered-p
    (indexed-result nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count indexed-result)))
  (if (consp indexed-result)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-76-ordered-after-first-p
        (car indexed-result)
        (cdr indexed-result)
        nums)
       (verina-advanced-76-pairwise-frequency-ordered-p
        (cdr indexed-result)
        nums))
    t))

(defun verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent-postcond
    (nums k result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-76-integer-listp nums)
   (natp k)
   (verina-advanced-76-integer-listp result)
   (equal (len result) k)
   (verina-advanced-76-all-members-p result nums)
   (verina-advanced-76-pairwise-distinct-p result)
   (verina-advanced-76-all-result-elements-dominant-p
    result
    nums
    result)
   (verina-advanced-76-pairwise-frequency-ordered-p
    (verina-advanced-76-zip-index result)
    nums)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int and Nat binders and the distinct-count
;; precondition; its conclusion applies the full postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums k)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-76-integer-listp nums)
    (natp k)
    (verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent-precond nums k))
   (verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent-postcond
    nums
    k
    (verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent nums k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
-- catalog title "topKFrequent": a deterministic frequency-table program
-- returns the k most frequent integers in non-increasing frequency order and
-- is connected to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced76 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 5 _||_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ _∈_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

containsInt : Int → List Int → Bool
containsInt sought [] = false
containsInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then true
  else containsInt sought xs

eraseDups : List Int → List Int
eraseDups [] = []
eraseDups (x ∷ xs) =
  if containsInt x xs
  then eraseDups xs
  else (x ∷ eraseDups xs)

countInt : Int → List Int → Nat
countInt sought [] = zero
countInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then suc (countInt sought xs)
  else countInt sought xs

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data _∈_ (x : Int) : List Int → Set where
  here : {xs : List Int} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : Int} {xs : List Int} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

record Entry : Set where
  constructor entry
  field
    entryKey : Int
    entryCount : Nat

open Entry public

FrequencyList : Set
FrequencyList = List Entry

findEntry : Int → FrequencyList → Maybe Entry
findEntry key [] = nothing
findEntry key (current@(entry stored-key count) ∷ rest) =
  if intEqual stored-key key
  then just current
  else findEntry key rest

incrementMatching : Int → Entry → Entry
incrementMatching key (entry stored-key count) =
  if intEqual stored-key key
  then entry stored-key (suc count)
  else entry stored-key count

frequencyStep : FrequencyList → Int → FrequencyList
frequencyStep frequencies key with findEntry key frequencies
... | just current =
  mapList (incrementMatching key) frequencies
... | nothing =
  appendList frequencies (entry key (suc zero) ∷ [])

buildFrequencyList : List Int → FrequencyList
buildFrequencyList nums =
  foldLeft frequencyStep [] nums

insertSorted : Entry → FrequencyList → FrequencyList
insertSorted current [] = current ∷ []
insertSorted current@(entry key count)
  (next@(entry next-key next-count) ∷ rest) =
  if natLess next-count count
  then (current ∷ next ∷ rest)
  else (next ∷ insertSorted current rest)

sortByDescendingFrequency : FrequencyList → FrequencyList
sortByDescendingFrequency frequencies =
  foldLeft
    (λ sorted current → insertSorted current sorted)
    []
    frequencies

topKFrequent-precond : List Int → Nat → Set
topKFrequent-precond nums k =
  k ≤ listLength (eraseDups nums)

topKFrequent :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (k : Nat) →
  topKFrequent-precond nums k →
  List Int
topKFrequent nums k h-precond =
  let frequency-list = buildFrequencyList nums
      sorted = sortByDescendingFrequency frequency-list
  in mapList entryKey (takeList k sorted)

record IndexedInt : Set where
  constructor indexed
  field
    indexedValue : Int
    indexedPosition : Nat

open IndexedInt public

zipIdxFrom : Nat → List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdxFrom position [] = []
zipIdxFrom position (x ∷ xs) =
  indexed x position ∷ zipIdxFrom (suc position) xs

zipIdx : List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdx values = zipIdxFrom zero values

orderedByFrequency :
  List Int → IndexedInt → IndexedInt → Set
orderedByFrequency nums first-entry second-entry =
  indexedPosition first-entry < indexedPosition second-entry →
  countInt (indexedValue second-entry) nums ≤
    countInt (indexedValue first-entry) nums

topKFrequent-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (result : List Int) →
  topKFrequent-precond nums k →
  Set
topKFrequent-postcond nums k result h-precond =
  (listLength result ≡ k) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ x → containsInt x nums)
      result) ∧
  Pairwise
    (λ x y → Not (x ≡ y))
    result ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ x →
        allList
          (λ y →
            containsInt y result ||
            natLessOrEqual
              (countInt y nums)
              (countInt x nums))
          nums)
      result) ∧
  Pairwise
    (orderedByFrequency nums)
    (zipIdx result)

topKFrequent-spec-satisfied : Set
topKFrequent-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (k : Nat) →
  (h-precond : topKFrequent-precond nums k) →
  topKFrequent-postcond
    nums
    k
    (topKFrequent nums k h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_76,
  catalog title "topKFrequent": the executable frequency-counting and stable
  descending insertion-sort program returns the requested most-frequent
  integers under its distinct-element precondition. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pairTheory;

val topKFrequent_eraseDups_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_eraseDups_def",
  ``topKFrequent_eraseDups (nums : int list) =
      FOLDL
        (\seen : int list. \x : int.
           if MEM x seen then seen else seen ++ [x])
        ([] : int list)
        nums``
);

val topKFrequent_precond_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_precond_def",
  ``topKFrequent_precond (nums : int list) (k : num) <=>
      k <= LENGTH (topKFrequent_eraseDups nums)``
);

val topKFrequent_freqStep_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_freqStep_def",
  ``topKFrequent_freqStep
      (acc : (int # num) list) (n : int) =
      if MEM n (MAP FST acc) then
        MAP
          (\entry : int # num.
             if FST entry = n then
               (FST entry, SND entry + 1)
             else
               entry)
          acc
      else
        acc ++ [(n, 1)]``
);

val topKFrequent_freqList_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_freqList_def",
  ``topKFrequent_freqList (nums : int list) =
      FOLDL topKFrequent_freqStep
        ([] : (int # num) list) nums``
);

val topKFrequent_insertSorted_def = Define `
  (topKFrequent_insertSorted
      (pair : int # num) ([] : (int # num) list) =
     [pair]) /\
  (topKFrequent_insertSorted
      pair (entry::rest) =
     if SND pair > SND entry then
       pair::entry::rest
     else
       entry::topKFrequent_insertSorted pair rest)
`;

val topKFrequent_sorted_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_sorted_def",
  ``topKFrequent_sorted (nums : int list) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc : (int # num) list. \pair : int # num.
           topKFrequent_insertSorted pair acc)
        ([] : (int # num) list)
        (topKFrequent_freqList nums)``
);

val topKFrequent_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_def",
  ``topKFrequent (nums : int list) (k : num) =
      MAP FST (TAKE k (topKFrequent_sorted nums))``
);

val topKFrequent_count_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_count_def",
  ``topKFrequent_count (nums : int list) (x : int) =
      LENGTH (FILTER (\y : int. y = x) nums)``
);

val topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom_def = Define `
  (topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom
      (index : num) ([] : int list) =
     ([] : (int # num) list)) /\
  (topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom
      index (x::xs) =
     (x, index)::topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom (SUC index) xs)
`;

val topKFrequent_zipIdx_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_zipIdx_def",
  ``topKFrequent_zipIdx (xs : int list) =
      topKFrequent_zipIdxFrom 0 xs``
);

val topKFrequent_ordered_def = Define `
  (topKFrequent_ordered
      (nums : int list) ([] : (int # num) list) =
     T) /\
  (topKFrequent_ordered
      nums (entry::rest) =
     EVERY
       (\later : int # num.
          SND entry < SND later ==>
          topKFrequent_count nums (FST later) <=
          topKFrequent_count nums (FST entry))
       rest /\
     topKFrequent_ordered nums rest)
`;

val topKFrequent_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "topKFrequent_postcond_def",
  ``topKFrequent_postcond
      (nums : int list) (k : num) (result : int list) <=>
      LENGTH result = k /\
      EVERY (\x : int. MEM x nums) result /\
      ALL_DISTINCT result /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
           EVERY
             (\y : int.
                MEM y result \/
                topKFrequent_count nums y <=
                topKFrequent_count nums x)
             nums)
        result /\
      topKFrequent_ordered nums (topKFrequent_zipIdx result)``
);

val topKFrequent_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(nums : int list) (k : num).
      topKFrequent_precond nums k ==>
      topKFrequent_postcond
        nums k (topKFrequent nums k)``;

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_76 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_76), catalog title
  topKFrequent: the exact first-occurrence frequency fold, stable descending
  insertion sort, and take-and-project computation return the requested
  number of most frequent integers with the complete correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains.
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists, and
  VERINA76Pair is the source pair type Int x Nat. For a word w, # ` w is
  its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, ran w is its entry
  set, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA76Count is Lean's List.count with integer equality.
  VERINA76FrequencyUpdateGraph is one exact step of the source freqList
  fold. If find? sees a matching key, the source map increments every
  matching pair and preserves every other pair. If no key matches, the
  source append adds the pair (n, 1). VERINA76FrequencyListGraph records the
  complete left-to-right fold trace from the empty word, and
  VERINA76FrequencyList selects its unique result. In particular, its pairs
  have distinct keys in first-occurrence order, exactly as in the program.

  VERINA76InsertSortedGraph is the exact local insertSorted recursion. The
  insertion position is the first accumulated pair with a strictly smaller
  count, or the word length when none exists. Thus equal-count pairs remain
  in their previous order. VERINA76SortedGraph records the source foldl over
  freqList from the empty word, and VERINA76Sorted selects its unique stable
  descending-frequency result.

  VERINA76TakeKeysGraph reproduces sorted.take k followed by mapping first
  projections, including arbitrary natural k. VERINA76TopKFrequentGraph
  explicitly composes the frequency fold, sorting fold, and take-and-project
  graph, so VERINA76TopKFrequent is fixed by the executable computation
  independently of the postcondition and permits no extra outputs.

  VERINA76DistinctCount is nums.eraseDups.length, equivalently the finite
  cardinality of ran nums. VERINA76Pre is exactly k <= that length.
  VERINA76Post preserves result length k, membership in nums, pairwise
  distinctness, the nested result.all/nums.all frequency-dominance clause,
  and List.Pairwise on result.zipIdx, expanded over all earlier and later
  result positions. The proof-valued precondition arguments are
  computationally and propositionally unused and are represented by the
  explicit antecedent of the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a
  is syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA76Pair VERINA76NatMin VERINA76Count
  VERINA76FrequencyUpdateGraph
  VERINA76FrequencyListGraph VERINA76FrequencyList
  VERINA76InsertSortedGraph
  VERINA76SortedGraph VERINA76Sorted
  VERINA76TakeKeysGraph VERINA76TakeKeys
  VERINA76TopKFrequentGraph VERINA76TopKFrequent
  VERINA76DistinctCount VERINA76Pre VERINA76Post
$.

verina76-pair-syntax
  $a class VERINA76Pair $.
verina76-nat-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76NatMin A B ) $.
verina76-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76Count A B ) $.
verina76-frequency-update-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76FrequencyUpdateGraph A B C ) $.
verina76-frequency-list-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76FrequencyListGraph A B ) $.
verina76-frequency-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76FrequencyList A ) $.
verina76-insert-sorted-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76InsertSortedGraph A B C ) $.
verina76-sorted-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76SortedGraph A B ) $.
verina76-sorted-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76Sorted A ) $.
verina76-take-keys-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76TakeKeysGraph A B C ) $.
verina76-take-keys-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76TakeKeys A B ) $.
verina76-top-k-frequent-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76TopKFrequentGraph A B C ) $.
verina76-top-k-frequent-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76TopKFrequent A B ) $.
verina76-distinct-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA76DistinctCount A ) $.
verina76-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76Pre A B ) $.
verina76-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA76Post A B C ) $.

verina76-pair-definition $a |- VERINA76Pair = (
  ZZ X. NN0
) $.

verina76-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA76NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verina76-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = B
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina76-frequency-update-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76FrequencyUpdateGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA76Pair
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word VERINA76Pair
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( 1st ` ( A ` j ) ) = B
        /\
        (
          ( # ` C ) = ( # ` A )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              C ` i
            ) = if (
              ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) = B ,
              <.
                ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) ,
                ( ( 2nd ` ( A ` i ) ) + 1 )
              >. ,
              ( A ` i )
            )
        )
      )
      \/
      (
        -.
        E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( 1st ` ( A ` j ) ) = B
        /\
        (
          ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              ( C ` i ) = ( A ` i )
            /\
            ( C ` ( # ` A ) ) = <. B , 1 >.
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i t A B $.

  verina76-frequency-list-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76FrequencyListGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA76Pair
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word VERINA76Pair )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA76FrequencyUpdateGraph
                ( t ` i )
                ( A ` i )
                ( t ` ( i + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina76-frequency-list-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76FrequencyList A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA76Pair
      ( VERINA76FrequencyListGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i p A B C $.

  verina76-insert-sorted-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76InsertSortedGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINA76Pair
        /\
        B e. Word VERINA76Pair
      )
      /\
      C e. Word VERINA76Pair
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ p )
              -. (
                ( 2nd ` ( B ` i ) ) < ( 2nd ` A )
              )
            /\
            (
              p < ( # ` B )
              ->
              ( 2nd ` ( B ` p ) ) < ( 2nd ` A )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` C ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
            /\
            (
              ( C ` p ) = A
              /\
              (
                A. i e. ( 0 ..^ p )
                  ( C ` i ) = ( B ` i )
                /\
                A. i e. ( p ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( C ` ( i + 1 ) ) = ( B ` i )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i t A B $.

  verina76-sorted-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76SortedGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINA76Pair
      /\
      B e. Word VERINA76Pair
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word VERINA76Pair )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA76InsertSortedGraph
                ( A ` i )
                ( t ` i )
                ( t ` ( i + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verina76-sorted-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76Sorted A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINA76Pair
      ( VERINA76SortedGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verina76-take-keys-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76TakeKeysGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINA76Pair
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = (
        VERINA76NatMin B ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        ( C ` i ) = ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina76-take-keys-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76TakeKeys A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA76TakeKeysGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f s A B C $.

  verina76-top-k-frequent-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76TopKFrequentGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. f e. Word VERINA76Pair
      E. s e. Word VERINA76Pair
        (
          (
            VERINA76FrequencyListGraph A f
            /\
            VERINA76SortedGraph f s
          )
          /\
          VERINA76TakeKeysGraph s B C
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina76-top-k-frequent-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76TopKFrequent A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA76TopKFrequentGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verina76-distinct-count-definition $a |- (
  VERINA76DistinctCount A
) = (
  # ` ran A
) $.

verina76-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA76Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  B <_ ( VERINA76DistinctCount A )
) $.

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verina76-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA76Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = B
      /\
      (
        ran C C_ ran A
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
              (
                i < j
                ->
                ( C ` i ) =/= ( C ` j )
              )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  ( A ` j ) e. ran C
                  \/
                  (
                    VERINA76Count A ( A ` j )
                  ) <_ (
                    VERINA76Count A ( C ` i )
                  )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
                (
                  i < j
                  ->
                  (
                    VERINA76Count A ( C ` j )
                  ) <_ (
                    VERINA76Count A ( C ` i )
                  )
                )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k w $.

  verina-advanced-76-top-k-frequent $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    A. k e. NN0
      (
        ( VERINA76Pre w k )
        ->
        (
          VERINA76Post
            w
            k
            ( VERINA76TopKFrequent w k )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_76, catalog title "topKFrequent": the distinct-count
:: precondition, exact first-occurrence frequency fold, stable descending
:: insertion-sort fold, top-k projection, full frequency postcondition, and
:: final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, FINSET_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, FINSET_1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums,result being FinSequence of INT,
      k being Nat st
    k <= card (rng nums) &
    (ex freqList,sorted being FinSequence of [:INT,NAT:],
        freqStates,sortStates being FinSequence of [:INT,NAT:]* st
      len freqStates = len nums + 1 &
      freqStates/.1 = <*>[:INT,NAT:] &
      freqStates/.(len nums + 1) = freqList &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom nums holds
        ex current,next being FinSequence of [:INT,NAT:],
           n being Integer st
          current = freqStates/.i &
          next = freqStates/.(i + 1) &
          n = nums/.i &
          (((ex q being Nat, c being Nat st
                q in dom current & current/.q = [n,c]) &
            len next = len current &
            (for q being Nat st q in dom current holds
              ex key being Integer, count being Nat st
                current/.q = [key,count] &
                ((key = n & next/.q = [key,count + 1]) or
                 (key <> n & next/.q = [key,count])))) or
           ((not ex q being Nat, c being Nat st
                q in dom current & current/.q = [n,c]) &
            next = current ^ <*[n,1]*>))) &
      len sortStates = len freqList + 1 &
      sortStates/.1 = <*>[:INT,NAT:] &
      sortStates/.(len freqList + 1) = sorted &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom freqList holds
        ex current,next,leftPart,rightPart
             being FinSequence of [:INT,NAT:],
           pair being Element of [:INT,NAT:],
           x being Integer, cx being Nat st
          current = sortStates/.i &
          next = sortStates/.(i + 1) &
          pair = freqList/.i &
          pair = [x,cx] &
          current = leftPart ^ rightPart &
          next = leftPart ^ <*pair*> ^ rightPart &
          (for q being Nat st q in dom leftPart holds
            ex y being Integer, cy being Nat st
              leftPart/.q = [y,cy] & cx <= cy) &
          (rightPart = <*>[:INT,NAT:] or
            ex y being Integer, cy being Nat st
              rightPart/.1 = [y,cy] & cy < cx)) &
      len result = k &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom result holds
        ex count being Nat st sorted/.i = [result/.i,count]))
  holds
    len result = k &
    (for i being Nat st i in dom result holds result/.i in rng nums) &
    result is one-to-one &
    (for i,j being Nat st i in dom result & j in dom nums holds
      nums/.j in rng result or
      len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
        q in dom nums & nums.q = result/.i}) >=
      len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
        q in dom nums & nums.q = nums/.j})) &
    for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
    holds
      len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
        q in dom nums & nums.q = result/.i}) >=
      len Seq (nums | {q where q is Nat :
        q in dom nums & nums.q = result/.j})
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_76
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_76, catalog title "topKFrequent": counting integer
% occurrences in first-occurrence order, stably sorting by descending
% frequency, and returning the first k keys under the full executable
% correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_76: THEORY
BEGIN

  frequency_pair: TYPE =
    [# frequency_key: int,
       frequency_count: nat #]

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_member(
      requested: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = requested
          OR int_member(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  append_int(
      values: list[int],
      value: int): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(value, null[int]),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, append_int(tail, value))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  distinct_values_fold(
      remaining, seen: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        seen,
      cons(head, tail):
        distinct_values_fold(
          tail,
          IF int_member(head, seen) THEN
            seen
          ELSE
            append_int(seen, head)
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  distinct_count(values: list[int]): nat =
    int_list_length(
      distinct_values_fold(values, null[int]))

  topKFrequent_precond(
      nums: list[int],
      k: nat): bool =
    k <= distinct_count(nums)

  frequency_key_member(
      requested: int,
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES frequencies OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        frequency_key(head) = requested
          OR frequency_key_member(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE frequencies BY <<

  increment_frequency(
      requested: int,
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    CASES frequencies OF
      null:
        null[frequency_pair],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          IF frequency_key(head) = requested THEN
            (# frequency_key := frequency_key(head),
               frequency_count := frequency_count(head) + 1 #)
          ELSE
            head
          ENDIF,
          increment_frequency(requested, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE frequencies BY <<

  append_frequency_pair(
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair],
      pair: frequency_pair): RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    CASES frequencies OF
      null:
        cons(pair, null[frequency_pair]),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          head,
          append_frequency_pair(tail, pair))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE frequencies BY <<

  build_frequency_list(
      remaining: list[int],
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        frequencies,
      cons(head, tail):
        build_frequency_list(
          tail,
          IF frequency_key_member(head, frequencies) THEN
            increment_frequency(head, frequencies)
          ELSE
            append_frequency_pair(
              frequencies,
              (# frequency_key := head,
                 frequency_count := 1 #))
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  insert_by_descending_frequency(
      pair: frequency_pair,
      sorted: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    CASES sorted OF
      null:
        cons(pair, null[frequency_pair]),
      cons(head, tail):
        IF frequency_count(pair) > frequency_count(head) THEN
          cons(pair, cons(head, tail))
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            insert_by_descending_frequency(pair, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE sorted BY <<

  stable_frequency_sort_fold(
      remaining, sorted: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        sorted,
      cons(head, tail):
        stable_frequency_sort_fold(
          tail,
          insert_by_descending_frequency(head, sorted))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  take_frequency_pairs(
      k: nat,
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[frequency_pair] =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      null[frequency_pair]
    ELSE
      CASES frequencies OF
        null:
          null[frequency_pair],
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            take_frequency_pairs(k - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE k

  frequency_keys(
      frequencies: list[frequency_pair]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES frequencies OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          frequency_key(head),
          frequency_keys(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE frequencies BY <<

  % The Lean precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant. The
  % two folds and strict comparison below exactly preserve first insertion
  % order and place a new equal-frequency pair after existing equal pairs.
  topKFrequent(
      nums: list[int],
      k: nat): list[int] =
    LET frequencies: list[frequency_pair] =
          build_frequency_list(
            nums,
            null[frequency_pair]),
        sorted: list[frequency_pair] =
          stable_frequency_sort_fold(
            frequencies,
            null[frequency_pair])
    IN
      frequency_keys(
        take_frequency_pairs(k, sorted))

  occurrence_count(
      requested: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = requested THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(requested, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_members_of(
      values, source: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_member(head, source)
          AND all_members_of(tail, source)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicate_ints(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT int_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_ints(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_competitors_bounded(
      selected: int,
      competitors, original, result: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES competitors OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (int_member(head, result)
          OR occurrence_count(selected, original)
               >= occurrence_count(head, original))
          AND all_competitors_bounded(
                selected,
                tail,
                original,
                result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE competitors BY <<

  every_result_dominates(
      remaining, original, result: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_competitors_bounded(
          head,
          original,
          original,
          result)
          AND every_result_dominates(
                tail,
                original,
                result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  all_later_counts_at_most(
      selected: int,
      later, original: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        occurrence_count(selected, original)
            >= occurrence_count(head, original)
          AND all_later_counts_at_most(
                selected,
                tail,
                original)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later BY <<

  % In zipIdx, every element recursively compared by List.Pairwise has a
  % strictly larger index, so the source implication reduces exactly to this
  % pairwise non-increasing-frequency predicate.
  pairwise_nonincreasing_frequencies(
      values, original: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:

      cons(head, tail):
        all_later_counts_at_most(

          tail,
          original)
          AND pairwise_nonincreasing_frequencies(

                original)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  topKFrequent_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      k: nat,

    int_list_length(result) = k
      AND all_members_of(result, nums)
      AND no_duplicate_ints(result)
      AND every_result_dominates(
            result,
            nums,
            result)
      AND pairwise_nonincreasing_frequencies(
            result,
            nums)

  topKFrequent_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int], k: nat):
      topKFrequent_precond(nums, k)
        IMPLIES
          topKFrequent_postcond(

            topKFrequent(nums, k))

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_77,
   catalog title "trapRainWater": an executable two-pointer computation of
   trapped rainwater over natural-number elevations, together with the
   per-index maximum-height summation correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition trapRainWater_precond
    (_height : list nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint trapLoop_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (height : list nat)
    (left right leftMax rightMax water : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => water
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb left right
      then
        let hLeft := nth left height 0 in
        let hRight := nth right height 0 in
        if Nat.ltb hLeft hRight
        then
          if Nat.leb leftMax hLeft
          then
            trapLoop_fuel
              fuel' height (S left) right hLeft rightMax water
          else
            trapLoop_fuel
              fuel' height (S left) right leftMax rightMax
              (water + (leftMax - hLeft))
        else
          if Nat.leb rightMax hRight
          then
            trapLoop_fuel
              fuel' height left (right - 1) leftMax hRight water
          else
            trapLoop_fuel
              fuel' height left (right - 1) leftMax rightMax
              (water + (rightMax - hRight))
      else water
  end.

Definition trapLoop
    (height : list nat)
    (left right leftMax rightMax water : nat) : nat :=
  trapLoop_fuel
    (S (right - left))
    height left right leftMax rightMax water.

Definition trapRainWater
    (height : list nat)
    (_h_precond : trapRainWater_precond height) : nat :=
  trapLoop height 0 (length height - 1) 0 0 0.

Definition trapRainWater_postcond
    (height : list nat)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : trapRainWater_precond height) : Prop :=
  let waterAt :=
    map
      (fun i =>
        let lmax :=
          fold_left Nat.max (firstn (i + 1) height) 0 in
        let rmax :=
          fold_left Nat.max (skipn i height) 0 in
        Nat.min lmax rmax - nth i height 0)
      (seq 0 (length height)) in
  result - fold_left Nat.add waterAt 0 = 0 /\
  fold_left Nat.add waterAt 0 <= result.

Theorem trapRainWater_spec_satisfied
    (height : list nat)
    (h_precond : trapRainWater_precond height) :
  trapRainWater_postcond
    height (trapRainWater height h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_77,
  catalog title "trapRainWater": an executable two-pointer program computes
  trapped rain water from a list of natural-number elevations, together with
  its precondition, exact water-sum postcondition, and final correctness
  proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_77
  imports Main
begin

definition trapRainWater_getBang ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "trapRainWater_getBang xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else 0)"

definition trapRainWater_precond :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "trapRainWater_precond height \<longleftrightarrow> True"

partial_function (tailrec) trapLoop ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "trapLoop height left right leftMax rightMax water =
    (if left < right then
       let hLeft = trapRainWater_getBang height left;
           hRight = trapRainWater_getBang height right
       in
         if hLeft < hRight then
           let updated =
             (if leftMax \<le> hLeft
              then (hLeft, water)
              else (leftMax, water + (leftMax - hLeft)))
           in trapLoop height (left + 1) right
                (fst updated) rightMax (snd updated)
         else
           let updated =
             (if rightMax \<le> hRight
              then (hRight, water)
              else (rightMax, water + (rightMax - hRight)))
           in trapLoop height left (right - 1)
                leftMax (fst updated) (snd updated)
     else water)"

definition trapRainWater :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "trapRainWater height =
    trapLoop height 0 (length height - 1) 0 0 0"

definition trapRainWater_waterAt :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "trapRainWater_waterAt height =
    map
      (\<lambda>i.
        let lmax = foldl max 0 (take (i + 1) height);
            rmax = foldl max 0 (drop i height)
        in min lmax rmax - trapRainWater_getBang height i)
      [0..<length height]"

definition trapRainWater_postcond ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "trapRainWater_postcond height result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let total = foldl (+) 0 (trapRainWater_waterAt height)
     in result - total = 0 \<and> total \<le> result)"

theorem trapRainWater_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "trapRainWater_precond height"
  shows "trapRainWater_postcond height (trapRainWater height)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_77
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_77,
  catalog title "trapRainWater": a deterministic two-pointer program computes
  trapped rain water over natural-number elevations, with its total
  precondition and per-index water-sum correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let trapRainWater_precond = new_definition
  `trapRainWater_precond (height:num list) <=> T`;;

let trapRainWater_get =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!height:num list.
        trapRainWater_get 0 height =
        if height = [] then 0 else HD height) /\
     (!i:num. !height:num list.
        trapRainWater_get (SUC i) height =
        if height = [] then 0
        else trapRainWater_get i (TL height))`;;

let trapRainWater_loopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!height:num list.
      !left:num. !right:num.
      !leftMax:num. !rightMax:num. !water:num.
        trapRainWater_loopFuel
          0 height left right leftMax rightMax water =
        water) /\
     (!fuel:num. !height:num list.
      !left:num. !right:num.
      !leftMax:num. !rightMax:num. !water:num.
        trapRainWater_loopFuel
          (SUC fuel) height left right leftMax rightMax water =
        if left < right then
          let hLeft = trapRainWater_get left height in
          let hRight = trapRainWater_get right height in
          if hLeft < hRight then
            if hLeft >= leftMax then
              trapRainWater_loopFuel
                fuel height (left + 1) right
                hLeft rightMax water
            else
              trapRainWater_loopFuel
                fuel height (left + 1) right
                leftMax rightMax (water + (leftMax - hLeft))
          else
            if hRight >= rightMax then
              trapRainWater_loopFuel
                fuel height left (right - 1)
                leftMax hRight water
            else
              trapRainWater_loopFuel
                fuel height left (right - 1)
                leftMax rightMax (water + (rightMax - hRight))
        else
          water)`;;

let trapLoop = new_definition
  `trapLoop
      (height:num list)
      (left:num) (right:num)
      (leftMax:num) (rightMax:num) (water:num) =
     trapRainWater_loopFuel
       (right - left) height left right leftMax rightMax water`;;

let trapRainWater = new_definition
  `trapRainWater (height:num list) =
     trapLoop height 0 (LENGTH height - 1) 0 0 0`;;

let trapRainWater_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!height:num list.
        trapRainWater_take 0 height = []) /\
     (!n:num. !height:num list.
        trapRainWater_take (SUC n) height =
        if height = [] then []
        else CONS (HD height)
          (trapRainWater_take n (TL height)))`;;

let trapRainWater_drop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!height:num list.
        trapRainWater_drop 0 height = height) /\
     (!n:num. !height:num list.
        trapRainWater_drop (SUC n) height =
        if height = [] then []
        else trapRainWater_drop n (TL height))`;;

let trapRainWater_maxFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:num.
        trapRainWater_maxFold acc [] = acc) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list. !acc:num.
        trapRainWater_maxFold acc (CONS x xs) =
        trapRainWater_maxFold (MAX acc x) xs)`;;

let trapRainWater_waterAtFrom =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!height:num list. !i:num.
        trapRainWater_waterAtFrom 0 height i = []) /\
     (!count:num. !height:num list. !i:num.
        trapRainWater_waterAtFrom (SUC count) height i =
        let lmax =
          trapRainWater_maxFold 0
            (trapRainWater_take (i + 1) height) in
        let rmax =
          trapRainWater_maxFold 0
            (trapRainWater_drop i height) in
        CONS
          (MIN lmax rmax - trapRainWater_get i height)
          (trapRainWater_waterAtFrom
            count height (i + 1)))`;;

let trapRainWater_waterAt = new_definition
  `trapRainWater_waterAt (height:num list) =
     trapRainWater_waterAtFrom (LENGTH height) height 0`;;

let trapRainWater_sumFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:num.
        trapRainWater_sumFold acc [] = acc) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list. !acc:num.
        trapRainWater_sumFold acc (CONS x xs) =
        trapRainWater_sumFold (acc + x) xs)`;;

let trapRainWater_postcond = new_definition
  `trapRainWater_postcond
      (height:num list) (result:num) <=>
     let total =
       trapRainWater_sumFold 0
         (trapRainWater_waterAt height) in
     result - total = 0 /\ total <= result`;;

let trapRainWater_spec_satisfied =
  `!height:num list.
     trapRainWater_precond height
     ==> trapRainWater_postcond
           height (trapRainWater height)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_77,
;; catalog title "trapRainWater": an exact two-pointer natural-list program
;; computes trapped rain water and satisfies its prefix/suffix-maximum
;; specification. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Nat domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of naturals.

(defun verina-advanced-77-natural-listp (height)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count height)))
  (if (consp height)
      (and
       (natp (car height))
       (verina-advanced-77-natural-listp (cdr height)))
    (equal height nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water-precond (height)
  (declare (ignore height))
  t)

;; This is Lean's truncated subtraction on naturals.

(defun verina-advanced-77-nat-sub (left right)
  (nfix (- (nfix left) (nfix right))))

;; List.get! returns the default natural zero outside the list.

(defun verina-advanced-77-nth-default-zero (index values)
  (if (and
       (natp index)
       (< index (len values)))
      (nfix (nth index values))
    0))

;; FUEL is exactly right - left. Every recursive source step either increments
;; LEFT or decrements RIGHT, so this is an exact operational presentation of
;; the source's well-founded recursion rather than an execution bound.

(defun verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
    (height left right left-max right-max water fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      water
    (if (< left right)
        (let ((height-left
               (verina-advanced-77-nth-default-zero
                left
                height))
              (height-right
               (verina-advanced-77-nth-default-zero
                right
                height)))
          (if (< height-left height-right)
              (if (>= height-left left-max)
                  (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
                   height
                   (+ left 1)
                   right
                   height-left
                   right-max
                   water
                   (- fuel 1))
                (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
                 height
                 (+ left 1)
                 right
                 left-max
                 right-max
                 (+ water
                    (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub
                     left-max
                     height-left))
                 (- fuel 1)))
            (if (>= height-right right-max)
                (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
                 height
                 left
                 (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub right 1)
                 left-max
                 height-right
                 water
                 (- fuel 1))
              (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
               height
               left
               (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub right 1)
               left-max
               right-max
               (+ water
                  (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub
                   right-max
                   height-right))
               (- fuel 1)))))
      water)))

(defun verina-advanced-77-trap-loop
    (height left right left-max right-max water)
  (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop-fuel
   height
   left
   right
   left-max
   right-max
   water
   (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub right left)))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant in
;; Lean and is erased here. All remaining arguments and initial values are
;; exactly those of trapRainWater.

(defun verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water (height)
  (verina-advanced-77-trap-loop
   height
   0
   (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub (len height) 1)
   0
   0
   0))

;; These helpers reproduce List.take, List.drop, and foldl Nat.max 0.

(defun verina-advanced-77-take (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp values)
        (cons
         (car values)
         (verina-advanced-77-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr values)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-77-drop (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      values
    (if (consp values)
        (verina-advanced-77-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr values))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-77-fold-max (values accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (verina-advanced-77-fold-max
       (cdr values)
       (if (>= (car values) accumulator)
           (car values)
         accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-77-nat-min (left right)
  (if (<= left right)
      left
    right))

;; This is the postcondition's waterAt value for one index.

(defun verina-advanced-77-water-at-index (height index)
  (let* ((left-max
          (verina-advanced-77-fold-max
           (verina-advanced-77-take
            (+ index 1)
            height)
           0))
         (right-max
          (verina-advanced-77-fold-max
           (verina-advanced-77-drop index height)
           0))
         (bounded-height
          (verina-advanced-77-nat-min
           left-max
           right-max)))
    (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub
     bounded-height
     (verina-advanced-77-nth-default-zero
      index
      height))))

;; These functions reproduce List.range height.length, its map by waterAt, and
;; the final left fold by natural addition.

(defun verina-advanced-77-range-from
    (index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     index
     (verina-advanced-77-range-from
      (+ index 1)
      (- remaining 1)))))

(defun verina-advanced-77-range (count)
  (verina-advanced-77-range-from 0 count))

(defun verina-advanced-77-map-water-at
    (indices height)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count indices)))
  (if (consp indices)
      (cons
       (verina-advanced-77-water-at-index
        height
        (car indices))
       (verina-advanced-77-map-water-at
        (cdr indices)
        height))
    nil))

(defun verina-advanced-77-fold-sum
    (values accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (verina-advanced-77-fold-sum
       (cdr values)
       (+ accumulator (car values)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-advanced-77-expected-water (height)
  (verina-advanced-77-fold-sum
   (verina-advanced-77-map-water-at
    (verina-advanced-77-range (len height))
    height)
   0))

;; The two conjuncts deliberately preserve the source Nat subtraction
;; formulation rather than replacing it textually by equality.

(defun verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water-postcond
    (height result)
  (let ((expected
         (verina-advanced-77-expected-water height)))
    (and
     (verina-advanced-77-natural-listp height)
     (natp result)
     (equal
      (verina-advanced-77-nat-sub result expected)
      0)
     (<= expected result))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Nat binder and source precondition; its
;; conclusion applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water-spec-satisfied-statement
    (height)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-77-natural-listp height)
    (verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water-precond height))
   (verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water-postcond
    height
    (verina-advanced-77-trap-rain-water height))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
