;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_79,
;; catalog title "twoSum": a deterministic nested search on an integer list
;; returns the lexicographically first increasing pair of indices whose values
;; sum to the target, or none when no such pair exists. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's List Int domain is represented by proper ACL2 lists of integers.

(defun verina-advanced-79-integer-listp (nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (integerp (car nums))
       (verina-advanced-79-integer-listp (cdr nums)))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; The source precondition is True.

(defun verina-advanced-79-two-sum-precond (nums target)
  (declare (ignore nums target))
  t)

;; Option (Nat x Nat) is represented by :none or by
;; (:some . (first-index . second-index)).

(defun verina-advanced-79-option-index-pair-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result :none)
   (and
    (consp result)
    (equal (car result) :some)
    (consp (cdr result))
    (natp (car (cdr result)))
    (natp (cdr (cdr result))))))

(defun verina-advanced-79-some-index (index)
  (cons :some index))

(defun verina-advanced-79-some-index-pair
    (first-index second-index)
  (cons :some (cons first-index second-index)))

;; This is the source-local inner recursion. It scans the suffix from left to
;; right and returns the first index whose value forms the target sum with X.

(defun verina-advanced-79-inner
    (remaining x target index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (equal (+ x (car remaining)) target)
          (verina-advanced-79-some-index index)
        (verina-advanced-79-inner
         (cdr remaining)
         x
         target
         (+ index 1)))
    :none))

;; This is the source-local outer recursion. For each list position it runs
;; INNER on exactly the later positions, then advances only if no partner was
;; found. Thus its traversal order is lexicographic in the two indices.

(defun verina-advanced-79-outer
    (remaining target index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((inner-result
             (verina-advanced-79-inner
              (cdr remaining)
              (car remaining)
              target
              (+ index 1))))
        (if (and
             (consp inner-result)
             (equal (car inner-result) :some))
            (verina-advanced-79-some-index-pair
             index
             (cdr inner-result))
          (verina-advanced-79-outer
           (cdr remaining)
           target
           (+ index 1))))
    :none))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; in Lean and is erased here. The remaining call is exactly outer nums 0.

(defun verina-advanced-79-two-sum (nums target)
  (verina-advanced-79-outer nums target 0))

;; These are exact total representations of List.drop and List.take on natural
;; counts.

(defun verina-advanced-79-drop (count nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nums
    (if (consp nums)
        (verina-advanced-79-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr nums))
      nil)))

(defun verina-advanced-79-take (count nums)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp nums)
        (cons
         (car nums)
         (verina-advanced-79-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr nums)))
      nil)))

;; This is List.all for the predicate that a fixed value does not sum with
;; any element of NUMS to TARGET.

(defun verina-advanced-79-no-sum-with-all-p
    (value nums target)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (not (equal (+ value (car nums)) target))
       (verina-advanced-79-no-sum-with-all-p
        value
        (cdr nums)
        target))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; These two predicates exactly render
;; List.Pairwise (fun left right => left + right != target).

(defun verina-advanced-79-pairwise-no-sum-p
    (nums target)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count nums)))
  (if (consp nums)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-79-no-sum-with-all-p
        (car nums)
        (cdr nums)
        target)
       (verina-advanced-79-pairwise-no-sum-p
        (cdr nums)
        target))
    (equal nums nil)))

;; PREFIX is nums.take i. Attaching INDEX = 0 and advancing it reproduces
;; zipIdx. For every earlier first index i', DROP checks all possible later
;; partners, exactly matching the first lexicographic-minimality clause.

(defun verina-advanced-79-no-earlier-pair-p
    (prefix whole index target)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count prefix)))
  (if (consp prefix)
      (and
       (verina-advanced-79-no-sum-with-all-p
        (car prefix)
        (verina-advanced-79-drop
         (+ index 1)
         whole)
        target)
       (verina-advanced-79-no-earlier-pair-p
        (cdr prefix)
        whole
        (+ index 1)
        target))
    (equal prefix nil)))

;; Lean's natural expression j - i - 1 uses truncated subtraction at each
;; step.

(defun verina-advanced-79-partners-before-count (i j)
  (nfix (- (nfix (- j i)) 1)))

(defun verina-advanced-79-two-sum-postcond
    (nums target result)
  (and
   (verina-advanced-79-integer-listp nums)
   (integerp target)
   (verina-advanced-79-option-index-pair-p result)
   (if (equal result :none)
       (verina-advanced-79-pairwise-no-sum-p
        nums
        target)
     (let* ((index-pair (cdr result))
            (i (car index-pair))
            (j (cdr index-pair)))
       (and
        (< i j)
        (< j (len nums))
        (equal
         (+ (nth i nums) (nth j nums))
         target)
        (verina-advanced-79-no-earlier-pair-p
         (verina-advanced-79-take i nums)
         nums
         0
         target)
        (verina-advanced-79-no-sum-with-all-p
         (nth i nums)
         (verina-advanced-79-take
          (verina-advanced-79-partners-before-count i j)
          (verina-advanced-79-drop
           (+ i 1)
           nums))
         target))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves the List Int and Int binder domains and the True
;; precondition; its conclusion connects the complete postcondition to the
;; exact executable result.

(defun
    verina-advanced-79-two-sum-spec-satisfied-statement
    (nums target)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-advanced-79-integer-listp nums)
    (integerp target)
    (verina-advanced-79-two-sum-precond
     nums
     target))
   (verina-advanced-79-two-sum-postcond
    nums
    target
    (verina-advanced-79-two-sum
     nums
     target))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

zeroInt : Int

one : Nat
one = suc zero

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

record NatPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : Nat
    pairSecond : Nat

open NatPair public

record IndexedInt : Set where
  constructor indexed
  field
    indexedValue : Int
    indexedPosition : Nat

open IndexedInt public

zipIdxFrom : Nat → List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdxFrom position [] = []
zipIdxFrom position (x ∷ xs) =
  indexed x position ∷ zipIdxFrom (suc position) xs

zipIdx : List Int → List IndexedInt
zipIdx nums = zipIdxFrom zero nums

twoSum-precond : List Int → Int → Set
twoSum-precond nums target = Top

findPartner :
  Int →
  List Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Maybe Nat
findPartner x [] target j = nothing
findPartner x (y ∷ ys) target j =
  if intEqual (intAdd x y) target
  then just j
  else findPartner x ys target (suc j)

twoSumAux :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Maybe NatPair
twoSumAux [] target i = nothing
twoSumAux (x ∷ xs) target i
  with findPartner x xs target (suc i)
... | just j = just (pair i j)
... | nothing = twoSumAux xs target (suc i)

twoSum :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (target : Int) →
  twoSum-precond nums target →
  Maybe NatPair
twoSum nums target h-precond =
  twoSumAux nums target zero

NoTargetSum : Int → Int → Int → Set
NoTargetSum target x y =
  Not (intAdd x y ≡ target)

noEarlierFirstPair :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Bool
noEarlierFirstPair nums target i =
  allList
    (λ entry →
      allList
        (λ b →
          boolNot
            (intEqual
              (intAdd (indexedValue entry) b)
              target))
        (dropList (suc (indexedPosition entry)) nums))
    (zipIdx (takeList i nums))

noEarlierPartner :
  List Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
noEarlierPartner nums target i j =
  allList
    (λ b →
      boolNot
        (intEqual
          (intAdd (indexDefault zeroInt nums i) b)
          target))
    (takeList
      (natSubtract (natSubtract j i) one)
      (dropList (suc i) nums))

twoSum-postcond :
  (nums : List Int) →
  (target : Int) →
  (result : Maybe NatPair) →
  twoSum-precond nums target →
  Set
twoSum-postcond nums target nothing h-precond =
  Pairwise (NoTargetSum target) nums
twoSum-postcond nums target (just result) h-precond =
  let i = pairFirst result
      j = pairSecond result
  in
    (i < j) ∧
    (j < listLength nums) ∧
    (intAdd
      (indexDefault zeroInt nums i)
      (indexDefault zeroInt nums j) ≡ target) ∧
    IsTrue (noEarlierFirstPair nums target i) ∧
    IsTrue (noEarlierPartner nums target i j)

twoSum-spec-satisfied : Set
twoSum-spec-satisfied =
  (nums : List Int) →
  (target : Int) →
  (h-precond : twoSum-precond nums target) →
  twoSum-postcond
    nums
    target
    (twoSum nums target h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_79
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_79,
  catalog title "twoSum": the executable nested left-to-right search returns
  the lexicographically first increasing pair of indices whose integer values
  sum to the target, or NONE when no such pair exists. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory pairTheory;

val twoSum_nthD_def = Define `
  (twoSum_nthD
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (twoSum_nthD
      0 (x::xs) = x) /\
  (twoSum_nthD
      (SUC index) (x::xs) =
     twoSum_nthD index xs)
`;

val twoSum_precond_def = new_definition (
  "twoSum_precond_def",
  ``twoSum_precond
      (nums : int list) (target : int) <=>
      T``
);

val twoSum_inner_def = Define `
  (twoSum_inner
      (x : int)
      ([] : int list)
      (target : int)
      (j : num) =
     (NONE : num option)) /\
  (twoSum_inner
      x
      (y::ys)
      target
      j =
     if x + y = target then
       SOME j
     else
       twoSum_inner x ys target (j + 1))
`;

val twoSum_outer_def = Define `
  (twoSum_outer
      ([] : int list)
      (target : int)
      (i : num) =
     (NONE : (num # num) option)) /\
  (twoSum_outer
      (x::xs)
      target
      i =
     case twoSum_inner x xs target (i + 1) of
       NONE => twoSum_outer xs target (i + 1)
     | SOME j => SOME (i,j))
`;

val twoSum_def = new_definition (
  "twoSum_def",
  ``twoSum
      (nums : int list) (target : int) =
      twoSum_outer nums target 0``
);

val twoSum_pairwiseNoSum_def = Define `
  (twoSum_pairwiseNoSum
      (target : int) ([] : int list) <=>
     T) /\
  (twoSum_pairwiseNoSum
      target (x::xs) <=>
     EVERY (\y : int. x + y <> target) xs /\
     twoSum_pairwiseNoSum target xs)
`;

val twoSum_noEarlierOuter_def = new_definition (
  "twoSum_noEarlierOuter_def",
  ``twoSum_noEarlierOuter
      (nums : int list) (target : int) (i : num) <=>
      !i' k.
        i' < i /\ i' < k /\ k < LENGTH nums ==>
        twoSum_nthD i' nums + twoSum_nthD k nums <> target``
);

val twoSum_noEarlierInner_def = new_definition (
  "twoSum_noEarlierInner_def",
  ``twoSum_noEarlierInner
      (nums : int list) (target : int) (i : num) (j : num) <=>
      !k.
        i < k /\ k < j ==>
        twoSum_nthD i nums + twoSum_nthD k nums <> target``
);

val twoSum_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "twoSum_postcond_def",
  ``twoSum_postcond
      (nums : int list)
      (target : int)
      (result : (num # num) option) <=>
      case result of
        NONE => twoSum_pairwiseNoSum target nums
      | SOME pair =>
          let i = FST pair in
          let j = SND pair in
            i < j /\
            j < LENGTH nums /\
            twoSum_nthD i nums + twoSum_nthD j nums = target /\
            twoSum_noEarlierOuter nums target i /\
            twoSum_noEarlierInner nums target i j``
);

val twoSum_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(nums : int list) (target : int).
      twoSum_precond nums target ==>
      twoSum_postcond
        nums target (twoSum nums target)``;

title: verina_advanced_79
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_79 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_79), catalog title
  twoSum: the exact nested recursive search returns the lexicographically
  first pair of increasing indices whose integer entries sum to the target,
  or none when no such pair exists, with its full correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA79GetBang reproduces Lean's zero-default List.get! indexing, and
  VERINA79NatSub is truncated natural subtraction. VERINA79Drop is exactly
  List.drop. VERINA79None and VERINA79Some give disjoint tagged encodings
  used by VERINA79OptionNat and VERINA79OptionPair.

  VERINA79InnerGraph is the exact local inner recursion: on a finite suffix
  it returns the supplied starting index plus the position of the first
  entry whose sum with the fixed outer value is the target, and returns none
  exactly when no such entry exists. VERINA79OuterGraph is the exact local
  outer recursion: it tests outer positions from left to right using that
  inner computation, returns the first successful index pair, and returns
  none exactly when every outer position fails. VERINA79TwoSum invokes the
  outer recursion with index zero, independently of the postcondition.

  VERINA79Pre is the source True precondition together with the List Int and
  Int binder domains. In VERINA79Post, the none branch is exactly
  List.Pairwise failure of the target sum. The some branch preserves the
  increasing indices, bound, indexed sum, absence of a solution at every
  earlier outer index, and absence of an earlier partner for the selected
  outer index. The two finite universal clauses are bidirectionally
  equivalent to the source take/zipIdx/drop/all expressions under the stated
  index bounds. The proof-valued precondition arguments are computationally
  and propositionally unused and are represented by the explicit antecedent
  of the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a
  faithful definition required by this rendering, and this database has no
  $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA79GetBang VERINA79NatSub
  VERINA79None VERINA79Some
  VERINA79PairNat VERINA79OptionNat VERINA79OptionPair
  VERINA79DropGraph VERINA79Drop
  VERINA79InnerGraph VERINA79Inner
  VERINA79OuterGraph VERINA79Outer VERINA79TwoSum
  VERINA79Pre VERINA79Post
$.

verina79-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79GetBang A B ) $.
verina79-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79NatSub A B ) $.
verina79-none-syntax
  $a class VERINA79None $.
verina79-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79Some A ) $.
verina79-pair-nat-syntax
  $a class VERINA79PairNat $.
verina79-option-nat-syntax
  $a class VERINA79OptionNat $.
verina79-option-pair-syntax
  $a class VERINA79OptionPair $.
verina79-drop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA79DropGraph A B C ) $.
verina79-drop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79Drop A B ) $.
verina79-inner-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA79InnerGraph A B C D E ) $.
verina79-inner-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79Inner A B C D ) $.
verina79-outer-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA79OuterGraph A B C D ) $.
verina79-outer-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79Outer A B C ) $.
verina79-two-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA79TwoSum A B ) $.
verina79-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA79Pre A B ) $.
verina79-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA79Post A B C ) $.

verina79-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINA79GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verina79-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINA79NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verina79-none-definition $a |- VERINA79None = (/) $.

verina79-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINA79Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

verina79-pair-nat-definition $a |- VERINA79PairNat = (
  NN0 X. NN0
) $.

${
  $d x y $.

  verina79-option-nat-definition $a |- VERINA79OptionNat =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA79None
        \/
        E. y e. NN0 x = ( VERINA79Some y )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d p x $.

  verina79-option-pair-definition $a |- VERINA79OptionPair =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINA79None
        \/
        E. p e. VERINA79PairNat x = ( VERINA79Some p )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina79-drop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79DropGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        # ` C
      ) = (
        VERINA79NatSub
          ( # ` A )
          B
      )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          C ` k
        ) = (
          A ` ( B + k )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina79-drop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79Drop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINA79DropGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k m A B C D E $.

  verina79-inner-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79InnerGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. ZZ
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. VERINA79OptionNat
    )
    /\
    (
      E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          (
            C + ( A ` k )
          ) = B
          /\
          (
            E = (
              VERINA79Some
                ( D + k )
            )
            /\
            A. m e. ( 0 ..^ k )
              (
                C + ( A ` m )
              ) =/= B
          )
        )
      \/
      (
        -.
        E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            C + ( A ` k )
          ) = B
        /\
        E = VERINA79None
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d o A B C D $.

  verina79-inner-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79Inner A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ o e. VERINA79OptionNat
      ( VERINA79InnerGraph A B C D o )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k m A B C D $.

  verina79-outer-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79OuterGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        C e. NN0
      )
      /\
      D e. VERINA79OptionPair
    )
    /\
    (
      E. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        E. j e. NN0
          (
            (
              VERINA79Inner
                ( VERINA79Drop A ( k + 1 ) )
                B
                ( A ` k )
                ( ( C + k ) + 1 )
            ) = (
              VERINA79Some j
            )
            /\
            (
              D = (
                VERINA79Some
                  <. ( C + k ) , j >.
              )
              /\
              A. m e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                (
                  VERINA79Inner
                    ( VERINA79Drop A ( m + 1 ) )
                    B
                    ( A ` m )
                    ( ( C + m ) + 1 )
                ) = VERINA79None
            )
          )
      \/
      (
        (
          A. m e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              VERINA79Inner
                ( VERINA79Drop A ( m + 1 ) )
                B
                ( A ` m )
                ( ( C + m ) + 1 )
            ) = VERINA79None
        )
        /\
        D = VERINA79None
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d o A B C $.

  verina79-outer-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79Outer A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ o e. VERINA79OptionPair
      ( VERINA79OuterGraph A B C o )
  ) $.
$}

verina79-two-sum-definition $a |- (
  VERINA79TwoSum A B
) = (
  VERINA79Outer A B 0
) $.

verina79-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA79Pre A B
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  B e. ZZ
) $.

${
  $d i j m n A B C $.

  verina79-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA79Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINA79OptionPair
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        C = VERINA79None
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          A. j e. ( ( i + 1 ) ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( A ` i ) + ( A ` j )
            ) =/= B
      )
      \/
      E. i e. NN0 E. j e. NN0
        (
          C = (
            VERINA79Some <. i , j >.
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              i < j
              /\
              j < ( # ` A )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                VERINA79GetBang A i
              ) + (
                VERINA79GetBang A j
              )
            ) = B
            /\
            (
              A. m e. ( 0 ..^ i )
                A. n e. ( ( m + 1 ) ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                  (
                    ( A ` m ) + ( A ` n )
                  ) =/= B
              /\
              A. n e. ( ( i + 1 ) ..^ j )
                (
                  ( VERINA79GetBang A i ) + ( A ` n )
                ) =/= B
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-79-two-sum $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  A. z e. ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA79Pre w z )
      ->
      (
        VERINA79Post
          w
          z
          ( VERINA79TwoSum w z )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_advanced_79
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_79, catalog title "twoSum": the true precondition, exact
:: nested left-to-right search implementation, optional lexicographically
:: first index-pair postcondition, and final correctness contract.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for nums being FinSequence of INT,
      target being Integer,
      result being Element of [:BOOLEAN,[:NAT,NAT:]:] st
    (ex preconditionValue being Element of BOOLEAN,
        inner being Function of [:INT*,[:INT,INT:],NAT:],NAT,
        outer being
          Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],[:BOOLEAN,[:NAT,NAT:]:] st
      preconditionValue = TRUE &
      (for wanted,x being Integer, candidate being Nat holds
        inner/.[<*>INT,[wanted,x],candidate] = 0) &
      (for y,wanted,x being Integer, candidate being Nat,
           ys,whole being FinSequence of INT st
        whole = <*y*> ^ ys
      holds
        (x + y = wanted &
          inner/.[whole,[wanted,x],candidate] = candidate + 1) or
        (x + y <> wanted &
          inner/.[whole,[wanted,x],candidate] =
            inner/.[ys,[wanted,x],candidate + 1])) &
      (for wanted being Integer, i being Nat holds
        outer/.[<*>INT,wanted,i] = [FALSE,[0,0]]) &
      (for x,wanted being Integer, i being Nat,
           xs,whole being FinSequence of INT st
        whole = <*x*> ^ xs
      holds
        (inner/.[xs,[wanted,x],i + 1] <> 0 &
          outer/.[whole,wanted,i] =
            [TRUE,[i,inner/.[xs,[wanted,x],i + 1] -' 1]]) or
        (inner/.[xs,[wanted,x],i + 1] = 0 &
          outer/.[whole,wanted,i] =
            outer/.[xs,wanted,i + 1])) &
      result = outer/.[nums,target,0])
  holds
    (result = [FALSE,[0,0]] &
      (for i,j being Nat st
        i < j & j < len nums
      holds nums/.(i + 1) + nums/.(j + 1) <> target)) or
    (ex i,j being Nat st
      result = [TRUE,[i,j]] &
      i < j &
      j < len nums &
      nums/.(i + 1) + nums/.(j + 1) = target &
      (for i0,j0 being Nat st
        i0 < i & i0 < j0 & j0 < len nums
      holds nums/.(i0 + 1) + nums/.(j0 + 1) <> target) &
      (for j0 being Nat st
        i < j0 & j0 < j
      holds nums/.(i + 1) + nums/.(j0 + 1) <> target))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_advanced_79
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
% verina_advanced_79, catalog title "twoSum": deterministically finding the
% lexicographically first pair of indices whose integer entries sum to a
% target, with the exact executable search and correctness contract. This
% file contains no proof.

verina_advanced_79: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_pair: TYPE =
    [# first_index: nat,
       second_index: nat #]

  nat_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoNat: NoNat?
    SomeNat(option_value: nat): SomeNat?
  END nat_option

  nat_pair_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoPair: NoPair?
    SomePair(pair_value: nat_pair): SomePair?
  END nat_pair_option

  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(head, int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_later_sums_differ(
      first: int,
      later: list[int],
      target: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(second, rest):
        first + second /= target
          AND all_later_sums_differ(first, rest, target)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later BY <<

  pairwise_sums_differ(
      values: list[int],
      target: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(first, later):
        all_later_sums_differ(first, later, target)
          AND pairwise_sums_differ(later, target)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % For each of the first `count` positions, this checks its sum with every
  % strictly later entry. It is the source take/zipIdx/drop/all condition.
  no_pair_before_index(
      values: list[int],
      target: int,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          TRUE,
        cons(first, later):
          all_later_sums_differ(first, later, target)
            AND no_pair_before_index(later, target, count - 1)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE values BY <<

  twoSum_precond(
      nums: list[int],
      target: int): bool =
    TRUE

  inner_search(
      remaining: list[int],
      target, first_value: int,
      next_index: nat): RECURSIVE nat_option =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        NoNat,
      cons(candidate, rest):
        IF first_value + candidate = target THEN
          SomeNat(next_index)
        ELSE
          inner_search(
            rest,
            target,
            first_value,
            next_index + 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  outer_search(
      remaining: list[int],
      target: int,
      first_index_value: nat): RECURSIVE nat_pair_option =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        NoPair,
      cons(first_value, rest):
        CASES inner_search(
            rest,
            target,
            first_value,
            first_index_value + 1) OF
          NoNat:
            outer_search(
              rest,
              target,
              first_index_value + 1),
          SomeNat(found_index):
            SomePair(
              (# first_index := first_index_value,
                 second_index := found_index #))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % This is exactly the proof-erased nested first-match recursive search.
  twoSum(
      nums: list[int],
      target: int): nat_pair_option =
    outer_search(nums, target, 0)

  twoSum_postcond(
      nums: list[int],
      target: int,
      result: nat_pair_option): bool =
    CASES result OF
      NoPair:
        pairwise_sums_differ(nums, target),
      SomePair(found_pair):
        LET i: nat = first_index(found_pair),
            j: nat = second_index(found_pair)
        IN
          i < j
            AND j < int_list_length(nums)
            AND int_list_get_bang(i, nums)
                  + int_list_get_bang(j, nums)
                = target
            AND no_pair_before_index(nums, target, i)
            AND all_later_sums_differ(
                  int_list_get_bang(i, nums),
                  int_list_take(
                    j - i - 1,
                    int_list_drop(i + 1, nums)),
                  target)
    ENDCASES

  twoSum_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (nums: list[int], target: int):
      twoSum_precond(nums, target)
        IMPLIES
          twoSum_postcond(
            nums,
            target,
            twoSum(nums, target))

END verina_advanced_79

@[reducible]
def canCompleteCircuit_precond (gas : List Int) (cost : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  gas.length > 0 ∧ gas.length = cost.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond


-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def canCompleteCircuit (gas : List Int) (cost : List Int) (h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond (gas) (cost)) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let totalGas := gas.foldl (· + ·) 0
  let totalCost := cost.foldl (· + ·) 0

  if totalGas < totalCost then
    -1
  else
    let rec loop (g c : List Int) (idx : Nat) (tank : Int) (start : Nat) : Int :=
      match g, c with
      | [], [] => start
      | gi :: gs, ci :: cs =>
        let tank' := tank + gi - ci
        if tank' < 0 then
          loop gs cs (idx + 1) 0 (idx + 1)
        else
          loop gs cs (idx + 1) tank' start
      | _, _ => -1  -- lengths don’t match

    let zipped := List.zip gas cost
    let rec walk (pairs : List (Int × Int)) (i : Nat) (tank : Int) (start : Nat) : Int :=
      match pairs with
      | [] => start
      | (g, c) :: rest =>
        let newTank := tank + g - c
        if newTank < 0 then
          walk rest (i + 1) 0 (i + 1)
        else
          walk rest (i + 1) newTank start

    walk zipped 0 0 0
  -- !benchmark @end code


-- !benchmark @start postcond_aux

-- !benchmark @end postcond_aux


@[reducible]
def canCompleteCircuit_postcond (gas : List Int) (cost : List Int) (result: Int) (h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond (gas) (cost)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let valid (start : Nat) := List.range gas.length |>.all (fun i =>
    let acc := List.range (i + 1) |>.foldl (fun t j =>
      let jdx := (start + j) % gas.length
      t + gas[jdx]! - cost[jdx]!) 0
    acc ≥ 0)
  -- The result is either -1 or a valid starting index
  (result ≥ -1) ∧
  -- For result = -1: It's impossible to complete the circuit starting from any index
  -- In other words, there's no starting point from which we can always maintain a non-negative gas tank
  (result = -1 → (List.range gas.length).all (fun start => ¬ valid start)) ∧
  -- For result ≥ 0: This is the valid starting point
  -- When starting from this index, the gas tank never becomes negative during the entire circuit
  (result ≥ 0 → result < gas.length ∧ valid result.toNat ∧ (List.range result.toNat).all (fun start => ¬ valid start))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start proof_aux

-- !benchmark @end proof_aux


theorem canCompleteCircuit_spec_satisfied (gas: List Int) (cost: List Int) (h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond (gas) (cost)) :
    canCompleteCircuit_postcond (gas) (cost) (canCompleteCircuit (gas) (cost) h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof

  -- !benchmark @end proof

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_8,
   catalog title "canCompleteCircuit": an executable greedy scan selecting the
   least viable starting index for a circular gas-station journey, or -1 when
   total gas is insufficient, together with its exact correctness contract.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition canCompleteCircuit_precond
    (gas cost : list Z) : Prop :=
  (0 < length gas)%nat /\
  length gas = length cost.

Fixpoint canCompleteCircuit_loop
    (g c : list Z)
    (idx : nat)
    (tank : Z)
    (start : nat) : Z :=
  match g, c with
  | [], [] => Z.of_nat start
  | gi :: gs, ci :: cs =>
      let tank' := (tank + gi - ci)%Z in
      if Z.ltb tank' 0%Z
      then canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (S idx) 0%Z (S idx)
      else canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (S idx) tank' start
  | _, _ => (-1)%Z
  end.

Fixpoint canCompleteCircuit_walk
    (pairs : list (Z * Z))
    (i : nat)
    (tank : Z)
    (start : nat) : Z :=
  match pairs with
  | [] => Z.of_nat start
  | (g, c) :: rest =>
      let newTank := (tank + g - c)%Z in
      if Z.ltb newTank 0%Z
      then canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (S i) 0%Z (S i)
      else canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (S i) newTank start
  end.

Definition canCompleteCircuit
    (gas cost : list Z)
    (_h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost) : Z :=
  let totalGas := fold_left Z.add gas 0%Z in
  let totalCost := fold_left Z.add cost 0%Z in
  if Z.ltb totalGas totalCost
  then (-1)%Z
  else canCompleteCircuit_walk (combine gas cost) 0%nat 0%Z 0%nat.

Definition canCompleteCircuit_prefixTank
    (gas cost : list Z)
    (start i : nat) : Z :=
  fold_left
    (fun tank j =>
      let jdx := Nat.modulo (start + j) (length gas) in
      (tank + nth jdx gas 0%Z - nth jdx cost 0%Z)%Z)
    (seq 0%nat (S i))
    0%Z.

Definition canCompleteCircuit_valid
    (gas cost : list Z)
    (start : nat) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun i =>
      Z.leb 0%Z (canCompleteCircuit_prefixTank gas cost start i))
    (seq 0%nat (length gas)).

Definition canCompleteCircuit_postcond
    (gas cost : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost) : Prop :=
  (-1 <= result)%Z /\
  (result = (-1)%Z ->
    forallb
      (fun start =>
        negb (canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start))
      (seq 0%nat (length gas)) = true) /\
  ((0 <= result)%Z ->
    (result < Z.of_nat (length gas))%Z /\
    canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost (Z.to_nat result) = true /\
    forallb
      (fun start =>
        negb (canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start))
      (seq 0%nat (Z.to_nat result)) = true).

Theorem canCompleteCircuit_spec_satisfied
    (gas cost : list Z)
    (h_precond : canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost) :
  canCompleteCircuit_postcond
    gas cost (canCompleteCircuit gas cost h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_8,
  catalog title "canCompleteCircuit": an executable greedy program returns the
  least gas-station index from which every prefix of a circular trip maintains
  nonnegative fuel, or -1 when no such index exists. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory verina_advanced_8
  imports Main
begin

definition canCompleteCircuit_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost \<longleftrightarrow>
    length gas > 0 \<and> length gas = length cost"

fun canCompleteCircuit_loop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_loop [] [] idx tank start = int start"
| "canCompleteCircuit_loop [] (ci # cs) idx tank start = -1"
| "canCompleteCircuit_loop (gi # gs) [] idx tank start = -1"
| "canCompleteCircuit_loop (gi # gs) (ci # cs) idx tank start =
    (let tank' = tank + gi - ci
     in if tank' < 0
        then canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (idx + 1) 0 (idx + 1)
        else canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (idx + 1) tank' start)"

fun canCompleteCircuit_walk ::
    "(int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_walk [] i tank start = int start"
| "canCompleteCircuit_walk ((g, c) # rest) i tank start =
    (let newTank = tank + g - c
     in if newTank < 0
        then canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (i + 1) 0 (i + 1)
        else canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (i + 1) newTank start)"

definition canCompleteCircuit :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "canCompleteCircuit gas cost =
    (let totalGas = foldl (+) 0 gas;
         totalCost = foldl (+) 0 cost
     in if totalGas < totalCost
        then -1
        else canCompleteCircuit_walk (zip gas cost) 0 0 0)"

fun canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault ::
    "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault d [] n = d"
| "canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault d (x # xs) 0 = x"
| "canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault d (x # xs) (Suc n) =
    canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault d xs n"

definition canCompleteCircuit_valid ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start \<longleftrightarrow>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i.
        0 \<le>
          foldl
            (\<lambda>t j.
              let jdx = (start + j) mod length gas
              in t +
                 canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault 0 gas jdx -
                 canCompleteCircuit_nthDefault 0 cost jdx)
            0 [0..<i + 1])
      [0..<length gas]"

definition canCompleteCircuit_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "canCompleteCircuit_postcond gas cost result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result \<ge> -1 \<and>
    (result = -1 \<longrightarrow>
      list_all
        (\<lambda>start. \<not> canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
        [0..<length gas]) \<and>
    (result \<ge> 0 \<longrightarrow>
      result < int (length gas) \<and>
      canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost (nat result) \<and>
      list_all
        (\<lambda>start. \<not> canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
        [0..<nat result])"

theorem canCompleteCircuit_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost"
  shows
    "canCompleteCircuit_postcond gas cost
      (canCompleteCircuit gas cost)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_8,
  catalog title "canCompleteCircuit": an executable greedy scan returns the
  least gas-station index from which every circular prefix has nonnegative
  fuel, or -1 when no start works, with its precondition and full correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let canCompleteCircuit_precond = new_definition
  `canCompleteCircuit_precond
      (gas:int list) (cost:int list) <=>
     LENGTH gas > 0 /\
     LENGTH gas = LENGTH cost`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_sumFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        canCompleteCircuit_sumFold ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        canCompleteCircuit_sumFold (CONS x xs) acc =
        canCompleteCircuit_sumFold xs (acc + x))`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_zip =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!cost:int list.
        canCompleteCircuit_zip ([]:int list) cost =
        ([]:(int#int)list)) /\
     (!g:int. !gs:int list. !cost:int list.
        canCompleteCircuit_zip (CONS g gs) cost =
        if cost = [] then []
        else
          CONS (g,HD cost)
            (canCompleteCircuit_zip gs (TL cost)))`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_walk =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !tank:int. !start:num.
        canCompleteCircuit_walk
          ([]:(int#int)list) i tank start =
        (&start:int)) /\
     (!station:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list.
      !i:num. !tank:int. !start:num.
        canCompleteCircuit_walk
          (CONS station rest) i tank start =
        let newTank =
          tank + FST station - SND station in
        if newTank < &0 then
          canCompleteCircuit_walk
            rest (i + 1) (&0:int) (i + 1)
        else
          canCompleteCircuit_walk
            rest (i + 1) newTank start)`;;

let canCompleteCircuit = new_definition
  `canCompleteCircuit
      (gas:int list) (cost:int list) =
     let totalGas =
       canCompleteCircuit_sumFold gas (&0:int) in
     let totalCost =
       canCompleteCircuit_sumFold cost (&0:int) in
     if totalGas < totalCost then (-- &1:int)
     else
       canCompleteCircuit_walk
         (canCompleteCircuit_zip gas cost)
         0 (&0:int) 0`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_range =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(canCompleteCircuit_range 0 = []) /\
     (!n:num.
        canCompleteCircuit_range (SUC n) =
        APPEND
          (canCompleteCircuit_range n)
          (CONS n []))`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_balanceFold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!gas:int list. !cost:int list. !start:num. !acc:int.
        canCompleteCircuit_balanceFold
          gas cost start acc ([]:num list) =
        acc) /\
     (!j:num. !js:num list.
      !gas:int list. !cost:int list. !start:num. !acc:int.
        canCompleteCircuit_balanceFold
          gas cost start acc (CONS j js) =
        let jdx =
          (start + j) MOD LENGTH gas in
        canCompleteCircuit_balanceFold
          gas cost start
          (acc + EL jdx gas - EL jdx cost)
          js)`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_valid = new_definition
  `canCompleteCircuit_valid
      (gas:int list) (cost:int list) (start:num) <=>
     ALL
       (\i:num.
          canCompleteCircuit_balanceFold
            gas cost start (&0:int)
            (canCompleteCircuit_range (i + 1))
          >= &0)
       (canCompleteCircuit_range (LENGTH gas))`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_intToNat = new_definition
  `canCompleteCircuit_intToNat (z:int) =
     if z < &0 then 0 else num_of_int z`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_postcond = new_definition
  `canCompleteCircuit_postcond
      (gas:int list) (cost:int list) (result:int) <=>
     result >= -- &1 /\
     (result = -- &1
      ==> ALL
            (\start:num.
               ~canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
            (canCompleteCircuit_range (LENGTH gas))) /\
     (result >= &0
      ==> result < &(LENGTH gas) /\
          canCompleteCircuit_valid
            gas cost
            (canCompleteCircuit_intToNat result) /\
          ALL
            (\start:num.
               ~canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
            (canCompleteCircuit_range
              (canCompleteCircuit_intToNat result)))`;;

let canCompleteCircuit_spec_satisfied =
  `!gas:int list. !cost:int list.
     canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost
     ==> canCompleteCircuit_postcond
           gas cost (canCompleteCircuit gas cost)`;;

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_8,
;; catalog title canCompleteCircuit: the executable gas-station circuit
;; algorithm, its nonempty equal-length input precondition, and its
;; minimal-valid-start correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun va8-integer-listp (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and (integerp (car xs))
           (va8-integer-listp (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun va8-can-complete-circuit-precond (gas cost)
  (and (va8-integer-listp gas)
       (va8-integer-listp cost)
       (< 0 (len gas))
       (equal (len gas) (len cost))))

(defun va8-sum-list (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (+ (car xs) (va8-sum-list (cdr xs)))
    0))

;; ACL2 cons pairs encode Lean products, so CAR and CDR are respectively the
;; gas and cost components of each element of the zipped list.
(defun va8-zip (gas cost)
  (if (and (consp gas) (consp cost))
      (cons (cons (car gas) (car cost))
            (va8-zip (cdr gas) (cdr cost)))
    nil))

;; This preserves the source's local LOOP helper, including its mismatched-list
;; branch, even though the executable body ultimately calls WALK instead.
(defun va8-loop (g c idx tank start)
  (declare (xargs :measure
                  (+ (acl2-count g) (acl2-count c))))
  (cond ((and (endp g) (endp c))
         start)
        ((and (consp g) (consp c))
         (let ((tank-prime (- (+ tank (car g)) (car c))))
           (if (< tank-prime 0)
               (va8-loop (cdr g) (cdr c)
                         (+ idx 1) 0 (+ idx 1))
             (va8-loop (cdr g) (cdr c)
                       (+ idx 1) tank-prime start))))
        (t -1)))

(defun va8-walk (pairs index tank start)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count pairs)))
  (if (consp pairs)
      (let* ((pair (car pairs))
             (new-tank (- (+ tank (car pair)) (cdr pair))))
        (if (< new-tank 0)
            (va8-walk (cdr pairs) (+ index 1) 0 (+ index 1))
          (va8-walk (cdr pairs) (+ index 1) new-tank start)))
    start))

(defun va8-can-complete-circuit (gas cost)
  (let ((total-gas (va8-sum-list gas))
        (total-cost (va8-sum-list cost)))
    (if (< total-gas total-cost)
        -1
      (va8-walk (va8-zip gas cost) 0 0 0))))

(defun va8-nth-int-default-zero (xs index)
  (cond ((or (not (natp index)) (endp xs))
         0)
        ((zp index)
         (car xs))
        (t
         (va8-nth-int-default-zero (cdr xs) (- index 1)))))

;; This is the fold over List.range (i + 1) in the source VALID predicate.
(defun va8-prefix-balance-aux
    (gas cost start circuit-length offset remaining balance)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      balance
    (let* ((station (mod (+ start offset) circuit-length))
           (next-balance
            (- (+ balance (va8-nth-int-default-zero gas station))
               (va8-nth-int-default-zero cost station))))
      (va8-prefix-balance-aux
       gas cost start circuit-length (+ offset 1) (- remaining 1)
       next-balance))))

(defun va8-prefix-balance (gas cost start circuit-length steps)
  (va8-prefix-balance-aux
   gas cost start circuit-length 0 steps 0))

;; Iterate over List.range circuit-length.  At index I, recompute the source
;; fold over the first I+1 legs and require its accumulated tank to be
;; nonnegative.
(defun va8-valid-prefixes-p
    (gas cost start circuit-length index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and (<= 0
             (va8-prefix-balance
              gas cost start circuit-length (+ index 1)))
         (va8-valid-prefixes-p
          gas cost start circuit-length (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun va8-valid-start-p (gas cost start circuit-length)
  (va8-valid-prefixes-p
   gas cost start circuit-length 0 circuit-length))

;; Every natural start in [START, START+REMAINING) fails VALID.
(defun va8-all-starts-invalid-p
    (gas cost circuit-length start remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and (not (va8-valid-start-p gas cost start circuit-length))
         (va8-all-starts-invalid-p
          gas cost circuit-length (+ start 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun va8-int-to-nat (value)
  (if (and (integerp value) (<= 0 value))
      value
    0))

(defun va8-can-complete-circuit-postcond (gas cost result)
  (let ((circuit-length (len gas)))
    (and
     (integerp result)
     (<= -1 result)
     (implies
      (equal result -1)
      (va8-all-starts-invalid-p
       gas cost circuit-length 0 circuit-length))
     (implies
      (<= 0 result)
      (and
       (< result circuit-length)
       (va8-valid-start-p
        gas cost (va8-int-to-nat result) circuit-length)
       (va8-all-starts-invalid-p
        gas cost circuit-length 0 (va8-int-to-nat result)))))))

;; The source postcondition's proof argument is unused, so proof erasure leaves
;; this universally quantified implication with the implementation result
;; explicitly connected to the same postcondition.
(defun-sk verina-advanced-8-can-complete-circuit-spec-satisfied-statement ()
  (forall (gas cost)
    (implies
     (va8-can-complete-circuit-precond gas cost)
     (va8-can-complete-circuit-postcond
      gas cost (va8-can-complete-circuit gas cost)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_advanced_8,
-- catalog title "canCompleteCircuit": a deterministic gas-station program
-- returns the least feasible circuit start, or -1 when none exists, and is
-- connected to its full prefix-balance correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaAdvanced8 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual x y = boolNot (intLess y x)

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual x y = intLessOrEqual y x

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

minusOne : Int
minusOne = negsuc zero

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

record IntPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : Int
    pairSecond : Int

zipList : List Int → List Int → List IntPair
zipList [] ys = []
zipList xs [] = []
zipList (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  pair x y ∷ zipList xs ys

canCompleteCircuit-precond : List Int → List Int → Set
canCompleteCircuit-precond gas cost =
  (zero < listLength gas) ∧
  (listLength gas ≡ listLength cost)

sumList : List Int → Int
sumList values = foldLeft intAdd zeroInt values

unusedLoop :
  List Int →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Int
unusedLoop [] [] index tank start = pos start
unusedLoop [] (_ ∷ _) index tank start = minusOne
unusedLoop (_ ∷ _) [] index tank start = minusOne
unusedLoop (g ∷ gs) (c ∷ cs) index tank start =
  let new-tank = intSubtract (intAdd tank g) c
  in
    if intLess new-tank zeroInt
    then unusedLoop gs cs (suc index) zeroInt (suc index)
    else unusedLoop gs cs (suc index) new-tank start

walk :
  List IntPair →
  Nat →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Int
walk [] index tank start = pos start
walk (pair g c ∷ rest) index tank start =
  let new-tank = intSubtract (intAdd tank g) c
  in
    if intLess new-tank zeroInt
    then walk rest (suc index) zeroInt (suc index)
    else walk rest (suc index) new-tank start

canCompleteCircuit :
  (gas cost : List Int) →
  canCompleteCircuit-precond gas cost →
  Int
canCompleteCircuit gas cost h-precond =
  let total-gas = sumList gas
      total-cost = sumList cost
  in
    if intLess total-gas total-cost
    then minusOne
    else walk (zipList gas cost) zero zeroInt zero

prefixBalance :
  List Int →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Int
prefixBalance gas cost start prefix-end =
  foldLeft
    (λ tank offset →
      let station =
            naturalMod
              (start + offset)
              (listLength gas)
      in
        intSubtract
          (intAdd
            tank
            (indexDefault zeroInt gas station))
          (indexDefault zeroInt cost station))
    zeroInt
    (range (suc prefix-end))

validStart :
  List Int →
  List Int →
  Nat →
  Bool
validStart gas cost start =
  allList
    (λ prefix-end →
      intGreaterOrEqual
        (prefixBalance gas cost start prefix-end)
        zeroInt)
    (range (listLength gas))

intToNat : Int → Nat
intToNat (pos n) = n
intToNat (negsuc n) = zero

noValidStart :
  List Int →
  List Int →
  List Nat →
  Bool
noValidStart gas cost starts =
  allList
    (λ start → boolNot (validStart gas cost start))
    starts

canCompleteCircuit-postcond :
  (gas cost : List Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  canCompleteCircuit-precond gas cost →
  Set
canCompleteCircuit-postcond gas cost result h-precond =
  IsTrue (intGreaterOrEqual result minusOne) ∧
  ((result ≡ minusOne →
      IsTrue
        (noValidStart gas cost (range (listLength gas)))) ∧
   (IsTrue (intGreaterOrEqual result zeroInt) →
      IsTrue (intLess result (pos (listLength gas))) ∧
      IsTrue (validStart gas cost (intToNat result)) ∧
      IsTrue
        (noValidStart gas cost (range (intToNat result)))))

canCompleteCircuit-spec-satisfied : Set
canCompleteCircuit-spec-satisfied =
  (gas cost : List Int) →
  (h-precond : canCompleteCircuit-precond gas cost) →
  canCompleteCircuit-postcond
    gas
    cost
    (canCompleteCircuit gas cost h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA artifact verina_advanced_8,
  cataloged as "canCompleteCircuit": the executable greedy scan selects the
  least gas-station index from which every circular prefix has nonnegative
  fuel, or returns -1 when no such index exists. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pairTheory;

val canCompleteCircuit_precond_def = new_definition (
  "canCompleteCircuit_precond_def",
  ``canCompleteCircuit_precond
      (gas : int list) (cost : int list) <=>
      0 < LENGTH gas /\ LENGTH gas = LENGTH cost``
);

val canCompleteCircuit_loop_def = Define `
  (canCompleteCircuit_loop
      ([] : int list)
      ([] : int list)
      (idx : num)
      (tank : int)
      (start : num) =
     int_of_num start) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_loop
      (gi::gs)
      (ci::cs)
      idx
      tank
      start =
     let tank' = tank + gi - ci in
     if tank' < 0 then
       canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (idx + 1) 0 (idx + 1)
     else
       canCompleteCircuit_loop gs cs (idx + 1) tank' start) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_loop
      ([] : int list)
      (ci::cs)
      idx
      tank
      start =
     (~1 : int)) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_loop
      (gi::gs)
      ([] : int list)
      idx
      tank
      start =
     (~1 : int))
`;

val canCompleteCircuit_zip_def = Define `
  (canCompleteCircuit_zip
      ([] : int list)
      (ys : int list) =
     ([] : (int # int) list)) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_zip
      (x::xs)
      ([] : int list) =
     ([] : (int # int) list)) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_zip
      (x::xs)
      (y::ys) =
     (x,y)::canCompleteCircuit_zip xs ys)
`;

val canCompleteCircuit_walk_def = Define `
  (canCompleteCircuit_walk
      ([] : (int # int) list)
      (i : num)
      (tank : int)
      (start : num) =
     int_of_num start) /\
  (canCompleteCircuit_walk
      ((g,c)::rest)
      i
      tank
      start =
     let newTank = tank + g - c in
     if newTank < 0 then
       canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (i + 1) 0 (i + 1)
     else
       canCompleteCircuit_walk rest (i + 1) newTank start)
`;

val canCompleteCircuit_def = new_definition (
  "canCompleteCircuit_def",
  ``canCompleteCircuit
      (gas : int list) (cost : int list) =
      let totalGas =
        FOLDL (\acc : int. \g : int. acc + g) 0 gas in
      let totalCost =
        FOLDL (\acc : int. \c : int. acc + c) 0 cost in
      if totalGas < totalCost then
        (~1 : int)
      else
        let zipped = canCompleteCircuit_zip gas cost
        in
          canCompleteCircuit_walk zipped 0 0 0``
);

val canCompleteCircuit_valid_def = new_definition (
  "canCompleteCircuit_valid_def",
  ``canCompleteCircuit_valid
      (gas : int list) (cost : int list) (start : num) <=>
      EVERY
        (\i : num.
           0 <=
             FOLDL
               (\tank : int.
                  \j : num.
                    let jdx = (start + j) MOD LENGTH gas
                    in
                      tank + EL jdx gas - EL jdx cost)
               0
               (COUNT_LIST (i + 1)))
        (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH gas))``
);

val canCompleteCircuit_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "canCompleteCircuit_postcond_def",
  ``canCompleteCircuit_postcond
      (gas : int list) (cost : int list) (result : int) <=>
      (~1 : int) <= result /\
      (result = (~1 : int) ==>
        EVERY
          (\start : num.
             ~canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH gas))) /\
      (0 <= result ==>
        result < int_of_num (LENGTH gas) /\
        canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost (Num result) /\
        EVERY
          (\start : num.
             ~canCompleteCircuit_valid gas cost start)
          (COUNT_LIST (Num result)))``
);

val canCompleteCircuit_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(gas : int list) (cost : int list).
      canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost ==>
      canCompleteCircuit_postcond
        gas cost (canCompleteCircuit gas cost)``;

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_advanced_8 (verina__metamath__verina_advanced_8), catalog title
  canCompleteCircuit: the exact greedy gas-station circuit computation on
  equal nonempty finite integer lists, with its impossibility-or-least-valid-
  start correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains. Word ZZ
  is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer lists, and
  Word ( ZZ X. ZZ ) is the type of arbitrary finite lists of integer pairs.
  For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based
  lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINA8Sum is the source integer foldl addition from zero. VERINA8ZipGraph
  and VERINA8Zip reproduce List.zip, including truncation to the shorter
  input. VERINA8LoopGraph preserves the source's unused local loop helper on
  all typed arguments: it consumes paired heads, resets the tank and advances
  the candidate start after a negative tank, returns the start when both
  lists end together, and returns -1 on a length mismatch.

  VERINA8WalkGraph is the exact execution trace of the local walk helper used
  by the program. Its integer-tank and natural-start traces process the zipped
  pairs from left to right with precisely the source reset rule.
  VERINA8CanCompleteCircuit first compares the two source sums and returns -1
  when total gas is smaller; otherwise it invokes walk on the exact zip with
  initial index, tank, and start all zero. Thus the executable result is fixed
  independently of the postcondition and no extra output is admitted.

  VERINA8GetBang is Lean's zero-default List.get! indexing.
  VERINA8PrefixGraph exactly records the postcondition's foldl over
  List.range (i + 1), using the circular index (start + j) modulo the gas-list
  length. VERINA8Valid requires every such prefix accumulator through one
  complete circuit to be nonnegative. VERINA8Pre preserves the nonempty,
  equal-length input condition. VERINA8Post preserves the lower result bound,
  the universal impossibility condition for -1, and the valid least-index
  condition for every nonnegative result. The proof-valued precondition
  arguments are computationally and propositionally unused inside the source
  program and postcondition, and the final assertion supplies the complete
  precondition as its explicit antecedent.

  The final $a declaration is the complete source correctness proposition.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by this
  rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINA8NatMin VERINA8Sum
  VERINA8ZipGraph VERINA8Zip
  VERINA8LoopGraph VERINA8Loop
  VERINA8WalkGraph VERINA8Walk
  VERINA8CanCompleteCircuit
  VERINA8GetBang VERINA8PrefixGraph VERINA8Prefix VERINA8Valid
  VERINA8Pre VERINA8Post
$.

verina8-nat-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8NatMin A B ) $.
verina8-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8Sum A ) $.
verina8-zip-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8ZipGraph A B C ) $.
verina8-zip-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8Zip A B ) $.
verina8-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8LoopGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verina8-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8Loop A B C D E ) $.
verina8-walk-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8WalkGraph A B C D E ) $.
verina8-walk-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8Walk A B C D ) $.
verina8-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8CanCompleteCircuit A B ) $.
verina8-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8GetBang A B ) $.
verina8-prefix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8PrefixGraph A B C D E ) $.
verina8-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINA8Prefix A B C D ) $.
verina8-valid-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8Valid A B C ) $.
verina8-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8Pre A B ) $.
verina8-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINA8Post A B C ) $.

verina8-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINA8NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

${
  $d k A $.

  verina8-sum-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Sum A
  ) = (
    sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      ( A ` k )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verina8-zip-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8ZipGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        # ` C
      ) = (
        VERINA8NatMin
          ( # ` A )
          ( # ` B )
      )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          C ` k
        ) = <.
          ( A ` k )
          ,
          ( B ` k )
        >.
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verina8-zip-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Zip A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      ( VERINA8ZipGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k m s t A B C D E F $.

  verina8-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8LoopGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word ZZ
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. NN0
          /\
          D e. ZZ
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        E e. NN0
        /\
        F e. ZZ
      )
    )
    /\
    E. m e. NN0 E. t e. Word ZZ E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        m = (
          VERINA8NatMin
            ( # ` A )
            ( # ` B )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` t ) = ( m + 1 )
              /\
              ( # ` s ) = ( m + 1 )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( t ` 0 ) = D
              /\
              ( s ` 0 ) = E
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. ( 0 ..^ m )
              (
                (
                  t ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  (
                    (
                      ( t ` k ) + ( A ` k )
                    ) - ( B ` k )
                  ) < 0 ,
                  0 ,
                  (
                    ( t ` k ) + ( A ` k )
                  ) - ( B ` k )
                )
                /\
                (
                  s ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  (
                    (
                      ( t ` k ) + ( A ` k )
                    ) - ( B ` k )
                  ) < 0 ,
                  ( ( C + k ) + 1 ) ,
                  ( s ` k )
                )
              )
            /\
            F = if (
              ( # ` A ) = ( # ` B ) ,
              ( s ` m ) ,
              ( -u 1 )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verina8-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Loop A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA8LoopGraph A B C D E y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k s t A B C D E $.

  verina8-walk-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8WalkGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. ZZ
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ZZ E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          (
            ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
            /\
            ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( t ` 0 ) = C
            /\
            ( s ` 0 ) = D
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              (
                t ` ( k + 1 )
              ) = if (
                (
                  (
                    ( t ` k )
                    +
                    ( 1st ` ( A ` k ) )
                  )
                  -
                  ( 2nd ` ( A ` k ) )
                ) < 0 ,
                0 ,
                (
                  (
                    ( t ` k )
                    +
                    ( 1st ` ( A ` k ) )
                  )
                  -
                  ( 2nd ` ( A ` k ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                s ` ( k + 1 )
              ) = if (
                (
                  (
                    ( t ` k )
                    +
                    ( 1st ` ( A ` k ) )
                  )
                  -
                  ( 2nd ` ( A ` k ) )
                ) < 0 ,
                ( ( B + k ) + 1 ) ,
                ( s ` k )
              )
            )
          /\
          E = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verina8-walk-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Walk A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA8WalkGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

verina8-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINA8CanCompleteCircuit A B
) = if (
  ( VERINA8Sum A ) < ( VERINA8Sum B ) ,
  ( -u 1 ) ,
  (
    VERINA8Walk
      ( VERINA8Zip A B )
      0
      0
      0
  )
) $.

verina8-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINA8GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d j t A B C D E $.

  verina8-prefix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8PrefixGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word ZZ
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. NN0
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ZZ
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( D + 1 ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = 0
        )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( D + 1 ) )
            (
              t ` ( j + 1 )
            ) = (
              (
                ( t ` j )
                +
                (
                  VERINA8GetBang
                    A
                    (
                      ( C + j )
                      mod
                      ( # ` A )
                    )
                )
              )
              -
              (
                VERINA8GetBang
                  B
                  (
                    ( C + j )
                    mod
                    ( # ` A )
                  )
              )
            )
          /\
          E = ( t ` ( D + 1 ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verina8-prefix-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Prefix A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINA8PrefixGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verina8-valid-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Valid A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      0 <_ (
        VERINA8Prefix A B C i
      )
  ) $.
$}

verina8-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINA8Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    0 < ( # ` A )
    /\
    ( # ` A ) = ( # ` B )
  )
) $.

${
  $d s A B C $.

  verina8-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINA8Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( -u 1 ) <_ C
      /\
      (
        (
          C = ( -u 1 )
          ->
          A. s e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            -. ( VERINA8Valid A B s )
        )
        /\
        (
          0 <_ C
          ->
          (
            C < ( # ` A )
            /\
            (
              ( VERINA8Valid A B C )
              /\
              A. s e. ( 0 ..^ C )
                -. ( VERINA8Valid A B s )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-advanced-8-can-complete-circuit $a |- A. g e. Word ZZ
  A. c e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINA8Pre g c )
      ->
      (
        VERINA8Post
          g
          c
          ( VERINA8CanCompleteCircuit g c )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_advanced_8
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_advanced_8, catalog title "canCompleteCircuit": the nonempty
:: equal-length integer-list precondition, exact gas and cost folds, zipped
:: greedy circuit-start implementation, minimal-valid-index postcondition,
:: and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,

begin

theorem
  for gas,cost being FinSequence of INT,
      result being Integer st
    0 < len gas &
    len gas = len cost &
    (ex gasTotals,costTotals being FinSequence of INT st
      len gasTotals = len gas + 1 &
      gasTotals/.1 = 0 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom gas holds
        gasTotals/.(k + 1) = gasTotals/.k + gas/.k) &
      len costTotals = len cost + 1 &
      costTotals/.1 = 0 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom cost holds

      ((gasTotals/.(len gas + 1) < costTotals/.(len cost + 1) &
        result = -1) or
       (not gasTotals/.(len gas + 1) < costTotals/.(len cost + 1) &
        ex zipped being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:],
           indices being FinSequence of NAT,
           tanks,starts being FinSequence of INT st
          len zipped = len gas &
          (for k being Nat st k in dom gas holds
            zipped/.k = [gas/.k,cost/.k]) &
          len indices = len zipped + 1 &
          indices/.1 = 0 &
          len tanks = len zipped + 1 &
          tanks/.1 = 0 &
          len starts = len zipped + 1 &
          starts/.1 = 0 &
          (for k being Nat st k in dom zipped holds
            indices/.(k + 1) = indices/.k + 1 &
            ex newTank being Integer st
              newTank = tanks/.k + gas/.k - cost/.k &
              ((newTank < 0 &
                tanks/.(k + 1) = 0 &
                starts/.(k + 1) = indices/.k + 1) or
               (not newTank < 0 &
                tanks/.(k + 1) = newTank &
                starts/.(k + 1) = starts/.k))) &
          result = starts/.(len zipped + 1))))
  holds
    result >= -1 &
    (result = -1 implies
      for start being Nat st start < len gas holds
        not ex balances being FinSequence of INT st
          len balances = len gas + 1 &
          balances/.1 = 0 &
          (for j being Nat st j < len gas holds
            balances/.(j + 2) =
              balances/.(j + 1) +
                gas/.(((start + j) mod len gas) + 1) -
                cost/.(((start + j) mod len gas) + 1)) &
          for p being Nat st 1 <= p & p <= len gas holds
            balances/.(p + 1) >= 0) &
    (result >= 0 implies
      ex start being Nat st
        result = start &
        start < len gas &
        (ex balances being FinSequence of INT st
          len balances = len gas + 1 &
          balances/.1 = 0 &
          (for j being Nat st j < len gas holds
            balances/.(j + 2) =
              balances/.(j + 1) +
                gas/.(((start + j) mod len gas) + 1) -
                cost/.(((start + j) mod len gas) + 1)) &
          for p being Nat st 1 <= p & p <= len gas holds
            balances/.(p + 1) >= 0) &
        for earlier being Nat st earlier < start holds
          not ex balances being FinSequence of INT st
            len balances = len gas + 1 &
            balances/.1 = 0 &
            (for j being Nat st j < len gas holds
              balances/.(j + 2) =
                balances/.(j + 1) +
                  gas/.(((earlier + j) mod len gas) + 1) -
                  cost/.(((earlier + j) mod len gas) + 1)) &
            for p being Nat st 1 <= p & p <= len gas holds
              balances/.(p + 1) >= 0)
proof
end;
