title: verina_basic_104
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
   catalog title "update_map": an executable right-biased merge of two
   list-backed integer maps followed by stable sorting by key, together with
   its uniqueness precondition, lookup-based postcondition, and final
   correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List Sorting.Sorted ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Record Map (K V : Type) : Type := {
  entries : list (K * V)
}.

Arguments entries {K V} _.

Definition empty {K V : Type} : Map K V :=
  {| entries := [] |}.

Definition pair_beq {K V : Type}
    (key_eqb : K -> K -> bool)
    (value_eqb : V -> V -> bool)
    (p1 p2 : K * V) : bool :=
  andb
    (key_eqb (fst p1) (fst p2))
    (value_eqb (snd p1) (snd p2)).

Fixpoint list_beq {A : Type}
    (element_eqb : A -> A -> bool)
    (xs ys : list A) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      andb (element_eqb x y) (list_beq element_eqb xs' ys')
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition map_beq {K V : Type}
    (key_eqb : K -> K -> bool)
    (value_eqb : V -> V -> bool)
    (m1 m2 : Map K V) : bool :=
  andb
    (Nat.eqb (length (entries m1)) (length (entries m2)))
    (list_beq (pair_beq key_eqb value_eqb)
      (entries m1) (entries m2)).

Definition insert {K V : Type}
    (key_eqb : K -> K -> bool)
    (m : Map K V)
    (k : K)
    (v : V) : Map K V :=
  {| entries :=
       filter
         (fun p => negb (key_eqb (fst p) k))
         (entries m) ++ [(k, v)] |}.

Fixpoint find_value {K V : Type}
    (key_eqb : K -> K -> bool)
    (xs : list (K * V))
    (k : K) : option V :=
  match xs with
  | [] => None
  | p :: rest =>
      if key_eqb (fst p) k
      then Some (snd p)
      else find_value key_eqb rest k
  end.

Definition update_map_find
    (m : Map Z Z)
    (k : Z) : option Z :=
  find_value Z.eqb (entries m) k.

Definition update_map_precond
    (m1 m2 : Map Z Z) : Prop :=
  NoDup (map fst (entries m1)) /\
  NoDup (map fst (entries m2)).

Definition update_map_fold_entry
    (acc : Map Z Z)
    (entry : Z * Z) : Map Z Z :=
  insert Z.eqb acc (fst entry) (snd entry).

Fixpoint update_map_merge_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (left right : list (Z * Z)) : list (Z * Z) :=
  match fuel with
  | O => left ++ right
  | S fuel' =>
      match left, right with
      | [], _ => right
      | _, [] => left
      | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
          if Z.leb (fst x) (fst y)
          then x :: update_map_merge_fuel fuel' xs (y :: ys)
          else y :: update_map_merge_fuel fuel' (x :: xs) ys
      end
  end.

Definition update_map_merge
    (left right : list (Z * Z)) : list (Z * Z) :=
  update_map_merge_fuel
    (length left + length right)%nat left right.

Fixpoint update_map_mergeSort_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (xs : list (Z * Z)) : list (Z * Z) :=
  match fuel with
  | O => xs
  | S fuel' =>
      match xs with
      | [] => []
      | [x] => [x]
      | _ :: _ :: _ =>
          let split_point := Nat.div (S (length xs)) 2 in
          update_map_merge
            (update_map_mergeSort_fuel
              fuel' (firstn split_point xs))
            (update_map_mergeSort_fuel
              fuel' (skipn split_point xs))
      end
  end.

Definition update_map_mergeSort
    (xs : list (Z * Z)) : list (Z * Z) :=
  update_map_mergeSort_fuel (length xs) xs.

Definition update_map
    (m1 m2 : Map Z Z)
    (_h_precond : update_map_precond m1 m2) : Map Z Z :=
  let updated :=
    fold_left update_map_fold_entry (entries m2) m1 in
  {| entries := update_map_mergeSort (entries updated) |}.

Definition option_Z_eqb
    (x y : option Z) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | Some a, Some b => Z.eqb a b
  | None, None => true
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition update_map_postcond
    (m1 m2 result : Map Z Z)
    (_h_precond : update_map_precond m1 m2) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted
    (fun a b => (fst a <= fst b)%Z)
    (entries result) /\
  forallb
    (fun x =>
      option_Z_eqb
        (update_map_find result (fst x))
        (Some (snd x)))
    (entries m2) = true /\
  forallb
    (fun x =>
      match update_map_find m2 (fst x) with
      | Some _ => true
      | None =>
          option_Z_eqb
            (update_map_find result (fst x))
            (Some (snd x))
      end)
    (entries m1) = true /\
  forallb
    (fun x =>
      match update_map_find m1 (fst x) with
      | Some v =>
          match update_map_find m2 (fst x) with
          | Some v' => Z.eqb (snd x) v'
          | None => Z.eqb (snd x) v
          end
      | None =>
          option_Z_eqb
            (update_map_find m2 (fst x))
            (Some (snd x))
      end)
    (entries result) = true.

Theorem update_map_spec_satisfied
    (m1 m2 : Map Z Z)
    (h_precond : update_map_precond m1 m2) :
  update_map_postcond
    m1 m2 (update_map m1 m2 h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_104
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
  catalog title "update_map": an executable association-list map update folds
  the second integer map into the first with overwrite semantics, sorts the
  result by key, and states the complete map-correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_104
  imports Main
begin

datatype ('k, 'v) verina_map = Map "('k \<times> 'v) list"

fun map_entries :: "('k, 'v) verina_map \<Rightarrow> ('k \<times> 'v) list" where
  "map_entries (Map entries) = entries"

definition update_map_map_beq ::
    "('k, 'v) verina_map \<Rightarrow> ('k, 'v) verina_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "update_map_map_beq m1 m2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    length (map_entries m1) = length (map_entries m2) \<and>
    map_entries m1 = map_entries m2"

definition update_map_empty :: "('k, 'v) verina_map" where
  "update_map_empty = Map []"

definition update_map_insert ::
    "('k, 'v) verina_map \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow>
      ('k, 'v) verina_map" where
  "update_map_insert m k v =
    Map (filter (\<lambda>p. fst p \<noteq> k) (map_entries m) @ [(k, v)])"

fun update_map_find_entries ::
    "('k \<times> 'v) list \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'v option" where
  "update_map_find_entries [] k = None"
| "update_map_find_entries (p # ps) k =
    (if fst p = k
     then Some (snd p)
     else update_map_find_entries ps k)"

definition update_map_find ::
    "('k, 'v) verina_map \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'v option" where
  "update_map_find m k =
    update_map_find_entries (map_entries m) k"

definition update_map_precond ::
    "(int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> (int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
  "update_map_precond m1 m2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    distinct (map fst (map_entries m1)) \<and>
    distinct (map fst (map_entries m2))"

definition update_map_fold_step ::
    "(int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) \<Rightarrow>
      (int, int) verina_map" where
  "update_map_fold_step acc entry =
    update_map_insert acc (fst entry) (snd entry)"

fun update_map_sort_insert ::
    "(int \<times> int) \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow>
      (int \<times> int) list" where
  "update_map_sort_insert p [] = [p]"
| "update_map_sort_insert p (q # qs) =
    (if fst p \<le> fst q
     then p # q # qs
     else q # update_map_sort_insert p qs)"

fun update_map_sort ::
    "(int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) list" where
  "update_map_sort [] = []"
| "update_map_sort (p # ps) =
    update_map_sort_insert p (update_map_sort ps)"

definition update_map ::
    "(int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> (int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow>
      (int, int) verina_map" where
  "update_map m1 m2 =
    Map
      (update_map_sort
        (map_entries
          (foldl update_map_fold_step m1 (map_entries m2))))"

fun update_map_pairwise_le ::
    "(int \<times> int) list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "update_map_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "update_map_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. fst x \<le> fst y) xs \<and>
     update_map_pairwise_le xs)"

definition update_map_postcond ::
    "(int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> (int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow>
      (int, int) verina_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "update_map_postcond m1 m2 result \<longleftrightarrow>
    update_map_pairwise_le (map_entries result) \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x. update_map_find result (fst x) = Some (snd x))
      (map_entries m2) \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x.
        case update_map_find m2 (fst x) of
          Some v \<Rightarrow> True
        | None \<Rightarrow>
            update_map_find result (fst x) = Some (snd x))
      (map_entries m1) \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x.
        case update_map_find m1 (fst x) of
          Some v \<Rightarrow>
            (case update_map_find m2 (fst x) of
               Some v' \<Rightarrow> snd x = v'
             | None \<Rightarrow> snd x = v)
        | None \<Rightarrow>
            update_map_find m2 (fst x) = Some (snd x))
      (map_entries result)"

theorem update_map_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "update_map_precond m1 m2"
  shows "update_map_postcond m1 m2 (update_map m1 m2)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_104
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
  catalog title "update_map": an executable association-list map update gives
  the second integer map priority, sorts the resulting entries by key, and is
  connected to its complete lookup correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let update_map_key_member =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!key:int.
        update_map_key_member key ([]:(int#int)list) <=> F) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list. !key:int.
        update_map_key_member key (CONS entry rest) <=>
        key = FST entry \/ update_map_key_member key rest)`;;

let update_map_nodup_keys =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(update_map_nodup_keys ([]:(int#int)list) <=> T) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list.
        update_map_nodup_keys (CONS entry rest) <=>
        ~(update_map_key_member (FST entry) rest) /\
        update_map_nodup_keys rest)`;;

let update_map_empty = new_definition
  `update_map_empty:(int#int)list = []`;;

let update_map_insert = new_definition
  `update_map_insert
      (entries:(int#int)list) (key:int) (value:int) =
     APPEND
       (FILTER (\entry:int#int. ~(FST entry = key)) entries)
       (CONS (key,value) [])`;;

let update_map_precond = new_definition
  `update_map_precond
      (m1:(int#int)list) (m2:(int#int)list) <=>
     update_map_nodup_keys m1 /\
     update_map_nodup_keys m2`;;

let update_map_fold_inserts =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:(int#int)list.
        update_map_fold_inserts ([]:(int#int)list) acc = acc) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list.
      !acc:(int#int)list.
        update_map_fold_inserts (CONS entry rest) acc =
        update_map_fold_inserts rest
          (update_map_insert acc (FST entry) (SND entry)))`;;

let update_map_insert_sorted =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!entry:int#int.
        update_map_insert_sorted entry ([]:(int#int)list) =
        CONS entry []) /\
     (!current:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list. !entry:int#int.
        update_map_insert_sorted entry (CONS current rest) =
        if FST entry <= FST current then
          CONS entry (CONS current rest)
        else
          CONS current (update_map_insert_sorted entry rest))`;;

let update_map_sort_entries =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(update_map_sort_entries ([]:(int#int)list) = []) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list.
        update_map_sort_entries (CONS entry rest) =
        update_map_insert_sorted
          entry (update_map_sort_entries rest))`;;

let update_map = new_definition
  `update_map (m1:(int#int)list) (m2:(int#int)list) =
     let updated = update_map_fold_inserts m2 m1 in
     update_map_sort_entries updated`;;

let update_map_find =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!key:int.
        update_map_find ([]:(int#int)list) key =
        (NONE:int option)) /\
     (!entry:int#int. !rest:(int#int)list. !key:int.
        update_map_find (CONS entry rest) key =
        if FST entry = key then SOME (SND entry)
        else update_map_find rest key)`;;

let update_map_option_value =
  new_recursive_definition option_RECURSION
    `(update_map_option_value (NONE:int option) = &0) /\
     (!value:int.
        update_map_option_value (SOME value) = value)`;;

let update_map_m1_entry_condition = new_definition
  `update_map_m1_entry_condition
      (m2:(int#int)list) (result:(int#int)list)
      (entry:int#int) <=>
     if update_map_find m2 (FST entry) = NONE then
       update_map_find result (FST entry) = SOME (SND entry)
     else T`;;

let update_map_result_entry_condition = new_definition
  `update_map_result_entry_condition
      (m1:(int#int)list) (m2:(int#int)list)
      (entry:int#int) <=>
     let from_m1 = update_map_find m1 (FST entry) in
     let from_m2 = update_map_find m2 (FST entry) in
     if from_m1 = NONE then
       from_m2 = SOME (SND entry)
     else if from_m2 = NONE then
       SND entry = update_map_option_value from_m1
     else
       SND entry = update_map_option_value from_m2`;;

let update_map_postcond = new_definition
  `update_map_postcond
      (m1:(int#int)list) (m2:(int#int)list)
      (result:(int#int)list) <=>
     PAIRWISE
       (\first second:int#int. FST first <= FST second)
       result /\
     ALL
       (\entry:int#int.
          update_map_find result (FST entry) =
          SOME (SND entry))
       m2 /\
     ALL
       (update_map_m1_entry_condition m2 result)
       m1 /\
     ALL
       (update_map_result_entry_condition m1 m2)
       result`;;

let update_map_spec_satisfied =
  `!m1:(int#int)list. !m2:(int#int)list.
     update_map_precond m1 m2
     ==> update_map_postcond
           m1 m2 (update_map m1 m2)`;;

title: verina_basic_104
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
;; catalog title "update_map": a deterministic integer-map program lets the
;; second map override the first and sorts the resulting entries by key, with
;; its complete lookup and no-extra-entry contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source Map Int Int structure is represented by its entries field: a
;; proper list of dotted integer pairs (key . value).

(defun verina-basic-104-integer-map-p (entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (let ((entry (car entries)))
        (and
         (consp entry)
         (integerp (car entry))
         (integerp (cdr entry))
         (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p
          (cdr entries))))
    (equal entries nil)))

;; These definitions express List.Nodup after mapping Prod.fst.

(defun verina-basic-104-key-member-p (key entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (or
       (equal key (car (car entries)))
       (verina-basic-104-key-member-p
        key
        (cdr entries)))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-104-unique-keys-p (entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (not
        (verina-basic-104-key-member-p
         (car (car entries))
         (cdr entries)))
       (verina-basic-104-unique-keys-p
        (cdr entries)))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun verina-basic-104-update-map-precond (m1 m2)
  (and
   (verina-basic-104-unique-keys-p m1)
   (verina-basic-104-unique-keys-p m2)))

;; INSERT first filters every entry whose key equals KEY, preserving the order
;; of all other entries, and then appends (KEY . VALUE). This is the source
;; filter followed by singleton append.

(defun verina-basic-104-remove-key (key entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (if (equal key (car (car entries)))
          (verina-basic-104-remove-key
           key
           (cdr entries))
        (cons
         (car entries)
         (verina-basic-104-remove-key
          key
          (cdr entries))))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-104-insert
    (entries key value)
  (append
   (verina-basic-104-remove-key key entries)
   (list (cons key value))))

;; This tail recursion is m2.entries.foldl foldFn m1.

(defun verina-basic-104-fold-inserts
    (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((entry (car remaining)))
        (verina-basic-104-fold-inserts
         (cdr remaining)
         (verina-basic-104-insert
          accumulator
          (car entry)
          (cdr entry))))
    accumulator))

;; Under the source precondition, folding INSERT produces unique keys.
;; Insertion sorting by key is therefore extensionally identical to
;; List.mergeSort (fun a b => a.1 <= b.1): each returns the unique ascending
;; ordering of exactly the same entries.

(defun verina-basic-104-insert-sorted-entry
    (entry sorted)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sorted)))
  (if (consp sorted)
      (if (<= (car entry)
              (car (car sorted)))
          (cons entry sorted)
        (cons
         (car sorted)
         (verina-basic-104-insert-sorted-entry
          entry
          (cdr sorted))))
    (list entry)))

(defun verina-basic-104-sort-entries (entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (verina-basic-104-insert-sorted-entry
       (car entries)
       (verina-basic-104-sort-entries
        (cdr entries)))
    nil))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and is
;; erased. All executable data transformations remain connected exactly as in
;; the source update_map definition.

(defun verina-basic-104-update-map (m1 m2)
  (verina-basic-104-sort-entries
   (verina-basic-104-fold-inserts
    m2
    m1)))

;; Tagged dotted pairs (:some . value) and the atom :none represent Option Int
;; without identifying none with any possible integer value. The scan returns
;; the first matching entry, exactly as List.find? followed by Option.map snd.

(defun verina-basic-104-find-option
    (entries key)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (let ((entry (car entries)))
        (if (equal (car entry) key)
            (cons :some (cdr entry))
          (verina-basic-104-find-option
           (cdr entries)
           key)))
    :none))

(defun verina-basic-104-some-option-p (option)
  (and
   (consp option)
   (equal (car option) :some)
   (integerp (cdr option))))

(defun verina-basic-104-option-value (option)
  (cdr option))

;; List.Pairwise requires each head key to be at most every later key, and
;; recursively imposes the same requirement on the tail.

(defun verina-basic-104-key-at-most-all-p
    (key entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (<= key (car (car entries)))
       (verina-basic-104-key-at-most-all-p
        key
        (cdr entries)))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun verina-basic-104-pairwise-key-order-p
    (entries)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count entries)))
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (verina-basic-104-key-at-most-all-p
        (car (car entries))
        (cdr entries))
       (verina-basic-104-pairwise-key-order-p
        (cdr entries)))
    (equal entries nil)))

;; Every m2 entry must be found in RESULT with its original value.

(defun verina-basic-104-all-m2-entries-present-p
    (remaining result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((entry (car remaining)))
        (and
         (equal
          (verina-basic-104-find-option
           result
           (car entry))
          (cons :some (cdr entry)))
         (verina-basic-104-all-m2-entries-present-p
          (cdr remaining)
          result)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

;; For each m1 entry, a key present in m2 imposes no additional clause here;
;; otherwise RESULT must retain the m1 value.

(defun verina-basic-104-all-unoverridden-m1-entries-present-p
    (remaining m2 result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((entry (car remaining))
             (from-m2
              (verina-basic-104-find-option
               m2
               (car entry))))
        (and
         (if (verina-basic-104-some-option-p from-m2)
             t
           (equal
            (verina-basic-104-find-option
             result
             (car entry))
            (cons :some (cdr entry))))
         (verina-basic-104-all-unoverridden-m1-entries-present-p
          (cdr remaining)
          m2
          result)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

;; Every result entry must carry m2's value when its key occurs there, m1's
;; value when it occurs only in m1, and otherwise be witnessed by m2. This is
;; the source's final List.all match expression and excludes extra entries.

(defun verina-basic-104-all-result-entries-valid-p
    (remaining m1 m2)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((entry (car remaining))
             (key (car entry))
             (value (cdr entry))
             (from-m1
              (verina-basic-104-find-option m1 key))
             (from-m2
              (verina-basic-104-find-option m2 key)))
        (and
         (if (verina-basic-104-some-option-p from-m1)
             (if (verina-basic-104-some-option-p from-m2)
                 (equal
                  value
                  (verina-basic-104-option-value
                   from-m2))
               (equal
                value
                (verina-basic-104-option-value
                 from-m1)))
           (equal
            from-m2
            (cons :some value)))
         (verina-basic-104-all-result-entries-valid-p
          (cdr remaining)
          m1
          m2)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-104-update-map-postcond
    (m1 m2 result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p m1)
   (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p m2)
   (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p result)
   (verina-basic-104-pairwise-key-order-p result)
   (verina-basic-104-all-m2-entries-present-p
    m2
    result)
   (verina-basic-104-all-unoverridden-m1-entries-present-p
    m1
    m2
    result)
   (verina-basic-104-all-result-entries-valid-p
    result
    m1
    m2)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. Its
;; antecedent preserves both arbitrary Map Int Int inputs and the complete
;; unique-key precondition; its conclusion applies the full postcondition to
;; the exact executable update_map result.

(defun verina-basic-104-update-map-spec-satisfied-statement
    (m1 m2)
  (implies
   (and
    (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p m1)
    (verina-basic-104-integer-map-p m2)
    (verina-basic-104-update-map-precond
     m1
     m2))
   (verina-basic-104-update-map-postcond
    m1
    m2
    (verina-basic-104-update-map m1 m2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_104
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
-- catalog title "update_map": a deterministic association-list map update
-- gives the second map priority, sorts the resulting entries by integer key,
-- and is connected to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic104 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _∈_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairFirst : A
    pairSecond : B

open Pair public

record Map (K V : Set) : Set where
  constructor map
  field
    entries : List (Pair K V)

open Map public

empty : {K V : Set} → Map K V
empty = map []

data _∈_ {A : Set} (x : A) : List A → Set where
  here : {xs : List A} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : A} {xs : List A} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates {A : Set} : List A → Set where
  noDuplicatesNil : NoDuplicates []
  noDuplicatesCons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} →
    Not (x ∈ xs) →
    NoDuplicates xs →
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

keys : {V : Set} → List (Pair Int V) → List Int
keys [] = []
keys (entry ∷ rest) =
  pairFirst entry ∷ keys rest

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

filterNotKey :
  Int → List (Pair Int Int) → List (Pair Int Int)
filterNotKey key [] = []
filterNotKey key (entry ∷ rest) =
  if boolNot (intEqual (pairFirst entry) key)
  then entry ∷ filterNotKey key rest
  else filterNotKey key rest

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

insert :
  Map Int Int → Int → Int → Map Int Int
insert m key value =
  map
    (appendList
      (filterNotKey key (entries m))
      (pair key value ∷ []))

foldLeft :
  {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

insertEntry :
  Map Int Int → Pair Int Int → Map Int Int
insertEntry accumulator entry =
  insert accumulator (pairFirst entry) (pairSecond entry)

insertSorted :
  Pair Int Int →
  List (Pair Int Int) →
  List (Pair Int Int)
insertSorted entry [] = entry ∷ []
insertSorted entry (current ∷ rest) =
  if intLessOrEqual (pairFirst entry) (pairFirst current)
  then (entry ∷ current ∷ rest)
  else (current ∷ insertSorted entry rest)

sortEntries :
  List (Pair Int Int) → List (Pair Int Int)
sortEntries [] = []
sortEntries (entry ∷ rest) =
  insertSorted entry (sortEntries rest)

lookup :
  Map Int Int → Int → Maybe Int
lookup m key = findInEntries (entries m) key
  where
  findInEntries :
    List (Pair Int Int) → Int → Maybe Int
  findInEntries [] sought = nothing
  findInEntries (entry ∷ rest) sought =
    if intEqual (pairFirst entry) sought
    then just (pairSecond entry)
    else findInEntries rest sought

update-map-precond :
  Map Int Int → Map Int Int → Set
update-map-precond m1 m2 =
  NoDuplicates (keys (entries m1)) ∧
  NoDuplicates (keys (entries m2))

update-map :
  (m1 m2 : Map Int Int) →
  update-map-precond m1 m2 →
  Map Int Int
update-map m1 m2 h-precond =
  let updated =
        foldLeft insertEntry m1 (entries m2)
  in map (sortEntries (entries updated))

m1-entry-condition :
  Map Int Int →
  Map Int Int →
  Pair Int Int →
  Set
m1-entry-condition m2 result entry
  with lookup m2 (pairFirst entry)
... | just value = Top
... | nothing =
  lookup result (pairFirst entry) ≡ just (pairSecond entry)

result-entry-from-lookups :
  Pair Int Int →
  Maybe Int →
  Maybe Int →
  Set
result-entry-from-lookups entry (just oldValue) (just newValue) =
  pairSecond entry ≡ newValue
result-entry-from-lookups entry (just oldValue) nothing =
  pairSecond entry ≡ oldValue
result-entry-from-lookups entry nothing maybeNewValue =
  maybeNewValue ≡ just (pairSecond entry)

result-entry-condition :
  Map Int Int →
  Map Int Int →
  Pair Int Int →
  Set
result-entry-condition m1 m2 entry =
  result-entry-from-lookups
    entry
    (lookup m1 (pairFirst entry))
    (lookup m2 (pairFirst entry))

entriesOrdered :
  Pair Int Int → Pair Int Int → Set
entriesOrdered firstEntry secondEntry =
  IntLessOrEqual
    (pairFirst firstEntry)
    (pairFirst secondEntry)

update-map-postcond :
  (m1 m2 result : Map Int Int) →
  update-map-precond m1 m2 →
  Set
update-map-postcond m1 m2 result h-precond =
  Pairwise entriesOrdered (entries result) ∧
  All
    (λ entry →
      lookup result (pairFirst entry) ≡
      just (pairSecond entry))
    (entries m2) ∧
  All
    (m1-entry-condition m2 result)
    (entries m1) ∧
  All
    (result-entry-condition m1 m2)
    (entries result)

update-map-spec-satisfied : Set
update-map-spec-satisfied =
  (m1 m2 : Map Int Int) →
  (h-precond : update-map-precond m1 m2) →
  update-map-postcond
    m1
    m2
    (update-map m1 m2 h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_104
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
  catalog title "update_map": the executable association-list map update
  gives second-map entries precedence, retains unoverridden first-map entries,
  and sorts the result by integer key. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open integerTheory listTheory optionTheory pairTheory;

val update_map_precond_def = new_definition (
  "update_map_precond_def",
  ``update_map_precond
      (m1 : (int # int) list) (m2 : (int # int) list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST m1) /\
      ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST m2)``
);

val update_map_insert_def = new_definition (
  "update_map_insert_def",
  ``update_map_insert
      (m : (int # int) list) (k : int) (v : int) =
      FILTER (\entry. FST entry <> k) m ++ [(k,v)]``
);

val update_map_sort_insert_def = Define `
  (update_map_sort_insert
      (entry : int # int) ([] : (int # int) list) =
     [entry]) /\
  (update_map_sort_insert
      entry (head::tail) =
     if FST entry <= FST head then
       entry::head::tail
     else
       head::update_map_sort_insert entry tail)
`;

val update_map_sort_def = Define `
  (update_map_sort
      ([] : (int # int) list) =
     ([] : (int # int) list)) /\
  (update_map_sort
      (entry::rest) =
     update_map_sort_insert entry (update_map_sort rest))
`;

val update_map_def = new_definition (
  "update_map_def",
  ``update_map
      (m1 : (int # int) list) (m2 : (int # int) list) =
      let updated =
        FOLDL
          (\acc entry.
             update_map_insert acc (FST entry) (SND entry))
          m1
          m2
      in
        update_map_sort updated``
);

val update_map_find_def = Define `
  (update_map_find
      ([] : (int # int) list) (k : int) =
     (NONE : int option)) /\
  (update_map_find
      ((key,value)::rest) k =
     if key = k then
       SOME value
     else
       update_map_find rest k)
`;

val update_map_pairwise_def = Define `
  (update_map_pairwise
      ([] : (int # int) list) =
     T) /\
  (update_map_pairwise
      (entry::rest) =
     (EVERY
        (\later : int # int. FST entry <= FST later)
        rest /\
      update_map_pairwise rest))
`;

val update_map_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "update_map_postcond_def",
  ``update_map_postcond
      (m1 : (int # int) list)
      (m2 : (int # int) list)
      (result : (int # int) list) <=>
      update_map_pairwise result /\
      EVERY
        (\entry.
           update_map_find result (FST entry) =
           SOME (SND entry))
        m2 /\
      EVERY
        (\entry.
           case update_map_find m2 (FST entry) of
             NONE =>
               update_map_find result (FST entry) =
               SOME (SND entry)
           | SOME value => T)
        m1 /\
      EVERY
        (\entry.
           case update_map_find m1 (FST entry) of
             NONE =>
               update_map_find m2 (FST entry) =
               SOME (SND entry)
           | SOME value =>
               (case update_map_find m2 (FST entry) of
                  NONE => SND entry = value
                | SOME value2 => SND entry = value2))
        result``
);

val update_map_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(m1 : (int # int) list) (m2 : (int # int) list).
      update_map_precond m1 m2 ==>
      update_map_postcond m1 m2 (update_map m1 m2)``;

title: verina_basic_104
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_basic_104 (verina__metamath__verina_basic_104), catalog title
  update_map: the exact list-backed integer-map insertion fold and stable
  key-sorting computation satisfies its unique-key, lookup, value-selection,
  and sortedness correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINAB104Pair is Int x Int, VERINAB104Map is the source Map structure's
  entries field represented by an arbitrary finite word of integer pairs, and
  VERINAB104Empty is the source empty map. For a word w, # ` w is its length,
  w ` i is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINAB104KeepCount counts entries before a specified index whose key is
  different from the inserted key. VERINAB104FilterKeyGraph therefore gives
  exactly the stable List.filter used by insert. VERINAB104InsertGraph copies
  that filtered word and appends the new key-value pair. The fold graph threads
  this exact insertion through m2 from left to right, starting at m1.

  VERINAB104MergeSortGraph uses a permutation of source indices ordered first
  by key and then by original index. This is exactly stable List.mergeSort
  with comparator fun a b => a.1 <= b.1, including equal-key tie ordering.
  VERINAB104UpdateMapGraph composes the insertion fold and that sort, so the
  executable result is fixed independently of the postcondition.

  VERINAB104FindGraph is List.find? with integer key equality: it returns the
  value at the least matching index, or none when no key matches.
  VERINAB104NodupKeys is List.Nodup after mapping first projections, and
  VERINAB104Pre is the conjunction of that condition for both source maps.
  VERINAB104PairwiseLE is List.Pairwise on nondecreasing keys.
  VERINAB104Post preserves all four source conjuncts: sorted output; every m2
  entry has its value in the result; every m1 entry not overridden by m2 keeps
  its value; and each result entry has exactly the branch-selected value from
  m1 and m2.

  The source proof-valued precondition argument does not affect computation
  and is not inspected by the postcondition, so the final correctness
  assertion represents it by an explicit antecedent. The source Map BEq
  instance is unused by every preserved computation and proposition. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering,
  and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB104Pair VERINAB104Map VERINAB104Empty
  VERINAB104KeepCount
  VERINAB104FilterKeyGraph VERINAB104FilterKey
  VERINAB104InsertGraph VERINAB104Insert
  VERINAB104FoldGraph VERINAB104Fold
  VERINAB104MergeSortGraph VERINAB104MergeSort
  VERINAB104UpdateMapGraph VERINAB104UpdateMap
  VERINAB104None VERINAB104Some VERINAB104OptionInt
  VERINAB104FindGraph VERINAB104Find
  VERINAB104NodupKeys VERINAB104Pre
  VERINAB104PairwiseLE VERINAB104Post
$.

verinab104-pair-syntax
  $a class VERINAB104Pair $.
verinab104-map-syntax
  $a class VERINAB104Map $.
verinab104-empty-syntax
  $a class VERINAB104Empty $.
verinab104-keep-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104KeepCount A B C ) $.
verinab104-filter-key-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104FilterKeyGraph A B C ) $.
verinab104-filter-key-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104FilterKey A B ) $.
verinab104-insert-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104InsertGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab104-insert-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104Insert A B C ) $.
verinab104-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104FoldGraph A B C ) $.
verinab104-fold-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104Fold A B ) $.
verinab104-merge-sort-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104MergeSortGraph A B ) $.
verinab104-merge-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104MergeSort A ) $.
verinab104-update-map-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104UpdateMapGraph A B C ) $.
verinab104-update-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104UpdateMap A B ) $.
verinab104-none-syntax
  $a class VERINAB104None $.
verinab104-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104Some A ) $.
verinab104-option-int-syntax
  $a class VERINAB104OptionInt $.
verinab104-find-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104FindGraph A B C ) $.
verinab104-find-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB104Find A B ) $.
verinab104-nodup-keys-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104NodupKeys A ) $.
verinab104-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104Pre A B ) $.
verinab104-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab104-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB104Post A B C ) $.

verinab104-pair-definition $a |- VERINAB104Pair = (
  ZZ X. ZZ
) $.

verinab104-map-definition $a |- VERINAB104Map = (
  Word VERINAB104Pair
) $.

verinab104-empty-definition $a |- VERINAB104Empty = (/) $.

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab104-keep-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104KeepCount A B C
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ C )
      |
      ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) =/= B
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab104-filter-key-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104FilterKeyGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINAB104Map
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = (
        VERINAB104KeepCount A B ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) =/= B
          ->
          (
            C ` ( VERINAB104KeepCount A B i )
          ) = ( A ` i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab104-filter-key-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104FilterKey A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104Map
      ( VERINAB104FilterKeyGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verinab104-insert-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104InsertGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. VERINAB104Map
          /\
          B e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        C e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      D e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = (
        ( # ` ( VERINAB104FilterKey A B ) ) + 1
      )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. (
          0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINAB104FilterKey A B ) )
        )
          ( D ` i ) = (
            ( VERINAB104FilterKey A B ) ` i
          )
        /\
        (
          D ` ( # ` ( VERINAB104FilterKey A B ) )
        ) = <. B , C >.
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab104-insert-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104Insert A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104Map
      ( VERINAB104InsertGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i t A B C $.

  verinab104-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104FoldGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINAB104Map
        /\
        B e. VERINAB104Map
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word VERINAB104Map
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` B ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = A
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              VERINAB104InsertGraph
                ( t ` i )
                ( 1st ` ( B ` i ) )
                ( 2nd ` ( B ` i ) )
                ( t ` ( i + 1 ) )
            )
          /\
          C = ( t ` ( # ` B ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab104-fold-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104Fold A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104Map
      ( VERINAB104FoldGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j p A B $.

  verinab104-merge-sort-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104MergeSortGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. VERINAB104Map
      /\
      B e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` p ) = ( # ` A )
          /\
          ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( p ` i ) < ( # ` A )
              /\
              ( B ` i ) = ( A ` ( p ` i ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  i =/= j
                  ->
                  ( p ` i ) =/= ( p ` j )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
                (
                  i < j
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      1st ` ( B ` i )
                    ) < (
                      1st ` ( B ` j )
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      (
                        1st ` ( B ` i )
                      ) = (
                        1st ` ( B ` j )
                      )
                      /\
                      ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
                    )
                  )
                )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab104-merge-sort-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104MergeSort A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104Map
      ( VERINAB104MergeSortGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f A B C $.

  verinab104-update-map-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104UpdateMapGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINAB104Map
        /\
        B e. VERINAB104Map
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    E. f e. VERINAB104Map
      (
        VERINAB104FoldGraph A B f
        /\
        VERINAB104MergeSortGraph f C
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab104-update-map-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104UpdateMap A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104Map
      ( VERINAB104UpdateMapGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab104-none-definition $a |- VERINAB104None = (/) $.

verinab104-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB104Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d x z $.

  verinab104-option-int-definition $a |- VERINAB104OptionInt = {
    x |
    (
      x = VERINAB104None
      \/
      E. z e. ZZ x = ( VERINAB104Some z )
    )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verinab104-find-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104FindGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINAB104Map
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINAB104OptionInt
    )
    /\
    (
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          (
            ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) = B
            /\
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ i )
              ( 1st ` ( A ` j ) ) =/= B
          )
          /\
          C = (
            VERINAB104Some ( 2nd ` ( A ` i ) )
          )
        )
      \/
      (
        -.
        E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) ) = B
        /\
        C = VERINAB104None
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab104-find-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104Find A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. VERINAB104OptionInt
      ( VERINAB104FindGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab104-nodup-keys-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104NodupKeys A
  ) <-> (
    A e. VERINAB104Map
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          (
            1st ` ( A ` i )
          ) =/= (
            1st ` ( A ` j )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

verinab104-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB104Pre A B
) <-> (
  ( VERINAB104NodupKeys A )
  /\
  ( VERINAB104NodupKeys B )
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab104-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104PairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. VERINAB104Map
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          (
            1st ` ( A ` i )
          ) <_ (
            1st ` ( A ` j )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i u v A B C $.

  verinab104-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB104Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. VERINAB104Map
        /\
        B e. VERINAB104Map
      )
      /\
      C e. VERINAB104Map
    )
    /\
    (
      ( VERINAB104PairwiseLE C )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          (
            VERINAB104Find
              C
              ( 1st ` ( B ` i ) )
          ) = (
            VERINAB104Some ( 2nd ` ( B ` i ) )
          )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              (
                VERINAB104Find
                  B
                  ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) )
              ) = VERINAB104None
              ->
              (
                VERINAB104Find
                  C
                  ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) )
              ) = (
                VERINAB104Some ( 2nd ` ( A ` i ) )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
            (
              E. u e. ZZ
                (
                  (
                    VERINAB104Find
                      A
                      ( 1st ` ( C ` i ) )
                  ) = ( VERINAB104Some u )
                  /\
                  (
                    E. v e. ZZ
                      (
                        (
                          VERINAB104Find
                            B
                            ( 1st ` ( C ` i ) )
                        ) = ( VERINAB104Some v )
                        /\
                        ( 2nd ` ( C ` i ) ) = v
                      )
                    \/
                    (
                      (
                        VERINAB104Find
                          B
                          ( 1st ` ( C ` i ) )
                      ) = VERINAB104None
                      /\
                      ( 2nd ` ( C ` i ) ) = u
                    )
                  )
                )
              \/
              (
                (
                  VERINAB104Find
                    A
                    ( 1st ` ( C ` i ) )
                ) = VERINAB104None
                /\
                (
                  VERINAB104Find
                    B
                    ( 1st ` ( C ` i ) )
                ) = (
                  VERINAB104Some ( 2nd ` ( C ` i ) )
                )
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d m n $.

  verina-basic-104-update-map $a |- A. m e. VERINAB104Map
    A. n e. VERINAB104Map
      (
        ( VERINAB104Pre m n )
        ->
        (
          VERINAB104Post
            m
            n
            ( VERINAB104UpdateMap m n )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: verina_basic_104
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_104, catalog title "update_map": the unique-key precondition,
:: exact key-removing insertion and left-fold implementation, key-sorted
:: output, first-match lookup helper, full update postcondition, and final
:: correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP,
    XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for m1,m2,result being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:] st
    (for i,j being Nat, ki,kj,vi,vj being Integer st
      i in dom m1 & j in dom m1 &
      m1/.i = [ki,vi] & m1/.j = [kj,vj] & ki = kj
    holds i = j) &
    (for i,j being Nat, ki,kj,vi,vj being Integer st
      i in dom m2 & j in dom m2 &
      m2/.i = [ki,vi] & m2/.j = [kj,vj] & ki = kj
    holds i = j) &
    (ex removeKey being
          Function of [:[:INT,INT:]*,INT:],[:INT,INT:]*,
        insertMap being
          Function of [:[:INT,INT:]*,INT,INT:],[:INT,INT:]*,
        findMap being
          Function of [:[:INT,INT:]*,INT:],[:BOOLEAN,INT:],
        foldStates being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:]*,
        updated being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:] st
      (for key being Integer holds
        removeKey/.[<*>[:INT,INT:],key] = <*>[:INT,INT:]) &
      (for headKey,headValue,key being Integer,
           tail,whole being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:] st
        whole = <*[headKey,headValue]*> ^ tail
      holds
        ((headKey = key &
          removeKey/.[whole,key] = removeKey/.[tail,key]) or
         (headKey <> key &
          removeKey/.[whole,key] =
            <*[headKey,headValue]*> ^ removeKey/.[tail,key]))) &
      (for source being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:],
           key,value being Integer holds
        insertMap/.[source,key,value] =
          removeKey/.[source,key] ^ <*[key,value]*>) &
      (for key being Integer holds
        findMap/.[<*>[:INT,INT:],key] = [FALSE,0]) &
      (for headKey,headValue,key being Integer,
           tail,whole being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:] st
        whole = <*[headKey,headValue]*> ^ tail
      holds
        ((headKey = key &
          findMap/.[whole,key] = [TRUE,headValue]) or
         (headKey <> key &
          findMap/.[whole,key] = findMap/.[tail,key]))) &
      len foldStates = len m2 + 1 &
      foldStates/.1 = m1 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom m2 holds
        ex current,next being FinSequence of [:INT,INT:],
           key,value being Integer st
          current = foldStates/.k &
          next = foldStates/.(k + 1) &
          m2/.k = [key,value] &
          next = insertMap/.[current,key,value]) &
      updated = foldStates/.(len m2 + 1) &
      len result = len updated &
      rng result = rng updated &
      result is one-to-one &
      (for i,j being Nat, ki,kj,vi,vj being Integer st
        i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j &
        result/.i = [ki,vi] & result/.j = [kj,vj]
      holds ki <= kj))
  holds
    (for i,j being Nat, ki,kj,vi,vj being Integer st
      i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j &
      result/.i = [ki,vi] & result/.j = [kj,vj]
    holds ki <= kj) &
    (for k being Nat, key,value being Integer st
      k in dom m2 & m2/.k = [key,value]
    holds
      ex q being Nat st
        q in dom result &
        result/.q = [key,value] &
        for h being Nat, earlierValue being Integer st
          h in dom result & h < q
        holds result/.h <> [key,earlierValue]) &
    (for k being Nat, key,value being Integer st
      k in dom m1 & m1/.k = [key,value] &
      not ex q being Nat, newValue being Integer st
        q in dom m2 & m2/.q = [key,newValue]
    holds
      ex q being Nat st
        q in dom result &
        result/.q = [key,value] &
        for h being Nat, earlierValue being Integer st
          h in dom result & h < q
        holds result/.h <> [key,earlierValue]) &
    (for k being Nat, key,value being Integer st
      k in dom result & result/.k = [key,value]
    holds
      ((ex q being Nat st
          q in dom m2 &
          m2/.q = [key,value] &
          for h being Nat, earlierValue being Integer st
            h in dom m2 & h < q
          holds m2/.h <> [key,earlierValue]) or
       (not ex q being Nat, newValue being Integer st
          q in dom m2 & m2/.q = [key,newValue]) &
       (ex q being Nat st
          q in dom m1 &
          m1/.q = [key,value] &
          for h being Nat, earlierValue being Integer st
            h in dom m1 & h < q
          holds m1/.h <> [key,earlierValue])))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_104
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_104,
% catalog title "update_map": replacing entries of one unique-key integer map
% from a second map, sorting by key, and stating the full correctness contract.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_104: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_map_entry: TYPE =
    [# map_key: int,
       map_value: int #]

  int_map: TYPE =
    [# map_entries: list[int_map_entry] #]

  int_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoInt: NoInt?
    SomeInt(option_value: int): SomeInt?
  END int_option

  empty_map: int_map =
    (# map_entries := null #)

  key_member(
      requested_key: int,
      values: list[int_map_entry]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        map_key(entry) = requested_key
          OR key_member(requested_key, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  unique_keys(
      values: list[int_map_entry]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        NOT key_member(map_key(entry), rest)
          AND unique_keys(rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is exactly filter-by-different-key followed by appending the new pair.
  insert_entries(
      values: list[int_map_entry],
      requested_key, requested_value: int):
        RECURSIVE list[int_map_entry] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(
          (# map_key := requested_key,
             map_value := requested_value #),
          null),
      cons(entry, rest):
        IF map_key(entry) = requested_key THEN
          insert_entries(
            rest,
            requested_key,
            requested_value)
        ELSE
          cons(
            entry,
            insert_entries(
              rest,
              requested_key,
              requested_value))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  insert(
      m: int_map,
      requested_key, requested_value: int): int_map =
    (# map_entries :=
         insert_entries(
           map_entries(m),
           requested_key,
           requested_value) #)

  fold_insert(
      remaining: list[int_map_entry],
      accumulator: int_map): RECURSIVE int_map =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(entry, rest):
        fold_insert(
          rest,
          insert(
            accumulator,
            map_key(entry),
            map_value(entry)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  insert_sorted(
      entry: int_map_entry,
      values: list[int_map_entry]):
        RECURSIVE list[int_map_entry] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(entry, null),
      cons(head, tail):
        IF map_key(entry) <= map_key(head) THEN
          cons(entry, cons(head, tail))
        ELSE
          cons(head, insert_sorted(entry, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  sort_entries(
      values: list[int_map_entry]):
        RECURSIVE list[int_map_entry] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null,
      cons(entry, rest):
        insert_sorted(entry, sort_entries(rest))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  update_map_precond(
      m1, m2: int_map): bool =
    unique_keys(map_entries(m1))
      AND unique_keys(map_entries(m2))

  % The source proof argument is computationally irrelevant. On the
  % unique-key precondition, sorting by insertion and Lean's mergeSort with
  % integer-key comparison return the same uniquely ordered entry list.
  update_map(
      m1, m2: int_map): int_map =
    LET updated: int_map =
          fold_insert(map_entries(m2), m1)
    IN
      (# map_entries :=
           sort_entries(map_entries(updated)) #)

  find_value(
      values: list[int_map_entry],
      requested_key: int): RECURSIVE int_option =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        NoInt,
      cons(entry, rest):
        IF map_key(entry) = requested_key THEN
          SomeInt(map_value(entry))
        ELSE
          find_value(rest, requested_key)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  all_keys_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int_map_entry]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        lower <= map_key(entry)
          AND all_keys_at_least(lower, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int_map_entry]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        all_keys_at_least(map_key(entry), rest)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing(rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  second_entries_present(
      remaining, result_entries: list[int_map_entry]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        find_value(result_entries, map_key(entry))
            = SomeInt(map_value(entry))
          AND second_entries_present(rest, result_entries)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  first_entries_preserved(
      remaining,
      second_entries,
      result_entries: list[int_map_entry]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        (CASES find_value(second_entries, map_key(entry)) OF
           NoInt:
             find_value(result_entries, map_key(entry))
               = SomeInt(map_value(entry)),
           SomeInt(second_value):
             TRUE
         ENDCASES)
          AND first_entries_preserved(
                rest,
                second_entries,
                result_entries)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  result_entries_valid(
      remaining,
      first_entries,
      second_entries: list[int_map_entry]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(entry, rest):
        (CASES find_value(first_entries, map_key(entry)) OF
           NoInt:
             find_value(second_entries, map_key(entry))
               = SomeInt(map_value(entry)),
           SomeInt(first_value):
             CASES find_value(second_entries, map_key(entry)) OF
               NoInt:
                 map_value(entry) = first_value,
               SomeInt(second_value):
                 map_value(entry) = second_value
             ENDCASES
         ENDCASES)
          AND result_entries_valid(
                rest,
                first_entries,
                second_entries)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  update_map_postcond(
      m1, m2, result: int_map): bool =
    pairwise_nondecreasing(map_entries(result))
      AND second_entries_present(
            map_entries(m2),
            map_entries(result))
      AND first_entries_preserved(
            map_entries(m1),
            map_entries(m2),
            map_entries(result))
      AND result_entries_valid(
            map_entries(result),
            map_entries(m1),
            map_entries(m2))

  update_map_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (m1, m2: int_map):
      update_map_precond(m1, m2)
        IMPLIES
          update_map_postcond(
            m1,
            m2,
            update_map(m1, m2))

END verina_basic_104
