  `!s:num list. !oldChar:num. !newChar:num.
     replaceChars_string s
     ==> replaceChars_validChar oldChar
     ==> replaceChars_validChar newChar
     ==> replaceChars_precond s oldChar newChar
     ==> replaceChars_postcond
           s oldChar newChar
           (replaceChars s oldChar newChar)`;;

title: verina_basic_16
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_16,
;; catalog title "replaceChars": a deterministic Unicode-string program
;; replaces every occurrence of one character with another while preserving
;; length and all other positions. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values, preserving the complete Lean Char domain.

(defun verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-basic-16-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-basic-16-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The typed input domains remain explicit
;; in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-basic-16-replace-chars-precond
    (s old-char new-char)
  (declare (ignore s old-char new-char))
  t)

;; This structural recursion is exactly the source String.toList map followed
;; by String.mk. The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally
;; irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-16-replace-chars
    (s old-char new-char)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (cons
       (if (equal (car s) old-char)
           new-char
         (car s))
       (verina-basic-16-replace-chars
        (cdr s)
        old-char
        new-char))
    nil))

;; List.get! is only observed at in-bounds indices in a true postcondition.
;; This total accessor supplies Unicode NUL outside that range.

(defun verina-basic-16-char-at (i chars)
  (if (and
       (natp i)
       (< i (len chars)))
      (nth i chars)
    0))

;; This preserves the source postcondition's universal Nat index and its two
;; conditional clauses for replaced and unchanged characters.

(defun-sk verina-basic-16-correct-at-every-index-p
    (s old-char new-char result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i (len s)))
     (and
      (implies
       (equal
        (verina-basic-16-char-at i s)
        old-char)
       (equal
        (verina-basic-16-char-at i result)
        new-char))
      (implies
       (not
        (equal
         (verina-basic-16-char-at i s)
         old-char))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-16-char-at i result)
        (verina-basic-16-char-at i s)))))))

(defun verina-basic-16-replace-chars-postcond
    (s old-char new-char result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-16-string-p s)
   (verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p old-char)
   (verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p new-char)
   (verina-basic-16-string-p result)
   (equal (len result) (len s))
   (verina-basic-16-correct-at-every-index-p
    s
    old-char
    new-char
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It applies
;; the complete postcondition to the exact executable result for every typed
;; input satisfying the source's True precondition.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-16-replace-chars-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (s old-char new-char)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-16-string-p s)
      (verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p old-char)
      (verina-basic-16-unicode-scalar-p new-char)
      (verina-basic-16-replace-chars-precond
       s
       old-char
       new-char))
     (verina-basic-16-replace-chars-postcond
      s
      old-char
      new-char
      (verina-basic-16-replace-chars
       s
       old-char
       new-char)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_16
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_16,
-- catalog title "replaceChars": a deterministic string program replaces every
-- occurrence of one character with another while preserving the string length
-- and all nonmatching characters. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic16 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using
  (String; primStringFromList; primStringToList)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

nullChar : Char
nullChar = primNatToChar zero

replaceChar : Char → Char → Char → Char
replaceChar oldChar newChar c =
  if primCharEquality c oldChar
  then newChar
  else c

replaceChars-precond : String → Char → Char → Set
replaceChars-precond s oldChar newChar = Top

replaceChars :
  (s : String) →
  (oldChar newChar : Char) →
  replaceChars-precond s oldChar newChar →
  String
replaceChars s oldChar newChar h-precond =
  primStringFromList
    (mapList
      (replaceChar oldChar newChar)
      (primStringToList s))

replaceChars-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (oldChar newChar : Char) →
  (result : String) →
  replaceChars-precond s oldChar newChar →
  Set
replaceChars-postcond s oldChar newChar result h-precond =
  let inputChars = primStringToList s
      resultChars = primStringToList result
  in
    (listLength resultChars ≡ listLength inputChars) ∧
    ((i : Nat) →
      i < listLength inputChars →
      ((indexDefault nullChar inputChars i ≡ oldChar →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡ newChar) ∧
       (Not (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i ≡ oldChar) →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡
          indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)))

replaceChars-spec-satisfied : Set
replaceChars-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (oldChar newChar : Char) →
  (h-precond : replaceChars-precond s oldChar newChar) →
  replaceChars-postcond
    s
    oldChar
    newChar
    (replaceChars s oldChar newChar h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_16
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_16,
  catalog title "replaceChars": the executable Unicode-string map replaces
  every occurrence of one character with another while preserving length and
  all other characters. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar_def = new_definition (
  "replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar_def",
  ``replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar (c : num) <=>
      c < 1114112 /\ ~(55296 <= c /\ c <= 57343)``
);

val replaceChars_isUnicodeString_def = new_definition (
  "replaceChars_isUnicodeString_def",
  ``replaceChars_isUnicodeString (s : num list) <=>
      EVERY replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar s``
);

val replaceChars_precond_def = new_definition (
  "replaceChars_precond_def",
  ``replaceChars_precond
      (s : num list) (oldChar : num) (newChar : num) <=>
      T``
);

val replaceChars_def = new_definition (
  "replaceChars_def",
  ``replaceChars
      (s : num list) (oldChar : num) (newChar : num) =
      MAP
        (\c : num. if c = oldChar then newChar else c)
        s``
);

val replaceChars_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "replaceChars_postcond_def",
  ``replaceChars_postcond
      (s : num list)
      (oldChar : num)
      (newChar : num)
      (result : num list) <=>
      LENGTH result = LENGTH s /\
      (!i : num.
         i < LENGTH s ==>
         (EL i s = oldChar ==> EL i result = newChar) /\
         (EL i s <> oldChar ==> EL i result = EL i s))``
);

val replaceChars_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(s : num list) (oldChar : num) (newChar : num).
      replaceChars_isUnicodeString s ==>
      replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar oldChar ==>
      replaceChars_isUnicodeScalar newChar ==>
      replaceChars_precond s oldChar newChar ==>
      replaceChars_postcond
        s oldChar newChar (replaceChars s oldChar newChar)``;

title: verina_basic_16
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_16
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_16), catalog title replaceChars: the exact
  executable character-map program replaces every occurrence of one character
  in an arbitrary Unicode string with another character and satisfies its
  length and pointwise replacement correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINAB16Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINAB16Char represents arbitrary Lean strings extensionally through
  String.toList. Word length is therefore String.length, word lookup is
  zero-based, and 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) is the complete valid-index set.

  VERINAB16ToCharList and VERINAB16StringMk are the source String.toList and
  String.mk conversions; both are extensionally the identity on this word
  representation. VERINAB16MapGraph is exactly List.map with the source
  branch fun c => if c = oldChar then newChar else c: it preserves length and
  fixes every output position to that branch value. VERINAB16Map selects the
  unique mapped word, and VERINAB16ReplaceChars composes the source
  conversions and map. Its result is fixed independently of the postcondition
  and admits no additional outputs.

  VERINAB16Pre is the source True precondition on typed String and Char
  inputs. VERINAB16Post preserves result.length = s.length and both source
  implications at every valid input index. Because those lengths are equal,
  direct word lookup there is exactly the source get! lookup on both lists.
  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent in
  the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB16Char
  VERINAB16ToCharList VERINAB16StringMk
  VERINAB16MapGraph VERINAB16Map
  VERINAB16Pre VERINAB16ReplaceChars VERINAB16Post
$.

verinab16-char-syntax
  $a class VERINAB16Char $.
verinab16-to-char-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB16ToCharList A ) $.
verinab16-string-mk-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB16StringMk A ) $.
verinab16-map-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB16MapGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab16-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB16Map A B C ) $.
verinab16-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB16Pre A B C ) $.
verinab16-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB16ReplaceChars A B C ) $.
verinab16-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB16Post A B C D ) $.

verinab16-char-definition $a |- VERINAB16Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verinab16-to-char-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB16ToCharList A
) = A $.

verinab16-string-mk-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB16StringMk A
) = A $.

${
  $d k A B C D $.

  verinab16-map-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB16MapGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINAB16Char
        /\
        B e. VERINAB16Char
      )
      /\
      (
        C e. VERINAB16Char
        /\
        D e. Word VERINAB16Char
      )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          D ` k
        ) = if (
          ( A ` k ) = B ,
          C ,
          A ` k
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab16-map-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB16Map A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB16Char
      ( VERINAB16MapGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab16-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB16Pre A B C
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word VERINAB16Char
    /\
    B e. VERINAB16Char
  )
  /\
  C e. VERINAB16Char
) $.

verinab16-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB16ReplaceChars A B C
) = (
  VERINAB16StringMk
    (
      VERINAB16Map
        ( VERINAB16ToCharList A )
        B
        C
    )
) $.

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verinab16-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB16Post A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word VERINAB16Char
          /\
          B e. VERINAB16Char
        )
        /\
        C e. VERINAB16Char
      )
      /\
      D e. Word VERINAB16Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. (
        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINAB16ToCharList A ) )
      )
        (
          (
            (
              ( VERINAB16ToCharList A ) ` i
            ) = B
            ->
            (
              ( VERINAB16ToCharList D ) ` i
            ) = C
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( VERINAB16ToCharList A ) ` i
            ) =/= B
            ->
            (
              ( VERINAB16ToCharList D ) ` i
            ) = (
              ( VERINAB16ToCharList A ) ` i
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-16-replace-chars $a |-
  A. s e. Word VERINAB16Char
    A. o e. VERINAB16Char
      A. n e. VERINAB16Char
        (
          ( VERINAB16Pre s o n )
          ->
          (
            VERINAB16Post
              s
              o
              n
              ( VERINAB16ReplaceChars s o n )
          )
        )
$.

:: verina_basic_16, catalog title "replaceChars": an exact Unicode-scalar
:: finite-sequence encoding of the unconditional precondition, deterministic

environ

    0 = 0 &
    (ex replace being Function of NAT,NAT st
      (for c being Element of NAT holds

    len result = len s &

title: verina_basic_16
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_16,
% catalog title "replaceChars": replacing every occurrence of one character in
% a Unicode-scalar string while preserving its length and all other characters.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_16: THEORY
BEGIN

  % String.toList observes a Lean string as its finite list of Unicode scalar
  % characters, so this preserves the full extensional source string domain.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]

  lean_string_length(s: lean_string): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES s OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        lean_string_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE s BY <<

  % Lean List.get! for characters returns the null character outside the list.
  lean_char_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE lean_char =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          lean_char_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  replaceChars_precond(
      s: lean_string,
      oldChar, newChar: lean_char): bool =
    TRUE

  replace_chars(
      values: list[lean_char],
      oldChar, newChar: lean_char): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          IF head = oldChar THEN newChar ELSE head ENDIF,
          replace_chars(tail, oldChar, newChar))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % This recursion is exactly the proof-erased List.map replacement program.
  replaceChars(
      s: lean_string,
      oldChar, newChar: lean_char): lean_string =
    replace_chars(s, oldChar, newChar)

  replaceChars_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      oldChar, newChar: lean_char,
      result: lean_string): bool =
    lean_string_length(result) = lean_string_length(s)
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < lean_string_length(s)
            IMPLIES
              ((lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s) = oldChar
                  IMPLIES
                    lean_char_list_get_bang(i, result) = newChar)
                AND
               (lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s) /= oldChar
                  IMPLIES
                    lean_char_list_get_bang(i, result)
                      = lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s))))

  replaceChars_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string), (oldChar, newChar: lean_char):
      replaceChars_precond(s, oldChar, newChar)
        IMPLIES
          replaceChars_postcond(
            s,
            oldChar,
            newChar,
            replaceChars(s, oldChar, newChar))

END verina_basic_16

title: verina_basic_17
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
   catalog title "toLowercase": an executable Unicode-scalar string program
   maps each ASCII uppercase character to the codepoint 32 positions later
   and leaves every other character unchanged, together with its trivial
   precondition, pointwise postcondition, and correctness contract. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Inductive lean_trit : Type :=
| Trit0
| Trit1
| Trit2.

Inductive lean_bits3 : Type :=
| LeanBits3 : bool -> bool -> bool -> lean_bits3.

Inductive lean_bits4 : Type :=
| LeanBits4 : bool -> bool -> bool -> bool -> lean_bits4.

Inductive lean_bits5 : Type :=
| LeanBits5 : bool -> bool -> bool -> bool -> bool -> lean_bits5.

Inductive lean_byte : Type :=
| LeanByte :
    bool -> bool -> bool -> bool ->
    bool -> bool -> bool -> bool ->
    lean_byte.

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanBmpLow :
    lean_trit -> lean_trit -> lean_trit ->
    lean_bits3 -> lean_byte -> lean_char
| LeanBmpHigh :
    lean_bits5 -> lean_byte -> lean_char
| LeanSupplementary :
    lean_bits4 -> lean_byte -> lean_byte -> lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition lean_bit_value (b : bool) : nat :=
  if b then 1 else 0.

Definition lean_trit_value (t : lean_trit) : nat :=
  match t with
  | Trit0 => 0
  | Trit1 => 1
  | Trit2 => 2
  end.

Definition lean_bits3_value (bits : lean_bits3) : nat :=
  match bits with
  | LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0 =>
      lean_bit_value b2 * 4 +
      lean_bit_value b1 * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b0
  end.

Definition lean_bits4_value (bits : lean_bits4) : nat :=
  match bits with
  | LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0 =>
      lean_bit_value b3 * 8 +
      lean_bit_value b2 * 4 +
      lean_bit_value b1 * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b0
  end.

Definition lean_bits5_value (bits : lean_bits5) : nat :=
  match bits with
  | LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0 =>
      lean_bit_value b4 * 16 +
      lean_bit_value b3 * 8 +
      lean_bit_value b2 * 4 +
      lean_bit_value b1 * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b0
  end.

Definition lean_byte_value (byte : lean_byte) : nat :=
  match byte with
  | LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0 =>
      lean_bit_value b7 * 128 +
      lean_bit_value b6 * 64 +
      lean_bit_value b5 * 32 +
      lean_bit_value b4 * 16 +
      lean_bit_value b3 * 8 +
      lean_bit_value b2 * 4 +
      lean_bit_value b1 * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b0
  end.

Definition lean_char_to_nat (c : lean_char) : nat :=
  match c with
  | LeanBmpLow t2 t1 t0 bits byte =>
      ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
          lean_trit_value t0) * 8 +
         lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
       lean_byte_value byte)
  | LeanBmpHigh bits byte =>
      57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte
  | LeanSupplementary bits high low =>
      65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
      lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low
  end.

Definition lean_trit_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_trit :=
  match Nat.modulo n 3 with
  | O => Trit0
  | S O => Trit1
  | _ => Trit2
  end.

Definition lean_bit_of_nat (n : nat) : bool :=
  Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n 2) 1.

Definition lean_bits3_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_bits3 :=
  LeanBits3
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 4))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 2))
    (lean_bit_of_nat n).

Definition lean_bits4_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_bits4 :=
  LeanBits4
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 8))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 4))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 2))
    (lean_bit_of_nat n).

Definition lean_bits5_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_bits5 :=
  LeanBits5
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 16))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 8))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 4))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 2))
    (lean_bit_of_nat n).

Definition lean_byte_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_byte :=
  LeanByte
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 128))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 64))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 32))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 16))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 8))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 4))
    (lean_bit_of_nat (Nat.div n 2))
    (lean_bit_of_nat n).

Definition lean_low_char_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_char :=
  let q := Nat.div n 2048 in
  LeanBmpLow
    (lean_trit_of_nat (Nat.div q 9))
    (lean_trit_of_nat (Nat.modulo (Nat.div q 3) 3))
    (lean_trit_of_nat (Nat.modulo q 3))
    (lean_bits3_of_nat (Nat.modulo (Nat.div n 256) 8))
    (lean_byte_of_nat (Nat.modulo n 256)).

Definition lean_char_of_nat (n : nat) : lean_char :=
  if Nat.ltb n 55296 then
    lean_low_char_of_nat n
  else if Nat.ltb n 57344 then
    lean_low_char_of_nat 0
  else if Nat.ltb n 65536 then
    let m := n - 57344 in
    LeanBmpHigh
      (lean_bits5_of_nat (Nat.div m 256))
      (lean_byte_of_nat (Nat.modulo m 256))
  else if Nat.ltb n 1114112 then
    let m := n - 65536 in
    LeanSupplementary
      (lean_bits4_of_nat (Nat.div m 65536))
      (lean_byte_of_nat (Nat.modulo (Nat.div m 256) 256))
      (lean_byte_of_nat (Nat.modulo m 256))
  else
    lean_low_char_of_nat 0.

Definition lean_null_char : lean_char :=
  lean_char_of_nat 0.

Definition isUpperCase (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  andb
    (Nat.leb 65 (lean_char_to_nat c))
    (Nat.leb (lean_char_to_nat c) 90).

Definition shift32 (c : lean_char) : lean_char :=
  lean_char_of_nat (lean_char_to_nat c + 32).

Definition toLowercase_precond (_s : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition toLowercase
    (s : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : toLowercase_precond s) : lean_string :=
  map
    (fun c => if isUpperCase c then shift32 c else c)
    s.

Definition toLowercase_postcond
    (s : lean_string)
    (result : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : toLowercase_precond s) : Prop :=
  length result = length s /\
  forall i : nat,
    i < length s ->
    (isUpperCase (nth i s lean_null_char) = true ->
      nth i result lean_null_char =
        shift32 (nth i s lean_null_char)) /\
    (isUpperCase (nth i s lean_null_char) = false ->
      nth i result lean_null_char =
        nth i s lean_null_char).

Theorem toLowercase_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (h_precond : toLowercase_precond s) :
  toLowercase_postcond
    s (toLowercase s h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_17
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
  catalog title "toLowercase": an executable Unicode-scalar string program
  maps each ASCII uppercase character to the codepoint 32 positions later and
  leaves every other character unchanged, together with its trivial
  precondition, pointwise postcondition, and correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_17
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_trit_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_trit" where
  "lean_trit_of_nat n =
    (if n mod 3 = 0 then Trit0
     else if n mod 3 = 1 then Trit1
     else Trit2)"

definition lean_bits3_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits3" where
  "lean_bits3_of_nat n =
    LeanBits3
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_bits4_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits4" where
  "lean_bits4_of_nat n =
    LeanBits4
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_bits5_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_bits5" where
  "lean_bits5_of_nat n =
    LeanBits5
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_byte_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_byte" where
  "lean_byte_of_nat n =
    LeanByte
      ((n div 128) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 64) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 32) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 16) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 8) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 4) mod 2 = 1)
      ((n div 2) mod 2 = 1)
      (n mod 2 = 1)"

definition lean_low_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_low_char_of_nat n =
    (let q = n div 2048
     in BMP_Low
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q div 9))
          (lean_trit_of_nat ((q div 3) mod 3))
          (lean_trit_of_nat (q mod 3))
          (lean_bits3_of_nat ((n div 256) mod 8))
          (lean_byte_of_nat (n mod 256)))"

definition lean_char_of_nat :: "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_char_of_nat n =
    (if n < 55296 then lean_low_char_of_nat n
     else if n < 57344 then lean_low_char_of_nat 0
     else if n < 65536 then
       (let m = n - 57344
        in BMP_High
             (lean_bits5_of_nat (m div 256))
             (lean_byte_of_nat (m mod 256)))
     else if n < 1114112 then
       (let m = n - 65536
        in Supplementary
             (lean_bits4_of_nat (m div 65536))
             (lean_byte_of_nat ((m div 256) mod 256))
             (lean_byte_of_nat (m mod 256)))
     else lean_low_char_of_nat 0)"

definition isUpperCase :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isUpperCase c \<longleftrightarrow>
    65 \<le> lean_char_to_nat c \<and> lean_char_to_nat c \<le> 90"

definition shift32 :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "shift32 c = lean_char_of_nat (lean_char_to_nat c + 32)"

definition toLowercase_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "toLowercase_precond s \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition toLowercase_toList :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "toLowercase_toList s = s"

definition toLowercase_mk :: "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "toLowercase_mk chars = chars"

definition toLowercase :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "toLowercase s =
    (let cs = toLowercase_toList s;
         cs' = map (\<lambda>c. if isUpperCase c then shift32 c else c) cs
     in toLowercase_mk cs')"

definition toLowercase_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "toLowercase_postcond s result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let cs = toLowercase_toList s;
         cs' = toLowercase_toList result
     in length result = length s \<and>
        (\<forall>i. i < length s \<longrightarrow>
          ((isUpperCase (cs ! i) \<longrightarrow>
            cs' ! i = shift32 (cs ! i)) \<and>
           (\<not> isUpperCase (cs ! i) \<longrightarrow>
            cs' ! i = cs ! i))))"

theorem toLowercase_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "toLowercase_precond s"
  shows "toLowercase_postcond s (toLowercase s)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_17
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
  catalog title "toLowercase": an executable Unicode-string map converts each
  uppercase ASCII letter to its lowercase counterpart and leaves every other
  character unchanged, with its total correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let toLowercase_validChar = new_definition
  `toLowercase_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let toLowercase_string = new_definition
  `toLowercase_string (s:num list) <=>
     ALL toLowercase_validChar s`;;

let isUpperCase = new_definition
  `isUpperCase (c:num) <=> 65 <= c /\ c <= 90`;;

let shift32 = new_definition
  `shift32 (c:num) =
     if toLowercase_validChar (c + 32) then c + 32 else 0`;;

let toLowercase_precond = new_definition
  `toLowercase_precond (s:num list) <=> T`;;

let toLowercase = new_definition
  `toLowercase (s:num list) =
     MAP
       (\c:num. if isUpperCase c then shift32 c else c)
       s`;;

let toLowercase_postcond = new_definition
  `toLowercase_postcond
      (s:num list) (result:num list) <=>
     LENGTH result = LENGTH s /\
     (!i:num.
        i < LENGTH s
        ==> (isUpperCase (EL i s)
             ==> EL i result = shift32 (EL i s)) /\
            (~isUpperCase (EL i s)
             ==> EL i result = EL i s))`;;

let toLowercase_spec_satisfied =
  `!s:num list.
     toLowercase_string s
     ==> toLowercase_precond s
     ==> toLowercase_postcond s (toLowercase s)`;;

title: verina_basic_17
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
;; catalog title "toLowercase": a deterministic Unicode-string program maps
;; each ASCII uppercase letter to its lowercase counterpart, preserves every
;; other character, and preserves string length. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values, preserving the complete Lean Char domain.

(defun verina-basic-17-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-basic-17-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-basic-17-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-basic-17-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

;; These are the source isUpperCase and Char.ofNat helpers. Char.ofNat returns
;; Unicode NUL when its natural-number input is not a Unicode scalar value.

(defun verina-basic-17-is-uppercase (c)
  (and
   (<= 65 c)
   (<= c 90)))

(defun verina-basic-17-char-of-nat (n)
  (if (verina-basic-17-unicode-scalar-p n)
      n
    0))

(defun verina-basic-17-shift32 (c)
  (verina-basic-17-char-of-nat (+ c 32)))

;; The source precondition is True. The String binder domain remains explicit
;; in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-basic-17-to-lowercase-precond (s)
  (declare (ignore s))
  t)

;; Under the canonical representation, String.toList and String.mk are the
;; identity conversions around this exact List.map computation. The
;; proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.

(defun verina-basic-17-to-lowercase (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (cons
       (if (verina-basic-17-is-uppercase (car s))
           (verina-basic-17-shift32 (car s))
         (car s))
       (verina-basic-17-to-lowercase (cdr s)))
    nil))

;; List.get! is total in Lean. Unicode NUL is its default character, matching
;; this accessor outside the natural in-bounds case.

(defun verina-basic-17-char-at (i chars)
  (if (and
       (natp i)
       (< i (len chars)))
      (nth i chars)
    0))

;; This preserves the postcondition's universal Nat index and both conditional
;; clauses for uppercase and non-uppercase input characters.

(defun-sk verina-basic-17-correct-at-every-index-p
    (s result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i (len s)))
     (and
      (implies
       (verina-basic-17-is-uppercase
        (verina-basic-17-char-at i s))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-17-char-at i result)
        (verina-basic-17-shift32
         (verina-basic-17-char-at i s))))
      (implies
       (not
        (verina-basic-17-is-uppercase
         (verina-basic-17-char-at i s)))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-17-char-at i result)
        (verina-basic-17-char-at i s)))))))

(defun verina-basic-17-to-lowercase-postcond
    (s result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-17-string-p s)
   (verina-basic-17-string-p result)
   (equal (len result) (len s))
   (verina-basic-17-correct-at-every-index-p
    s
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It preserves
;; the arbitrary Unicode-string input and True precondition, and applies the
;; complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-17-to-lowercase-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (s)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-17-string-p s)
      (verina-basic-17-to-lowercase-precond s))
     (verina-basic-17-to-lowercase-postcond
      s
      (verina-basic-17-to-lowercase s)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_17
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
-- catalog title "toLowercase": a deterministic string program converts ASCII
-- uppercase characters to lowercase by shifting their character codes by 32,
-- preserves all other characters, and is connected to its length-and-character
-- correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic17 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharToNat; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using
  (String; primStringFromList; primStringToList)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_
infixr 5 _&&_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

nullChar : Char
nullChar = primNatToChar zero

isUpperCase : Char → Bool
isUpperCase c =
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat 'A') (primCharToNat c) &&
  natLessOrEqual (primCharToNat c) (primCharToNat 'Z')

shift32 : Char → Char
shift32 c = primNatToChar (primCharToNat c + 32)

lowercaseChar : Char → Char
lowercaseChar c =
  if isUpperCase c
  then shift32 c
  else c

toLowercase-precond : String → Set
toLowercase-precond s = Top

toLowercase :
  (s : String) →
  toLowercase-precond s →
  String
toLowercase s h-precond =
  primStringFromList
    (mapList lowercaseChar (primStringToList s))

toLowercase-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (result : String) →
  toLowercase-precond s →
  Set
toLowercase-postcond s result h-precond =
  let inputChars = primStringToList s
      resultChars = primStringToList result
  in
    (listLength resultChars ≡ listLength inputChars) ∧
    ((i : Nat) →
      i < listLength inputChars →
      ((IsTrue (isUpperCase (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)) →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡
          shift32 (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)) ∧
       (Not (IsTrue (isUpperCase
          (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i))) →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡
          indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)))

toLowercase-spec-satisfied : Set
toLowercase-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (h-precond : toLowercase-precond s) →
  toLowercase-postcond
    s
    (toLowercase s h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_17
verina_basic_17
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_17), catalog title toLowercase: the exact
  executable character-map program converts ASCII uppercase characters in an
  arbitrary Unicode string by adding 32 to their code points, leaves every
  other character unchanged, and satisfies its length and pointwise
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINAB17Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINAB17Char represents arbitrary Lean strings extensionally through
  String.toList. Word length is therefore String.length, word lookup is
  zero-based, and 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) is the complete valid-index set.

  VERINAB17IsUpper is the source Boolean helper for the inclusive ASCII range
  A through Z. VERINAB17Shift32 exactly represents Char.ofNat
  (c.toNat + 32): it returns the sum when that sum is a Unicode scalar value
  and Lean's null character otherwise. In every executable uppercase branch
  the sum is a valid lowercase ASCII scalar.

  VERINAB17ToCharList and VERINAB17StringMk are the source String.toList and
  String.mk conversions; both are extensionally the identity on this word
  representation. VERINAB17MapGraph is exactly List.map with the source
  branch fun c => if isUpperCase c then shift32 c else c: it preserves length
  and fixes every output position to that branch value. VERINAB17Map selects
  the unique mapped word, and VERINAB17ToLowercase composes the source
  conversions and map. Its result is fixed independently of the postcondition
  and admits no additional outputs.

  VERINAB17Pre is the source True precondition on typed String inputs.
  VERINAB17Post preserves result.length = s.length and both source
  implications at every valid input index. Because those lengths are equal,
  direct word lookup there is exactly the source get! lookup on both lists.
  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent in
  the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB17Char
  VERINAB17IsUpper VERINAB17Shift32
  VERINAB17ToCharList VERINAB17StringMk
  VERINAB17MapGraph VERINAB17Map
  VERINAB17Pre VERINAB17ToLowercase VERINAB17Post
$.

verinab17-char-syntax
  $a class VERINAB17Char $.
verinab17-is-upper-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17IsUpper A ) $.
verinab17-shift32-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17Shift32 A ) $.
verinab17-to-char-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) $.
verinab17-string-mk-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17StringMk A ) $.
verinab17-map-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB17MapGraph A B ) $.
verinab17-map-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17Map A ) $.
verinab17-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB17Pre A ) $.
verinab17-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB17ToLowercase A ) $.
verinab17-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB17Post A B ) $.

verinab17-char-definition $a |- VERINAB17Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verinab17-is-upper-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17IsUpper A
) = if (
  (
    ; 6 5 <_ A
    /\
    A <_ ; 9 0
  ) ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verinab17-shift32-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17Shift32 A
) = if (
  ( A + ; 3 2 ) e. VERINAB17Char ,
  ( A + ; 3 2 ) ,
  0
) $.

verinab17-to-char-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17ToCharList A
) = A $.

verinab17-string-mk-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17StringMk A
) = A $.

${
  $d k A B $.

  verinab17-map-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB17MapGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINAB17Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINAB17Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          B ` k
        ) = if (
          ( VERINAB17IsUpper ( A ` k ) ) = 1 ,
          ( VERINAB17Shift32 ( A ` k ) ) ,
          A ` k
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab17-map-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB17Map A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB17Char
      ( VERINAB17MapGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab17-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word VERINAB17Char
) $.

verinab17-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB17ToLowercase A
) = (
  VERINAB17StringMk
    (
      VERINAB17Map
        ( VERINAB17ToCharList A )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab17-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB17Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word VERINAB17Char
      /\
      B e. Word VERINAB17Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. (
        0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) )
      )
        (
          (
            (
              VERINAB17IsUpper
                ( ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) ` i )
            ) = 1
            ->
            (
              ( VERINAB17ToCharList B ) ` i
            ) = (
              VERINAB17Shift32
                ( ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) ` i )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              VERINAB17IsUpper
                ( ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) ` i )
            ) = 0
            ->
            (
              ( VERINAB17ToCharList B ) ` i
            ) = (
              ( VERINAB17ToCharList A ) ` i
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_17,
% catalog title "toLowercase": mapping ASCII uppercase characters in a
% Unicode-scalar string to lowercase while preserving all other characters
% and the string length. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_17: THEORY
BEGIN

  % String.toList observes a Lean string as its finite list of Unicode scalar
  % characters, preserving the full extensional source string domain.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_string: TYPE = list[lean_char]

  lean_valid_char_code(codepoint: nat): bool =
    codepoint < 1114112
      AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)

  % Lean Char.ofNat returns NUL when its argument is not a Unicode scalar.
  lean_char_of_nat(codepoint: nat): lean_char =
    IF lean_valid_char_code(codepoint) THEN codepoint ELSE 0 ENDIF

  isUpperCase(c: lean_char): bool =
    c >= 65 AND c <= 90

  shift32(c: lean_char): lean_char =
    lean_char_of_nat(c + 32)

  lean_string_length(s: lean_string): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES s OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        lean_string_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE s BY <<

  % Lean List.get! for characters returns NUL outside the list.
  lean_char_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE lean_char =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          lean_char_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  toLowercase_precond(s: lean_string): bool =
    TRUE

  lowercase_chars(
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(
          IF isUpperCase(head) THEN shift32(head) ELSE head ENDIF,
          lowercase_chars(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % This recursion is exactly the proof-erased List.map implementation.
  toLowercase(s: lean_string): lean_string =
    lowercase_chars(s)

  toLowercase_postcond(
      s: lean_string,
      result: lean_string): bool =
    lean_string_length(result) = lean_string_length(s)
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < lean_string_length(s)
            IMPLIES
              ((isUpperCase(lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s))
                  IMPLIES
                    lean_char_list_get_bang(i, result)
                      = shift32(lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s)))
                AND
               (NOT isUpperCase(lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s))
                  IMPLIES
                    lean_char_list_get_bang(i, result)
                      = lean_char_list_get_bang(i, s))))

  toLowercase_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (s: lean_string):
      toLowercase_precond(s)
        IMPLIES
          toLowercase_postcond(
            s,
            toLowercase(s))

END verina_basic_17

title: verina_basic_18
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
   catalog title "sumOfDigits": an executable accumulator loop computes the
   sum of the decimal digits of a natural number, together with its trivial
   precondition, decimal-representation postcondition, and final correctness
   proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition sumOfDigits_precond (_n : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint sumOfDigits_loop_fuel
    (fuel n acc : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => acc
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n 0
      then acc
      else
        sumOfDigits_loop_fuel
          fuel' (Nat.div n 10) (acc + Nat.modulo n 10)
  end.

Definition sumOfDigits
    (n : nat)
    (_h_precond : sumOfDigits_precond n) : nat :=
  sumOfDigits_loop_fuel n n 0.

Fixpoint sumOfDigits_decimal_digits_rev_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => []
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n 0
      then []
      else
        Nat.modulo n 10
          :: sumOfDigits_decimal_digits_rev_fuel
               fuel' (Nat.div n 10)
  end.

Definition sumOfDigits_decimal_digits
    (n : nat) : list nat :=
  if Nat.eqb n 0
  then [0]
  else rev (sumOfDigits_decimal_digits_rev_fuel n n).

Fixpoint sumOfDigits_list_sum
    (digits : list nat) : nat :=
  match digits with
  | [] => 0
  | digit :: rest =>
      digit + sumOfDigits_list_sum rest
  end.

Definition sumOfDigits_decimal_repr_sum
    (n : nat) : nat :=
  sumOfDigits_list_sum (sumOfDigits_decimal_digits n).

Definition sumOfDigits_postcond
    (n result : nat)
    (_h_precond : sumOfDigits_precond n) : Prop :=
  Nat.sub result (sumOfDigits_decimal_repr_sum n) = 0 /\
  Nat.sub (sumOfDigits_decimal_repr_sum n) result = 0.

Theorem sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied
    (n : nat)
    (h_precond : sumOfDigits_precond n) :
  sumOfDigits_postcond
    n (sumOfDigits n h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
  catalog title "sumOfDigits": an executable natural-number program repeatedly
  extracts base-10 digits and returns their sum, together with its trivial
  precondition, decimal-representation postcondition, and correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_18
  imports Main
begin

definition sumOfDigits_precond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "sumOfDigits_precond n \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun sumOfDigits_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumOfDigits_loop 0 n acc = acc"
| "sumOfDigits_loop (Suc fuel) n acc =
    (if n = 0
     then acc
     else sumOfDigits_loop fuel (n div 10) (acc + n mod 10))"

definition sumOfDigits :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumOfDigits n = sumOfDigits_loop (Suc n) n 0"

fun decimalDigitsRev_go :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "decimalDigitsRev_go 0 n = []"
| "decimalDigitsRev_go (Suc fuel) n =
    (if n = 0
     then []
     else (n mod 10) # decimalDigitsRev_go fuel (n div 10))"

definition decimalDigitValues :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "decimalDigitValues n =
    (if n = 0
     then [0]
     else rev (decimalDigitsRev_go (Suc n) n))"

definition decimalRepresentationDigitSum :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "decimalRepresentationDigitSum n = sum_list (decimalDigitValues n)"

definition sumOfDigits_postcond :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "sumOfDigits_postcond n result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result - decimalRepresentationDigitSum n = 0 \<and>
    decimalRepresentationDigitSum n - result = 0"

theorem sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "sumOfDigits_precond n"
  shows "sumOfDigits_postcond n (sumOfDigits n)"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
  catalog title "sumOfDigits": an executable decimal-digit loop computes the
  sum of the digits of any natural number, with its total precondition and
  decimal-representation correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let sumOfDigits_precond = new_definition
  `sumOfDigits_precond (n:num) <=> T`;;

let sumOfDigits_loopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!n:num. !acc:num.
        sumOfDigits_loopFuel 0 n acc = acc) /\
     (!fuel:num. !n:num. !acc:num.
        sumOfDigits_loopFuel (SUC fuel) n acc =
        if n = 0 then acc
        else
          sumOfDigits_loopFuel
            fuel (n DIV 10) (acc + n MOD 10))`;;

let sumOfDigits = new_definition
  `sumOfDigits (n:num) =
     sumOfDigits_loopFuel (SUC n) n 0`;;

let sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!n:num.
        sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel 0 n = []) /\
     (!fuel:num. !n:num.
        sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel (SUC fuel) n =
        if n < 10 then CONS n []
        else
          APPEND
            (sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel fuel (n DIV 10))
            (CONS (n MOD 10) []))`;;

let sumOfDigits_decimalDigits = new_definition
  `sumOfDigits_decimalDigits (n:num) =
     if n = 0 then CONS 0 []
     else sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel n n`;;

let sumOfDigits_listSum =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(sumOfDigits_listSum ([]:num list) = 0) /\
     (!d:num. !ds:num list.
        sumOfDigits_listSum (CONS d ds) =
        d + sumOfDigits_listSum ds)`;;

let sumOfDigits_postcond = new_definition
  `sumOfDigits_postcond (n:num) (result:num) <=>
     let digitSum =
       sumOfDigits_listSum (sumOfDigits_decimalDigits n) in
     result - digitSum = 0 /\
     digitSum - result = 0`;;

let sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied =
  `!n:num.
     sumOfDigits_precond n
     ==> sumOfDigits_postcond n (sumOfDigits n)`;;

title: verina_basic_18
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
;; catalog title "sumOfDigits": a deterministic natural-number program sums
;; the decimal digits of its input, with correctness stated against the
;; independent digit sum of its decimal representation. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The Nat input domain remains explicit in
;; the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; Fuel starts at N. Every nonzero source step replaces N by floor(N/10), so
;; on natural inputs the recursion reaches zero before the fuel can expire.
;; The fuel is therefore only an ACL2 termination device and adds no cutoff.

(defun verina-basic-18-loop-go (n acc fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp n)
      acc
    (if (zp fuel)
        acc
      (verina-basic-18-loop-go
       (floor n 10)
       (+ acc (mod n 10))
       (- fuel 1)))))

;; This wrapper preserves the source-local loop on its Nat arguments. The
;; proof-valued True precondition argument to sumOfDigits is computationally
;; irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-18-loop (n acc)
  (verina-basic-18-loop-go
   (nfix n)
   (nfix acc)
   (nfix n)))

(defun verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits (n)
  (verina-basic-18-loop n 0))

;; Nat.repr yields the one-digit representation "0" for zero and otherwise
;; the ordinary most-significant-first decimal representation. Replacing each
;; character by Char.toNat(c) - Char.toNat('0') gives exactly this digit list.
;; This computation is kept separate from the executable loop, as in the
;; source postcondition.

(defun verina-basic-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (not (natp n))
       (zp n)
       (zp fuel))
      nil
    (let ((quotient (floor n 10))
          (digit (mod n 10)))
      (if (equal quotient 0)
          (list digit)
        (append
         (verina-basic-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux
          quotient
          (- fuel 1))
         (list digit))))))

(defun verina-basic-18-decimal-digits (n)
  (if (not (natp n))
      nil
    (if (equal n 0)
        (list 0)
      (verina-basic-18-decimal-digits-positive-aux
       n
       n))))

(defun verina-basic-18-list-sum (digits)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count digits)))
  (if (consp digits)
      (+ (car digits)
         (verina-basic-18-list-sum (cdr digits)))
    0))

;; Lean Nat subtraction truncates at zero.

(defun verina-basic-18-nat-sub (left right)
  (nfix (- left right)))

(defun verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits-postcond
    (n result)
  (let ((represented-digit-sum
         (verina-basic-18-list-sum
          (verina-basic-18-decimal-digits n))))
    (and
     (natp n)
     (natp result)
     (equal
      (verina-basic-18-nat-sub
       result
       represented-digit-sum)
      0)
     (equal
      (verina-basic-18-nat-sub
       represented-digit-sum
       result)
      0))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It preserves
;; the arbitrary Nat input and True precondition, and applies the complete
;; postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits-precond n))
     (verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits-postcond
      n
      (verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_18
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
-- catalog title "sumOfDigits": a deterministic natural-number program sums
-- the decimal digits of its input and is connected to the corresponding
-- decimal-representation correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic18 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalDiv : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero = zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

ten : Nat
ten =
  suc
    (suc
      (suc
        (suc
          (suc
            (suc
              (suc
                (suc
                  (suc
                    (suc zero)))))))))

sumOfDigits-loop : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
sumOfDigits-loop zero current accumulator = accumulator
sumOfDigits-loop (suc fuel) zero accumulator = accumulator
sumOfDigits-loop (suc fuel) current@(suc _) accumulator =
  sumOfDigits-loop
    fuel
    (naturalDiv current ten)
    (accumulator + naturalMod current ten)

sumOfDigits-precond : Nat → Set
sumOfDigits-precond n = Top

sumOfDigits :
  (n : Nat) →
  sumOfDigits-precond n →
  Nat
sumOfDigits n h-precond =
  sumOfDigits-loop n n zero

digitsReversedWithFuel : Nat → Nat → List Nat
digitsReversedWithFuel zero current = []
digitsReversedWithFuel (suc fuel) zero = []
digitsReversedWithFuel (suc fuel) current@(suc _) =
  naturalMod current ten ∷
  digitsReversedWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv current ten)

reverseOnto : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
reverseOnto accumulator [] = accumulator
reverseOnto accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  reverseOnto (x ∷ accumulator) xs

reverseList : {A : Set} → List A → List A
reverseList xs = reverseOnto [] xs

decimalDigits : Nat → List Nat
decimalDigits zero = zero ∷ []
decimalDigits n@(suc _) =
  reverseList (digitsReversedWithFuel n n)

sumList : List Nat → Nat
sumList [] = zero
sumList (x ∷ xs) = x + sumList xs

decimalDigitSum : Nat → Nat
decimalDigitSum n = sumList (decimalDigits n)

sumOfDigits-postcond :
  (n result : Nat) →
  sumOfDigits-precond n →
  Set
sumOfDigits-postcond n result h-precond =
  (natSubtract result (decimalDigitSum n) ≡ zero) ∧
  (natSubtract (decimalDigitSum n) result ≡ zero)

sumOfDigits-spec-satisfied : Set
sumOfDigits-spec-satisfied =
  (n : Nat) →
  (h-precond : sumOfDigits-precond n) →
  sumOfDigits-postcond
    n
    (sumOfDigits n h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
  catalog title "sumOfDigits": the executable natural-number program
  repeatedly takes base-10 remainders and quotients to sum the decimal digits,
  with its precondition and decimal-representation postcondition. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val sumOfDigits_loopFuel_def = Define `
  (sumOfDigits_loopFuel
      0 (n : num) (acc : num) =
     acc) /\
  (sumOfDigits_loopFuel
      (SUC fuel) n acc =
     if n = 0 then
       acc
     else
       sumOfDigits_loopFuel fuel (n DIV 10) (acc + n MOD 10))
`;

val sumOfDigits_precond_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfDigits_precond_def",
  ``sumOfDigits_precond (n : num) <=> T``
);

val sumOfDigits_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfDigits_def",
  ``sumOfDigits (n : num) =
      sumOfDigits_loopFuel n n 0``
);

val sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel_def = Define `
  (sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel
      0 (n : num) =
     ([] : num list)) /\
  (sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel
      (SUC fuel) n =
     if n < 10 then
       [n]
     else
       sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel fuel (n DIV 10) ++ [n MOD 10])
`;

val sumOfDigits_decimalDigits_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfDigits_decimalDigits_def",
  ``sumOfDigits_decimalDigits (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then
        [0]
      else
        sumOfDigits_decimalDigitsFuel n n``
);

val sumOfDigits_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfDigits_postcond_def",
  ``sumOfDigits_postcond (n : num) (result : num) <=>
      let digitSum =
        FOLDL
          (\acc d. acc + d)
          0
          (sumOfDigits_decimalDigits n)
      in
        result - digitSum = 0 /\
        digitSum - result = 0``
);

val sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied =
  ``!n : num.
      sumOfDigits_precond n ==>
      sumOfDigits_postcond n (sumOfDigits n)``;

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number traces and digit lists.

  VERINAB18LoopGraph is the exact finite execution graph of the source local
  loop for an arbitrary current number and accumulator. Its traces repeatedly
  replace a positive current number by its natural quotient by ten and add
  its remainder modulo ten to the accumulator, stopping precisely at zero.
  VERINAB18Loop selects the unique final accumulator, and
  VERINAB18SumOfDigits invokes that loop with accumulator zero. Thus the
  executable result is fixed independently of the postcondition and admits
  no additional outputs.

  VERINAB18DecimalDigits is the unique canonical most-significant-first
  decimal digit word of a natural number, including the one-digit word
  containing zero for input zero. This is exactly the result of mapping
  Char.toNat c - Char.toNat '0' over String.toList (Nat.repr n), since every
  character emitted by Nat.repr is an ASCII decimal digit.
  VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum is the source List.sum of that mapped list.

  VERINAB18NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction. VERINAB18Pre is
  the source True precondition together with the Nat input type.
  VERINAB18Post preserves both source conjuncts: each truncated difference
  between the executable result and the decimal-representation digit sum is
  zero. The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent in
  the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB18LoopGraph VERINAB18Loop VERINAB18SumOfDigits
  VERINAB18DecimalDigitsGraph VERINAB18DecimalDigits
  VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum
  VERINAB18NatSub VERINAB18Pre VERINAB18Post
$.

verinab18-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB18LoopGraph A B C ) $.
verinab18-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB18Loop A B ) $.
verinab18-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB18SumOfDigits A ) $.
verinab18-decimal-digits-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB18DecimalDigitsGraph A B ) $.
verinab18-decimal-digits-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB18DecimalDigits A ) $.
verinab18-decimal-digit-sum-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum A ) $.
verinab18-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB18NatSub A B ) $.
verinab18-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB18Pre A ) $.
verinab18-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB18Post A B ) $.

${
  $d i k s t A B C $.

  verinab18-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB18LoopGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. k e. NN0 E. s e. Word NN0 E. t e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          (
            ( # ` s ) = ( k + 1 )
            /\
            ( # ` t ) = ( k + 1 )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` 0 ) = A
            /\
            ( t ` 0 ) = B
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            (
              0 < ( s ` i )
              /\
              (
                (
                  s ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  |_ ` ( ( s ` i ) / ; 1 0 )
                )
                /\
                (
                  t ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  ( t ` i )
                  +
                  ( ( s ` i ) mod ; 1 0 )
                )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` k ) = 0
            /\
            C = ( t ` k )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab18-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB18Loop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB18LoopGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab18-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB18SumOfDigits A
) = (
  VERINAB18Loop A 0
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab18-decimal-digits-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB18DecimalDigitsGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. Word NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      0 < ( # ` B )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          ( B ` i ) < ; 1 0
        /\
        (
          (
            (
              A = 0
              ->
              ( # ` B ) = 1
            )
            /\
            (
              0 < A
              ->
              0 < ( B ` 0 )
            )
          )
          /\
          A = sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              ( B ` i )
              x.
              (
                ; 1 0
                ^
                ( ( ( # ` B ) - 1 ) - i )
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab18-decimal-digits-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB18DecimalDigits A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word NN0
      ( VERINAB18DecimalDigitsGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verinab18-decimal-digit-sum-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum A
  ) = (
    sum_ i e. (
      0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINAB18DecimalDigits A ) )
    )
      (
        ( VERINAB18DecimalDigits A ) ` i
      )
  ) $.
$}

verinab18-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB18NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab18-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB18Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
) $.

verinab18-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB18Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      VERINAB18NatSub
        B
        ( VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum A )
    ) = 0
    /\
    (
      VERINAB18NatSub
        ( VERINAB18DecimalDigitSum A )
        B
    ) = 0
  )
) $.

verina-basic-18-sum-of-digits $a |- A. n e. NN0
  (
    ( VERINAB18Pre n )
    ->
    (
      VERINAB18Post
        n
        ( VERINAB18SumOfDigits n )
    )
  )
$.

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_18,
% catalog title "sumOfDigits": computing a natural number's decimal digit sum
% and specifying equality with the digit sum of its canonical decimal representation.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_18: THEORY
BEGIN

  sumOfDigits_precond(n: nat): bool =
    TRUE

  % The fuel is solely a PVS structural termination index. Starting with n
  % permits every recursive division-by-ten step of the source loop.
  sumOfDigits_loop(
      n, accumulator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSE
      sumOfDigits_loop(
        ndiv(n, 10),
        accumulator + mod(n, 10),
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  sumOfDigits(n: nat): nat =
    sumOfDigits_loop(n, 0, n)

  decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(
      n, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      null[nat]
    ELSIF fuel = 0 THEN
      null[nat]
    ELSE
      cons(
        mod(n, 10),
        decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(
          ndiv(n, 10),
          fuel - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  decimal_digits_reversed(n: nat): list[nat] =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      cons(0, null[nat])
    ELSE
      decimal_digits_reversed_fuel(n, n)
    ENDIF

  reverse_nat_list_acc(
      values, accumulator: list[nat]): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        reverse_nat_list_acc(
          tail,
          cons(head, accumulator))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % These are exactly the base-ten digit values obtained by mapping
  % Char.toNat(c) - Char.toNat('0') over String.toList(Nat.repr(n)).
  decimal_repr_digits(n: nat): list[nat] =
    reverse_nat_list_acc(
      decimal_digits_reversed(n),
      null[nat])

  nat_list_sum(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        head + nat_list_sum(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  sumOfDigits_postcond(
      n, result: nat): bool =
    LET expected: nat = nat_list_sum(decimal_repr_digits(n))
    IN
      nat_subtract(result, expected) = 0
        AND nat_subtract(expected, result) = 0

  sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      sumOfDigits_precond(n)
        IMPLIES
          sumOfDigits_postcond(
            n,
            sumOfDigits(n))

END verina_basic_18

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_19,
   catalog title "isSorted": an executable Boolean check that every adjacent
   pair in an integer array is nondecreasing, together with its trivial
   precondition, exact Boolean postcondition, and final correctness
   proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition isSorted_precond (_a : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint isSorted_scan
    (previous : Z)
    (rest : list Z) : bool :=
  match rest with
  | [] => true
  | current :: tail =>
      if Z.leb previous current
      then isSorted_scan current tail
      else false
  end.

Definition isSorted
    (a : list Z)
    (_h_precond : isSorted_precond a) : bool :=
  if Nat.leb (length a) 1%nat
  then true
  else
    match a with
    | [] => true
    | first :: rest => isSorted_scan first rest
    end.

Definition isSorted_postcond
    (a : list Z)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : isSorted_precond a) : Prop :=
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < length a - 1)%nat ->
      nth i a 0%Z <= nth (S i) a 0%Z) <->
  result = true.

Theorem isSorted_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (h_precond : isSorted_precond a) :
  isSorted_postcond a (isSorted a h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_19,
  catalog title "isSorted": an executable integer-array program returns true
  exactly when every adjacent pair is in non-decreasing order, together with
  its trivial precondition, Boolean postcondition, and correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_19
  imports Main
begin

definition isSorted_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isSorted_precond a \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition isSorted_mapIdx :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool list" where
  "isSorted_mapIdx a =
    map
      (\<lambda>(i, x).
        if i + 1 < length a
        then x \<le> a ! (i + 1)
        else True)
      (zip [0..<length a] a)"

definition isSorted :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isSorted a =
    (if length a \<le> 1
     then True
     else list_all id (isSorted_mapIdx a))"

definition isSorted_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isSorted_postcond a result \<longleftrightarrow>
    ((\<forall>i<length a - 1. a ! i \<le> a ! (i + 1)) \<longleftrightarrow> result)"

theorem isSorted_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "isSorted_precond a"
  shows "isSorted_postcond a (isSorted a)"
  sorry

end

  catalog title "isSorted": an executable Boolean check determines whether an
  integer array is nondecreasing, with its total precondition and exact
  adjacent-pair correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let isSorted =

    `(isSorted ([]:int list) = T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.

        if xs = [] then T
        else x <= HD xs /\ isSorted xs)`;;

  `!a:int list.
     isSorted_precond a
     ==> isSorted_postcond a (isSorted a)`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_19,
;; catalog title "isSorted": a deterministic integer-array program returns
;; true exactly when every adjacent pair is in nondecreasing order. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2 proper lists of integers represent exactly the finite Array Int inputs.

(defun verina-basic-19-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-19-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int binder domain remains
;; explicit in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-basic-19-is-sorted-precond (a)
  (declare (ignore a))
  t)

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant.
;; This recursion returns true for arrays of length at most one and otherwise
;; performs the same adjacent comparisons as mapIdx followed by all id.

(defun verina-basic-19-is-sorted (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (or
       (endp a)
       (endp (cdr a)))
      t
    (and
     (<= (car a) (cadr a))
     (verina-basic-19-is-sorted (cdr a)))))

(defun verina-basic-19-bool-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result t)
   (equal result nil)))

;; NFIX of an integer difference is Lean's truncated Nat subtraction.

(defun verina-basic-19-nat-sub (left right)
  (if (and
       (natp left)
       (natp right))
      (nfix (- left right))
    0))

;; This preserves the source postcondition's universal Nat index binder and
;; the bound i < a.size - 1.

(defun-sk verina-basic-19-every-adjacent-pair-nondecreasing-p (a)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i
         (verina-basic-19-nat-sub
          (len a)
          1)))
     (<= (nth i a)
         (nth (+ i 1) a)))))

(defun verina-basic-19-is-sorted-postcond (a result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-19-int-array-p a)
   (verina-basic-19-bool-p result)
   (iff
    (verina-basic-19-every-adjacent-pair-nondecreasing-p a)
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It preserves
;; the arbitrary Array Int input and True precondition, and applies the
;; complete biconditional postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk verina-basic-19-is-sorted-spec-satisfied-statement ()
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-19-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-19-is-sorted-precond a))
     (verina-basic-19-is-sorted-postcond
      a
      (verina-basic-19-is-sorted a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_19
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_19,
-- catalog title "isSorted": a deterministic integer-array scan returns true
-- exactly when every adjacent pair is nondecreasing and is connected to its
-- correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic19 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

infix 2 _↔_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_
infixr 5 _&&_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && other = other
false && other = false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

isSorted-scan : Array Int → Bool
isSorted-scan [] = true
isSorted-scan (x ∷ []) = true
isSorted-scan (x ∷ y ∷ rest) =
  intLessOrEqual x y && isSorted-scan (y ∷ rest)

isSorted-precond : Array Int → Set
isSorted-precond a = Top

isSorted :
  (a : Array Int) →
  isSorted-precond a →
  Bool
isSorted a h-precond = isSorted-scan a

isSorted-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (result : Bool) →
  isSorted-precond a →
  Set
isSorted-postcond a result h-precond =
  ((i : Nat) →
    i < (arraySize a - one) →
    IntLessOrEqual
      (indexDefault zeroInt a i)
      (indexDefault zeroInt a (i + one)))
  ↔ IsTrue result

isSorted-spec-satisfied : Set
isSorted-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : isSorted-precond a) →
  isSorted-postcond
    a
    (isSorted a h-precond)
    h-precond

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_19,
  catalog title "isSorted": the executable Boolean program checks every
  adjacent pair of an integer array for non-decreasing order, together with
  its unconditional correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory rich_listTheory;

val isSorted_precond_def = new_definition (

  ``isSorted_precond (a : int list) <=> T``

val isSorted_indexCheck_def = new_definition (
  "isSorted_indexCheck_def",
  ``isSorted_indexCheck (a : int list) (i : num) =
      if i + 1 < LENGTH a then
        EL i a <= EL (i + 1) a
      else
        T``
);

val isSorted_def = new_definition (
  "isSorted_def",
  ``isSorted (a : int list) =
      if LENGTH a <= 1 then
        T
      else
        EVERY
          (isSorted_indexCheck a)
          (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH a))``
);

val isSorted_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "isSorted_postcond_def",
  ``isSorted_postcond (a : int list) (result : bool) <=>
      ((!i : num.
          i < LENGTH a - 1 ==>
          EL i a <= EL (i + 1) a) <=>
       result)``
);

val isSorted_spec_satisfied =
  ``!a : int list.
      isSorted_precond a ==>
      isSorted_postcond a (isSorted a)``;
