title: verina_basic_22
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
   catalog title "dissimilarElements": an executable integer-array program
   computes the sorted duplicate-free symmetric difference of two arrays,
   together with its unconditional precondition, full postcondition, and final
   correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint inArray (a : list Z) (x : Z) : bool :=
  match a with
  | [] => false
  | y :: ys =>
      if Z.eqb y x then true else inArray ys x
  end.

Definition dissimilarElements_precond
    (_a _b : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition dissimilarElements_set_insert
    (acc : list Z) (x : Z) : list Z :=
  if inArray acc x then acc else x :: acc.

Definition dissimilarElements_collect
    (other acc : list Z) (x : Z) : list Z :=
  if negb (inArray other x)
  then dissimilarElements_set_insert acc x
  else acc.

Fixpoint dissimilarElements_sorted_insert
    (x : Z) (sorted : list Z) : list Z :=
  match sorted with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if Z.leb x y
      then x :: y :: ys
      else y :: dissimilarElements_sorted_insert x ys
  end.

Fixpoint dissimilarElements_sort
    (values : list Z) : list Z :=
  match values with
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs =>
      dissimilarElements_sorted_insert
        x (dissimilarElements_sort xs)
  end.

Definition dissimilarElements
    (a b : list Z)
    (_h_precond : dissimilarElements_precond a b) : list Z :=
  let from_a :=
    fold_left (dissimilarElements_collect b) a [] in
  let from_both :=
    fold_left (dissimilarElements_collect a) b from_a in
  dissimilarElements_sort from_both.

Fixpoint dissimilarElements_pairwise_le
    (values : list Z) : Prop :=
  match values with
  | [] => True
  | x :: xs =>
      Forall (fun y => (x <= y)%Z) xs /\
      dissimilarElements_pairwise_le xs
  end.

Definition dissimilarElements_postcond
    (a b result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : dissimilarElements_precond a b) : Prop :=
  Forall (fun x => inArray a x <> inArray b x) result /\
  dissimilarElements_pairwise_le result /\
  NoDup result /\
  Forall
    (fun x =>
      if inArray b x
      then ~ In x result
      else In x result)
    a /\
  Forall
    (fun x =>
      if inArray a x
      then ~ In x result
      else In x result)
    b.

Theorem dissimilarElements_spec_satisfied
    (a b : list Z)
    (h_precond : dissimilarElements_precond a b) :
  dissimilarElements_postcond
    a b (dissimilarElements a b h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_22
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_22), catalog title "dissimilarElements":
  an executable integer-array program returns the sorted duplicate-free
  symmetric difference of two arrays, together with its unconditional
  precondition, full postcondition, and final correctness proposition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_22
  imports Main
begin

definition inArray :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "inArray a x \<longleftrightarrow> x \<in> set a"

definition dissimilarElements_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "dissimilarElements_precond a b \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition dissimilarElements_collect ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "dissimilarElements_collect other acc x =
    (if \<not> inArray other x
     then if x \<in> set acc then acc else x # acc
     else acc)"

fun dissimilarElements_insert ::
    "int \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "dissimilarElements_insert x [] = [x]"
| "dissimilarElements_insert x (y # ys) =
    (if x \<le> y
     then x # y # ys
     else y # dissimilarElements_insert x ys)"

fun dissimilarElements_sort :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "dissimilarElements_sort [] = []"
| "dissimilarElements_sort (x # xs) =
    dissimilarElements_insert x (dissimilarElements_sort xs)"

definition dissimilarElements ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "dissimilarElements a b =
    (let fromA =
       foldl (dissimilarElements_collect b) [] a;
         fromBoth =
       foldl (dissimilarElements_collect a) fromA b
     in dissimilarElements_sort fromBoth)"

fun dissimilarElements_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "dissimilarElements_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "dissimilarElements_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     dissimilarElements_pairwise_le xs)"

definition dissimilarElements_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "dissimilarElements_postcond a b result \<longleftrightarrow>
    list_all (\<lambda>x. inArray a x \<noteq> inArray b x) result \<and>
    dissimilarElements_pairwise_le result \<and>
    distinct result \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x. if x \<in> set b
        then x \<notin> set result
        else x \<in> set result)
      a \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x. if x \<in> set a
        then x \<notin> set result
        else x \<in> set result)
      b"

theorem dissimilarElements_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "dissimilarElements_precond a b"
  shows
    "dissimilarElements_postcond a b (dissimilarElements a b)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_22
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
  catalog title "dissimilarElements": a deterministic integer-array program
  returns the sorted duplicate-free symmetric difference of two arrays,
  together with its full membership and ordering contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let dissimilarElements_inArray = new_definition
  `dissimilarElements_inArray (a:int list) (x:int) <=> MEM x a`;;

let dissimilarElements_precond = new_definition
  `dissimilarElements_precond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) <=> T`;;

let dissimilarElements_setInsert = new_definition
  `dissimilarElements_setInsert
      (x:int) (set:int list) =
     if dissimilarElements_inArray set x then set
     else CONS x set`;;

let dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!other:int list. !set:int list.
        dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar
          ([]:int list) other set =
        set) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !other:int list. !set:int list.
        dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar
          (CONS x xs) other set =
        dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar
          xs other
          (if dissimilarElements_inArray other x then set
           else dissimilarElements_setInsert x set))`;;

let dissimilarElements_insertSorted =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(dissimilarElements_insertSorted
        (x:int) ([]:int list) =
      CONS x []) /\
     (!y:int. !ys:int list. !x:int.
        dissimilarElements_insertSorted x (CONS y ys) =
        if x <= y then CONS x (CONS y ys)
        else
          CONS y
            (dissimilarElements_insertSorted x ys))`;;

let dissimilarElements_sort =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(dissimilarElements_sort ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        dissimilarElements_sort (CONS x xs) =
        dissimilarElements_insertSorted
          x (dissimilarElements_sort xs))`;;

let dissimilarElements = new_definition
  `dissimilarElements (a:int list) (b:int list) =
     let fromA =
       dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar a b [] in
     let fromB =
       dissimilarElements_foldDissimilar b a fromA in
     dissimilarElements_sort fromB`;;

let dissimilarElements_allMembershipsDiffer =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list. !b:int list.
        dissimilarElements_allMembershipsDiffer
          ([]:int list) a b <=>
        T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !a:int list. !b:int list.
        dissimilarElements_allMembershipsDiffer
          (CONS x xs) a b <=>
        ~(dissimilarElements_inArray a x <=>
          dissimilarElements_inArray b x) /\
        dissimilarElements_allMembershipsDiffer xs a b)`;;

let dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!other:int list. !result:int list.
        dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage
          ([]:int list) other result <=>
        T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !other:int list. !result:int list.
        dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage
          (CONS x xs) other result <=>
        (if dissimilarElements_inArray other x
         then ~dissimilarElements_inArray result x
         else dissimilarElements_inArray result x) /\
        dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage
          xs other result)`;;

let dissimilarElements_noDuplicates =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(dissimilarElements_noDuplicates ([]:int list) <=> T) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list.
        dissimilarElements_noDuplicates (CONS x xs) <=>
        ~dissimilarElements_inArray xs x /\
        dissimilarElements_noDuplicates xs)`;;

let dissimilarElements_postcond = new_definition
  `dissimilarElements_postcond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     dissimilarElements_allMembershipsDiffer result a b /\
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) result /\
     dissimilarElements_noDuplicates result /\
     dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage a b result /\
     dissimilarElements_directionalCoverage b a result`;;

let dissimilarElements_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !b:int list.
     dissimilarElements_precond a b
     ==> dissimilarElements_postcond
           a b (dissimilarElements a b)`;;

title: verina_basic_22
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
;; catalog title "dissimilarElements": a deterministic integer-array program
;; returns the sorted duplicate-free symmetric difference of two arrays,
;; together with its full membership and ordering contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2 proper lists of integers represent exactly the finite Array Int inputs
;; and output.

(defun verina-basic-22-int-array-p (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (and
       (integerp (car arr))
       (verina-basic-22-int-array-p (cdr arr)))
    (equal arr nil)))

;; This is the source inArray helper: Array.any with integer equality, returned
;; as an ACL2 Boolean.

(defun verina-basic-22-in-array (arr x)
  (if (member-equal x arr)
      t
    nil))

;; The source precondition is True. Both Array Int domains remain explicit in
;; the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements-precond (a b)
  (declare (ignore a b))
  t)

;; A duplicate-free ACL2 list represents the source HashSet extensionally.
;; HashSet.insert changes exactly the represented membership when the value is
;; fresh; its internal bucket order is unobservable before the final sort.

(defun verina-basic-22-set-insert (x set)
  (if (verina-basic-22-in-array set x)
      set
    (cons x set)))

;; This is one source Array.foldl. Each value absent from OTHER is inserted
;; into SET, while a value present in OTHER leaves SET unchanged.

(defun verina-basic-22-fold-dissimilar
    (remaining other set)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((x (car remaining)))
        (verina-basic-22-fold-dissimilar
         (cdr remaining)
         other
         (if (verina-basic-22-in-array other x)
             set
           (verina-basic-22-set-insert x set))))
    set))

;; Insertion sorting is extensionally identical to the source mergeSort here:
;; both return the unique nondecreasing permutation of the HashSet contents.

(defun verina-basic-22-insert-sorted (x sorted)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sorted)))
  (if (consp sorted)
      (if (<= x (car sorted))
          (cons x sorted)
        (cons
         (car sorted)
         (verina-basic-22-insert-sorted
          x
          (cdr sorted))))
    (list x)))

(defun verina-basic-22-sort (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (verina-basic-22-insert-sorted
       (car xs)
       (verina-basic-22-sort (cdr xs)))
    nil))

;; These two folds are the exact executable program after erasing the
;; proof-valued True precondition argument. The first adds values unique to A;
;; the second adds values unique to B; the final sort canonically fixes order.

(defun verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements (a b)
  (let* ((from-a
          (verina-basic-22-fold-dissimilar
           a
           b
           nil))
         (from-b
          (verina-basic-22-fold-dissimilar
           b
           a
           from-a)))
    (verina-basic-22-sort from-b)))

;; This is result.all (fun x => inArray a x != inArray b x).

(defun verina-basic-22-all-memberships-differ-p
    (result a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count result)))
  (if (consp result)
      (and
       (not
        (equal
         (verina-basic-22-in-array a (car result))
         (verina-basic-22-in-array b (car result))))
       (verina-basic-22-all-memberships-differ-p
        (cdr result)
        a
        b))
    (equal result nil)))

;; List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y) requires each head to be at most every
;; later element, recursively.

(defun verina-basic-22-head-at-most-all-p (x xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (<= x (car xs))
       (verina-basic-22-head-at-most-all-p
        x
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun verina-basic-22-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (verina-basic-22-head-at-most-all-p
        (car xs)
        (cdr xs))
       (verina-basic-22-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; This is List.Nodup.

(defun verina-basic-22-no-duplicates-p (xs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count xs)))
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not
        (verina-basic-22-in-array
         (cdr xs)
         (car xs)))
       (verina-basic-22-no-duplicates-p
        (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

;; For every element of SOURCE, this preserves the source conditional:
;; membership in OTHER implies absence from RESULT, and nonmembership in
;; OTHER implies membership in RESULT.

(defun verina-basic-22-directional-coverage-p
    (source other result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count source)))
  (if (consp source)
      (and
       (if (verina-basic-22-in-array other (car source))
           (not
            (verina-basic-22-in-array
             result
             (car source)))
         (verina-basic-22-in-array
          result
          (car source)))
       (verina-basic-22-directional-coverage-p
        (cdr source)
        other
        result))
    (equal source nil)))

(defun verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements-postcond
    (a b result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-22-int-array-p a)
   (verina-basic-22-int-array-p b)
   (verina-basic-22-int-array-p result)
   (verina-basic-22-all-memberships-differ-p
    result
    a
    b)
   (verina-basic-22-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
    result)
   (verina-basic-22-no-duplicates-p
    result)
   (verina-basic-22-directional-coverage-p
    a
    b
    result)
   (verina-basic-22-directional-coverage-p
    b
    a
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It preserves
;; arbitrary Array Int inputs and the True precondition, and applies the full
;; postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-22-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-22-int-array-p b)
      (verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements-precond a b))
     (verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements-postcond
      a
      b
      (verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements a b)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_22
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
-- catalog title "dissimilarElements": a deterministic integer-array program
-- computes the sorted duplicate-free symmetric difference and is connected to
-- its full membership, ordering, uniqueness, and coverage contract. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic22 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _∈_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

chooseSet : Bool → Set → Set → Set
chooseSet true when-true when-false = when-true
chooseSet false when-true when-false = when-false

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLessOrEqual n m

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

inArray : Array Int → Int → Bool
inArray [] sought = false
inArray (x ∷ xs) sought =
  if intEqual x sought
  then true
  else inArray xs sought

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

insertDistinct : List Int → Int → List Int
insertDistinct accumulator x =
  if inArray accumulator x
  then accumulator
  else (x ∷ accumulator)

dissimilarStep : Array Int → List Int → Int → List Int
dissimilarStep excluded accumulator x =
  if notBool (inArray excluded x)
  then insertDistinct accumulator x
  else accumulator

insertSorted : Int → List Int → List Int
insertSorted x [] = x ∷ []
insertSorted x (y ∷ ys) =
  if intLessOrEqual x y
  then (x ∷ y ∷ ys)
  else (y ∷ insertSorted x ys)

sortList : List Int → List Int
sortList [] = []
sortList (x ∷ xs) = insertSorted x (sortList xs)

dissimilarElements-precond :
  Array Int → Array Int → Set
dissimilarElements-precond a b = Top

dissimilarElements :
  (a b : Array Int) →
  dissimilarElements-precond a b →
  Array Int
dissimilarElements a b h-precond =
  sortList
    (foldLeft
      (dissimilarStep a)
      (foldLeft (dissimilarStep b) [] a)
      b)

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

data _∈_ (x : Int) : List Int → Set where
  here : {xs : List Int} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there :
    {y : Int} {xs : List Int} →
    x ∈ xs →
    x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

NoDuplicates : List Int → Set
NoDuplicates [] = Top
NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs) =
  Not (x ∈ xs) ∧ NoDuplicates xs

dissimilarElements-postcond :
  (a b : Array Int) →
  (result : Array Int) →
  dissimilarElements-precond a b →
  Set
dissimilarElements-postcond a b result h-precond =
  All
    (λ x → Not (inArray a x ≡ inArray b x))
    result ∧
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual result ∧
  NoDuplicates result ∧
  All
    (λ x →
      chooseSet
        (inArray b x)
        (Not (x ∈ result))
        (x ∈ result))
    a ∧
  All
    (λ x →
      chooseSet
        (inArray a x)
        (Not (x ∈ result))
        (x ∈ result))
    b

dissimilarElements-spec-satisfied : Set
dissimilarElements-spec-satisfied =
  (a b : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : dissimilarElements-precond a b) →
  dissimilarElements-postcond
    a
    b
    (dissimilarElements a b h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_22
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
  catalog title "dissimilarElements": the executable set-accumulation and
  sorting program returns the sorted, duplicate-free symmetric difference of
  two integer arrays and satisfies the source postcondition. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open integerTheory listTheory;

val dissimilarElements_inArray_def = new_definition (
  "dissimilarElements_inArray_def",
  ``dissimilarElements_inArray
      (a : int list) (x : int) =
      MEM x a``
);

val dissimilarElements_precond_def = new_definition (
  "dissimilarElements_precond_def",
  ``dissimilarElements_precond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) <=>
      T``
);

val dissimilarElements_setInsert_def = new_definition (
  "dissimilarElements_setInsert_def",
  ``dissimilarElements_setInsert
      (x : int) (acc : int list) =
      if MEM x acc then acc else x::acc``
);

val dissimilarElements_collect_def = Define `
  (dissimilarElements_collect
      ([] : int list)
      (other : int list)
      (acc : int list) =
     acc) /\
  (dissimilarElements_collect
      (x::xs)
      other
      acc =
     dissimilarElements_collect
       xs
       other
       (if ~dissimilarElements_inArray other x then
          dissimilarElements_setInsert x acc
        else
          acc))
`;

val dissimilarElements_sortInsert_def = Define `
  (dissimilarElements_sortInsert
      (x : int) ([] : int list) =
     [x]) /\
  (dissimilarElements_sortInsert
      x (y::ys) =
     if x <= y then
       x::y::ys
     else
       y::dissimilarElements_sortInsert x ys)
`;

val dissimilarElements_sort_def = Define `
  (dissimilarElements_sort
      ([] : int list) =
     ([] : int list)) /\
  (dissimilarElements_sort
      (x::xs) =
     dissimilarElements_sortInsert
       x (dissimilarElements_sort xs))
`;

val dissimilarElements_def = new_definition (
  "dissimilarElements_def",
  ``dissimilarElements
      (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      let fromA =
        dissimilarElements_collect a b []
      in
      let fromBoth =
        dissimilarElements_collect b a fromA
      in
        dissimilarElements_sort fromBoth``
);

val dissimilarElements_pairwiseLe_def = Define `
  (dissimilarElements_pairwiseLe
      ([] : int list) <=>
     T) /\
  (dissimilarElements_pairwiseLe
      (x::xs) <=>
     EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
     dissimilarElements_pairwiseLe xs)
`;

val dissimilarElements_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "dissimilarElements_postcond_def",
  ``dissimilarElements_postcond
      (a : int list)
      (b : int list)
      (result : int list) <=>
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
           dissimilarElements_inArray a x <>
           dissimilarElements_inArray b x)
        result /\
      dissimilarElements_pairwiseLe result /\
      ALL_DISTINCT result /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
           if MEM x b then
             ~MEM x result
           else
             MEM x result)
        a /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
           if MEM x a then
             ~MEM x result
           else
             MEM x result)
        b``
);

val dissimilarElements_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (b : int list).
      dissimilarElements_precond a b ==>
      dissimilarElements_postcond
        a b (dissimilarElements a b)``;

title: verina_basic_22
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_22), catalog title dissimilarElements: the
  exact two-pass hash-set computation returns the sorted duplicate-free
  symmetric difference of two arbitrary finite integer arrays and satisfies
  its complete correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer arrays and lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, ran w is its entry set,
  and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid-index set. Booleans are represented
  by zero and one.

  VERINAB22InArray is the source helper a.any (fun y => y = x), represented
  by its exact Boolean membership value. A hash set is represented
  extensionally by a duplicate-free integer word. VERINAB22HashInsert keeps
  that word when the value is already present and otherwise prepends the new
  value, which has exactly the source Std.HashSet.insert membership semantics.
  VERINAB22FoldGraph records every state of the source left-to-right fold:
  values present in the other array leave the accumulator unchanged, and all
  other values are inserted. The initial emptyWithCapacity set is the empty
  word. Capacity and bucket layout are unobservable.

  VERINAB22ToList chooses the canonical word representative of the final hash
  set. The source HashSet.toList can differ from this representative only by
  a permutation. VERINAB22MergeSortGraph characterizes the unique
  nondecreasing word with the same integer multiplicities, so sorting either
  representative gives exactly the same result as the source
  List.mergeSort (fun x y => x <= y). VERINAB22DissimilarElements composes
  the first fold over a against b, the second fold over b against a, toList,
  and mergeSort. Its output is therefore fixed by the executable computation
  independently of the postcondition.

  VERINAB22Pre is the source True precondition on the two typed Array Int
  inputs. VERINAB22PairwiseLE and VERINAB22Nodup reproduce List.Pairwise
  (fun x y => x <= y) and List.Nodup. VERINAB22Post preserves all five source
  conjuncts: every result entry has unequal inArray Booleans, the result is
  nondecreasing and duplicate-free, and each occurrence in either input is
  included exactly when it is absent from the other input. The proof-valued
  precondition argument is computationally and propositionally unused and is
  represented by the explicit antecedent in the final correctness assertion.
  Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by this
  rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB22InArray
  VERINAB22HashInsert
  VERINAB22FoldGraph VERINAB22Fold
  VERINAB22ToList
  VERINAB22MergeSortGraph VERINAB22MergeSort
  VERINAB22Pre VERINAB22DissimilarElements
  VERINAB22PairwiseLE VERINAB22Nodup VERINAB22Post
$.

verinab22-in-array-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22InArray A B ) $.
verinab22-hash-insert-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22HashInsert A B ) $.
verinab22-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22FoldGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab22-fold-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22Fold A B C ) $.
verinab22-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22ToList A ) $.
verinab22-merge-sort-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22MergeSortGraph A B ) $.
verinab22-merge-sort-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22MergeSort A ) $.
verinab22-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22Pre A B ) $.
verinab22-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB22DissimilarElements A B ) $.
verinab22-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab22-nodup-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22Nodup A ) $.
verinab22-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB22Post A B C ) $.

verinab22-in-array-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB22InArray A B
) = if (
  B e. ran A ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verinab22-hash-insert-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB22HashInsert A B
) = if (
  B e. ran A ,
  A ,
  ( <" B "> ++ A )
) $.

${
  $d k t A B C D $.

  verinab22-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22FoldGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. Word ZZ
        )
        /\
        C e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      D e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = C
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              (
                VERINAB22InArray
                  B
                  ( A ` k )
              ) = 1 ,
              ( t ` k ) ,
              (
                VERINAB22HashInsert
                  ( t ` k )
                  ( A ` k )
              )
            )
          /\
          D = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab22-fold-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22Fold A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB22FoldGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab22-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB22ToList A
) = A $.

${
  $d i j x A B $.

  verinab22-merge-sort-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22MergeSortGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( B ` i ) <_ ( B ` j )
          )
      /\
      A. x e. ZZ
        (
          # ` {
            i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            |
            ( A ` i ) = x
          }
        ) = (
          # ` {
            j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            |
            ( B ` j ) = x
          }
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab22-merge-sort-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22MergeSort A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB22MergeSortGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab22-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB22Pre A B
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  B e. Word ZZ
) $.

verinab22-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB22DissimilarElements A B
) = (
  VERINAB22MergeSort
    (
      VERINAB22ToList
        (
          VERINAB22Fold
            B
            A
            (
              VERINAB22Fold
                A
                B
                (/)
            )
        )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab22-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22PairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab22-nodup-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22Nodup A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i =/= j
          ->
          ( A ` i ) =/= ( A ` j )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab22-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB22Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          VERINAB22InArray
            A
            ( C ` i )
        ) =/= (
          VERINAB22InArray
            B
            ( C ` i )
        )
      /\
      (
        ( VERINAB22PairwiseLE C )
        /\
        (
          ( VERINAB22Nodup C )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                (
                  ( A ` i ) e. ran B
                  ->
                  ( A ` i ) e/ ran C
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( A ` i ) e/ ran B
                  ->
                  ( A ` i ) e. ran C
                )
              )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              (
                (
                  ( B ` i ) e. ran A
                  ->
                  ( B ` i ) e/ ran C
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( B ` i ) e/ ran A
                  ->
                  ( B ` i ) e. ran C
                )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-22-dissimilar-elements $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
  A. b e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINAB22Pre a b )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB22Post
          a
          b
          ( VERINAB22DissimilarElements a b )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_basic_22
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_22, catalog title "dissimilarElements": the unconditional
:: precondition, exact two-pass hash-set insertion and increasing-sort
:: implementation, symmetric-difference postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, FINSET_1, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN, MCART_1,
    XTUPLE_0;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0,
    ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0,
    XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b,result being FinSequence of INT st
    0 = 0 &
    (ex inArray being Function of [:INT*,INT:],BOOLEAN,
        firstStates,secondStates being FinSequence of bool INT,
        res1,res2 being finite Subset of INT st
      (for xs being FinSequence of INT, x being Integer holds
        ((x in rng xs &
            inArray/.[xs,x] = TRUE) or
         (not x in rng xs &
            inArray/.[xs,x] = FALSE))) &
      len firstStates = len a + 1 &
      firstStates/.1 = {} &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom a holds
        ((inArray/.[b,a/.k] = TRUE &
            firstStates/.(k + 1) = firstStates/.k) or
         (inArray/.[b,a/.k] = FALSE &
            firstStates/.(k + 1) =
              firstStates/.k \/ {a/.k}))) &
      res1 = firstStates/.(len a + 1) &
      len secondStates = len b + 1 &
      secondStates/.1 = res1 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom b holds
        ((inArray/.[a,b/.k] = TRUE &
            secondStates/.(k + 1) = secondStates/.k) or
         (inArray/.[a,b/.k] = FALSE &
            secondStates/.(k + 1) =
              secondStates/.k \/ {b/.k}))) &
      res2 = secondStates/.(len b + 1) &
      rng result = res2 &
      result is one-to-one &
      (for i,j being Nat st
        i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
      holds result/.i <= result/.j))
  holds
    (for x being Integer st x in rng result holds
      ((x in rng a & not x in rng b) or
       (not x in rng a & x in rng b))) &
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
    holds result/.i <= result/.j) &
    result is one-to-one &
    (for x being Integer st x in rng a holds
      ((x in rng b & not x in rng result) or
       (not x in rng b & x in rng result))) &
    (for x being Integer st x in rng b holds
      ((x in rng a & not x in rng result) or
       (not x in rng a & x in rng result)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_22
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_22,
% catalog title "dissimilarElements": computing the sorted duplicate-free
% symmetric difference of two finite integer arrays with the exact executable
% program and its correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_22: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve the exact contents and order of Lean arrays.
  inArray(
      a: list[int],
      x: int): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES a OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = x OR inArray(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE a BY <<

  % This duplicate-free list is an extensional representation of the integer
  % HashSet used by the source program.
  set_insert(
      accumulator: list[int],
      x: int): list[int] =
    IF inArray(accumulator, x) THEN
      accumulator
    ELSE
      cons(x, accumulator)
    ENDIF

  dissimilar_fold(
      remaining, other, accumulator: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        dissimilar_fold(
          tail,
          other,
          IF NOT inArray(other, head) THEN
            set_insert(accumulator, head)
          ELSE
            accumulator
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  sorted_insert(
      x: int,
      sorted_values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES sorted_values OF
      null:
        cons(x, null[int]),
      cons(head, tail):
        IF x <= head THEN
          cons(x, cons(head, tail))
        ELSE
          cons(head, sorted_insert(x, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE sorted_values BY <<

  insertion_sort(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        sorted_insert(head, insertion_sort(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  dissimilarElements_precond(
      a, b: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % set_insert has exactly HashSet insertion semantics for integers. Sorting
  % its duplicate-free result makes HashSet.toList iteration order irrelevant,
  % and insertion_sort returns the same nondecreasing integer sequence as the
  % source mergeSort.
  dissimilarElements(
      a, b: list[int]): list[int] =
    insertion_sort(
      dissimilar_fold(
        b,
        a,
        dissimilar_fold(
          a,
          b,
          null[int])))

  result_elements_dissimilar(
      result, a, b: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES result OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        inArray(a, head) /= inArray(b, head)
          AND result_elements_dissimilar(tail, a, b)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE result BY <<

  all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicates(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT inArray(tail, head)
          AND no_duplicates(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  source_membership_contract(
      source, other, result: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES source OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF inArray(other, head) THEN
           NOT inArray(result, head)
         ELSE
           inArray(result, head)
         ENDIF)
          AND source_membership_contract(
                tail,
                other,
                result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE source BY <<

  dissimilarElements_postcond(
      a, b, result: list[int]): bool =
    result_elements_dissimilar(result, a, b)
      AND pairwise_nondecreasing(result)
      AND no_duplicates(result)
      AND source_membership_contract(a, b, result)
      AND source_membership_contract(b, a, result)

  dissimilarElements_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: list[int]):
      dissimilarElements_precond(a, b)
        IMPLIES
          dissimilarElements_postcond(
            a,
            b,
            dissimilarElements(a, b))

END verina_basic_22

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
   catalog title "differenceMinMax": an executable scan of a nonempty integer
   array returns the difference between its maximum and minimum, together with
   its fold-based postcondition and final correctness proposition. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition differenceMinMax_precond (a : list Z) : Prop :=
  (0 < length a)%nat.

Definition differenceMinMax_min_step (acc x : Z) : Z :=
  if Z.ltb x acc then x else acc.

Definition differenceMinMax_max_step (acc x : Z) : Z :=
  if Z.ltb acc x then x else acc.

Fixpoint differenceMinMax_loop
    (remaining : list Z)
    (minVal maxVal : Z) : Z :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => maxVal - minVal
  | x :: xs =>
      let newMin := differenceMinMax_min_step minVal x in
      let newMax := differenceMinMax_max_step maxVal x in
      differenceMinMax_loop xs newMin newMax
  end.

Definition differenceMinMax
    (a : list Z)
    (_h_precond : differenceMinMax_precond a) : Z :=
  match a with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: xs => differenceMinMax_loop xs x x
  end.

Definition differenceMinMax_postcond
    (a : list Z)
    (result : Z)
    (_h_precond : differenceMinMax_precond a) : Prop :=
  result +
    fold_left differenceMinMax_min_step a (hd 0%Z a) =
  fold_left differenceMinMax_max_step a (hd 0%Z a).

Theorem differenceMinMax_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (h_precond : differenceMinMax_precond a) :
  differenceMinMax_postcond
    a (differenceMinMax a h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_23), catalog title "differenceMinMax":
  an executable nonempty integer-array scan initializes from the first value,
  tracks the running minimum and maximum, and returns their difference,
  together with its fold-based postcondition and final correctness
  proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_23
  imports Main
begin

definition differenceMinMax_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "differenceMinMax_precond a \<longleftrightarrow> length a > 0"

definition differenceMinMax_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "differenceMinMax_getBang a i =
    (if i < length a then a ! i else 0)"

fun differenceMinMax_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "differenceMinMax_loop 0 a i minVal maxVal = maxVal - minVal"
| "differenceMinMax_loop (Suc fuel) a i minVal maxVal =
    (if i < length a then
       (let x = differenceMinMax_getBang a i;
            newMin = (if x < minVal then x else minVal);
            newMax = (if x > maxVal then x else maxVal)
        in differenceMinMax_loop fuel a (i + 1) newMin newMax)
     else maxVal - minVal)"

definition differenceMinMax :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "differenceMinMax a =
    differenceMinMax_loop
      (length a) a 1
      (differenceMinMax_getBang a 0)
      (differenceMinMax_getBang a 0)"

definition differenceMinMax_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "differenceMinMax_postcond a result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result +
      foldl
        (\<lambda>acc x. if x < acc then x else acc)
        (differenceMinMax_getBang a 0) a =
    foldl
      (\<lambda>acc x. if x > acc then x else acc)
      (differenceMinMax_getBang a 0) a"

theorem differenceMinMax_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "differenceMinMax_precond a"
  shows "differenceMinMax_postcond a (differenceMinMax a)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_23
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
  catalog title "differenceMinMax": an executable scan of a nonempty integer
  array returns its maximum minus its minimum, with the exact accumulator-fold
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let differenceMinMax_precond = new_definition
  `differenceMinMax_precond (a:int list) <=>
     ~(a = [])`;;

let differenceMinMax_loop =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!minVal:int. !maxVal:int.
        differenceMinMax_loop
          ([]:int list) minVal maxVal =
        maxVal - minVal) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !minVal:int. !maxVal:int.
        differenceMinMax_loop
          (CONS x xs) minVal maxVal =
        let newMin =
          if x < minVal then x else minVal in
        let newMax =
          if x > maxVal then x else maxVal in
        differenceMinMax_loop xs newMin newMax)`;;

let differenceMinMax = new_definition
  `differenceMinMax (a:int list) =
     if a = [] then
       (&0:int)
     else
       differenceMinMax_loop (TL a) (HD a) (HD a)`;;

let differenceMinMax_foldMin =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        differenceMinMax_foldMin ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        differenceMinMax_foldMin (CONS x xs) acc =
        differenceMinMax_foldMin
          xs (if x < acc then x else acc))`;;

let differenceMinMax_foldMax =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int.
        differenceMinMax_foldMax ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int.
        differenceMinMax_foldMax (CONS x xs) acc =
        differenceMinMax_foldMax
          xs (if x > acc then x else acc))`;;

let differenceMinMax_postcond = new_definition
  `differenceMinMax_postcond
      (a:int list) (result:int) <=>
     let initial = if a = [] then (&0:int) else HD a in
     result + differenceMinMax_foldMin a initial =
     differenceMinMax_foldMax a initial`;;

let differenceMinMax_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list.
     differenceMinMax_precond a
     ==> differenceMinMax_postcond
           a (differenceMinMax a)`;;

title: verina_basic_23
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
;; catalog title "differenceMinMax": a deterministic nonempty integer-array
;; scan returns the maximum element minus the minimum element, with correctness
;; stated against independent minimum and maximum folds. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements are arbitrary integers.

(defun verina-basic-23-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-23-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; The source precondition a.size > 0 is exactly list nonemptiness.

(defun verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-precond (a)
  (< 0 (len a)))

;; The source local loop starts after the first element and carries the
;; smallest and largest values seen so far. Structural recursion over the
;; remaining suffix is the exact list representation of its increasing index.

(defun verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-loop
    (remaining min-value max-value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((x (car remaining))
             (new-min
              (if (< x min-value)
                  x
                min-value))
             (new-max
              (if (> x max-value)
                  x
                max-value)))
        (verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-loop
         (cdr remaining)
         new-min
         new-max))
    (- max-value min-value)))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and is
;; erased. On every source-valid input this initializes from a[0] and scans
;; exactly the entries at indices 1 through a.size - 1. The empty branch is
;; unreachable under the source precondition.

(defun verina-basic-23-difference-min-max (a)
  (if (consp a)
      (verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-loop
       (cdr a)
       (car a)
       (car a))
    0))

;; These two recursions independently reproduce the source Array.foldl
;; computations over the full array, including its first element.

(defun verina-basic-23-min-fold (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((x (car remaining)))
        (verina-basic-23-min-fold
         (cdr remaining)
         (if (< x accumulator)
             x
           accumulator)))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-basic-23-max-fold (remaining accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((x (car remaining)))
        (verina-basic-23-max-fold
         (cdr remaining)
         (if (> x accumulator)
             x
           accumulator)))
    accumulator))

;; The source postcondition states result + folded minimum = folded maximum.
;; Its proof-valued precondition argument is unused and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-postcond
    (a result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-23-int-array-p a)
   (integerp result)
   (equal
    (+ result
       (verina-basic-23-min-fold a (car a)))
    (verina-basic-23-max-fold a (car a)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It preserves
;; the arbitrary Array Int input and nonempty precondition, and applies the
;; complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-23-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-precond a))
     (verina-basic-23-difference-min-max-postcond
      a
      (verina-basic-23-difference-min-max a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_23
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
-- catalog title "differenceMinMax": a deterministic nonempty integer-array
-- scan returns the maximum minus the minimum and is connected to the fold-based
-- minimum/maximum correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic23 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

data NonEmpty {A : Set} : List A → Set where
  nonempty : {x : A} {xs : List A} → NonEmpty (x ∷ xs)

headDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → A
headDefault default [] = default
headDefault default (x ∷ xs) = x

foldLeft : {A B : Set} → (A → B → A) → A → List B → A
foldLeft step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldLeft step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldLeft step (step accumulator x) xs

minimumStep : Int → Int → Int
minimumStep accumulator x =
  if intLess x accumulator
  then x
  else accumulator

maximumStep : Int → Int → Int
maximumStep accumulator x =
  if intLess accumulator x
  then x
  else accumulator

differenceMinMax-loop : List Int → Int → Int → Int
differenceMinMax-loop [] minimum maximum =
  intSubtract maximum minimum
differenceMinMax-loop (x ∷ xs) minimum maximum =
  differenceMinMax-loop
    xs
    (minimumStep minimum x)
    (maximumStep maximum x)

differenceMinMax-precond : Array Int → Set
differenceMinMax-precond a = NonEmpty a

differenceMinMax :
  (a : Array Int) →
  differenceMinMax-precond a →
  Int
differenceMinMax [] ()
differenceMinMax (x ∷ xs) nonempty =
  differenceMinMax-loop xs x x

differenceMinMax-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  differenceMinMax-precond a →
  Set
differenceMinMax-postcond a result h-precond =
  intAdd
    result
    (foldLeft
      minimumStep
      (headDefault zeroInt a)
      a)
  ≡
  foldLeft
    maximumStep
    (headDefault zeroInt a)
    a

differenceMinMax-spec-satisfied : Set
differenceMinMax-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : differenceMinMax-precond a) →
  differenceMinMax-postcond
    a
    (differenceMinMax a h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
  catalog title "differenceMinMax": the executable indexed scan of a nonempty
  integer array returns its maximum value minus its minimum value and satisfies
  the corresponding fold-based correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val differenceMinMax_precond_def = new_definition (
  "differenceMinMax_precond_def",
  ``differenceMinMax_precond (a : int list) <=>
      LENGTH a > 0``
);

val differenceMinMax_nthD_def = Define `
  (differenceMinMax_nthD
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (differenceMinMax_nthD
      0 (x::xs) = x) /\
  (differenceMinMax_nthD
      (SUC index) (x::xs) =
     differenceMinMax_nthD index xs)
`;

val differenceMinMax_loopFuel_def = Define `
  (differenceMinMax_loopFuel
      (a : int list)
      (i : num)
      (minVal : int)
      (maxVal : int)
      0 =
     maxVal - minVal) /\
  (differenceMinMax_loopFuel
      a i minVal maxVal (SUC fuel) =
     if i < LENGTH a then
       let x = differenceMinMax_nthD i a in
       let newMin = if x < minVal then x else minVal in
       let newMax = if x > maxVal then x else maxVal in
         differenceMinMax_loopFuel
           a (i + 1) newMin newMax fuel
     else
       maxVal - minVal)
`;

val differenceMinMax_loop_def = new_definition (
  "differenceMinMax_loop_def",
  ``differenceMinMax_loop
      (a : int list)
      (i : num)
      (minVal : int)
      (maxVal : int) =
      differenceMinMax_loopFuel
        a i minVal maxVal (LENGTH a - i + 1)``
);

val differenceMinMax_def = new_definition (
  "differenceMinMax_def",
  ``differenceMinMax (a : int list) =
      let first = differenceMinMax_nthD 0 a in
        differenceMinMax_loop a 1 first first``
);

val differenceMinMax_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "differenceMinMax_postcond_def",
  ``differenceMinMax_postcond
      (a : int list) (result : int) <=>
      result +
        FOLDL
          (\acc : int. \x : int.
             if x < acc then x else acc)
          (differenceMinMax_nthD 0 a)
          a =
      FOLDL
        (\acc : int. \x : int.
           if x > acc then x else acc)
        (differenceMinMax_nthD 0 a)
        a``
);

val differenceMinMax_spec_satisfied =
  ``!a : int list.
      differenceMinMax_precond a ==>
      differenceMinMax_postcond a (differenceMinMax a)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_23), catalog title differenceMinMax: the
  exact recursive scan of a nonempty finite integer array returns its running
  maximum minus its running minimum and satisfies the independent fold-based
  minimum-and-maximum correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid-index set.

  VERINAB23GetBang reproduces Lean Array.get! on integer arrays, including
  its inhabited default value zero outside the array. VERINAB23NatSub is
  Lean's truncated natural subtraction. VERINAB23IntMin and
  VERINAB23IntMax are the source integer conditional minimum and maximum.

  VERINAB23LoopGraph is the exact complete execution trace of the source
  local recursive loop for every array, natural index, and pair of integer
  accumulators. The two trace words begin with minVal and maxVal. For each
  remaining valid array index they read the same get! value and perform the
  source's strict-comparison updates; when the index reaches or exceeds the
  array length, the graph returns final maxVal minus final minVal.
  VERINAB23Loop selects the unique result of this deterministic trace, and
  VERINAB23DifferenceMinMax invokes it at index one with both accumulators
  initialized by a[0]!, exactly as the source executable implementation.

  VERINAB23FoldMinGraph and VERINAB23FoldMaxGraph independently reproduce the
  two source Array.foldl computations from a[0]!, including processing the
  zeroth entry again. Their iota-selected functions therefore denote exactly
  the minimum and maximum expressions occurring in the postcondition.

  VERINAB23Pre preserves the nonempty Array Int precondition. VERINAB23Post
  preserves the source integer equation result + folded minimum = folded
  maximum. The proof-valued precondition argument has no computational effect
  and is represented by the explicit antecedent in the final correctness
  assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by
  this rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB23GetBang VERINAB23NatSub
  VERINAB23IntMin VERINAB23IntMax
  VERINAB23LoopGraph VERINAB23Loop
  VERINAB23Pre VERINAB23DifferenceMinMax
  VERINAB23FoldMinGraph VERINAB23FoldMin
  VERINAB23FoldMaxGraph VERINAB23FoldMax
  VERINAB23Post
$.

verinab23-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23GetBang A B ) $.
verinab23-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23NatSub A B ) $.
verinab23-int-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23IntMin A B ) $.
verinab23-int-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23IntMax A B ) $.
verinab23-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB23LoopGraph A B C D E ) $.
verinab23-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23Loop A B C D ) $.
verinab23-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB23Pre A ) $.
verinab23-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23DifferenceMinMax A ) $.
verinab23-fold-min-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB23FoldMinGraph A B ) $.
verinab23-fold-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23FoldMin A ) $.
verinab23-fold-max-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB23FoldMaxGraph A B ) $.
verinab23-fold-max-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB23FoldMax A ) $.
verinab23-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB23Post A B ) $.

verinab23-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB23GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verinab23-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB23NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab23-int-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB23IntMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

verinab23-int-max-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB23IntMax A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  B ,
  A
) $.

${
  $d k m n A B C D E $.

  verinab23-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB23LoopGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word ZZ
            /\
            B e. NN0
          )
          /\
          C e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        D e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      E e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. m e. Word ZZ
      E. n e. Word ZZ
        (
          (
            (
              ( # ` m ) = (
                ( VERINAB23NatSub ( # ` A ) B ) + 1
              )
              /\
              ( # ` n ) = (
                ( VERINAB23NatSub ( # ` A ) B ) + 1
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( m ` 0 ) = C
              /\
              ( n ` 0 ) = D
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. k e. (
              0 ..^ ( VERINAB23NatSub ( # ` A ) B )
            )
              (
                (
                  m ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINAB23IntMin
                    ( VERINAB23GetBang A ( B + k ) )
                    ( m ` k )
                )
                /\
                (
                  n ` ( k + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINAB23IntMax
                    ( n ` k )
                    ( VERINAB23GetBang A ( B + k ) )
                )
              )
            /\
            E = (
              (
                n ` ( VERINAB23NatSub ( # ` A ) B )
              )
              -
              (
                m ` ( VERINAB23NatSub ( # ` A ) B )
              )
            )

        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verinab23-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB23Loop A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ZZ
      ( VERINAB23LoopGraph A B C D y )

  VERINAB23Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  0 < ( # ` A )
) $.

  VERINAB23DifferenceMinMax A

  VERINAB23Loop
    A
    1
    ( VERINAB23GetBang A 0 )
    ( VERINAB23GetBang A 0 )

title: verina_basic_23
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_23,
% catalog title "differenceMinMax": a one-pass scan of a nonempty finite
% integer array returns its maximum minus its minimum and satisfies the exact
% min/max fold correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_23: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve the exact contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean's Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array. The
  % executable loop uses this accessor only at indices below the array size.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  differenceMinMax_precond(a: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(a) > 0

  differenceMinMax_loop_steps(
      a: list[int],
      i: nat,
      min_val, max_val: int,
      remaining: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      max_val - min_val
    ELSE
      LET x: int = int_list_get_bang(i, a)
      IN
        LET new_min: int =
              IF x < min_val THEN x ELSE min_val ENDIF,
            new_max: int =
              IF x > max_val THEN x ELSE max_val ENDIF
        IN
          differenceMinMax_loop_steps(
            a,
            i + 1,
            new_min,
            new_max,
            remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  % Starting at index one with the first element as both accumulators is the
  % exact proof-erased source loop; the precondition proof is irrelevant.
  differenceMinMax(a: list[int]): int =
    differenceMinMax_loop_steps(
      a,
      1,
      int_list_get_bang(0, a),
      int_list_get_bang(0, a),
      nat_subtract(int_list_length(a), 1))

  int_min_fold_left(
      values: list[int],
      accumulator: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_min_fold_left(
          tail,
          IF head < accumulator THEN head ELSE accumulator ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_max_fold_left(
      values: list[int],
      accumulator: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_max_fold_left(
          tail,
          IF head > accumulator THEN head ELSE accumulator ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  differenceMinMax_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      result: int): bool =
    result
        + int_min_fold_left(
            a,
            int_list_get_bang(0, a))
      = int_max_fold_left(
          a,
          int_list_get_bang(0, a))

  differenceMinMax_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int]):
      differenceMinMax_precond(a)
        IMPLIES
          differenceMinMax_postcond(
            a,
            differenceMinMax(a))

END verina_basic_23

-- !benchmark @start code_aux

-- !benchmark @end code_aux


def firstEvenOddDifference (a : Array Int) (h_precond : firstEvenOddDifference_precond (a)) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let rec findFirstEvenOdd (i : Nat) (firstEven firstOdd : Option Nat) : Int :=
    if i < a.size then
      let x := a[i]!
      let firstEven := if firstEven.isNone && isEven x then some i else firstEven
      let firstOdd := if firstOdd.isNone && isOdd x then some i else firstOdd
      match firstEven, firstOdd with
      | some e, some o => a[e]! - a[o]!
      | _, _ => findFirstEvenOdd (i + 1) firstEven firstOdd
    else
      -- This case is impossible due to h2, but we need a value
      0

    (∀ k, k < i → isOdd (a[k]!)) ∧ (∀ k, k < j → isEven (a[k]!))
