content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_34), catalog title "findEvenNumbers": an
  executable left fold extracts exactly the even integers from an array while
  preserving multiplicities and input order, together with its total
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let isEven = new_definition
  `isEven (n:int) <=>
     n rem (&2:int) = (&0:int)`;;

let findEvenNumbers_precond = new_definition
  `findEvenNumbers_precond (arr:int list) <=> T`;;

let findEvenNumbers_fold =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!acc:int list.
        findEvenNumbers_fold ([]:int list) acc = acc) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !acc:int list.
        findEvenNumbers_fold (CONS x xs) acc =
        findEvenNumbers_fold xs
          (if isEven x then APPEND acc [x] else acc))`;;

let findEvenNumbers = new_definition
  `findEvenNumbers (arr:int list) =
     findEvenNumbers_fold arr []`;;

let findEvenNumbers_count = new_definition
  `findEvenNumbers_count (value:int) (xs:int list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = value) xs)`;;

let findEvenNumbers_idxOf =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(findEvenNumbers_idxOf (value:int) [] = 0) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !value:int.
        findEvenNumbers_idxOf value (CONS x xs) =
        if x = value then 0
        else SUC (findEvenNumbers_idxOf value xs))`;;

let findEvenNumbers_postcond = new_definition
  `findEvenNumbers_postcond
      (arr:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     ALL
       (\x:int.
          isEven x /\
          MEM x arr /\
          findEvenNumbers_count x result =
            findEvenNumbers_count x arr)
       result /\
     ALL
       (\x:int. isEven x ==> MEM x result)
       arr /\
     ALL
       (\x:int.
          ALL
            (\y:int.
               isEven x
               ==> isEven y
               ==> findEvenNumbers_idxOf x arr <=
                   findEvenNumbers_idxOf y arr
               ==> findEvenNumbers_idxOf x result <=
                   findEvenNumbers_idxOf y result)
            arr)
       arr`;;

let findEvenNumbers_spec_satisfied =
  `!arr:int list.
     findEvenNumbers_precond arr
     ==> findEvenNumbers_postcond
           arr (findEvenNumbers arr)`;;

title: verina_basic_34
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34,
;; catalog title "findEvenNumbers": a deterministic integer-array program
;; extracts exactly the even entries in input order, preserving multiplicity.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-34-int-array-p (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (and
       (integerp (car arr))
       (verina-basic-34-int-array-p (cdr arr)))
    (equal arr nil)))

;; With positive divisor two, ACL2 MOD and Lean Int.emod agree on every
;; integer, so this is exactly the source Boolean helper isEven.

(defun verina-basic-34-is-even (n)
  (equal (mod n 2) 0))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int binder domain remains
;; explicit in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-precond (arr)
  (declare (ignore arr))
  t)

;; ACC is the source fold accumulator. Appending the current even entry is the
;; list representation of Array.push, so this recursion is exactly the source
;; Array.foldl traversal from the empty array. The proof-valued precondition
;; argument is computationally irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-fold (remaining acc)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       (if (verina-basic-34-is-even (car remaining))
           (append acc (cons (car remaining) nil))
         acc))
    acc))

(defun verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers (arr)
  (verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-fold arr nil))

;; Exact recursive encodings of source list membership, List.count, and
;; List.idxOf. The latter returns the list length when the value is absent.

(defun verina-basic-34-member-p (x values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (or
       (equal x (car values))
       (verina-basic-34-member-p x (cdr values)))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-34-count (x values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (+
       (if (equal x (car values)) 1 0)
       (verina-basic-34-count x (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun verina-basic-34-idx-of-aux (x remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (equal x (car remaining))
          index
        (verina-basic-34-idx-of-aux
         x
         (cdr remaining)
         (+ index 1)))
    index))

(defun verina-basic-34-idx-of (x values)
  (verina-basic-34-idx-of-aux x values 0))

;; This is result.all from the first source postcondition conjunct. Each output
;; entry is even, occurs in the input, and has the same full-list multiplicity
;; in the result and input.

(defun verina-basic-34-result-all-valid-p
    (remaining result arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((x (car remaining)))
        (and
         (verina-basic-34-is-even x)
         (verina-basic-34-member-p x arr)
         (equal
          (verina-basic-34-count x result)
          (verina-basic-34-count x arr))
         (verina-basic-34-result-all-valid-p
          (cdr remaining)
          result
          arr)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

;; This is arr.all from the second source conjunct: every even input entry is
;; present in the result.

(defun verina-basic-34-all-even-inputs-present-p
    (remaining result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (implies
        (verina-basic-34-is-even (car remaining))
        (verina-basic-34-member-p (car remaining) result))
       (verina-basic-34-all-even-inputs-present-p
        (cdr remaining)
        result))
    (equal remaining nil)))

;; These nested traversals reproduce the two source Array.all calls in the
;; order conjunct. For every input pair x and y, if both are even and x's first
;; input occurrence is no later than y's, the same first-occurrence ordering
;; holds in the result.

(defun verina-basic-34-all-y-order-preserved-p
    (x remaining-y arr result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-y)))
  (if (consp remaining-y)
      (let ((y (car remaining-y)))
        (and
         (implies
          (and
           (verina-basic-34-is-even x)
           (verina-basic-34-is-even y)
           (<=
            (verina-basic-34-idx-of x arr)
            (verina-basic-34-idx-of y arr)))
          (<=
           (verina-basic-34-idx-of x result)
           (verina-basic-34-idx-of y result)))
         (verina-basic-34-all-y-order-preserved-p
          x
          (cdr remaining-y)
          arr
          result)))
    (equal remaining-y nil)))

(defun verina-basic-34-all-order-preserved-p
    (remaining-x arr result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining-x)))
  (if (consp remaining-x)
      (and
       (verina-basic-34-all-y-order-preserved-p
        (car remaining-x)
        arr
        arr
        result)
       (verina-basic-34-all-order-preserved-p
        (cdr remaining-x)
        arr
        result))
    (equal remaining-x nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. Its proof-valued True
;; precondition argument is unused and therefore erased.

(defun verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-postcond
    (arr result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-34-int-array-p arr)
   (verina-basic-34-int-array-p result)
   (verina-basic-34-result-all-valid-p
    result
    result
    arr)
   (verina-basic-34-all-even-inputs-present-p
    arr
    result)
   (verina-basic-34-all-order-preserved-p
    arr
    arr
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over the complete Array Int domain, applies the source True precondition,
;; and connects the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (arr)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-34-int-array-p arr)
      (verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-precond arr))
     (verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers-postcond
      arr
      (verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers arr)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_34
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34,
-- catalog title "findEvenNumbers": a deterministic integer-array fold extracts
-- exactly the even entries in input order and is connected to its membership,
-- multiplicity, and first-occurrence-order correctness contract. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic34 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _∈_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

naturalModTwo : Nat → Nat
naturalModTwo zero = zero
naturalModTwo (suc zero) = suc zero
naturalModTwo (suc (suc n)) = naturalModTwo n

-- Lean remainder modulo positive two is the nonnegative parity remainder.
moduloByTwo : Int → Int
moduloByTwo (pos n) = pos (naturalModTwo n)
moduloByTwo (negsuc n) = pos (naturalModTwo (suc n))

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

isEven : Int → Bool
isEven n = intEqual (moduloByTwo n) zeroInt

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

snoc : {A : Set} → List A → A → List A
snoc [] x = x ∷ []
snoc (y ∷ ys) x = y ∷ snoc ys x

foldl :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B → A) →
  A →
  List B →
  A
foldl step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldl step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldl step (step accumulator x) xs

filterEvenStep : Array Int → Int → Array Int
filterEvenStep accumulator x =
  if isEven x
  then snoc accumulator x
  else accumulator

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

data _∈_ {A : Set} (x : A) : List A → Set where
  here : {xs : List A} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there :
    {y : A} {xs : List A} →
    x ∈ xs →
    x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

count : Int → List Int → Nat
count x [] = zero
count x (y ∷ ys) =
  if intEqual x y
  then suc (count x ys)
  else count x ys

idxOf : Int → List Int → Nat
idxOf x [] = zero
idxOf x (y ∷ ys) =
  if intEqual x y
  then zero
  else suc (idxOf x ys)

findEvenNumbers-precond : Array Int → Set
findEvenNumbers-precond arr = Top

findEvenNumbers :
  (arr : Array Int) →
  findEvenNumbers-precond arr →
  Array Int
findEvenNumbers arr h-precond =
  foldl filterEvenStep [] arr

findEvenNumbers-postcond :
  (arr : Array Int) →
  (result : Array Int) →
  findEvenNumbers-precond arr →
  Set
findEvenNumbers-postcond arr result h-precond =
  All
    (λ x →
      IsTrue (isEven x) ∧
      (x ∈ arr) ∧
      (count x result ≡ count x arr))
    result ∧
  All
    (λ x →
      IsTrue (isEven x) →
      x ∈ result)
    arr ∧
  All
    (λ x →
      All
        (λ y →
          IsTrue (isEven x) →
          IsTrue (isEven y) →
          idxOf x arr ≤ idxOf y arr →
          idxOf x result ≤ idxOf y result)
        arr)
    arr

findEvenNumbers-spec-satisfied : Set
findEvenNumbers-spec-satisfied =
  (arr : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : findEvenNumbers-precond arr) →
  findEvenNumbers-postcond
    arr
    (findEvenNumbers arr h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_34
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34,
  catalog title "findEvenNumbers": the executable left-fold program extracts
  exactly the even integers from an input array in their original order and
  satisfies its multiplicity, membership, and index-order contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val isEven_def = new_definition (
  "isEven_def",
  ``isEven (n : int) <=> n % 2 = 0``
);

val findEvenNumbers_precond_def = new_definition (
  "findEvenNumbers_precond_def",
  ``findEvenNumbers_precond (arr : int list) <=> T``
);

val findEvenNumbers_def = new_definition (
  "findEvenNumbers_def",
  ``findEvenNumbers (arr : int list) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc x.
          if isEven x then acc ++ [x] else acc)
        ([] : int list)
        arr``
);

val findEvenNumbers_count_def = new_definition (
  "findEvenNumbers_count_def",
  ``findEvenNumbers_count (x : int) (xs : int list) =
      LENGTH (FILTER (\y : int. y = x) xs)``
);

val findEvenNumbers_idxOf_def = Define `
  (findEvenNumbers_idxOf
      (value : int) ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (findEvenNumbers_idxOf
      value (head::tail) =
     if head = value then
       0
     else
       SUC (findEvenNumbers_idxOf value tail))
`;

val findEvenNumbers_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "findEvenNumbers_postcond_def",
  ``findEvenNumbers_postcond
      (arr : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
          isEven x /\
          MEM x arr /\
          findEvenNumbers_count x result =
            findEvenNumbers_count x arr)
        result /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
          isEven x ==> MEM x result)
        arr /\
      EVERY
        (\x : int.
          EVERY
            (\y : int.
              isEven x ==>
              isEven y ==>
              findEvenNumbers_idxOf x arr <=
                findEvenNumbers_idxOf y arr ==>
              findEvenNumbers_idxOf x result <=
                findEvenNumbers_idxOf y result)
            arr)
        arr``
);

val findEvenNumbers_spec_satisfied =
  ``!arr : int list.
      findEvenNumbers_precond arr ==>
      findEvenNumbers_postcond
        arr (findEvenNumbers arr)``;

title: verina_basic_34
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_34), catalog title findEvenNumbers: the
  exact executable left-to-right integer-array fold retains precisely the
  even entries in their original order and satisfies the complete
  multiplicity, membership, and idxOf-order correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer arrays and lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, ran w is its entry set,
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid-index set, (/) is the empty word,
  <" x "> is a singleton word, and ++ is word concatenation.

  VERINAB34IsEven is the source Boolean helper isEven: it is one exactly when
  Lean's integer Euclidean remainder modulo two is zero, and zero otherwise.
  VERINAB34ToList is the source Array.toList conversion, extensionally the
  identity on the finite-word representation.

  VERINAB34FoldGraph records every accumulator of the source Array.foldl.
  It starts with the empty word and scans every input entry from left to
  right. An even entry is appended to the accumulator exactly as Array.push
  does; an odd entry leaves the accumulator unchanged. VERINAB34FindEvenNumbers
  selects the unique final accumulator, so the executable result is fixed
  independently of the postcondition and admits no additional outputs.

  VERINAB34Count is List.count. VERINAB34IdxOfGraph characterizes List.idxOf
  exactly: it returns the least matching index, or the word length when the
  integer is absent. VERINAB34Post preserves all three source clauses:
  every result entry is even, belongs to the input, and has the same full
  multiplicity there; every even input entry belongs to the result; and the
  nested source Array.all implication compares the same first-occurrence
  idxOf values for every ordered pair of input entries.

  VERINAB34Pre is the source True precondition on typed Array Int inputs.
  The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally and
  propositionally unused and is represented by the explicit antecedent in
  the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB34IsEven VERINAB34ToList
  VERINAB34FoldGraph
  VERINAB34Pre VERINAB34FindEvenNumbers
  VERINAB34Count
  VERINAB34IdxOfGraph VERINAB34IdxOf
  VERINAB34Post
$.

verinab34-is-even-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB34IsEven A ) $.
verinab34-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB34ToList A ) $.
verinab34-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB34FoldGraph A B ) $.
verinab34-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB34Pre A ) $.
verinab34-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB34FindEvenNumbers A ) $.
verinab34-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB34Count A B ) $.
verinab34-idx-of-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB34IdxOfGraph A B C ) $.
verinab34-idx-of-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB34IdxOf A B ) $.
verinab34-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB34Post A B ) $.

verinab34-is-even-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB34IsEven A
) = if (
  ( A mod 2 ) = 0 ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verinab34-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB34ToList A
) = A $.

${
  $d k t A B $.

  verinab34-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34FoldGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = (/)
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              ( VERINAB34IsEven ( A ` k ) ) = 1 ,
              ( ( t ` k ) ++ <" ( A ` k ) "> ) ,
              ( t ` k )
            )
          /\
          B = ( t ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

verinab34-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB34Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab34-program-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34FindEvenNumbers A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB34FoldGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab34-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34Count A B
  ) = (
    # ` {
      i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      |
      ( A ` i ) = B
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j A B C $.

  verinab34-idx-of-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34IdxOfGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      C <_ ( # ` A )
      /\
      (
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          ( A ` j ) =/= B
        /\
        (
          C < ( # ` A )
          ->
          ( A ` C ) = B
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab34-idx-of-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34IdxOf A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB34IdxOfGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verinab34-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB34Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
        (
          (
            ( VERINAB34IsEven ( B ` i ) ) = 1
            /\
            ( B ` i ) e. ran ( VERINAB34ToList A )
          )
          /\
          (
            VERINAB34Count
              ( VERINAB34ToList B )
              ( B ` i )
          ) = (
            VERINAB34Count
              ( VERINAB34ToList A )
              ( B ` i )
          )
        )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            ( VERINAB34IsEven ( A ` i ) ) = 1
            ->
            ( A ` i ) e. ran ( VERINAB34ToList B )
          )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              ( VERINAB34IsEven ( A ` i ) ) = 1
              ->
              (
                ( VERINAB34IsEven ( A ` j ) ) = 1
                ->
                (
                  (
                    VERINAB34IdxOf
                      ( VERINAB34ToList A )
                      ( A ` i )
                  ) <_ (
                    VERINAB34IdxOf
                      ( VERINAB34ToList A )
                      ( A ` j )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    VERINAB34IdxOf
                      ( VERINAB34ToList B )
                      ( A ` i )
                  ) <_ (
                    VERINAB34IdxOf
                      ( VERINAB34ToList B )
                      ( A ` j )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-34-find-even-numbers $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINAB34Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINAB34Post
        w
        ( VERINAB34FindEvenNumbers w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_basic_34
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_34, catalog title "findEvenNumbers": the integer-parity
:: helper, unconditional precondition, exact stable filtering fold,
:: occurrence-and-order postcondition, and final correctness contract.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN, CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1, CLASSES1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1,
    CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex isEven being Function of INT,BOOLEAN,
     findEvenNumbersPrecond being Function of INT*,BOOLEAN,
     occurrenceCount,firstIndex being Function of [:INT*,INT:],NAT,
     findEvenNumbers being Function of INT*,INT*,
     findEvenNumbersPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT*:],BOOLEAN st
    (for n being Integer holds
      ((n mod (2 qua Integer) = 0 &
          isEven/.n = TRUE) or
       (n mod (2 qua Integer) <> 0 &
          isEven/.n = FALSE))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      findEvenNumbersPrecond/.a = TRUE) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, x being Integer holds
      occurrenceCount/.[a,x] =
        len Seq (a | {j where j is Nat :
          j in dom a & a/.j = x})) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, x being Integer holds
      ((x in rng a &
          firstIndex/.[a,x] < len a &
          a/.(firstIndex/.[a,x] + 1) = x &
          (for k being Nat st k < firstIndex/.[a,x] holds
            a/.(k + 1) <> x)) or
       (not x in rng a &
          firstIndex/.[a,x] = len a))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      ex states being FinSequence of INT* st
        len states = len a + 1 &
        states/.1 = <*>INT &
        states/.(len a + 1) = findEvenNumbers/.a &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom a holds
          ((isEven/.(a/.k) = TRUE &
              states/.(k + 1) = states/.k ^ <*a/.k*>) or
           (isEven/.(a/.k) = FALSE &
              states/.(k + 1) = states/.k)))) &
    (for a,result being FinSequence of INT holds
      (((for i being Nat st i in dom result holds
            isEven/.(result/.i) = TRUE &
            result/.i in rng a &
            occurrenceCount/.[result,result/.i] =
              occurrenceCount/.[a,result/.i]) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom a holds
            isEven/.(a/.i) = TRUE implies a/.i in rng result) &
          (for i,j being Nat st i in dom a & j in dom a holds
            isEven/.(a/.i) = TRUE implies
              (isEven/.(a/.j) = TRUE implies
                (firstIndex/.[a,a/.i] <= firstIndex/.[a,a/.j]
                  implies firstIndex/.[result,a/.i] <=
                    firstIndex/.[result,a/.j]))) &
          findEvenNumbersPostcond/.[a,result] = TRUE) or
       (not ((for i being Nat st i in dom result holds
            isEven/.(result/.i) = TRUE &
            result/.i in rng a &
            occurrenceCount/.[result,result/.i] =
              occurrenceCount/.[a,result/.i]) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom a holds
            isEven/.(a/.i) = TRUE implies a/.i in rng result) &
          (for i,j being Nat st i in dom a & j in dom a holds
            isEven/.(a/.i) = TRUE implies
              (isEven/.(a/.j) = TRUE implies
                (firstIndex/.[a,a/.i] <= firstIndex/.[a,a/.j]
                  implies firstIndex/.[result,a/.i] <=
                    firstIndex/.[result,a/.j])))) &
          findEvenNumbersPostcond/.[a,result] = FALSE))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT st
      findEvenNumbersPrecond/.a = TRUE
    holds
      findEvenNumbersPostcond/.[a,findEvenNumbers/.a] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_34
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_34,
% catalog title "findEvenNumbers": a deterministic integer-array fold extracts
% exactly the even entries in input order and satisfies its membership,
% multiplicity, and first-occurrence-order contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_34: THEORY
BEGIN

  isEven(n: int): bool =
    mod(n, 2) = 0

  findEvenNumbers_precond(
      arr: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  % This is Array.push on the finite-list representation of a Lean array.
  int_list_snoc(
      values: list[int],
      value: int): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        cons(value, null[int]),
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, int_list_snoc(tail, value))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is the source Array.foldl with its accumulator made explicit.
  findEvenNumbers_fold(
      accumulator, remaining: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF isEven(head) THEN
          findEvenNumbers_fold(
            int_list_snoc(accumulator, head),
            tail)
        ELSE
          findEvenNumbers_fold(accumulator, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  findEvenNumbers(
      arr: list[int]): list[int] =
    findEvenNumbers_fold(null[int], arr)

  int_list_member(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = value
          OR int_list_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + int_list_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean List.idxOf returns the first matching index, or the list length when
  % the requested value does not occur.
  int_list_index_of(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head = value THEN
          0
        ELSE
          1 + int_list_index_of(value, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  result_entries_valid(
      arr, whole_result, remaining: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        isEven(head)
          AND int_list_member(head, arr)
          AND int_list_count(head, whole_result)
                = int_list_count(head, arr)
          AND result_entries_valid(
                arr,
                whole_result,
                tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  even_inputs_present(
      remaining, result: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        (isEven(head)
          IMPLIES int_list_member(head, result))
          AND even_inputs_present(tail, result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  order_for_fixed_input(
      x: int,
      arr, result, remaining_y: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining_y OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(y, tail):
        (isEven(x)
          IMPLIES
            (isEven(y)
              IMPLIES
                (int_list_index_of(x, arr)
                    <= int_list_index_of(y, arr)
                  IMPLIES
                    int_list_index_of(x, result)
                      <= int_list_index_of(y, result))))
          AND order_for_fixed_input(
                x,
                arr,
                result,
                tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining_y BY <<

  input_order_preserved(
      arr, result, remaining_x: list[int]):
        RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES remaining_x OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(x, tail):
        order_for_fixed_input(x, arr, result, arr)
          AND input_order_preserved(
                arr,
                result,
                tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining_x BY <<

  findEvenNumbers_postcond(
      arr, result: list[int]): bool =
    result_entries_valid(arr, result, result)
      AND even_inputs_present(arr, result)
      AND input_order_preserved(arr, result, arr)

  findEvenNumbers_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (arr: list[int]):
      findEvenNumbers_precond(arr)
        IMPLIES
          findEvenNumbers_postcond(
            arr,
            findEvenNumbers(arr))

END verina_basic_34

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35,
   catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": an executable stable partition of an
   integer array into its nonzero entries followed by its zero entries,
   together with the permutation and exact prefix/suffix correctness
   contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool Lists.List Sorting.Permutation ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition MoveZeroesToEnd_precond (_arr : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition MoveZeroesToEnd_isNonzero (x : Z) : bool :=
  negb (Z.eqb x 0%Z).

Definition MoveZeroesToEnd_isZero (x : Z) : bool :=
  Z.eqb x 0%Z.

Definition MoveZeroesToEnd
    (arr : list Z)
    (_h_precond : MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr) : list Z :=
  filter MoveZeroesToEnd_isNonzero arr ++
  filter MoveZeroesToEnd_isZero arr.

Fixpoint MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOfZero (xs : list Z) : nat :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0%nat
  | x :: rest =>
      if Z.eqb x 0%Z
      then 0%nat
      else S (MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOfZero rest)
  end.

Definition MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond
    (arr result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr) : Prop :=
  let firstResZeroIdx := MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOfZero result in
  Permutation result arr /\
  firstn firstResZeroIdx result =
    filter MoveZeroesToEnd_isNonzero arr /\
  skipn firstResZeroIdx result =
    filter MoveZeroesToEnd_isZero arr.

Theorem MoveZeroesToEnd_spec_satisfied
    (arr : list Z)
    (h_precond : MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr) :
  MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond
    arr (MoveZeroesToEnd arr h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_35), catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": an
  executable integer-array program stably partitions the entries into the
  nonzero entries followed by the zero entries, together with its unconditional
  precondition, permutation and first-zero split postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_35
  imports Main
begin

definition MoveZeroesToEnd_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition MoveZeroesToEnd :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "MoveZeroesToEnd arr =
    filter (\<lambda>x. x \<noteq> 0) arr @ filter (\<lambda>x. x = 0) arr"

fun MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf [] value = 0"
| "MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf (x # xs) value =
    (if x = value then 0 else Suc (MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf xs value))"

definition MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond arr result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let firstResZeroIdx = MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf result 0
     in (\<forall>value. count_list result value = count_list arr value) \<and>
        take firstResZeroIdx result =
          filter (\<lambda>x. x \<noteq> 0) arr \<and>
        drop firstResZeroIdx result =
          filter (\<lambda>x. x = 0) arr)"

theorem MoveZeroesToEnd_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr"
  shows
    "MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond arr (MoveZeroesToEnd arr)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_35), catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": an
  executable stable partition moves all zeroes in an integer array to the end,
  with the permutation and exact first-zero prefix/suffix correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let MoveZeroesToEnd_precond = new_definition
  `MoveZeroesToEnd_precond (arr:int list) <=> T`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd = new_definition
  `MoveZeroesToEnd (arr:int list) =
     APPEND
       (FILTER (\x:int. ~(x = (&0:int))) arr)
       (FILTER (\x:int. x = (&0:int)) arr)`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf (value:int) [] = 0) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !value:int.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf value (CONS x xs) =
        if x = value then 0
        else SUC (MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf value xs))`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_take =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!n:num.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_take n ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !n:num.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_take n (CONS x xs) =
        if n = 0 then []
        else CONS x (MoveZeroesToEnd_take (PRE n) xs))`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_drop =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!n:num.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_drop n ([]:int list) = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !n:num.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_drop n (CONS x xs) =
        if n = 0 then CONS x xs
        else MoveZeroesToEnd_drop (PRE n) xs)`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_count = new_definition
  `MoveZeroesToEnd_count (value:int) (xs:int list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = value) xs)`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_isPerm = new_definition
  `MoveZeroesToEnd_isPerm (xs:int list) (ys:int list) <=>
     (!value:int.
        MoveZeroesToEnd_count value xs =
        MoveZeroesToEnd_count value ys)`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond = new_definition
  `MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond
      (arr:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     let firstResZeroIdx =
       MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf (&0:int) result in
     MoveZeroesToEnd_isPerm result arr /\
     MoveZeroesToEnd_take firstResZeroIdx result =
       FILTER (\x:int. ~(x = (&0:int))) arr /\
     MoveZeroesToEnd_drop firstResZeroIdx result =
       FILTER (\x:int. x = (&0:int)) arr`;;

let MoveZeroesToEnd_spec_satisfied =
  `!arr:int list.
     MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr
     ==> MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond
           arr (MoveZeroesToEnd arr)`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35,
;; catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": a deterministic stable partition moves
;; every zero in an integer array after all nonzero entries while preserving
;; the complete permutation, prefix, and suffix contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-35-int-array-p (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (and
       (integerp (car arr))
       (verina-basic-35-int-array-p (cdr arr)))
    (equal arr nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int binder domain remains
;; explicit in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end-precond (arr)
  (declare (ignore arr))
  t)

;; These two stable filters are exactly the source List.filter calls.

(defun verina-basic-35-filter-nonzero (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (if (not (equal (car arr) 0))
          (cons
           (car arr)
           (verina-basic-35-filter-nonzero (cdr arr)))
        (verina-basic-35-filter-nonzero (cdr arr)))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-35-filter-zero (arr)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count arr)))
  (if (consp arr)
      (if (equal (car arr) 0)
          (cons
           (car arr)
           (verina-basic-35-filter-zero (cdr arr)))
        (verina-basic-35-filter-zero (cdr arr)))
    nil))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. APPEND followed by the list-to-array representation is
;; exactly Array.mk (nonZeros ++ zeros).

(defun verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end (arr)
  (append
   (verina-basic-35-filter-nonzero arr)
   (verina-basic-35-filter-zero arr)))

;; This is List.idxOf 0: it returns the first zero index, or the list length
;; when zero is absent.

(defun verina-basic-35-first-zero-index (values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (if (equal (car values) 0)
          0
        (+ 1
           (verina-basic-35-first-zero-index
            (cdr values))))
    0))

;; Exact total representations of List.take and List.drop on natural counts.

(defun verina-basic-35-take (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (and
       (natp count)
       (< 0 count)
       (consp values))
      (cons
       (car values)
       (verina-basic-35-take
        (- count 1)
        (cdr values)))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-35-drop (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (and
       (natp count)
       (< 0 count)
       (consp values))
      (verina-basic-35-drop
       (- count 1)
       (cdr values))
    values))

;; Removing the first equal entry and recurring gives an exact Boolean
;; characterization of List.isPerm, including duplicate multiplicities.

(defun verina-basic-35-member-p (value values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (or
       (equal value (car values))
       (verina-basic-35-member-p
        value
        (cdr values)))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-35-remove-first (value values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (if (equal value (car values))
          (cdr values)
        (cons
         (car values)
         (verina-basic-35-remove-first
          value
          (cdr values))))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-35-permutation-p (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (verina-basic-35-member-p (car left) right)
       (verina-basic-35-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-basic-35-remove-first
         (car left)
         right)))
    (equal right nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The proof-valued True
;; precondition argument is unused and therefore erased.

(defun verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end-postcond
    (arr result)
  (let ((first-zero-index
         (verina-basic-35-first-zero-index result)))
    (and
     (verina-basic-35-int-array-p arr)
     (verina-basic-35-int-array-p result)
     (verina-basic-35-permutation-p result arr)
     (equal
      (verina-basic-35-take first-zero-index result)
      (verina-basic-35-filter-nonzero arr))
     (equal
      (verina-basic-35-drop first-zero-index result)
      (verina-basic-35-filter-zero arr)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over the complete Array Int domain, applies the source True precondition,
;; and connects the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (arr)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-35-int-array-p arr)
      (verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end-precond arr))
     (verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end-postcond
      arr
      (verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end arr)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_35
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35,
-- catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": a deterministic integer-array program
-- stably moves all zeroes to the end and is connected to its permutation and
-- first-zero prefix/suffix correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic35 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolNot : Bool → Bool
boolNot true = false
boolNot false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

filterList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → List A
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then x ∷ filterList predicate xs
  else filterList predicate xs

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropList n xs

idxOfInt : Int → List Int → Nat
idxOfInt sought [] = zero
idxOfInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual sought x
  then zero
  else suc (idxOfInt sought xs)

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A → List A → Set where
  permutationNil :
    Permutation [] []

  permutationSkip :
    {x : A} {xs ys : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

  permutationSwap :
    {x y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Permutation (y ∷ x ∷ xs) (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

  permutationTrans :
    {xs ys zs : List A} →
    Permutation xs ys →
    Permutation ys zs →
    Permutation xs zs

MoveZeroesToEnd-precond : Array Int → Set
MoveZeroesToEnd-precond arr = Top

MoveZeroesToEnd :
  (arr : Array Int) →
  MoveZeroesToEnd-precond arr →
  Array Int
MoveZeroesToEnd arr h-precond =
  let nonZeros =
        filterList
          (λ x → boolNot (intEqual x zeroInt))
          arr
      zeros =
        filterList
          (λ x → intEqual x zeroInt)
          arr
  in appendList nonZeros zeros

MoveZeroesToEnd-postcond :
  (arr : Array Int) →
  (result : Array Int) →
  MoveZeroesToEnd-precond arr →
  Set
MoveZeroesToEnd-postcond arr result h-precond =
  let firstResZeroIdx = idxOfInt zeroInt result
  in
    Permutation result arr ∧
    (takeList firstResZeroIdx result ≡
      filterList
        (λ x → boolNot (intEqual x zeroInt))
        arr) ∧
    (dropList firstResZeroIdx result ≡
      filterList
        (λ x → intEqual x zeroInt)
        arr)

MoveZeroesToEnd-spec-satisfied : Set
MoveZeroesToEnd-spec-satisfied =
  (arr : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : MoveZeroesToEnd-precond arr) →
  MoveZeroesToEnd-postcond
    arr
    (MoveZeroesToEnd arr h-precond)
    h-precond

(*

  catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": the executable integer-array program keeps
  the nonzero elements in order and moves all zero elements to the end, with
  its permutation and exact prefix/suffix contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;

);

      (value : int) ([] : int list) = 0) /\

  "MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond_def",

      let firstResZeroIdx =
        MoveZeroesToEnd_idxOf (0 : int) result
      in
        PERM result arr /\
        TAKE firstResZeroIdx result =
          FILTER (\x : int. x <> 0) arr /\
        DROP firstResZeroIdx result =
          FILTER (\x : int. x = 0) arr``
);

val MoveZeroesToEnd_spec_satisfied =

      MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr ==>

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain, and Word ZZ is exactly the type of
  arbitrary finite integer arrays and lists. For a word w, # ` w is its
  natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and

  VERINAB35FilterNonzeroGraph and VERINAB35FilterZeroGraph select exactly all
  matching source positions in strictly increasing order. Their unique-choice
  functions therefore reproduce the two stable List.filter calls, including
  duplicates. VERINAB35MoveZeroesToEnd composes those filters, append, and
  Array.mk exactly, fixing the executable result independently of the
  postcondition and admitting no additional outputs.

  matching index, or the word length when zero is absent. VERINAB35TakeGraph
  and VERINAB35DropGraph reproduce List.take and List.drop for every natural
  index, including clipping at the word length. VERINAB35Perm is List.isPerm,
  represented equivalently by equality of every integer's multiplicity.

  VERINAB35Pre is the source True precondition on typed Array Int inputs.
  VERINAB35Post preserves the source permutation clause and the exact take and
  drop equalities at the first result-zero index. The proof-valued precondition
  arguments to the implementation and postcondition are computationally and
  propositionally unused and are represented by the explicit antecedent in

  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p

verinab35-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35ToList A
) = A $.

verinab35-array-mk-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35ArrayMk A
) = A $.

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verinab35-filter-nonzero-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35FilterNonzeroGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) =/= 0
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( A ` i ) =/= 0
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab35-filter-nonzero-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35FilterNonzero A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB35FilterNonzeroGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j k p A B $.

  verinab35-filter-zero-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35FilterZeroGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      (
        ( # ` p ) = ( # ` B )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
            (
              (
                ( p ` j ) < ( # ` A )
                /\
                ( A ` ( p ` j ) ) = 0
              )
              /\
              ( B ` j ) = ( A ` ( p ` j ) )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
              A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                (
                  j < k
                  ->
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` k )
                )
            /\
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              (
                ( A ` i ) = 0
                ->
                E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
                  ( p ` j ) = i

$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab35-filter-zero-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35FilterZero A
  ) = (

      ( VERINAB35FilterZeroGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verinab35-idx-of-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35IdxOfGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        (
          C e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          /\
          ( A ` C ) = B
        )
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          ( A ` j ) =/= B
      )
      \/
      (
        C = ( # ` A )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          ( A ` i ) =/= B
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab35-idx-of-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35IdxOf A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB35IdxOfGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab35-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab35-take-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35TakeGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = (
        VERINAB35NatMin B ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        ( C ` i ) = ( A ` i )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab35-take-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35Take A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB35TakeGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab35-drop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35DropGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` C ) = (
        ( # ` A ) - (
          VERINAB35NatMin B ( # ` A )
        )
      )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` C ) )
        (
          C ` i
        ) = (
          A ` (
            ( VERINAB35NatMin B ( # ` A ) ) + i
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab35-drop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35Drop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB35DropGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j x A B $.

  verinab35-permutation-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB35Perm A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    A. x e. ZZ
      (
        # ` {
          i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          |
          ( A ` i ) = x
        }
      ) = (
        # ` {
          j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          |
          ( B ` j ) = x
        }
      )
  ) $.
$}

verinab35-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
) $.

verinab35-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35MoveZeroesToEnd A
) = (
  VERINAB35ArrayMk (
    (
      VERINAB35FilterNonzero
        ( VERINAB35ToList A )
    )
    ++
    (
      VERINAB35FilterZero
        ( VERINAB35ToList A )
    )
  )
) $.

verinab35-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB35Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      VERINAB35Perm
        ( VERINAB35ToList B )
        ( VERINAB35ToList A )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        VERINAB35Take
          ( VERINAB35ToList B )
          (
            VERINAB35IdxOf
              ( VERINAB35ToList B )
              0
          )
      ) = (
        VERINAB35FilterNonzero
          ( VERINAB35ToList A )
      )
      /\
      (
        VERINAB35Drop
          ( VERINAB35ToList B )
          (
            VERINAB35IdxOf
              ( VERINAB35ToList B )
              0
          )
      ) = (
        VERINAB35FilterZero
          ( VERINAB35ToList A )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-basic-35-move-zeroes-to-end
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINAB35Pre w )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB35Post
          w
          ( VERINAB35MoveZeroesToEnd w )
      )
    )
  $.

title: verina_basic_35
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_35, catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": the unconditional
:: precondition, exact stable nonzero/zero filtering and concatenation
:: implementation, permutation-and-split postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN,
    CLASSES1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1, CLASSES1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP,
    XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1, CLASSES1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex moveZeroesToEndPrecond being Function of INT*,BOOLEAN,
     nonZeros,zeros,moveZeroesToEnd being Function of INT*,INT*,
     firstZeroIndex being Function of INT*,NAT,
     moveZeroesToEndPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT*:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      moveZeroesToEndPrecond/.a = TRUE) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      nonZeros/.a =
        Seq (a | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom a & a/.i <> (0 qua Integer)})) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      zeros/.a =
        Seq (a | {i where i is Nat :
          i in dom a & a/.i = (0 qua Integer)})) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      moveZeroesToEnd/.a = nonZeros/.a ^ zeros/.a) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      (((0 qua Integer) in rng a &
          firstZeroIndex/.a < len a &
          a/.(firstZeroIndex/.a + 1) = (0 qua Integer) &
          (for k being Nat st k < firstZeroIndex/.a holds
            a/.(k + 1) <> (0 qua Integer))) or
       (not (0 qua Integer) in rng a &
          firstZeroIndex/.a = len a))) &
    (for a,result being FinSequence of INT holds
      ((moveZeroesToEndPostcond/.[a,result] = TRUE iff
          a,result are_fiberwise_equipotent &
          len (nonZeros/.a) = firstZeroIndex/.result &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom (nonZeros/.a) holds
            result/.i = (nonZeros/.a).i) &
          len result = firstZeroIndex/.result + len (zeros/.a) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom (zeros/.a) holds
            result/.(firstZeroIndex/.result + i) = (zeros/.a).i)) &
       (moveZeroesToEndPostcond/.[a,result] = FALSE iff
          not (a,result are_fiberwise_equipotent &
          len (nonZeros/.a) = firstZeroIndex/.result &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom (nonZeros/.a) holds
            result/.i = (nonZeros/.a).i) &
          len result = firstZeroIndex/.result + len (zeros/.a) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom (zeros/.a) holds
            result/.(firstZeroIndex/.result + i) =
              (zeros/.a).i))))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT st
      moveZeroesToEndPrecond/.a = TRUE
    holds
      moveZeroesToEndPostcond/.[a,moveZeroesToEnd/.a] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_35
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_35,
% catalog title "MoveZeroesToEnd": a deterministic integer-array transformation
% stably moves all zero entries after all nonzero entries and satisfies the
% source permutation and zero-boundary contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_35: THEORY
BEGIN

  MoveZeroesToEnd_precond(
      arr: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  int_list_filter_nonzero(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head /= 0 THEN
          cons(head, int_list_filter_nonzero(tail))
        ELSE
          int_list_filter_nonzero(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_filter_zero(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head = 0 THEN
          cons(head, int_list_filter_zero(tail))
        ELSE
          int_list_filter_zero(tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_append(
      first, second: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES first OF
      null:
        second,
      cons(head, tail):
        cons(head, int_list_append(tail, second))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE first BY <<

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  MoveZeroesToEnd(
      arr: list[int]): list[int] =
    int_list_append(
      int_list_filter_nonzero(arr),
      int_list_filter_zero(arr))

  % Lean List.idxOf returns the first matching index, or the list length when
  % the requested value does not occur.
  int_list_index_of(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF head = value THEN
          0
        ELSE
          1 + int_list_index_of(value, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF count = 0 THEN
          null[int]
        ELSE
          cons(head, int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF count = 0 THEN
          values
        ELSE
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + int_list_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % For finite integer lists, equality of every value's multiplicity is
  % equivalent to Lean's List.isPerm relation.
  int_lists_are_permutations(
      first, second: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      int_list_count(value, first)
        = int_list_count(value, second)

  MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond(
      arr, result: list[int]): bool =
    LET firstResZeroIdx: nat =
      int_list_index_of(0, result)
    IN
      int_lists_are_permutations(result, arr)
        AND
          int_list_take(firstResZeroIdx, result)
            = int_list_filter_nonzero(arr)
        AND
          int_list_drop(firstResZeroIdx, result)
            = int_list_filter_zero(arr)

  MoveZeroesToEnd_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (arr: list[int]):
      MoveZeroesToEnd_precond(arr)
        IMPLIES
          MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond(
            arr,
            MoveZeroesToEnd(arr))

END verina_basic_35

title: verina_basic_36
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_36,
   catalog title "replaceWithColon": executable replacement of every space,
   comma, or dot in an arbitrary Unicode string by a colon, together with
   length preservation, pointwise correctness, and the final correctness
   proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_string := list lean_char.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  match x, y with
  | LeanAscii a, LeanAscii b =>
      Nat.eqb (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a) (Ascii.nat_of_ascii b)
  | LeanNonAscii xcode _ _, LeanNonAscii ycode _ _ =>
      N.eqb xcode ycode
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition replaceWithColon_space : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 32).

Definition replaceWithColon_comma : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 44).

Definition replaceWithColon_dot : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 46).

Definition replaceWithColon_colon : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 58).

Definition replaceWithColon_default_char : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 0).

Definition isSpaceCommaDot (c : lean_char) : bool :=
  if lean_char_eqb c replaceWithColon_space then true
  else if lean_char_eqb c replaceWithColon_comma then true
  else if lean_char_eqb c replaceWithColon_dot then true
  else false.

Definition replaceWithColon_precond (_s : lean_string) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition replaceWithColon
    (s : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : replaceWithColon_precond s) : lean_string :=
  map
    (fun c =>
      if isSpaceCommaDot c
      then replaceWithColon_colon
      else c)
    s.

Definition replaceWithColon_postcond
    (s result : lean_string)
    (_h_precond : replaceWithColon_precond s) : Prop :=
  length result = length s /\
  forall i : nat,
    i < length s ->
    (isSpaceCommaDot
       (nth i s replaceWithColon_default_char) = true ->
      nth i result replaceWithColon_default_char =
        replaceWithColon_colon) /\
    (isSpaceCommaDot
       (nth i s replaceWithColon_default_char) <> true ->
      nth i result replaceWithColon_default_char =
        nth i s replaceWithColon_default_char).

Theorem replaceWithColon_spec_satisfied
    (s : lean_string)
    (h_precond : replaceWithColon_precond s) :
  replaceWithColon_postcond
    s (replaceWithColon s h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_36
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_36
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_36), catalog title "replaceWithColon": an
  executable Unicode-scalar string program replaces every ASCII space, comma,
  or dot with a colon and leaves all other characters unchanged, together with
  its unconditional precondition, length-preserving pointwise postcondition,
  and final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_36
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_nul :: lean_char where
  "lean_nul =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False False False False False False False)"

definition lean_space :: lean_char where
  "lean_space =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True False False False False False)"

definition lean_comma :: lean_char where
  "lean_comma =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True False True True False False)"

definition lean_dot :: lean_char where
  "lean_dot =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True False True True True False)"

definition lean_colon :: lean_char where
  "lean_colon =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True True True False True False)"

definition isSpaceCommaDot :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "isSpaceCommaDot c \<longleftrightarrow>
    c = lean_space \<or> c = lean_comma \<or> c = lean_dot"

definition replaceWithColon_precond :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "replaceWithColon_precond s \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition replaceWithColon_toList ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_char list" where
  "replaceWithColon_toList s = s"

definition replaceWithColon_mk ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "replaceWithColon_mk chars = chars"

definition replaceWithColon :: "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "replaceWithColon s =
    (let cs = replaceWithColon_toList s;
         cs' =
           map
             (\<lambda>c. if isSpaceCommaDot c then lean_colon else c)
             cs
     in replaceWithColon_mk cs')"

fun replaceWithColon_getBang ::
    "lean_char list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "replaceWithColon_getBang [] i = lean_nul"
| "replaceWithColon_getBang (c # cs) 0 = c"
| "replaceWithColon_getBang (c # cs) (Suc i) =
    replaceWithColon_getBang cs i"

definition replaceWithColon_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "replaceWithColon_postcond s result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let cs = replaceWithColon_toList s;
         cs' = replaceWithColon_toList result
     in length result = length s \<and>
        (\<forall>i. i < length s \<longrightarrow>
          ((isSpaceCommaDot (replaceWithColon_getBang cs i)
              \<longrightarrow>
            replaceWithColon_getBang cs' i = lean_colon) \<and>
           (\<not> isSpaceCommaDot (replaceWithColon_getBang cs i)
              \<longrightarrow>
            replaceWithColon_getBang cs' i =
              replaceWithColon_getBang cs i))))"

theorem replaceWithColon_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "replaceWithColon_precond s"
  shows "replaceWithColon_postcond s (replaceWithColon s)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_36
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_36), catalog title "replaceWithColon": an
  executable Unicode-string map replaces spaces, commas, and dots with colons
  and leaves all other characters unchanged, together with its total
  length-preserving correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let replaceWithColon_validChar = new_definition
  `replaceWithColon_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let replaceWithColon_string = new_definition
  `replaceWithColon_string (s:num list) <=>
     ALL replaceWithColon_validChar s`;;

let isSpaceCommaDot = new_definition
  `isSpaceCommaDot (c:num) <=>
     c = 32 \/ c = 44 \/ c = 46`;;

let replaceWithColon_precond = new_definition
  `replaceWithColon_precond (s:num list) <=> T`;;

let replaceWithColon = new_definition
  `replaceWithColon (s:num list) =
     MAP
       (\c:num. if isSpaceCommaDot c then 58 else c)
       s`;;

let replaceWithColon_postcond = new_definition
  `replaceWithColon_postcond
      (s:num list) (result:num list) <=>
     LENGTH result = LENGTH s /\
     (!i:num.
        i < LENGTH s
        ==> (isSpaceCommaDot (EL i s)
             ==> EL i result = 58) /\
            (~isSpaceCommaDot (EL i s)
             ==> EL i result = EL i s))`;;

let replaceWithColon_spec_satisfied =
  `!s:num list.
     replaceWithColon_string s
     ==> replaceWithColon_precond s
     ==> replaceWithColon_postcond
           s (replaceWithColon s)`;;

title: verina_basic_36
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_36,
;; catalog title "replaceWithColon": a deterministic Unicode-string program
;; replaces spaces, commas, and dots with colons while preserving length and
;; every other character. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean String is canonically represented by its finite list of Unicode
;; scalar values, preserving the complete Lean Char domain.

(defun verina-basic-36-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-basic-36-string-p (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (and
       (verina-basic-36-unicode-scalar-p (car s))
       (verina-basic-36-string-p (cdr s)))
    (equal s nil)))

;; Unicode scalar values 32, 44, and 46 are space, comma, and dot.

(defun verina-basic-36-is-space-comma-dot (c)
  (or
   (equal c 32)
   (equal c 44)
   (equal c 46)))

;; The source precondition is True. The String binder domain remains explicit
;; in the final correctness statement.

(defun verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon-precond (s)
  (declare (ignore s))
  t)

;; Under the canonical representation, this structural recursion is exactly
;; String.toList, List.map with the source conditional, and String.mk. Unicode
;; scalar value 58 is colon. The proof-valued True precondition argument is
;; computationally irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon (s)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count s)))
  (if (consp s)
      (cons
       (if (verina-basic-36-is-space-comma-dot (car s))
           58
         (car s))
       (verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon (cdr s)))
    nil))

;; List.get! is only observed at in-bounds indices in the source postcondition.
;; This total accessor supplies Unicode NUL outside that range.

(defun verina-basic-36-char-at (i chars)
  (if (and
       (natp i)
       (< i (len chars)))
      (nth i chars)
    0))

;; This preserves the universal Nat index and both conditional clauses for
;; replaced and unchanged characters.

(defun-sk verina-basic-36-correct-at-every-index-p
    (s result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i (len s)))
     (and
      (implies
       (verina-basic-36-is-space-comma-dot
        (verina-basic-36-char-at i s))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-36-char-at i result)
        58))
      (implies
       (not
        (verina-basic-36-is-space-comma-dot
         (verina-basic-36-char-at i s)))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-36-char-at i result)
        (verina-basic-36-char-at i s)))))))

(defun verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon-postcond
    (s result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-36-string-p s)
   (verina-basic-36-string-p result)
   (equal (len result) (len s))
   (verina-basic-36-correct-at-every-index-p
    s
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It applies
;; the complete postcondition to the exact executable result for every typed
;; input satisfying the source's True precondition.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (s)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-36-string-p s)
      (verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon-precond s))
     (verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon-postcond
      s
      (verina-basic-36-replace-with-colon s)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_36
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_36,
-- catalog title "replaceWithColon": a deterministic string program replaces
-- every space, comma, or period with a colon, preserves all other characters
-- and the string length, and is connected to its pointwise correctness
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic36 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using
  (Char; primCharEquality; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.String using
  (String; primStringFromList; primStringToList)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → List A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

nullChar : Char
nullChar = primNatToChar zero

isSpaceCommaDot : Char → Bool
isSpaceCommaDot c =
  if primCharEquality c ' '
  then true
  else
    if primCharEquality c ','
    then true
    else
      if primCharEquality c '.'
      then true
      else false

replaceWithColonChar : Char → Char
replaceWithColonChar c =
  if isSpaceCommaDot c
  then ':'
  else c

replaceWithColon-precond : String → Set
replaceWithColon-precond s = Top

replaceWithColon :
  (s : String) →
  replaceWithColon-precond s →
  String
replaceWithColon s h-precond =
  primStringFromList
    (mapList replaceWithColonChar (primStringToList s))

replaceWithColon-postcond :
  (s : String) →
  (result : String) →
  replaceWithColon-precond s →
  Set
replaceWithColon-postcond s result h-precond =
  let inputChars = primStringToList s
      resultChars = primStringToList result
  in
    (listLength resultChars ≡ listLength inputChars) ∧
    ((i : Nat) →
      i < listLength inputChars →
      ((IsTrue (isSpaceCommaDot
          (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)) →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡ ':') ∧
       (Not (IsTrue (isSpaceCommaDot
          (indexDefault nullChar inputChars i))) →
        indexDefault nullChar resultChars i ≡
          indexDefault nullChar inputChars i)))

replaceWithColon-spec-satisfied : Set
replaceWithColon-spec-satisfied =
  (s : String) →
  (h-precond : replaceWithColon-precond s) →
  replaceWithColon-postcond
    s
    (replaceWithColon s h-precond)
    h-precond
