(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_49), catalog title "findFirstOdd": an
  executable left-to-right scan of a nonempty integer array returns the first
  odd element's natural-number index, or no index when every element is even,
  together with its exact first-occurrence correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let findFirstOdd_isOdd = new_definition
  `findFirstOdd_isOdd (x:int) <=>
     ~(x rem (&2:int) = (&0:int))`;;

let findFirstOdd_precond = new_definition
  `findFirstOdd_precond (a:int list) <=>
     LENGTH a > 0`;;

let findFirstOdd_scan =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num.
        findFirstOdd_scan ([]:int list) i =
        (NONE:num option)) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !i:num.
        findFirstOdd_scan (CONS x xs) i =
        if findFirstOdd_isOdd x then
          SOME i
        else
          findFirstOdd_scan xs (SUC i))`;;

let findFirstOdd = new_definition
  `findFirstOdd (a:int list) =
     findFirstOdd_scan a 0`;;

let findFirstOdd_postcond = new_definition
  `findFirstOdd_postcond
      (a:int list) (result:num option) <=>
     (result = NONE /\
      (!i:num.
         i < LENGTH a
         ==> ~findFirstOdd_isOdd (EL i a))) \/
     (?idx:num.
        result = SOME idx /\
        idx < LENGTH a /\
        findFirstOdd_isOdd (EL idx a) /\
        (!j:num.
           j < idx
           ==> ~findFirstOdd_isOdd (EL j a)))`;;

let findFirstOdd_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list.
     findFirstOdd_precond a
     ==> findFirstOdd_postcond a (findFirstOdd a)`;;

title: verina_basic_49
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49,
;; catalog title "findFirstOdd": a deterministic scan of a nonempty integer
;; array returns none when no entry is odd, or the least index containing an
;; odd integer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-49-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-49-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; With positive divisor two, ACL2 MOD and Lean Int.emod agree on every
;; integer, so this is exactly the source isOdd Boolean helper.

(defun verina-basic-49-is-odd (x)
  (not (equal (mod x 2) 0)))

(defun verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-precond (a)
  (< 0 (len a)))

;; Option Nat is represented by :none or the tagged dotted pair
;; (:some . index), keeping none distinct from every natural-number index.

(defun verina-basic-49-option-nat-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result :none)
   (and
    (consp result)
    (equal (car result) :some)
    (natp (cdr result)))))

;; REMAINING is the suffix whose first entry has zero-based source index
;; INDEX. Testing before recursion exactly reproduces List.find? over
;; a.toList.zipIdx followed by Option.map of the index projection.

(defun verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-loop
    (remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (verina-basic-49-is-odd (car remaining))
          (cons :some index)
        (verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-loop
         (cdr remaining)
         (+ index 1)))
    :none))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. Starting with the full array at index zero preserves the exact
;; executable source computation.

(defun verina-basic-49-find-first-odd (a)
  (verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-loop a 0))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the in-bounds entry and the inhabited
;; integer default zero outside the array.

(defun verina-basic-49-nth-default-zero (index a)
  (if (and
       (natp index)
       (< index (len a)))
      (nth index a)
    0))

;; These predicates preserve the source postcondition's universal Nat
;; binders and their exact strict bounds.

(defun-sk verina-basic-49-no-odd-before-p (a bound)
  (forall (j)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp j)
      (< j bound))
     (not
      (verina-basic-49-is-odd
       (verina-basic-49-nth-default-zero j a))))))

(defun-sk verina-basic-49-no-odd-in-array-p (a)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i (len a)))
     (not
      (verina-basic-49-is-odd
       (verina-basic-49-nth-default-zero i a))))))

;; This is the complete source match on the Option Nat result. A present
;; index is in bounds, points to an odd entry, and has no earlier odd entry;
;; an absent result means that every array entry is not odd.

(defun verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-postcond
    (a result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-49-int-array-p a)
   (verina-basic-49-option-nat-p result)
   (if (equal result :none)
       (verina-basic-49-no-odd-in-array-p a)
     (let ((index (cdr result)))
       (and
        (< index (len a))
        (verina-basic-49-is-odd
         (verina-basic-49-nth-default-zero index a))
        (verina-basic-49-no-odd-before-p
         a
         index))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over the complete Array Int domain, assumes exactly the source nonempty
;; precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-49-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-precond a))
     (verina-basic-49-find-first-odd-postcond
      a
      (verina-basic-49-find-first-odd a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_49
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49,
-- catalog title "findFirstOdd": a deterministic scan of a nonempty integer
-- array returns the least index containing an odd value, or no index exactly
-- when the array contains no odd value. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic49 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

naturalModTwo : Nat → Nat
naturalModTwo zero = zero
naturalModTwo (suc zero) = suc zero
naturalModTwo (suc (suc n)) = naturalModTwo n

-- Lean remainder modulo positive two is the nonnegative parity remainder.
moduloByTwo : Int → Int
moduloByTwo (pos n) = pos (naturalModTwo n)
moduloByTwo (negsuc n) = pos (naturalModTwo (suc n))

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

isOdd : Int → Bool
isOdd x = notBool (intEqual (moduloByTwo x) zeroInt)

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

findFirstOdd-precond : Array Int → Set
findFirstOdd-precond a = zero < arraySize a

findFirstOddFrom : Array Int → Nat → Maybe Nat
findFirstOddFrom [] index = nothing
findFirstOddFrom (x ∷ xs) index =
  if isOdd x
  then just index
  else findFirstOddFrom xs (suc index)

findFirstOdd :
  (a : Array Int) →
  findFirstOdd-precond a →
  Maybe Nat
findFirstOdd a h-precond =
  findFirstOddFrom a zero

findFirstOdd-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (result : Maybe Nat) →
  findFirstOdd-precond a →
  Set
findFirstOdd-postcond a (just idx) h-precond =
  (idx < arraySize a) ∧
  IsTrue (isOdd (indexDefault zeroInt a idx)) ∧
  ((j : Nat) →
    j < idx →
    Not (IsTrue (isOdd (indexDefault zeroInt a j))))
findFirstOdd-postcond a nothing h-precond =
  (i : Nat) →
  i < arraySize a →
  Not (IsTrue (isOdd (indexDefault zeroInt a i)))

findFirstOdd-spec-satisfied : Set
findFirstOdd-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : findFirstOdd-precond a) →
  findFirstOdd-postcond
    a
    (findFirstOdd a h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_49
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49,
  catalog title "findFirstOdd": the executable left-to-right scan of a
  nonempty integer array returns the natural-number index of its first odd
  entry, or NONE when no odd entry exists, under its complete correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val isOdd_def = new_definition (
  "isOdd_def",
  ``isOdd (x : int) <=> x % 2 <> 0``
);

val findFirstOdd_precond_def = new_definition (
  "findFirstOdd_precond_def",
  ``findFirstOdd_precond (a : int list) <=>
      LENGTH a > 0``
);

val findFirstOdd_from_def = Define `
  (findFirstOdd_from
      ([] : int list) (index : num) =
     (NONE : num option)) /\
  (findFirstOdd_from
      (x::xs) index =
     if isOdd x then
       SOME index
     else
       findFirstOdd_from xs (SUC index))
`;

val findFirstOdd_def = new_definition (
  "findFirstOdd_def",
  ``findFirstOdd (a : int list) =
      findFirstOdd_from a 0``
);

val findFirstOdd_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "findFirstOdd_postcond_def",
  ``findFirstOdd_postcond
      (a : int list) (result : num option) <=>
      case result of
        SOME index =>
          index < LENGTH a /\
          isOdd (EL index a) /\
          (!j : num.
             j < index ==>
             ~isOdd (EL j a))
      | NONE =>
          !i : num.
            i < LENGTH a ==>
            ~isOdd (EL i a)``
);

val findFirstOdd_spec_satisfied =
  ``!a : int list.
      findFirstOdd_precond a ==>
      findFirstOdd_postcond a (findFirstOdd a)``;

title: verina_basic_49
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_49), catalog title findFirstOdd: the exact
  executable indexed-list search returns the least natural index containing
  an odd integer in a nonempty finite array, or none when no such index
  exists, and satisfies its complete correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays and lists.
  For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based
  lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid-index set. The Boolean
  domain is represented by { 0 , 1 }, with false = 0 and true = 1.

  VERINAB49IsOdd is exactly the source Boolean helper x % 2 != 0. For the
  positive divisor two, SetMM integer remainder agrees with Lean's
  nonnegative Int remainder on every integer. VERINAB49GetBang reproduces
  Lean Array.get! on integer arrays, including its inhabited default zero
  outside the array. VERINAB49ToList is the source Array.toList conversion
  extensionally.

  VERINAB49Pair is Int x Nat. VERINAB49IndexedGraph and VERINAB49Indexed
  construct exactly a.toList.zipIdx: the output has the same length and its
  entry at each valid position i is the pair (a[i], i).
  VERINAB49FirstMatch is the unique least indexed-list position whose value
  is odd. VERINAB49FindPair returns the pair at that position when one
  exists, and none otherwise, exactly reproducing the source List.find?.

  VERINAB49None, VERINAB49Some, VERINAB49OptionPair, and
  VERINAB49OptionNat are disjoint tagged encodings of the two source option
  types. VERINAB49FoundValue extracts the pair from a successful find, and
  VERINAB49MapIndex reproduces Option.map (fun (_, i) => i).
  VERINAB49FindFirstOdd composes these exact source operations, so its output
  is fixed independently of the postcondition and admits no additional
  results.

  VERINAB49Pre is exactly the positive-size precondition on an Array Int.
  VERINAB49Post preserves both branches of the source option match: some idx
  requires an in-bounds odd entry and no odd entry at an earlier natural
  index, while none requires that every valid array entry is not odd. The
  proof-valued precondition arguments to the implementation and
  postcondition have no computational or propositional effect beyond the
  explicit antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a
  is syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB49IsOdd VERINAB49GetBang VERINAB49ToList
  VERINAB49Pair VERINAB49IndexedGraph VERINAB49Indexed
  VERINAB49None VERINAB49Some VERINAB49OptionPair VERINAB49OptionNat
  VERINAB49FirstMatch VERINAB49FindPair
  VERINAB49FoundValue VERINAB49MapIndex
  VERINAB49Pre VERINAB49FindFirstOdd VERINAB49Post
$.

verinab49-is-odd-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49IsOdd A ) $.
verinab49-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49GetBang A B ) $.
verinab49-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49ToList A ) $.
verinab49-pair-syntax
  $a class VERINAB49Pair $.
verinab49-indexed-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB49IndexedGraph A B ) $.
verinab49-indexed-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49Indexed A ) $.
verinab49-none-syntax
  $a class VERINAB49None $.
verinab49-some-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49Some A ) $.
verinab49-option-pair-syntax
  $a class VERINAB49OptionPair $.
verinab49-option-nat-syntax
  $a class VERINAB49OptionNat $.
verinab49-first-match-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49FirstMatch A ) $.
verinab49-find-pair-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49FindPair A ) $.
verinab49-found-value-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49FoundValue A ) $.
verinab49-map-index-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49MapIndex A ) $.
verinab49-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB49Pre A ) $.
verinab49-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB49FindFirstOdd A ) $.
verinab49-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB49Post A B ) $.

verinab49-is-odd-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49IsOdd A
) = if (
  ( A mod 2 ) =/= 0 ,
  1 ,
  0
) $.

verinab49-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verinab49-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49ToList A
) = A $.

verinab49-pair-definition $a |- VERINAB49Pair = (
  ZZ X. NN0
) $.

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab49-indexed-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49IndexedGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. Word VERINAB49Pair
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( B ` i ) = <. ( A ` i ) , i >.
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab49-indexed-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49Indexed A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB49Pair
      ( VERINAB49IndexedGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab49-none-definition $a |- VERINAB49None = (/) $.

verinab49-some-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49Some A
) = <. 1 , A >. $.

${
  $d p x $.

  verinab49-option-pair-definition $a |- VERINAB49OptionPair =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINAB49None
        \/
        E. p e. VERINAB49Pair x = ( VERINAB49Some p )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d n x $.

  verinab49-option-nat-definition $a |- VERINAB49OptionNat =
    { x |
      (
        x = VERINAB49None
        \/
        E. n e. NN0 x = ( VERINAB49Some n )
      )
    } $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab49-first-match-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49FirstMatch A
  ) = (
    iota_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        (
          VERINAB49IsOdd
            ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) )
        ) = 1
        /\
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ i )
          (
            VERINAB49IsOdd
              ( 1st ` ( A ` j ) )
          ) = 0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A $.

  verinab49-find-pair-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49FindPair A
  ) = if (
    E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        VERINAB49IsOdd
          ( 1st ` ( A ` i ) )
      ) = 1 ,
    (
      VERINAB49Some
        ( A ` ( VERINAB49FirstMatch A ) )
    ) ,
    VERINAB49None
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d p A $.

  verinab49-found-value-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49FoundValue A
  ) = (
    iota_ p e. VERINAB49Pair
      A = ( VERINAB49Some p )
  ) $.
$}

verinab49-map-index-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49MapIndex A
) = if (
  A = VERINAB49None ,
  VERINAB49None ,
  (
    VERINAB49Some
      ( 2nd ` ( VERINAB49FoundValue A ) )
  )
) $.

verinab49-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49Pre A
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    0 < ( # ` A )
  )
) $.

verinab49-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB49FindFirstOdd A
) = (
  VERINAB49MapIndex
    (
      VERINAB49FindPair
        (
          VERINAB49Indexed
            ( VERINAB49ToList A )
        )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verinab49-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB49Post A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. VERINAB49OptionNat
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        B = VERINAB49None
        /\
        A. i e. NN0
          (
            i < ( # ` A )
            ->
            (
              VERINAB49IsOdd
                ( VERINAB49GetBang A i )
            ) = 0
          )
      )
      \/
      E. i e. NN0
        (
          B = ( VERINAB49Some i )
          /\
          (
            (
              i < ( # ` A )
              /\
              (
                VERINAB49IsOdd
                  ( VERINAB49GetBang A i )
              ) = 1
            )
            /\
            A. j e. NN0
              (
                j < i
                ->
                (
                  VERINAB49IsOdd
                    ( VERINAB49GetBang A j )
                ) = 0
              )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-49-find-first-odd $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  (
    ( VERINAB49Pre w )
    ->
    (
      VERINAB49Post
        w
        ( VERINAB49FindFirstOdd w )
    )
  )
$.

title: verina_basic_49
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_49, catalog title "findFirstOdd": the integer-parity helper,
:: nonempty-array precondition, exact zero-based left-to-right optional-index
:: search, first-odd postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex isOdd being Function of INT,BOOLEAN,
     findFirstOddPrecond being Function of INT*,BOOLEAN,
     findFirstOddFrom being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],NAT*,
     findFirstOdd being Function of INT*,NAT*,
     findFirstOddPostcond being Function of [:INT*,NAT*:],BOOLEAN st
    (for n being Integer holds
      (isOdd/.n = TRUE iff n mod (2 qua Integer) <> 0) &
      (isOdd/.n = FALSE iff n mod (2 qua Integer) = 0)) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      (findFirstOddPrecond/.a = TRUE iff 0 < len a) &
      (findFirstOddPrecond/.a = FALSE iff not 0 < len a)) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, i being Nat holds
      (len a <= i &
        findFirstOddFrom/.[a,i] = <*>NAT) or
      (i < len a &
        isOdd/.(a/.(i + 1)) = TRUE &
        findFirstOddFrom/.[a,i] = <*i*>) or
      (i < len a &
        isOdd/.(a/.(i + 1)) = FALSE &
        findFirstOddFrom/.[a,i] =
          findFirstOddFrom/.[a,i + 1])) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      findFirstOdd/.a = findFirstOddFrom/.[a,0]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         result being FinSequence of NAT holds
      (findFirstOddPostcond/.[a,result] = TRUE iff
        ((result = <*>NAT &
            for i being Nat st i < len a holds
              isOdd/.(a/.(i + 1)) = FALSE) or
         (ex idx being Nat st
            result = <*idx*> &
            idx < len a &
            isOdd/.(a/.(idx + 1)) = TRUE &
            for j being Nat st j < idx holds
              isOdd/.(a/.(j + 1)) = FALSE))) &
      (findFirstOddPostcond/.[a,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          ((result = <*>NAT &
              for i being Nat st i < len a holds
                isOdd/.(a/.(i + 1)) = FALSE) or
           (ex idx being Nat st
              result = <*idx*> &
              idx < len a &
              isOdd/.(a/.(idx + 1)) = TRUE &
              for j being Nat st j < idx holds
                isOdd/.(a/.(j + 1)) = FALSE)))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT st
      findFirstOddPrecond/.a = TRUE
    holds
      findFirstOddPostcond/.[a,findFirstOdd/.a] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_49
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_49,
% catalog title "findFirstOdd": a deterministic left-to-right scan of a
% nonempty integer array returns the index of its first odd entry, or none
% when no odd entry exists. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_49: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_option: DATATYPE
  BEGIN
    NoNat: NoNat?
    SomeNat(option_value: nat): SomeNat?
  END nat_option

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  isOdd(value: int): bool =
    mod(value, 2) /= 0

  findFirstOdd_precond(
      a: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(a) > 0

  % This is exactly the source's toList.zipIdx.find? scan followed by mapping
  % the first matching pair to its index.
  find_first_odd_from(
      remaining: list[int],
      index: nat): RECURSIVE nat_option =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        NoNat,
      cons(value, rest):
        IF isOdd(value) THEN
          SomeNat(index)
        ELSE
          find_first_odd_from(rest, index + 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  findFirstOdd(
      a: list[int]): nat_option =
    find_first_odd_from(a, 0)

  findFirstOdd_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      result: nat_option): bool =
    CASES result OF
      NoNat:
        FORALL (i: nat):
          i < int_list_length(a)
            IMPLIES
              NOT isOdd(int_list_get_bang(i, a)),
      SomeNat(idx):
        idx < int_list_length(a)
          AND isOdd(int_list_get_bang(idx, a))
          AND
            (FORALL (j: nat):
              j < idx
                IMPLIES
                  NOT isOdd(int_list_get_bang(j, a)))
    ENDCASES

  findFirstOdd_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int]):
      findFirstOdd_precond(a)
        IMPLIES
          findFirstOdd_postcond(
            a,
            findFirstOdd(a))

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_5,
-- catalog title "multiply": a total integer program returns the product of
-- its two inputs and is connected to its two-difference correctness contract.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
intAdd (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
intAdd (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
intAdd (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

intMultiply : Int → Int → Int
intMultiply (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
intMultiply (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

multiply-precond : Int → Int → Set
multiply-precond a b = Top

multiply :
  (a b : Int) →
  multiply-precond a b →
  Int
multiply a b h-precond =
  intMultiply a b

multiply-postcond :
  (a b result : Int) →
  multiply-precond a b →
  Set
multiply-postcond a b result h-precond =
  (intSubtract result (intMultiply a b) ≡ zeroInt) ∧
  (intSubtract (intMultiply a b) result ≡ zeroInt)

multiply-spec-satisfied : Set
multiply-spec-satisfied =
  (a b : Int) →
  (h-precond : multiply-precond a b) →
  multiply-postcond
    a
    b
    (multiply a b h-precond)
    h-precond

    second : B

data Nonnegative : Int → Set where
  nonnegative : {n : Nat} → Nonnegative (pos n)

data Negative : Int → Set where
  negative : {n : Nat} → Negative (negsuc n)

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int

intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =

  (x : Int) →
  (result : Int) →
  Abs-precond x →

  (Negative x → intAdd x result ≡ zeroInt)

% catalog title "Abs": computing the absolute value of any integer by preserving
% nonnegative inputs and negating negative inputs, with its branchwise
% correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_50: THEORY
BEGIN

  Abs_precond(x: int): bool =
    TRUE

  Abs(x: int): int =
    IF x < 0 THEN -x ELSE x ENDIF

  Abs_postcond(
      x, result: int): bool =
    (x >= 0 IMPLIES x = result)
      AND
    (x < 0 IMPLIES x + result = 0)

  Abs_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (x: int):
      Abs_precond(x)
        IMPLIES
          Abs_postcond(
            x,
            Abs(x))

END verina_basic_50

title: verina_basic_51
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51,
   catalog title "BinarySearch": executable lower-bound binary search for the
   insertion index of an integer in a nondecreasing integer array, together
   with its prefix/suffix ordering contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List Sorting.Sorted
  ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition BinarySearch_precond
    (a : list Z)
    (_key : Z) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le a.

Fixpoint binarySearchLoop_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (a : list Z)
    (key : Z)
    (lo hi : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => lo
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb lo hi then
        let mid := Nat.div (Nat.add lo hi) 2%nat in
        if Z.ltb (nth mid a 0%Z) key
        then binarySearchLoop_fuel fuel' a key (S mid) hi
        else binarySearchLoop_fuel fuel' a key lo mid
      else
        lo
  end.

Definition binarySearchLoop
    (a : list Z)
    (key : Z)
    (lo hi : nat) : nat :=
  binarySearchLoop_fuel (S (Nat.sub hi lo)) a key lo hi.

Definition BinarySearch
    (a : list Z)
    (key : Z)
    (_h_precond : BinarySearch_precond a key) : nat :=
  binarySearchLoop a key 0%nat (length a).

Definition BinarySearch_postcond
    (a : list Z)
    (key : Z)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : BinarySearch_precond a key) : Prop :=
  Nat.le result (length a) /\
  forallb (fun x => Z.ltb x key) (firstn result a) = true /\
  forallb (fun x => Z.leb key x) (skipn result a) = true.

Theorem BinarySearch_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (key : Z)
    (h_precond : BinarySearch_precond a key) :
  BinarySearch_postcond
    a key (BinarySearch a key h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_51
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_51), catalog title "BinarySearch": an
  executable binary-search loop returns the lower-bound insertion index in a
  pairwise nondecreasing integer array, together with its precondition,
  postcondition, and final correctness proposition. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_51
  imports Main
begin

fun BinarySearch_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BinarySearch_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "BinarySearch_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     BinarySearch_pairwise_le xs)"

definition BinarySearch_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BinarySearch_precond a key \<longleftrightarrow>
    BinarySearch_pairwise_le a"

definition binarySearch_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "binarySearch_getBang a i =
    (if i < length a then a ! i else 0)"

partial_function (tailrec) binarySearchLoop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "binarySearchLoop a key lo hi =
    (if lo < hi then
       let mid = (lo + hi) div 2
       in if binarySearch_getBang a mid < key
          then binarySearchLoop a key (mid + 1) hi
          else binarySearchLoop a key lo mid
     else lo)"

definition BinarySearch :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "BinarySearch a key =
    binarySearchLoop a key 0 (length a)"

definition BinarySearch_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BinarySearch_postcond a key result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result \<le> length a \<and>
    list_all (\<lambda>x. x < key) (take result a) \<and>
    list_all (\<lambda>x. x \<ge> key) (drop result a)"

theorem BinarySearch_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "BinarySearch_precond a key"
  shows "BinarySearch_postcond a key (BinarySearch a key)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_51
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_51), catalog title "BinarySearch": an
  executable lower-bound binary search on a nondecreasing integer array,
  together with its insertion-index correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let binarySearch_getDefault = new_definition
  `binarySearch_getDefault (a:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH a then EL i a else (&0:int)`;;

let BinarySearch_precond = new_definition
  `BinarySearch_precond (a:int list) (key:int) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) a`;;

let binarySearchLoopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list. !key:int. !lo:num. !hi:num.
        binarySearchLoopFuel 0 a key lo hi = lo) /\
     (!fuel:num. !a:int list. !key:int. !lo:num. !hi:num.
        binarySearchLoopFuel (SUC fuel) a key lo hi =
        if lo < hi then
          let mid = (lo + hi) DIV 2 in
          if binarySearch_getDefault a mid < key then
            binarySearchLoopFuel fuel a key (mid + 1) hi
          else
            binarySearchLoopFuel fuel a key lo mid
        else
          lo)`;;

let binarySearchLoop = new_definition
  `binarySearchLoop
      (a:int list) (key:int) (lo:num) (hi:num) =
     binarySearchLoopFuel (hi - lo) a key lo hi`;;

let BinarySearch = new_definition
  `BinarySearch (a:int list) (key:int) =
     binarySearchLoop a key 0 (LENGTH a)`;;

let BinarySearch_postcond = new_definition
  `BinarySearch_postcond
      (a:int list) (key:int) (result:num) <=>
     result <= LENGTH a /\
     (!i:num.
        i < result
        ==> binarySearch_getDefault a i < key) /\
     (!i:num.
        result <= i /\ i < LENGTH a
        ==> key <= binarySearch_getDefault a i)`;;

let BinarySearch_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !key:int.
     BinarySearch_precond a key
     ==> BinarySearch_postcond
           a key (BinarySearch a key)`;;

title: verina_basic_51
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51,
;; catalog title "BinarySearch": deterministic lower-bound binary search on a
;; nondecreasing integer array returns an insertion index with every preceding
;; value below the key and every following value at least the key. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-51-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-51-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; These predicates are exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y): each head
;; is at most every later value, recursively for every suffix.

(defun verina-basic-51-head-at-most-all-p
    (head remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (<= head (car remaining))
       (verina-basic-51-head-at-most-all-p
        head
        (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-51-head-at-most-all-p
        (car a)
        (cdr a))
       (verina-basic-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

(defun verina-basic-51-binary-search-precond
    (a key)
  (declare (ignore key))
  (verina-basic-51-pairwise-nondecreasing-p a))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the in-bounds entry and the inhabited
;; integer default zero outside the array.

(defun verina-basic-51-array-read (index a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp a)
        (if (zp index)
            (car a)
          (verina-basic-51-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr a)))
      0)))

;; This fuel recursion evaluates binarySearchLoop. For natural LO and HI the
;; wrapper supplies HI-LO units. Whenever LO < HI, MID=floor((LO+HI)/2) makes
;; each source recursive call strictly reduce that width, so fuel cannot
;; expire before the source base case and does not change the result.

(defun verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop-fuel
    (a key lo hi fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (zp fuel)
       (not (natp lo))
       (not (natp hi))
       (not (< lo hi)))
      lo
    (let* ((mid
            (floor (+ lo hi) 2))
           (mid-value
            (verina-basic-51-array-read mid a)))
      (if (< mid-value key)
          (verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop-fuel
           a
           key
           (+ mid 1)
           hi
           (- fuel 1))
        (verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop-fuel
         a
         key
         lo
         mid
         (- fuel 1))))))

(defun verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop
    (a key lo hi)
  (verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop-fuel
   a
   key
   lo
   hi
   (nfix (- hi lo))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. The initial interval [0, a.size) exactly reproduces the source
;; executable BinarySearch function.

(defun verina-basic-51-binary-search (a key)
  (verina-basic-51-binary-search-loop
   a
   key
   0
   (len a)))

;; These are Array.take and Array.drop at a natural count under the list
;; representation.

(defun verina-basic-51-take (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (if (consp values)
        (cons
         (car values)
         (verina-basic-51-take
          (- count 1)
          (cdr values)))
      nil)))

(defun verina-basic-51-drop (count values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      values
    (if (consp values)
        (verina-basic-51-drop
         (- count 1)
         (cdr values))
      nil)))

;; These predicates are Array.all for the two source comparisons.

(defun verina-basic-51-all-less-than-p
    (values key)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (< (car values) key)
       (verina-basic-51-all-less-than-p
        (cdr values)
        key))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun verina-basic-51-all-at-least-p
    (values key)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (>= (car values) key)
       (verina-basic-51-all-at-least-p
        (cdr values)
        key))
    (equal values nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The proof-valued precondition
;; argument is unused and erased.

(defun verina-basic-51-binary-search-postcond
    (a key result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-51-int-array-p a)
   (integerp key)
   (natp result)
   (<= result (len a))
   (verina-basic-51-all-less-than-p
    (verina-basic-51-take result a)
    key)
   (verina-basic-51-all-at-least-p
    (verina-basic-51-drop result a)
    key)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every finite integer array and integer key, assumes exactly the source
;; sortedness precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-51-binary-search-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a key)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-51-int-array-p a)
      (integerp key)
      (verina-basic-51-binary-search-precond
       a
       key))
     (verina-basic-51-binary-search-postcond
      a
      key
      (verina-basic-51-binary-search a key)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_51
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51,
-- catalog title "BinarySearch": a deterministic lower-bound binary search on
-- a nondecreasing integer array returns an insertion index whose prefix is
-- below the key and whose suffix is at least the key. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic51 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; div-helper)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

naturalDiv : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero = zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natLessOrEqual n m

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual x y = intLessOrEqual y x

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

two : Nat
two = suc (suc zero)

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) =
  x ∷ takeList n xs

dropList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
dropList zero xs = xs
dropList (suc n) [] = []
dropList (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) =
  dropList n xs

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} → (A → A → Set) → List A → Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

BinarySearch-precond : Array Int → Int → Set
BinarySearch-precond a key =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual a

binarySearchLoopFuel :
  Nat →
  Array Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
binarySearchLoopFuel zero a key lo hi = lo
binarySearchLoopFuel (suc fuel) a key lo hi =
  if natLess lo hi
  then
    (let mid = naturalDiv (lo + hi) two
     in
       if intLess (indexDefault zeroInt a mid) key
       then binarySearchLoopFuel fuel a key (suc mid) hi
       else binarySearchLoopFuel fuel a key lo mid)
  else lo

binarySearchLoop :
  Array Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
binarySearchLoop a key lo hi =
  binarySearchLoopFuel
    (natSubtract hi lo)
    a
    key
    lo
    hi

BinarySearch :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (key : Int) →
  BinarySearch-precond a key →
  Nat
BinarySearch a key h-precond =
  binarySearchLoop a key zero (arraySize a)

BinarySearch-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (key : Int) →
  (result : Nat) →
  BinarySearch-precond a key →
  Set
BinarySearch-postcond a key result h-precond =
  (result ≤ arraySize a) ∧
  IsTrue (allList (λ x → intLess x key) (takeList result a)) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ x → intGreaterOrEqual x key)
      (dropList result a))

BinarySearch-spec-satisfied : Set
BinarySearch-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (key : Int) →
  (h-precond : BinarySearch-precond a key) →
  BinarySearch-postcond
    a
    key
    (BinarySearch a key h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51,
  catalog title "BinarySearch": the executable lower-bound binary search on a
  nondecreasing integer array returns the first insertion index separating
  entries below the key from entries at least the key. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val BinarySearch_pairwiseLe_def = Define `
  (BinarySearch_pairwiseLe ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (BinarySearch_pairwiseLe (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
      BinarySearch_pairwiseLe xs))
`;

val BinarySearch_precond_def = new_definition (
  "BinarySearch_precond_def",
  ``BinarySearch_precond
      (a : int list) (key : int) <=>
      BinarySearch_pairwiseLe a``
);

val BinarySearch_nthD_def = Define `
  (BinarySearch_nthD
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (BinarySearch_nthD
      0 (x::xs) = x) /\
  (BinarySearch_nthD
      (SUC index) (x::xs) =
     BinarySearch_nthD index xs)
`;

val binarySearchLoopFuel_def = Define `
  (binarySearchLoopFuel
      (a : int list) (key : int)
      (lo : num) (hi : num) 0 =
     lo) /\
  (binarySearchLoopFuel
      a key lo hi (SUC fuel) =
     if lo < hi then
       let mid = (lo + hi) DIV 2 in
         if BinarySearch_nthD mid a < key then
           binarySearchLoopFuel a key (mid + 1) hi fuel
         else
           binarySearchLoopFuel a key lo mid fuel
     else
       lo)
`;

val binarySearchLoop_def = new_definition (
  "binarySearchLoop_def",
  ``binarySearchLoop
      (a : int list) (key : int)
      (lo : num) (hi : num) =
      binarySearchLoopFuel a key lo hi (hi - lo)``
);

val BinarySearch_def = new_definition (
  "BinarySearch_def",
  ``BinarySearch (a : int list) (key : int) =
      binarySearchLoop a key 0 (LENGTH a)``
);

val BinarySearch_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "BinarySearch_postcond_def",
  ``BinarySearch_postcond
      (a : int list) (key : int) (result : num) <=>
      result <= LENGTH a /\
      EVERY (\x : int. x < key) (TAKE result a) /\
      EVERY (\x : int. key <= x) (DROP result a)``
);

val BinarySearch_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (key : int).
      BinarySearch_precond a key ==>
      BinarySearch_postcond a key (BinarySearch a key)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_51), catalog title BinarySearch: the exact
  executable recursive lower-bound binary search on a nondecreasing finite
  integer array returns its insertion index and satisfies the strict-prefix
  and greater-or-equal-suffix correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays and their
  toList conversions. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number length,
  w ` i is zero-based lookup, 0 ..^ n is { 0, ..., n - 1 }, and m ..^ n is
  the half-open natural interval from m through n - 1.

  VERINAB51ToList is Array.toList, extensionally the identity on this finite
  word representation. VERINAB51GetBang reproduces Lean Array.get! on integer
  arrays, including its inhabited default value zero outside the array.
  VERINAB51PairwiseLE is exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y), expressed
  over every earlier/later index pair. VERINAB51Pre preserves that sortedness
  precondition together with both source input types.

  VERINAB51LoopGraph is the complete finite execution trace of the source
  binarySearchLoop for every typed array, integer key, and natural lo and hi.
  Every nonterminal state has lo < hi, uses floor((lo + hi) / 2), and takes
  exactly the source branch determined by get! at that midpoint. Its final
  state has hi <= lo and returns lo, exactly matching the source else branch.
  VERINAB51Loop selects the unique natural result fixed by this trace, and
  VERINAB51BinarySearch invokes it with lo zero and hi equal to the array
  size. Thus the executable output is fixed independently of the postcondition
  and the graph admits no extra outputs, including for unsorted arrays or
  arbitrary natural helper bounds.

  VERINAB51Post is bidirectionally equivalent to the source Array.take/all and
  Array.drop/all conjunction. Its first conjunct requires result <= size; under
  that bound, take result has exactly indices below result and drop result has
  exactly the indices from result through size - 1. The two bounded universal
  clauses therefore preserve the source strict-prefix and
  greater-or-equal-suffix Boolean all tests, including empty ranges.

  The proof-valued precondition arguments to the implementation and
  postcondition have no computational or propositional effect beyond the
  explicit antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is
  syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering, and this
  database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB51ToList VERINAB51GetBang
  VERINAB51PairwiseLE VERINAB51Pre
  VERINAB51LoopGraph VERINAB51Loop
  VERINAB51BinarySearch VERINAB51Post
$.

verinab51-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB51ToList A ) $.
verinab51-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB51GetBang A B ) $.
verinab51-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB51PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab51-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB51Pre A B ) $.
verinab51-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB51LoopGraph A B C D E ) $.
verinab51-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB51Loop A B C D ) $.
verinab51-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB51BinarySearch A B ) $.
verinab51-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB51Post A B C ) $.

verinab51-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB51ToList A
) = A $.

verinab51-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB51GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab51-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB51PairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
        )
  ) $.
$}

verinab51-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB51Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    VERINAB51PairwiseLE
      ( VERINAB51ToList A )
  )
) $.

${
  $d i l r A B C D E $.

  verinab51-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB51LoopGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. ZZ
        )
        /\
        (
          C e. NN0
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
      )
      /\
      E e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. l e. Word NN0
      E. r e. Word NN0
        (
          (
            (
              (
                ( # ` l ) = ( # ` r )
                /\
                0 < ( # ` l )
              )
              /\
              (
                ( l ` 0 ) = C
                /\
                ( r ` 0 ) = D
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                r ` ( ( # ` r ) - 1 )
              ) <_ (
                l ` ( ( # ` l ) - 1 )
              )
              /\
              E = ( l ` ( ( # ` l ) - 1 ) )
            )
          )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` l ) - 1 ) )
            (
              ( l ` i ) < ( r ` i )
              /\
              (
                (
                  l ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  (
                    VERINAB51GetBang
                      A
                      (
                        |_ ` (
                          (
                            ( l ` i ) + ( r ` i )
                          ) / 2
                        )
                      )
                  ) < B ,
                  (
                    (
                      |_ ` (
                        (
                          ( l ` i ) + ( r ` i )
                        ) / 2
                      )
                    ) + 1
                  ) ,
                  ( l ` i )
                )
                /\
                (
                  r ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = if (
                  (
                    VERINAB51GetBang
                      A
                      (
                        |_ ` (
                          (
                            ( l ` i ) + ( r ` i )
                          ) / 2
                        )
                      )
                  ) < B ,
                  ( r ` i ) ,
                  (
                    |_ ` (
                      (
                        ( l ` i ) + ( r ` i )
                      ) / 2
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verinab51-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB51Loop A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB51LoopGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab51-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB51BinarySearch A B
) = (
  VERINAB51Loop A B 0 ( # ` A )
) $.

${
  $d i A B C $.

  verinab51-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB51Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      C <_ ( # ` A )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ C )
          ( A ` i ) < B
        /\
        A. i e. ( C ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          B <_ ( A ` i )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-51-binary-search
  $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
    A. k e. ZZ
      (
        ( VERINAB51Pre w k )
        ->
        (
          VERINAB51Post
            w
            k
            ( VERINAB51BinarySearch w k )
        )
      )
  $.

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_51), catalog title "BinarySearch": the
:: non-decreasing integer-array precondition, zero-defaulting array read,
:: exact recursive binary-search implementation, insertion-index
:: postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex binarySearchPrecond being Function of [:INT*,INT:],BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],INT,
     binarySearchLoop being
       Function of [:INT*,INT,[:NAT,NAT:]:],NAT,
     binarySearch being Function of [:INT*,INT:],NAT,
     binarySearchPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, key being Integer holds
      (binarySearchPrecond/.[a,key] = TRUE iff
        for i,j being Nat st
          i in dom a & j in dom a & i < j
        holds a/.i <= a/.j) &
      (binarySearchPrecond/.[a,key] = FALSE iff
        not
          (for i,j being Nat st
            i in dom a & j in dom a & i < j
          holds a/.i <= a/.j))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, i being Nat holds
      ((i < len a &
          readDefault/.[a,i] = a/.(i + 1)) or
       (len a <= i &
          readDefault/.[a,i] = 0))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, key being Integer,
         lo,hi being Nat holds
      ((lo < hi &
        ex mid being Nat st
          mid = (lo + hi) div 2 &
          ((readDefault/.[a,mid] < key &
              binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[lo,hi]] =
                binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[mid + 1,hi]]) or
           (not readDefault/.[a,mid] < key &
              binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[lo,hi]] =
                binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[lo,mid]]))) or
       (not lo < hi &
          binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[lo,hi]] = lo))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, key being Integer holds
      binarySearch/.[a,key] =
        binarySearchLoop/.[a,key,[0,len a]]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, key being Integer,
         result being Nat holds
      (binarySearchPostcond/.[a,key,result] = TRUE iff
        result <= len a &
        (for i being Nat st i < result holds
          a/.(i + 1) < key) &
        (for i being Nat st result <= i & i < len a holds
          key <= a/.(i + 1))) &
      (binarySearchPostcond/.[a,key,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result <= len a &
           (for i being Nat st i < result holds
             a/.(i + 1) < key) &
           (for i being Nat st result <= i & i < len a holds
             key <= a/.(i + 1))))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, key being Integer st
      binarySearchPrecond/.[a,key] = TRUE
    holds
      binarySearchPostcond/.[a,key,binarySearch/.[a,key]] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_51
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_51,
% catalog title "BinarySearch": lower-bound binary search on a sorted finite
% integer array returns the first insertion index satisfying the source
% precondition and postcondition. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_51: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND int_list_all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Lean List.Pairwise (fun first later => first <= later).
  int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  BinarySearch_precond(
      a: list[int],
      key: int): bool =
    int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(a)

  % When lo < hi, each source recursive call strictly shrinks hi - lo.
  % Therefore hi - lo + 1 fuel is sufficient, and the fuel-zero branch is
  % unreachable from binarySearchLoop.
  binarySearchLoop_fuel(
      a: list[int],
      key: int,
      lo, hi, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      lo
    ELSIF lo < hi THEN
      LET mid: nat = ndiv(lo + hi, 2)
      IN
        IF int_list_get_bang(mid, a) < key THEN
          binarySearchLoop_fuel(
            a,
            key,
            mid + 1,
            hi,
            fuel - 1)
        ELSE
          binarySearchLoop_fuel(
            a,
            key,
            lo,
            mid,
            fuel - 1)
        ENDIF
    ELSE
      lo
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  binarySearchLoop(
      a: list[int],
      key: int,
      lo, hi: nat): nat =
    IF lo < hi THEN
      binarySearchLoop_fuel(
        a,
        key,
        lo,
        hi,
        hi - lo + 1)
    ELSE
      lo
    ENDIF

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  BinarySearch(
      a: list[int],
      key: int): nat =
    binarySearchLoop(
      a,
      key,
      0,
      int_list_length(a))

  int_list_take(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[int]
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_take(count - 1, tail))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_drop(
      count: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      values
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null:
          null[int],
        cons(head, tail):
          int_list_drop(count - 1, tail)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  int_list_all_less_than(
      upper: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head < upper
          AND int_list_all_less_than(upper, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  BinarySearch_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      key: int,
      result: nat): bool =
    result <= int_list_length(a)
      AND
        int_list_all_less_than(
          key,
          int_list_take(result, a))
      AND
        int_list_all_at_least(
          key,
          int_list_drop(result, a))

  BinarySearch_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int], key: int):
      BinarySearch_precond(a, key)
        IMPLIES
          BinarySearch_postcond(
            a,
            key,
            BinarySearch(a, key))

END verina_basic_51
