title: verina_basic_52
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52,
   catalog title "BubbleSort": executable bubble sort on an integer array,
   together with nondecreasing sortedness, permutation correctness, and the
   final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List
  Sorting.Permutation Sorting.Sorted ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition BubbleSort_precond (_a : list Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint bubbleSort_set_nth
    (index : nat)
    (value : Z)
    (a : list Z) : list Z :=
  match a with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      match index with
      | O => value :: rest
      | S index' => x :: bubbleSort_set_nth index' value rest
      end
  end.

Definition swap
    (a : list Z)
    (i j : nat) : list Z :=
  let temp := nth i a 0%Z in
  let a1 := bubbleSort_set_nth i (nth j a 0%Z) a in
  bubbleSort_set_nth j temp a1.

Fixpoint bubbleInner_fuel
    (fuel j : nat)
    (a : list Z) : list Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => a
  | S fuel' =>
      let a' :=
        if Z.gtb (nth j a 0%Z) (nth (S j) a 0%Z)
        then swap a j (S j)
        else a in
      bubbleInner_fuel fuel' (S j) a'
  end.

Definition bubbleInner
    (j i : nat)
    (a : list Z) : list Z :=
  bubbleInner_fuel (i - j)%nat j a.

Fixpoint bubbleOuter
    (i : nat)
    (a : list Z) : list Z :=
  match i with
  | O => a
  | S i' => bubbleOuter i' (bubbleInner 0%nat (S i') a)
  end.

Definition BubbleSort
    (a : list Z)
    (_h_precond : BubbleSort_precond a) : list Z :=
  if Nat.eqb (length a) 0%nat
  then a
  else bubbleOuter (length a - 1)%nat a.

Definition BubbleSort_postcond
    (a result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : BubbleSort_precond a) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Z.le result /\
  Permutation result a.

Theorem BubbleSort_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (h_precond : BubbleSort_precond a) :
  BubbleSort_postcond
    a (BubbleSort a h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_52
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_52), catalog title "BubbleSort": an
  executable bubble-sort program repeatedly swaps adjacent out-of-order
  integers and returns a pairwise nondecreasing permutation of the input,
  together with its unconditional precondition, postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_52
  imports Main
begin

definition BubbleSort_precond :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BubbleSort_precond a \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition bubbleSort_getBang :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "bubbleSort_getBang a i =
    (if i < length a then a ! i else 0)"

definition bubbleSort_setBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "bubbleSort_setBang a i x =
    (if i < length a then list_update a i x else a)"

definition bubbleSort_swap ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "bubbleSort_swap a i j =
    (let temp = bubbleSort_getBang a i;
         a1 = bubbleSort_setBang a i (bubbleSort_getBang a j)
     in bubbleSort_setBang a1 j temp)"

fun bubbleInner_steps ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "bubbleInner_steps 0 j a = a"
| "bubbleInner_steps (Suc n) j a =
    (let a' =
       (if bubbleSort_getBang a j > bubbleSort_getBang a (j + 1)
        then bubbleSort_swap a j (j + 1)
        else a)
     in bubbleInner_steps n (j + 1) a')"

definition bubbleInner ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "bubbleInner j i a = bubbleInner_steps (i - j) j a"

fun bubbleOuter :: "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "bubbleOuter 0 a = a"
| "bubbleOuter (Suc i) a =
    bubbleOuter i (bubbleInner 0 (Suc i) a)"

definition BubbleSort :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "BubbleSort a =
    (if length a = 0 then a else bubbleOuter (length a - 1) a)"

fun BubbleSort_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BubbleSort_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "BubbleSort_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     BubbleSort_pairwise_le xs)"

definition BubbleSort_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "BubbleSort_postcond a result \<longleftrightarrow>
    BubbleSort_pairwise_le result \<and>
    (\<forall>z. count_list result z = count_list a z)"

theorem BubbleSort_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "BubbleSort_precond a"
  shows "BubbleSort_postcond a (BubbleSort a)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_52
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_52), catalog title "BubbleSort": an
  executable bubble-sort traversal of an integer array, including defaulted
  indexing, indexed updates, swapping, and the inner and outer loops, with its
  total precondition and sorted-permutation correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let bubbleSort_getDefault = new_definition
  `bubbleSort_getDefault (a:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH a then EL i a else (&0:int)`;;

let bubbleSort_setAt =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !value:int.
        bubbleSort_setAt ([]:int list) i value = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !i:num. !value:int.
        bubbleSort_setAt (CONS x xs) i value =
        if i = 0 then CONS value xs
        else CONS x (bubbleSort_setAt xs (PRE i) value))`;;

let BubbleSort_precond = new_definition
  `BubbleSort_precond (a:int list) <=> T`;;

let swap = new_definition
  `swap (a:int list) (i:num) (j:num) =
     let temp = bubbleSort_getDefault a i in
     let a1 =
       bubbleSort_setAt a i (bubbleSort_getDefault a j) in
     bubbleSort_setAt a1 j temp`;;

let bubbleInnerFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!j:num. !i:num. !a:int list.
        bubbleInnerFuel 0 j i a = a) /\
     (!fuel:num. !j:num. !i:num. !a:int list.
        bubbleInnerFuel (SUC fuel) j i a =
        if j < i then
          let a' =
            if bubbleSort_getDefault a j >
               bubbleSort_getDefault a (j + 1)
            then swap a j (j + 1)
            else a in
          bubbleInnerFuel fuel (j + 1) i a'
        else
          a)`;;

let bubbleInner = new_definition
  `bubbleInner (j:num) (i:num) (a:int list) =
     bubbleInnerFuel (i - j) j i a`;;

let bubbleOuter =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list.
        bubbleOuter 0 a = a) /\
     (!i:num. !a:int list.
        bubbleOuter (SUC i) a =
        let a' = bubbleInner 0 (SUC i) a in
        bubbleOuter i a')`;;

let BubbleSort = new_definition
  `BubbleSort (a:int list) =
     if LENGTH a = 0 then a
     else bubbleOuter (LENGTH a - 1) a`;;

let BubbleSort_count = new_definition
  `BubbleSort_count (value:int) (a:int list) =
     LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = value) a)`;;

let BubbleSort_isPerm = new_definition
  `BubbleSort_isPerm (xs:int list) (ys:int list) <=>
     !value:int.
       BubbleSort_count value xs =
       BubbleSort_count value ys`;;

let BubbleSort_postcond = new_definition
  `BubbleSort_postcond
      (a:int list) (result:int list) <=>
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) result /\
     BubbleSort_isPerm result a`;;

let BubbleSort_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list.
     BubbleSort_precond a
     ==> BubbleSort_postcond a (BubbleSort a)`;;

title: verina_basic_52
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52,
;; catalog title "BubbleSort": the executable bubble-sort program returns a
;; nondecreasing integer array that is a permutation of its input. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-52-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-52-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int domain remains explicit in
;; the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-sort-precond (a)
  (declare (ignore a))
  t)

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the indexed entry when it is present and
;; the inhabited integer default zero otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-52-array-read (index a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp a)
        (if (zp index)
            (car a)
          (verina-basic-52-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr a)))
      0)))

;; Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves the array unchanged when
;; the natural index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-basic-52-array-set (index value a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      a
    (if (consp a)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons value (cdr a))
          (cons
           (car a)
           (verina-basic-52-array-set
            (- index 1)
            value
            (cdr a))))
      nil)))

;; This is the exact ordered pair of reads and writes in the source swap
;; helper, including the total get! and set! behavior at arbitrary Nat indices.

(defun verina-basic-52-swap (a i j)
  (let* ((temp
          (verina-basic-52-array-read i a))
         (a1
          (verina-basic-52-array-set
           i
           (verina-basic-52-array-read j a)
           a)))
    (verina-basic-52-array-set j temp a1)))

;; For natural J and I, I-J fuel units are exactly the number of source
;; recursive calls before J reaches I. Thus fuel cannot expire while J < I,
;; and this function computes bubbleInner without admitting extra outcomes.

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-inner-fuel
    (j i a fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (zp fuel)
       (not (natp j))
       (not (natp i))
       (not (< j i)))
      a
    (let* ((next-index (+ j 1))
           (next-a
            (if (>
                 (verina-basic-52-array-read j a)
                 (verina-basic-52-array-read next-index a))
                (verina-basic-52-swap
                 a
                 j
                 next-index)
              a)))
      (verina-basic-52-bubble-inner-fuel
       next-index
       i
       next-a
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-inner (j i a)
  (verina-basic-52-bubble-inner-fuel
   j
   i
   a
   (nfix (- i j))))

;; For natural I, I fuel units reproduce the source recursive countdown to
;; zero. Each pass invokes the exact bubbleInner computation before decreasing
;; I, just as in bubbleOuter.

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-outer-fuel
    (i a fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (zp fuel)
       (not (natp i))
       (not (> i 0)))
      a
    (let ((next-a
           (verina-basic-52-bubble-inner
            0
            i
            a)))
      (verina-basic-52-bubble-outer-fuel
       (- i 1)
       next-a
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-outer (i a)
  (verina-basic-52-bubble-outer-fuel
   i
   a
   (nfix i)))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. This empty-array branch and initial outer index exactly
;; reproduce the source BubbleSort implementation.

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-sort (a)
  (if (equal (len a) 0)
      a
    (verina-basic-52-bubble-outer
     (- (len a) 1)
     a)))

;; These predicates are exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y): each head
;; is at most every later entry, recursively for every suffix.

(defun verina-basic-52-head-at-most-all-p
    (head remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (<= head (car remaining))
       (verina-basic-52-head-at-most-all-p
        head
        (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-52-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-52-head-at-most-all-p
        (car a)
        (cdr a))
       (verina-basic-52-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; Removing one matching occurrence at each step gives exact finite-list
;; multiset equality, including duplicate multiplicities, and hence List.isPerm.

(defun verina-basic-52-remove-first (value a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (if (equal value (car a))
          (cdr a)
        (cons
         (car a)
         (verina-basic-52-remove-first
          value
          (cdr a))))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-52-permutation-p (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (verina-basic-52-permutation-p
        (cdr left)
        (verina-basic-52-remove-first
         (car left)
         right)))
    (equal right nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The proof-valued precondition
;; argument is unused and erased.

(defun verina-basic-52-bubble-sort-postcond
    (a result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-52-int-array-p a)
   (verina-basic-52-int-array-p result)
   (verina-basic-52-pairwise-nondecreasing-p result)
   (verina-basic-52-permutation-p result a)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every finite integer array satisfying the source True precondition and
;; applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-52-bubble-sort-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-52-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-52-bubble-sort-precond a))
     (verina-basic-52-bubble-sort-postcond
      a
      (verina-basic-52-bubble-sort a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_52
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52,
-- catalog title "BubbleSort": the deterministic bubble-sort array program
-- returns the input integers in nondecreasing order with the same multiset.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic52 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolAnd : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolAnd true right = right
boolAnd false right = false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natLessOrEqual n m

intGreater : Int → Int → Bool
intGreater x y = intLess y x

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

one : Nat
one = suc zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

updateAt : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat → A → Array A
updateAt [] index value = []
updateAt (x ∷ xs) zero value = value ∷ xs
updateAt (x ∷ xs) (suc index) value =
  x ∷ updateAt xs index value

BubbleSort-precond : Array Int → Set
BubbleSort-precond a = Top

swap : Array Int → Nat → Nat → Array Int
swap a i j =
  let temporary = indexDefault zeroInt a i
      first-update =
        updateAt a i (indexDefault zeroInt a j)
  in updateAt first-update j temporary

bubbleInnerSteps :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Array Int →
  Array Int
bubbleInnerSteps j zero a = a
bubbleInnerSteps j (suc remaining) a =
  let next = suc j
      updated =
        if intGreater
             (indexDefault zeroInt a j)
             (indexDefault zeroInt a next)
        then swap a j next
        else a
  in bubbleInnerSteps next remaining updated

bubbleInner :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Array Int →
  Array Int
bubbleInner j i a =
  bubbleInnerSteps j (natSubtract i j) a

bubbleOuter : Nat → Array Int → Array Int
bubbleOuter zero a = a
bubbleOuter (suc i) a =
  bubbleOuter i (bubbleInner zero (suc i) a)

BubbleSort :
  (a : Array Int) →
  BubbleSort-precond a →
  Array Int
BubbleSort a h-precond =
  if natEqual (arraySize a) zero
  then a
  else bubbleOuter
         (natSubtract (arraySize a) one)
         a

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} →
  (A → A → Set) →
  List A →
  Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

listIsEmpty : {A : Set} → List A → Bool
listIsEmpty [] = true
listIsEmpty (_ ∷ _) = false

containsInt : List Int → Int → Bool
containsInt [] sought = false
containsInt (x ∷ xs) sought =
  if intEqual x sought
  then true
  else containsInt xs sought

eraseFirstInt : Int → List Int → List Int
eraseFirstInt sought [] = []
eraseFirstInt sought (x ∷ xs) =
  if intEqual x sought
  then xs
  else (x ∷ eraseFirstInt sought xs)

listIsPerm : List Int → List Int → Bool
listIsPerm [] ys = listIsEmpty ys
listIsPerm (x ∷ xs) ys =
  boolAnd
    (containsInt ys x)
    (listIsPerm xs (eraseFirstInt x ys))

BubbleSort-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (result : Array Int) →
  BubbleSort-precond a →
  Set
BubbleSort-postcond a result h-precond =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual result ∧
  IsTrue (listIsPerm result a)

BubbleSort-spec-satisfied : Set
BubbleSort-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : BubbleSort-precond a) →
  BubbleSort-postcond
    a
    (BubbleSort a h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_52
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52,
  catalog title "BubbleSort": the executable bubble-sort program swaps
  adjacent out-of-order integers and returns a pairwise nondecreasing
  permutation of the input array. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory sortingTheory;

val BubbleSort_precond_def = new_definition (
  "BubbleSort_precond_def",
  ``BubbleSort_precond (a : int list) <=> T``
);

val BubbleSort_nthD_def = Define `
  (BubbleSort_nthD
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (BubbleSort_nthD
      0 (x::xs) = x) /\
  (BubbleSort_nthD
      (SUC index) (x::xs) =
     BubbleSort_nthD index xs)
`;

val BubbleSort_setD_def = new_definition (
  "BubbleSort_setD_def",
  ``BubbleSort_setD
      (a : int list) (index : num) (value : int) =
      if index < LENGTH a then
        LUPDATE value index a
      else
        a``
);

val swap_def = new_definition (
  "swap_def",
  ``swap (a : int list) (i : num) (j : num) =
      let temp = BubbleSort_nthD i a in
      let a1 =
        BubbleSort_setD a i (BubbleSort_nthD j a)
      in
        BubbleSort_setD a1 j temp``
);

val bubbleInnerFuel_def = Define `
  (bubbleInnerFuel
      0 (j : num) (i : num) (a : int list) =
     a) /\
  (bubbleInnerFuel
      (SUC fuel) j i a =
     if j < i then
       let a1 =
         if BubbleSort_nthD j a >
            BubbleSort_nthD (j + 1) a
         then
           swap a j (j + 1)
         else
           a
       in
         bubbleInnerFuel fuel (j + 1) i a1
     else
       a)
`;

val bubbleInner_def = new_definition (
  "bubbleInner_def",
  ``bubbleInner (j : num) (i : num) (a : int list) =
      bubbleInnerFuel (i - j) j i a``
);

val bubbleOuter_def = Define `
  (bubbleOuter 0 (a : int list) = a) /\
  (bubbleOuter (SUC i) a =
     let a1 = bubbleInner 0 (SUC i) a
     in
       bubbleOuter i a1)
`;

val BubbleSort_def = new_definition (
  "BubbleSort_def",
  ``BubbleSort (a : int list) =
      if LENGTH a = 0 then
        a
      else
        bubbleOuter (LENGTH a - 1) a``
);

val BubbleSort_pairwiseLe_def = Define `
  (BubbleSort_pairwiseLe ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (BubbleSort_pairwiseLe (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
      BubbleSort_pairwiseLe xs))
`;

val BubbleSort_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "BubbleSort_postcond_def",
  ``BubbleSort_postcond
      (a : int list) (result : int list) <=>
      BubbleSort_pairwiseLe result /\
      PERM result a``
);

val BubbleSort_spec_satisfied =
  ``!a : int list.
      BubbleSort_precond a ==>
      BubbleSort_postcond a (BubbleSort a)``;

title: verina_basic_52
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_52), catalog title BubbleSort: the exact
  adjacent-swap inner loop and decreasing-bound outer loop sort an arbitrary
  finite integer array into a nondecreasing permutation of its input. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays and their
  toList conversions. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number length,
  w ` k is zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid
  index set.

  VERINAB52NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB52GetBang reproduces Array.get! on integer arrays, including its
  inhabited default value zero outside the array. VERINAB52SetBangGraph and
  its iota-selected function reproduce Array.set!, including unchanged-array
  behavior at an out-of-range index. VERINAB52Swap performs the source's two
  left-to-right set! calls after saving the original entry at its first index.

  VERINAB52InnerGraph is the complete finite execution trace of bubbleInner
  for every natural j and i and every integer array. It has max(i - j, 0)
  transitions. Transition k compares exactly the current entries at j + k
  and j + k + 1 and swaps them precisely when the left entry is greater.
  VERINAB52BubbleInner selects the unique final array fixed by that trace.

  VERINAB52OuterGraph is the complete finite execution trace of bubbleOuter.
  Starting with bound i, its k-th transition invokes bubbleInner at zero with
  bound i - k, so the successive positive bounds are i, i - 1, ..., 1.
  VERINAB52BubbleOuter selects the unique final array. VERINAB52BubbleSort
  preserves the source empty-array branch and otherwise starts bubbleOuter
  at a.size - 1. Thus the executable output is fixed independently of the
  postcondition and neither graph admits additional outputs.

  VERINAB52ToList is Array.toList, extensionally the identity on this finite
  word representation. VERINAB52PairwiseLE is exactly List.Pairwise (<=),
  and VERINAB52Perm is List.isPerm, represented equivalently by equality of
  every integer's multiplicity. VERINAB52Pre is the source True precondition
  on typed Array Int inputs, and VERINAB52Post is the source conjunction of
  sortedness and permutation. The proof-valued precondition arguments have no
  computational or propositional effect beyond the explicit antecedent in
  the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB52NatSub VERINAB52GetBang
  VERINAB52SetBangGraph VERINAB52SetBang VERINAB52Swap
  VERINAB52InnerGraph VERINAB52BubbleInner
  VERINAB52OuterGraph VERINAB52BubbleOuter
  VERINAB52Pre VERINAB52BubbleSort VERINAB52ToList
  VERINAB52PairwiseLE VERINAB52Perm VERINAB52Post
$.

verinab52-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52NatSub A B ) $.
verinab52-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52GetBang A B ) $.
verinab52-set-bang-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52SetBangGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab52-set-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52SetBang A B C ) $.
verinab52-swap-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52Swap A B C ) $.
verinab52-inner-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52InnerGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab52-inner-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52BubbleInner A B C ) $.
verinab52-outer-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52OuterGraph A B C ) $.
verinab52-outer-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52BubbleOuter A B ) $.
verinab52-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52Pre A ) $.
verinab52-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52BubbleSort A ) $.
verinab52-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB52ToList A ) $.
verinab52-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab52-permutation-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52Perm A B ) $.
verinab52-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB52Post A B ) $.

verinab52-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB52NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab52-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB52GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d k A B C D $.

  verinab52-set-bang-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB52SetBangGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        C e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      D e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( D ` k ) = if (
          k = B ,
          C ,
          ( A ` k )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab52-set-bang-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB52SetBang A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB52SetBangGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab52-swap-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB52Swap A B C
) = (
  VERINAB52SetBang
    (
      VERINAB52SetBang
        A
        B
        ( VERINAB52GetBang A C )
    )
    C
    ( VERINAB52GetBang A B )
) $.

${
  $d k t A B C D $.

  verinab52-inner-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB52InnerGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. NN0
          /\

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_52), catalog title "BubbleSort": zero-default
:: array reads, bounds-checked updates, exact swap and recursive bubble-sort
:: implementation, sorted-permutation postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, FUNCT_4, FUNCT_7, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1,

    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FUNCT_7, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0,
    XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex bubbleSortPrecond being Function of INT*,BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],INT,
     setBang being Function of [:INT*,NAT,INT:],INT*,
     swap being Function of [:INT*,NAT,NAT:],INT*,
     bubbleInner being Function of [:NAT,NAT,INT*:],INT*,
     bubbleOuter being Function of [:NAT,INT*:],INT*,
     bubbleSort being Function of INT*,INT*,
     bubbleSortPostcond being Function of [:INT*,INT*:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      bubbleSortPrecond/.a = TRUE) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, i being Nat holds
      ((i < len a &
          readDefault/.[a,i] = a/.(i + 1)) or
       (len a <= i &
          readDefault/.[a,i] = 0))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, i being Nat,
         x being Integer holds
      ((i < len a &
          setBang/.[a,i,x] = a +* ((i + 1),x)) or
       (len a <= i &
          setBang/.[a,i,x] = a))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, i,j being Nat holds
      swap/.[a,i,j] =
        setBang/.[setBang/.[a,i,readDefault/.[a,j]],j,
          readDefault/.[a,i]]) &
    (for j,i being Nat, a being FinSequence of INT holds
      ((j < i &
        ((readDefault/.[a,j + 1] < readDefault/.[a,j] &
            bubbleInner/.[j,i,a] =
              bubbleInner/.[j + 1,i,swap/.[a,j,j + 1]]) or
         (not readDefault/.[a,j + 1] < readDefault/.[a,j] &
            bubbleInner/.[j,i,a] =
              bubbleInner/.[j + 1,i,a]))) or
       (not j < i &
          bubbleInner/.[j,i,a] = a))) &
    (for i being Nat, a being FinSequence of INT holds
      ((0 < i &
          bubbleOuter/.[i,a] =
            bubbleOuter/.[i -' 1,bubbleInner/.[0,i,a]]) or
       (not 0 < i &
          bubbleOuter/.[i,a] = a))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT holds
      ((len a = 0 &
          bubbleSort/.a = a) or
       (0 < len a &
          bubbleSort/.a = bubbleOuter/.[len a -' 1,a]))) &
    (for a,result being FinSequence of INT holds
      (bubbleSortPostcond/.[a,result] = TRUE iff
        ((for i,j being Nat st
            i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
          holds result/.i <= result/.j) &
         result,a are_fiberwise_equipotent)) &
      (bubbleSortPostcond/.[a,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          ((for i,j being Nat st
              i in dom result & j in dom result & i < j
            holds result/.i <= result/.j) &
           result,a are_fiberwise_equipotent))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT st
      bubbleSortPrecond/.a = TRUE
    holds
      bubbleSortPostcond/.[a,bubbleSort/.a] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_52,
% catalog title "BubbleSort": the exact bubble-sort array computation produces
% a nondecreasing permutation of every finite integer input array. This file
% contains no proof.

verina_basic_52: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves an out-of-bounds
  % array unchanged.
  int_list_set_bang(
      index: nat,
      new_value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(new_value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_set_bang(
              index - 1,
              new_value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  BubbleSort_precond(a: list[int]): bool =
    TRUE

  swap(
      a: list[int],
      i, j: nat): list[int] =
    LET temp: int =
          int_list_get_bang(i, a),
        first_update: list[int] =
          int_list_set_bang(
            i,
            int_list_get_bang(j, a),
            a)
    IN
      int_list_set_bang(
        j,
        temp,
        first_update)

  % Starting bubbleInner_fuel with i - j fuel makes the fuel-zero branch
  % unreachable while j < i, so this is exactly the source inner loop.
  bubbleInner_fuel(
      j, i: nat,
      a: list[int],
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF j < i THEN
      IF fuel = 0 THEN
        a
      ELSE
        LET updated: list[int] =
              IF int_list_get_bang(j, a)
                   > int_list_get_bang(j + 1, a)
              THEN
                swap(a, j, j + 1)
              ELSE
                a
              ENDIF
        IN
          bubbleInner_fuel(
            j + 1,
            i,
            updated,
            fuel - 1)
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      a
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  bubbleInner(
      j, i: nat,
      a: list[int]): list[int] =
    bubbleInner_fuel(
      j,
      i,
      a,
      nat_subtract(i, j))

  % Starting bubbleOuter_fuel with i fuel makes its fuel-zero branch
  % unreachable while i > 0, preserving the exact source outer loop.
  bubbleOuter_fuel(
      i: nat,
      a: list[int],
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF i > 0 THEN
      IF fuel = 0 THEN
        a
      ELSE
        LET updated: list[int] =
              bubbleInner(0, i, a)
        IN
          bubbleOuter_fuel(
            nat_subtract(i, 1),
            updated,
            fuel - 1)
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      a
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  bubbleOuter(
      i: nat,
      a: list[int]): list[int] =
    bubbleOuter_fuel(i, a, i)

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  BubbleSort(a: list[int]): list[int] =
    IF int_list_length(a) = 0 THEN
      a
    ELSE
      bubbleOuter(
        nat_subtract(int_list_length(a), 1),
        a)
    ENDIF

  int_list_all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND int_list_all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Lean List.Pairwise (fun first later => first <= later).
  int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_list_count(
      value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF head = value THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + int_list_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % For finite integer lists, equality of every value's multiplicity is
  % equivalent to Lean List.isPerm.
  int_lists_are_permutations(
      first, second: list[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      int_list_count(value, first)
        = int_list_count(value, second)

  BubbleSort_postcond(
      a, result: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(result)
      AND int_lists_are_permutations(result, a)

  BubbleSort_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int]):
      BubbleSort_precond(a)
        IMPLIES
          BubbleSort_postcond(
            a,
            BubbleSort(a))

END verina_basic_52

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_53,
   catalog title "CalSum": an executable recursive sum of the natural numbers
   from one through N, together with its unrestricted precondition, doubled
   closed-form postcondition, and final correctness proposition. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition CalSum_precond (_N : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint CalSum_loop (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => O
  | S k => S k + CalSum_loop k
  end.

Definition CalSum
    (N : nat)
    (_h_precond : CalSum_precond N) : nat :=
  CalSum_loop N.

Definition CalSum_postcond
    (N result : nat)
    (_h_precond : CalSum_precond N) : Prop :=
  2 * result = N * (N + 1).

Theorem CalSum_spec_satisfied
    (N : nat)
    (h_precond : CalSum_precond N) :
  CalSum_postcond N (CalSum N h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_53,
;; catalog title "CalSum": a deterministic natural-number recursion computes
;; the sum from one through N and satisfies the standard doubled triangular-
;; number identity. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The Nat input domain remains explicit in
;; the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-53-cal-sum-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; This is the source-local LOOP recursion. Zero returns zero; every positive
;; natural N adds N to the result at N - 1. The proof-valued precondition
;; argument to CalSum is computationally irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-53-cal-sum-loop (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (+ n
       (verina-basic-53-cal-sum-loop
        (- n 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-53-cal-sum (n)
  (verina-basic-53-cal-sum-loop n))

;; This is the complete source postcondition, with both Nat binder domains
;; represented explicitly.

(defun verina-basic-53-cal-sum-postcond (n result)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp result)
   (equal
    (* 2 result)
    (* n (+ n 1)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every natural input, assumes exactly the source True precondition, and
;; applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk verina-basic-53-cal-sum-spec-satisfied-statement ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (verina-basic-53-cal-sum-precond n))
     (verina-basic-53-cal-sum-postcond
      n
      (verina-basic-53-cal-sum n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_53,
-- catalog title "CalSum": a deterministic natural-number recursion computes
-- the sum from N down to one and is connected to its arithmetic-series
-- correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic53 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

CalSum-precond : Nat → Set
CalSum-precond N = Top

CalSum-loop : Nat → Nat
CalSum-loop zero = zero
CalSum-loop (suc n) =
  suc n + CalSum-loop n

CalSum :
  (N : Nat) →
  CalSum-precond N →
  Nat
CalSum N h-precond =
  CalSum-loop N

CalSum-postcond :
  (N result : Nat) →
  CalSum-precond N →
  Set
CalSum-postcond N result h-precond =
  2 * result ≡ N * (N + 1)

CalSum-spec-satisfied : Set
CalSum-spec-satisfied =
  (N : Nat) →
  (h-precond : CalSum-precond N) →
  CalSum-postcond
    N
    (CalSum N h-precond)
    h-precond

  natural-number recursion sums the integers from one through N and satisfies
  the closed-form correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain. For N in NN0, the finite sum
  over 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) adds exactly 0, 1, ..., N using natural addition.

  VERINAB53Loop is definitionally equivalent to the source local recursion:
  at zero its only summand is zero, and extending the range from N to N + 1
  adds the new summand N + 1. VERINAB53CalSum invokes that helper unchanged,
  so the executable result is fixed independently of the postcondition and
  no additional outputs are admitted.

  VERINAB53Pre is the source True precondition together with the Nat input
  type. VERINAB53Post preserves the Nat result type and the exact source
  equation 2 * result = N * (N + 1). The proof-valued precondition arguments
  to the implementation and postcondition are computationally and
  propositionally unused beyond the explicit antecedent in the final
  correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition
  required by this rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB53Loop VERINAB53Pre VERINAB53CalSum VERINAB53Post
$.

title: verina_basic_53

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_53
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_53), catalog title "CalSum": recursively summing
% the natural numbers from N down to one and stating the exact arithmetic
% correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_53: THEORY
BEGIN

  CalSum_precond(N: nat): bool =
    TRUE

  CalSum_loop(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      n + CalSum_loop(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  CalSum(N: nat): nat =
    CalSum_loop(N)

  CalSum_postcond(
      N, result: nat): bool =
    2 * result = N * (N + 1)

  CalSum_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (N: nat):
      CalSum_precond(N)
        IMPLIES
          CalSum_postcond(
            N,
            CalSum(N))

END verina_basic_53

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54,
   catalog title "CanyonSearch": an executable two-pointer search for the
   minimum absolute difference between elements of two nonempty nondecreasing
   integer arrays, together with its correctness contract. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List Sorting.Sorted
  ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition CanyonSearch_precond
    (a b : list Z) : Prop :=
  a <> [] /\
  b <> [] /\
  StronglySorted Z.le a /\
  StronglySorted Z.le b.

Fixpoint canyonSearchAux_fuel
    (fuel : nat)
    (a b : list Z)
    (m n d : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => d
  | S fuel' =>
      if andb (Nat.ltb m (length a)) (Nat.ltb n (length b))
      then
        let ai := nth m a 0%Z in
        let bi := nth n b 0%Z in
        let diff := Z.abs_nat (ai - bi)%Z in
        let new_d := if Nat.ltb diff d then diff else d in
        if Z.leb ai bi
        then canyonSearchAux_fuel fuel' a b (S m) n new_d
        else canyonSearchAux_fuel fuel' a b m (S n) new_d
      else d
  end.

Definition canyonSearchAux
    (a b : list Z)
    (m n d : nat) : nat :=
  canyonSearchAux_fuel
    (Nat.sub (Nat.sub (Nat.add (length a) (length b)) m) n)
    a b m n d.

Definition CanyonSearch
    (a b : list Z)
    (_h_precond : CanyonSearch_precond a b) : nat :=
  let a0 := nth 0%nat a 0%Z in
  let b0 := nth 0%nat b 0%Z in
  let init :=
    if Z.ltb a0 b0
    then Z.abs_nat (b0 - a0)%Z
    else Z.abs_nat (a0 - b0)%Z in
  canyonSearchAux a b 0%nat 0%nat init.

Definition CanyonSearch_postcond
    (a b : list Z)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : CanyonSearch_precond a b) : Prop :=
  (exists ai bi : Z,
      In ai a /\
      In bi b /\
      result = Z.abs_nat (ai - bi)%Z) /\
  (forall ai bi : Z,
      In ai a ->
      In bi b ->
      Nat.le result (Z.abs_nat (ai - bi)%Z)).

Theorem CanyonSearch_spec_satisfied
    (a b : list Z)
    (h_precond : CanyonSearch_precond a b) :
  CanyonSearch_postcond
    a b (CanyonSearch a b h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_54
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_54), catalog title "CanyonSearch": an
  executable two-pointer search computes the minimum absolute difference
  between elements of two nonempty pairwise nondecreasing integer arrays,
  together with its precondition, postcondition, and final correctness
  proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_54
  imports Main
begin

definition canyonSearch_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "canyonSearch_getBang xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else 0)"

definition canyonSearch_natAbs :: "int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "canyonSearch_natAbs x = nat (abs x)"

fun canyonSearch_pairwise_le :: "int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "canyonSearch_pairwise_le [] = True"
| "canyonSearch_pairwise_le (x # xs) =
    (list_all (\<lambda>y. x \<le> y) xs \<and>
     canyonSearch_pairwise_le xs)"

definition CanyonSearch_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "CanyonSearch_precond a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    length a > 0 \<and>
    length b > 0 \<and>
    canyonSearch_pairwise_le a \<and>
    canyonSearch_pairwise_le b"

fun canyonSearchAux_steps ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "canyonSearchAux_steps 0 a b m n d = d"
| "canyonSearchAux_steps (Suc fuel) a b m n d =
    (if m < length a \<and> n < length b then
       let diff =
         canyonSearch_natAbs
           (canyonSearch_getBang a m - canyonSearch_getBang b n);
           new_d = (if diff < d then diff else d)
       in if canyonSearch_getBang a m \<le> canyonSearch_getBang b n
          then canyonSearchAux_steps fuel a b (m + 1) n new_d
          else canyonSearchAux_steps fuel a b m (n + 1) new_d
     else d)"

definition canyonSearchAux ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "canyonSearchAux a b m n d =
    canyonSearchAux_steps (length a + length b - m - n) a b m n d"

definition CanyonSearch :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "CanyonSearch a b =
    (let a0 = canyonSearch_getBang a 0;
         b0 = canyonSearch_getBang b 0;
         init =
           (if a0 < b0
            then canyonSearch_natAbs (b0 - a0)
            else canyonSearch_natAbs (a0 - b0))
     in canyonSearchAux a b 0 0 init)"

definition CanyonSearch_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "CanyonSearch_postcond a b result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>ai\<in>set a. \<exists>bi\<in>set b.
      result = canyonSearch_natAbs (ai - bi)) \<and>
    (\<forall>ai\<in>set a. \<forall>bi\<in>set b.
      result \<le> canyonSearch_natAbs (ai - bi))"

theorem CanyonSearch_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "CanyonSearch_precond a b"
  shows "CanyonSearch_postcond a b (CanyonSearch a b)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_54
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_54), catalog title "CanyonSearch": an
  executable two-pointer scan computes the minimum absolute difference between
  elements of two nonempty nondecreasing integer arrays, together with its
  exact minimum-and-attainment correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let canyonSearch_getDefault = new_definition
  `canyonSearch_getDefault (xs:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH xs then EL i xs else (&0:int)`;;

let canyonSearch_natAbsDiff = new_definition
  `canyonSearch_natAbsDiff (x:int) (y:int) =
     num_of_int (abs (x - y))`;;

let CanyonSearch_precond = new_definition
  `CanyonSearch_precond (a:int list) (b:int list) <=>
     0 < LENGTH a /\
     0 < LENGTH b /\
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) a /\
     PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) b`;;

let canyonSearchAuxFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list. !b:int list. !m:num. !n:num. !d:num.
        canyonSearchAuxFuel 0 a b m n d = d) /\
     (!fuel:num. !a:int list. !b:int list. !m:num. !n:num. !d:num.
        canyonSearchAuxFuel (SUC fuel) a b m n d =
        if m < LENGTH a /\ n < LENGTH b then
          let diff =
            canyonSearch_natAbsDiff
              (canyonSearch_getDefault a m)
              (canyonSearch_getDefault b n) in
          let new_d = if diff < d then diff else d in
          if canyonSearch_getDefault a m <=
             canyonSearch_getDefault b n
          then
            canyonSearchAuxFuel fuel a b (m + 1) n new_d
          else
            canyonSearchAuxFuel fuel a b m (n + 1) new_d
        else
          d)`;;

let canyonSearchAux = new_definition
  `canyonSearchAux
      (a:int list) (b:int list) (m:num) (n:num) (d:num) =
     canyonSearchAuxFuel
       (LENGTH a + LENGTH b - m - n) a b m n d`;;

let CanyonSearch = new_definition
  `CanyonSearch (a:int list) (b:int list) =
     let a0 = canyonSearch_getDefault a 0 in
     let b0 = canyonSearch_getDefault b 0 in
     let init =
       if a0 < b0 then canyonSearch_natAbsDiff b0 a0
       else canyonSearch_natAbsDiff a0 b0 in
     canyonSearchAux a b 0 0 init`;;

let CanyonSearch_postcond = new_definition
  `CanyonSearch_postcond
      (a:int list) (b:int list) (result:num) <=>
     (?ai:int. ?bi:int.
        MEM ai a /\
        MEM bi b /\
        result = canyonSearch_natAbsDiff ai bi) /\
     (!ai:int. !bi:int.
        MEM ai a /\ MEM bi b
        ==> result <= canyonSearch_natAbsDiff ai bi)`;;

let CanyonSearch_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !b:int list.
     CanyonSearch_precond a b
     ==> CanyonSearch_postcond a b (CanyonSearch a b)`;;

title: verina_basic_54
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54,
;; catalog title "CanyonSearch": a deterministic two-pointer search of two
;; nonempty nondecreasing integer arrays computes their minimum pairwise
;; absolute difference. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-54-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-54-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; These predicates are exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y): each head
;; is at most every later entry, recursively for every suffix.

(defun verina-basic-54-head-at-most-all-p
    (head remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (<= head (car remaining))
       (verina-basic-54-head-at-most-all-p
        head
        (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-54-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-54-head-at-most-all-p
        (car a)
        (cdr a))
       (verina-basic-54-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; Array.size > 0 is nonemptiness in the list representation. Together with
;; the two Pairwise predicates this is exactly the source precondition.

(defun verina-basic-54-canyon-search-precond (a b)
  (and
   (consp a)
   (consp b)
   (verina-basic-54-pairwise-nondecreasing-p a)
   (verina-basic-54-pairwise-nondecreasing-p b)))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the indexed entry when it is present and
;; the inhabited integer default zero otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-54-array-read (index a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp a)
        (if (zp index)
            (car a)
          (verina-basic-54-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr a)))
      0)))

;; On an integer this is Lean Int.natAbs, with a natural-number result.

(defun verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs (x)
  (if (< x 0)
      (- x)
    x))

;; The fuel is the source termination measure
;; a.size + b.size - m - n. When both natural indices are in bounds this
;; measure is positive and decreases by one in either recursive branch, so
;; fuel cannot expire before the source base case. The wrapper therefore
;; computes exactly canyonSearchAux on its typed domain.

(defun verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux-fuel
    (a b m n d fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or
       (zp fuel)
       (not (natp m))
       (not (natp n))
       (not (natp d)))
      (nfix d)
    (if (and
         (< m (len a))
         (< n (len b)))
        (let* ((a-value
                (verina-basic-54-array-read m a))
               (b-value
                (verina-basic-54-array-read n b))
               (diff
                (verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs
                 (- a-value b-value)))
               (new-d
                (if (< diff d)
                    diff
                  d)))
          (if (<= a-value b-value)
              (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux-fuel
               a
               b
               (+ m 1)
               n
               new-d
               (- fuel 1))
            (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux-fuel
             a
             b
             m
             (+ n 1)
             new-d
             (- fuel 1))))
      d)))

(defun verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux
    (a b m n d)
  (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux-fuel
   a
   b
   m
   n
   d
   (nfix
    (-
     (+ (len a) (len b))
     (+ m n)))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. The initial branch and the call at indices zero reproduce the
;; complete executable CanyonSearch definition, including get! defaults.

(defun verina-basic-54-canyon-search (a b)
  (let* ((a-zero
          (verina-basic-54-array-read 0 a))
         (b-zero
          (verina-basic-54-array-read 0 b))
         (init
          (if (< a-zero b-zero)
              (verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs
               (- b-zero a-zero))
            (verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs
             (- a-zero b-zero)))))
    (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-aux
     a
     b
     0
     0
     init)))

;; These two recursive predicates are the nested Array.any in the source
;; postcondition: the result must equal the absolute difference of some pair.

(defun verina-basic-54-difference-attained-in-b-p
    (a-value b result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count b)))
  (if (consp b)
      (or
       (equal
        result
        (verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs
         (- a-value (car b))))
       (verina-basic-54-difference-attained-in-b-p
        a-value
        (cdr b)
        result))
    nil))

(defun verina-basic-54-difference-attained-p
    (a b result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (or
       (verina-basic-54-difference-attained-in-b-p
        (car a)
        b
        result)
       (verina-basic-54-difference-attained-p
        (cdr a)
        b
        result))
    nil))

;; These two predicates are the nested Array.all in the source postcondition:
;; the result is no larger than the absolute difference of every pair.

(defun verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-in-b-p
    (a-value b result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count b)))
  (if (consp b)
      (and
       (<=
        result
        (verina-basic-54-int-nat-abs
         (- a-value (car b))))
       (verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-in-b-p
        a-value
        (cdr b)
        result))
    (equal b nil)))

(defun verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-p
    (a b result)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-in-b-p
        (car a)
        b
        result)
       (verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-p
        (cdr a)
        b
        result))
    (equal a nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The explicit domain predicates
;; preserve the Array Int and Nat binder types; the proof-valued precondition
;; argument is unused and erased.

(defun verina-basic-54-canyon-search-postcond
    (a b result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-54-int-array-p a)
   (verina-basic-54-int-array-p b)
   (natp result)
   (verina-basic-54-difference-attained-p
    a
    b
    result)
   (verina-basic-54-at-most-all-differences-p
    a
    b
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over all finite integer arrays, assumes exactly the source nonemptiness and
;; sortedness precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-54-canyon-search-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-54-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-54-int-array-p b)
      (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-precond
       a
       b))
     (verina-basic-54-canyon-search-postcond
      a
      b
      (verina-basic-54-canyon-search a b)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- catalog title "CanyonSearch": a deterministic two-pointer scan of two
-- nonempty nondecreasing integer arrays returns their minimum attained
-- absolute pairwise difference. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic54 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

boolAnd : Bool → Bool → Bool
boolAnd true right = right
boolAnd false right = false

natAdd : Nat → Nat → Nat
natAdd zero n = n
natAdd (suc m) n = suc (natAdd m n)

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natMinimum : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMinimum m n =
  if natLess m n then m else n

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd x (pos zero) = x
intAdd x (pos (suc n)) =
  intSuccessor (intAdd x (pos n))
intAdd x (negsuc zero) = intPredecessor x
intAdd x (negsuc (suc n)) =
  intPredecessor (intAdd x (negsuc n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

intNatAbs : Int → Nat
intNatAbs (pos n) = n
intNatAbs (negsuc n) = suc n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natLessOrEqual n m

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} →
  (A → A → Set) →
  List A →
  Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

anyList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
anyList predicate [] = false
anyList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then true
  else anyList predicate xs

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

CanyonSearch-precond : Array Int → Array Int → Set
CanyonSearch-precond a b =
  (zero < arraySize a) ∧
  (zero < arraySize b) ∧
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual a ∧
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual b

canyonSearchAuxWithFuel :
  Nat →
  Array Int →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
canyonSearchAuxWithFuel zero a b m n d = d
canyonSearchAuxWithFuel (suc fuel) a b m n d =
  if boolAnd
       (natLess m (arraySize a))
       (natLess n (arraySize b))
  then
    (let ai = indexDefault zeroInt a m
         bi = indexDefault zeroInt b n
         diff = intNatAbs (intSubtract ai bi)
         new-d = natMinimum diff d
     in
       if intLessOrEqual ai bi
       then canyonSearchAuxWithFuel fuel a b (suc m) n new-d
       else canyonSearchAuxWithFuel fuel a b m (suc n) new-d)
  else d

canyonSearchAux :
  Array Int →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
canyonSearchAux a b m n d =
  canyonSearchAuxWithFuel
    (natSubtract
      (natSubtract
        (natAdd (arraySize a) (arraySize b))
        m)
      n)
    a
    b
    m
    n
    d

CanyonSearch :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  CanyonSearch-precond a b →
  Nat
CanyonSearch a b h-precond =
  let first-a = indexDefault zeroInt a zero
      first-b = indexDefault zeroInt b zero
      initial-difference =
        if intLess first-a first-b
        then intNatAbs (intSubtract first-b first-a)
        else intNatAbs (intSubtract first-a first-b)
  in canyonSearchAux a b zero zero initial-difference

CanyonSearch-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  (result : Nat) →
  CanyonSearch-precond a b →
  Set
CanyonSearch-postcond a b result h-precond =
  IsTrue
    (anyList
      (λ ai →
        anyList
          (λ bi →
            natEqual
              result
              (intNatAbs (intSubtract ai bi)))
          b)
      a) ∧
  IsTrue
    (allList
      (λ ai →
        allList
          (λ bi →
            natLessOrEqual
              result
              (intNatAbs (intSubtract ai bi)))
          b)
      a)

CanyonSearch-spec-satisfied : Set
CanyonSearch-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (b : Array Int) →
  (h-precond : CanyonSearch-precond a b) →
  CanyonSearch-postcond
    a
    b
    (CanyonSearch a b h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_54
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54,
  catalog title "CanyonSearch": the executable two-pointer search scans two
  nonempty pairwise nondecreasing integer arrays, maintaining and returning
  an attained minimum absolute difference. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe_def = Define `
  (CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y : int. x <= y) xs /\
      CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe xs))
`;

val CanyonSearch_precond_def = new_definition (
  "CanyonSearch_precond_def",
  ``CanyonSearch_precond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) <=>
      0 < LENGTH a /\
      0 < LENGTH b /\
      CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe a /\
      CanyonSearch_pairwiseLe b``
);

val CanyonSearch_nthD_def = Define `
  (CanyonSearch_nthD
      (index : num) ([] : int list) = (0 : int)) /\
  (CanyonSearch_nthD
      0 (x::xs) = x) /\
  (CanyonSearch_nthD
      (SUC index) (x::xs) =
     CanyonSearch_nthD index xs)
`;

val CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff_def = new_definition (
  "CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff_def",
  ``CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff (x : int) (y : int) =
      Num (ABS (x - y))``
);

val canyonSearchAuxFuel_def = Define `
  (canyonSearchAuxFuel
      0
      (a : int list) (b : int list)
      (m : num) (n : num) (d : num) =
     d) /\
  (canyonSearchAuxFuel
      (SUC fuel) a b m n d =
     if m < LENGTH a /\ n < LENGTH b then
       let am = CanyonSearch_nthD m a in
       let bn = CanyonSearch_nthD n b in
       let diff = CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff am bn in
       let new_d = if diff < d then diff else d in
         if am <= bn then
           canyonSearchAuxFuel fuel a b (m + 1) n new_d
         else
           canyonSearchAuxFuel fuel a b m (n + 1) new_d
     else
       d)
`;

val canyonSearchAux_def = new_definition (
  "canyonSearchAux_def",
  ``canyonSearchAux
      (a : int list) (b : int list)
      (m : num) (n : num) (d : num) =
      canyonSearchAuxFuel
        ((LENGTH a - m) + (LENGTH b - n))
        a b m n d``
);

val CanyonSearch_def = new_definition (
  "CanyonSearch_def",
  ``CanyonSearch (a : int list) (b : int list) =
      let a0 = CanyonSearch_nthD 0 a in
      let b0 = CanyonSearch_nthD 0 b in
      let init =
        if a0 < b0 then
          CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff b0 a0
        else
          CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff a0 b0
      in
        canyonSearchAux a b 0 0 init``
);

val CanyonSearch_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "CanyonSearch_postcond_def",
  ``CanyonSearch_postcond
      (a : int list) (b : int list) (result : num) <=>
      EXISTS
        (\ai : int.
           EXISTS
             (\bi : int.
                result = CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff ai bi)
             b)
        a /\
      EVERY
        (\ai : int.
           EVERY
             (\bi : int.
                result <= CanyonSearch_natAbsDiff ai bi)
             b)
        a``
);

val CanyonSearch_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (b : int list).
      CanyonSearch_precond a b ==>
      CanyonSearch_postcond
        a b (CanyonSearch a b)``;

title: verina_basic_54
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
  verina_basic_54 (verina__metamath__verina_basic_54), catalog title
  CanyonSearch: the exact recursive two-pointer search of two nonempty
  nondecreasing integer arrays returns their attained minimum pairwise
  absolute difference. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete index set.

  VERINAB54ToList is Array.toList, extensionally the identity on this finite
  word representation. VERINAB54GetBang reproduces Lean Array.get! on integer
  arrays, including its inhabited default value zero outside the array.
  VERINAB54NatAbs is Lean Int.natAbs on integers, VERINAB54NatMin is natural
  minimum, and VERINAB54NatSub is truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB54PairwiseLE is exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y), expressed
  over every earlier/later index pair. VERINAB54Pre preserves the two
  nonemptiness and two nondecreasing-order assumptions.

  VERINAB54AuxGraph is the exact deterministic operational graph of
  canyonSearchAux for every pair of typed arrays and every natural m, n, and
  d. Its trace length uses the source termination measure
  (a.size + b.size - m) - n. Each active transition computes the same
  absolute difference and minimum update, then increments m exactly when
  a[m]! <= b[n]! and increments n otherwise. Once either index is out of
  bounds the trace is absorbing, which has the same returned d as the source
  base case. An active transition strictly decreases the source measure, so
  the final trace value is exactly the recursive helper result.
  VERINAB54Aux selects that unique result.

  VERINAB54CanyonSearch preserves the source initial comparison and invokes
  the helper at m = n = 0. VERINAB54Post is the conjunction of the nested
  Array.any assertion that the result is attained by some pair and the nested
  Array.all assertion that it is no greater than every pairwise absolute
  difference. The proof-valued precondition arguments to the implementation
  and postcondition are computationally and propositionally unused beyond the
  explicit precondition antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering,
  and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB54NatSub VERINAB54NatAbs VERINAB54NatMin
  VERINAB54ToList VERINAB54GetBang
  VERINAB54PairwiseLE VERINAB54Pre
  VERINAB54AuxGraph VERINAB54Aux
  VERINAB54CanyonSearch VERINAB54Post
$.

verinab54-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54NatSub A B ) $.
verinab54-nat-abs-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54NatAbs A ) $.
verinab54-nat-min-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54NatMin A B ) $.
verinab54-to-list-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54ToList A ) $.
verinab54-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54GetBang A B ) $.
verinab54-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB54PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab54-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB54Pre A B ) $.
verinab54-aux-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB54AuxGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verinab54-aux-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54Aux A B C D E ) $.
verinab54-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB54CanyonSearch A B ) $.
verinab54-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB54Post A B C ) $.

verinab54-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab54-nat-abs-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54NatAbs A
) = (
  abs ` A
) $.

verinab54-nat-min-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54NatMin A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  A ,
  B
) $.

verinab54-to-list-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54ToList A
) = A $.

verinab54-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab54-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB54PairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
        )
  ) $.
$}

verinab54-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54Pre A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    B e. Word ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      0 < ( # ` A )
      /\
      0 < ( # ` B )
    )
    /\
    (
      ( VERINAB54PairwiseLE ( VERINAB54ToList A ) )
      /\
      ( VERINAB54PairwiseLE ( VERINAB54ToList B ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d k p q r A B C D E F $.

  verinab54-aux-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB54AuxGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word ZZ
            /\
            B e. Word ZZ
          )
          /\
          (
            C e. NN0
            /\
            D e. NN0
          )
        )
        /\
        E e. NN0
      )
      /\
      F e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. p e. Word NN0
      E. q e. Word NN0
        E. r e. Word NN0
          (
            (
              (
                (
                  ( # ` p ) = (
                    (
                      VERINAB54NatSub
                        (
                          VERINAB54NatSub
                            ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
                            C
                        )
                        D
                    ) + 1
                  )
                  /\
                  ( # ` q ) = ( # ` p )
                )
                /\
                ( # ` r ) = ( # ` p )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( p ` 0 ) = C
                  /\
                  ( q ` 0 ) = D
                )
                /\
                ( r ` 0 ) = E
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              A. k e. (
                0 ..^ (
                  VERINAB54NatSub
                    (
                      VERINAB54NatSub
                        ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
                        C
                    )
                    D
                )
              )
                (
                  (
                    p ` ( k + 1 )
                  ) = if (
                    (
                      ( p ` k ) < ( # ` A )
                      /\
                      ( q ` k ) < ( # ` B )
                    )
                    ,
                    if (
                      (
                        VERINAB54GetBang A ( p ` k )
                      ) <_ (
                        VERINAB54GetBang B ( q ` k )
                      )
                      ,
                      ( ( p ` k ) + 1 )
                      ,
                      ( p ` k )
                    )
                    ,
                    ( p ` k )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      q ` ( k + 1 )
                    ) = if (
                      (
                        ( p ` k ) < ( # ` A )
                        /\
                        ( q ` k ) < ( # ` B )
                      )
                      ,
                      if (
                        (
                          VERINAB54GetBang A ( p ` k )
                        ) <_ (
                          VERINAB54GetBang B ( q ` k )
                        )
                        ,
                        ( q ` k )
                        ,
                        ( ( q ` k ) + 1 )
                      )
                      ,
                      ( q ` k )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      r ` ( k + 1 )
                    ) = if (
                      (
                        ( p ` k ) < ( # ` A )
                        /\
                        ( q ` k ) < ( # ` B )
                      )
                      ,
                      (
                        VERINAB54NatMin
                          (
                            VERINAB54NatAbs
                              (
                                (
                                  VERINAB54GetBang A ( p ` k )
                                )
                                -
                                (
                                  VERINAB54GetBang B ( q ` k )
                                )
                              )
                          )
                          ( r ` k )
                      )
                      ,
                      ( r ` k )
                    )
                  )
                )
              /\
              F = (
                r ` (
                  VERINAB54NatSub
                    (
                      VERINAB54NatSub
                        ( ( # ` A ) + ( # ` B ) )
                        C
                    )
                    D
                )
              )
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verinab54-aux-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB54Aux A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB54AuxGraph A B C D E y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab54-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB54CanyonSearch A B
) = (
  VERINAB54Aux
    A
    B
    0
    0
    if (
      (
        VERINAB54GetBang A 0
      ) < (
        VERINAB54GetBang B 0
      )
      ,
      (
        VERINAB54NatAbs
          (
            ( VERINAB54GetBang B 0 )
            -
            ( VERINAB54GetBang A 0 )
          )
      )
      ,
      (
        VERINAB54NatAbs
          (
            ( VERINAB54GetBang A 0 )
            -
            ( VERINAB54GetBang B 0 )
          )
      )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j A B C $.

  verinab54-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB54Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. Word ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        E. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          C = (
            VERINAB54NatAbs
              ( ( A ` i ) - ( B ` j ) )
          )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` B ) )
          C <_ (
            VERINAB54NatAbs
              ( ( A ` i ) - ( B ` j ) )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-54-canyon-search $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
  A. b e. Word ZZ
    (
      ( VERINAB54Pre a b )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB54Post
          a
          b
          ( VERINAB54CanyonSearch a b )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_basic_54
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_54), catalog title "CanyonSearch": the
:: nonempty non-decreasing integer-array precondition, exact two-pointer
:: minimum-difference implementation, attained-minimum postcondition, and
:: final correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, COMPLEX1, MCART_1,
    XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, COMPLEX1, XTUPLE_0,
    XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex canyonSearchPrecond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT*:],BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],INT,
     natAbsDiff being Function of [:INT,INT:],NAT,
     canyonSearchAux being
       Function of [:[:INT*,INT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],NAT,
     canyonSearch being Function of [:INT*,INT*:],NAT,
     canyonSearchPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT*,NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a,b being FinSequence of INT holds
      (canyonSearchPrecond/.[a,b] = TRUE iff
        0 < len a & 0 < len b &
        (for i,j being Nat st
          i in dom a & j in dom a & i < j
        holds a/.i <= a/.j) &
        (for i,j being Nat st
          i in dom b & j in dom b & i < j
        holds b/.i <= b/.j)) &
      (canyonSearchPrecond/.[a,b] = FALSE iff
        not
          (0 < len a & 0 < len b &
           (for i,j being Nat st
             i in dom a & j in dom a & i < j
           holds a/.i <= a/.j) &
           (for i,j being Nat st
             i in dom b & j in dom b & i < j
           holds b/.i <= b/.j)))) &
    (for s being FinSequence of INT, i being Nat holds
      ((i < len s &
          readDefault/.[s,i] = s/.(i + 1)) or
       (len s <= i &
          readDefault/.[s,i] = 0))) &
    (for x,y being Integer holds
      natAbsDiff/.[x,y] = |.x - y.|) &
    (for a,b being FinSequence of INT, m,n,d being Nat holds
      (m < len a & n < len b &
        readDefault/.[a,m] <= readDefault/.[b,n] &
        canyonSearchAux/.[[a,b],[m,n],d] =
          canyonSearchAux/.
            [[a,b],[m + 1,n],
              min(natAbsDiff/.
                [readDefault/.[a,m],readDefault/.[b,n]],d)]) or
      (m < len a & n < len b &
        not readDefault/.[a,m] <= readDefault/.[b,n] &
        canyonSearchAux/.[[a,b],[m,n],d] =

        canyonSearch/.[a,b] =
