% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_54
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_54), catalog title "CanyonSearch": the specified
% two-pointer search on two nonempty nondecreasing integer arrays returns an
% attained minimum cross-array absolute difference. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_54: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Lean Int.natAbs.
  int_nat_abs(value: int): nat =
    abs(value)

  int_list_all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND int_list_all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Lean List.Pairwise (fun first later => first <= later).
  int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  CanyonSearch_precond(
      a, b: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(a) > 0
      AND int_list_length(b) > 0
      AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(a)
      AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(b)

  % At every active source step exactly one index increases. Starting with the
  % sum of the list lengths therefore makes the fuel-zero branch unreachable,
  % for every call exposed through canyonSearchAux.
  canyonSearchAux_fuel(
      a, b: list[int],
      m, n, d, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF m < int_list_length(a)
         AND n < int_list_length(b) THEN
      IF fuel = 0 THEN
        d
      ELSE
        LET diff: nat =
              int_nat_abs(
                int_list_get_bang(m, a)
                  - int_list_get_bang(n, b)),
            new_d: nat =
              IF diff < d THEN diff ELSE d ENDIF
        IN
          IF int_list_get_bang(m, a)
               <= int_list_get_bang(n, b) THEN
            canyonSearchAux_fuel(
              a,
              b,
              m + 1,
              n,
              new_d,
              fuel - 1)
          ELSE
            canyonSearchAux_fuel(
              a,
              b,
              m,
              n + 1,
              new_d,
              fuel - 1)
          ENDIF
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      d
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  canyonSearchAux(
      a, b: list[int],
      m, n, d: nat): nat =
    canyonSearchAux_fuel(
      a,
      b,
      m,
      n,
      d,
      int_list_length(a) + int_list_length(b))

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  CanyonSearch(
      a, b: list[int]): nat =
    LET first_a: int = int_list_get_bang(0, a),
        first_b: int = int_list_get_bang(0, b),
        init: nat =
          IF first_a < first_b THEN
            int_nat_abs(first_b - first_a)
          ELSE
            int_nat_abs(first_a - first_b)
          ENDIF
    IN
      canyonSearchAux(a, b, 0, 0, init)

  int_list_any_abs_difference_with(
      selected: int,
      result: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        result = int_nat_abs(selected - head)
          OR int_list_any_abs_difference_with(
               selected,
               result,
               tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_lists_any_abs_difference(
      a, b: list[int],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES a OF
      null:
        FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_any_abs_difference_with(head, result, b)
          OR int_lists_any_abs_difference(tail, b, result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE a BY <<

  int_list_all_abs_differences_at_least(
      selected: int,
      result: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        result <= int_nat_abs(selected - head)
          AND int_list_all_abs_differences_at_least(
                selected,
                result,
                tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_lists_all_abs_differences_at_least(
      a, b: list[int],
      result: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES a OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_all_abs_differences_at_least(head, result, b)
          AND int_lists_all_abs_differences_at_least(
                tail,
                b,
                result)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE a BY <<

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  CanyonSearch_postcond(
      a, b: list[int],
      result: nat): bool =
    int_lists_any_abs_difference(a, b, result)
      AND int_lists_all_abs_differences_at_least(a, b, result)

  CanyonSearch_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: list[int]):
      CanyonSearch_precond(a, b)
        IMPLIES
          CanyonSearch_postcond(
            a,
            b,
            CanyonSearch(a, b))

END verina_basic_54

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_55,
   catalog title "Compare": an executable Boolean equality test for two
   integers, together with its trivial precondition, two-branch postcondition,
   and final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool ZArith.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition Compare_precond (_a _b : Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition Compare
    (a b : Z)
    (_h_precond : Compare_precond a b) : bool :=
  if Z.eqb a b then true else false.

Definition Compare_postcond
    (a b : Z)
    (result : bool)
    (_h_precond : Compare_precond a b) : Prop :=
  (a = b -> result = true) /\
  (a <> b -> result = false).

Theorem Compare_spec_satisfied
    (a b : Z)
    (h_precond : Compare_precond a b) :
  Compare_postcond a b (Compare a b h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

;; catalog title "Compare": deterministic integer equality comparison returns
;; true exactly when the two inputs are equal and false otherwise. This file

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The two Int input domains remain explicit
;; in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-55-compare-precond (a b)
  (declare (ignore a b))
  t)

;; This recognizes exactly the two values of Lean Bool.

(defun verina-basic-55-bool-p (result)
  (or
   (equal result t)
   (equal result nil)))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. This conditional is the exact source Compare computation.

(defun verina-basic-55-compare (a b)
  (if (equal a b)
      t
    nil))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. Typed Int and Bool binder domains
;; are explicit, and the proof-valued precondition argument is unused and
;; erased.

(defun verina-basic-55-compare-postcond
    (a b result)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (verina-basic-55-bool-p result)
   (implies
    (equal a b)
    (equal result t))
   (implies
    (not (equal a b))
    (equal result nil))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over all integer inputs, assumes exactly the source True precondition, and
;; applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-55-compare-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp a)
      (integerp b)
      (verina-basic-55-compare-precond a b))
     (verina-basic-55-compare-postcond
      a
      b
      (verina-basic-55-compare a b)))))

:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_55,
-- catalog title "Compare": deterministic equality comparison of two integers
-- returns the corresponding Boolean and satisfies both result branches.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic55 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

Compare-precond : Int → Int → Set
Compare-precond a b = Top

Compare :
  (a b : Int) →
  Compare-precond a b →
  Bool
Compare a b h-precond = intEqual a b

Compare-postcond :
  (a b : Int) →
  (result : Bool) →
  Compare-precond a b →
  Set
Compare-postcond a b result h-precond =
  ((a ≡ b) → (result ≡ true)) ∧
  (Not (a ≡ b) → (result ≡ false))

Compare-spec-satisfied : Set
Compare-spec-satisfied =
  (a b : Int) →
  (h-precond : Compare-precond a b) →
  Compare-postcond
    a
    b
    (Compare a b h-precond)
    h-precond

  returns one when the two integers are equal and zero otherwise, so it admits

  postcondition are computationally and propositionally unused beyond the

   catalog title "copy": executable copying of a bounded segment from a source
   integer array into a destination integer array, together with its
   precondition, postcondition, and final correctness proposition. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition copy_precond
    (src : list Z)
    (sStart : nat)
    (dest : list Z)
    (dStart len : nat) : Prop :=
  (sStart + len <= length src)%nat /\
  (dStart + len <= length dest)%nat.

Fixpoint copy_set_nth
    (index : nat)
    (value : Z)
    (xs : list Z) : list Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      match index with
      | O => value :: rest
      | S index' => x :: copy_set_nth index' value rest
      end
  end.

Fixpoint updateSegment
    (r src : list Z)
    (sStart dStart n : nat) : list Z :=
  match n with
  | O => r
  | S n' =>
      let rNew :=
        copy_set_nth
          (dStart + n')%nat
          (nth (sStart + n')%nat src 0%Z)
          r in
      updateSegment rNew src sStart dStart n'
  end.

Definition copy
    (src : list Z)
    (sStart : nat)
    (dest : list Z)
    (dStart len : nat)
    (_h_precond : copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len) : list Z :=
  if Nat.eqb len O
  then dest
  else updateSegment dest src sStart dStart len.

Definition copy_postcond
    (src : list Z)
    (sStart : nat)
    (dest : list Z)
    (dStart len : nat)
    (result : list Z)
    (_h_precond : copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len) : Prop :=
  length result = length dest /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < dStart)%nat ->
      nth i result 0%Z = nth i dest 0%Z) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (dStart + len <= i)%nat ->
      (i < length result)%nat ->
      nth i result 0%Z = nth i dest 0%Z) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < len)%nat ->
      nth (dStart + i)%nat result 0%Z =
      nth (sStart + i)%nat src 0%Z).

Theorem copy_spec_satisfied
    (src : list Z)
    (sStart : nat)
    (dest : list Z)
    (dStart len : nat)
    (h_precond : copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len) :
  copy_postcond
    src sStart dest dStart len
    (copy src sStart dest dStart len h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_56
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_56), catalog title "copy": an executable
  bounded segment-copy program replaces a destination segment by the
  corresponding source segment while preserving all other destination
  entries, together with its bounds precondition, postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_56
  imports Main
begin

definition copy_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len \<longleftrightarrow>
    length src \<ge> sStart + len \<and>
    length dest \<ge> dStart + len"

definition copy_getBang :: "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "copy_getBang xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else 0)"

definition copy_setBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "copy_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

fun updateSegment ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "updateSegment r src sStart dStart 0 = r"
| "updateSegment r src sStart dStart (Suc n) =
    updateSegment
      (copy_setBang r (dStart + n) (copy_getBang src (sStart + n)))
      src sStart dStart n"

definition copy ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "copy src sStart dest dStart len =
    (if len = 0
     then dest
     else
       (let r = dest
        in updateSegment r src sStart dStart len))"

definition copy_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> int list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "copy_postcond src sStart dest dStart len result \<longleftrightarrow>
    length result = length dest \<and>
    (\<forall>i. i < dStart \<longrightarrow>
      copy_getBang result i = copy_getBang dest i) \<and>
    (\<forall>i. dStart + len \<le> i \<longrightarrow> i < length result \<longrightarrow>
      copy_getBang result i = copy_getBang dest i) \<and>
    (\<forall>i. i < len \<longrightarrow>
      copy_getBang result (dStart + i) =
        copy_getBang src (sStart + i))"

theorem copy_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len"
  shows
    "copy_postcond
      src sStart dest dStart len (copy src sStart dest dStart len)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_56
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_56), catalog title "copy": an executable
  segment copy replaces a bounded portion of a destination integer array with
  the corresponding source segment, together with its bounds precondition and
  complete pointwise correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let copy_precond = new_definition
  `copy_precond
      (src:int list) (sStart:num) (dest:int list)
      (dStart:num) (len:num) <=>
     LENGTH src >= sStart + len /\
     LENGTH dest >= dStart + len`;;

let copy_getDefault = new_definition
  `copy_getDefault (xs:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH xs then EL i xs else (&0:int)`;;

let copy_setAt =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !value:int.
        copy_setAt ([]:int list) i value = []) /\
     (!x:int. !xs:int list. !i:num. !value:int.
        copy_setAt (CONS x xs) i value =
        if i = 0 then CONS value xs
        else CONS x (copy_setAt xs (PRE i) value))`;;

let copy_updateSegment_rec =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!r:int list. !src:int list. !sStart:num. !dStart:num.
        copy_updateSegment_rec 0 r src sStart dStart = r) /\
     (!n:num. !r:int list. !src:int list. !sStart:num. !dStart:num.
        copy_updateSegment_rec (SUC n) r src sStart dStart =
        copy_updateSegment_rec n
          (copy_setAt r (dStart + n)
            (copy_getDefault src (sStart + n)))
          src sStart dStart)`;;

let updateSegment = new_definition
  `updateSegment
      (r:int list) (src:int list) (sStart:num)
      (dStart:num) (n:num) =
     copy_updateSegment_rec n r src sStart dStart`;;

let copy = new_definition
  `copy
      (src:int list) (sStart:num) (dest:int list)
      (dStart:num) (len:num) =
     if len = 0 then dest
     else updateSegment dest src sStart dStart len`;;

let copy_postcond = new_definition
  `copy_postcond
      (src:int list) (sStart:num) (dest:int list)
      (dStart:num) (len:num) (result:int list) <=>
     LENGTH result = LENGTH dest /\
     (!i:num.
        i < dStart
        ==> copy_getDefault result i = copy_getDefault dest i) /\
     (!i:num.
        dStart + len <= i
        ==> i < LENGTH result
        ==> copy_getDefault result i = copy_getDefault dest i) /\
     (!i:num.
        i < len
        ==> copy_getDefault result (dStart + i) =
            copy_getDefault src (sStart + i))`;;

let copy_spec_satisfied =
  `!src:int list. !sStart:num. !dest:int list.
   !dStart:num. !len:num.
     copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len
     ==> copy_postcond
           src sStart dest dStart len
           (copy src sStart dest dStart len)`;;

title: verina_basic_56
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56,
;; catalog title "copy": a deterministic integer-array program copies a
;; specified source segment into a destination segment while preserving every
;; destination entry outside that segment. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-56-integer-array-p (array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count array)))
  (if (consp array)
      (and
       (integerp (car array))
       (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p (cdr array)))
    (equal array nil)))

;; This is exactly the source precondition after Array.size is represented by
;; list length.

(defun verina-basic-56-copy-precond
    (src s-start dest d-start copy-len)
  (and
   (<= (+ s-start copy-len) (len src))
   (<= (+ d-start copy-len) (len dest))))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the indexed entry when it is present and
;; the inhabited integer default zero otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-56-array-read (index array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (car array)
          (verina-basic-56-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr array)))
      0)))

;; Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves the array unchanged when
;; its natural index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-basic-56-array-set
    (index value array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      array
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons value (cdr array))
          (cons
           (car array)
           (verina-basic-56-array-set
            (- index 1)
            value
            (cdr array))))
      nil)))

;; This is the source updateSegment recursion. At positive N it first writes
;; source index S-START + (N - 1) to destination index D-START + (N - 1),
;; then recurses on N - 1, so the same descending sequence of updates is
;; preserved exactly.

(defun verina-basic-56-update-segment
    (result src s-start d-start n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      result
    (let* ((index (- n 1))
           (result-new
            (verina-basic-56-array-set
             (+ d-start index)
             (verina-basic-56-array-read
              (+ s-start index)
              src)
             result)))
      (verina-basic-56-update-segment
       result-new
       src
       s-start
       d-start
       index))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. The zero-length branch and the call to updateSegment reproduce
;; the complete executable copy definition.

(defun verina-basic-56-copy
    (src s-start dest d-start copy-len)
  (if (equal copy-len 0)
      dest
    (verina-basic-56-update-segment
     dest
     src
     s-start
     d-start
     copy-len)))

;; These predicates preserve the three universal Nat binders in the source
;; postcondition, including both default-zero array reads and the original
;; index bounds.

(defun-sk verina-basic-56-before-segment-unchanged-p
    (dest d-start result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i d-start))
     (equal
      (verina-basic-56-array-read i result)
      (verina-basic-56-array-read i dest)))))

(defun-sk verina-basic-56-after-segment-unchanged-p
    (dest d-start copy-len result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (<= (+ d-start copy-len) i)
      (< i (len result)))
     (equal
      (verina-basic-56-array-read i result)
      (verina-basic-56-array-read i dest)))))

(defun-sk verina-basic-56-segment-copied-p
    (src s-start d-start copy-len result)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (< i copy-len))
     (equal
      (verina-basic-56-array-read
       (+ d-start i)
       result)
      (verina-basic-56-array-read
       (+ s-start i)
       src)))))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. ACL2 predicates make the typed
;; Array Int and Nat binders explicit; the unused proof-valued precondition
;; argument is erased.

(defun verina-basic-56-copy-postcond
    (src s-start dest d-start copy-len result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p src)
   (natp s-start)
   (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p dest)
   (natp d-start)
   (natp copy-len)
   (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p result)
   (equal (len result) (len dest))
   (verina-basic-56-before-segment-unchanged-p
    dest
    d-start
    result)
   (verina-basic-56-after-segment-unchanged-p
    dest
    d-start
    copy-len
    result)
   (verina-basic-56-segment-copied-p
    src
    s-start
    d-start
    copy-len
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every pair of finite integer arrays and all natural start indices and
;; lengths, assumes exactly the source bounds precondition, and applies the
;; complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-56-copy-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (src s-start dest d-start copy-len)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p src)
      (natp s-start)
      (verina-basic-56-integer-array-p dest)
      (natp d-start)
      (natp copy-len)
      (verina-basic-56-copy-precond
       src
       s-start
       dest
       d-start
       copy-len))
     (verina-basic-56-copy-postcond
      src
      s-start
      dest
      d-start
      copy-len
      (verina-basic-56-copy
       src
       s-start
       dest
       d-start
       copy-len)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_56
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56,
-- catalog title "copy": a deterministic integer-array program copies a
-- bounded source segment into a destination segment, preserves all other
-- destination entries and its size, and is connected to its correctness
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic56 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

updateAt : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat → A → Array A
updateAt [] index value = []
updateAt (x ∷ xs) zero value = value ∷ xs
updateAt (x ∷ xs) (suc index) value =
  x ∷ updateAt xs index value

copy-precond :
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Set
copy-precond src sStart dest dStart len =
  (sStart + len ≤ arraySize src) ∧
  (dStart + len ≤ arraySize dest)

updateSegment :
  Array Int →
  Array Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Array Int
updateSegment r src sStart dStart zero = r
updateSegment r src sStart dStart (suc n) =
  let rNew =
        updateAt
          r
          (dStart + n)
          (indexDefault zeroInt src (sStart + n))
  in updateSegment rNew src sStart dStart n

copy :
  (src : Array Int) →
  (sStart : Nat) →
  (dest : Array Int) →
  (dStart : Nat) →
  (len : Nat) →
  copy-precond src sStart dest dStart len →
  Array Int
copy src sStart dest dStart zero h-precond = dest
copy src sStart dest dStart (suc len) h-precond =
  updateSegment dest src sStart dStart (suc len)

copy-postcond :
  (src : Array Int) →
  (sStart : Nat) →
  (dest : Array Int) →
  (dStart : Nat) →
  (len : Nat) →
  (result : Array Int) →
  copy-precond src sStart dest dStart len →
  Set
copy-postcond src sStart dest dStart len result h-precond =
  (arraySize result ≡ arraySize dest) ∧
  ((i : Nat) →
    i < dStart →
    indexDefault zeroInt result i ≡
      indexDefault zeroInt dest i) ∧
  ((i : Nat) →
    dStart + len ≤ i →
    i < arraySize result →
    indexDefault zeroInt result i ≡
      indexDefault zeroInt dest i) ∧
  ((i : Nat) →
    i < len →
    indexDefault zeroInt result (dStart + i) ≡
      indexDefault zeroInt src (sStart + i))

copy-spec-satisfied : Set
copy-spec-satisfied =
  (src : Array Int) →
  (sStart : Nat) →
  (dest : Array Int) →
  (dStart : Nat) →
  (len : Nat) →
  (h-precond : copy-precond src sStart dest dStart len) →
  copy-postcond
    src
    sStart
    dest
    dStart
    len
    (copy src sStart dest dStart len h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_56
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56,
  catalog title "copy": the executable program copies a bounded segment from
  a source integer array into a destination array by descending indexed
  updates and states its precondition/postcondition correctness contract.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val copy_getBang_def = new_definition (
  "copy_getBang_def",
  ``copy_getBang (xs : int list) (index : num) =
      if index < LENGTH xs then EL index xs else (0 : int)``
);

val copy_precond_def = new_definition (
  "copy_precond_def",
  ``copy_precond
      (src : int list) (sStart : num)
      (dest : int list) (dStart : num) (len : num) <=>
      sStart + len <= LENGTH src /\
      dStart + len <= LENGTH dest``
);

val updateSegment_def = Define `
  (updateSegment
      (r : int list) (src : int list)
      (sStart : num) (dStart : num) 0 =
     r) /\
  (updateSegment r src sStart dStart (SUC n) =
     let rNew =
       LUPDATE
         (copy_getBang src (sStart + n))
         (dStart + n)
         r
     in
       updateSegment rNew src sStart dStart n)
`;

val copy_def = new_definition (
  "copy_def",
  ``copy
      (src : int list) (sStart : num)
      (dest : int list) (dStart : num) (len : num) =
      if len = 0 then
        dest
      else
        updateSegment dest src sStart dStart len``
);

val copy_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "copy_postcond_def",
  ``copy_postcond
      (src : int list) (sStart : num)
      (dest : int list) (dStart : num) (len : num)
      (result : int list) <=>
      LENGTH result = LENGTH dest /\
      (!i : num.
         i < dStart ==>
         copy_getBang result i = copy_getBang dest i) /\
      (!i : num.
         dStart + len <= i ==>
         i < LENGTH result ==>
         copy_getBang result i = copy_getBang dest i) /\
      (!i : num.
         i < len ==>
         copy_getBang result (dStart + i) =
         copy_getBang src (sStart + i))``
);

val copy_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(src : int list) (sStart : num)
      (dest : int list) (dStart : num) (len : num).
      copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len ==>
      copy_postcond
        src sStart dest dStart len
        (copy src sStart dest dStart len)``;

title: verina_basic_56
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_56), catalog title copy: the exact
  executable descending-index segment copy replaces the designated part of a
  finite integer destination array from a finite integer source array and
  satisfies its size, preservation, and copied-entry contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` i is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ n is the set of natural indices below n.

  VERINAB56NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB56GetBang reproduces Lean Array.get! on integer arrays, including
  its inhabited default value zero outside the array. VERINAB56SetBangGraph
  and its iota-selected function reproduce Array.set!, including unchanged
  array behavior at an out-of-range index.

  VERINAB56UpdateSegmentGraph is the exact finite execution trace of the
  source recursive updateSegment helper. For length n, transition k writes
  offset n - 1 - k, so the writes occur in the source order n - 1 down to
  zero. Each transition reads the immutable source array with get! and
  applies set! to the current destination state. VERINAB56UpdateSegment
  selects the unique final array fixed by that trace.

  VERINAB56Pre preserves both source bounds assumptions.
  VERINAB56Copy preserves the explicit zero-length branch and otherwise calls
  updateSegment on the original destination. VERINAB56Post preserves the
  result-size equation, the unchanged prefix and suffix conditions, and the
  copied-segment equation. The proof-valued precondition arguments to the
  implementation and postcondition are computationally and propositionally
  unused beyond the explicit precondition antecedent in the final correctness
  assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by
  this rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB56NatSub VERINAB56GetBang
  VERINAB56SetBangGraph VERINAB56SetBang
  VERINAB56UpdateSegmentGraph VERINAB56UpdateSegment
  VERINAB56Pre VERINAB56Copy VERINAB56Post
$.

verinab56-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB56NatSub A B ) $.
verinab56-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB56GetBang A B ) $.
verinab56-set-bang-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB56SetBangGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab56-set-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB56SetBang A B C ) $.
verinab56-update-segment-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB56UpdateSegmentGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verinab56-update-segment-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB56UpdateSegment A B C D E ) $.
verinab56-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB56Pre A B C D E ) $.
verinab56-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB56Copy A B C D E ) $.
verinab56-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB56Post A B C D E F ) $.

verinab56-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB56NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab56-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB56GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i A B C D $.

  verinab56-set-bang-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB56SetBangGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        C e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      D e. Word ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( D ` i ) = if (
          i = B ,
          C ,
          ( A ` i )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab56-set-bang-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB56SetBang A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word ZZ
      ( VERINAB56SetBangGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E F $.

  verinab56-update-segment-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB56UpdateSegmentGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word ZZ
            /\
            B e. Word ZZ
          )
          /\

::$P-
theorem

       Function of [:[:INT*,INT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],INT,
     setBang being Function of [:INT*,NAT,INT:],INT*,
     updateSegment being
       Function of [:[:INT*,INT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],INT*,
     copyProgram being
       Function of [:[:INT*,INT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],INT*,
     copyPostcond being
       Function of
         [:[:INT*,INT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],[:NAT,INT*:]:],BOOLEAN st
    (for src,dest being FinSequence of INT,
         sStart,dStart,copyLen being Nat holds
      (copyPrecond/.[[src,dest],[sStart,dStart],copyLen] = TRUE iff
        sStart + copyLen <= len src &
        dStart + copyLen <= len dest) &
      (copyPrecond/.[[src,dest],[sStart,dStart],copyLen] = FALSE iff
        not
          (sStart + copyLen <= len src &

        (for j being Nat st j in dom r holds

           (j <> i + 1 & rNew/.j = r/.j)))) &
    (for r,src being FinSequence of INT,
         sStart,dStart being Nat holds
      updateSegment/.[[r,src],[sStart,dStart],0] = r) &
    (for r,src being FinSequence of INT,
         sStart,dStart,n being Nat holds
      updateSegment/.[[r,src],[sStart,dStart],n + 1] =
        updateSegment/.
          [[setBang/.

           [sStart,dStart],n]) &

         sStart,dStart,copyLen being Nat holds

         sStart,dStart,copyLen being Nat holds

        holds

           holds

         sStart,dStart,copyLen being Nat st
      copyPrecond/.[[src,dest],[sStart,dStart],copyLen] = TRUE
    holds

        [[src,dest],[sStart,dStart],

          copyProgram/.[[src,dest],[sStart,dStart],copyLen]]] = TRUE)

end;

title: verina_basic_56
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_56
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_56), catalog title "copy": copying a bounded
% source-array segment into a destination array while preserving its other
% entries and size. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_56: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves an out-of-bounds
  % array unchanged.
  int_list_set_bang(
      index: nat,
      new_value: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(new_value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            int_list_set_bang(
              index - 1,
              new_value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  copy_precond(
      src: list[int],
      sStart: nat,
      dest: list[int],
      dStart, len: nat): bool =
    int_list_length(src) >= sStart + len
      AND int_list_length(dest) >= dStart + len

  % This is the source updateSegment recursion: for positive n it first writes
  % offset n - 1, then continues with n - 1.
  updateSegment(
      r, src: list[int],
      sStart, dStart, n: nat): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      r
    ELSE
      LET previous: nat = n - 1,
          rNew: list[int] =
            int_list_set_bang(
              dStart + previous,
              int_list_get_bang(sStart + previous, src),
              r)
      IN
        updateSegment(
          rNew,
          src,
          sStart,
          dStart,
          previous)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  copy(
      src: list[int],
      sStart: nat,
      dest: list[int],
      dStart, len: nat): list[int] =
    IF len = 0 THEN
      dest
    ELSE
      updateSegment(
        dest,
        src,
        sStart,
        dStart,
        len)
    ENDIF

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  copy_postcond(
      src: list[int],
      sStart: nat,
      dest: list[int],
      dStart, len: nat,
      result: list[int]): bool =
    int_list_length(result) = int_list_length(dest)
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < dStart
            IMPLIES
              int_list_get_bang(i, result)
                = int_list_get_bang(i, dest))
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          dStart + len <= i
            IMPLIES
              i < int_list_length(result)
                IMPLIES
                  int_list_get_bang(i, result)
                    = int_list_get_bang(i, dest))
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < len
            IMPLIES
              int_list_get_bang(dStart + i, result)
                = int_list_get_bang(sStart + i, src))

  copy_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (
        src: list[int],
        sStart: nat,
        dest: list[int],
        dStart, len: nat):
      copy_precond(
        src,
        sStart,
        dest,
        dStart,
        len)
        IMPLIES
          copy_postcond(
            src,
            sStart,
            dest,
            dStart,
            len,
            copy(
              src,
              sStart,
              dest,
              dStart,
              len))

END verina_basic_56

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57,
   catalog title "CountLessThan": executable counting of the integers in an
   array that are strictly below a threshold, together with its
   no-precondition correctness contract. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List ZArith.

Fixpoint countLessThan_count
    (fuel i acc : nat)
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => acc
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb i (length numbers)
      then
        let new_acc :=
          if Z.ltb (nth i numbers 0%Z) threshold
          then S acc
          else acc in
        countLessThan_count fuel' (S i) new_acc numbers threshold
      else acc
  end.

Definition countLessThan
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z) : nat :=
  countLessThan_count
    (length numbers) 0%nat 0%nat numbers threshold.

Definition CountLessThan_precond
    (_numbers : list Z)
    (_threshold : Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition CountLessThan
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z)
    (_h_precond : CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold) : nat :=
  countLessThan numbers threshold.

Definition CountLessThan_expected
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z) : nat :=
  fold_left
    (fun count n =>
      if Z.ltb n threshold then S count else count)
    numbers 0%nat.

Definition CountLessThan_postcond
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold) : Prop :=
  Nat.sub result (CountLessThan_expected numbers threshold) = 0%nat /\
  Nat.sub (CountLessThan_expected numbers threshold) result = 0%nat.

Theorem CountLessThan_spec_satisfied
    (numbers : list Z)
    (threshold : Z)
    (h_precond : CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold) :
  CountLessThan_postcond
    numbers threshold
    (CountLessThan numbers threshold h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_57), catalog title "CountLessThan": an
  executable array loop counts the integers strictly below a threshold,
  together with its unconditional precondition, fold-based postcondition,
  and final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_57
  imports Main
begin

definition CountLessThan_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition countLessThan_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "countLessThan_getBang numbers i =
    (if i < length numbers then numbers ! i else 0)"

definition countLessThan_loop_step ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countLessThan_loop_step numbers threshold acc i =
    (if countLessThan_getBang numbers i < threshold
     then acc + 1
     else acc)"

definition countLessThan_loop ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countLessThan_loop numbers threshold i acc =
    foldl (countLessThan_loop_step numbers threshold)
      acc [i..<length numbers]"

definition countLessThan :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "countLessThan numbers threshold =
    countLessThan_loop numbers threshold 0 0"

definition CountLessThan :: "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "CountLessThan numbers threshold =
    countLessThan numbers threshold"

definition CountLessThan_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "CountLessThan_postcond numbers threshold result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result -
      foldl
        (\<lambda>count n. if n < threshold then count + 1 else count)
        0 numbers = 0 \<and>
    foldl
      (\<lambda>count n. if n < threshold then count + 1 else count)
      0 numbers - result = 0"

theorem CountLessThan_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold"
  shows
    "CountLessThan_postcond
      numbers threshold (CountLessThan numbers threshold)"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_57), catalog title "CountLessThan": an
  executable indexed scan counts the integers in an array that are strictly
  below a threshold, together with its total precondition and
  truncated-subtraction correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

let CountLessThan_precond = new_definition
  `CountLessThan_precond
      (numbers:int list) (threshold:int) <=> T`;;

let countLessThan_getDefault = new_definition
  `countLessThan_getDefault (numbers:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH numbers then EL i numbers else (&0:int)`;;

let countLessThan_loopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!numbers:int list. !threshold:int. !i:num. !acc:num.
        countLessThan_loopFuel
          0 numbers threshold i acc = acc) /\
     (!fuel:num. !numbers:int list. !threshold:int.
      !i:num. !acc:num.
        countLessThan_loopFuel
          (SUC fuel) numbers threshold i acc =
        if i < LENGTH numbers then
          countLessThan_loopFuel
            fuel numbers threshold (i + 1)
            (if countLessThan_getDefault numbers i < threshold
             then acc + 1
             else acc)
        else
          acc)`;;

let countLessThan = new_definition
  `countLessThan (numbers:int list) (threshold:int) =
     countLessThan_loopFuel
       (SUC (LENGTH numbers)) numbers threshold 0 0`;;

let CountLessThan = new_definition
  `CountLessThan (numbers:int list) (threshold:int) =
     countLessThan numbers threshold`;;

let countLessThan_foldl =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!threshold:int. !acc:num.
        countLessThan_foldl
          ([]:int list) threshold acc = acc) /\
     (!n:int. !rest:int list. !threshold:int. !acc:num.
        countLessThan_foldl
          (CONS n rest) threshold acc =
        countLessThan_foldl
          rest threshold
          (if n < threshold then acc + 1 else acc))`;;

let CountLessThan_postcond = new_definition
  `CountLessThan_postcond
      (numbers:int list) (threshold:int) (result:num) <=>
     result - countLessThan_foldl numbers threshold 0 = 0 /\
     countLessThan_foldl numbers threshold 0 - result = 0`;;

let CountLessThan_spec_satisfied =
  `!numbers:int list. !threshold:int.
     CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold
     ==> CountLessThan_postcond
           numbers threshold
           (CountLessThan numbers threshold)`;;

title: verina_basic_57
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57,
;; catalog title "CountLessThan": a deterministic scan of an arbitrary integer
;; array returns the number of entries strictly below an integer threshold,
;; with correctness stated against an independent left fold. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-57-int-array-p (numbers)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count numbers)))
  (if (consp numbers)
      (and
       (integerp (car numbers))
       (verina-basic-57-int-array-p (cdr numbers)))
    (equal numbers nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The Array Int and Int binder domains remain
;; explicit in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-57-count-less-than-precond
    (numbers threshold)
  (declare (ignore numbers threshold))
  t)

;; REMAINING is the suffix beginning at the source loop index. Testing its
;; head, updating the natural accumulator, and advancing to its tail exactly
;; reproduces the increasing-index local recursion while the index is in
;; bounds.

(defun verina-basic-57-count-loop
    (remaining threshold accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-basic-57-count-loop
       (cdr remaining)
       threshold
       (if (< (car remaining) threshold)
           (+ accumulator 1)
         accumulator))
    accumulator))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. Starting with the full array and accumulator zero preserves
;; the exact executable CountLessThan computation.

(defun verina-basic-57-count-less-than
    (numbers threshold)
  (verina-basic-57-count-loop
   numbers
   threshold
   0))

;; This independent recursion is exactly the postcondition's Array.foldl with
;; the conditional increment function and initial accumulator zero.

(defun verina-basic-57-specification-fold
    (remaining threshold accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (verina-basic-57-specification-fold
       (cdr remaining)
       threshold
       (if (< (car remaining) threshold)
           (+ accumulator 1)
         accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun verina-basic-57-fold-count
    (numbers threshold)
  (verina-basic-57-specification-fold
   numbers
   threshold
   0))

;; On natural-number arguments this is Lean Nat.sub, including truncation at
;; zero.

(defun verina-basic-57-nat-sub (left right)
  (if (and
       (natp left)
       (natp right))
      (nfix (- left right))
    0))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. It retains both truncated
;; subtraction equalities rather than replacing them by a single equality.
;; The explicit predicates preserve the Array Int, Int, and Nat binder types.

(defun verina-basic-57-count-less-than-postcond
    (numbers threshold result)
  (let ((expected
         (verina-basic-57-fold-count
          numbers
          threshold)))
    (and
     (verina-basic-57-int-array-p numbers)
     (integerp threshold)
     (natp result)
     (equal
      (verina-basic-57-nat-sub result expected)
      0)
     (equal
      (verina-basic-57-nat-sub expected result)
      0))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every finite integer array and integer threshold, assumes exactly the
;; source True precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the
;; exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-57-count-less-than-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (numbers threshold)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-57-int-array-p numbers)
      (integerp threshold)
      (verina-basic-57-count-less-than-precond
       numbers
       threshold))
     (verina-basic-57-count-less-than-postcond
      numbers
      threshold
      (verina-basic-57-count-less-than
       numbers
       threshold)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_57
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57,
-- catalog title "CountLessThan": a deterministic integer-array scan counts
-- exactly the elements below an integer threshold and is connected to its
-- fold-based correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic57 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

foldl :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B → A) →
  A →
  List B →
  A
foldl step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldl step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldl step (step accumulator x) xs

CountLessThan-precond : Array Int → Int → Set
CountLessThan-precond numbers threshold = Top

countLessThan-loop :
  Array Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
countLessThan-loop numbers threshold i accumulator zero =
  accumulator
countLessThan-loop numbers threshold i accumulator (suc remaining) =
  let new-accumulator =
        if intLess (indexDefault zeroInt numbers i) threshold
        then suc accumulator
        else accumulator
  in countLessThan-loop
       numbers
       threshold
       (suc i)
       new-accumulator
       remaining

countLessThan : Array Int → Int → Nat
countLessThan numbers threshold =
  countLessThan-loop
    numbers
    threshold
    zero
    zero
    (arraySize numbers)

CountLessThan :
  (numbers : Array Int) →
  (threshold : Int) →
  CountLessThan-precond numbers threshold →
  Nat
CountLessThan numbers threshold h-precond =
  countLessThan numbers threshold

countStep : Int → Nat → Int → Nat
countStep threshold accumulator n =
  if intLess n threshold
  then suc accumulator
  else accumulator

CountLessThan-postcond :
  (numbers : Array Int) →
  (threshold : Int) →
  (result : Nat) →
  CountLessThan-precond numbers threshold →
  Set
CountLessThan-postcond numbers threshold result h-precond =
  let expected = foldl (countStep threshold) zero numbers
  in (natSubtract result expected ≡ zero) ∧
     (natSubtract expected result ≡ zero)

CountLessThan-spec-satisfied : Set
CountLessThan-spec-satisfied =
  (numbers : Array Int) →
  (threshold : Int) →
  (h-precond : CountLessThan-precond numbers threshold) →
  CountLessThan-postcond
    numbers
    threshold
    (CountLessThan numbers threshold h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_57
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57,
  catalog title "CountLessThan": an executable indexed scan counts the
  integers in an array that are strictly less than a threshold and states its
  total precondition and fold-based correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val CountLessThan_precond_def = new_definition (
  "CountLessThan_precond_def",
  ``CountLessThan_precond
      (numbers : int list) (threshold : int) <=>
      T``
);

val countLessThan_getBang_def = new_definition (
  "countLessThan_getBang_def",
  ``countLessThan_getBang
      (numbers : int list) (i : num) =
      if i < LENGTH numbers then EL i numbers else (0 : int)``
);

val countLessThan_loopFuel_def = Define `
  (countLessThan_loopFuel
      0
      (numbers : int list) (threshold : int)
      (i : num) (acc : num) =
     acc) /\
  (countLessThan_loopFuel
      (SUC fuel) numbers threshold i acc =
     if i < LENGTH numbers then
       let new_acc =
         if countLessThan_getBang numbers i < threshold then
           acc + 1
         else
           acc
       in
         countLessThan_loopFuel
           fuel numbers threshold (i + 1) new_acc
     else
       acc)
`;

val countLessThan_def = new_definition (
  "countLessThan_def",
  ``countLessThan
      (numbers : int list) (threshold : int) =
      countLessThan_loopFuel
        (SUC (LENGTH numbers))
        numbers threshold 0 0``
);

val CountLessThan_def = new_definition (
  "CountLessThan_def",
  ``CountLessThan
      (numbers : int list) (threshold : int) =
      countLessThan numbers threshold``
);

val CountLessThan_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "CountLessThan_postcond_def",
  ``CountLessThan_postcond
      (numbers : int list) (threshold : int) (result : num) <=>
      result -
        FOLDL
          (\count n.
             if n < threshold then count + 1 else count)
          0
          numbers = 0 /\
      FOLDL
        (\count n.
           if n < threshold then count + 1 else count)
        0
        numbers - result = 0``
);

val CountLessThan_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(numbers : int list) (threshold : int).
      CountLessThan_precond numbers threshold ==>
      CountLessThan_postcond
        numbers threshold
        (CountLessThan numbers threshold)``;

title: verina_basic_57
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_57), catalog title CountLessThan: the exact
  executable integer-array scan counts entries below an arbitrary integer
  threshold and satisfies its independently folded counting contract. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains, and
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays. For a word
  w, # ` w is its natural-number length, w ` k is zero-based lookup, and
  0 ..^ n is the set of natural indices below n.

  VERINAB57NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB57CountGraph is the exact finite execution graph of the source local
  recursive count helper for every natural starting index and accumulator.
  The number of loop iterations is array-size minus the starting index,
  truncated at zero. Each transition examines the next in-bounds integer and
  increments the natural accumulator exactly when that integer is below the
  threshold. VERINAB57Count selects the unique final accumulator.
  VERINAB57CountLessThan invokes that helper at index zero with accumulator
  zero, exactly as the source executable implementation does.

  VERINAB57FoldGraph separately records every accumulator of the source
  Array.foldl in left-to-right order, and VERINAB57Fold selects its unique
  final value. VERINAB57Pre is the source True precondition on typed inputs.
  VERINAB57Post preserves literally the two source truncated-subtraction
  equations between the result and the fold count.

  The proof-valued precondition arguments to the implementation and
  postcondition are computationally and propositionally unused and are
  represented by the explicit precondition antecedent in the final
  correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition
  required by this rendering, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB57NatSub
  VERINAB57CountGraph VERINAB57Count
  VERINAB57Pre VERINAB57CountLessThan
  VERINAB57FoldGraph VERINAB57Fold
  VERINAB57Post
$.

verinab57-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB57NatSub A B ) $.
verinab57-count-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB57CountGraph A B C D E ) $.
verinab57-count-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB57Count A B C D ) $.
verinab57-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB57Pre A B ) $.
verinab57-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB57CountLessThan A B ) $.
verinab57-fold-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB57FoldGraph A B C ) $.
verinab57-fold-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB57Fold A B ) $.
verinab57-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB57Post A B C ) $.

verinab57-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB57NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

${
  $d k s A B C D E $.

  verinab57-count-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB57CountGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word ZZ
            /\
            B e. ZZ
          )
          /\
          C e. NN0
        )
        /\
        D e. NN0
      )
      /\
      E e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          (
            # ` s
          ) = (
            (
              VERINAB57NatSub
                ( # ` A )
                C
            ) + 1
          )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = D
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. (
            0 ..^ (
              VERINAB57NatSub
                ( # ` A )
                C
            )
          )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              ( A ` ( C + k ) ) < B ,
              ( ( s ` k ) + 1 ) ,
              ( s ` k )
            )
          /\
          E = (
            s ` (
              VERINAB57NatSub
                ( # ` A )
                C
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verinab57-count-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB57Count A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB57CountGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab57-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB57Pre A B
) <-> (
  A e. Word ZZ
  /\
  B e. ZZ
) $.

verinab57-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB57CountLessThan A B
) = (
  VERINAB57Count A B 0 0
) $.

${
  $d k s A B C $.

  verinab57-fold-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB57FoldGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ZZ
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          ( # ` s ) = ( ( # ` A ) + 1 )
          /\
          ( s ` 0 ) = 0
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
            (
              s ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              ( A ` k ) < B ,
              ( ( s ` k ) + 1 ) ,
              ( s ` k )
            )
          /\
          C = ( s ` ( # ` A ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab57-fold-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB57Fold A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB57FoldGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab57-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB57Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    C e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      VERINAB57NatSub
        C
        ( VERINAB57Fold A B )
    ) = 0
    /\
    (
      VERINAB57NatSub
        ( VERINAB57Fold A B )
        C
    ) = 0
  )
) $.

verina-basic-57-count-less-than $a |- A. w e. Word ZZ
  A. z e. ZZ
    (
      ( VERINAB57Pre w z )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB57Post
          w
          z
          ( VERINAB57CountLessThan w z )
      )
    )
$.

title: verina_basic_57
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_57 (verina__mizar__verina_basic_57), catalog title
:: "CountLessThan": the unconditional precondition, exact zero-based
:: accumulator implementation, independent left-fold postcondition, and final
:: correctness contract for counting integer-array entries below a threshold.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1,
    ORDINAL4, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0,
    MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_5, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_5, FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN,

  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex countLessThanPrecond being Function of [:INT*,INT:],BOOLEAN,
     countLessThanLoop being
       Function of [:[:INT*,INT:],[:NAT,NAT:]:],NAT,
     countLessThanImpl,countLessThanProgram being
       Function of [:INT*,INT:],NAT,
     foldLessThan being Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],NAT,
     countLessThanPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer holds
      countLessThanPrecond/.[numbers,threshold] = TRUE) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer,
         i,acc being Nat holds
      (i < len numbers & numbers/.(i + 1) < threshold &
        countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[i,acc]] =
          countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[i + 1,acc + 1]]) or
      (i < len numbers & not numbers/.(i + 1) < threshold &
        countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[i,acc]] =
          countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[i + 1,acc]]) or
      (len numbers <= i &
        countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[i,acc]] = acc)) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer holds
      countLessThanImpl/.[numbers,threshold] =
        countLessThanLoop/.[[numbers,threshold],[0,0]]) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer holds
      countLessThanProgram/.[numbers,threshold] =
        countLessThanImpl/.[numbers,threshold]) &
    (for threshold being Integer, acc being Nat holds
      foldLessThan/.[<*>INT,threshold,acc] = acc) &
    (for x,threshold being Integer, acc being Nat,
         rest being FinSequence of INT holds
      (x < threshold &
        foldLessThan/.[<*x*> ^ rest,threshold,acc] =
          foldLessThan/.[rest,threshold,acc + 1]) or
      (not x < threshold &
        foldLessThan/.[<*x*> ^ rest,threshold,acc] =
          foldLessThan/.[rest,threshold,acc])) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer,
         result being Nat holds
      (countLessThanPostcond/.[numbers,threshold,result] = TRUE iff
        result -' foldLessThan/.[numbers,threshold,0] = 0 &
        foldLessThan/.[numbers,threshold,0] -' result = 0) &
      (countLessThanPostcond/.[numbers,threshold,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result -' foldLessThan/.[numbers,threshold,0] = 0 &
           foldLessThan/.[numbers,threshold,0] -' result = 0))) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of INT, threshold being Integer st
      countLessThanPrecond/.[numbers,threshold] = TRUE
    holds
      countLessThanPostcond/.
        [numbers,threshold,countLessThanProgram/.[numbers,threshold]] =
          TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_57
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_57
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_57), catalog title "CountLessThan": deterministically
% counting the entries of a finite integer array that are strictly below an
% integer threshold. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_57: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  CountLessThan_precond(
      numbers: list[int],
      threshold: int): bool =
    TRUE

  % Starting with index zero and the array length as remaining fuel is exactly
  % the source local count loop: each step reads numbers[index], conditionally
  % increments the accumulator, and advances to the next array index.
  countLessThan_count(
      numbers: list[int],
      threshold: int,
      index, remaining, accumulator: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      accumulator
    ELSE
      countLessThan_count(
        numbers,
        threshold,
        index + 1,
        remaining - 1,
        IF int_list_get_bang(index, numbers) < threshold THEN
          accumulator + 1
        ELSE
          accumulator
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  countLessThan(
      numbers: list[int],
      threshold: int): nat =
    countLessThan_count(
      numbers,
      threshold,
      0,
      int_list_length(numbers),
      0)

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  CountLessThan(
      numbers: list[int],
      threshold: int): nat =
    countLessThan(numbers, threshold)

  % This is the source Array.foldl postcondition expression with its
  % accumulator made explicit.
  countLessThan_fold(
      remaining: list[int],
      threshold: int,
      accumulator: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES remaining OF
      null:
        accumulator,
      cons(head, tail):
        countLessThan_fold(
          tail,
          threshold,
          IF head < threshold THEN
            accumulator + 1
          ELSE
            accumulator
          ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE remaining BY <<

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  CountLessThan_postcond(
      numbers: list[int],
      threshold: int,
      result: nat): bool =
    LET expected: nat =
      countLessThan_fold(numbers, threshold, 0)
    IN
      nat_subtract(result, expected) = 0
        AND nat_subtract(expected, result) = 0

  CountLessThan_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (
        numbers: list[int],
        threshold: int):
      CountLessThan_precond(numbers, threshold)
        IMPLIES
          CountLessThan_postcond(
            numbers,
            threshold,
            CountLessThan(numbers, threshold))

END verina_basic_57
