    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, POWER, ABIAN, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQOP, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, ABIAN, XXREAL_0,
    XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, VALUED_1, BINOP_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, COMPLEX1,
    NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, ABIAN, XTUPLE_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XCMPLX_0, VALUED_1, SUBSET_1, XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex maxFinite,overflowMidpoint being Real,
     binary64Parts being Function of [:REAL,NAT,NAT:],BOOLEAN,
     isFiniteFloat,isFloat,isNaNFloat,isInfFloat being
       Function of [:NAT,REAL:],BOOLEAN,
     floatLe,floatLt being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:],[:NAT,REAL:]:],BOOLEAN,
     roundAbsDifference being Function of REAL,[:NAT,REAL:],
     absDiff being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:],[:NAT,REAL:]:],[:NAT,REAL:],
     hasCloseElementsPrecond being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,[:NAT,REAL:]:],BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,NAT:],[:NAT,REAL:],
     hasCloseElementsInner being
       Function of
         [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,[:NAT,REAL:],NAT,NAT:],BOOLEAN,
     hasCloseElementsOuter being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,[:NAT,REAL:],NAT:],BOOLEAN,
     hasCloseElements being
       Function of [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,[:NAT,REAL:]:],BOOLEAN,
     hasCloseElementsPostcond being
       Function of
         [:[:NAT,REAL:]*,[:NAT,REAL:],BOOLEAN:],BOOLEAN st
    maxFinite =
      (((2 |^ 53) -' 1) qua Real) *
        ((2 qua Real) to_power (971 qua Real)) &
    overflowMidpoint =
      (maxFinite + (2 qua Real) to_power (1024 qua Real)) / 2 &
    (for x being Real, exponent,significand being Nat holds
      (binary64Parts/.[x,exponent,significand] = TRUE iff
        (exponent = 0 &
          significand < 2 |^ 52 &
          x = (significand qua Real) *
            ((2 qua Real) to_power
              ((0 qua Real) - (1074 qua Real)))) or
        (1 <= exponent & exponent <= 2046 &
          2 |^ 52 <= significand & significand < 2 |^ 53 &
          x = (significand qua Real) *
            ((2 qua Real) to_power
              ((exponent qua Real) - (1075 qua Real)))))) &
    (for f being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (isFiniteFloat/.f = TRUE iff
        ex x being Real st
          f = [0,x] &
          ex exponent,significand being Nat st
            binary64Parts/.
              [|.x.|,exponent,significand] = TRUE)) &
    (for f being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (isFloat/.f = TRUE iff
        isFiniteFloat/.f = TRUE or
        f = [1,0] or f = [2,0] or f = [3,0])) &
    (for f being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (isNaNFloat/.f = TRUE iff f = [3,0])) &
    (for f being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (isInfFloat/.f = TRUE iff f = [1,0] or f = [2,0])) &
    (for a,b being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (floatLe/.[a,b] = TRUE iff
        isFloat/.a = TRUE & isFloat/.b = TRUE &
        isNaNFloat/.a = FALSE & isNaNFloat/.b = FALSE &
        (a = [2,0] or b = [1,0] or
          ex x,y being Real st
            a = [0,x] & b = [0,y] & x <= y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (floatLt/.[a,b] = TRUE iff
        isFloat/.a = TRUE & isFloat/.b = TRUE &
        isNaNFloat/.a = FALSE & isNaNFloat/.b = FALSE &
        ((a = [2,0] & b <> [2,0]) or
         (b = [1,0] & a <> [1,0]) or
         ex x,y being Real st
           a = [0,x] & b = [0,y] & x < y))) &
    (for d being Real st 0 <= d holds
      (overflowMidpoint <= d &
        roundAbsDifference/.d = [1,0]) or
      (d < overflowMidpoint &
        ex rounded being Real,
           exponent,significand being Nat st
          roundAbsDifference/.d = [0,rounded] &
          binary64Parts/.
            [rounded,exponent,significand] = TRUE &
          (for other being Real,
               otherExponent,otherSignificand being Nat st
            binary64Parts/.
              [other,otherExponent,otherSignificand] = TRUE &
            other <> rounded
          holds
            |.d - rounded.| < |.d - other.| or
            (|.d - rounded.| = |.d - other.| &
              significand mod (2 qua Nat) = 0)))) &
    (for a,b being Element of [:NAT,REAL:],
         x,y being Real st
      a = [0,x] & b = [0,y] &
      isFiniteFloat/.a = TRUE & isFiniteFloat/.b = TRUE
    holds
      absDiff/.[a,b] = roundAbsDifference/.|.x - y.|) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      (hasCloseElementsPrecond/.[numbers,threshold] = TRUE iff
        isFloat/.threshold = TRUE &
        floatLe/.[[0,0],threshold] = TRUE &
        isNaNFloat/.threshold = FALSE &
        for i being Nat st i in dom numbers holds
          isFloat/.(numbers/.i) = TRUE &
          isNaNFloat/.(numbers/.i) = FALSE &
          isInfFloat/.(numbers/.i) = FALSE)) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         i being Nat holds
      (i < len numbers &
        readDefault/.[numbers,i] = numbers/.(i + 1)) or
      (len numbers <= i &
        readDefault/.[numbers,i] = [0,0])) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:],
         index,index2 being Nat holds
      (index2 < index &
        floatLt/.
          [absDiff/.
            [readDefault/.[numbers,index2],
             readDefault/.[numbers,index]],
           threshold] = TRUE &
        hasCloseElementsInner/.
          [numbers,threshold,index,index2] = TRUE) or
      (index2 < index &
        floatLt/.
          [absDiff/.
            [readDefault/.[numbers,index2],
             readDefault/.[numbers,index]],
           threshold] = FALSE &
        hasCloseElementsInner/.
          [numbers,threshold,index,index2] =
            hasCloseElementsInner/.
              [numbers,threshold,index,index2 + 1]) or
      (index <= index2 &
        hasCloseElementsInner/.
          [numbers,threshold,index,index2] = FALSE)) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:],
         index being Nat holds
      (index < len numbers &
        hasCloseElementsInner/.
          [numbers,threshold,index,0] = TRUE &
        hasCloseElementsOuter/.
          [numbers,threshold,index] = TRUE) or
      (index < len numbers &
        hasCloseElementsInner/.
          [numbers,threshold,index,0] = FALSE &
        hasCloseElementsOuter/.
          [numbers,threshold,index] =
            hasCloseElementsOuter/.
              [numbers,threshold,index + 1]) or
      (len numbers <= index &
        hasCloseElementsOuter/.
          [numbers,threshold,index] = FALSE)) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] holds
      hasCloseElements/.[numbers,threshold] =
        hasCloseElementsOuter/.[numbers,threshold,0]) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:],
         result being Element of BOOLEAN holds
      (hasCloseElementsPostcond/.[numbers,threshold,result] = TRUE iff
        (result = FALSE iff
          for i,j being Nat st
            i in dom numbers & j in dom numbers & i < j
          holds
            floatLe/.
              [threshold,absDiff/.[numbers/.i,numbers/.j]] = TRUE)) &
      (hasCloseElementsPostcond/.[numbers,threshold,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result = FALSE iff
            for i,j being Nat st
              i in dom numbers & j in dom numbers & i < j
            holds
              floatLe/.
                [threshold,absDiff/.[numbers/.i,numbers/.j]] =
                  TRUE))) &
    (for numbers being FinSequence of [:NAT,REAL:],
         threshold being Element of [:NAT,REAL:] st
      hasCloseElementsPrecond/.[numbers,threshold] = TRUE
    holds
      hasCloseElementsPostcond/.
        [numbers,threshold,
         hasCloseElements/.[numbers,threshold]] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_63
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_63
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_63), catalog title "has_close_elements": an
% executable nested scan decides whether two finite binary64 list elements
% have rounded absolute difference below a non-NaN, nonnegative binary64
% threshold. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_63: THEORY
BEGIN

  two_to_52: nat = 4503599627370496
  two_to_53: nat = 9007199254740992
  two_to_54: nat = 18014398509481984
  two_to_63: nat = 9223372036854775808
  two_to_64: nat = 18446744073709551616

  % Lean Float values are IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns.
  float64: TYPE = {bits: nat | bits < two_to_64}

  binary64_fraction(bits: float64): nat =
    mod(bits, two_to_52)

  binary64_exponent_field(bits: float64): nat =
    mod(ndiv(bits, two_to_52), 2048)

  binary64_magnitude_bits(bits: float64): nat =
    mod(bits, two_to_63)

  binary64_negative(bits: float64): bool =
    bits >= two_to_63

  binary64_is_nan(bits: float64): bool =
    binary64_exponent_field(bits) = 2047
      AND binary64_fraction(bits) /= 0

  binary64_is_infinite(bits: float64): bool =
    binary64_exponent_field(bits) = 2047
      AND binary64_fraction(bits) = 0

  binary64_is_finite(bits: float64): bool =
    binary64_exponent_field(bits) < 2047

  binary64_is_zero(bits: float64): bool =
    binary64_exponent_field(bits) = 0
      AND binary64_fraction(bits) = 0

  binary64_nonnegative_finite(bits: float64): bool =
    NOT binary64_negative(bits)
      AND binary64_is_finite(bits)

  % Exact magnitude of every finite binary64 value.
  binary64_magnitude_value(bits: float64): real =
    LET exponent: nat = binary64_exponent_field(bits),
        fraction: nat = binary64_fraction(bits)
    IN
      IF exponent = 0 THEN
        (fraction :: real) / ((2 :: real) ^ 1074)
      ELSIF exponent <= 1075 THEN
        ((two_to_52 + fraction) :: real)
          / ((2 :: real) ^ (1075 - exponent))
      ELSE
        ((two_to_52 + fraction) :: real)
          * ((2 :: real) ^ (exponent - 1075))
      ENDIF

  binary64_signed_value(bits: float64): real =
    IF binary64_negative(bits) THEN
      -binary64_magnitude_value(bits)
    ELSE
      binary64_magnitude_value(bits)
    ENDIF

  binary64_even_significand(bits: float64): bool =
    mod(bits, 2) = 0

  float64_positive_zero: float64 = 0

  float64_positive_infinity: float64 =
    2047 * two_to_52

  % Under round-to-nearest, ties-to-even, this is the first nonnegative real
  % magnitude whose binary64 result is positive infinity.
  binary64_overflow_midpoint: real =
    ((two_to_54 - 1) :: real) * ((2 :: real) ^ 970)

  % Exact IEEE-754 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even graph for a nonnegative real.
  % The finite branch chooses a closest representable finite value; the
  % midpoint branch captures binary64 overflow to positive infinity.
  binary64_rounds_nonnegative(
      value: real,
      rounded: float64): bool =
    value >= 0
      AND
        (IF value >= binary64_overflow_midpoint THEN
          rounded = float64_positive_infinity
        ELSE
          binary64_nonnegative_finite(rounded)
            AND
              (FORALL (candidate: float64):
                binary64_nonnegative_finite(candidate)
                  IMPLIES
                    abs(value - binary64_magnitude_value(rounded))
                      <= abs(value - binary64_magnitude_value(candidate)))
            AND
              ((EXISTS (candidate: float64):
                binary64_nonnegative_finite(candidate)
                  AND candidate /= rounded
                  AND
                    abs(value - binary64_magnitude_value(rounded))
                      = abs(value - binary64_magnitude_value(candidate)))
                IMPLIES binary64_even_significand(rounded))
        ENDIF)

  % IEEE numeric equality: NaNs compare unequal and signed zeros compare equal.
  float64_equal(left, right: float64): bool =
    NOT binary64_is_nan(left)
      AND NOT binary64_is_nan(right)
      AND
        (left = right
          OR
            (binary64_is_zero(left)
              AND binary64_is_zero(right)))

  % Exact IEEE strict order on all non-NaN binary64 values.
  float64_less_than(left, right: float64): bool =
    IF binary64_is_nan(left) OR binary64_is_nan(right) THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF binary64_is_zero(left) AND binary64_is_zero(right) THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF binary64_negative(left) AND NOT binary64_negative(right) THEN
      TRUE
    ELSIF NOT binary64_negative(left) AND binary64_negative(right) THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF NOT binary64_negative(left) THEN
      left < right
    ELSE
      left > right
    ENDIF

  float64_less_equal(left, right: float64): bool =
    float64_less_than(left, right)
      OR float64_equal(left, right)

  % For finite a and b, Lean's absDiff first rounds a - b and, exactly when
  % that result is negative, rounds b - a. Round-to-nearest is sign-symmetric,
  % so its order comparisons are exactly characterized by this graph for the
  % rounded nonnegative magnitude. Canonicalizing a possible -0 result to +0
  % preserves both comparisons used by the implementation and postcondition.
  absDiff_rounds(
      a, b, rounded: float64): bool =
    binary64_is_finite(a)
      AND binary64_is_finite(b)
      AND
        binary64_rounds_nonnegative(
          abs(binary64_signed_value(a) - binary64_signed_value(b)),
          rounded)

  absDiff_less_than(
      a, b, threshold: float64): bool =
    EXISTS (rounded: float64):
      absDiff_rounds(a, b, rounded)
        AND float64_less_than(rounded, threshold)

  absDiff_greater_equal(
      a, b, threshold: float64): bool =
    EXISTS (rounded: float64):
      absDiff_rounds(a, b, rounded)
        AND float64_less_equal(threshold, rounded)

  float64_list_length(
      values: list[float64]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        float64_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Lean List.getD with positive zero as its default.
  float64_list_get_default(
      index: nat,
      values: list[float64]): RECURSIVE float64 =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        float64_positive_zero,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          float64_list_get_default(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  binary64_list_all_finite(
      values: list[float64]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        binary64_is_finite(head)
          AND binary64_list_all_finite(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  has_close_elements_precond(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64): bool =
    float64_less_equal(float64_positive_zero, threshold)
      AND NOT binary64_is_nan(threshold)
      AND binary64_list_all_finite(numbers)

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  % The remaining argument counts exactly the source inner-loop iterations
  % with idx2 < idx.
  has_close_elements_inner_steps(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64,
      idx, idx2, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      LET a: float64 =
            float64_list_get_default(idx2, numbers),
          b: float64 =
            float64_list_get_default(idx, numbers)
      IN
        IF absDiff_less_than(a, b, threshold) THEN
          TRUE
        ELSE
          has_close_elements_inner_steps(
            numbers,
            threshold,
            idx,
            idx2 + 1,
            remaining - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  has_close_elements_inner(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64,
      idx: nat): bool =
    has_close_elements_inner_steps(
      numbers,
      threshold,
      idx,
      0,
      idx)

  % The remaining argument counts exactly the source outer-loop iterations
  % with idx < numbers.length.
  has_close_elements_outer_steps(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64,
      idx, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSIF has_close_elements_inner(numbers, threshold, idx) THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      has_close_elements_outer_steps(
        numbers,
        threshold,
        idx + 1,
        remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  has_close_elements_outer(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64,
      idx: nat): bool =
    has_close_elements_outer_steps(
      numbers,
      threshold,
      idx,
      nat_subtract(float64_list_length(numbers), idx))

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  has_close_elements(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64): bool =
    has_close_elements_outer(numbers, threshold, 0)

  absDiff_head_greater_equal(
      head: float64,
      tail: list[float64],
      threshold: float64): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES tail OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(next, rest):
        absDiff_greater_equal(head, next, threshold)
          AND absDiff_head_greater_equal(head, rest, threshold)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE tail BY <<

  % This is Lean List.Pairwise (fun a b => absDiff a b >= threshold).
  absDiff_pairwise_greater_equal(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES numbers OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        absDiff_head_greater_equal(head, tail, threshold)
          AND absDiff_pairwise_greater_equal(tail, threshold)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE numbers BY <<

  has_close_elements_postcond(
      numbers: list[float64],
      threshold: float64,
      result: bool): bool =
    (NOT result)
      IFF absDiff_pairwise_greater_equal(numbers, threshold)

  has_close_elements_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (
        numbers: list[float64],
        threshold: float64):
      has_close_elements_precond(numbers, threshold)
        IMPLIES
          has_close_elements_postcond(
            numbers,
            threshold,
            has_close_elements(numbers, threshold))

END verina_basic_63

title: verina_basic_64
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64,
   catalog title "insert": executable insertion of a bounded prefix of one
   Unicode-character array into a bounded prefix of another at a specified
   position, together with its precondition, postcondition, and final
   correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_char_scalar_value (c : lean_char) : N :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a => N.of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a)
  | LeanNonAscii code _ _ => code
  end.

Definition lean_char_eq (x y : lean_char) : Prop :=
  lean_char_scalar_value x = lean_char_scalar_value y.

Definition insert_default_char : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 0).

Definition insert_space_char : lean_char :=
  LeanAscii (Ascii.ascii_of_nat 32).

Definition insert_precond
    (oline : list lean_char)
    (l : nat)
    (nl : list lean_char)
    (p atPos : nat) : Prop :=
  (l <= length oline)%nat /\
  (p <= length nl)%nat /\
  (atPos <= l)%nat.

Fixpoint insert_set_nth
    (index : nat)
    (value : lean_char)
    (xs : list lean_char) : list lean_char :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
      match index with
      | O => value :: rest
      | S index' => x :: insert_set_nth index' value rest
      end
  end.

Fixpoint insert_fold_indices
    (count current : nat)
    (step : list lean_char -> nat -> list lean_char)
    (acc : list lean_char) : list lean_char :=
  match count with
  | O => acc
  | S count' =>
      insert_fold_indices
        count' (S current) step (step acc current)
  end.

Definition insert
    (oline : list lean_char)
    (l : nat)
    (nl : list lean_char)
    (p atPos : nat)
    (_h_precond : insert_precond oline l nl p atPos) :
    list lean_char :=
  let result := repeat insert_space_char (l + p)%nat in
  let result :=
    insert_fold_indices
      l O
      (fun (acc : list lean_char) (i : nat) =>
        if Nat.ltb i atPos
        then
          insert_set_nth
            i (nth i oline insert_default_char) acc
        else acc)
      result in
  let result :=
    insert_fold_indices
      p O
      (fun (acc : list lean_char) (i : nat) =>
        insert_set_nth
          (atPos + i)%nat
          (nth i nl insert_default_char)
          acc)
      result in
  insert_fold_indices
    l O
    (fun (acc : list lean_char) (i : nat) =>
      if Nat.leb atPos i
      then
        insert_set_nth
          (i + p)%nat
          (nth i oline insert_default_char)
          acc
      else acc)
    result.

Definition insert_postcond
    (oline : list lean_char)
    (l : nat)
    (nl : list lean_char)
    (p atPos : nat)
    (result : list lean_char)
    (_h_precond : insert_precond oline l nl p atPos) : Prop :=
  length result = (l + p)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < p)%nat ->
      lean_char_eq
        (nth (atPos + i)%nat result insert_default_char)
        (nth i nl insert_default_char)) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < atPos)%nat ->
      lean_char_eq
        (nth i result insert_default_char)
        (nth i oline insert_default_char)) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < l - atPos)%nat ->
      lean_char_eq
        (nth (atPos + p + i)%nat result insert_default_char)
        (nth (atPos + i)%nat oline insert_default_char)).

Theorem insert_spec_satisfied
    (oline : list lean_char)
    (l : nat)
    (nl : list lean_char)
    (p atPos : nat)
    (h_precond : insert_precond oline l nl p atPos) :
  insert_postcond
    oline l nl p atPos
    (insert oline l nl p atPos h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_64
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_64), catalog title "insert": an executable
  Unicode-character array program inserts the first p characters of one array
  into the first l characters of another at atPos, together with its bounds
  precondition, segment-wise postcondition, and final correctness proposition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_64
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_char_array = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition lean_nul :: lean_char where
  "lean_nul =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False False False False False False False)"

definition lean_space :: lean_char where
  "lean_space =
    BMP_Low Trit0 Trit0 Trit0
      (LeanBits3 False False False)
      (LeanByte False False True False False False False False)"

definition lean_char_array_getBang ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char" where
  "lean_char_array_getBang xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else lean_nul)"

definition lean_char_array_setBang ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char \<Rightarrow>
      lean_char_array" where
  "lean_char_array_setBang xs i x =
    (if i < length xs then list_update xs i x else xs)"

definition insert_precond ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insert_precond oline l nl p atPos \<longleftrightarrow>
    l \<le> length oline \<and>
    p \<le> length nl \<and>
    atPos \<le> l"

definition insert_prefix_step ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array" where
  "insert_prefix_step oline atPos acc i =
    (if i < atPos
     then lean_char_array_setBang acc i
       (lean_char_array_getBang oline i)
     else acc)"

definition insert_new_step ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array" where
  "insert_new_step nl atPos acc i =
    lean_char_array_setBang acc (atPos + i)
      (lean_char_array_getBang nl i)"

definition insert_suffix_step ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array" where
  "insert_suffix_step oline p atPos acc i =
    (if atPos \<le> i
     then lean_char_array_setBang acc (i + p)
       (lean_char_array_getBang oline i)
     else acc)"

definition insert ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array" where
  "insert oline l nl p atPos =
    (let result0 = replicate (l + p) lean_space;
         result1 =
           foldl (insert_prefix_step oline atPos) result0 [0..<l];
         result2 =
           foldl (insert_new_step nl atPos) result1 [0..<p];
         result3 =
           foldl (insert_suffix_step oline p atPos) result2 [0..<l]
     in result3)"

definition insert_postcond ::
    "lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> lean_char_array \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "insert_postcond oline l nl p atPos result \<longleftrightarrow>
    length result = l + p \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i. lean_char_array_getBang result (atPos + i) =
        lean_char_array_getBang nl i)
      [0..<p] \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i. lean_char_array_getBang result i =
        lean_char_array_getBang oline i)
      [0..<atPos] \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i. lean_char_array_getBang result (atPos + p + i) =
        lean_char_array_getBang oline (atPos + i))
      [0..<l - atPos]"

theorem insert_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "insert_precond oline l nl p atPos"
  shows
    "insert_postcond
      oline l nl p atPos (insert oline l nl p atPos)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_64
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_64), catalog title "insert": an executable
  three-pass insertion of a bounded character-array prefix into another
  bounded character-array prefix, together with its bounds precondition,
  exact layout postcondition, and correctness proposition. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let insert_validChar = new_definition
  `insert_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let insert_array = new_definition
  `insert_array (xs:num list) <=>
     ALL insert_validChar xs`;;

let insert_precond = new_definition
  `insert_precond
      (oline:num list) (l:num) (nl:num list) (p:num) (atPos:num) <=>
     l <= LENGTH oline /\
     p <= LENGTH nl /\
     atPos <= l`;;

let insert_getDefault = new_definition
  `insert_getDefault (xs:num list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH xs then EL i xs else 0`;;

let insert_setAt =
  new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
    `(!i:num. !value:num.
        insert_setAt ([]:num list) i value = []) /\
     (!x:num. !xs:num list. !i:num. !value:num.
        insert_setAt (CONS x xs) i value =
        if i = 0 then CONS value xs
        else CONS x (insert_setAt xs (PRE i) value))`;;

let insert_prefixLoop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!oline:num list. !atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_prefixLoop 0 oline atPos i result = result) /\
     (!fuel:num. !oline:num list. !atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_prefixLoop (SUC fuel) oline atPos i result =
        let next =
          if i < atPos then
            insert_setAt result i (insert_getDefault oline i)
          else
            result in
        insert_prefixLoop fuel oline atPos (SUC i) next)`;;

let insert_newLoop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!nl:num list. !atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_newLoop 0 nl atPos i result = result) /\
     (!fuel:num. !nl:num list. !atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_newLoop (SUC fuel) nl atPos i result =
        let next =
          insert_setAt result (atPos + i) (insert_getDefault nl i) in
        insert_newLoop fuel nl atPos (SUC i) next)`;;

let insert_suffixLoop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!oline:num list. !p atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_suffixLoop 0 oline p atPos i result = result) /\
     (!fuel:num. !oline:num list. !p atPos i:num. !result:num list.
        insert_suffixLoop (SUC fuel) oline p atPos i result =
        let next =
          if atPos <= i then
            insert_setAt result (i + p) (insert_getDefault oline i)
          else
            result in
        insert_suffixLoop fuel oline p atPos (SUC i) next)`;;

let insert = new_definition
  `insert
      (oline:num list) (l:num) (nl:num list) (p:num) (atPos:num) =
     let result0 = REPLICATE (l + p) (32:num) in
     let result1 = insert_prefixLoop l oline atPos 0 result0 in
     let result2 = insert_newLoop p nl atPos 0 result1 in
     insert_suffixLoop l oline p atPos 0 result2`;;

let insert_postcond = new_definition
  `insert_postcond
      (oline:num list) (l:num) (nl:num list) (p:num) (atPos:num)
      (result:num list) <=>
     LENGTH result = l + p /\
     (!i:num.
        i < p
        ==> insert_getDefault result (atPos + i) =
            insert_getDefault nl i) /\
     (!i:num.
        i < atPos
        ==> insert_getDefault result i =
            insert_getDefault oline i) /\
     (!i:num.
        i < l - atPos
        ==> insert_getDefault result (atPos + p + i) =
            insert_getDefault oline (atPos + i))`;;

let insert_spec_satisfied =
  `!oline:num list. !l:num. !nl:num list. !p atPos:num.
     insert_array oline /\
     insert_array nl /\
     insert_precond oline l nl p atPos
     ==> insert_postcond
           oline l nl p atPos
           (insert oline l nl p atPos)`;;

title: verina_basic_64
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64,
;; catalog title "insert": a deterministic Unicode-character array program
;; inserts the first p characters of one array at a natural position within
;; the first l characters of another array. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean Array Char values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2 lists of
;; Unicode scalar values, preserving the complete Lean Char domain.

(defun verina-basic-64-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-basic-64-char-array-p (array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count array)))
  (if (consp array)
      (and
       (verina-basic-64-unicode-scalar-p (car array))
       (verina-basic-64-char-array-p (cdr array)))
    (equal array nil)))

;; This is exactly the source precondition after Array.size is represented by
;; list length.

(defun verina-basic-64-insert-precond
    (oline l nl p at-pos)
  (and
   (<= l (len oline))
   (<= p (len nl))
   (<= at-pos l)))

;; Array.get! on Array Char returns the indexed entry when present and the
;; inhabited Unicode NUL character otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-64-array-read (index array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (car array)
          (verina-basic-64-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr array)))
      0)))

;; Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves the array unchanged when
;; its natural index is out of bounds.

(defun verina-basic-64-array-set
    (index value array)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      array
    (if (consp array)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons value (cdr array))
          (cons
           (car array)
           (verina-basic-64-array-set
            (- index 1)
            value
            (cdr array))))
      nil)))

;; This is Array.mkArray for the source's initial space-filled result.

(defun verina-basic-64-make-spaces (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons
     32
     (verina-basic-64-make-spaces (- n 1)))))

;; Each fold below traverses exactly the corresponding Array.range in
;; increasing order. REMAINING is the number of unprocessed range entries,
;; and INDEX is the current entry.

(defun verina-basic-64-copy-prefix-fold
    (result oline at-pos remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      result
    (verina-basic-64-copy-prefix-fold
     (if (< index at-pos)
         (verina-basic-64-array-set
          index
          (verina-basic-64-array-read index oline)
          result)
       result)
     oline
     at-pos
     (- remaining 1)
     (+ index 1))))

(defun verina-basic-64-insert-new-fold
    (result nl at-pos remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      result
    (verina-basic-64-insert-new-fold
     (verina-basic-64-array-set
      (+ at-pos index)
      (verina-basic-64-array-read index nl)
      result)
     nl
     at-pos
     (- remaining 1)
     (+ index 1))))

(defun verina-basic-64-copy-suffix-fold
    (result oline p at-pos remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      result
    (verina-basic-64-copy-suffix-fold
     (if (<= at-pos index)
         (verina-basic-64-array-set
          (+ index p)
          (verina-basic-64-array-read index oline)
          result)
       result)
     oline
     p
     at-pos
     (- remaining 1)
     (+ index 1))))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. The initializer and three folds reproduce the complete source
;; program in their original order.

(defun verina-basic-64-insert
    (oline l nl p at-pos)
  (let* ((result
          (verina-basic-64-make-spaces (+ l p)))
         (result
          (verina-basic-64-copy-prefix-fold
           result
           oline
           at-pos
           l
           0))
         (result
          (verina-basic-64-insert-new-fold
           result
           nl
           at-pos
           p
           0))
         (result
          (verina-basic-64-copy-suffix-fold
           result
           oline
           p
           at-pos
           l
           0)))
    result))

;; These bounded recursions are exactly the three List.range(...).all
;; expressions in the source postcondition, starting each range at zero.

(defun verina-basic-64-inserted-segment-correct-p
    (result nl at-pos remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (verina-basic-64-array-read
       (+ at-pos index)
       result)
      (verina-basic-64-array-read index nl))
     (verina-basic-64-inserted-segment-correct-p
      result
      nl
      at-pos
      (- remaining 1)
      (+ index 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-64-prefix-correct-p
    (result oline remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (verina-basic-64-array-read index result)
      (verina-basic-64-array-read index oline))
     (verina-basic-64-prefix-correct-p
      result
      oline
      (- remaining 1)
      (+ index 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-64-suffix-correct-p
    (result oline at-pos p remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (verina-basic-64-array-read
       (+ at-pos p index)
       result)
      (verina-basic-64-array-read
       (+ at-pos index)
       oline))
     (verina-basic-64-suffix-correct-p
      result
      oline
      at-pos
      p
      (- remaining 1)
      (+ index 1)))))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The typed Array Char and Nat
;; domains are explicit; the unused proof-valued precondition argument is
;; erased.

(defun verina-basic-64-insert-postcond
    (oline l nl p at-pos result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-64-char-array-p oline)
   (natp l)
   (verina-basic-64-char-array-p nl)
   (natp p)
   (natp at-pos)
   (verina-basic-64-char-array-p result)
   (equal (len result) (+ l p))
   (verina-basic-64-inserted-segment-correct-p
    result
    nl
    at-pos
    p
    0)
   (verina-basic-64-prefix-correct-p
    result
    oline
    at-pos
    0)
   (verina-basic-64-suffix-correct-p
    result
    oline
    at-pos
    p
    (- l at-pos)
    0)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over all finite Unicode-character arrays and natural parameters, assumes
;; exactly the source precondition, and connects the complete postcondition
;; to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-64-insert-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (oline l nl p at-pos)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-64-char-array-p oline)
      (natp l)
      (verina-basic-64-char-array-p nl)
      (natp p)
      (natp at-pos)
      (verina-basic-64-insert-precond
       oline
       l
       nl
       p
       at-pos))
     (verina-basic-64-insert-postcond
      oline
      l
      nl
      p
      at-pos
      (verina-basic-64-insert
       oline
       l
       nl
       p
       at-pos)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_64
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64,
-- catalog title "insert": a deterministic character-array program inserts
-- the first p characters of nl into the first l characters of oline at atPos
-- and is connected to its size and pointwise correctness contract. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic64 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using (Char; primNatToChar)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

nullChar : Char
nullChar = primNatToChar zero

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

updateAt : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat → A → Array A
updateAt [] index value = []
updateAt (x ∷ xs) zero value = value ∷ xs
updateAt (x ∷ xs) (suc index) value =
  x ∷ updateAt xs index value

replicate : {A : Set} → Nat → A → Array A
replicate zero value = []
replicate (suc count) value = value ∷ replicate count value

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

foldl :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B → A) →
  A →
  List B →
  A
foldl step accumulator [] = accumulator
foldl step accumulator (x ∷ xs) =
  foldl step (step accumulator x) xs

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

insert-precond :
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Set
insert-precond oline l nl p atPos =
  (l ≤ arraySize oline) ∧
  (p ≤ arraySize nl) ∧
  (atPos ≤ l)

copyPrefixStep :
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char
copyPrefixStep oline atPos accumulator i =
  if natLess i atPos
  then
    updateAt
      accumulator
      i
      (indexDefault nullChar oline i)
  else accumulator

insertNewStep :
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char
insertNewStep nl atPos accumulator i =
  updateAt
    accumulator
    (atPos + i)
    (indexDefault nullChar nl i)

copySuffixStep :
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Array Char →
  Nat →
  Array Char
copySuffixStep oline atPos p accumulator i =
  if natLessOrEqual atPos i
  then
    updateAt
      accumulator
      (i + p)
      (indexDefault nullChar oline i)
  else accumulator

insert :
  (oline : Array Char) →
  (l : Nat) →
  (nl : Array Char) →
  (p : Nat) →
  (atPos : Nat) →
  insert-precond oline l nl p atPos →
  Array Char
insert oline l nl p atPos h-precond =
  let initial-result = replicate (l + p) ' '
      prefix-result =
        foldl
          (copyPrefixStep oline atPos)
          initial-result
          (range l)
      inserted-result =
        foldl
          (insertNewStep nl atPos)
          prefix-result
          (range p)
      final-result =
        foldl
          (copySuffixStep oline atPos p)
          inserted-result
          (range l)
  in final-result

insert-postcond :
  (oline : Array Char) →
  (l : Nat) →
  (nl : Array Char) →
  (p : Nat) →
  (atPos : Nat) →
  (result : Array Char) →
  insert-precond oline l nl p atPos →
  Set
insert-postcond oline l nl p atPos result h-precond =
  (arraySize result ≡ l + p) ∧
  All
    (λ i →
      indexDefault nullChar result (atPos + i) ≡
      indexDefault nullChar nl i)
    (range p) ∧
  All
    (λ i →
      indexDefault nullChar result i ≡
      indexDefault nullChar oline i)
    (range atPos) ∧
  All
    (λ i →
      indexDefault nullChar result (atPos + p + i) ≡
      indexDefault nullChar oline (atPos + i))
    (range (natSubtract l atPos))

insert-spec-satisfied : Set
insert-spec-satisfied =
  (oline : Array Char) →
  (l : Nat) →
  (nl : Array Char) →
  (p : Nat) →
  (atPos : Nat) →
  (h-precond : insert-precond oline l nl p atPos) →
  insert-postcond
    oline
    l
    nl
    p
    atPos
    (insert oline l nl p atPos h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_64
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64,
  catalog title "insert": the executable Unicode-character array program
  inserts the first p characters of one array at a natural position within
  the first l characters of another array and satisfies its size and
  pointwise correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val insert_isUnicodeScalar_def = new_definition (
  "insert_isUnicodeScalar_def",
  ``insert_isUnicodeScalar (c : num) <=>
      c < 1114112 /\ ~(55296 <= c /\ c <= 57343)``
);

val insert_isUnicodeString_def = new_definition (
  "insert_isUnicodeString_def",
  ``insert_isUnicodeString (s : num list) <=>
      EVERY insert_isUnicodeScalar s``
);

val insert_nthD_def = new_definition (
  "insert_nthD_def",
  ``insert_nthD (xs : num list) (index : num) =
      if index < LENGTH xs then EL index xs else 0``
);

val insert_precond_def = new_definition (
  "insert_precond_def",
  ``insert_precond
      (oline : num list) (l : num)
      (nl : num list) (p : num) (atPos : num) <=>
      l <= LENGTH oline /\
      p <= LENGTH nl /\
      atPos <= l``
);

val insert_def = new_definition (
  "insert_def",
  ``insert
      (oline : num list) (l : num)
      (nl : num list) (p : num) (atPos : num) =
      let result = REPLICATE (l + p) 32 in
      let result =
        FOLDL
          (\acc : num list. \i : num.
             if i < atPos then
               LUPDATE (insert_nthD oline i) i acc
             else
               acc)
          result
          (GENLIST (\i : num. i) l)
      in
      let result =
        FOLDL
          (\acc : num list. \i : num.
             LUPDATE
               (insert_nthD nl i)
               (atPos + i)
               acc)
          result
          (GENLIST (\i : num. i) p)
      in
      let result =
        FOLDL
          (\acc : num list. \i : num.
             if atPos <= i then
               LUPDATE
                 (insert_nthD oline i)
                 (i + p)
                 acc
             else
               acc)
          result
          (GENLIST (\i : num. i) l)
      in
        result``
);

val insert_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "insert_postcond_def",
  ``insert_postcond
      (oline : num list) (l : num)
      (nl : num list) (p : num) (atPos : num)
      (result : num list) <=>
      insert_isUnicodeString result /\
      LENGTH result = l + p /\
      (!i : num.
         i < p ==>
         insert_nthD result (atPos + i) =
         insert_nthD nl i) /\
      (!i : num.
         i < atPos ==>
         insert_nthD result i =
         insert_nthD oline i) /\
      (!i : num.
         i < l - atPos ==>
         insert_nthD result (atPos + p + i) =
         insert_nthD oline (atPos + i))``
);

val insert_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(oline : num list) (l : num)
      (nl : num list) (p : num) (atPos : num).
      insert_isUnicodeString oline ==>
      insert_isUnicodeString nl ==>
      insert_precond oline l nl p atPos ==>
      insert_postcond
        oline l nl p atPos
        (insert oline l nl p atPos)``;

title: verina_basic_64
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_64), catalog title insert: the exact
  executable three-pass character-array program inserts a specified prefix of
  one finite array into another at the designated position and satisfies its
  size, prefix, inserted-segment, and shifted-suffix contract. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINAB64Char is exactly Lean's Char domain of Unicode scalar values, and
  Word VERINAB64Char is exactly the type of arbitrary finite character
  arrays. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number size, w ` k is zero-based
  lookup, and 0 ..^ n is the set of natural indices traversed by Array.range
  n. The Unicode scalar value 32 is Lean's space character.

  VERINAB64NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB64GetBang reproduces Array.get! on character arrays, including the
  inhabited default character with scalar value zero outside the array.
  VERINAB64SetBangGraph and its iota-selected function reproduce Array.set!,
  including unchanged-array behavior at an out-of-range index.
  VERINAB64BlankArray is exactly Array.mkArray n ' '.

  VERINAB64PrefixGraph is the exact execution trace of the first Array.foldl
  over Array.range l: transition k writes oline[k]! at k precisely when
  k < atPos. VERINAB64NewGraph is the exact trace of the second fold: its
  transition k writes nl[k]! at atPos + k. VERINAB64SuffixGraph is the exact
  trace of the third fold: transition k writes oline[k]! at k + p precisely
  when k >= atPos. Their iota-selected functions therefore fix the same
  unique intermediate and final arrays as the source program, in the same
  left-to-right order, without admitting additional outputs.

  VERINAB64Pre preserves the three source bounds. VERINAB64Insert composes the
  blank-array initialization and the three folds exactly. VERINAB64Post
  preserves the result-size equation and the three List.range all conditions,
  with get! retained explicitly. The proof-valued precondition arguments to
  the implementation and postcondition are computationally and
  propositionally unused beyond the explicit precondition antecedent in the
  final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this database has no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB64Char VERINAB64NatSub VERINAB64GetBang
  VERINAB64SetBangGraph VERINAB64SetBang
  VERINAB64BlankArrayGraph VERINAB64BlankArray
  VERINAB64PrefixGraph VERINAB64Prefix
  VERINAB64NewGraph VERINAB64New
  VERINAB64SuffixGraph VERINAB64Suffix
  VERINAB64Pre VERINAB64Insert VERINAB64Post
$.

verinab64-char-syntax
  $a class VERINAB64Char $.
verinab64-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64NatSub A B ) $.
verinab64-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64GetBang A B ) $.
verinab64-set-bang-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64SetBangGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab64-set-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64SetBang A B C ) $.
verinab64-blank-array-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64BlankArrayGraph A B ) $.
verinab64-blank-array-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64BlankArray A ) $.
verinab64-prefix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64PrefixGraph A B C D E ) $.
verinab64-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64Prefix A B C D ) $.
verinab64-new-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64NewGraph A B C D E ) $.
verinab64-new-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64New A B C D ) $.
verinab64-suffix-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64SuffixGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verinab64-suffix-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64Suffix A B C D E ) $.
verinab64-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64Pre A B C D E ) $.
verinab64-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB64Insert A B C D E ) $.
verinab64-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB64Post A B C D E F ) $.

verinab64-char-definition $a |- VERINAB64Char =
  { x e. NN0 |
    (
      x < ; ; ; ; ; ; 1 1 1 4 1 1 2
      /\
      (
        x < ; ; ; ; 5 5 2 9 6
        \/
        ; ; ; ; 5 7 3 4 3 < x
      )
    )
  } $.

verinab64-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB64NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab64-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB64GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d k A B C D $.

  verinab64-set-bang-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64SetBangGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word VERINAB64Char
          /\
          B e. NN0
        )
        /\
        C e. VERINAB64Char
      )
      /\
      D e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` D ) = ( # ` A )
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        ( D ` k ) = if (
          k = B ,
          C ,
          ( A ` k )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab64-set-bang-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64SetBang A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB64Char
      ( VERINAB64SetBangGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k A B $.

  verinab64-blank-array-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64BlankArrayGraph A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. NN0
      /\
      B e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    (
      ( # ` B ) = A
      /\
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ A )
        ( B ` k ) = ( ; 3 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A $.

  verinab64-blank-array-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64BlankArray A
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB64Char
      ( VERINAB64BlankArrayGraph A y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E $.

  verinab64-prefix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64PrefixGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word VERINAB64Char
            /\
            B e. NN0
          )
          /\
          C e. NN0
        )
        /\
        D e. Word VERINAB64Char
      )
      /\
      E e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word VERINAB64Char )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( B + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = D
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ B )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              k < C ,
              (
                VERINAB64SetBang
                  ( t ` k )
                  k
                  ( VERINAB64GetBang A k )
              ) ,
              ( t ` k )
            )
          /\
          E = ( t ` B )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verinab64-prefix-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64Prefix A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB64Char
      ( VERINAB64PrefixGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E $.

  verinab64-new-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64NewGraph A B C D E
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word VERINAB64Char
            /\
            B e. NN0
          )
          /\
          C e. NN0
        )
        /\
        D e. Word VERINAB64Char
      )
      /\
      E e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word VERINAB64Char )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( B + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = D
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ B )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = (
              VERINAB64SetBang
                ( t ` k )
                ( C + k )
                ( VERINAB64GetBang A k )
            )
          /\
          E = ( t ` B )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D $.

  verinab64-new-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64New A B C D
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB64Char
      ( VERINAB64NewGraph A B C D y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E F $.

  verinab64-suffix-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64SuffixGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            (
              A e. Word VERINAB64Char
              /\
              B e. NN0
            )
            /\
            C e. NN0
          )
          /\
          D e. NN0
        )
        /\
        E e. Word VERINAB64Char
      )
      /\
      F e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( Word VERINAB64Char )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( B + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = E
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ B )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              D <_ k ,
              (
                VERINAB64SetBang
                  ( t ` k )
                  ( k + C )
                  ( VERINAB64GetBang A k )
              ) ,
              ( t ` k )
            )
          /\
          F = ( t ` B )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verinab64-suffix-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64Suffix A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. Word VERINAB64Char
      ( VERINAB64SuffixGraph A B C D E y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab64-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB64Pre A B C D E
) <-> (
  (
    (
      (
        A e. Word VERINAB64Char
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. Word VERINAB64Char
    )
    /\
    (
      D e. NN0
      /\
      E e. NN0
    )
  )
  /\
  (
    B <_ ( # ` A )
    /\
    (
      D <_ ( # ` C )
      /\
      E <_ B
    )
  )
) $.

verinab64-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB64Insert A B C D E
) = (
  VERINAB64Suffix
    A
    B
    D
    E
    (
      VERINAB64New
        C
        D
        E
        (
          VERINAB64Prefix
            A
            B
            E
            ( VERINAB64BlankArray ( B + D ) )
        )
    )
) $.

${
  $d i A B C D E F $.

  verinab64-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB64Post A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            (
              A e. Word VERINAB64Char
              /\
              B e. NN0
            )
            /\
            C e. Word VERINAB64Char
          )
          /\
          (
            D e. NN0
            /\
            E e. NN0
          )
        )
        /\
        F e. Word VERINAB64Char
      )
      /\
      ( # ` F ) = ( B + D )
    )
    /\
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ D )
        (
          VERINAB64GetBang F ( E + i )
        ) = (
          VERINAB64GetBang C i
        )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ E )
          (
            VERINAB64GetBang F i
          ) = (
            VERINAB64GetBang A i
          )
        /\
        A. i e. (
          0 ..^ ( VERINAB64NatSub B E )
        )
          (
            VERINAB64GetBang F ( ( E + D ) + i )
          ) = (
            VERINAB64GetBang A ( E + i )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-64-insert $a |-
  A. o e. Word VERINAB64Char
    A. l e. NN0
      A. n e. Word VERINAB64Char
        A. p e. NN0
          A. a e. NN0
            (
              ( VERINAB64Pre o l n p a )
              ->
              (
                VERINAB64Post
                  o
                  l
                  n
                  p
                  a
                  ( VERINAB64Insert o l n p a )
              )
            )
$.

title: verina_basic_64
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_64), catalog title "insert": the Unicode-
:: scalar array precondition, exact space initialization and three-pass
:: insertion implementation, segment postcondition, and final correctness
:: contract. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, FUNCT_4, FUNCT_7, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1,
    ORDINAL4, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0,
    MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FUNCT_4, FUNCT_7, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCT_4,
    FUNCT_7, CARD_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FUNCT_7, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0,
    XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex isUnicodeScalar being Function of NAT,BOOLEAN,
     isCharArray being Function of NAT*,BOOLEAN,
     insertPrecond being
       Function of [:[:NAT*,NAT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],BOOLEAN,
     readDefault being Function of [:NAT*,NAT:],NAT,
     setBang being Function of [:NAT*,NAT,NAT:],NAT*,
     blankArray being Function of NAT,NAT*,
     firstPass,secondPass being
       Function of [:[:NAT*,NAT*:],[:NAT,NAT:]:],NAT*,
     thirdPass being
       Function of [:[:NAT*,NAT*:],[:NAT,NAT,NAT:]:],NAT*,
     insertProgram being
       Function of [:[:NAT*,NAT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:],NAT*,
     insertPostcond being
       Function of
         [:[:NAT*,NAT*:],[:NAT,NAT:],[:NAT,NAT*:]:],BOOLEAN st
    (for c being Nat holds
      (isUnicodeScalar/.c = TRUE iff
        c < 1114112 & (c < 55296 or 57343 < c)) &
      (isUnicodeScalar/.c = FALSE iff
        not (c < 1114112 & (c < 55296 or 57343 < c)))) &
    (for s being FinSequence of NAT holds
      (isCharArray/.s = TRUE iff
        for i being Nat st i in dom s holds
          isUnicodeScalar/.(s/.i) = TRUE) &
      (isCharArray/.s = FALSE iff
        not
          (for i being Nat st i in dom s holds
            isUnicodeScalar/.(s/.i) = TRUE))) &
    (for oline,nl being FinSequence of NAT,
         l,p,atPos being Nat holds
      (insertPrecond/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],atPos] = TRUE iff
        l <= len oline & p <= len nl & atPos <= l) &
      (insertPrecond/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],atPos] = FALSE iff
        not (l <= len oline & p <= len nl & atPos <= l))) &
    (for s being FinSequence of NAT, i being Nat holds
      ((i < len s &
          readDefault/.[s,i] = s/.(i + 1)) or
       (len s <= i &
          readDefault/.[s,i] = 0))) &
    (for s being FinSequence of NAT, i,value being Nat holds
      ((i < len s &
          setBang/.[s,i,value] = s +* ((i + 1),value)) or
       (len s <= i &
          setBang/.[s,i,value] = s))) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      len (blankArray/.n) = n &
      for i being Nat st i in dom (blankArray/.n) holds
        (blankArray/.n).i = 32) &
    (for oline,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos being Nat holds
      firstPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,0]] = acc) &
    (for oline,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos,n being Nat holds
      (n < atPos &
        firstPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,n + 1]] =
          setBang/.
            [firstPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,n]],
             n,readDefault/.[oline,n]]) or
      (atPos <= n &
        firstPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,n + 1]] =
          firstPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,n]])) &
    (for nl,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos being Nat holds
      secondPass/.[[nl,acc],[atPos,0]] = acc) &
    (for nl,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos,n being Nat holds
      secondPass/.[[nl,acc],[atPos,n + 1]] =
        setBang/.
          [secondPass/.[[nl,acc],[atPos,n]],
           atPos + n,readDefault/.[nl,n]]) &
    (for oline,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos,p being Nat holds
      thirdPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,p,0]] = acc) &
    (for oline,acc being FinSequence of NAT,
         atPos,p,n being Nat holds
      (n < atPos &
        thirdPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,p,n + 1]] =
          thirdPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,p,n]]) or
      (atPos <= n &
        thirdPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,p,n + 1]] =
          setBang/.
            [thirdPass/.[[oline,acc],[atPos,p,n]],
             n + p,readDefault/.[oline,n]])) &
    (for oline,nl being FinSequence of NAT,
         l,p,atPos being Nat holds
      insertProgram/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],atPos] =
        thirdPass/.
          [[oline,
            secondPass/.
              [[nl,
                firstPass/.
                  [[oline,blankArray/.(l + p)],[atPos,l]]],
               [atPos,p]]],
           [atPos,p,l]]) &
    (for oline,nl,result being FinSequence of NAT,
         l,p,atPos being Nat holds
      (insertPostcond/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],[atPos,result]] = TRUE iff
        len result = l + p &
        (for i being Nat st i < p holds
          readDefault/.[result,atPos + i] =
            readDefault/.[nl,i]) &
        (for i being Nat st i < atPos holds
          readDefault/.[result,i] =
            readDefault/.[oline,i]) &
        (for i being Nat st i < l -' atPos holds
          readDefault/.[result,atPos + p + i] =
            readDefault/.[oline,atPos + i])) &
      (insertPostcond/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],[atPos,result]] = FALSE iff
        not
          (len result = l + p &
           (for i being Nat st i < p holds
             readDefault/.[result,atPos + i] =
               readDefault/.[nl,i]) &
           (for i being Nat st i < atPos holds
             readDefault/.[result,i] =
               readDefault/.[oline,i]) &
           (for i being Nat st i < l -' atPos holds
             readDefault/.[result,atPos + p + i] =
               readDefault/.[oline,atPos + i])))) &
    (for oline,nl being FinSequence of NAT,
         l,p,atPos being Nat st
      isCharArray/.oline = TRUE &
      isCharArray/.nl = TRUE &
      insertPrecond/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],atPos] = TRUE
    holds
      insertPostcond/.
        [[oline,nl],[l,p],
         [atPos,insertProgram/.[[oline,nl],[l,p],atPos]]] = TRUE)
proof
end;

title: verina_basic_64
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_64
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_64), catalog title "insert": inserting a bounded
% prefix of one character array at a specified position in a bounded prefix of
% another, with the exact three-fold executable program and its size and
% indexwise correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_64: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Lean Char values are Unicode scalar values.
  lean_char: TYPE =
    {codepoint: nat |
      codepoint < 1114112
        AND (codepoint < 55296 OR codepoint >= 57344)}

  lean_null_char: lean_char = 0
  lean_space: lean_char = 32

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  lean_char_list_length(
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        lean_char_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on character arrays returns the inhabited null character
  % outside the array. Every source-program access is in bounds under the
  % precondition, but the total behavior is retained.
  lean_char_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE lean_char =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        lean_null_char,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          lean_char_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.set! replaces an in-bounds entry and leaves an out-of-bounds
  % array unchanged.
  lean_char_list_set_bang(
      index: nat,
      new_value: lean_char,
      values: list[lean_char]): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        null[lean_char],
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          cons(new_value, tail)
        ELSE
          cons(
            head,
            lean_char_list_set_bang(
              index - 1,
              new_value,
              tail))
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is Array.mkArray for character arrays.
  lean_char_mk_array(
      count: nat,
      value: lean_char): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null[lean_char]
    ELSE
      cons(
        value,
        lean_char_mk_array(count - 1, value))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  insert_precond(
      oline: list[lean_char],
      l: nat,
      nl: list[lean_char],
      p, atPos: nat): bool =
    l <= lean_char_list_length(oline)
      AND p <= lean_char_list_length(nl)
      AND atPos <= l

  % Each pass below is the source Array.foldl over Array.range, processing the
  % generated indices in increasing order with the same conditional updates.
  insert_first_pass(
      oline: list[lean_char],
      atPos: nat,
      result: list[lean_char],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      result
    ELSE
      LET updated: list[lean_char] =
            IF index < atPos THEN
              lean_char_list_set_bang(
                index,
                lean_char_list_get_bang(index, oline),
                result)
            ELSE
              result
            ENDIF
      IN
        insert_first_pass(
          oline,
          atPos,
          updated,
          index + 1,
          remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  insert_second_pass(
      nl: list[lean_char],
      atPos: nat,
      result: list[lean_char],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      result
    ELSE
      LET updated: list[lean_char] =
            lean_char_list_set_bang(
              atPos + index,
              lean_char_list_get_bang(index, nl),
              result)
      IN
        insert_second_pass(
          nl,
          atPos,
          updated,
          index + 1,
          remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  insert_third_pass(
      oline: list[lean_char],
      p, atPos: nat,
      result: list[lean_char],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE list[lean_char] =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      result
    ELSE
      LET updated: list[lean_char] =
            IF index >= atPos THEN
              lean_char_list_set_bang(
                index + p,
                lean_char_list_get_bang(index, oline),
                result)
            ELSE
              result
            ENDIF
      IN
        insert_third_pass(
          oline,
          p,
          atPos,
          updated,
          index + 1,
          remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  insert(
      oline: list[lean_char],
      l: nat,
      nl: list[lean_char],
      p, atPos: nat): list[lean_char] =
    LET initial: list[lean_char] =
          lean_char_mk_array(l + p, lean_space),
        after_first: list[lean_char] =
          insert_first_pass(
            oline,
            atPos,
            initial,
            0,
            l),
        after_second: list[lean_char] =
          insert_second_pass(
            nl,
            atPos,
            after_first,
            0,
            p)
    IN
      insert_third_pass(
        oline,
        p,
        atPos,
        after_second,
        0,
        l)

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  insert_postcond(
      oline: list[lean_char],
      l: nat,
      nl: list[lean_char],
      p, atPos: nat,
      result: list[lean_char]): bool =
    lean_char_list_length(result) = l + p
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < p
            IMPLIES
              lean_char_list_get_bang(atPos + i, result)
                = lean_char_list_get_bang(i, nl))
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < atPos
            IMPLIES
              lean_char_list_get_bang(i, result)
                = lean_char_list_get_bang(i, oline))
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < nat_subtract(l, atPos)
            IMPLIES
              lean_char_list_get_bang(atPos + p + i, result)
                = lean_char_list_get_bang(atPos + i, oline))

  insert_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (
        oline: list[lean_char],
        l: nat,
        nl: list[lean_char],
        p, atPos: nat):
      insert_precond(oline, l, nl, p, atPos)
        IMPLIES
          insert_postcond(
            oline,
            l,
            nl,
            p,
            atPos,
            insert(oline, l, nl, p, atPos))

END verina_basic_64

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_65,
   catalog title "SquareRoot": executable computation of the integer square
   root of a natural number by a bounded incrementing loop, together with its
   precondition, square-bound postcondition, and final correctness proposition.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool.

Definition SquareRoot_precond (_N : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint SquareRoot_boundedLoop
    (N bound r : nat) : nat :=
  match bound with
  | O => r
  | S bound' =>
      if Nat.leb ((r + 1) * (r + 1)) N
      then SquareRoot_boundedLoop N bound' (r + 1)
      else r
  end.

Definition SquareRoot
    (N : nat)
    (_h_precond : SquareRoot_precond N) : nat :=
  SquareRoot_boundedLoop N (N + 1) O.

Definition SquareRoot_postcond
    (N result : nat)
    (_h_precond : SquareRoot_precond N) : Prop :=
  (result * result <= N)%nat /\
  (N < (result + 1) * (result + 1))%nat.

Theorem SquareRoot_spec_satisfied
    (N : nat)
    (h_precond : SquareRoot_precond N) :
  SquareRoot_postcond
    N (SquareRoot N h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_65,
;; catalog title "SquareRoot": a deterministic bounded natural-number search
;; computes the integer square root characterized by consecutive squares.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The Nat input domain remains explicit in
;; the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-65-square-root-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; This is the source-local BOUNDEDLOOP recursion. Zero fuel returns the
;; current candidate. Positive fuel increments the candidate exactly when its
;; next square is at most N, then recurs with predecessor fuel; otherwise it
;; returns the current candidate immediately.

(defun verina-basic-65-bounded-loop (n bound r)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix bound)))
  (if (zp bound)
      r
    (if (<= (* (+ r 1) (+ r 1)) n)
        (verina-basic-65-bounded-loop
         n
         (- bound 1)
         (+ r 1))
      r)))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. Starting from zero with N+1 units of fuel reproduces the
;; complete executable Lean implementation.

(defun verina-basic-65-square-root (n)
  (verina-basic-65-bounded-loop n (+ n 1) 0))

;; This is the complete source postcondition over Nat: RESULT is the greatest
;; natural whose square is at most N, expressed by the same two inequalities.

(defun verina-basic-65-square-root-postcond (n result)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp result)
   (<= (* result result) n)
   (< n (* (+ result 1) (+ result 1)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every natural input, assumes exactly the source True precondition, and
;; applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-65-square-root-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (verina-basic-65-square-root-precond n))
     (verina-basic-65-square-root-postcond
      n
      (verina-basic-65-square-root n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_65
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_65,
-- catalog title "SquareRoot": a deterministic bounded natural-number loop
-- computes the integer square root and is connected to the contract that its
-- square is at most N while the next square exceeds N. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic65 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

SquareRoot-precond : Nat → Set
SquareRoot-precond N = Top

SquareRoot-boundedLoop : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
SquareRoot-boundedLoop N zero r = r
SquareRoot-boundedLoop N (suc bound) r =
  if natLessOrEqual ((suc r) * (suc r)) N
  then SquareRoot-boundedLoop N bound (suc r)
  else r

SquareRoot :
  (N : Nat) →
  SquareRoot-precond N →
  Nat
SquareRoot N h-precond =
  SquareRoot-boundedLoop N (suc N) zero

SquareRoot-postcond :
  (N result : Nat) →
  SquareRoot-precond N →
  Set
SquareRoot-postcond N result h-precond =
  (result * result ≤ N) ∧
  (N < (suc result) * (suc result))

SquareRoot-spec-satisfied : Set
SquareRoot-spec-satisfied =
  (N : Nat) →
  (h-precond : SquareRoot-precond N) →
  SquareRoot-postcond
    N
    (SquareRoot N h-precond)
    h-precond
