    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex linearSearchPrecond being Function of [:INT*,INT:],BOOLEAN,
     linearSearchAux being Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],NAT,
     linearSearchProgram being Function of [:INT*,INT:],NAT,
     linearSearchPostcond being
       Function of [:INT*,INT,NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, e being Integer holds
      (linearSearchPrecond/.[a,e] = TRUE iff
        ex i being Nat st
          i < len a & a/.(i + 1) = e) &
      (linearSearchPrecond/.[a,e] = FALSE iff
        not ex i being Nat st
          i < len a & a/.(i + 1) = e)) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, e being Integer,
         n being Nat holds
      ((n < len a &
          a/.(n + 1) = e &
          linearSearchAux/.[a,e,n] = n) or
       (n < len a &
          a/.(n + 1) <> e &
          linearSearchAux/.[a,e,n] =
            linearSearchAux/.[a,e,n + 1]) or
       (len a <= n &
          linearSearchAux/.[a,e,n] = 0))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, e being Integer holds
      linearSearchProgram/.[a,e] =
        linearSearchAux/.[a,e,0]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, e being Integer,
         result being Nat holds
      (linearSearchPostcond/.[a,e,result] = TRUE iff
        result < len a &
        a/.(result + 1) = e &
        (for k being Nat st k < result holds
          a/.(k + 1) <> e)) &
      (linearSearchPostcond/.[a,e,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result < len a &
           a/.(result + 1) = e &
           (for k being Nat st k < result holds
             a/.(k + 1) <> e)))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT, e being Integer st
      linearSearchPrecond/.[a,e] = TRUE
    holds
      linearSearchPostcond/.
        [a,e,linearSearchProgram/.[a,e]] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_69
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_69
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_69), catalog title "LinearSearch": assuming a
% target occurs in a finite integer array, the exact recursive left-to-right
% search returns its first index. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_69: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  LinearSearch_precond(
      a: list[int],
      e: int): bool =
    EXISTS (i: nat):
      i < int_list_length(a)
        AND int_list_get_bang(i, a) = e

  linearSearchAux_steps(
      a: list[int],
      e: int,
      n, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF n < int_list_length(a) THEN
      IF int_list_get_bang(n, a) = e THEN
        n
      ELSE
        linearSearchAux_steps(
          a,
          e,
          n + 1,
          fuel - 1)
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  % The distance to the array boundary plus one covers every source recursive
  % call and its final bounds check, so the fuel-zero fallback is unreachable.
  linearSearchAux(
      a: list[int],
      e: int,
      n: nat): nat =
    linearSearchAux_steps(
      a,
      e,
      n,
      nat_subtract(int_list_length(a), n) + 1)

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  LinearSearch(
      a: list[int],
      e: int): nat =
    linearSearchAux(a, e, 0)

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  LinearSearch_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      e: int,
      result: nat): bool =
    result < int_list_length(a)
      AND int_list_get_bang(result, a) = e
      AND
        (FORALL (k: nat):
          k < result
            IMPLIES int_list_get_bang(k, a) /= e)

  LinearSearch_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int], e: int):
      LinearSearch_precond(a, e)
        IMPLIES
          LinearSearch_postcond(
            a,
            e,
            LinearSearch(a, e))

END verina_basic_69

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7,
   catalog title "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": executable accumulation of
   the squares of the first n odd natural numbers, together with its trivial
   precondition, closed-form postcondition, and final correctness proposition.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond
    (_n : nat) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
    (k sum : nat) : nat :=
  match k with
  | O => sum
  | S k' =>
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
        k'
        (sum + (2 * S k' - 1) * (2 * S k' - 1))
  end.

Definition sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers
    (n : nat)
    (_h_precond : sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n) : nat :=
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop n 0.

Definition sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
    (n result : nat)
    (_h_precond : sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n) : Prop :=
  result - Nat.div (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) 3 = 0 /\
  Nat.div (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) 3 - result = 0.

Theorem sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_spec_satisfied
    (n : nat)
    (h_precond : sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n) :
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
    n
    (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

(*

  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_7), catalog title
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": an executable natural-number recursion
  sums the squares of the first n odd numbers, together with its unconditional
  precondition, closed-form postcondition, and final correctness proposition.
  This file contains no proof.

theory verina_basic_7
  imports Main
begin

definition sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop 0 acc = acc"
| "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop (Suc k) acc =
    sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop k
      (acc + (2 * (Suc k) - 1) * (2 * (Suc k) - 1))"

definition sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n =
    sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop n 0"

    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond n result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result - (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div 3 = 0 \<and>
    (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div 3 - result = 0"

theorem sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_spec_satisfied:
  assumes "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n"
  shows
    "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
      n (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_7), catalog title
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": an executable natural-number recursion
  accumulates the squares of the first n odd numbers and is connected to its
  exact natural-division and truncated-subtraction correctness contract. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond = new_definition
  `sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond (n:num) <=> T`;;

let sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!acc:num.
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop 0 acc = acc) /\
     (!k:num. !acc:num.
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop (SUC k) acc =
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
          k
          (acc +
           (2 * SUC k - 1) * (2 * SUC k - 1)))`;;

let sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers = new_definition
  `sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers (n:num) =
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop n 0`;;

let sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond = new_definition
  `sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
      (n:num) (result:num) <=>
     result - ((n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) DIV 3) = 0 /\
     ((n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1)) DIV 3) - result = 0`;;

let sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_spec_satisfied =
  `!n:num.
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n
     ==> sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond

title: verina_basic_7
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7,
;; catalog title "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": a deterministic
;; natural-number recursion sums the squares of the first n odd numbers and
;; satisfies the source closed formula. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The Nat input domain remains explicit in
;; the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-precond (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  t)

;; This is the source-local LOOP recursion. For positive K, ODD is the source
;; value 2 * K - 1, the accumulator gains ODD squared, and K decreases by one.

(defun verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-loop (k sum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      sum
    (let ((odd (- (* 2 k) 1)))
      (verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-loop
       (- k 1)
       (+ sum (* odd odd))))))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument has no computational effect and
;; is erased. The initial call preserves the source loop n 0 exactly.

(defun verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares (n)
  (verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-loop n 0))

;; Lean Nat subtraction truncates at zero.

(defun verina-basic-7-nat-sub (left right)
  (nfix (- left right)))

;; On natural inputs, ACL2 FLOOR by positive divisor three is Lean Nat
;; division. The multiplication and truncated subtraction preserve the source
;; expression n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 3.

(defun verina-basic-7-closed-form (n)
  (floor
   (* n
      (verina-basic-7-nat-sub (* 2 n) 1)
      (+ (* 2 n) 1))
   3))

;; This is the complete two-sided source postcondition.

(defun verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-postcond (n result)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp result)
   (let ((expected (verina-basic-7-closed-form n)))
     (and
      (equal
       (verina-basic-7-nat-sub result expected)
       0)
      (equal
       (verina-basic-7-nat-sub expected result)
       0)))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over the complete Nat input domain, assumes exactly the source True
;; precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-precond n))
     (verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-postcond
      n
      (verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7,
-- catalog title "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": a deterministic natural-number
-- countdown program sums the squares of the first n odd numbers and is connected
-- to its closed-form correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic7 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

naturalDivThree : Nat → Nat
naturalDivThree zero = zero
naturalDivThree (suc zero) = zero
naturalDivThree (suc (suc zero)) = zero
naturalDivThree (suc (suc (suc n))) =
  suc (naturalDivThree n)

oddSquare : Nat → Nat
oddSquare k =
  let odd = natSubtract (two * k) one
  in odd * odd

sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-loop : Nat → Nat → Nat
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-loop zero sum = sum
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-loop (suc k) sum =
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-loop
    k
    (sum + oddSquare (suc k))

sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-precond : Nat → Set
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-precond n = Top

sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers :
  (n : Nat) →
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-precond n →
  Nat
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n h-precond =
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-loop n zero

sumOfSquaresClosedForm : Nat → Nat
sumOfSquaresClosedForm n =
  naturalDivThree
    ((n * natSubtract (two * n) one) * ((two * n) + one))

sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-postcond :
  (n result : Nat) →
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-precond n →
  Set
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-postcond n result h-precond =
  (natSubtract result (sumOfSquaresClosedForm n) ≡ zero) ∧
  (natSubtract (sumOfSquaresClosedForm n) result ≡ zero)

sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-spec-satisfied : Set
sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-spec-satisfied =
  (n : Nat) →
  (h-precond : sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-precond n) →
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers-postcond
    n
    (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n h-precond)
    h-precond

(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7,
  catalog title "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": the executable
  natural-number recursion sums the squares of the first n odd numbers and
  satisfies the stated closed-form contract. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond_def",
  ``sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond (n : num) <=> T``
);

val sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop_def = Define `
  (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
      0 (sum : num) =
     sum) /\
  (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
      (SUC k) sum =
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop
       k
       (sum +
        (2 * SUC k - 1) * (2 * SUC k - 1)))
`;

val sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_def",
  ``sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers (n : num) =
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop n 0``
);

val sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond_def",
  ``sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
      (n : num) (result : num) <=>
      result - (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1) DIV 3) = 0 /\
      (n * (2 * n - 1) * (2 * n + 1) DIV 3) - result = 0``
);

val sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_spec_satisfied =
  ``!n : num.
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond n ==>
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond
        n (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers n)``;

title: verina_basic_7
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_7), catalog title
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers: the exact descending natural-number
  accumulator recursion sums the squares of the first n odd numbers and
  satisfies its closed-form correctness contract. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the full natural-number domain, and Word NN0 is exactly the
  type of arbitrary finite natural-number execution traces.

  VERINAB7NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction.
  VERINAB7LoopGraph is the exact execution graph of the source local loop for
  every natural current counter and accumulator. Its two traces begin with
  those arguments. At each of exactly A transitions the positive counter is
  decremented by one and the accumulator is increased by the square of
  2*k-1, using truncated subtraction exactly as in the Lean program. The
  final counter is zero and C is the final accumulator. VERINAB7Loop selects
  this unique result, and VERINAB7SumOfSquares invokes it with accumulator
  zero. Thus the executable result is fixed independently of the
  postcondition and no extra output is admitted.

  VERINAB7ClosedForm is the source natural-number expression
  n*(2*n-1)*(2*n+1)/3. Since its numerator is nonnegative, floor of SetMM
  rational division by three is exactly Lean's Nat.div. VERINAB7Pre is the
  source True precondition together with the Nat input type. VERINAB7Post
  preserves both source conjuncts using truncated natural subtraction.
  The proof-valued precondition arguments are computationally and
  propositionally unused and are represented by the explicit precondition
  antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax
  or a faithful definition required by this rendering, and this database has
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB7NatSub VERINAB7LoopGraph VERINAB7Loop
  VERINAB7Pre VERINAB7SumOfSquares VERINAB7ClosedForm VERINAB7Post
$.

verinab7-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB7NatSub A B ) $.
verinab7-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB7LoopGraph A B C ) $.
verinab7-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB7Loop A B ) $.
verinab7-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB7Pre A ) $.
verinab7-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB7SumOfSquares A ) $.
verinab7-closed-form-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB7ClosedForm A ) $.
verinab7-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB7Post A B ) $.

verinab7-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB7NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

${
  $d i k s A B C $.

  verinab7-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB7LoopGraph A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. NN0
        /\
        B e. NN0
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. k e. Word NN0 E. s e. Word NN0
      (
        (
          (
            ( # ` k ) = ( A + 1 )
            /\
            ( # ` s ) = ( A + 1 )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( k ` 0 ) = A
            /\
            ( s ` 0 ) = B
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ A )
            (
              0 < ( k ` i )
              /\
              (
                (
                  k ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  VERINAB7NatSub
                    ( k ` i )
                    1
                )
                /\
                (
                  s ` ( i + 1 )
                ) = (
                  ( s ` i )
                  +
                  (
                    (
                      VERINAB7NatSub
                        ( 2 x. ( k ` i ) )
                        1
                    )
                    x.
                    (
                      VERINAB7NatSub
                        ( 2 x. ( k ` i ) )
                        1
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            ( k ` A ) = 0
            /\
            C = ( s ` A )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B $.

  verinab7-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB7Loop A B
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB7LoopGraph A B y )
  ) $.
$}

verinab7-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB7Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. NN0
) $.

verinab7-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB7SumOfSquares A
) = (
  VERINAB7Loop A 0
) $.

verinab7-closed-form-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB7ClosedForm A
) = (
  |_ ` (
    (
      (
        A
        x.
        ( VERINAB7NatSub ( 2 x. A ) 1 )
      )
      x.
      ( ( 2 x. A ) + 1 )
    )
    /
    3
  )
) $.

verinab7-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB7Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. NN0
    /\
    B e. NN0
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      VERINAB7NatSub
        B
        ( VERINAB7ClosedForm A )
    ) = 0
    /\
    (
      VERINAB7NatSub
        ( VERINAB7ClosedForm A )
        B
    ) = 0
  )
) $.

verina-basic-7-sum-of-squares-of-first-n-odd-numbers $a |- A. n e. NN0
  (
    ( VERINAB7Pre n )
    ->
    (
      VERINAB7Post
        n
        ( VERINAB7SumOfSquares n )
    )
  )
$.

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact
:: verina_basic_7 (verina__mizar__verina_basic_7), catalog title
:: "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": the unconditional precondition, exact
:: accumulator recursion summing the squares of the first n odd natural
:: numbers, closed-form postcondition, and final correctness contract. This
:: file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, CARD_1,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0,
    MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPrecond being
       Function of NAT,BOOLEAN,
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersLoop being
       Function of [:NAT,NAT:],NAT,
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers being Function of NAT,NAT,
     sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPostcond being
       Function of [:NAT,NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for n being Nat holds
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPrecond/.n = TRUE) &
    (for sum being Nat holds
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersLoop/.[0,sum] = sum) &
    (for k,sum being Nat holds
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersLoop/.[k + 1,sum] =
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersLoop/.
          [k,sum + (2 * (k + 1) -' 1) * (2 * (k + 1) -' 1)]) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers/.n =
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersLoop/.[n,0]) &
    (for n,result being Nat holds
      (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPostcond/.[n,result] = TRUE iff
        result -'
            ((n * (2 * n -' 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div (3 qua Nat)) = 0 &
        ((n * (2 * n -' 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div (3 qua Nat)) -'
            result = 0) &
      (sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPostcond/.[n,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result -'
              ((n * (2 * n -' 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div (3 qua Nat)) = 0 &
           ((n * (2 * n -' 1) * (2 * n + 1)) div (3 qua Nat)) -'
              result = 0))) &
    (for n being Nat st
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPrecond/.n = TRUE
    holds
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbersPostcond/.
        [n,sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers/.n] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_7
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_7
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_7), catalog title
% "sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers": recursively summing the squares of the
% first n odd natural numbers and satisfying the exact closed-form contract.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_7: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  lean_nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond(n: nat): bool =
    TRUE

  % This is the source local loop: for positive k it adds (2*k - 1)^2 to the
  % accumulator and recurses at k - 1.
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop(
      k, sum: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      sum
    ELSE
      LET odd: nat = lean_nat_subtract(2 * k, 1)
      IN
        sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop(
          k - 1,
          sum + odd * odd)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE k

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers(n: nat): nat =
    sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_loop(n, 0)

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond(
      n, result: nat): bool =
    LET expected: nat =
      ndiv(
        n * lean_nat_subtract(2 * n, 1) * (2 * n + 1),
        3)
    IN
      lean_nat_subtract(result, expected) = 0
        AND lean_nat_subtract(expected, result) = 0

  sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_precond(n)
        IMPLIES
          sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers_postcond(
            n,
            sumOfSquaresOfFirstNOddNumbers(n))

END verina_basic_7

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70,
   catalog title "LinearSearch3": executable left-to-right search of an
   integer array for the first element satisfying a Boolean predicate under
   an existence precondition, together with its first-occurrence
   postcondition and final correctness proposition. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition LinearSearch3_precond
    (a : list Z) (P : Z -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists i : nat,
    (i < length a)%nat /\
    P (nth i a 0%Z) = true.

Fixpoint LinearSearch3_scan
    (remaining : list Z)
    (P : Z -> bool)
    (n : nat) : nat :=
  match remaining with
  | [] => 0%nat
  | x :: rest =>
      if P x
      then n
      else LinearSearch3_scan rest P (S n)
  end.

Definition LinearSearch3_loop
    (a : list Z)
    (P : Z -> bool)
    (n : nat) : nat :=
  LinearSearch3_scan (skipn n a) P n.

Definition LinearSearch3
    (a : list Z)
    (P : Z -> bool)
    (_h_precond : LinearSearch3_precond a P) : nat :=
  LinearSearch3_loop a P 0%nat.

Definition LinearSearch3_postcond
    (a : list Z)
    (P : Z -> bool)
    (result : nat)
    (_h_precond : LinearSearch3_precond a P) : Prop :=
  (result < length a)%nat /\
  P (nth result a 0%Z) = true /\
  forall k : nat,
    (k < result)%nat ->
    P (nth k a 0%Z) <> true.

Theorem LinearSearch3_spec_satisfied
    (a : list Z)
    (P : Z -> bool)
    (h_precond : LinearSearch3_precond a P) :
  LinearSearch3_postcond
    a P (LinearSearch3 a P h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_70
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_70), catalog title "LinearSearch3": an
  executable left-to-right search of an integer array known to contain an
  element satisfying a Boolean predicate returns the first satisfying index,
  together with the existence precondition, first-occurrence postcondition,
  and final correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_70
  imports Main
begin

definition LinearSearch3_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "LinearSearch3_getBang a i =
    (if i < length a then a ! i else 0)"

definition LinearSearch3_precond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LinearSearch3_precond a P \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>i. i < length a \<and> P (LinearSearch3_getBang a i))"

fun LinearSearch3_scan ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "LinearSearch3_scan [] P n = 0"
| "LinearSearch3_scan (x # xs) P n =
    (if P x
     then n
     else LinearSearch3_scan xs P (Suc n))"

definition LinearSearch3 ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "LinearSearch3 a P = LinearSearch3_scan a P 0"

definition LinearSearch3_postcond ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> (int \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LinearSearch3_postcond a P result \<longleftrightarrow>
    result < length a \<and>
    P (LinearSearch3_getBang a result) \<and>
    (\<forall>k. k < result \<longrightarrow>
      \<not> P (LinearSearch3_getBang a k))"

theorem LinearSearch3_spec_satisfied:
  fixes a :: "int list"
    and P :: "int \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes "LinearSearch3_precond a P"
  shows "LinearSearch3_postcond a P (LinearSearch3 a P)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_70
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_70), catalog title "LinearSearch3": an
  executable left-to-right scan of an integer array known to contain an
  element satisfying an arbitrary Boolean predicate returns the first such
  index, together with its exact precondition and correctness contract. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let LinearSearch3_precond = new_definition
  `LinearSearch3_precond (a:int list) (P:int->bool) <=>
     ?i:num. i < LENGTH a /\ P (EL i a)`;;

let LinearSearch3_loopFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:int list. !P:int->bool. !n:num.
        LinearSearch3_loopFuel 0 a P n = 0) /\
     (!fuel:num. !a:int list. !P:int->bool. !n:num.
        LinearSearch3_loopFuel (SUC fuel) a P n =
        if n < LENGTH a then
          if P (EL n a) then n
          else LinearSearch3_loopFuel fuel a P (n + 1)
        else
          0)`;;

let LinearSearch3_loop = new_definition
  `LinearSearch3_loop
      (a:int list) (P:int->bool) (n:num) =
     LinearSearch3_loopFuel (SUC (LENGTH a - n)) a P n`;;

let LinearSearch3 = new_definition
  `LinearSearch3 (a:int list) (P:int->bool) =
     LinearSearch3_loop a P 0`;;

let LinearSearch3_postcond = new_definition
  `LinearSearch3_postcond
      (a:int list) (P:int->bool) (result:num) <=>
     result < LENGTH a /\
     P (EL result a) /\
     (!k:num. k < result ==> ~(P (EL k a)))`;;

let LinearSearch3_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:int list. !P:int->bool.
     LinearSearch3_precond a P
     ==> LinearSearch3_postcond
           a P (LinearSearch3 a P)`;;

title: verina_basic_70
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70,
;; catalog title "LinearSearch3": under the assumption that an integer array
;; has an element satisfying an arbitrary Boolean predicate, a deterministic
;; left-to-right scan returns the first such index. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Finite Lean Array Int values are represented bijectively by proper ACL2
;; lists whose elements range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-70-int-array-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (integerp (car a))
       (verina-basic-70-int-array-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; DEFSTUB is ACL2's conservative interface for the arbitrary source
;; parameter P : Int -> Bool. Boolean normalization identifies NIL with false
;; and every non-NIL result with true; this ranges over exactly all Boolean
;; predicates on the integers.

(defstub verina-basic-70-p (x) t)

(defun verina-basic-70-p-holds (x)
  (if (verina-basic-70-p x)
      t
    nil))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the in-bounds entry and the inhabited
;; integer default zero outside the array.

(defun verina-basic-70-nth-default-zero (index a)
  (if (and
       (natp index)
       (< index (len a)))
      (nth index a)
    0))

;; This is exactly the source precondition: some natural index within the
;; array has an element for which P is true.

(defun-sk verina-basic-70-linear-search3-precond (a)
  (exists (i)
    (and
     (natp i)
     (< i (len a))
     (verina-basic-70-p-holds
      (verina-basic-70-nth-default-zero i a)))))

;; REMAINING is the suffix beginning at the source loop index INDEX. A true
;; predicate result returns INDEX immediately; otherwise the exact source
;; computation advances one index. Exhausting the array returns zero.

(defun verina-basic-70-linear-search3-loop
    (remaining index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (verina-basic-70-p-holds (car remaining))
          index
        (verina-basic-70-linear-search3-loop
         (cdr remaining)
         (+ index 1)))
    0))

;; The proof-valued precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and
;; is erased. Starting the exact loop at natural index zero reproduces the
;; executable Lean implementation.

(defun verina-basic-70-linear-search3 (a)
  (verina-basic-70-linear-search3-loop a 0))

;; This predicate preserves the source postcondition's universal Nat binder:
;; no index strictly before RESULT has an element for which P is true.

(defun-sk verina-basic-70-no-match-before-p
    (a result)
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp k)
      (< k result))
     (not
      (verina-basic-70-p-holds
       (verina-basic-70-nth-default-zero k a))))))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The proof-valued precondition
;; argument is unused and therefore erased.

(defun verina-basic-70-linear-search3-postcond
    (a result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-70-int-array-p a)
   (natp result)
   (< result (len a))
   (verina-basic-70-p-holds
    (verina-basic-70-nth-default-zero result a))
   (verina-basic-70-no-match-before-p
    a
    result)))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. The DEFSTUB
;; above makes it generic over every Boolean predicate on Int; it quantifies
;; over the complete Array Int domain, assumes exactly the existential source
;; precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-70-linear-search3-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-70-int-array-p a)
      (verina-basic-70-linear-search3-precond a))
     (verina-basic-70-linear-search3-postcond
      a
      (verina-basic-70-linear-search3 a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_70
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70,
-- catalog title "LinearSearch3": a deterministic linear search of an integer
-- array returns the first index satisfying a Boolean predicate under an
-- existence precondition and is connected to its complete correctness
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic70 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data Exists {A : Set} (P : A → Set) : Set where
  witness : (x : A) → P x → Exists P

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

dropArray : {A : Set} → Nat → Array A → Array A
dropArray zero xs = xs
dropArray (suc n) [] = []
dropArray (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = dropArray n xs

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

LinearSearch3-precond : Array Int → (Int → Bool) → Set
LinearSearch3-precond a P =
  Exists
    (λ i →
      (i < arraySize a) ∧
      IsTrue (P (indexDefault zeroInt a i)))

LinearSearch3-loop-from :
  Array Int →
  (Int → Bool) →
  Nat →
  Nat
LinearSearch3-loop-from [] P n = zero
LinearSearch3-loop-from (x ∷ xs) P n =
  if P x
  then n
  else LinearSearch3-loop-from xs P (suc n)

-- Dropping n entries makes structural recursion express exactly the source
-- loop's scan from index n; an exhausted suffix has the source result zero.
LinearSearch3-loop :
  Array Int →
  (Int → Bool) →
  Nat →
  Nat
LinearSearch3-loop a P n =
  LinearSearch3-loop-from (dropArray n a) P n

LinearSearch3 :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (P : Int → Bool) →
  LinearSearch3-precond a P →
  Nat
LinearSearch3 a P h-precond =
  LinearSearch3-loop a P zero

LinearSearch3-postcond :
  (a : Array Int) →
  (P : Int → Bool) →
  (result : Nat) →
  LinearSearch3-precond a P →
  Set
LinearSearch3-postcond a P result h-precond =
  (result < arraySize a) ∧
  IsTrue (P (indexDefault zeroInt a result)) ∧
  ((k : Nat) →
    k < result →
    Not (IsTrue (P (indexDefault zeroInt a k))))

LinearSearch3-spec-satisfied : Set
LinearSearch3-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Array Int) →
  (P : Int → Bool) →
  (h-precond : LinearSearch3-precond a P) →
  LinearSearch3-postcond
    a
    P
    (LinearSearch3 a P h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_70
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70,
  catalog title "LinearSearch3": under the assumption that an integer array
  contains an element satisfying a predicate, the executable left-to-right
  search returns the first satisfying index. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val LinearSearch3_nthD_def = Define `
  (LinearSearch3_nthD
      ([] : int list) (index : num) = (0 : int)) /\
  (LinearSearch3_nthD
      (x::xs) 0 = x) /\
  (LinearSearch3_nthD
      (x::xs) (SUC index) =
     LinearSearch3_nthD xs index)
`;

val LinearSearch3_precond_def = new_definition (
  "LinearSearch3_precond_def",
  ``LinearSearch3_precond
      (a : int list) (P : int -> bool) <=>
      ?i : num.
        i < LENGTH a /\ P (LinearSearch3_nthD a i)``
);

val LinearSearch3_loopFuel_def = Define `
  (LinearSearch3_loopFuel
      0
      (a : int list)
      (P : int -> bool)
      (n : num) =
     0) /\
  (LinearSearch3_loopFuel
      (SUC fuel)
      a
      P
      n =
     if n < LENGTH a then
       if P (LinearSearch3_nthD a n) then
         n
       else
         LinearSearch3_loopFuel fuel a P (n + 1)
     else
       0)
`;

val LinearSearch3_loop_def = new_definition (
  "LinearSearch3_loop_def",
  ``LinearSearch3_loop
      (a : int list) (P : int -> bool) (n : num) =
      LinearSearch3_loopFuel (SUC (LENGTH a - n)) a P n``
);

val LinearSearch3_def = new_definition (
  "LinearSearch3_def",
  ``LinearSearch3 (a : int list) (P : int -> bool) =
      LinearSearch3_loop a P 0``
);

val LinearSearch3_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "LinearSearch3_postcond_def",
  ``LinearSearch3_postcond
      (a : int list) (P : int -> bool) (result : num) <=>
      result < LENGTH a /\
      P (LinearSearch3_nthD a result) /\
      (!k : num.
         k < result ==>
         ~P (LinearSearch3_nthD a k))``
);

val LinearSearch3_spec_satisfied =
  ``!(a : int list) (P : int -> bool).
      LinearSearch3_precond a P ==>
      LinearSearch3_postcond a P (LinearSearch3 a P)``;

title: verina_basic_70
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_70), catalog title LinearSearch3: the exact
  executable left-to-right search of a finite integer array under an arbitrary
  Boolean predicate returns its first satisfying index. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains,
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays, and
  { 0 , 1 } ^m ZZ is the full type of predicates Int -> Bool, with false = 0
  and true = 1. For a word a, # ` a is its natural-number size, a ` i is
  zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ n is the set of natural indices below n.

  VERINAB70GetBang reproduces Lean Array.get! on integer arrays, including
  its inhabited default value zero outside the array. VERINAB70NatSub is
  truncated natural subtraction.

  VERINAB70LoopGraph is the exact deterministic graph of the source local
  recursive loop. Its witness p is the number of consecutive false predicate
  results beginning at the supplied natural index n, bounded by a.size - n.
  If p is smaller than that bound, the predicate is true at n + p and the
  result is n + p. If p equals the bound, the scan is exhausted and the result
  is zero. These are exactly the source true, recursive n + 1, and
  out-of-bounds branches, including starts at or beyond the array size.
  VERINAB70Loop selects the unique graph result.

  VERINAB70Pre is the source precondition that the predicate is true at some
  valid array index. VERINAB70LinearSearch3 is exactly the executable source
  call loop 0. VERINAB70Post states that the result is a valid index where the
  predicate is true and that the predicate is false at every smaller natural
  index. The proof-valued precondition arguments to the implementation and
  postcondition are computationally and propositionally unused beyond the
  explicit precondition antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every
  earlier $a is syntax or a faithful definition required by this rendering,
  and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB70NatSub VERINAB70GetBang
  VERINAB70LoopGraph VERINAB70Loop
  VERINAB70Pre VERINAB70LinearSearch3 VERINAB70Post
$.

verinab70-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB70NatSub A B ) $.
verinab70-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB70GetBang A B ) $.
verinab70-loop-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB70LoopGraph A B C D ) $.
verinab70-loop-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB70Loop A B C ) $.
verinab70-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB70Pre A B ) $.
verinab70-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB70LinearSearch3 A B ) $.
verinab70-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB70Post A B C ) $.

verinab70-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB70NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab70-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB70GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d j p A B C D $.

  verinab70-loop-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB70LoopGraph A B C D
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          A e. Word ZZ
          /\
          B e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m ZZ )
        )
        /\
        C e. NN0
      )
      /\
      D e. NN0
    )
    /\
    E. p e. NN0
      (
        p <_ (
          VERINAB70NatSub
            ( # ` A )
            C
        )
        /\
        (
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ p )
            (
              B
              `
              (
                VERINAB70GetBang
                  A
                  ( C + j )
              )
            ) = 0
          /\
          (
            (
              p < (
                VERINAB70NatSub
                  ( # ` A )
                  C
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  B
                  `
                  (
                    VERINAB70GetBang
                      A
                      ( C + p )
                  )
                ) = 1
                /\
                D = ( C + p )
              )
            )
            \/
            (
              p = (
                VERINAB70NatSub
                  ( # ` A )
                  C
              )
              /\
              D = 0
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C $.

  verinab70-loop-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB70Loop A B C
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. NN0
      ( VERINAB70LoopGraph A B C y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab70-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB70Pre A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ZZ
      /\
      B e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m ZZ )
    )
    /\
    E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      (
        B
        `
        ( VERINAB70GetBang A i )
      ) = 1
  ) $.
$}

verinab70-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB70LinearSearch3 A B
) = (
  VERINAB70Loop A B 0
) $.

${
  $d k A B C $.

  verinab70-postcondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB70Post A B C
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        A e. Word ZZ
        /\
        B e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m ZZ )
      )
      /\
      C e. NN0
    )
    /\
    (
      C < ( # ` A )
      /\
      (
        (
          B
          `
          ( VERINAB70GetBang A C )
        ) = 1
        /\
        A. k e. NN0
          (
            k < C
            ->
            (
              B
              `
              ( VERINAB70GetBang A k )
            ) = 0
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

verina-basic-70-linear-search3 $a |- A. a e. Word ZZ
  A. p e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m ZZ )
    (
      ( VERINAB70Pre a p )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB70Post
          a
          p
          ( VERINAB70LinearSearch3 a p )
      )
    )
$.

:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_70), catalog title "LinearSearch3": the
:: predicate-witness precondition, exact zero-based recursive linear-search
:: implementation with zero fallback, first-satisfying-index postcondition,

environ

    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex linearSearch3Precond being
       Function of [:INT*,Funcs(INT,BOOLEAN):],BOOLEAN,
     linearSearch3Loop being
       Function of [:INT*,Funcs(INT,BOOLEAN),NAT:],NAT,
     linearSearch3Program being
       Function of [:INT*,Funcs(INT,BOOLEAN):],NAT,
     linearSearch3Postcond being
       Function of [:INT*,Funcs(INT,BOOLEAN),NAT:],BOOLEAN st
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         P being Function of INT,BOOLEAN holds
      (linearSearch3Precond/.[a,P] = TRUE iff
        ex i being Nat st
          i < len a & P/.(a/.(i + 1)) = TRUE) &
      (linearSearch3Precond/.[a,P] = FALSE iff
        not ex i being Nat st
          i < len a & P/.(a/.(i + 1)) = TRUE)) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         P being Function of INT,BOOLEAN,
         n being Nat holds
      ((n < len a &
          P/.(a/.(n + 1)) = TRUE &
          linearSearch3Loop/.[a,P,n] = n) or
       (n < len a &
          P/.(a/.(n + 1)) = FALSE &
          linearSearch3Loop/.[a,P,n] =
            linearSearch3Loop/.[a,P,n + 1]) or
       (len a <= n &
          linearSearch3Loop/.[a,P,n] = 0))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         P being Function of INT,BOOLEAN holds
      linearSearch3Program/.[a,P] =
        linearSearch3Loop/.[a,P,0]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         P being Function of INT,BOOLEAN,
         result being Nat holds
      (linearSearch3Postcond/.[a,P,result] = TRUE iff
        result < len a &
        P/.(a/.(result + 1)) = TRUE &
        (for k being Nat st k < result holds
          P/.(a/.(k + 1)) = FALSE)) &
      (linearSearch3Postcond/.[a,P,result] = FALSE iff
        not
          (result < len a &
           P/.(a/.(result + 1)) = TRUE &
           (for k being Nat st k < result holds
             P/.(a/.(k + 1)) = FALSE)))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT,
         P being Function of INT,BOOLEAN st
      linearSearch3Precond/.[a,P] = TRUE
    holds
      linearSearch3Postcond/.
        [a,P,linearSearch3Program/.[a,P]] = TRUE)

end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_70
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_70
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_70), catalog title "LinearSearch3": assuming an
% arbitrary Boolean predicate holds somewhere in a finite integer array, the
% exact recursive left-to-right search returns its first satisfying index.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_70: THEORY
BEGIN

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean natural-number subtraction is truncated at zero.
  nat_subtract(first, second: nat): nat =
    IF first >= second THEN first - second ELSE 0 ENDIF

  LinearSearch3_precond(
      a: list[int],
      P: [int -> bool]): bool =
    EXISTS (i: nat):
      i < int_list_length(a)
        AND P(int_list_get_bang(i, a))

  LinearSearch3_loop_steps(
      a: list[int],
      P: [int -> bool],
      n, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF n < int_list_length(a) THEN
      IF P(int_list_get_bang(n, a)) THEN
        n
      ELSE
        LinearSearch3_loop_steps(
          a,
          P,
          n + 1,
          fuel - 1)
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  % The distance to the array boundary plus one covers every source recursive
  % call and its final bounds check, so the fuel-zero fallback is unreachable.
  LinearSearch3_loop(
      a: list[int],
      P: [int -> bool],
      n: nat): nat =
    LinearSearch3_loop_steps(
      a,
      P,
      n,
      nat_subtract(int_list_length(a), n) + 1)

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  LinearSearch3(
      a: list[int],
      P: [int -> bool]): nat =
    LinearSearch3_loop(a, P, 0)

  % The source proof argument to the postcondition is logically irrelevant.
  LinearSearch3_postcond(
      a: list[int],
      P: [int -> bool],
      result: nat): bool =
    result < int_list_length(a)
      AND P(int_list_get_bang(result, a))
      AND
        (FORALL (k: nat):
          k < result
            IMPLIES NOT P(int_list_get_bang(k, a)))

  LinearSearch3_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[int]), (P: [int -> bool]):
      LinearSearch3_precond(a, P)
        IMPLIES
          LinearSearch3_postcond(
            a,
            P,
            LinearSearch3(a, P))

END verina_basic_70

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71,
   catalog title "LongestCommonPrefix": executable computation of the longest
   common prefix of two arbitrary Unicode-character lists, together with its
   prefix, maximality, and final correctness contract. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List NArith Strings.Ascii.

Import ListNotations.

Definition unicode_scalar (code : N) : Prop :=
  (code < 55296)%N \/
  ((57343 < code)%N /\ (code < 1114112)%N).

Inductive lean_char : Type :=
| LeanAscii : ascii -> lean_char
| LeanNonAscii :
    forall code : N,
      (256 <= code)%N ->
      unicode_scalar code ->
      lean_char.

Definition lean_char_scalar_value (c : lean_char) : N :=
  match c with
  | LeanAscii a => N.of_nat (Ascii.nat_of_ascii a)
  | LeanNonAscii code _ _ => code
  end.

Definition lean_char_eqb (x y : lean_char) : bool :=
  N.eqb (lean_char_scalar_value x) (lean_char_scalar_value y).

Definition lean_char_list_scalar_values
    (chars : list lean_char) : list N :=
  map lean_char_scalar_value chars.

Definition lean_char_option_scalar_value
    (char : option lean_char) : option N :=
  match char with
  | Some c => Some (lean_char_scalar_value c)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition LongestCommonPrefix_precond
    (_str1 _str2 : list lean_char) : Prop :=
  True.

Fixpoint LongestCommonPrefix_aux
    (fuel : nat)
    (str1 str2 : list lean_char)
    (minLength idx : nat)
    (acc : list lean_char) : list lean_char :=
  match fuel with
  | O => acc
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb idx minLength
      then
        match nth_error str1 idx, nth_error str2 idx with
        | Some c1, Some c2 =>
            if lean_char_eqb c1 c2
            then
              LongestCommonPrefix_aux
                fuel' str1 str2 minLength (S idx) (acc ++ [c1])
            else acc
        | _, _ => acc
        end
      else acc
  end.

Definition LongestCommonPrefix
    (str1 str2 : list lean_char)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2) :
    list lean_char :=
  let minLength := Nat.min (length str1) (length str2) in
  LongestCommonPrefix_aux minLength str1 str2 minLength O [].

Definition LongestCommonPrefix_postcond
    (str1 str2 result : list lean_char)
    (_h_precond : LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2) : Prop :=
  (length result <= length str1)%nat /\
  lean_char_list_scalar_values result =
    lean_char_list_scalar_values (firstn (length result) str1) /\
  (length result <= length str2)%nat /\
  lean_char_list_scalar_values result =
    lean_char_list_scalar_values (firstn (length result) str2) /\
  (length result = length str1 \/
   length result = length str2 \/
   lean_char_option_scalar_value
       (nth_error str1 (length result)) <>
     lean_char_option_scalar_value
       (nth_error str2 (length result))).

Theorem LongestCommonPrefix_spec_satisfied
    (str1 str2 : list lean_char)
    (h_precond : LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2) :
  LongestCommonPrefix_postcond
    str1 str2
    (LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2 h_precond)
    h_precond.
Admitted.

title: verina_basic_71
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_71), catalog title
  "LongestCommonPrefix": an executable Unicode-scalar list program computes
  the longest shared initial segment of two character lists, together with
  its unconditional precondition, maximal-prefix postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_71
  imports Main
begin

datatype lean_trit = Trit0 | Trit1 | Trit2

datatype lean_bits3 = LeanBits3 bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits4 = LeanBits4 bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_bits5 = LeanBits5 bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_byte = LeanByte bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

datatype lean_char =
    BMP_Low lean_trit lean_trit lean_trit lean_bits3 lean_byte
  | BMP_High lean_bits5 lean_byte
  | Supplementary lean_bits4 lean_byte lean_byte

type_synonym lean_string = "lean_char list"

definition lean_bit_value :: "bool \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bit_value b = (if b then 1 else 0)"

fun lean_trit_value :: "lean_trit \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_trit_value Trit0 = 0"
| "lean_trit_value Trit1 = 1"
| "lean_trit_value Trit2 = 2"

fun lean_bits3_value :: "lean_bits3 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits3_value (LeanBits3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (lean_bit_value b2 * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits4_value :: "lean_bits4 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits4_value (LeanBits4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    ((lean_bit_value b3 * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_bits5_value :: "lean_bits5 \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_bits5_value (LeanBits5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((lean_bit_value b4 * 2 + lean_bit_value b3) * 2 +
       lean_bit_value b2) * 2 + lean_bit_value b1) * 2 +
    lean_bit_value b0"

fun lean_byte_value :: "lean_byte \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_byte_value (LeanByte b7 b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0) =
    (((((((lean_bit_value b7 * 2 + lean_bit_value b6) * 2 +
          lean_bit_value b5) * 2 + lean_bit_value b4) * 2 +
        lean_bit_value b3) * 2 + lean_bit_value b2) * 2 +
      lean_bit_value b1) * 2 + lean_bit_value b0)"

fun lean_char_to_nat :: "lean_char \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_Low t2 t1 t0 bits byte) =
    ((((lean_trit_value t2 * 3 + lean_trit_value t1) * 3 +
        lean_trit_value t0) * 8 + lean_bits3_value bits) * 256 +
      lean_byte_value byte)"
| "lean_char_to_nat (BMP_High bits byte) =
    57344 + lean_bits5_value bits * 256 + lean_byte_value byte"
| "lean_char_to_nat (Supplementary bits high low) =
    65536 + lean_bits4_value bits * 65536 +
    lean_byte_value high * 256 + lean_byte_value low"

definition LongestCommonPrefix_precond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2 \<longleftrightarrow> True"

fun lean_list_get ::
    "'a list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option" where
  "lean_list_get [] n = None"
| "lean_list_get (x # xs) 0 = Some x"
| "lean_list_get (x # xs) (Suc n) = lean_list_get xs n"

fun LongestCommonPrefix_aux ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "LongestCommonPrefix_aux 0 str1 str2 idx acc = acc"
| "LongestCommonPrefix_aux (Suc fuel) str1 str2 idx acc =
    (case lean_list_get str1 idx of
       None \<Rightarrow> acc
     | Some c1 \<Rightarrow>
         (case lean_list_get str2 idx of
            None \<Rightarrow> acc
          | Some c2 \<Rightarrow>
              (if c1 \<noteq> c2
               then acc
               else LongestCommonPrefix_aux
                 fuel str1 str2 (Suc idx) (acc @ [c1]))))"

definition LongestCommonPrefix ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string" where
  "LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2 =
    LongestCommonPrefix_aux
      (min (length str1) (length str2)) str1 str2 0 []"

definition LongestCommonPrefix_postcond ::
    "lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> lean_string \<Rightarrow> bool"
    where
  "LongestCommonPrefix_postcond str1 str2 result \<longleftrightarrow>
    length result \<le> length str1 \<and>
    result = take (length result) str1 \<and>
    length result \<le> length str2 \<and>
    result = take (length result) str2 \<and>
    (length result = length str1 \<or>
     length result = length str2 \<or>
     lean_list_get str1 (length result) \<noteq>
       lean_list_get str2 (length result))"

theorem LongestCommonPrefix_spec_satisfied:
  fixes str1 str2 :: lean_string
  assumes "LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2"
  shows
    "LongestCommonPrefix_postcond
      str1 str2 (LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_71
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_71), catalog title
  "LongestCommonPrefix": an executable indexed scan returns the longest
  common prefix of two Unicode character lists, together with its total
  precondition and exact prefix-maximality correctness contract. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let LongestCommonPrefix_validChar = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_validChar (c:num) <=>
     c < 55296 \/ (57343 < c /\ c < 1114112)`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_string = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_string (s:num list) <=>
     ALL LongestCommonPrefix_validChar s`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_precond = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_precond
      (str1:num list) (str2:num list) <=> T`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_minLength = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_minLength
      (str1:num list) (str2:num list) =
     MIN (LENGTH str1) (LENGTH str2)`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_getOption = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_getOption
      (s:num list) (idx:num) =
     if idx < LENGTH s then SOME (EL idx s)
     else (NONE:num option)`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_optionValue =
  new_recursive_definition option_RECURSION
    `(LongestCommonPrefix_optionValue
        (NONE:num option) = 0) /\
     (!c:num.
        LongestCommonPrefix_optionValue (SOME c) = c)`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!str1:num list. !str2:num list. !idx:num. !acc:num list.
        LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
          0 str1 str2 idx acc = acc) /\
     (!fuel:num. !str1:num list. !str2:num list.
      !idx:num. !acc:num list.
        LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
          (SUC fuel) str1 str2 idx acc =
        let minLength =
          LongestCommonPrefix_minLength str1 str2 in
        if idx < minLength then
          let c1Option =
            LongestCommonPrefix_getOption str1 idx in
          let c2Option =
            LongestCommonPrefix_getOption str2 idx in
          if c1Option = NONE \/ c2Option = NONE then
            acc
          else
            let c1 =
              LongestCommonPrefix_optionValue c1Option in
            let c2 =
              LongestCommonPrefix_optionValue c2Option in
            if ~(c1 = c2) then
              acc
            else
              LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
                fuel str1 str2 (idx + 1)
                (APPEND acc (CONS c1 []))
        else
          acc)`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_aux = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_aux
      (str1:num list) (str2:num list)
      (idx:num) (acc:num list) =
     LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
       (SUC
         (LongestCommonPrefix_minLength str1 str2 - idx))
       str1 str2 idx acc`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix
      (str1:num list) (str2:num list) =
     LongestCommonPrefix_aux str1 str2 0 []`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_take =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!s:num list.
        LongestCommonPrefix_take 0 s = []) /\
     (!n:num. !s:num list.
        LongestCommonPrefix_take (SUC n) s =
        if s = [] then
          []
        else
          CONS (HD s)
            (LongestCommonPrefix_take n (TL s)))`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_postcond = new_definition
  `LongestCommonPrefix_postcond
      (str1:num list) (str2:num list)
      (result:num list) <=>
     LENGTH result <= LENGTH str1 /\
     result =
       LongestCommonPrefix_take (LENGTH result) str1 /\
     LENGTH result <= LENGTH str2 /\
     result =
       LongestCommonPrefix_take (LENGTH result) str2 /\
     (LENGTH result = LENGTH str1 \/
      LENGTH result = LENGTH str2 \/
      ~(LongestCommonPrefix_getOption
          str1 (LENGTH result) =
        LongestCommonPrefix_getOption
          str2 (LENGTH result)))`;;

let LongestCommonPrefix_spec_satisfied =
  `!str1:num list. !str2:num list.
     LongestCommonPrefix_string str1
     ==> LongestCommonPrefix_string str2
     ==> LongestCommonPrefix_precond str1 str2
     ==> LongestCommonPrefix_postcond
           str1 str2
           (LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2)`;;

title: verina_basic_71
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71,
;; catalog title "LongestCommonPrefix": a deterministic Unicode-character-list
;; program computes the longest prefix shared by two input lists and satisfies
;; the complete maximal-common-prefix contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Lean List Char is represented bijectively by a proper ACL2 list of
;; Unicode scalar values, preserving the complete Lean Char domain.

(defun verina-basic-71-unicode-scalar-p (c)
  (and
   (natp c)
   (or
    (< c 55296)
    (and
     (< 57343 c)
     (< c 1114112)))))

(defun verina-basic-71-char-list-p (characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count characters)))
  (if (consp characters)
      (and
       (verina-basic-71-unicode-scalar-p
        (car characters))
       (verina-basic-71-char-list-p
        (cdr characters)))
    (equal characters nil)))

;; The source precondition is True. The two List Char binder domains remain
;; explicit in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-precond
    (str1 str2)
  (declare (ignore str1 str2))
  t)

;; This is Nat.min on the natural list lengths used by the implementation.

(defun verina-basic-71-nat-min (left right)
  (if (<= left right)
      left
    right))

;; Option Char is represented by :none or the tagged pair (:some . code).
;; This is exactly List.get? at a natural index.

(defun verina-basic-71-nth-option (index characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      :none
    (if (consp characters)
        (if (zp index)
            (cons :some (car characters))
          (verina-basic-71-nth-option
           (- index 1)
           (cdr characters)))
      :none)))

;; This is the source local AUX recursion. MIN-LENGTH is the closed-over
;; Nat.min of the input lengths. At each natural IDX below that bound, the
;; optional entries are compared; a mismatch returns ACC, while a match
;; appends the character and advances the index.

(defun verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-aux
    (idx acc min-length str1 str2)
  (declare
   (xargs :measure
          (nfix (- min-length idx))))
  (if (and
       (natp idx)
       (natp min-length)
       (< idx min-length))
      (let ((left
             (verina-basic-71-nth-option idx str1))
            (right
             (verina-basic-71-nth-option idx str2)))
        (if (and
             (consp left)
             (equal (car left) :some)
             (consp right)
             (equal (car right) :some))
            (let ((c1 (cdr left))
                  (c2 (cdr right)))
              (if (not (equal c1 c2))
                  acc
                (verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-aux
                 (+ idx 1)
                 (append acc (list c1))
                 min-length
                 str1
                 str2)))
          acc))
    acc))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. The exact source call starts AUX at index zero with an empty
;; accumulator and the minimum input length.

(defun verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix
    (str1 str2)
  (let ((min-length
         (verina-basic-71-nat-min
          (len str1)
          (len str2))))
    (verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-aux
     0
     nil
     min-length
     str1
     str2)))

;; Exact recursive encoding of List.take on natural lengths.

(defun verina-basic-71-take (n characters)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or
       (not (natp n))
       (zp n)
       (not (consp characters)))
      nil
    (cons
     (car characters)
     (verina-basic-71-take
      (- n 1)
      (cdr characters)))))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The tagged optional accesses
;; preserve the final disjunction: the result reaches an input's length, or
;; the next optional characters differ.

(defun verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-postcond
    (str1 str2 result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-71-char-list-p str1)
   (verina-basic-71-char-list-p str2)
   (verina-basic-71-char-list-p result)
   (<= (len result) (len str1))
   (equal
    result
    (verina-basic-71-take
     (len result)
     str1))
   (<= (len result) (len str2))
   (equal
    result
    (verina-basic-71-take
     (len result)
     str2))
   (or
    (equal (len result) (len str1))
    (equal (len result) (len str2))
    (not
     (equal
      (verina-basic-71-nth-option
       (len result)
       str1)
      (verina-basic-71-nth-option
       (len result)
       str2))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every pair of finite Lean character lists, assumes exactly the source
;; True precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact
;; executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (str1 str2)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-71-char-list-p str1)
      (verina-basic-71-char-list-p str2)
      (verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-precond
       str1
       str2))
     (verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix-postcond
      str1
      str2
      (verina-basic-71-longest-common-prefix
       str1
       str2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_71
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71,
-- catalog title "LongestCommonPrefix": a deterministic indexed recursion
-- computes the longest common prefix of two character lists and is connected
-- to its complete prefix-and-maximality correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic71 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Char using (Char; primCharEquality)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Empty

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natMin : Nat → Nat → Nat
natMin zero n = zero
natMin (suc m) zero = zero
natMin (suc m) (suc n) = suc (natMin m n)

listLength : {A : Set} → List A → Nat
listLength [] = zero
listLength (_ ∷ xs) = suc (listLength xs)

appendList : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
appendList [] ys = ys
appendList (x ∷ xs) ys = x ∷ appendList xs ys

takeList : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → List A
takeList zero xs = []
takeList (suc n) [] = []
takeList (suc n) (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ takeList n xs

listIndex : {A : Set} → Nat → List A → Maybe A
listIndex zero [] = nothing
listIndex zero (x ∷ xs) = just x
listIndex (suc n) [] = nothing
listIndex (suc n) (_ ∷ xs) = listIndex n xs

LongestCommonPrefix-precond : List Char → List Char → Set
LongestCommonPrefix-precond str1 str2 = Top

LongestCommonPrefix-aux :
  Nat →
  List Char →
  List Char →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Char →
  List Char
LongestCommonPrefix-aux zero str1 str2 minLength idx acc = acc
LongestCommonPrefix-aux
  (suc fuel) str1 str2 minLength idx acc
  with natLess idx minLength
... | false = acc
... | true with listIndex idx str1 | listIndex idx str2
...   | just c1 | just c2 =
  if primCharEquality c1 c2
  then
    LongestCommonPrefix-aux
      fuel
      str1
      str2
      minLength
      (suc idx)
      (appendList acc (c1 ∷ []))
  else acc
...   | _ | _ = acc

LongestCommonPrefix :
  (str1 : List Char) →
  (str2 : List Char) →
  LongestCommonPrefix-precond str1 str2 →
  List Char
LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2 h-precond =
  let minLength = natMin (listLength str1) (listLength str2)
  in
    LongestCommonPrefix-aux
      minLength
      str1
      str2
      minLength
      zero
      []

LongestCommonPrefix-postcond :
  (str1 : List Char) →
  (str2 : List Char) →
  (result : List Char) →
  LongestCommonPrefix-precond str1 str2 →
  Set
LongestCommonPrefix-postcond str1 str2 result h-precond =
  (listLength result ≤ listLength str1) ∧
  (result ≡ takeList (listLength result) str1) ∧
  (listLength result ≤ listLength str2) ∧
  (result ≡ takeList (listLength result) str2) ∧
  ((listLength result ≡ listLength str1) ∨
   (listLength result ≡ listLength str2) ∨
   Not
     (listIndex (listLength result) str1 ≡
      listIndex (listLength result) str2))

LongestCommonPrefix-spec-satisfied : Set
LongestCommonPrefix-spec-satisfied =
  (str1 : List Char) →
  (str2 : List Char) →
  (h-precond : LongestCommonPrefix-precond str1 str2) →
  LongestCommonPrefix-postcond
    str1
    str2
    (LongestCommonPrefix str1 str2 h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_71
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_71,
  catalog title "LongestCommonPrefix": the executable Unicode-character-list
  program scans two inputs from the left and returns their longest common
  prefix under its complete maximal-prefix contract. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory optionTheory;

val LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeScalar_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeScalar_def",
  ``LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeScalar (c : num) <=>
      c < 1114112 /\ ~(55296 <= c /\ c <= 57343)``
);

val LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeString_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeString_def",
  ``LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeString (s : num list) <=>
      EVERY LongestCommonPrefix_isUnicodeScalar s``
);

val LongestCommonPrefix_precond_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonPrefix_precond_def",
  ``LongestCommonPrefix_precond
      (str1 : num list) (str2 : num list) <=>
      T``
);

val LongestCommonPrefix_minLength_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonPrefix_minLength_def",
  ``LongestCommonPrefix_minLength
      (str1 : num list) (str2 : num list) =
      if LENGTH str1 <= LENGTH str2 then
        LENGTH str1
      else
        LENGTH str2``
);

val LongestCommonPrefix_getOpt_def = new_definition (
  "LongestCommonPrefix_getOpt_def",
  ``LongestCommonPrefix_getOpt
      (xs : num list) (idx : num) =
      if idx < LENGTH xs then
        SOME (EL idx xs)
      else
        NONE``
);

val LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel_def = Define `
  (LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
      0
      (str1 : num list)
      (str2 : num list)
      (minLength : num)
      (idx : num)
      (acc : num list) =
     acc) /\
  (LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
      (SUC fuel)
      str1
      str2
      minLength
      idx
      acc =
     if idx < minLength then
       case LongestCommonPrefix_getOpt str1 idx of
         NONE => acc
       | SOME c1 =>
           (case LongestCommonPrefix_getOpt str2 idx of
              NONE => acc
            | SOME c2 =>
                if c1 <> c2 then
                  acc
                else
                  LongestCommonPrefix_auxFuel
                    fuel
                    str1
                    str2
                    minLength
                    (idx + 1)
                    (acc ++ [c1]))
     else
       acc)
`;

val LongestCommonPrefix_aux_def = new_definition (

      (str1 : num list)
