content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90,
   catalog title "SlopeSearch": executable fuel-bounded slope search for an
   integer in a nonempty rectangular matrix sorted by rows and columns,
   together with its precondition, found-or-absent postcondition, and final
   correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Module VerinaBasic90.

Definition get2d
    (a : list (list Z))
    (i j : Z) : Z :=
  nth (Z.to_nat j)
    (nth (Z.to_nat i) a [])
    0.

Fixpoint SlopeSearch_pairwise
    {A : Type}
    (relation : A -> A -> Prop)
    (xs : list A) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | [] => True
  | x :: rest =>
      Forall (relation x) rest /\
      SlopeSearch_pairwise relation rest
  end.

Definition SlopeSearch_precond
    (a : list (list Z))
    (_key : Z) : Prop :=
  (0 < length a)%nat /\
  (0 < length (nth 0 a []))%nat /\
  SlopeSearch_pairwise
    (fun row1 row2 => length row1 = length row2)
    a /\
  Forall (SlopeSearch_pairwise Z.le) a /\
  forall i : nat,
    (i < length (nth 0 a []))%nat ->
    SlopeSearch_pairwise
      Z.le
      (map (fun row => nth i row 0) a).

Fixpoint SlopeSearch_aux
    (a : list (list Z))
    (key : Z)
    (rows : nat)
    (m n : Z)
    (fuel : nat) : Z * Z :=
  match fuel with
  | O => (-1, -1)
  | S fuel' =>
      if orb
          (Z.geb m (Z.of_nat rows))
          (Z.ltb n 0)
      then (-1, -1)
      else if Z.eqb (get2d a m n) key
      then (m, n)
      else if Z.ltb (get2d a m n) key
      then SlopeSearch_aux a key rows (m + 1) n fuel'
      else SlopeSearch_aux a key rows m (n - 1) fuel'
  end.

Definition SlopeSearch
    (a : list (list Z))
    (key : Z)
    (_h_precond : SlopeSearch_precond a key) : Z * Z :=
  let rows := length a in
  let cols :=
    if Nat.ltb 0 rows
    then length (nth 0 a [])
    else 0%nat in
  SlopeSearch_aux
    a key rows 0
    (Z.of_nat (cols - 1))
    (rows + cols).

Definition SlopeSearch_postcond
    (a : list (list Z))
    (key : Z)
    (result : Z * Z)
    (_h_precond : SlopeSearch_precond a key) : Prop :=
  let '(m, n) := result in
  (m >= 0 /\
   m < Z.of_nat (length a) /\
   n >= 0 /\
   n < Z.of_nat (length (nth 0 a [])) /\
   get2d a m n = key) \/
  (m = -1 /\
   n = -1 /\
   Forall
     (fun row => Forall (fun element => element <> key) row)
     a).

Theorem SlopeSearch_spec_satisfied
    (a : list (list Z))
    (key : Z)
    (h_precond : SlopeSearch_precond a key) :
  SlopeSearch_postcond
    a key (SlopeSearch a key h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

End VerinaBasic90.

title: verina_basic_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_90), catalog title "SlopeSearch": an
  executable fuel-bounded slope search scans a nonempty rectangular integer
  matrix sorted by rows and columns for a key, returning its indices or
  (-1, -1), together with its precondition, postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_90
  imports Main
begin

definition SlopeSearch_row_getBang ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list" where
  "SlopeSearch_row_getBang a i =
    (if i < length a then a ! i else [])"

definition SlopeSearch_int_getBang ::
    "int list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "SlopeSearch_int_getBang xs i =
    (if i < length xs then xs ! i else 0)"

definition get2d ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "get2d a i j =
    SlopeSearch_int_getBang
      (SlopeSearch_row_getBang a (nat i))
      (nat j)"

fun SlopeSearch_pairwise ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "SlopeSearch_pairwise relation [] = True"
| "SlopeSearch_pairwise relation (x # xs) =
    (list_all (relation x) xs \<and>
     SlopeSearch_pairwise relation xs)"

definition SlopeSearch_precond ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "SlopeSearch_precond a key \<longleftrightarrow>
    length a > 0 \<and>
    length (SlopeSearch_row_getBang a 0) > 0 \<and>
    SlopeSearch_pairwise
      (\<lambda>x y. length x = length y)
      a \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>x. SlopeSearch_pairwise (\<lambda>u v. u \<le> v) x)
      a \<and>
    list_all
      (\<lambda>i.
        SlopeSearch_pairwise
          (\<lambda>u v. u \<le> v)
          (map (\<lambda>x. SlopeSearch_int_getBang x i) a))
      [0..<length (SlopeSearch_row_getBang a 0)]"

fun SlopeSearch_aux ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int \<times> int" where
  "SlopeSearch_aux a key rows m n 0 = (-1, -1)"
| "SlopeSearch_aux a key rows m n (Suc fuel) =
    (if m \<ge> int rows \<or> n < 0 then
       (-1, -1)
     else if get2d a m n = key then
       (m, n)
     else if get2d a m n < key then
       SlopeSearch_aux a key rows (m + 1) n fuel
     else
       SlopeSearch_aux a key rows m (n - 1) fuel)"

definition SlopeSearch ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<times> int" where
  "SlopeSearch a key =
    (let rows = length a;
         cols =
           (if rows > 0
            then length (SlopeSearch_row_getBang a 0)
            else 0)
     in SlopeSearch_aux
          a key rows 0 (int (cols - 1)) (rows + cols))"

definition SlopeSearch_postcond ::
    "int list list \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int \<times> int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "SlopeSearch_postcond a key result \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let m = fst result;
         n = snd result
     in
       (m \<ge> 0 \<and>
        m < int (length a) \<and>
        n \<ge> 0 \<and>
        n < int (length (SlopeSearch_row_getBang a 0)) \<and>
        get2d a m n = key) \<or>
       (m = -1 \<and>
        n = -1 \<and>
        list_all (\<lambda>x. list_all (\<lambda>e. e \<noteq> key) x) a))"

theorem SlopeSearch_spec_satisfied:
  fixes a :: "int list list" and key :: int
  assumes "SlopeSearch_precond a key"
  shows "SlopeSearch_postcond a key (SlopeSearch a key)"
  sorry

end

title: verina_basic_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90
  (verina__hol-light__verina_basic_90), catalog title "SlopeSearch": an
  executable fuel-bounded slope search in a nonempty rectangular integer
  matrix sorted by rows and columns returns a matching position or (-1,-1),
  together with its exact precondition and postcondition. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let SlopeSearch_intToNat = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_intToNat (z:int) =
     if z < (&0:int) then 0 else num_of_int z`;;

let SlopeSearch_getDefault = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_getDefault (xs:int list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH xs then EL i xs else (&0:int)`;;

let SlopeSearch_getRowDefault = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_getRowDefault (a:(int list) list) (i:num) =
     if i < LENGTH a then EL i a else ([]:int list)`;;

let SlopeSearch_get2d = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_get2d
      (a:(int list) list) (i:int) (j:int) =
     SlopeSearch_getDefault
       (SlopeSearch_getRowDefault a (SlopeSearch_intToNat i))
       (SlopeSearch_intToNat j)`;;

let SlopeSearch_precond = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_precond (a:(int list) list) (key:int) <=>
     0 < LENGTH a /\
     0 < LENGTH (SlopeSearch_getRowDefault a 0) /\
     PAIRWISE
       (\x y:int list. LENGTH x = LENGTH y)
       a /\
     ALL
       (\row:int list.
          PAIRWISE (\x y:int. x <= y) row)
       a /\
     (!j:num.
        j < LENGTH (SlopeSearch_getRowDefault a 0)
        ==> PAIRWISE
              (\x y:int. x <= y)
              (MAP
                (\row:int list. SlopeSearch_getDefault row j)
                a))`;;

let SlopeSearch_aux =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
    `(!a:(int list) list. !key:int. !rows:num. !m:int. !n:int.
        SlopeSearch_aux 0 a key rows m n =
        ((-- &1:int),(-- &1:int))) /\
     (!fuel:num. !a:(int list) list. !key:int. !rows:num.
      !m:int. !n:int.
        SlopeSearch_aux (SUC fuel) a key rows m n =
        if m >= (&rows:int) \/ n < (&0:int) then
          ((-- &1:int),(-- &1:int))
        else if SlopeSearch_get2d a m n = key then
          (m,n)
        else if SlopeSearch_get2d a m n < key then
          SlopeSearch_aux
            fuel a key rows (m + (&1:int)) n
        else
          SlopeSearch_aux
            fuel a key rows m (n - (&1:int)))`;;

let SlopeSearch = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch (a:(int list) list) (key:int) =
     let rows = LENGTH a in
     let cols =
       if rows > 0 then
         LENGTH (SlopeSearch_getRowDefault a 0)
       else
         0 in
     SlopeSearch_aux
       (rows + cols) a key rows
       (&0:int) (&(cols - 1):int)`;;

let SlopeSearch_postcond = new_definition
  `SlopeSearch_postcond
      (a:(int list) list) (key:int) (result:int#int) <=>
     let m = FST result in
     let n = SND result in
     ((&0:int) <= m /\
      m < (&(LENGTH a):int) /\
      (&0:int) <= n /\
      n <
        (&(LENGTH (SlopeSearch_getRowDefault a 0)):int) /\
      SlopeSearch_get2d a m n = key) \/
     (m = (-- &1:int) /\
      n = (-- &1:int) /\
      ALL
        (\row:int list.
           ALL (\e:int. ~(e = key)) row)
        a)`;;

let SlopeSearch_spec_satisfied =
  `!a:(int list) list. !key:int.
     SlopeSearch_precond a key
     ==> SlopeSearch_postcond
           a key (SlopeSearch a key)`;;

title: verina_basic_90
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90,
;; catalog title "SlopeSearch": a deterministic top-right search of a
;; nonempty rectangular integer matrix sorted by rows and columns returns a
;; matching position or (-1, -1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A finite Lean Array (Array Int) is represented bijectively by a proper
;; ACL2 list of proper integer lists.

(defun verina-basic-90-int-array-p (row)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count row)))
  (if (consp row)
      (and
       (integerp (car row))
       (verina-basic-90-int-array-p (cdr row)))
    (equal row nil)))

(defun verina-basic-90-int-matrix-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-90-int-array-p (car a))
       (verina-basic-90-int-matrix-p (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; These predicates are exactly List.Pairwise equality on row sizes: each
;; head row has the same length as every later row, recursively.

(defun verina-basic-90-head-length-equals-all-p
    (row-length remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (equal row-length (len (car remaining)))
       (verina-basic-90-head-length-equals-all-p
        row-length
        (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-90-pairwise-equal-row-lengths-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-90-head-length-equals-all-p
        (len (car a))
        (cdr a))
       (verina-basic-90-pairwise-equal-row-lengths-p
        (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; These predicates are exactly List.Pairwise (fun x y => x <= y): each head
;; is at most every later integer, recursively for every suffix.

(defun verina-basic-90-head-at-most-all-p
    (head remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (<= head (car remaining))
       (verina-basic-90-head-at-most-all-p
        head
        (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun verina-basic-90-pairwise-nondecreasing-p (values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (verina-basic-90-head-at-most-all-p
        (car values)
        (cdr values))
       (verina-basic-90-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

;; Array.get! on Array Int returns the indexed entry when present and the
;; inhabited integer default zero otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-90-array-read (index row)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      0
    (if (consp row)
        (if (zp index)
            (car row)
          (verina-basic-90-array-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr row)))
      0)))

;; Mapping the source defaulting read at INDEX over all rows gives exactly the
;; column list used by the source column-sortedness precondition.

(defun verina-basic-90-column-values (index a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (cons
       (verina-basic-90-array-read
        index
        (car a))
       (verina-basic-90-column-values
        index
        (cdr a)))
    nil))

;; Starting at column zero for the first row's length reproduces
;; (List.range (a[0]!.size)).all and its Pairwise test for every column.

(defun verina-basic-90-all-columns-nondecreasing-p
    (a index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (verina-basic-90-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
      (verina-basic-90-column-values index a))
     (verina-basic-90-all-columns-nondecreasing-p
      a
      (+ index 1)
      (- remaining 1)))))

(defun verina-basic-90-all-rows-nondecreasing-p (a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-90-pairwise-nondecreasing-p
        (car a))
       (verina-basic-90-all-rows-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr a)))
    (equal a nil)))

;; This is exactly the source precondition after Array.size is represented by
;; list length. KEY is unused by the source precondition.

(defun verina-basic-90-slope-search-precond (a key)
  (declare (ignore key))
  (and
   (consp a)
   (consp (car a))
   (verina-basic-90-pairwise-equal-row-lengths-p a)
   (verina-basic-90-all-rows-nondecreasing-p a)
   (verina-basic-90-all-columns-nondecreasing-p
    a
    0
    (len (car a)))))

;; Lean Int.toNat maps every negative integer to zero and preserves every
;; nonnegative integer.

(defun verina-basic-90-int-to-nat (value)
  (if (and
       (integerp value)
       (< value 0))
      0
    (nfix value)))

;; Array.get! on Array (Array Int) returns the indexed row when present and
;; the inhabited empty-array default otherwise.

(defun verina-basic-90-row-read (index a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (not (natp index))
      nil
    (if (consp a)
        (if (zp index)
            (car a)
          (verina-basic-90-row-read
           (- index 1)
           (cdr a)))
      nil)))

;; This is the complete source get2d helper, including both Int.toNat
;; conversions and both inhabited Array.get! defaults.

(defun verina-basic-90-get2d (a i j)
  (verina-basic-90-array-read
   (verina-basic-90-int-to-nat j)
   (verina-basic-90-row-read
    (verina-basic-90-int-to-nat i)
    a)))

;; An Int x Int result is represented by a dotted pair whose car and cdr are
;; arbitrary ACL2 integers.

(defun verina-basic-90-int-pair-p (result)
  (and
   (consp result)
   (integerp (car result))
   (integerp (cdr result))))

;; This fuel recursion reproduces the source-local AUX exactly. The first
;; branch returns (-1, -1) at zero fuel; the remaining guards, comparisons,
;; coordinate updates, and fuel decrement occur in the source order.

(defun verina-basic-90-slope-search-aux
    (a key m n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      (cons -1 -1)
    (if (or
         (>= m (len a))
         (< n 0))
        (cons -1 -1)
      (let ((entry
             (verina-basic-90-get2d a m n)))
        (if (equal entry key)
            (cons m n)
          (if (< entry key)
              (verina-basic-90-slope-search-aux
               a
               key
               (+ m 1)
               n
               (- fuel 1))
            (verina-basic-90-slope-search-aux
             a
             key
             m
             (- n 1)
             (- fuel 1))))))))

;; Natural subtraction in cols - 1 is represented by NFIX. The proof-valued
;; precondition argument is computationally irrelevant and is erased.

(defun verina-basic-90-slope-search (a key)
  (let* ((rows (len a))
         (cols
          (if (< 0 rows)
              (len (car a))
            0)))
    (verina-basic-90-slope-search-aux
     a
     key
     0
     (nfix (- cols 1))
     (+ rows cols))))

;; These recursions are the nested Array.all expression asserting that no
;; matrix entry equals KEY.

(defun verina-basic-90-row-excludes-key-p (row key)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count row)))
  (if (consp row)
      (and
       (not (equal (car row) key))
       (verina-basic-90-row-excludes-key-p
        (cdr row)
        key))
    (equal row nil)))

(defun verina-basic-90-matrix-excludes-key-p (a key)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (verina-basic-90-row-excludes-key-p
        (car a)
        key)
       (verina-basic-90-matrix-excludes-key-p
        (cdr a)
        key))
    (equal a nil)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition. The first disjunct gives an
;; in-bounds matching coordinate; the second requires exactly (-1, -1) and
;; absence of KEY from every row.

(defun verina-basic-90-slope-search-postcond
    (a key result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-90-int-matrix-p a)
   (integerp key)
   (verina-basic-90-int-pair-p result)
   (let ((m (car result))
         (n (cdr result)))
     (or
      (and
       (<= 0 m)
       (< m (len a))
       (<= 0 n)
       (< n (len (car a)))
       (equal
        (verina-basic-90-get2d a m n)
        key))
      (and
       (equal m -1)
       (equal n -1)
       (verina-basic-90-matrix-excludes-key-p
        a
        key))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It
;; quantifies over every finite integer matrix and integer key, assumes exactly
;; the source rectangular row/column sortedness precondition, and applies the
;; full postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-90-slope-search-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (a key)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-90-int-matrix-p a)
      (integerp key)
      (verina-basic-90-slope-search-precond
       a
       key))
     (verina-basic-90-slope-search-postcond
      a
      key
      (verina-basic-90-slope-search
       a
       key)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_90
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90,
-- catalog title "SlopeSearch": a deterministic fuel-bounded search scans a
-- row- and column-sorted integer matrix from its top-right corner and returns
-- a matching index pair or (-1, -1), with its full correctness contract.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic90 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 4 _,_
infixr 5 _×_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-conjunct : A
    second-conjunct : B

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    pairFirst : A
    pairSecond : B

open _×_ public

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || other = true
false || other = other

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

natLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLessOrEqual zero _ = true
natLessOrEqual (suc _) zero = false
natLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natLessOrEqual m n

natSubtract : Nat → Nat → Nat
natSubtract m zero = m
natSubtract zero (suc n) = zero
natSubtract (suc m) (suc n) = natSubtract m n

intEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natEqual m n
intEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natEqual m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

intLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = natLessOrEqual m n
intLessOrEqual (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLessOrEqual (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natLessOrEqual n m

intGreaterOrEqual : Int → Int → Bool
intGreaterOrEqual x y = intLessOrEqual y x

IntLess : Int → Int → Set
IntLess x y = IsTrue (intLess x y)

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual x y = IsTrue (intLessOrEqual x y)

zeroInt : Int
zeroInt = pos zero

minusOne : Int
minusOne = negsuc zero

intSuccessor : Int → Int
intSuccessor (pos n) = pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) = pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) = negsuc n

intPredecessor : Int → Int
intPredecessor (pos zero) = negsuc zero
intPredecessor (pos (suc n)) = pos n
intPredecessor (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc n)

intToNat : Int → Nat
intToNat (pos n) = n
intToNat (negsuc _) = zero

Array : Set → Set
Array A = List A

Matrix : Set
Matrix = Array (Array Int)

arraySize : {A : Set} → Array A → Nat
arraySize [] = zero
arraySize (_ ∷ xs) = suc (arraySize xs)

indexDefault : {A : Set} → A → Array A → Nat → A
indexDefault default [] index = default
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) zero = x
indexDefault default (x ∷ xs) (suc index) =
  indexDefault default xs index

mapList : {A B : Set} → (A → B) → List A → List B
mapList f [] = []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ mapList f xs

rangeFrom : Nat → Nat → List Nat
rangeFrom start zero = []
rangeFrom start (suc count) =
  start ∷ rangeFrom (suc start) count

range : Nat → List Nat
range count = rangeFrom zero count

allList : {A : Set} → (A → Bool) → List A → Bool
allList predicate [] = true
allList predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  if predicate x
  then allList predicate xs
  else false

All : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → List A → Set
All predicate [] = Top
All predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x ∧ All predicate xs

Pairwise :
  {A : Set} →
  (A → A → Set) →
  List A →
  Set
Pairwise relation [] = Top
Pairwise relation (x ∷ xs) =
  All (relation x) xs ∧ Pairwise relation xs

get2d : Matrix → Int → Int → Int
get2d a i j =
  indexDefault
    zeroInt
    (indexDefault [] a (intToNat i))
    (intToNat j)

sameRowSize : Array Int → Array Int → Set
sameRowSize first-row second-row =
  arraySize first-row ≡ arraySize second-row

sortedRow : Array Int → Set
sortedRow row =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual row

columnAt : Nat → Matrix → Array Int
columnAt j a =
  mapList
    (λ row → indexDefault zeroInt row j)
    a

sortedColumn : Matrix → Nat → Set
sortedColumn a j =
  Pairwise IntLessOrEqual (columnAt j a)

SlopeSearch-precond : Matrix → Int → Set
SlopeSearch-precond a key =
  let first-row = indexDefault [] a zero
  in
    (zero < arraySize a) ∧
    (zero < arraySize first-row) ∧
    Pairwise sameRowSize a ∧
    All sortedRow a ∧
    All (sortedColumn a) (range (arraySize first-row))

numberOfColumns : Matrix → Nat
numberOfColumns a =
  let rows = arraySize a
  in
    if natLess zero rows
    then arraySize (indexDefault [] a zero)
    else zero

slopeSearchAux :
  Matrix →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Int →
  Int →
  Nat →
  Int × Int
slopeSearchAux a key rows m n zero =
  minusOne , minusOne
slopeSearchAux a key rows m n (suc fuel) =
  if intGreaterOrEqual m (pos rows) || intLess n zeroInt
  then minusOne , minusOne
  else
    let value = get2d a m n
    in
      if intEqual value key
      then m , n
      else
        if intLess value key
        then
          slopeSearchAux
            a
            key
            rows
            (intSuccessor m)
            n
            fuel
        else
          slopeSearchAux
            a
            key
            rows
            m
            (intPredecessor n)
            fuel

SlopeSearch :
  (a : Matrix) →
  (key : Int) →
  SlopeSearch-precond a key →
  Int × Int
SlopeSearch a key h-precond =
  let rows = arraySize a
      cols = numberOfColumns a
      initial-column = pos (natSubtract cols (suc zero))
  in
    slopeSearchAux
      a
      key
      rows
      zeroInt
      initial-column
      (rows + cols)

SlopeSearch-postcond :
  (a : Matrix) →
  (key : Int) →
  (result : Int × Int) →
  SlopeSearch-precond a key →
  Set
SlopeSearch-postcond a key result h-precond =
  let m = pairFirst result
      n = pairSecond result
      rows = arraySize a
      cols = arraySize (indexDefault [] a zero)
  in
    (IntLessOrEqual zeroInt m ∧
     IntLess m (pos rows) ∧
     IntLessOrEqual zeroInt n ∧
     IntLess n (pos cols) ∧
     get2d a m n ≡ key) ∨
    (m ≡ minusOne ∧
     n ≡ minusOne ∧
     IsTrue
       (allList
         (λ row →
           allList
             (λ element → notBool (intEqual element key))
             row)
         a))

SlopeSearch-spec-satisfied : Set
SlopeSearch-spec-satisfied =
  (a : Matrix) →
  (key : Int) →
  (h-precond : SlopeSearch-precond a key) →
  SlopeSearch-postcond
    a
    key
    (SlopeSearch a key h-precond)
    h-precond

title: verina_basic_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA artifact verina_basic_90
  (SlopeSearch): a fuel-bounded staircase search over a rectangular integer
  matrix with sorted rows and columns returns either a matching coordinate or
  (-1,-1) when the key is absent. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val SlopeSearch_toNat_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_toNat_def",
  ``SlopeSearch_toNat (i:int) = if i < 0 then 0 else Num i``);

val SlopeSearch_rowBang_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_rowBang_def",
  ``SlopeSearch_rowBang (a:int list list) i =
      if i < LENGTH a then EL i a else []``);

val SlopeSearch_getBang_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_getBang_def",
  ``SlopeSearch_getBang (xs:int list) i =
      if i < LENGTH xs then EL i xs else 0``);

val get2d_def = new_definition (
  "get2d_def",
  ``get2d (a:int list list) (i:int) (j:int) =
      SlopeSearch_getBang
        (SlopeSearch_rowBang a (SlopeSearch_toNat i))
        (SlopeSearch_toNat j)``);

val SlopeSearch_pairwiseSameLength_def = Define `
  (SlopeSearch_pairwiseSameLength ([]:int list list) = T) /\
  (SlopeSearch_pairwiseSameLength (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y:int list. LENGTH x = LENGTH y) xs /\
      SlopeSearch_pairwiseSameLength xs))`;

val SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe_def = Define `
  (SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe ([]:int list) = T) /\
  (SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe (x::xs) =
     (EVERY (\y:int. x <= y) xs /\
      SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe xs))`;

val SlopeSearch_precond_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_precond_def",
  ``SlopeSearch_precond (a:int list list) (key:int) <=>
      0 < LENGTH a /\
      0 < LENGTH (SlopeSearch_rowBang a 0) /\
      SlopeSearch_pairwiseSameLength a /\
      EVERY SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe a /\
      EVERY
        (\i. SlopeSearch_pairwiseLe
               (MAP (\row. SlopeSearch_getBang row i) a))
        (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH (SlopeSearch_rowBang a 0)))``);

val SlopeSearch_auxFuel_def = Define `
  (SlopeSearch_auxFuel (a:int list list) (key:int) rows 0
     (m:int) (n:int) = ((-1:int),(-1:int))) /\
  (SlopeSearch_auxFuel a key rows (SUC fuel) m n =
     if int_of_num rows <= m \/ n < 0 then
       ((-1:int),(-1:int))
     else if get2d a m n = key then
       (m,n)
     else if get2d a m n < key then
       SlopeSearch_auxFuel a key rows fuel (m + 1) n
     else
       SlopeSearch_auxFuel a key rows fuel m (n - 1))`;

val SlopeSearch_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_def",
  ``SlopeSearch (a:int list list) (key:int) =
      let rows = LENGTH a in
      let cols =
        if 0 < rows then LENGTH (SlopeSearch_rowBang a 0) else 0
      in
        SlopeSearch_auxFuel a key rows (rows + cols)
          0 (int_of_num (cols - 1))``);

val SlopeSearch_postcond_def = new_definition (
  "SlopeSearch_postcond_def",
  ``SlopeSearch_postcond (a:int list list) (key:int)
       (result:int # int) <=>
      let m = FST result in
      let n = SND result in
        (0 <= m /\
         m < int_of_num (LENGTH a) /\
         0 <= n /\
         n < int_of_num (LENGTH (SlopeSearch_rowBang a 0)) /\
         get2d a m n = key) \/
        (m = -1 /\ n = -1 /\
         EVERY (\row. EVERY (\entry. entry <> key) row) a)``);

val SlopeSearch_correct_statement = ``
  !a key.
    SlopeSearch_precond a key ==>
    SlopeSearch_postcond a key (SlopeSearch a key)
``;

title: verina_basic_90
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_90), catalog title SlopeSearch: the exact
  fuel-bounded executable slope search of a rectangular integer matrix,
  under row-wise and column-wise nondecreasing-order assumptions, satisfies
  its found-position or absent-key correctness contract. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the full integer and natural-number domains.
  Word ZZ is exactly the type of arbitrary finite integer arrays, and
  Word ( Word ZZ ) is exactly the type of arbitrary finite arrays of such
  arrays. For a word w, # ` w is its natural-number size, w ` i is
  zero-based lookup, and 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) is its complete valid-index set.
  The product ZZ X. ZZ, ordered-pair constructor <. A , B >., and projections
  1st and 2nd represent the source result type Int x Int.

  VERINAB90NatSub is Lean's truncated natural subtraction, and
  VERINAB90ToNat is Lean Int.toNat. VERINAB90GetBang reproduces get! on an
  integer row with default zero. VERINAB90GetRowBang reproduces get! on the
  outer array with the default empty integer array. Consequently
  VERINAB90Get2d is exactly the source helper get2d, including both Int.toNat
  conversions and both inhabited defaults. VERINAB90Cols preserves the
  source rows-positive conditional used to compute cols.

  VERINAB90PairwiseSizeEq is List.Pairwise equality of row sizes.
  VERINAB90PairwiseLE is List.Pairwise integer nondecreasing order.
  VERINAB90ColumnsPairwiseLE applies that same relation to each column word
  produced by mapping zero-default row lookup over the matrix.
  VERINAB90Pre preserves the nonempty outer array, nonempty first row,
  pairwise-equal row sizes, every row's sortedness, every first-row column's
  sortedness, and the typed but otherwise unrestricted integer key.

  VERINAB90AuxGraph is the exact operational graph of the source local aux
  recursion. Its trace contains the initial (m,n) state and one state for
  each unit of natural fuel. At every positive-fuel step it first freezes on
  the source out-of-bounds test, next freezes on equality with the key, then
  increments m when the entry is below the key and otherwise decrements n.
  A successful result is admitted exactly when equality is observed at a
  state whose corresponding recursive call still has positive fuel; if no
  such state exists, including when equality is first reached only after the
  final transition, the result is (-1,-1). Thus the graph permits exactly
  the source computation and no additional output. VERINAB90Aux selects that
  unique result, and VERINAB90SlopeSearch starts at row zero and the
  truncated predecessor of cols with fuel rows + cols.

  VERINAB90NoKey is the nested Array.all absence test. VERINAB90Post preserves
  the source disjunction: either both result components are valid matrix
  indices containing the key, or both are -1 and every matrix entry differs
  from the key. The proof-valued precondition arguments have no computational
  or propositional effect beyond the explicit precondition antecedent in the
  final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this artifact adds no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB90NatSub VERINAB90ToNat
  VERINAB90GetBang VERINAB90GetRowBang VERINAB90Get2d VERINAB90Cols
  VERINAB90PairwiseSizeEq VERINAB90PairwiseLE
  VERINAB90ColumnsPairwiseLE VERINAB90Pre
  VERINAB90AuxGraph VERINAB90Aux VERINAB90SlopeSearch
  VERINAB90NoKey VERINAB90Post
$.

verinab90-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90NatSub A B ) $.
verinab90-to-nat-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90ToNat A ) $.
verinab90-get-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90GetBang A B ) $.
verinab90-get-row-bang-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90GetRowBang A B ) $.
verinab90-get2d-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90Get2d A B C ) $.
verinab90-cols-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90Cols A ) $.
verinab90-pairwise-size-eq-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90PairwiseSizeEq A ) $.
verinab90-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90PairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab90-columns-pairwise-le-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90ColumnsPairwiseLE A ) $.
verinab90-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90Pre A B ) $.
verinab90-aux-graph-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90AuxGraph A B C D E F ) $.
verinab90-aux-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90Aux A B C D E ) $.
verinab90-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB90SlopeSearch A B ) $.
verinab90-no-key-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90NoKey A B ) $.
verinab90-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB90Post A B C ) $.

verinab90-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

verinab90-to-nat-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90ToNat A
) = if (
  A < 0 ,
  0 ,
  A
) $.

verinab90-get-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90GetBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  0
) $.

verinab90-get-row-bang-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90GetRowBang A B
) = if (
  B < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( A ` B ) ,
  (/)
) $.

verinab90-get2d-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90Get2d A B C
) = (
  VERINAB90GetBang
    (
      VERINAB90GetRowBang
        A
        ( VERINAB90ToNat B )
    )
    ( VERINAB90ToNat C )
) $.

verinab90-cols-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90Cols A
) = if (
  0 < ( # ` A ) ,
  ( # ` ( VERINAB90GetRowBang A 0 ) ) ,
  0
) $.

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab90-pairwise-size-eq-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90PairwiseSizeEq A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          ( # ` ( A ` i ) ) = ( # ` ( A ` j ) )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j A $.

  verinab90-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90PairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ZZ
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        (
          i < j
          ->
          ( A ` i ) <_ ( A ` j )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c i j A $.

  verinab90-columns-pairwise-le-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90ColumnsPairwiseLE A
  ) <-> (
    A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
    /\
    A. c e. (
      0 ..^ ( # ` ( VERINAB90GetRowBang A 0 ) )
    )
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
          (
            i < j
            ->
            (
              VERINAB90GetBang ( A ` i ) c
            ) <_ (
              VERINAB90GetBang ( A ` j ) c
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i A B $.

  verinab90-precondition-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90Pre A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    (
      0 < ( # ` A )
      /\
      (
        0 < ( # ` ( VERINAB90GetRowBang A 0 ) )
        /\
        (
          ( VERINAB90PairwiseSizeEq A )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
              ( VERINAB90PairwiseLE ( A ` i ) )
            /\
            ( VERINAB90ColumnsPairwiseLE A )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k t A B C D E F $.

  verinab90-aux-graph-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90AuxGraph A B C D E F
  ) <-> (
    (
      (
        (
          (
            A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
            /\
            B e. ZZ
          )
          /\
          (
            C e. ZZ
            /\
            D e. ZZ
          )
        )
        /\
        E e. NN0
      )
      /\
      F e. ( ZZ X. ZZ )
    )
    /\
    E. t e. Word ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      (
        (
          ( # ` t ) = ( E + 1 )
          /\
          ( t ` 0 ) = <. C , D >.
        )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ( 0 ..^ E )
            (
              t ` ( k + 1 )
            ) = if (
              (
                ( # ` A ) <_ ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                \/
                ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) ) < 0
              ) ,
              ( t ` k ) ,
              if (
                (
                  VERINAB90Get2d
                    A
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                    ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                ) = B ,
                ( t ` k ) ,
                if (
                  (
                    VERINAB90Get2d
                      A
                      ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                      ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  ) < B ,
                  <.
                    ( ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) + 1 ) ,
                    ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  >. ,
                  <.
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) ,
                    ( ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) ) - 1 )
                  >.
                )
              )
            )
          /\
          (
            E. k e. ( 0 ..^ E )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) < ( # ` A )
                    /\
                    0 <_ ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    VERINAB90Get2d
                      A
                      ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                      ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  ) = B
                )
                /\
                F = ( t ` k )
              )
            \/
            (
              -.
              E. k e. ( 0 ..^ E )
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) ) < ( # ` A )
                    /\
                    0 <_ ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    VERINAB90Get2d
                      A
                      ( 1st ` ( t ` k ) )
                      ( 2nd ` ( t ` k ) )
                  ) = B
                )
              /\
              F = <. ( -u 1 ) , ( -u 1 ) >.
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y A B C D E $.

  verinab90-aux-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90Aux A B C D E
  ) = (
    iota_ y e. ( ZZ X. ZZ )
      (
        VERINAB90AuxGraph
          A B C D E y
      )
  ) $.
$}

verinab90-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90SlopeSearch A B
) = (
  VERINAB90Aux
    A
    B
    0
    ( VERINAB90NatSub ( VERINAB90Cols A ) 1 )
    ( ( # ` A ) + ( VERINAB90Cols A ) )
) $.

${
  $d i j A B $.

  verinab90-no-key-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB90NoKey A B
  ) <-> (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` A ) )
      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( A ` i ) ) )
        ( ( A ` i ) ` j ) =/= B
  ) $.
$}

verinab90-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB90Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      /\
      B e. ZZ
    )
    /\
    C e. ( ZZ X. ZZ )
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      (
        0 <_ ( 1st ` C )
        /\
        ( 1st ` C ) < ( # ` A )
      )
      /\
      (
        0 <_ ( 2nd ` C )
        /\
        (
          ( 2nd ` C ) < (
            # ` ( VERINAB90GetRowBang A 0 )
          )
          /\
          (
            VERINAB90Get2d
              A
              ( 1st ` C )
              ( 2nd ` C )
          ) = B
        )
      )
    )
    \/
    (
      (
        ( 1st ` C ) = ( -u 1 )
        /\
        ( 2nd ` C ) = ( -u 1 )
      )
      /\
      ( VERINAB90NoKey A B )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d a z $.

  verina-basic-90-slope-search $a |-
    A. a e. Word ( Word ZZ )
      A. z e. ZZ
        (
          ( VERINAB90Pre a z )
          ->
          (
            VERINAB90Post
              a
              z
              ( VERINAB90SlopeSearch a z )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: verina_basic_90
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90
:: (verina__mizar__verina_basic_90), catalog title "SlopeSearch": the
:: rectangular row- and column-sorted integer-matrix precondition, exact
:: defaulting lookup and fuel-bounded staircase-search implementation,
:: found-or-minus-one postcondition, and final correctness contract. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, MARGREL1,
    XBOOLEAN;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  constructors RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQOP, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, XBOOLEAN, MARGREL1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, XBOOLEAN,
    MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex intToNat being Function of INT,NAT,
     readOuterDefault being Function of [:(INT*)*,NAT:],INT*,
     readInnerDefault being Function of [:INT*,NAT:],INT,
     get2d being Function of [:(INT*)*,INT,INT:],INT,
     slopeSearchPrecond being Function of [:(INT*)*,INT:],BOOLEAN,
     slopeSearchAux being
       Function of [:[:(INT*)*,INT:],[:INT,INT:],NAT:],[:INT,INT:],
     slopeSearchProgram being
       Function of [:(INT*)*,INT:],[:INT,INT:],
     slopeSearchPostcond being
       Function of [:(INT*)*,INT,[:INT,INT:]:],BOOLEAN st
    (for z being Integer holds
      ((z < 0 & intToNat/.z = 0) or
       (0 <= z & (intToNat/.z qua Integer) = z))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, i being Nat holds
      ((i < len a &
          readOuterDefault/.[a,i] = a/.(i + 1)) or
       (len a <= i &
          readOuterDefault/.[a,i] = <*>INT))) &
    (for row being FinSequence of INT, j being Nat holds
      ((j < len row &
          readInnerDefault/.[row,j] = row/.(j + 1)) or
       (len row <= j &
          readInnerDefault/.[row,j] = 0))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, i,j being Integer holds
      get2d/.[a,i,j] =
        readInnerDefault/.
          [readOuterDefault/.[a,intToNat/.i],intToNat/.j]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key being Integer holds
      (slopeSearchPrecond/.[a,key] = TRUE iff
        0 < len a &
        0 < len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) &
        (for r,s being Nat st r < s & s < len a holds
          len (a/.(r + 1)) = len (a/.(s + 1))) &
        (for r,c,d being Nat st
          r < len a &
          c < d & d < len (a/.(r + 1))
        holds
          readInnerDefault/.[a/.(r + 1),c] <=
            readInnerDefault/.[a/.(r + 1),d]) &
        (for c,r,s being Nat st
          c < len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) &
          r < s & s < len a
        holds
          get2d/.[a,r,c] <= get2d/.[a,s,c])) &
      (slopeSearchPrecond/.[a,key] = FALSE iff
        not
          (0 < len a &
           0 < len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) &
           (for r,s being Nat st r < s & s < len a holds
             len (a/.(r + 1)) = len (a/.(s + 1))) &
           (for r,c,d being Nat st
             r < len a &
             c < d & d < len (a/.(r + 1))
           holds
             readInnerDefault/.[a/.(r + 1),c] <=
               readInnerDefault/.[a/.(r + 1),d]) &
           (for c,r,s being Nat st
             c < len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) &
             r < s & s < len a
           holds
             get2d/.[a,r,c] <= get2d/.[a,s,c])))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key,m,n being Integer holds
      slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n],0] = [-1,-1]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key,m,n being Integer,
         fuel being Nat holds
      ((((len a qua Integer) <= m or n < 0) &
          slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n],fuel + 1] = [-1,-1]) or
       (m < (len a qua Integer) & 0 <= n &
          get2d/.[a,m,n] = key &
          slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n],fuel + 1] = [m,n]) or
       (m < (len a qua Integer) & 0 <= n &
          get2d/.[a,m,n] < key &
          slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n],fuel + 1] =
            slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m + 1,n],fuel]) or
       (m < (len a qua Integer) & 0 <= n &
          get2d/.[a,m,n] <> key &
          not get2d/.[a,m,n] < key &
          slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n],fuel + 1] =
            slopeSearchAux/.[[a,key],[m,n - 1],fuel]))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key being Integer holds
      slopeSearchProgram/.[a,key] =
        slopeSearchAux/.
          [[a,key],
           [0,len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) -' 1],
           len a + len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0])]) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key,m,n being Integer holds
      (slopeSearchPostcond/.[a,key,[m,n]] = TRUE iff
        (0 <= m &
          m < (len a qua Integer) &
          0 <= n &
          n < (len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) qua Integer) &
          get2d/.[a,m,n] = key) or
        (m = -1 & n = -1 &
          for r,c being Nat st
            r < len a & c < len (a/.(r + 1))
          holds (a/.(r + 1)).(c + 1) <> key)) &
      (slopeSearchPostcond/.[a,key,[m,n]] = FALSE iff
        not
          ((0 <= m &
            m < (len a qua Integer) &
            0 <= n &
            n < (len (readOuterDefault/.[a,0]) qua Integer) &
            get2d/.[a,m,n] = key) or
           (m = -1 & n = -1 &
            for r,c being Nat st
              r < len a & c < len (a/.(r + 1))
            holds (a/.(r + 1)).(c + 1) <> key)))) &
    (for a being FinSequence of INT*, key being Integer st
      slopeSearchPrecond/.[a,key] = TRUE
    holds
      slopeSearchPostcond/.
        [a,key,slopeSearchProgram/.[a,key]] = TRUE)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: verina_basic_90
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_90
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_90), catalog title "SlopeSearch": the exact
% fuel-bounded top-right search on a nonempty rectangular integer matrix
% sorted by rows and columns, with its full contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_90: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_pair: TYPE =
    [# fst: int, snd: int #]

  % Finite PVS lists preserve exactly the contents and order of Lean arrays.
  int_list_length(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_length(tail) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_matrix_length(
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(row, rest):
        int_matrix_length(rest) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on integer arrays returns zero outside the array.
  int_list_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        0,
      cons(head, tail):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          head
        ELSE
          int_list_get_bang(index - 1, tail)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % Lean Array.get! on arrays returns the empty array outside the array.
  int_matrix_get_bang(
      index: nat,
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(row, rest):
        IF index = 0 THEN
          row
        ELSE
          int_matrix_get_bang(index - 1, rest)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  % This is Lean Int.toNat: every negative integer maps to zero.
  int_to_nat(value: int): nat =
    IF value >= 0 THEN value ELSE 0 ENDIF

  get2d(
      a: list[list[int]],
      i, j: int): int =
    int_list_get_bang(
      int_to_nat(j),
      int_matrix_get_bang(
        int_to_nat(i),
        a))

  int_list_all_at_least(
      lower: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        lower <= head
          AND int_list_all_at_least(lower, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  % This is List.Pairwise applied to integer nondecreasing order.
  int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        int_list_all_at_least(head, tail)
          AND int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_rows_all_same_length_as(
      row: list[int],
      later: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES later OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(next_row, rest):
        int_list_length(row) = int_list_length(next_row)
          AND int_rows_all_same_length_as(row, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE later BY <<

  % This is List.Pairwise applied to equality of row sizes.
  int_matrix_pairwise_equal_row_lengths(
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(row, rest):
        int_rows_all_same_length_as(row, rest)
          AND int_matrix_pairwise_equal_row_lengths(rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  int_matrix_all_rows_nondecreasing(
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(row, rest):
        int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(row)
          AND int_matrix_all_rows_nondecreasing(rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  % This is a.map (fun row => row[index]!) on the finite-list encoding.
  int_matrix_column(
      index: nat,
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE list[int] =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        null[int],
      cons(row, rest):
        cons(
          int_list_get_bang(index, row),
          int_matrix_column(index, rest))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  % Scanning index through index + remaining - 1 is exactly List.range
  % followed by List.all in the source column-sortedness condition.
  int_matrix_columns_nondecreasing(
      rows: list[list[int]],
      index, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      int_list_pairwise_nondecreasing(
        int_matrix_column(index, rows))
        AND
          int_matrix_columns_nondecreasing(
            rows,
            index + 1,
            remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  SlopeSearch_precond(
      a: list[list[int]],
      key: int): bool =
    LET rows: nat = int_matrix_length(a),
        first_row: list[int] = int_matrix_get_bang(0, a),
        columns: nat = int_list_length(first_row)
    IN
      rows > 0
        AND columns > 0
        AND int_matrix_pairwise_equal_row_lengths(a)
        AND int_matrix_all_rows_nondecreasing(a)
        AND int_matrix_columns_nondecreasing(a, 0, columns)

  SlopeSearch_aux(
      a: list[list[int]],
      key, m, n: int,
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE int_pair =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      (# fst := -1, snd := -1 #)
    ELSIF m >= int_matrix_length(a) OR n < 0 THEN
      (# fst := -1, snd := -1 #)
    ELSIF get2d(a, m, n) = key THEN
      (# fst := m, snd := n #)
    ELSIF get2d(a, m, n) < key THEN
      SlopeSearch_aux(
        a,
        key,
        m + 1,
        n,
        fuel - 1)
    ELSE
      SlopeSearch_aux(
        a,
        key,
        m,
        n - 1,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % This preserves the initial top-right position, exact rows + columns fuel,
  % branch order, coordinate updates, and failure pair.
  SlopeSearch(
      a: list[list[int]],
      key: int): int_pair =
    LET rows: nat = int_matrix_length(a),
        columns: nat =
          IF rows > 0 THEN
            int_list_length(
              int_matrix_get_bang(0, a))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    IN
      SlopeSearch_aux(
        a,
        key,
        0,
        ((columns - 1) :: int),
        rows + columns)

  int_list_all_different_from(
      key: int,
      values: list[int]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head /= key
          AND int_list_all_different_from(key, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  int_matrix_all_different_from(
      key: int,
      rows: list[list[int]]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES rows OF
      null:
        TRUE,
      cons(row, rest):
        int_list_all_different_from(key, row)
          AND int_matrix_all_different_from(key, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rows BY <<

  % The source precondition proof argument to the postcondition is logically
  % irrelevant, while every condition on the returned pair is retained.
  SlopeSearch_postcond(
      a: list[list[int]],
      key: int,
      result: int_pair): bool =
    LET m: int = fst(result),
        n: int = snd(result)
    IN
      (m >= 0
        AND m < int_matrix_length(a)
        AND n >= 0
        AND n
          < int_list_length(
              int_matrix_get_bang(0, a))
        AND get2d(a, m, n) = key)
      OR
        (m = -1
          AND n = -1
          AND int_matrix_all_different_from(key, a))

  SlopeSearch_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (a: list[list[int]], key: int):
      SlopeSearch_precond(a, key)
        IMPLIES
          SlopeSearch_postcond(
            a,
            key,
            SlopeSearch(a, key))

END verina_basic_90

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_91,
   catalog title "Swap": executable swapping of two arbitrary integers,
   together with its unconditional precondition, postcondition, and final
   correctness proposition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith.

Definition Swap_precond (_X _Y : Z) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition Swap
    (X Y : Z)
    (_h_precond : Swap_precond X Y) : Z * Z :=
  let x := X in
  let y := Y in
  let tmp := x in
  let x := y in
  let y := tmp in
  (x, y).

Definition Swap_postcond
    (X Y : Z)
    (result : Z * Z)
    (_h_precond : Swap_precond X Y) : Prop :=
  fst result = Y /\
  snd result = X /\
  (X <> Y -> fst result <> X /\ snd result <> Y).

Theorem Swap_spec_satisfied
    (X Y : Z)
    (h_precond : Swap_precond X Y) :
  Swap_postcond X Y (Swap X Y h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_91), catalog title "Swap": a total

  a pair, together with its unconditional precondition, component-wise

theory verina_basic_91

  "Swap_precond X Y \<longleftrightarrow> True"

  "Swap X Y =
    (let x0 = X;

         x1 = y0;

  shows "Swap_postcond X Y (Swap X Y)"
  sorry

title: verina_basic_91
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_91,
;; catalog title "Swap": a deterministic integer program exchanges its two
;; inputs and satisfies the complete swapped-pair contract. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The two Int input domains remain explicit
;; in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-91-swap-precond (x y)
  (declare (ignore x y))
  t)

;; Lean Int x Int values are represented bijectively by ACL2 cons pairs whose
;; car and cdr range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-91-int-pair-p (result)
  (and
   (consp result)
   (integerp (car result))
   (integerp (cdr result))))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. Alpha-renamed local bindings preserve the exact source
;; sequence: copy X and Y, save X in TMP, assign Y to X, and TMP to Y.

(defun verina-basic-91-swap (x y)
  (let* ((x-local x)
         (y-local y)
         (tmp x-local)
         (x-after-swap y-local)
         (y-after-swap tmp))
    (cons x-after-swap y-after-swap)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition: the pair components are Y and X,
;; and when the inputs differ each returned component differs from the input
;; originally occupying that position.

(defun verina-basic-91-swap-postcond (x y result)
  (and
   (integerp x)
   (integerp y)
   (verina-basic-91-int-pair-p result)
   (equal (car result) y)
   (equal (cdr result) x)
   (implies
    (not (equal x y))
    (and
     (not (equal (car result) x))
     (not (equal (cdr result) y))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every pair of integer inputs, assumes exactly the source True
;; precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; result.

(defun-sk verina-basic-91-swap-spec-satisfied-statement ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp x)
      (integerp y)
      (verina-basic-91-swap-precond x y))
     (verina-basic-91-swap-postcond
      x
      y
      (verina-basic-91-swap x y)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_91
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_91,
-- catalog title "Swap": a deterministic integer-pair program exchanges its
-- two inputs and is connected to its full correctness contract. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic91 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 4 _,_
infixr 5 _×_
infix 4 _≢_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data Bottom : Set where

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-conjunct : A
    second-conjunct : B

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    pairFirst : A
    pairSecond : B

open _×_ public

_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = x ≡ y → Bottom

Swap-precond : Int → Int → Set
Swap-precond X Y = Top

Swap :
  (X Y : Int) →
  Swap-precond X Y →
  Int × Int
Swap X Y h-precond =
  let x = X
      y = Y
      tmp = x
      new-x = y
      new-y = tmp
  in new-x , new-y

Swap-postcond :
  (X Y : Int) →
  (result : Int × Int) →
  Swap-precond X Y →
  Set
Swap-postcond X Y result h-precond =
  (pairFirst result ≡ Y) ∧
  (pairSecond result ≡ X) ∧
  (X ≢ Y →
    (pairFirst result ≢ X) ∧
    (pairSecond result ≢ Y))

Swap-spec-satisfied : Set
Swap-spec-satisfied =
  (X Y : Int) →
  (h-precond : Swap-precond X Y) →
  Swap-postcond
    X
    Y
    (Swap X Y h-precond)
    h-precond

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_91
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_91), catalog title "Swap": the deterministic
% integer-pair program swaps its two inputs and satisfies its full contract.
% This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_91: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_pair: TYPE =
    [# fst: int, snd: int #]

  Swap_precond(
      X, Y: int): bool =
    TRUE

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % These let bindings preserve the source program's assignment sequence.
  Swap(
      X, Y: int): int_pair =
    LET x: int = X,
        y: int = Y,
        tmp: int = x,
        swapped_x: int = y,
        swapped_y: int = tmp
    IN
      (# fst := swapped_x, snd := swapped_y #)

  % The source precondition proof argument is logically irrelevant here.
  Swap_postcond(
      X, Y: int,
      result: int_pair): bool =
    fst(result) = Y
      AND snd(result) = X
      AND
        (X /= Y IMPLIES
          fst(result) /= X
            AND snd(result) /= Y)

  Swap_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: int):
      Swap_precond(X, Y)
        IMPLIES
          Swap_postcond(
            X,
            Y,
            Swap(X, Y))

END verina_basic_91

(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_92,
   catalog title "SwapArithmetic": executable swapping of two arbitrary
   integers by subtraction and addition, together with its unconditional

    (h_precond : SwapArithmetic_precond X Y) :
  SwapArithmetic_postcond
    X Y (SwapArithmetic X Y h_precond) h_precond.

;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_92,
;; catalog title "SwapArithmetic": a deterministic integer arithmetic program
;; exchanges its two inputs and satisfies the complete swapped-pair contract.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source precondition is True. The two Int input domains remain explicit
;; in the final correctness proposition.

(defun verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic-precond (x y)
  (declare (ignore x y))
  t)

;; Lean Int x Int values are represented bijectively by ACL2 cons pairs whose
;; car and cdr range over all integers.

(defun verina-basic-92-int-pair-p (result)
  (and
   (consp result)
   (integerp (car result))
   (integerp (cdr result))))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. The LET* bindings preserve the exact source arithmetic
;; sequence.

(defun verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic (x y)
  (let* ((x1 x)
         (y1 y)
         (x2 (- y1 x1))
         (y2 (- y1 x2))
         (x3 (+ y2 x2)))
    (cons x3 y2)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition: the pair components are Y and X,
;; and when the inputs differ each returned component differs from the input
;; originally occupying that position.

(defun verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic-postcond
    (x y result)
  (and
   (integerp x)
   (integerp y)
   (verina-basic-92-int-pair-p result)
   (equal (car result) y)
   (equal (cdr result) x)
   (implies
    (not (equal x y))
    (and
     (not (equal (car result) x))
     (not (equal (cdr result) y))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over every pair of integer inputs, assumes exactly the source True
;; precondition, and applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable
;; arithmetic result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp x)
      (integerp y)
      (verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic-precond
       x
       y))
     (verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic-postcond
      x
      y
      (verina-basic-92-swap-arithmetic
       x
       y)))))

:q

-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_92,
-- catalog title "SwapArithmetic": a deterministic integer program swaps two
-- inputs through the specified subtraction-and-addition assignments and is
-- connected to its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic92 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 4 _,_
infixr 5 _×_
infix 4 _≢_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data Bottom : Set where

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-conjunct : A
    second-conjunct : B

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    pairFirst : A
    pairSecond : B

open _×_ public

_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = x ≡ y → Bottom

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

intAdd : Int → Int → Int
intAdd (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
intAdd (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
intAdd (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
intAdd (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

intNegate : Int → Int
intNegate (pos zero) = pos zero
intNegate (pos (suc n)) = negsuc n
intNegate (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

intSubtract : Int → Int → Int
intSubtract x y = intAdd x (intNegate y)

SwapArithmetic-precond : Int → Int → Set
SwapArithmetic-precond X Y = Top

SwapArithmetic :
  (X Y : Int) →
  SwapArithmetic-precond X Y →
  Int × Int
SwapArithmetic X Y h-precond =
  let x1 = X
      y1 = Y
      x2 = intSubtract y1 x1
      y2 = intSubtract y1 x2
      x3 = intAdd y2 x2
  in x3 , y2

SwapArithmetic-postcond :
  (X Y : Int) →
  (result : Int × Int) →
  SwapArithmetic-precond X Y →
  Set
SwapArithmetic-postcond X Y result h-precond =
  (pairFirst result ≡ Y) ∧
  (pairSecond result ≡ X) ∧
  (X ≢ Y →
    (pairFirst result ≢ X) ∧
    (pairSecond result ≢ Y))

SwapArithmetic-spec-satisfied : Set
SwapArithmetic-spec-satisfied =
  (X Y : Int) →
  (h-precond : SwapArithmetic-precond X Y) →
  SwapArithmetic-postcond
    X
    Y
    (SwapArithmetic X Y h-precond)
    h-precond

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_92
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_92), catalog title "SwapArithmetic": the
% deterministic arithmetic-swap program reverses two integers and satisfies
% its full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_92: THEORY
BEGIN

  int_pair: TYPE =
    [# fst: int, snd: int #]

  SwapArithmetic_precond(
      X, Y: int): bool =
    TRUE

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % These let bindings preserve the source program's arithmetic assignments.
  SwapArithmetic(
      X, Y: int): int_pair =
    LET x1: int = X,
        y1: int = Y,
        x2: int = y1 - x1,
        y2: int = y1 - x2,
        x3: int = y2 + x2
    IN
      (# fst := x3, snd := y2 #)

  % The source precondition proof argument is logically irrelevant here.
  SwapArithmetic_postcond(
      X, Y: int,
      result: int_pair): bool =
    fst(result) = Y
      AND snd(result) = X
      AND
        (X /= Y IMPLIES
          fst(result) /= X
            AND snd(result) /= Y)

  SwapArithmetic_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: int):
      SwapArithmetic_precond(X, Y)
        IMPLIES
          SwapArithmetic_postcond(
            X,
            Y,
            SwapArithmetic(X, Y))

END verina_basic_92

title: verina_basic_93
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_93,
   catalog title "SwapBitvectors": executable XOR-based swapping of two
   8-bit unsigned values, together with its unconditional precondition,
   postcondition, and final correctness proposition. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.Bool.

Module VerinaBasic93.

Record uint8 : Type := mk_uint8 {
  bit0 : bool;
  bit1 : bool;
  bit2 : bool;
  bit3 : bool;
  bit4 : bool;
  bit5 : bool;
  bit6 : bool;
  bit7 : bool
}.

Definition uint8_xor (x y : uint8) : uint8 :=
  mk_uint8
    (xorb (bit0 x) (bit0 y))
    (xorb (bit1 x) (bit1 y))
    (xorb (bit2 x) (bit2 y))
    (xorb (bit3 x) (bit3 y))
    (xorb (bit4 x) (bit4 y))
    (xorb (bit5 x) (bit5 y))
    (xorb (bit6 x) (bit6 y))
    (xorb (bit7 x) (bit7 y)).

Definition SwapBitvectors_precond
    (_X _Y : uint8) : Prop :=
  True.

Definition SwapBitvectors
    (X Y : uint8)
    (_h_precond : SwapBitvectors_precond X Y) : uint8 * uint8 :=
  let temp := uint8_xor X Y in
  let newY := uint8_xor temp Y in
  let newX := uint8_xor temp newY in
  (newX, newY).

Definition SwapBitvectors_postcond
    (X Y : uint8)
    (result : uint8 * uint8)
    (_h_precond : SwapBitvectors_precond X Y) : Prop :=
  fst result = Y /\
  snd result = X /\
  (X <> Y -> fst result <> X /\ snd result <> Y).

Theorem SwapBitvectors_spec_satisfied
    (X Y : uint8)
    (h_precond : SwapBitvectors_precond X Y) :
  SwapBitvectors_postcond
    X Y (SwapBitvectors X Y h_precond) h_precond.
Admitted.

End VerinaBasic93.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_93
  (verina__isabelle__verina_basic_93), catalog title "SwapBitvectors": an
  executable XOR-based swap of two 8-bit unsigned words, together with its
  unconditional precondition, component-wise postcondition, and final
  correctness proposition. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory verina_basic_93
  imports Main
begin

datatype uint8 =
  UInt8 bool bool bool bool bool bool bool bool

fun uint8_xor :: "uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8" where
  "uint8_xor
      (UInt8 x7 x6 x5 x4 x3 x2 x1 x0)
      (UInt8 y7 y6 y5 y4 y3 y2 y1 y0) =
    UInt8
      (x7 \<noteq> y7) (x6 \<noteq> y6) (x5 \<noteq> y5) (x4 \<noteq> y4)
      (x3 \<noteq> y3) (x2 \<noteq> y2) (x1 \<noteq> y1) (x0 \<noteq> y0)"

definition SwapBitvectors_precond ::
    "uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "SwapBitvectors_precond X Y \<longleftrightarrow> True"

definition SwapBitvectors ::
    "uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8 \<times> uint8" where
  "SwapBitvectors X Y =
    (let temp = uint8_xor X Y;
         newY = uint8_xor temp Y;
         newX = uint8_xor temp newY
     in (newX, newY))"

definition SwapBitvectors_postcond ::
    "uint8 \<Rightarrow> uint8 \<Rightarrow> (uint8 \<times> uint8) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "SwapBitvectors_postcond X Y result \<longleftrightarrow>
    fst result = Y \<and>
    snd result = X \<and>
    (X \<noteq> Y \<longrightarrow>
      fst result \<noteq> X \<and> snd result \<noteq> Y)"

theorem SwapBitvectors_spec_satisfied:
  fixes X Y :: uint8
  assumes "SwapBitvectors_precond X Y"
  shows "SwapBitvectors_postcond X Y (SwapBitvectors X Y)"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_93,
;; catalog title "SwapBitvectors": a deterministic three-XOR program swaps
;; two 8-bit unsigned integers and satisfies the complete swapped-pair
;; contract. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Canonical integers in [0, 256) represent Lean UInt8 values bijectively.

(defun verina-basic-93-uint8-p (value)
  (and
   (integerp value)
   (<= 0 value)
   (< value 256)))

;; The source precondition is True.

(defun verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors-precond (x y)
  (declare (ignore x y))
  t)

;; Modulo-256 integer XOR is exactly UInt8.xor on canonical UInt8 values.

(defun verina-basic-93-xor8 (left right)
  (mod (logxor left right) 256))

;; A Lean UInt8 x UInt8 value is represented bijectively by an ACL2 dotted
;; pair whose car and cdr are canonical UInt8 integers.

(defun verina-basic-93-uint8-pair-p (result)
  (and
   (consp result)
   (verina-basic-93-uint8-p (car result))
   (verina-basic-93-uint8-p (cdr result))))

;; The proof-valued True precondition argument is computationally irrelevant
;; and is erased. These LET* bindings preserve the source's exact three-XOR
;; sequence and return the resulting ordered pair.

(defun verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors (x y)
  (let* ((temp
          (verina-basic-93-xor8 x y))
         (new-y
          (verina-basic-93-xor8 temp y))
         (new-x
          (verina-basic-93-xor8 temp new-y)))
    (cons new-x new-y)))

;; This is the complete source postcondition, including the final implication
;; asserting componentwise change when the original inputs differ.

(defun verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors-postcond
    (x y result)
  (and
   (verina-basic-93-uint8-p x)
   (verina-basic-93-uint8-p y)
   (verina-basic-93-uint8-pair-p result)
   (equal (car result) y)
   (equal (cdr result) x)
   (implies
    (not (equal x y))
    (and
     (not (equal (car result) x))
     (not (equal (cdr result) y))))))

;; This predicate is the unproved final correctness proposition. It quantifies
;; over all UInt8 inputs, assumes exactly the source True precondition, and
;; applies the complete postcondition to the exact executable result.

(defun-sk
    verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors-spec-satisfied-statement
    ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (verina-basic-93-uint8-p x)
      (verina-basic-93-uint8-p y)
      (verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors-precond
       x
       y))
     (verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors-postcond
      x
      y
      (verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors
       x
       y)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: verina_basic_93
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_93,
-- catalog title "SwapBitvectors": a deterministic UInt8-pair program swaps
-- its two inputs using three bitwise XOR operations and is connected to its
-- full correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic93 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 4 _,_
infixr 5 _×_
infix 4 _≢_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data Bottom : Set where

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-conjunct : A
    second-conjunct : B

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    pairFirst : A
    pairSecond : B

open _×_ public

_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = x ≡ y → Bottom

data Bit : Set where
  zeroBit : Bit
  oneBit : Bit

data UInt8 : Set where
  byte :
    (bit0 bit1 bit2 bit3 bit4 bit5 bit6 bit7 : Bit) →
    UInt8

xorBit : Bit → Bit → Bit
xorBit zeroBit zeroBit = zeroBit
xorBit zeroBit oneBit = oneBit
xorBit oneBit zeroBit = oneBit
xorBit oneBit oneBit = zeroBit

xorUInt8 : UInt8 → UInt8 → UInt8
xorUInt8
  (byte x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 x7)
  (byte y0 y1 y2 y3 y4 y5 y6 y7) =
  byte
    (xorBit x0 y0)
    (xorBit x1 y1)
    (xorBit x2 y2)
    (xorBit x3 y3)
    (xorBit x4 y4)
    (xorBit x5 y5)
    (xorBit x6 y6)
    (xorBit x7 y7)

SwapBitvectors-precond : UInt8 → UInt8 → Set
SwapBitvectors-precond X Y = Top

SwapBitvectors :
  (X Y : UInt8) →
  SwapBitvectors-precond X Y →
  UInt8 × UInt8
SwapBitvectors X Y h-precond =
  let temp = xorUInt8 X Y
      newY = xorUInt8 temp Y
      newX = xorUInt8 temp newY
  in newX , newY

SwapBitvectors-postcond :
  (X Y : UInt8) →
  (result : UInt8 × UInt8) →
  SwapBitvectors-precond X Y →
  Set
SwapBitvectors-postcond X Y result h-precond =
  (pairFirst result ≡ Y) ∧
  (pairSecond result ≡ X) ∧
  (X ≢ Y →
    (pairFirst result ≢ X) ∧
    (pairSecond result ≢ Y))

SwapBitvectors-spec-satisfied : Set
SwapBitvectors-spec-satisfied =
  (X Y : UInt8) →
  (h-precond : SwapBitvectors-precond X Y) →
  SwapBitvectors-postcond
    X
    Y
    (SwapBitvectors X Y h-precond)
    h-precond

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_93
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_93), catalog title SwapBitvectors: the exact
  executable three-XOR computation swaps two 8-bit unsigned integers as an
  ordered pair and satisfies its component and changed-position correctness
  contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  VERINAB93UInt8 is exactly the 256-element unsigned 8-bit domain
  0 ..^ 2^8. For a natural A and bit position B, VERINAB93Bit A B is
  floor(A / 2^B) modulo two. VERINAB93Xor reconstructs the unique 8-bit word
  whose bit at each position below eight differs exactly when the
  corresponding input bits differ. Thus it is definitionally the source
  UInt8.xor operation on VERINAB93UInt8.

  VERINAB93Temp, VERINAB93NewY, and VERINAB93NewX preserve the source
  let-bound sequence exactly: temp is X xor Y, newY is temp xor Y, and newX
  is temp xor newY. VERINAB93SwapBitvectors returns exactly the ordered pair
  (newX,newY), so the executable result is fixed independently of the
  postcondition and admits no additional output.

  VERINAB93Pre is the source True precondition together with both UInt8 input
  types. VERINAB93Post preserves both component equations and the conditional
  clause that unequal inputs leave each returned component unequal to the
  input formerly occupying that position. The proof-valued precondition
  arguments to the implementation and postcondition are computationally and
  propositionally unused beyond the explicit precondition antecedent in the
  final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax or a faithful
  definition required by this rendering, and this artifact adds no $p
  declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB93UInt8 VERINAB93Bit VERINAB93Xor
  VERINAB93Temp VERINAB93NewY VERINAB93NewX
  VERINAB93Pre VERINAB93SwapBitvectors VERINAB93Post
$.

verinab93-uint8-syntax
  $a class VERINAB93UInt8 $.
verinab93-bit-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93Bit A B ) $.
verinab93-xor-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93Xor A B ) $.
verinab93-temp-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93Temp A B ) $.
verinab93-new-y-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93NewY A B ) $.
verinab93-new-x-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93NewX A B ) $.
verinab93-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB93Pre A B ) $.
verinab93-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB93SwapBitvectors A B ) $.
verinab93-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB93Post A B C ) $.

verinab93-uint8-definition $a |- VERINAB93UInt8 =
  ( 0 ..^ ( 2 ^ 8 ) ) $.

verinab93-bit-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93Bit A B
) = (
  ( |_ ` ( A / ( 2 ^ B ) ) ) mod 2
) $.

${
  $d k A B $.

  verinab93-xor-definition $a |- (
    VERINAB93Xor A B
  ) = (
    sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ 8 )
      if (
        ( VERINAB93Bit A k ) = ( VERINAB93Bit B k ) ,
        0 ,
        ( 2 ^ k )
      )
  ) $.
$}

verinab93-temp-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93Temp A B
) = (
  VERINAB93Xor A B
) $.

verinab93-new-y-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93NewY A B
) = (
  VERINAB93Xor
    ( VERINAB93Temp A B )
    B
) $.

verinab93-new-x-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93NewX A B
) = (
  VERINAB93Xor
    ( VERINAB93Temp A B )
    ( VERINAB93NewY A B )
) $.

verinab93-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93Pre A B
) <-> (
  A e. VERINAB93UInt8
  /\
  B e. VERINAB93UInt8
) $.

verinab93-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93SwapBitvectors A B
) = <.
  ( VERINAB93NewX A B ) ,
  ( VERINAB93NewY A B )
>. $.

verinab93-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB93Post A B C
) <-> (
  (
    (
      A e. VERINAB93UInt8
      /\
      B e. VERINAB93UInt8
    )
    /\
    C e. ( VERINAB93UInt8 X. VERINAB93UInt8 )
  )
  /\
  (
    ( 1st ` C ) = B
    /\
    (
      ( 2nd ` C ) = A
      /\
      (
        A =/= B
        ->
        (
          ( 1st ` C ) =/= A
          /\
          ( 2nd ` C ) =/= B
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

verina-basic-93-swap-bitvectors $a |- A. x e. VERINAB93UInt8
  A. y e. VERINAB93UInt8
    (
      ( VERINAB93Pre x y )
      ->
      (
        VERINAB93Post
          x
          y
          ( VERINAB93SwapBitvectors x y )
      )
    )
$.
