content:
-- Statement-only formalization of VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_99,
-- catalog title "Triple": a deterministic branched integer program computes
-- three times its input and is connected to its integer-division correctness
-- contract. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module VerinaBasic99 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixl 6 _+z_
infixl 7 _*z_
infixr 3 _∧_

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then when-true else when-false = when-true
if false then when-true else when-false = when-false

natLess : Nat → Nat → Bool
natLess zero zero = false
natLess zero (suc _) = true
natLess (suc _) zero = false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) = natLess m n

intLess : Int → Int → Bool
intLess (pos m) (pos n) = natLess m n
intLess (pos _) (negsuc _) = false
intLess (negsuc _) (pos _) = true
intLess (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = natLess n m

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

_+z_ : Int → Int → Int
pos m +z pos n = pos (m + n)
pos m +z negsuc n = difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +z pos n = difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +z negsuc n = negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*z_ : Int → Int → Int
pos m *z pos n = pos (m * n)
pos m *z negsuc n = negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *z pos n = negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *z negsuc n = pos (suc m * suc n)

naturalDivTwo : Nat → Nat
naturalDivTwo zero = zero
naturalDivTwo (suc zero) = zero
naturalDivTwo (suc (suc n)) = suc (naturalDivTwo n)

naturalCeilDivTwo : Nat → Nat
naturalCeilDivTwo zero = zero
naturalCeilDivTwo (suc zero) = suc zero
naturalCeilDivTwo (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (naturalCeilDivTwo n)

-- Lean integer division by positive two rounds toward negative infinity.
divideByTwo : Int → Int
divideByTwo (pos n) = pos (naturalDivTwo n)
divideByTwo (negsuc n) =
  negative (naturalCeilDivTwo (suc n))

naturalDivThree : Nat → Nat
naturalDivThree zero = zero
naturalDivThree (suc zero) = zero
naturalDivThree (suc (suc zero)) = zero
naturalDivThree (suc (suc (suc n))) =
  suc (naturalDivThree n)

naturalCeilDivThree : Nat → Nat
naturalCeilDivThree zero = zero
naturalCeilDivThree (suc zero) = suc zero
naturalCeilDivThree (suc (suc zero)) = suc zero
naturalCeilDivThree (suc (suc (suc n))) =
  suc (naturalCeilDivThree n)

-- Lean integer division by positive three rounds toward negative infinity.
divideByThree : Int → Int
divideByThree (pos n) = pos (naturalDivThree n)
divideByThree (negsuc n) =
  negative (naturalCeilDivThree (suc n))

Triple-precond : Int → Set
Triple-precond x = Top

Triple :
  (x : Int) →
  Triple-precond x →
  Int
Triple x h-precond =
  if intLess x (pos 18)
  then
    (let a = pos 2 *z x
         b = pos 4 *z x
     in divideByTwo (a +z b))
  else
    (let y = pos 2 *z x
     in x +z y)

Triple-postcond :
  (x result : Int) →
  Triple-precond x →
  Set
Triple-postcond x result h-precond =
  (divideByThree result ≡ x) ∧
  ((divideByThree result *z pos 3) ≡ result)

Triple-spec-satisfied : Set
Triple-spec-satisfied =
  (x : Int) →
  (h-precond : Triple-precond x) →
  Triple-postcond
    x
    (Triple x h-precond)
    h-precond

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_99
  (verina__metamath__verina_basic_99), catalog title Triple: the exact
  executable integer program uses a threshold branch whose two computations
  both triple the input, together with its complete integer-division
  correctness contract. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ is the full integer domain. VERINAB99FirstDouble and
  VERINAB99FirstQuadruple are exactly the source branch-local bindings
  a := 2 * x and b := 4 * x. VERINAB99ElseDouble is exactly the other
  branch's local binding y := 2 * x. Because the divisor two is positive,
  floor of SetMM rational division reproduces Lean integer division by two,
  including for negative sums. VERINAB99Triple is therefore exactly the
  source executable threshold branch, with no additional possible outputs.

  VERINAB99Pre is the source True precondition together with the Int input
  type. VERINAB99Post preserves both source conjuncts. Because the divisor
  three is positive, floor of SetMM rational division is exactly Lean's
  Euclidean integer quotient result / 3, including for negative results.
  The proof-valued precondition arguments are computationally and
  propositionally unused and are represented by the explicit precondition
  antecedent in the final correctness assertion. Every earlier $a is syntax
  or a faithful definition required by this rendering, and this database has
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  VERINAB99FirstDouble VERINAB99FirstQuadruple VERINAB99ElseDouble
  VERINAB99Pre VERINAB99Triple VERINAB99Post
$.

verinab99-first-double-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB99FirstDouble A ) $.
verinab99-first-quadruple-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB99FirstQuadruple A ) $.
verinab99-else-double-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB99ElseDouble A ) $.
verinab99-precondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB99Pre A ) $.
verinab99-program-syntax
  $a class ( VERINAB99Triple A ) $.
verinab99-postcondition-syntax
  $a wff ( VERINAB99Post A B ) $.

verinab99-first-double-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99FirstDouble A
) = (
  2 x. A
) $.

verinab99-first-quadruple-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99FirstQuadruple A
) = (
  4 x. A
) $.

verinab99-else-double-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99ElseDouble A
) = (
  2 x. A
) $.

verinab99-precondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99Pre A
) <-> (
  A e. ZZ
) $.

verinab99-program-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99Triple A
) = if (
  A < ; 1 8 ,
  (
    |_ ` (
      (
        ( VERINAB99FirstDouble A )
        +
        ( VERINAB99FirstQuadruple A )
      ) / 2
    )
  ) ,
  A + ( VERINAB99ElseDouble A )
) $.

verinab99-postcondition-definition $a |- (
  VERINAB99Post A B
) <-> (
  (
    A e. ZZ
    /\
    B e. ZZ
  )
  /\
  (
    ( |_ ` ( B / 3 ) ) = A
    /\
    ( ( |_ ` ( B / 3 ) ) x. 3 ) = B
  )
) $.

verina-basic-99-triple $a |- A. x e. ZZ
  (
    ( VERINAB99Pre x )
    ->
    (
      VERINAB99Post
        x
        ( VERINAB99Triple x )
    )
  )
$.

% Statement-only formalization of the VERINA corpus artifact verina_basic_99
% (verina__pvs__verina_basic_99), catalog title "Triple": a threshold branch
% computes three times any integer and satisfies its exact integer-division
% correctness contract. This file contains no proof.

verina_basic_99: THEORY
BEGIN

  Triple_precond(x: int): bool =
    TRUE

  % The source precondition proof argument is computationally irrelevant.
  % Both source branches and their local bindings are retained explicitly.
  Triple(x: int): int =
    IF x < 18 THEN
      LET a: int = 2 * x,
          b: int = 4 * x
      IN
        ndiv(a + b, 2)
    ELSE
      LET y: int = 2 * x
      IN
        x + y
    ENDIF

  % The source precondition proof argument is logically irrelevant here.
  Triple_postcond(
      x, result: int): bool =
    ndiv(result, 3) = x
      AND ndiv(result, 3) * 3 = result

  Triple_spec_satisfied: bool =
    FORALL (x: int):
      Triple_precond(x)
        IMPLIES
          Triple_postcond(
            x,
            Triple(x))

END verina_basic_99
